Anyone can perform Brave Fusion. It's simply a sign of the times.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

SD15-006.name: Angeloid

[LV1] (When Summoned)

I have begun training to become an Angelia... Do I really need to put on these wings?
-The Murmurs of Lapis, Second Day of the Fifth Month-

Return every opposing LV1 Spirit to the Hand. For each Spirit returned to the Hand by this effect, put a core from the Void to your Life.

[Ultimate. Archangel. Vaccine]
An Archangel Digimon with the appearance of a beautiful woman

I started repairing the Sword just as Guren-san taught me. But there aren't enough Sphere yet...
-The Murmurs of Lapis, Third Day of the Fifth Month-

[Mega. Seraph. Vaccine]
One of the three great angel Digimon. One of the facets of the Angel Digimon which represents the ultimate "good" is that it can, due to its extremism, be easily tainted with "Evil."

BS01-061.name: Apewhip
BS01-061.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
BS01-061.flavor: Those guys have been shut up in these woods for the evil deeds that they had done all around the forest. However, it seems that they haven't learned anything at all.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A162.effect: Flash- Send up to three cores from your Reserve to a Spirit you control, and draw a card.

BS01-077.name: Baby-Loki
BS01-077.flavor:
I attacked him with all my strength, but it was blocked completely with his hard shell. I stepped back to run from the monster's sharp fangs.
-From the 4th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS01-050.name: Beatbeetle
BS01-050.flavor: If you wander in the woods, you'll see them here and there. They seem to have no interests in the World Tree. I wonder if they ever want to try the fruit.

BS01-074.name: Berserker-Gun
BS01-074.flavor: Are they alive? Or are they machines? The odd beings came from the distorted gate floating in the sky. They are blanketing the world.

BS01-034.name: Bi-Python
BS01-034.flavor: It was an old snake with extensive knowledge that filled them with ideas of rebellion.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A167.name: Binding Thorn
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A167.kanji: バインディングソーン

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A168.name: Binding Woods
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A168.kanji: バインディングウッズ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A168.effect:

(Flash Step)(Your Main Phase) Target spirit gets +5000BP until end of turn.

BS01-035.name: Bone-Gladiator
BS01-035.kanji: ボーン・グラディエイター
BS01-035.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by Green Spirits.
BS01-035.flavor: They were the first ones who showed up there. However, they lost their green power just by standing there, and the field changed itself to the withered world.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A170.effect: Flash- Negate the "cannot block" effect of a Spirit you control.

BS01-010.name: Chakrambat

CB02-001.name: Agumon
CB02-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)

CB02-001.flavor:
[Rookie Level / Reptile Type / Vaccine Attribute]
Partner Digimon of Taichi "Tai" Kamiya. A Reptile Digimon which has an appearance like a tiny dinosaur, and has become able to walk on two legs.

CB02-033.name: Andromon
CB02-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Give this Spirit and all your "Champion" family Spirits: "[Heavy Armor: Purple/White] This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects."

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, this Spirit can't be blocked.
CB02-033.flavor:
[Ultimate. Cyborg. Vaccine]
A human-type Cyborg Digimon

Discard the entire opposing Hand. Then, the opponent can draw a card for each card discarded.

[LV2][LV3]
For each Cost 8 "Mega" family Spirit you control, this Spirit gains an extra Purple symbol.
CB02-059.flavor:
[Mega. Species Unknown. Unknown]
A mysterious Digimon that appeared when negative thoughts gathered through dark power.

BS28-077.name: Binding Root
BS28-077.kanji: バインディングルート
BS28-077.effect:
[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]
For each card the opponent increased when this Burst activates, the opponent discards a card from their Hand. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

Exhaust an opposing Spirit. Or, exhaust every opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.

CB02-003.name: Birdramon
CB02-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Warp Digivolve: Red] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Red "Ultimate" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.
CB02-003.flavor:
[Champion. Giant Bird. Vaccine]
A giant bird type digimon which has an appearance shrouded in blazing flames. Just like Meramon, it is a Digimon that was generated from the Internet's defensive "Firewall". It flaps its gigantic wings, and flies about the sky.

CB02-002.name: Biyomon
CB02-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.

[LV2] [Digivolve: Red] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Red "Champion" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB02-002.flavor:
[Rookie Level / Chick Type / Vaccine Attribute]
Partner Digimon of Sora Takenouchi. A chick Digimon whose wings have developed to become like arms. It is able to dexterously operate its wings and use them to grip objects, but for that reason it is poor at flying in the air.

SD01-039.name: Blizzard Wall
SD01-039.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, your Life can only be reduced by one by the attacks of opposing unblocked Spirits.

SD06-013.name: Burst Draw
SD06-013.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Brave's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Draw two cards. Then by paying the cost, activate this card's Main effect.

[Main]
Draw two cards.

BS05-072.name: Absorb Symbol
BS05-072.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, when cores are placed, or removed from opposing Spirits via Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects, exhaust those Spirits.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A184.name: Alligade
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A184.effect: [LV2] (During Your Turn) Each time 5 or more cards are moved from the top of your opponent's Deck to their Trash at once due to your effect, exhaust target unexhausted spirit your opponent controls.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A184.flavor: There are many bigots in the woods. Some turn back anyone who enters their territory without permission, even when the visitor is one of the Elders.

BS04-051.name: Arcanabeast-Hart
BS04-051.kanji: アルカナビースト・ハルト
BS04-051.effect:
[LV3]
Give all your "Arcana"-named Spirits the effect: "(When Attacks) This Spirit gains +2000 BP."
BS04-051.flavor: It's been found! It's been found in the land of trump!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A186.name: Arcanafighter-Quatre
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A186.kanji: アルカナファイター・カトル
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A186.flavor:
The soldiers are bustling restlessly. I thought they were getting ready for the journey to find the key. But it seems like they were preparing for the Queen's 44th birthday party. They say number 4 is considered to be the lucky number in the land of Trump. Well, congratulations, my lady.
-from the 2nd paragrph in chapter Yellow of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS04-054.name: Arcanasoldier-Cinq
BS04-054.kanji: アルカナソルジャー・サンク
BS04-054.effect:
[LV2] (Opposing Turn)
When the opponent uses any Magic effect that includes this Spirit as target, you can change the target of that Magic effect to only this Spirit.
BS04-054.flavor:
The soldier led us to the palace in a respectful manner. We were finally reaching the key.
-from the 5th paragraph in chapter Yellow of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A188.name: Armetcrab
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A188.effect: [LV1][LV2] Armor : Yellow - This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects of the stated color.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A188.flavor: Floating silently. Without being exhausted, it floats forever. However, it has no power to fight. It just clings to the invader and waits to perish.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A189.name: Banshee
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A189.flavor: Even when we hear a scream of terror, we cannot do anything but only cover our ears and run.

BERSERKER-MAGNUM2.name: Berserker-Magnum
BERSERKER-MAGNUM2.kanji: バーサーカー・マグナム
BERSERKER-MAGNUM2.flavor:
An army of machines filled the valley, surrounding the tower almost completely. I wondered what happened to the other places and whether the resistance was futile. The final and greatest counterattack was about to begin.
-From the 8th paragraph of chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A191.name: BlackMachG
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A191.flavor:
The guide said, "The black ones are huge!" His words immediately reminded me that I had heard exactly the same thing in another world I had visited. I felt that it was not a mere coincidence, as there were a number of common factors; black ones were huge, and unfamiliar dragons were appearing in both worlds.
-from the 4th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS04-029.name: BlackMonoqueiroz
BS04-029.kanji: ブラックモノケイロス
BS04-029.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
During this turn, every "Shellman"/"Shell Insect" family Spirit you control gains +3000 BP.
BS04-029.flavor: Did you hear that they've captured an eagle? They might finally locate the World Tree!

BS05-074.name: Branch Lock
BS05-074.effect:
[Flash]
If there are two or more colors of symbols on your Field, exhaust two opposing Spirits.

BS04-056.name: Braveless-Leo
BS04-056.flavor: Hmm? Do my eyes deceive me? I see a zipper on his back. It's kind of scary.

BRONZE-GOLEM2.name: Bronze-Golem
BRONZE-GOLEM2.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Crush (When Attacks) Move cards from the top of your opponent's Deck to their Trash equal to this spirits LV.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Permanent) Each time a nexus you control would be destroyed, you may move 1 core from this spirit to your Trash. In that case, the nexus remains on your Field instead.
BRONZE-GOLEM2.flavor: According to the designer of this warrior, he was originally designed for the construction. He seems to be aiming at the 1st place in both the competitive exhibition and the crushing competition.

CHAIN-DRAGON2.name: Chain-Dragon
CHAIN-DRAGON2.flavor:
The magical roar a group of dinosaurs emitted was blocked completely by his steel body.
-From the 6th paragraph in chapter Red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A197.name: Chamelewhip
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A197.effect:
[LV1] (Opposing Attack Step) This Spirit can't block.

[LV2] (When Attacks) This Spirit gains +1000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A197.flavor: He blends in with his surroundings and attacks his opponents before they can detect his presence. Isn't it clever? He would be an excellent soldier if he was more obedient.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A198.name: Chorus Birds
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A198.effect:
Main - Move 3 "Song Bird" spirit cards from your Trash to your hand.

Flash - Target spirit gets +2000BP until end of turn.

BS04-015.name: Cyclo-Winder
BS04-015.kanji: サイクロ・ワインダー
BS04-015.flavor:
I've been told that snakes are wise, but I'm beginning to doubt it. This one looks purely aggressive.
-from the 5th paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS04-094.name: Danse Macabre
BS04-094.effect:
[Flash]
Discard any number of cards from your Hand. For each card discarded, send a core from a single opposing Spirit to the Trash.

BS04-004.name: DarkDinohound
BS04-004.kanji: ダークディノハウンド
BS04-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - [Awaken]
You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.

[LV3] (When Attacks)

BS04-004.flavor: Some of the dinosaurs have left the battle. Can those hounds fight in place of them?

BS04-003.name: DarkGoradon
BS04-003.flavor: The ones covered with black scales are huge and violent. Keep away from them.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A203.name: DarkPiyon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A203.flavor: Did you know that song birds act as messengers for all countries? That one may be here to deliver an emergency message.

DRA-GOLEM2.name: Dra-Golem

[LV2] (During Your Battle Phase) Spirits you control with Evolution are treated as being at the following LV depending on the number of cores they have on them
1 core = LV1
2 cores = LV2
3 or more cores = the highest LV they have
DRA-GOLEM2.flavor: Do artisans have infinite originality and ingenuity? Artificial soldiers are usually human-shaped, but this one is dragon-shaped! I'm sure that he's going to get a high artistic score, but can he really compete in weightlifting?

BS04-092.name: Dragons' Rush
BS04-092.effect:
[Main]
During this turn, when only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your "Winged Dragon"/"Dragon"/"Ancient Dragon" family Spirits, refresh that Spirit you control.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

BS04-102.name: Dream Hand
BS04-102.effect:
[Flash]
Return every Cost 1 or less Spirit to its owner's Hand.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A207.name: Duckle
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A207.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks) If this is the first attack this turn, this spirit gets +2000BP until end of turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A207.flavor: Do you know what a chorus is? It's a song you sing in a group. Singing together can help you in battle too.

BS05-045.name: Dwarf-Seven
BS05-045.flavor: If I were a princess, I would hire many good looking guys as my servants. However, I don't think my dad will allow me to do that....

BS05-076.name: Eternal Shield
BS05-076.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, only up to five cards can be discarded from your deck via opposing Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.

FAL-CONDOR2.name: Fal-Condor

[LV1][LV2] (During Your Battle Phase) Each time this spirit defeats a spirit, gain 1 core in your Reserve.

[LV2] (During the Battle Phase) Each time this spirit defeats a spirit, if this spirit is exhausted, refresh this spirit.

IRCANNONMK-II2.name: Fenrircannon Mk-II
IRCANNONMK-II2.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Blocks) When blocking a Spirit at the same Lv, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] Armor:Red/Green - This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects of the stated colors.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A213.name: Giraffen
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A213.flavor: The rowdies are more arrogant than ever, but these easygoing fellows don't seem to care.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A214.name: Glacial Breath
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A214.effect:
(Your Main Phase) Return 2 target spirits you control to the bottom of your Deck in any order. In that case, return 2 target spirits your opponent controls to the bottom of their Deck in any order. This effect cannot be used unless you control a spirit with 2 or more Gems.

(Flash Step)(Your Main Phase) Target spirit with 2 or more Gems gets +5000BP until end of turn.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A215.name: Gleam Hope
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A215.effect:
Main - Target spirit you control gets Brilliance until end of turn.

[Any LV] Brilliance (During Your Battle Phase) While this spirit is battling, each time you play a spell card, at End of Battle Step, move that spell card from your Trash to your hand.

Flash - Target spirit gets +2000BP until end of turn.

BS04-089.name: Great Link
BS04-089.effect:
[Flash]
Send every core from your Trash to a Spirit with [Awaken] you control. This effect can't be used in Main Step.

CB34-022.name: Dragon Orphnoch Dragonoid Form
CB34-022.kanji: ドラゴンオルフェノク 龍人態
CB34-022.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) During your Main Step, if you have eight counters or more, and you control any "Faiz"/"Orphnoch", including being in Soul State, you can summon this card from the Trash.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can send cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve so that one core remains on it. By discarding a card from your Hand, this effect can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Heavy Armor].

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with two cores or less on it.
CB34-022.flavor: A member of Lucky Clover, the Orphnoch that Kitazaki turns into. When compared with Devil Form, it is slimmer and has a more dragon-like appearance due to the countless stripes running down its body.

BS12-004.name: Dragon-Pheasant
BS12-004.kanji: ドラゴン・フェゼント
BS12-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
For each Spirit-condition Brave you control, this Spirit gains +2000 BP.

[LV2]
Every Spirit-condition Brave you control gains +3000 BP.
BS12-004.flavor: "You don't need my guidance anymore, right? Besides, it looks like you've gotten stronger recently. I'll be joining the 'festivities' with the others. See you, Lolo... I hope you can finish your business soon."

CB15-065.name: Dragreder
CB15-065.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Kamen" & "Mounted Warrior" family Spirit effect, or sent to Trash from deck by the effect of your exactly-named "Henshin!! Kamen Rider Ryuki", you can add it to your Hand.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit. Also, when braved to a "Survive"-named Spirit, when this Spirit destroys an opposing Spirit, send an opposing Life to the Trash.
CB15-065.flavor: A red dragon type Mirror Monster that contracted with Kamen Rider Ryuki. While it hunt down Shinji in the beginning, through battling together after making a contract, it seems to have developed a deep bond with Shinji.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A220.name: Duald
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A220.flavor:
"Looking at the story depicted upon the wall painting, I felt I finally began to understand the teachings of the Dark Snakes. The Dragons, the Demonkin, the Rowdy Vandals, the Invaders, the Angels, and the Giants... Their existence is all one and the same, each with the same goal of conquering their respective Gem Worlds. The Sapphire Realm where total conquest has been achieved, the Topaz Realm whose great gates have yet to be opened... And the Ruby Realm's Ancient Dragons? They are Dragons who fought for their right to rule and lost."
-from the 1st paragraph of the final chapter in "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

PC11-X01.name: Evangelion Unit-02 Beast "G" Mode
PC11-X01.kanji: エヴァンゲリオン2号機 ビースト“G”モード
PC11-X01.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as "Godzilla".

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing 30000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, you can discard two "Evangelion"/"Godzilla" from your Hand, and when two cards are discarded, send an opposing Life to the Reserve, and this Spirit refreshes.
PC11-X01.flavor: The berserk form of Evangelion Unit-02 after injecting the G cells into itself and the cells being activated.

PB08-CP02.name: EX Gomora
PB08-CP02.effect:
When this card is revealed or sent to the Trash from your deck by your "Ultraman"-named effect, you can add it to the Hand.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks]
Ignoring the cost and "BP+" of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit and an opposing 13000 BP or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3]
The opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects, and this exhausted Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects.
PB08-CP02.flavor: Rei's primary partner, the ancient kaiju Gomora. Corresponding to Rei's awakening into Reimon, it evolved into its strongest form, EX Gomora.

LM14-01.name: Ex-Mugendra
LM14-01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [SSoul: Red]
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains [Red Core] (an extra Red symbol).

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.
LM14-01.flavor: I remember seeing that little guy. But, he looks a little different. Hm, I suppose that means he's been training too.

BSC26-036.name: Fake Godzilla
BSC26-036.effect:
This Spirit/Spirit card is also treated as [Mecha Godzilla].

[LV1][LV2] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a "MechaGodzilla"/"Type-3 Kiryu"-named Spirit card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.
BSC26-036.flavor:
MechaGodzilla disguised as Godzilla. Its skin tore off while fighting Godzilla, revealing the mechanical body inside.
―Godzilla vs MechaGodzilla (1974)―

FLAME-GUNDRAGNA1.name: Flame-Gundragna
FLAME-GUNDRAGNA1.kanji: フレイム・ガンドラグナー
FLAME-GUNDRAGNA1.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit. If you control any Ultimate, instead, destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit.
FLAME-GUNDRAGNA1.flavor: Why!? Why do you side with the Ultimates, despite being a Spirit yourself!

PC03-002.name: Gabora［S-class Species］
PC03-002.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as “Kaiju”.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can destroy an opposing one-symbol Spirit/Nexus, and the effects of the destroyed Spirit/Nexus can't activate.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When your “Kaiju”/“S-class Species”/“Seijin” depletes/destroys opposing Spirits, you can send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
PC03-002.flavor: S-class Species No. 8. It is highly radioactive, and can close the cover of its head to dig through the ground like a drill.

BS71-CP08.name: Generator Flame
BS71-CP08.kanji: ジェネレイターフレイム
BS71-CP08.effect:
When this card is sent to the Trash from deck by the effect of your "Brahma" Grandwalker Nexuses, you can add it to the Hand. When you've done so, (Once per Turn: Same Name) you can send out one of your "Rig Avatar Dragon" Tokens.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate, and effects of the destroyed target can't activate. By destroying any of your Tokens, for each Token destroyed, increase the limit of this "BP Destruction effect" by +5000.

BS76-006.name: Generator Yajdragon
BS76-006.kanji: ジェネレイターヤージュドラゴン
BS76-006.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Brahma", (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1-2-3] (When Manifests/Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, you can destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit, and the effects of the destroyed target can't activate.

[LV2-3] (When Attacks)
Including being in Soul State, if you control any "Contractor Brahma", you can send out one of your "Rig Avatar Dragon" Tokens.
BS76-006.flavor:
Let's wreak havoc together again for the first time in ages, Brahma! ―Grandwalker Indraー
I thought I said I'd leave it to you. Don't drag me into this! ―Grandwalker Brahma―

BS57-003.name: Genseiryu
BS57-003.effect:
When your Red/White Mirage is set by paying the cost, you can summon this card from the Hand without paying the cost. When you've done so, destroy an opposing Nexus, and draw a card. This effect doesn't stack.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By discarding one of your set cards, destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.
BS57-003.flavor:
Show me the proof of being a king, "Emperor" had said. And Astra, the leader of the Crusaders, talked about his resolve to save the future.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 6:22―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A230.name: Godseeker PrayerDragon Abinaya
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A230.kanji: ゴッドシーカー 祈祷竜アビナヤ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A230.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Brahma"-named Grandwalker Nexus card, and a Red "Celeste"/"Avatar"/"Saga" family card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards in any order to either only the decktop or deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2]
No more than three cards can be discarded from either player's deck per turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A230.flavor: The reason Brahma is helping Uru is because he is unable to leave troubled people alone. But what could the other two Gods be thinking?

CB28-004.name: Godzilla (1954)
CB28-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a "Godzilla" among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Then, once per turn, if you have four counters or more, this Spirit can refresh.
CB28-004.flavor: An ancient kaiju who lives under the sea around Odo Island. As an analogy to the legend passed down on the island, it was named "Godzilla".

LM18-G03.name: Godzilla (1984)
LM18-G03.effect:
While there is any "Godzilla"-named Spirit card in your Trash, this set card is unaffected by opposing effects.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks]
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. For each "Godzilla"-named Spirit you control, increase the limit of this "BP Destruction effect" by +5000. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
LM18-G03.flavor:
The Godzilla that was awakenede by the eruption in Daikoku Island.
-Godzilla(1984)

PB02-G04.name: Godzilla (1994)
PB02-G04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest BP. When this effect destroys, put two cores from the Void to any "Godzilla"-named Spirit(s)/Grandwalker Nexus(es) you control.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Effects of opposing Spirit/Ultimate destroyed by your "Godzilla"-named Spirit/Grandwalker Nexus can't activate.
PB02-G04.flavor:
It absorbed the energy that spread midair from Space Godzilla's crystals and used the Burn Spiral Heat Ray to defeat Space Godzilla.
―Godzilla vs Space Godzilla (1994)―

PB02-G08.name: Godzilla (2004)
PB02-G08.effect:
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, you can pay two costs to summon this card from the Trash.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When you've done so, put a core from the Void to this Spirit, and refresh it.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit/Ultimate would leave the Field, during this turn, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.
PB02-G08.flavor:
Privileged in both power and speed, he boasts an invincible strenght, he is the King of Kaiju.
―Godzilla Final Wars (2004)―

CB28-015.name: Godzilla (Godzilla VS Gigan Rex)
CB28-015.kanji: ゴジラ（ゴジラVSガイガンレクス）
CB28-015.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, destroy four opposing 12000 BP or less Spirits/Ultimates, and when destroys, draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.
CB28-015.flavor: It fought against the huge group of Gigan Miles that invaded the Earth all of a sudden, and their commander, Gigan Rex.

LM18-G04.name: Godzilla (vs Destoroyah)
LM18-G04.kanji: ゴジラ（対デストロイア）
LM18-G04.effect:
Flash- [Accel: Cost 5 ([Red Core][Red Core][Purple Core][Purple Core])]
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up on the Removed Zone.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can discard two cards from your decktop. For each "Godzilla"/"Destoroyah"-named Spirit card discarded, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.
LM18-G04.flavor:
The atomic energy within its body ran rampant and Godzilla entered meltdown state.
-Godzilla vs Destoroyah (1995)

BS01-145.name: Defensive Aura
BS01-145.kanji: ディフェンシブオーラ
BS01-145.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, give all your blocking Spirits +3000 BP.
sets: Let'S Play Battle Spirits!! Starter Kit

BS01-117.name: Double Draw
BS01-117.effect:
[Main]
Draw two cards.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.
sets: Let'S Play Battle Spirits!! Starter Kit

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A242.name: Dream Chest
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A242.effect: (Flash Step)(Your Main Phase) Move target spirit to the top of its owner's deck.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A244.name: Dream Ribbon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A244.effect: Flash - Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

DUALCANNON-BELL2.name: Dualcannon-Bell
DUALCANNON-BELL2.kanji: デュアルキャノン・ベル
DUALCANNON-BELL2.flavor: They are the guards of the gate of distortion. The gate of distortion comes and goes most unexpectedly. So, do they.

BS01-005.name: Eyeburn
BS01-005.flavor:
When I saw a one-eyed dragon attacking from the sky, the only thing that hit my mind was a spell that I just learned on this island. My quivering lips whispered "Flame Dance".
-from the 2nd paragraph in chapter Red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo.
sets: Let'S Play Battle Spirits!! Starter Kit

BS01-121.name: Flame Dance
BS01-121.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy a 4000 BP or less Spirit.
sets: Let'S Play Battle Spirits!! Starter Kit

BS01-001.name: Goradon
BS01-001.flavor: The disagreeable dragons and the extremely violent dinosaurs. The people who were caught between them had no choice but to become their followers.

BS01-075.name: Icemaiden
BS01-075.flavor: He is an invader from another world. The roaring sound from his body transforms the field in reaction. The color of the lives are fading away little by little.

BS01-019.name: Jurassickle
BS01-019.flavor:
I prepared for death when it flung up its scythe-looking arms. At that moment, no one could predict that it would let me live.
-from the 4th paragraph in chapter red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
sets: Let'S Play Battle Spirits!! Starter Kit

BS01-006.name: Merat
BS01-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Start Step)
Send a core from this Spirit to the Reserve. Besides via Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects, when cores are put onto this Spirit, it can't attack that turn.
BS01-006.flavor: Dragons were happy with his performance. However, it didn't take long before they found out that it was a vain delight.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A262.name: Offensive Aura
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A262.effect: Flash- During this turn, all your attacking Spirits gain +2000 BP.

LM17-07.name: The AprilYoungClown Fool-Bang-Kid
LM17-07.kanji: 四月幼化フール・バング・キッズ
LM17-07.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Add a White Spirit card with [Advent] among them to the Hand. Return the remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can [Advent] a White Spirit card from your Hand onto a White Spirit you control.
LM17-07.flavor:
The White YoungClown and YoungGoddess are all born from concealed ice crystals.
-from the separated chapter of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A265.name: Rabicrysta
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A265.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by Red Spirits.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A265.flavor: They search for the invaders' activities using their invisible bodies.

LM17-05.name: The AugustYoungSovereign Augustar-Kid
LM17-05.kanji: 八月幼皇アウグスター・キッズ
LM17-05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Add a Green Spirit card with [Advent] among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can [Advent] a Green Spirit card from your Hand onto a Green Spirit you control.
LM17-05.flavor:
The Green Young Sovereign and Young King were born in the center of the swirling gust of wind.
-from the separated chapter of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BS01-076.name: Ray-Bullet
BS01-076.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
While you control any "Armored Dragon" family Spirit, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
BS01-076.flavor: Someone found a distortion in a vacant place. The invaders came from another world through the distortion to bring an end to this world.
sets: Let'S Play Battle Spirits!! Starter Kit

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A270.name: The DarkStones DarkfearSlashDeity Dinovenge
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A270.kanji: 闇輝石六将 冥恐斬神ディノヴェンジ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A270.effect:
[Unleash: 2, Dark] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total of 12000 BP. This effect can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Armor]. Then, when your Field & Trash have [Red cards & 7 cards or more], by sending two cores from any of your Red Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit, send an opposing Life to the Void.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
Your exhausted Cost 6 or more "Terra Dragon" family Spirits gain +5000 BP and are unaffected by opposing effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A270.flavor: "My Avatar, Dinovenge, rules the Dark Stones and governs fear."

BS01-002.name: Rokceratops
BS01-002.flavor: The battlefield was filled with hundreds of thousands of Rokceratops that were proudly raising a shout of victory.

BS42-X03.name: The DarkStones HundredSwordsBushin Gogmazan
BS42-X03.kanji: 闇輝石六将 百刀武神ゴクマザン
BS42-X03.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

When your "Divine Weapon" family Brave is summoned, you can stack this card from your Hand onto that Brave Spirit or Brave via [Advent], without sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash.

[LV2] [deh: Hell] (Opposing Turn)
When your Field and Trash is [Green cards only & 5 cards or more], all opposing Spirits can't refresh and cores on them can't be brought to zero.
BS42-X03.flavor: The darkness which has stolen the power of origin. Green governs Hoariness.

BS01-013.name: Taurusknight
BS01-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - [Awaken]
You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.
BS01-013.flavor: They say that this supporter is capricious and only money can draw out his real power.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A276.name: The DarkStones ImaginaryBeastDeity Kirynx
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A276.kanji: 闇輝石六将 幻想獣神キリンクス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A276.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit is depleted/destroyed by opposing effects, by putting a core from the Void to this Spirit, it remains on the Field, exhausted. Then, you can summon an "Imaginary Beast" family card from your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] [deh: Hell] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. Or, if your Field and Trash are [Yellow cards only & 5 cards or more], draw until you have five cards in Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A276.flavor: The darkness which has stolen the power of origin. Yellow governs Sloth.

BS01-078.name: The AutoLady Mani
BS01-078.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send a core from your Trash to your Reserve.
BS01-078.flavor: Shivering body of glass. The girl keeps working even with her body undermined. Just for the one who supports the world.

BS43-X04.name: The DarkStones MachineBeastDeity Fenrig
BS43-X04.kanji: 闇輝石六将 機械獣神フェンリグ
BS43-X04.effect:
[Burst: s] (After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect)
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, if the opposing Hand has increased by two or more at once, or there are six or more cards in their Hand, target four cards in their Hand/Removed Zone/Field, and return every card other than those to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2][LV3] [deh: Heaven] (When Attacks)
When your Field and Removed Zone are [White cards only & 4 cards or more], you can return an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the Hand. When you've done so, refresh this Spirit.
BS43-X04.flavor: The darkness which has stolen the power of origin. White governs failure.

BS01-111.name: The Diamond Moon
BS01-111.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When blocked by opposing Red Spirits, or when blocking an opposing Spirit, your Spirits get +1000 BP.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Destroy the opposing Red Spirit that battled with your Spirit at the end of the battle.
BS01-111.flavor:
The other moon that can partially be seen from the gate of distortion. It gives off cold lights as it takes the lives of all the living things.
-From the Places of Interest 612/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS44-X06.name: The DarkStones SandseaPirateDeity Pharaom
BS44-X06.kanji: 闇輝石六将 砂海賊神ファラオム
BS44-X06.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned/Advents) effect resolves]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, destroy an opposing Spirit with a (When Summoned/Advents) effect, and if it's the Opposing Turn, end the turn.

[LV2][LV3] [Dark Esoterica - Heaven] (Your Attack Step)
When your Field & Removed Zone is [Blue cards only & 5 cards or more], while your Blue Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't use reduction symbols to reduce costs.
BS44-X06.flavor: The darkness which has stolen the power of origin. Blue governs deprivation.

BS01-100.name: The Ruby Sun
BS01-100.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When using a White card, unless the player pay one extra cost, it can't be used.

[LV2]
Besides via Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects, when cores are put onto, or removed from a White Spirit, exhaust it.
BS01-100.flavor:
The 2nd sun summoned by the dragons which refuses the night and forces people to keep being active.
-from the Places of Interest 531/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A285.name: The SilverScale Nithhoggr
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A285.flavor: Gentle dragons who love peace. They confront the invaders with their silver body.

BS42-X02.name: The DarkStones VioletCorpseDragonGod Daimezak
BS42-X02.kanji: 闇輝石六将 紫骸龍神ダイムザーク
BS42-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return any number of Spirit cards with [Accel] from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
Each Purple [Accel] in your Hand is treated as Cost 2 ([Purple Core]).

[LV2][LV3] [deh: Heaven] (When Attacks)
When your Field and Removed Zone is [Purple cards only & 10 cards or more], send two opposing Lives to the Void, and put two cores from the Void to your Life.
BS42-X02.flavor: The darkness which has stolen the power of origin. Purple governs Death.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A288.name: Towermittcrab
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A288.effect: [LV1][LV2] (Permanent) This spirit gets +1000BP for each nexus you control.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A288.flavor: They are the watchers of this world. They watch out for the invaders keeping still.

LM17-11.name: The DecemberYoungEndGod Chronodec-Kid
LM17-11.kanji: 十二月幼神クロノデック・キッズ
LM17-11.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Add a Blue Spirit card with [Advent] among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can [Advent] a Blue Spirit card from your Hand onto a Blue Spirit you control.
LM17-11.flavor:
The Blue Young God and Young Saint were born from the undulating water surface.
-from the separated section of "New Record of the Strange World"-

LM17-03.name: The FebruaryYoungMarquis Regifu-Gium-Kid
LM17-03.kanji: 二月幼侯レギフ・ギウム・キッズ
LM17-03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Add a Purple Spirit card with [Advent] among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can [Advent] a Purple Spirit card from your Hand onto a Purple Spirit you control.
LM17-03.flavor:
The Purple Young Marquis and Young Knight are born from darkness darker than darkness.
-from the separated section of "New Record of the Strange World"-

LM17-01.name: The JanuaryYoungPrimalGod Dianus-Kid
LM17-01.kanji: 一月幼神ディアヌス・キッズ
LM17-01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
