PX18-01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to an opposing effect, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can send four cores from any Red Grandwalker Nexuses you control to the Void. When you've done so, destroy four opposing 15000 BP or less Spirits/Ultimates. Cores on the Spirits/Ultimates destroyed by this effect are sent to the Trash, not the Reserve.
PX18-01.flavor: This being was once defeated by Apollon and, now burning with flames with rage, has turned into a Collapse Deity.

PX18-02.name: The CollapseGoddess Ruler-Themis
PX18-02.kanji: 崩女神ルーラー・テミス
PX18-02.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Heavy Armor: Red/Purple/Green/Yellow]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/Green/Yellow Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can send four cores from any of your White Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void. When you've done so, during the next (Your Turn), the (Core Step), (Main Step) and (Attack Step) are turned into (Draw Step).
PX18-02.flavor: One who once was called the Goddess of Law entrusts herself to the power of Collapse.

PX18-05.name: The CollapsePhantomGoddess Mitera-Tethys
PX18-05.kanji: 崩幻女神ミテラ・テテュス
PX18-05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit/Ultimate -5000 BP. For each Yellow Spirit you control, activate this effect once, and destroy all Spirits/Ultimates who are brought to 0 BP by this effect.

[LV2][LV3] Flash -
You can send four cores from any of your Yellow Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void. When you've done so, during this turn, the LV1/LV2/LV3/LV4/LV5/LV6 BP of all opposing Spirits/Ultimates becomes 1000 BP.
PX18-05.flavor: The one that, once upon a time, created many of their companions together with Magnu-Okeanos. The mother of the collapse deities.

PX18-06.name: The CollapseSeaDeity Magne-Okeanos
PX18-06.kanji: 崩海神マグヌ・オケアノス
PX18-06.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can send four cores from any of your Blue Grandwalker Nexuses to Void. When you've done so, discard 10 cards from the opposing decktop. Also, if your opposing Hand is five or more, by discarding the entire opposing Hand, the opponent draws two cards.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy two opposing Cost 5 or less Spirits.
PX18-06.flavor: Once upon a time, it ruled over the ocean. After being defeated by Poseidon, he turned into a collapse deity.

SD48-X01.name: The CreatorDragon Generator Dragon
SD48-X01.kanji: 創造龍ジェネレイタードラゴン
SD48-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit, and you can pay one cost to summon a Saga Brave card from your Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
You can separate a Brave from a Grandwalker Nexus you control and brave it to this Spirit. When you've done so, this Spirit refreshes.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Spirits/Grandwalker Nexuses braved to Saga Braves you control gain an extra Red symbol.
SD48-X01.flavor: "Saga! Creation! Change the world, Generator Dragon!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A330.name: The CreatorDragonDeity Generator Dragon-Zero
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A330.kanji: 創聖神龍ジェネレイタードラゴン・ゼロ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A330.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return up to three "Creation" family cards from your Hand/Removed Zone to the decktop. When this effect returned at least one card, destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Genesis] (When Attacks)
You can reveal cards from your decktop until you reveal a "Creation" family card (You can repeat this up to three times). Put one core from your Field/Red Grandwalker Nexuses to each of those cards to summon them. Discard any remaining cards.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A330.flavor: "Create the future of the Divine World! Generator Dragon-Zero!!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A331.name: The CreatorSacredBeast Unite-Horn
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A331.kanji: 創神獣 ユナイト・ホーン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A331.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 3 or more] ((Your Turn))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
When you send cards to the Trash via [Core Charge], you can add all those cards to the Hand. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[Unleash: 1] [LV3] (When Attacks)
By discarding one pre-advent card under this Spirit, or by sending one core from any of your Grandwalker Nexus to this Spirit, this Spirit can't be blocked.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A331.flavor: "You're my Avatar? Then, let us go, Unite-Horn!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A332.name: The CrimsonMoonDragon Strike-Siegwurm-Sagitta
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A332.kanji: 月紅龍ストライク・ジークヴルム・サジッタ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A332.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your Life or the opposing Life is reduced, draw a card.

[Unleash: 1] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects. Also, by putting one core from any Grandwalker Nexus you control to this Spirit, destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit destroys any opposing Spirit/Ultimate, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A332.flavor: The power of Sagittarius pushes the Moon into further heights.

SD44-X02.name: The DarkKingMachineBeast Darkness-Griffon X
SD44-X02.kanji: 黒皇機獣ダークネス・グリフォンX
SD44-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Besides [Soul Core], you can send two cores from your Trash to one of your White Grandwalker Nexuses. Also, discard an opposing Burst.
[Rush: God]
(While you have a God symbol, the effect below activates next)
[Core]: Return two opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.
[Rush: God]
(While you have a God symbol, the effect below activates next.)
[Core]: You can draw a card.
SD44-X02.flavor: Please tell Rutile I am so thankful for her help, Darkness-Griffon!

BS60-X05.name: The DawnKnightLord God-Yggdrasil
BS60-X05.kanji: 黎明の騎神ゴッド・イグドラシル
BS60-X05.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" & "Armed Machine" family effect, you can immediately activate the following Burst.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit attacks]
Until your next Start Step, your "Astroblazer" & "Armed Machine"/"Mounted Warrior" family Spirits are unaffected by opposing effects. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[Unleash: 2] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the deckbottom. Then, by sending two cores from any of your White-only Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit, this Spirit refreshes.
BS60-X05.flavor: The Dawn and the Doom. The pair of gods create the world, and end the world.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A335.name: The DestroyerDragonDeity Valdrum
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A335.kanji: 破壊神龍ヴァルドラム
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A335.effect:
Flash - [Grand Advent: Death Dragon & Cost 6 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By either sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, or putting a core from your Grandwalker Nexus to a Spirit you control, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Destroy every Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus, except this Spirit. If you have four or more face-down cards on your Removed Zone, this effect doesn't destroy your Spirits/Nexuses.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
By banishing four face-down cards on your Removed Zone, send an opposing Life to their Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A335.flavor: "Shall my great Avatar destroy it all? What do you say, Valdrum?"

BS49-X01.name: The DinosaurBushin Murakumo Rex
BS49-X01.kanji: 恐龍武神ムラクモレックス
BS49-X01.effect:
[Unleash: 2, Celestial] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can send two cores from any of your Red/Blue Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit. When you've done so, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's. Also, if you control any Blue symbols, send two cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void, and once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit destroys any opposing Spirit/Ultimate, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
BS49-X01.flavor: "My other half, the red Avatar, Murakumo Rex! Mow down the enemy!"

BS14-X01.name: The DragonHero Sieg-Yamato-Fried
BS14-X01.kanji: 龍の覇王ジーク・ヤマト・フリード
BS14-X01.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
When your Life is at three or less, destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit.

[LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
If you have a Burst set, destroy an opposing Spirit with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.
BS14-X01.flavor: He opened up a clear path through both armies in one fell blow! That must be Flame Shield's commander!

SD44-X01.name: The DragonShineDeity Shining-Dragon-Overray X
SD44-X01.kanji: 龍輝神シャイニング・ドラゴン・オーバーレイX
SD44-X01.effect:
While your Life is three or less, this card becomes Cost 6.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Every "Fencer" family Spirit you control can brave with up to two Braves.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Turn)
When any opposing Spirit is destroyed, this Spirit refreshes.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit. Also, while you control any Red Grandwalker Nexus, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.
SD44-X01.flavor: Lapis, I would make your wish come true, together with Overray!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A339.name: The EvilCapricornusDeity Stein-Bolg X
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A339.kanji: 魔羯邪神シュタイン・ボルグX
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A339.effect:
This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return a "Galaxian" family card from your Trash to the Hand.

[Unleash: 2, Astral] [LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Galaxian" family Spirit attacks, send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve. Also, by putting two cores from your six-colored Grandwalker Nexuses to any Spirits, during this turn, cores which this effect would send to the Reserve and opposing Lives which would be sent to the Reserve are sent to the Trash instead.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A339.flavor: Capricorn can also guide powers other than that of the stars.

PB33-007.name: The FineWeatherCharisma Super Agressive Churupa
PB33-007.kanji: 快晴のカリスマ 超アグレッシブちゅるぱ
PB33-007.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can't be destroyed via BP comparison. Also, while there is any six-colored Spirit card among this Spirit's pre-advent cards, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Magic effects.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attacks Step)
Once per turn, either draw a card, or put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Then, if it's the opposing Attack Step, refresh this Spirit.
PB33-007.flavor: "Nice attack...I won't let you call me an apprentice anymore, ruff!"

BS51-XX02.name: The GenesisSacredDragon Unite-Lolo-Dragon
BS51-XX02.kanji: 創世神龍ユナイト・ロロ・ドラゴン
BS51-XX02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put three cores from the Void to this Spirit. Then, you can summon any number of "Avatar" family Spirit cards/Ultimate cards from your Hand/Trash, paying one cost for each.

[Unleash: 1, Creator] [LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By putting a core from any "Alex"-named Grandwalker Nexus you control to this Spirit, during this turn, every "Avatar" family Spirit/Ultimate you control is treated as being on its highest level.
BS51-XX02.flavor: “You two also fused!? Well, I guess you would…”

BS61-X05.name: The GiantArmorSacredBeast Tepeyollotl
BS61-X05.kanji: 巨甲神獣テペヨロトル
BS61-X05.effect:
This card in Removed Zone becomes Cost 4. When this card is summoned from the Removed Zone, you can -2 opposing counters.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Ultimate Heavy Armor: Red/Purple/Yellow/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/Yellow/Blue effects.

[Unleash: 2] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit can't be destroyed by BP comparison. Also, you can send two cores from any of your White Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit. When you've done so, immediately activate one of the [Grand Skill] of your "Grandwalker Tezcatlipoca", treating cores as being sent to the Void.
BS61-X05.flavor: Show yourself, my avatar, Tepeyollotl...Let's test your abilities!

BS60-066.name: Alexandria-Golem
BS60-066.kanji: アレキサンドリア・ゴレム
BS60-066.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard three cards from the opposing decktop. For each counter you have, this "opposing deck discarding effect" discards +1 card (Max. +5).

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, if you have a Mirage set, this Spirit can refresh.
BS60-066.flavor:
"You may go. And from now on, the Tower's kin would not assist Chronos anymore..."
The-Tower looks up to the heaven, and announces such.

BS58-057.name: Antwerp-Golem
BS58-057.kanji: アンヴェルス・ゴレム
BS58-057.effect:
When summoning this card from the Hand, if you have any Blue Mirage set, treat it as Cost 4.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
For each card in the opposing Hand, discard a card from the opposing decktop.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Proximate"/“Astroblazer” & "Artificial Soldier" family Spirit attacks, discard a card from the opposing decktop.
BS58-057.flavor:
Facing the golems' attacks, our forces were forced to split and divide. Their tactics were also clever that knowing we had a bigger force, they aimed straight at our command center. And eventually a single strike from "Tower" had us all caught.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 7:27―

BS58-056.name: Bern-Golem
BS58-056.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to your Nexus/Grandstone Nexus.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void each to this Spirit and a "Proximate" & "Artificial Soldier" family Spirit you control.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Discard two cards from the opposing decktop.
BS58-056.flavor: "A call is received from the end of time. The oracle of 'Chariot' has moved. Surveillance would be continued."

BS60-067.name: Brick-Golem
BS60-067.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
If you control any Blue Nexus, you can put two cores from the Void to any of your "Proximate" family Spirits.

[LV2][LV3]
Once per turn, when this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, by discarding a card from the opposing decktop, it remains on the Field, exhausted.
BS60-067.flavor: It is tasked with securing the lands. Destroying civilizations, and return the lands to its pure state. The destruction is unstoppable, until the day its mission is completed.

BS59-025.name: Caucasus Eagle
BS59-025.kanji: コーカサス・イーグル
BS59-025.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Summoned)
Put two cores from the Void to any Spirits/exactly-named "Rin Jivre" you control.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't activate Burst effects.
[Rush: Green/Yellow]
(While you have Green/Yellow symbols, the following effect activate next)
[Green Core][Green Core][Yellow Core][Yellow Core]: Once per turn, draw a card from the deckbottom, and this Spirit refreshes.
BS59-025.flavor: At the same time when Polluc arrived at Chronos' Fortress, light was emitted from the Wise World Tree, and at the moment, Parvati's world connected with the Gap of Time.

BS58-059.name: Chartres-Golem
BS58-059.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Artificial Soldier" family Spirit activates an "opposing deck discarding" effect, and no cards are discarded due to opposing effects, during this battle, the Spirit that activated that effect gains an extra Blue symbol, and can't be blocked.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard six cards from the opposing decktop. For each "Artificial Soldier" family Spirit you control, increase the number of cards to be discarded by this "opposing deck discarding" effect by +1.
BS58-059.flavor: "Don't think that bombardment warfare is exclusive to chariots. Even a tower can turn into a barrel."

BS13-058.name: Chihyu
BS13-058.effect:
[When Braved] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by discarding five cards from your decktop, put a core from the Void to your Life, and this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing LV1/LV2 Spirits.
BS13-058.flavor:
Even the pivotal braves of the war appear to have returned home after the Star Finale.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS59-058.name: Cologne-Golem
BS59-058.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard four cards from the opposing decktop, and for each Nexus card discarded, during this turn, every Magic card in the opposing Hand/Removed Zone gets +1 cost.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
By destroying any number of "Artificial Soldier" family Spirits you control, summon a "Proximate"/“Astroblazer” & "Artificial Soldier" family Spirit card with a cost equal or inferior to the combined cost of the Spirits destroyed by this effect from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BS59-058.flavor: "Now that The-Tower has fallen, it probably isn't meaningful for us to fight anymore."

BS59-036.name: Cosmo Mastodon
BS59-036.effect:
Flash - [Mirage: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core])]
[During Set] (When Set)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Swap any number of cards in your Hand with "Machine Beast" family cards, or White cards with Mirage effect among them. Return the revealed cards to the deckbottom. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (End of Your Attack Step)
After the Step ends, an additional Draw Step or Refresh Step occurs only once.
BS59-036.flavor:
Chronos' palace is breaking apart, and the space-time is reverting back to what era it is supposed to be in. We can go back. It is by the moment I realized such fact that I finally feel that we've won.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 8:36―

BS56-009.name: Cosmo Raiser Dragon
BS56-009.kanji: コスモライザードラゴン
BS56-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy two opposing Spirits/Ultimates with "Armor"-named effects. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By discarding one of your Mirage, during this battle, this Spirit's symbol is fixed at three Red symbols.
BS56-009.flavor:
The puzzling action of The-Star has brought chaos to the battlefield. Taking such chance, Alex takes my hand and leaves the battlefield. Wait, where are we going, Alex?!
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5:39―

BS58-033.name: Cosmo Saber Tiger -Huma Mode-
BS58-033.kanji: コスモサーベルタイガー -ヒューマモード-
BS58-033.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
You can return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom. Then, you can immediately end the battle.

[LV2][LV3]
While your Hand has five or less cards, your Hand is unaffected by opposing effects, and when this Spirit would leave the Field by opposing effects, it can remain on the Field, exhausted.
BS58-033.flavor: "Oh, recently I've seen the Chariot City moving. Um...Ah, I think...it is heading towards End-Of-Journey? People say that's the Tower's city. You will understand when you see it."

BS58-082.name: Flow Light Petal
BS58-082.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned/Advents) effect resolves]
Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the decktop. Then by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
During this turn, every opposing Spirit/Ultimate can't attack. Also, if it is the opposing Attack Step, by sending three cores from an exactly-named "Grandwalker Parvati" you control to the Void, immediately end the battle.

BS56-039.name: Fortresster Emperor
BS56-039.kanji: フォートレスターエンペラー
BS56-039.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon any number of "Proximate" & "Machine Beast" family Spirit cards. Discard any remaining cards. While you have a White Mirage set, add one of the cards discarded by this effect to the Hand.

[LV2]
When this Spirit would leave the Field by opposing effects, it can remain on the Field, refreshed.
BS56-039.flavor:
The inquiry by the Spacetime Police has started. Seemingly a basic skill to them, they casually sucked a great deal of information up from the local Machine Beasts in a few seconds.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5:31―

SD63-CP01.name: Grandwalkers Gallet & Varte
SD63-CP01.kanji: 創界神ガレット＆ヴァルト
SD63-CP01.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (War Dragon/Clever Machine/Proximate/Astroblazer & Cost 3 or more)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same name as this Nexus, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Field] [LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
You can destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. Or, you can put a core from the Void to any of your Red-White dual color Grandwalker Nexus. This [Grand Field] doesn't stack.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) Return an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit to the Hand. Or, return a "Lord" family card from the Trash to your Hand.

BS58-068.name: Hercules-Golem
BS58-068.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2] (When Reborn)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest cost.

[LV2]
Once per turn, when this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, it can remain on the Field in the same state.
BS58-068.flavor:
"Those who defy the gods shall perish. Those who ride the Chariot shall also perish. This is where your journey ends."
The blue tower has turned into a humanoid form in split seconds. He stretches his right arm, and aims with his huge bow. Oh my goodness. If we take that shot we are done. Our journey would truly end here.

BS59-009.name: Lagrange Dragon
BS59-009.kanji: ラグランジュ・ドラゴン
BS59-009.effect:
Main - [Accel: Cost 3 ([Red Core][Red Core])]
Return a "Machine Dragon"/"Exalted Sword" family Brave card from the Trash to your Hand. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto your Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Spirits braved to "Exalted Sword" family Braves you control are unaffected by opposing Nexus/Magic effects.
BS59-009.flavor:
Receiving a strong boost by the remaining galaxian spirits guided by Wheel-of-Fortune, Sagittarius, Leo, and myself launched ourselves forward and turned into a ray of light.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 8:33―

BS60-033.name: Longhorn Falcon
BS60-033.kanji: ロングホーンファルコン
BS60-033.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By sending two cores from any of your "Rin Jivre" to the Void, summon this card from your Hand, without paying the cost. This effect doesn't trigger [Core Charge].

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Winged Beast"/"Hunter Beast" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.
BS60-033.flavor: Polluc has become light. And she responds to it. We would show the way. I do wonder, could we do it as good as that kid did? We are two but one. Although we couldn't have gone together by then, we would combine our power this time.

BS57-035.name: Mega-Toutatis
BS57-035.effect:
While you have a Mirage set, this set card is unaffected by opposing effects.

[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]
Return two opposing 7000 BP or less Spirits/Ultimates to the Hand. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost. Then, if the opposing Hand is five or more, and it's the opposing turn, immediately end this step.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.
BS57-035.flavor:
A resonance phenomenon of Mirage. With the surprising counter attack from the machine beasts, the Ultimate seemed to have lost his interest and flew away.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 6:12―

BSC47-008.name: Muruga-ChickenKnight
BSC47-008.kanji: ムルガ・チキンナイト
BSC47-008.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
[During Set] (When Set)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) During this turn, when you're summoning/deploying "Parvati", or "Hunter Beast" family cards, treat one of its [Yellow Core] reduction symbols as fulfilled.

[During Set] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced, you can send a card from your decktop to the Trash. If that card is "Parvati", or a "Devotee"/"Hunter Beast" family card, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -10000 BP, and destroy it when it is brought to 0 BP.
BSC47-008.flavor:
Seems like that power of mine is needed after all...
―Grandwalker Parvati―

BS58-027.name: Nenue-Falco
BS58-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can put a core from the Void to any Green/Yellow Spirit you control.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Yellow.

[LV2] 2 (When Attacks)
Heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates. [heb]
BS58-027.flavor:
Although our purpose of coming to the Holy Capital was just to obtain knowledge about the Oracles, we were fortunate enough to have ran into some miracles. The "Hierophant", who don't really show up in the world, manifested himself before us, and offered to accompany us on our journey.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 7:15―

BS57-052.name: Palast Golem
BS57-052.effect:
When this card is discarded by an opposing "deck-discarding" effect, during this turn, your deck can't be discarded, and return up to three cards from your Trash to the decktop only or deckbottom only.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit. Then, if you have a Blue Mirage set, put a core from the Void to any Nexus you control.
BS57-052.flavor:
"Gyagyagyagya. Y'all need some help? I AM Gary-Harius! I heard that my foolish brother, Sharcook, was taken good care of!" Such levity. It's Space Pirate again.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 6:18―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A387.name: Past Isis
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A387.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at six or less]

This card is also treated as being exactly-named "Grandwalker Isis", and the symbol and reduction symbols of this card/Ultimate are also treated as Yellow.

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned)
You can draw a card from the deckbottom.

[LV3][LV4][LV5] [Rebirth5]
When the opposing Life is reduced, or this Ultimate would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can flip this Ultimate. (Cores on it are sent to the Reserve.)
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A387.flavor: "Brother, welcome back. I have been a good girl!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A388.name: Past Set
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A388.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at two or more]

This card is also treated as being exactly-named "Grandwalker Set", and the symbol and reduction symbols of this card/Ultimate are also treated as Blue.

[LV3][LV4] [Rebirth5]
When the opposing Life is reduced, or this Ultimate would leave the Field due to the opponent, You can flip it. (Send all cores on it to the Reserve.)

[LV4] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A388.flavor: "Power is the very Truth! And I am the very War God that shields the king!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A389.name: Past Thoth
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A389.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at two or more]

This card is also treated as being exactly-named “Grandwalker Thoth”, and the symbol and reduction symbols of this card/Ultimate are also treated as White.

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Spirit with three cores or less on it to the deckbottom.

[LV4] [Rebirth5]
When the opposing Life is reduced, or this Ultimate would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can flip this Ultimate. (Cores on it are sent to the Reserve.)
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A389.flavor: "Book is good stuff. A Grandwalker-to-be got to be smart. Right, Horus?"

BS58-007.name: Schwarzer Dragon
BS58-007.kanji: シュバルツァードラゴン
BS58-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Neither player can use cards from Hand outside of Flash Timing.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Neither player can activate [Rebirth].

[LV2]
When you set a Mirage, during this turn, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.
BS58-007.flavor:
The demonstration of power that the SunStarDragons risked their lives on had brought not only victory to us, but also inspirations on how to use the powers. Setting "Tower" in its reversed position, the gate opened. Right in front of the shining door, Polluc announced, "Back to the future we go. For the final fight."
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 7:40―

BS58-061.name: Strasbourg-Golem
BS58-061.kanji: ストラスブール・ゴレム
BS58-061.effect:
While you have a Mirage set, this set card can't be discarded by the opponent.

[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the opponent]
Ignoring the costs of Braves, destroy two opposing Cost 7 or less Spirits/Ultimates. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Discard two cards from the opposing decktop.
BS58-061.flavor:
Seeing us all collapsed, The-Tower let his guard down and stood alone. Taking advantage of this, we finally succeeded in obtaining the power of "Tower".
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 7:29―

BS57-033.name: Synchroid Baihu
BS57-033.kanji: シンクロイド・バイフー
BS57-033.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core][Red Core])]
[During Set] (Start of Your Attack Step)
During this turn, an "Astroblazer" & "Machine Beast" family Spirit you control can't be blocked.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard an opposing Burst.
BS57-033.flavor:
Ultimate? I remember reading from some books about it. They are beings that normal spirits are no match for.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 6:10―

BS59-032.name: Synchroid Sarchus
BS59-032.kanji: シンクロイド・サルクス
BS59-032.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 5 ([White Core][White Core][White Core])]
Return two opposing 10000 BP or less Spirits to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto your Removed Zone.

[Mirage: Cost 7 ([White Core][White Core][White Core][White Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, refresh a "Machine Beast" family Spirit you control, and during this turn, that Spirit gains an extra White symbol.
BS59-032.flavor: "Chronos' sodiers are springing up without an end. Then it is up to us machines to hold them back!"

BS58-035.name: Synchroid-CaveLion
BS58-035.kanji: シンクロイド・ケイブリオン
BS58-035.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 5 ([White Core][White Core])]
[During Set] [msyn: Machine Beast] (Your Attack Step)
Every "Machine Beast" family Spirit you control also activates its (Your/Opposing/Either Attack Step) Mirage effects.

[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
Every "Astroblazer" & "Machine Beast" family Spirit you control gains an extra White symbol.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Blocks)
You can return an opposing Nexus to the deckbottom.
BS58-035.flavor: "We have achieved an evolution that was not possible originally. We are prepared even if it means to be pulverized."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A395.name: Synchroid-Moa
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A395.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
Once per turn, refresh two "Astroblazer" family Spirits you control.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, you can set a White Spirit card with Mirage effects from your Hand without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] [Heavy Armor: Green/White/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Green/White/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A395.flavor: The forces of the new generation Machine Beasts would probably become something that can't be ignored in the future.

BS56-042.name: The AbandonedUnit Disposal-Mammoth
BS56-042.kanji: 廃棄体ディスポーサル・マンモス
BS56-042.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the opponent]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, if it is the opposing turn, when this battle ends, end the Attack Step.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. While you have any White Mirage set, this effect can only be prevented by "Armor"-named effects.
BS56-042.flavor:
Following Mandi's orders, we moved altogether. The destination was the Red World. Alex, who was heavy-footed for some reason, rode on an elephant and departed.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5:33―

BS58-TX02.name: The AncestralMachineBeast Ark-Pteryx
BS58-TX02.kanji: 始祖機獣アーク・プテリクス
BS58-TX02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can discard an opposing Burst. Then, you can set a White Spirit card with Mirage effects from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] [Rebirth5]
When this Spirit attacks, if you have a "Machine Beast" family Mirage set, you can flip it.
BS58-TX02.flavor: No good. We can't break through the barrier formed by the Bal-Masques, Space Pirates, and The-Tower's kins. We are just one step from it...Anything...anything can do the final push?

BS58-TX02-A398.name: The AncestralMachineBeast Ark-Pteryx -Huma Mode-
BS58-TX02-A398.kanji: 始祖機獣アーク・プテリクス -ヒューマモード-
BS58-TX02-A398.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
You can return two opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the deckbottom. Then, if you have fewer cards in your Hand than your opponent, the opponent discards cards from their Hand until they have the same number of cards as your Hand. If you have zero cards in your Hand, instead, they discard all but one cards from their Hand.

[LV2][LV3] Red/Green/White/Blue
This Spirit can't be blocked, and is unaffected by opposing Red/Green/White/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
BS58-TX02-A398.flavor: "Situation understood. Leave this era to us. You guys set off to the future!"

BS57-045.name: The Angelia Difiel
BS57-045.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw two cards from the deckbottom. Then, you can show two Magic cards/"Divine Spirit" family cards in your Hand to the opponent. When you've done so, during this turn, every opposing Spirit can't block.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can summon a Yellow-only "Proximate" family Spirit card from your Hand without paying the cost.
BS57-045.flavor:
Handling the power of three strong Oracles seems to be too much even for Alex. That's why she asked the angelias, who excel at using magics, to help.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 6:39―

BS56-051.name: The Angelia Hamael
BS56-051.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Nexus's (When Summoned/Deployed) effect resolves]
During this turn, give every opposing Spirit -12000 BP, and destroy them when their BP are brought to 0. Or, while you have a Yellow Mirage set, during this turn, every Cost 5 or less card in the opposing Hand has their reduction symbols fixed at zero. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Blocks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, immediately end the battle.
BS56-051.flavor:
The tide has turned. The Space Pirates proceeded to run, heading towards the gate connected to the Blue World.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5:19―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A401.name: Amenborg
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A401.effect: [LV1][LV2] High Speed (Flash) This spirit card may be summoned from your hand during the Flash Step. In that case, the cost of this spirit and cores to be put on this spirit must be paid or moved from your Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A401.flavor: Since those dragons appeared, we haven't seen so many rowdies at the watering places. But I hear that the water in the woods is strangely sticky these days.

SD01-003.name: Ankillersaurus
SD01-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
While you control any Spirit with [Awaken]/[Clash], this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
SD01-003.flavor: They are assigned to deliver follow-up attacks. They advance behind the spearhead and charge the enemy.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A404.name: Armor Purge
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A404.effect: (Flash Step)(Your Main Phrase) Refresh all exhausted spirits you control with Immunity: X. Spirits you control lose and cannot gain Immunity: X until end of turn.

BONE-DOG2.name: Bone-Dog
BONE-DOG2.flavor:
It was a tragic sight. The knights of the Empty Sky generated powerful waves that made everything collapse. The crack in the Empty Sky bought destruction to everyone, including the undead. It was clear that they would not spare even this immortal realm.
-from the 8th paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

SD01-037.name: Carry Cores
SD01-037.effect:
[Flash]
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve. During this turn, give a Spirit +1000 BP.

SD01-036.name: Curse Enchant
SD01-036.effect:
[Main]
During this turn, give a Spirit you control the effect: "[Curse] (When Attacks) This Spirit destroys an opposing Spirit that blocked at the end of battle."

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

SD01-038.name: Emerald Boost
SD01-038.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, all your attacking Spirits gain +1000 BP for each reduction symbol that Spirit has.

SD01-001.name: Erimakilizard
SD01-001.flavor: The ability to run fast is important for any fighter, but I wish he used that ability to run after his enemies-not away from them.

SD01-034.name: Extra Draw
SD01-034.effect:
[Main]
Draw two cards. Then, reveal a card from your decktop. If that card is a Red Spirit card, add it to your Hand. Return any remaining card to the decktop.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

CB05-X06.name: Alphamon
CB05-X06.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom, and draw until your Hand has four cards. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By paying two costs, this Spirit refreshes.

[LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Send two cores from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.
CB05-X06.flavor:
[Mega. Holy Knight. Vaccine]
One of the 13 Royal Knights, the highest ranking holy knights in Network Security. Normally he does not show himself, being located in a place called the Blank Seat.

CB05-037.name: Ankylomon
CB05-037.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Your "Champion" family Spirits can't be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] [Warp Digivolve: Yellow] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Yellow "Ultimate" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB05-037.flavor:
[Champion. Dinosaur. Free]
A Dinosaur Digimon whose entire body is covered in hardened cuticles.

CB05-003.name: Aquilamon
CB05-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] [Warp Digivolve: Red] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Red "Ultimate" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
CB05-003.flavor:
[Champion. Giant Bird. Free]
A giant bird digimon with two large horns coming out of his head.

CB05-036.name: Armadillomon
CB05-036.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add "Champion"/"Armor" family Spirit cards, one of each, to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. Then, you can pay two cost to summon one Yellow "Champion" family Spirit card from your hand.

[LV2][LV3] [Digivolve: Yellow] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Yellow "Champion" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB05-036.flavor:
[Rookie. Mammal. Free]
Partner Digimon of Hida Iori.

CB05-054.name: Armageddemon
CB05-054.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By returning up to four exactly-named "Kuramon"/"Diaboromon" from your Trash to the Hand, summon this card from your Hand, and reduces its cost by 3 for each card returned.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with two or more Symbols.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your Cost 10 or more Spirit is attacking, unless the opponent destroys an Spirit they control, they can't block.
CB05-054.flavor:
[Mega. Unknown. Unknown.]
An Ultra Digimon born from the sudden fusing of a great number of Kuramon.

CB05-027.name: Arukenimon
CB05-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit, and put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
If you control any Green-only/Purple-only Nexus, you can reveal two cards from your decktop. You can summon one "Ultimate"/"Mega" family Spirit card among them, without paying the cost. Discard any remaining cards.
CB05-027.flavor:
[Ultimate. Dark Animal. Virus]
A Dark Animal Digimon which has the appearance of the "Queen of Spiders" of Greek mythology.

CB05-012.name: Bakemon
CB05-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Warp Digivolve: Purple] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Purple "Ultimate" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Send three cores from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.
CB05-012.flavor:
[Champion. Ghost. Virus]
A Ghost Digimon that wears a blanket on its head.

CB05-002.name: Bearmon
CB05-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.

[LV2] [Digivolve: Red/Purple] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to your Hand, summon a Red/Purple "Champion" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
CB05-002.flavor:
[Rookie. Beast. Vaccine]
A Baby Bear Beast Digimon whose trademark is wearing the baseball cap backwards.

CB05-028.name: Betamon
CB05-028.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add an "Armored Dragon" family Spirit card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] [Digivolve: White] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a White "Champion" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost
CB05-028.flavor:
[Rookie. Amphibian. Virus]
An Amphibian Digimon that walks on four legs. Its personality is gentle, but although it is a docile Digimon, once Betamon is angered it emits body generates more than 1 MV of electric current to strike the opponent.

CB05-X01.name: BlackWarGreymon
CB05-X01.kanji: ブラックウォーグレイモン
CB05-X01.effect:
Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
If an opposing 8000 BP or more Spirit/Ultimate is attacking, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit. When blocked by an opposing Spirit with the highest BP via this effect, this Spirit refreshes.
CB05-X01.flavor:
[Mega. Dragon Man Type. Virus Attribute]
The Virus Attribute WarGreymon, feared as the "Dragon Warrior of Darkness."

CB05-038.name: Centarumon
CB05-038.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed by the Opponent]
During this turn, give every opposing Spirit -5000 BP. Destroy every Spirit whose BP is brought to 0 by this effect. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2] [Warp Digivolve: Yellow] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Yellow "Ultimate" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB05-038.flavor:
[Champion. Beastman. Data]
A half-animal half-human Digimon, its upper body is humanoid and its lower body is beast-like.

CB05-056.name: D-3
CB05-056.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck, you can add it to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Turn)
When you use [Digivolution]/[Super Digivolution]/[DNA Digivolution], the effects of every opposing Spirit can't activate, and until that effect is resolved, the opponent can't use cards from their Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When you use [Armor Digivolution], by exhausting this Nexus, treat your Spirits as being returned to the Hand.
CB05-056.flavor: A new type of Digivice which allows the Partner Digimon to undergo a fake digivolution into Armor through the use of Digi-Eggs.

CB05-016.name: Daemon
CB05-016.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Purple & Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Advents)
Send one core each from every opposing Spirit to their Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can summon a Purple "Champion"/"Ultimate" family Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.
CB05-016.flavor:
[Mega. Demon Lord Type. Virus Attribute]
A demon lord type that leads many demon and fallen angel types.

CB05-050.name: Dagomon
CB05-050.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Brave's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with (When Summoned) effects.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Unless the opponent sends two cores from their Reserve to the Trash, they can't block.
CB05-050.flavor:
[Ultimate. Aquatic Beastman. Virus]
An evil god Digimon called the "Depraved Monk of the Deep"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A425.name: Dark Tower
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A425.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When an opposing "Armor" family Spirit is summoned, destroy this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn)
Neither player can [Advent], nor can they summon Spirit cards without paying the cost besides via Burst effects.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
This Nexus's color and symbol are also treated as Red.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A425.flavor: A black tower which suddenly appeared on the Digital World. It has a function that blocks Digivolution.

CB05-033.name: Datamon
CB05-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
You can put a core from the Void to this Spirit. When you've done so, this Spirit remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2][LV3] (Your End Step)
Refresh one of your Spirits.
CB05-033.flavor:
[Ultimate. Machine. Virus]
A super small therapeutic machine Digimon. It went berserk after being attacked by a powerful virus Digimon and having its rationality destroyed.

CB05-030.name: Deputymon
CB05-030.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Warp Digivolve: White] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a White "Ultimate" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2]
When the opponent summons a Spirit without paying the cost, put two cores from the Void to any Spirits you control.
CB05-030.flavor:
[Champion. Mutant. Vaccine]
A mutant Digimon whose body has partially turned into a gun barrel. Although the details of how it was born are completely unclear, it has a deep sense of justice and acts as a "Virus Buster".

CB05-059.name: Destiny Destroyer
CB05-059.kanji: アルティメットフレア
CB05-059.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by the effect of any exactly-named "Kuramon", you can add it to the Hand.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing Spirit with two cores or less on it. After this effect resolves, reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a Six-colored "Infernal Lord" family Spirit card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

CB05-039.name: Digmon
CB05-039.effect:
Flash - [Armor Digivolve: Rookie]
By returning a "Rookie" family Spirit you control to the Hand, pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, that Spirit can't block.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Your "Ultimate"/"Mega"/"Armor" family Spirits can't be destroyed by opposing effects.
CB05-039.flavor:
[Armor. Insectoid. Free]
An Insectoid Armor Digimon evolved from the Digi-Egg of Knowledge.

CB05-023.name: Dokugumon
CB05-023.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[LV2] [Warp Digivolve: Purple/Green] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Purple/Green "Ultimate" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB05-023.flavor:
[Champion. Insectoid. Virus]
A cursed Digimon in the shape of a spider, whose entire body has been parasitized by computer viruses.

BS14-091.name: Double Blaster
BS14-091.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed by the opponent]
Draw two cards. Then by paying the cost, activate this card's flash effect.

[Flash]
Destroy a Brave on an opposing Brave Spirit. Or, destroy an opposing Nexus.

CB05-035.name: Elecmon
CB05-035.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Add a "Drifting Spirit"/"Imaginary Beast" family Spirit card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] [Digivolve: Yellow] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Yellow "Champion" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB05-035.flavor:
[Rookie. Mammal. Data]
A Mammal Digimon which digivolved maintaing Tsunomon's mammal-like characterics.

CB05-047.name: Exveemon
CB05-047.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw two cards. Then, discard two cards from your Hand. When summoned via [Digivolution], this effect discards -1 card from Hand.

[LV2][LV3] [Warp Digivolve: Blue] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Blue "Ultimate" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB05-047.flavor:
[Champion. Whelp. Free]
A Champion Mythical Dragon Digimon evolved from a Veemon which obtained its true power.

CB05-006.name: Flamedramon
CB05-006.effect:
Flash - [Armor Digivolve: Rookie]
By returning a "Rookie" family Spirit you control to the Hand, pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit. When any Spirit is destroyed by this effect, draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit with "Digivolution"-named effects attack, you can target and attack an opposing Spirit.
CB05-006.flavor:
[Armor. Dragon Man. Free]
A dragon man Armor Digimon which evolved from the power of the Digi-Egg of Courage.

CB05-019.name: Floramon
CB05-019.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a "Plant Spirit" family Spirit card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] [Digivolve: Green] (Start of Your Attack Step)

BS60-X07.name: The KillerDivineConsort Kali
BS60-X07.effect:
When this card is sent to the Trash by your Yellow Mirage effect, treat it as Cost 4, and you can add it to your Hand.

(Once per turn: same name) When your "Astroblazer" & "Hunter Beast" family Spirit attacks, or would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can summon this card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[Unleash: 1~3] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can put 1~3 cores from any of your Purple/Yellow Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit. When you've done so, for each core put, send a core from the opposing Field to the Trash.
BS60-X07.flavor: "Don't...anger me too much...Or else, you would be destroyed right away."

SD61-005.name: The KingSacred Aldafodr
SD61-005.kanji: 王神機 アルダフェズル
SD61-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can set a White Mirage card without (When Set) effects from your Hand, without paying the cost. When you've done so, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by exhausting a Spirit you control, during this battle, this Spirit can't be blocked.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, when you would advent an “Armed Machine” family card, you can advent it, treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.
SD61-005.flavor: "So after Nova it is Chronos huh. All these problems springing up one after one."

BS59-005.name: The LaserBladeMachineDragon Dancing-Sodar
BS59-005.kanji: 光刃機龍ダンシング・ソーダー
BS59-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate, and when destroys, once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Rebirth3]
At the end of this Spirit's attack, or when this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can flip this Spirit. When you do, this Reborn Brave can either refresh and brave to a Spirit you control, or stay in Spirit condition by putting a core from your Reserve/Field onto it.
BS59-005.flavor:
Thanks to the surprise attacks carried out by the SunDragons, a gap is created. It is now or never. Only I'm free. I'll have to do this!
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 8:30―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A630.name: The LaserShellSheriff Mandi-Bularis
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A630.kanji: 光殻刑事マンディ・ブラリス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A630.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates, and put two cores from the Void to this Spirit. Then, you can set a Green/Yellow card with Mirage effect from your Hand, without paying the cost. When you've done so, you can return two opposing exhausted Spirits/Ultimates to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't activate Burst effects. Also, once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A630.flavor: "We are the Spacetime Police! We are here to arrest those who messed up the flow of time!"

BS58-X08.name: The LegendaryTowerDeity Babel-Golem
BS58-X08.kanji: 伝説塔神 バベル・ゴレム
BS58-X08.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Blue Core][Blue Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
By paying one cost, ignoring the costs of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Discard eight cards from the opposing decktop. Then, for each Blue “Proximate”/“Astroblazer” family Spirit you control, discard a card from the opposing decktop.
BS58-X08.flavor: "It's unimaginable to defy the gods. A mere Spirit shall not reach out to the gods. If you still have to challenge the gods, then it is up to us, the kin of the Tower, to crush you with all our might."

BS58-049.name: The LilySacredBeast Pegasati
BS58-049.effect:
When this card is sent to the Trash by your Yellow Mirage effect, treat it as Cost 5, and you can activate it, ignoring the Burst condition.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Return opposing LV1/LV2 Spirits, one of each, and opposing LV3/LV4 Ultimates, one of each, to the deckbottom; and draw a card from the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked.
BS58-049.flavor: Parvati's world is a gentle world adorned with waterlilies.

WELT-RAUM.name: The MachineDragonEmperor Welt-Raum
WELT-RAUM.kanji: 機龍皇ヴェルト・ラオム
WELT-RAUM.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects, and the effects of the Spirit/Ultimate destroyed by this effect can't activate.

[LV2][LV3] [Rebirth5]
If you have a Red Mirage set, instead of attacking with this Spirit, you can flip it.
WELT-RAUM.flavor: "Summoning a vanity deity? Seriously? And it is even an Ultimate...Are we forced to use that...? There are no other choices. Send Machine Dragon Emperor here!"

WELT-RAUM-A634.name: The MachineDragonEmperor Welt-Raum -G.O.D. Mode-
WELT-RAUM-A634.kanji: 機龍皇ヴェルト・ラオム -G.O.D.モード-
WELT-RAUM-A634.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn/Attacks)
You can draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] Flash
By returning a “Machine Dragon” family card from your Hand to the deckbottom, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest BP. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects, and the effects of the Spirit/Ultimate destroyed by this effect can't activate.
WELT-RAUM-A634.flavor: "ーーG.O.D. Mode, activate. Vanity Deity, now, please return to nothingness!!!"

BS22-016.name: The MagicFencer Prisila
BS22-016.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Every Spirit with (When Summoned) effects can't be returned from the Field to the Hand/Deck.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit. When this effect destroys a Brave Spirit, the Brave can't remain on the Field.
BS22-016.flavor: "I've decided on my next prey..." She told us about the TenSwordsSaint, but I didn't expect this to happen...

BS57-006.name: The MagicSwordCeratops Tricelord
BS57-006.kanji: 魔剣角龍トリケロード
BS57-006.effect:
When your "Astroblazer"/"Terra Dragon" family Spirit reduces the opposing Life, you can return this card from the Trash to the Hand. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Rebirth3]
When this Spirit attacks, you can flip it.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Nexus. If you have a Mirage set, effects of the Nexus destroyed by this effect can't activate.
BS57-006.flavor: There is a great number of reports of Spirits from the Past World having undergone sudden changes.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A637.name: The MagicSwordEmperor Tricelord
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A637.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn/Attacks)
Once per turn, destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest BP. Also, if you have a Mirage set, send two cores, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your effect destroys any opposing Spirits, you can draw a card. This effect doesn't stack.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A637.flavor: "This is...The seal of Megiddo...Bring forth chaos to the world..."

BS57-027.name: The MetalArmInvestigatingOfficer Musclebeet
BS57-027.kanji: 剛腕捜査官マッスルビート
BS57-027.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Green Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Blade Insect" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step with effects.

[During Set] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this Mirage.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed via BP comparison, send two opposing Lives to the Reserve.
BS57-027.flavor: "Ricky that guy, while putting on a gentle face, can do something really sick!"

BS23-005.name: The MeteorSwordMaster Shootingstar
BS23-005.kanji: 流星の剣聖シューティングスター
BS23-005.effect:
When your "Shining-Dragon"-named Spirit is summoned, return this Spirit card from the Trash to your Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Unsheathe] (When Summoned)
You can summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card that can brave with this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
Destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.
BS23-005.flavor:
What Guren-san had prepared, was a 13th Sword. By enshrining it in the country connecting to the two worlds, both of the worlds would be stabilized.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, Future Days-

BS41-047.name: The NobleGod Grace-Order
BS41-047.kanji: 秩序軍神グレイス・オーダー
BS41-047.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Purple/White & Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon an "Armed Machine"/"Death Dragon" family Spirit card, without paying the cost. Discard any remaining cards.

[During Advent] [LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block while exhausted.
BS41-047.flavor: The divine shining machine is truly befitting of the twinkle advent name.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A641.name: The NobleGuardian Skilfing
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A641.kanji: 秩序の守護者スキルヴィング
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A641.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" & "Armed Machine" family Spirit effect, you can add it to the Hand.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core])]
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon/deploy a "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" & "Armed Machine" family, or "Grandstone" family card, without paying the cost. Discard any remaining cards. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto your Removed Zone.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard an opposing Burst, and once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A641.flavor: “Looks like we've made it, Alex. We, the NobleOrder, would rush to your side even if that's the end of time!”

BS59-033.name: The NobleGunner Arms-Organizer
BS59-033.kanji: 秩序砲機アームズ・オーガナイザー
BS59-033.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" & "Armed Machine" family Spirit effect, if you don't have a Mirage set, you can set it without paying the cost.

[Mirage: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core][White Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
Every "Astroblazer" & "Armed Machine"/"Mounted Warrior family Spirit you control can't be blocked by opposing Spirits with costs equal or inferior to that Spirit's.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.
BS59-033.flavor: "Finish them, Ragna-Rock. The rest is up to you. Take our future back!"

BS58-039.name: The NobleOrder Jet-Hammer
BS58-039.kanji: 秩序軍 ジェット・ハマー
BS58-039.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" & "Armed Machine" family Spirit effect, you can set it without paying the cost. When you do, return your currently set Mirage to your Hand.

[Mirage: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, by exhausting an "Armed Machine" family Spirit you control, during this battle, a Spirit you control gains +(the exhausted Spirit's BP) BP.
BS58-039.flavor: "I thought I was lost and strayed from the main force, so it never occurred to me that I would be able to meet Alex again!"

PB39-X01.name: The OracleTwentyOneBirds 3 The-Penpress
PB39-X01.kanji: オラクル二十一鳥 3 ジ・ペンプレス
PB39-X01.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as "Pentan".

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can discard three cards from your decktop. Then, you can return two "Song Bird" family cards, besides any "The-Penpress", from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Pentan"/"Empereur"/"Penpress" can't be blocked by opposing LV2/LV3 Spirits and opposing LV4/LV5 Ultimates.
PB39-X01.flavor: Governs Selfishness, insatiability, love and hate, a member of the 21 Oracle Birds.

BS60-XX01.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars 0 The Fool
BS60-XX01.kanji: オラクル二十一柱 0 ザ・フール
BS60-XX01.effect:
This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow.

[LV1][LV2]LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Oracle" Spirit attacks, your counter can +1. Or, you can put a core from the Void to any of your Spirit/your Life (Max. 6 Lives).

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
This Spirit's symbol is fixed as zero. This effect is unaffected by either player's effects.
BS60-XX01.flavor: Governs Freedom and Possibility, a pillar among the 21 Oracle pillars.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A646.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars III The Empress
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A646.kanji: オラクル二十一柱 III ジ・エンプレス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A646.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can discard three cards from your decktop. When you've done so, you can return a total of two Green-only/Yellow-only Magic cards with Mirage effects, and Green-only/Yellow-only "Astroblazer" family cards, besides any exactly-named "The OracleTwentyOnePillars III The-Empress", from your Trash to the Hand. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Your "Astroblazer" family Spirits can't be blocked by opposing LV2/LV3 Spirits and opposing LV4/LV5 Ultimates.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A646.flavor: Governs Prosperity, Fertility and Love, a pillar among the 21 Oracle pillars.

BS62-X05.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars II The High Priestess
BS62-X05.kanji: オラクル二十一柱 II ザ・ハイプリエステス
BS62-X05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. You can [Contract Advent] any number of Spirit cards among them, besides adventing onto this Spirit, treating as [Soul Core] being sent to the Trash. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom. When you [Contract Advent] via this effect, during this turn, the opponent can't end the Turn/Attack Step via effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Activate a (When Advents)/(Start of Your Attack Step) effect of an “Astroblazer”/“Silver Zero” family Spirit you control.
BS62-X05.flavor: Governs Intuition, Expectation, and Intelligence, a pillar among the 21 Oracle pillars.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A648.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars IV The Emperor
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A648.kanji: オラクル二十一柱 IV ジ・エンペラー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A648.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Red/White "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" family Spirits you control can't be returned to the Hand/deck by opposing effects. When those Spirits would return to the Hand/deck by opposing effects, send an opposing Life to the Trash.

[LV2][LV3] [Emperor Road] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, this Spirit can battle up to four times in a row. (Before the end of battle, you can carry out another battle from the before-block Flash Timing (Max. 3 times).)
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A648.flavor: Governs Dominance, Authority and Execution, a pillar among the 21 Oracle pillars.

BS61-X01.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars I The Magician
BS61-X01.kanji: オラクル二十一柱 I ザ・マジシャン
BS61-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Your Red-only “Proximate”/“Astroblazer”/“Scarlet Flame” family “BP Destruction effects” ignore “BP+” and “give + BP” effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) If all your Spirits/Nexuses have "Astroblazer"/“Scarlet Flame” family, your counter +1, and destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's. Then, if you have six counters or more, during this turn, this Spirit and every “Flame Contract” family Spirit you control gains an extra Red symbol.
BS61-X01.flavor: Governs Possibility, Creation, and Chance, a pillar among the 21 Oracle pillars.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A650.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars IX The Hermit
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A650.kanji: オラクル二十一柱 IX ザ・ハーミット
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A650.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would become the target of opposing effects, you can refresh a Spirit you control. Also, if you have a Purple/White Mirage set, you can immediately return this Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
You can summon a "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" family Spirit card with both [Purple Core] and [White Core] reduction symbols from your Trash. This effect can only be used once per turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A650.flavor: Governs Concealment, Circumspection and Versatility, a pillar among the 21 Oracle pillars.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A651.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars VIII The Strength
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A651.kanji: オラクル二十一柱 VIII ジ・ストレングス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A651.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can discard 10 cards from the opposing decktop, and when 10 or more cards are discarded, this Spirit is fixed at zero symbols.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
You can discard one of your set cards, if that's a Blue card, refresh this Spirit.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
By discarding one of your set cards, discard a Magic card on the opposing Field.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A651.flavor: Governs Power, Bravery and Maturity, a pillar among the 21 Oracle pillars.

BS58-X05.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars VII The Chariot
BS58-X05.kanji: オラクル二十一柱 VII ザ・チャリオット
BS58-X05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can return an opposing Spirit/Nexus/Burst to the deckbottom.
[Rush: Purple/White]
(While you have Purple/White symbols, the following effect activate next)
[Purple Core][Purple Core][White Core][White Core]: During this turn, the opponent can't declare block.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By exhausting a Purple/White "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" family Spirit you control, send a core from the opposing Field/Reserve to the Trash.
BS58-X05.flavor: Governs Triumph, Subjugation and Success, a pillar among the 21 Oracle pillars.

BS67-CP07.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars VI The Lovers
BS67-CP07.kanji: オラクル二十一柱VI ザ・ラバーズ
BS67-CP07.effect:
When this card is revealed from your deck by your "Scarlet Flame"/"Blood Crystal"/"Jade Thunder"/"Silver Zero"/"Golden Cloud"/"Azure Wave" family effect, you can add it to the Hand.

Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Divine Attendant" family Spirit, you can summon this card from the Hand/Removed Zone, treating all reduction symbols as fulfilled. When you've done so, you can immediately end the battle.

[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can pay one cost to summon a Brave card with [Brave Engage] from your Hand/Trash.
BS67-CP07.flavor: Governs Trust, Sympathy and Bonding, a pillar among the 21 Oracle pillars.

BS58-X04.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars V The Hierophant
BS58-X04.kanji: オラクル二十一柱 V ザ・ハイエロファント
BS58-X04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can put five cores from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.
[Rush: Red]
(While you have a Red symbol, the following effect activate next)
[Red Core]: You can draw cards from your deck until you have five cards in Hand.
[Red Core][Red Core][Red Core]: During this battle, the symbol of this Spirit is fixed as two Green symbols and two Red symbols.
BS58-X04.flavor: Governs Mercy, Virtues and Compatibility, a pillar among the 21 Oracle pillars.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A655.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars XIII The Death
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A655.kanji: オラクル二十一柱 XIII ザ・デス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A655.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send 13 cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve. After this effect resolves, if no cards are sent to the Trash due to this effect, during this turn, increase the level cost of every opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus by +1.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Turn)
When opposing Spirits are depleted/destroyed, you can refresh a Purple/Blue "Astroblazer" family Spirit you control.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A655.flavor: Governs Death, Destruction and the End, a pillar among the 21 Oracle pillars.

BS63-X08.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars XII The Hanged Man
BS63-X08.kanji: オラクル二十一柱 XII ザ・ハングドマン
BS63-X08.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Enchain] (When Attacks)
The opponent chooses one among the following: Core Step/Draw Step/Main Step/Attack Step. On the next turn, the chosen step doesn't occur for the opponent. Each step of your [Enchain] can only be chosen once per game.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When your Blue-only "Astroblazer"/"Azure Contract"/"King Contract" family Spirit attacks, activate this Spirit's [Enchain].
BS63-X08.flavor: Governs Tolerance, Inhibition and Trials, a pillar among the 21 Oracle pillars.

BS62-X04.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars XIV The Temperance
BS62-X04.kanji: オラクル二十一柱 XIV ザ・テンパランス
BS62-X04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reduce up to three counters you have, but not having it become less than six. For each counter you reduced, draw a card. The opponent can't activate Burst effects due to this effect.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When your “Astroblazer”/“Jade Thunder” family Spirit attacks, heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit. Then, if every opposing Spirit is in heavily exhausted state, once per turn per Spirit, your attacking Spirit can refresh.
BS62-X04.flavor: Governs Harmony, Equality and Moderation, a pillar among the 21 Oracle pillars.

THE-SUN.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars XIX The Sun
THE-SUN.kanji: オラクル二十一柱 XIX ザ・サン
THE-SUN.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing single-symbol Spirit/Nexus, and the effects of the destroyed Spirit/Nexus can't activate.
[Rush: Red/Green]
(While you have Red/Green symbols, the following effect activate next)
[Green Core][Green Core]: Put two cores from the Void to any Spirits you control.
[Green Core][Green Core][Green Core]: Until the next opposing End Step, the opponent can't pay costs from the Field.
[Red Core][Red Core][Red Core][Green Core][Green Core][Green Core]: At the end of battle, send two opposing Lives to the Void.
THE-SUN.flavor: Governs Birth, Triumph, Promised Future, a pillar among the 21 Oracle pillars.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A659.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars XI The Justice
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A659.kanji: オラクル二十一柱 XI ザ・ジャスティス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A659.effect:
This card/Spirit gains the "Blade Insect"/"Divine Spirit" family.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can, leaving off an opposing Spirit/Ultimate, heavy exhaust every other opposing Spirit/Ultimate. [heb]

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Green/Yellow Cost 6/8 "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" family Spirit attacks, by paying three costs, during this battle, neither player can use cards from their Hand during Flash Timing.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A659.flavor: Governs Justice, Fairness and Equilibrium, a pillar among the 21 Oracle pillars.

BS61-X06.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars XVIII The Moon
BS61-X06.kanji: オラクル二十一柱 XVIII ザ・ムーン
BS61-X06.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can return a Magic card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced, if you have five counters or more, you can put a core from your Counter Area to your Life.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, every “Astroblazer”/ “Golden Cloud” family Spirit you control gains an extra Yellow symbol.
BS61-X06.flavor: Governs Instability, Illusions, and Deception, a pillar among the 21 Oracle pillars.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A661.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars XVII The Star
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A661.kanji: オラクル二十一柱 XVII ザ・スター
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A661.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Start of Opposing Attack Step)
Put a card from your decktop facedown under this Spirit. (When this Spirit is depleted, the cards beneath are discarded. When this Spirit leaves the Field otherwise, add them to your Hand.）

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When your Life would be reduced by the opponent, by adding a card beneath this Spirit to the Hand, reduce the number of Lives that would be reduced by -1.

[LV2][LV3]
Every Red/White “Astroblazer” family Spirit you control cannot have the number of cores on it become two or less due to opposing effects, and is unaffected by opposing White/Blue effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A661.flavor: Governs Hope, Possibility and Brilliance, a pillar among the 21 Oracle pillars.

BS58-X07.name: The OracleTwentyOnePillars XVI The Tower
BS58-X07.kanji: オラクル二十一柱 XVI ザ・タワー
BS58-X07.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your End Step)
You can discard three cards from the opposing decktop. This effect doesn't stack.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Turn)
When this Spirit would leave the Field by opposing effects, you can end the turn.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

BS02-066.effect:
