You can exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS02-066.flavor: In this world, there are seven lands and seven keys. However, it is natural to think that each country has one key. People in the land of trump are now searching for a key in their own land first.

BS02-070.name: Arcanaprince-Obero
BS02-070.kanji: アルカナプリンス・オベロ
BS02-070.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
For each "Arcana"-named Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.

[LV2][LV3]
All your Cost 2 Spirits are treated as "Arcana"-named.
BS02-070.flavor: It seems like all the people in the land of trump are searching for the key. The prince seems to be taking the lead.

ARMA-DILLO2.name: Arma-Dillo
ARMA-DILLO2.effect: [LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) All your White Spirits gain +1000 BP.
ARMA-DILLO2.flavor: The desert stopped shifting and shadows are fading away. Even the rock armor cannot stop the corrosion of the world. The only hope we have left is a song that carries all around the world.

BAT-BAT2.name: Bat-Bat
BAT-BAT2.effect: [LV2] (When Attacks) If this spirit is blocked, you may move 1 core from the blocking spirit to its owner's reserve.
BAT-BAT2.flavor: There are some guys who are plotting the rebellion. Bat-Bats fly all around the world as informers to find those guys. The rule by fear has no loopholes and the king's control gets stronger day by day.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A931.name: Bathopper
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A931.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks) Gain 1 core on this spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A931.flavor: They used to just be hopping around. Ever since the World Tree appeared, they are more energetic than ever. I wonder if the new air in the woods changed them?

BS02-094.name: Bloody Rain
BS02-094.effect:
[Main]
If there is a total of 10 to 19 cores on the opposing Field/Trash/Reserve, the opponent sends two cores among them to the Void. If there are 20 cores or more, they send six cores among them to the Void.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

BS02-019.name: Bottom Desuper
BS02-019.effect:
[LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by LV1 Spirits.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by LV1/LV2 Spirits.
BS02-019.flavor: They are two as one. They come from the depths of the shadow.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A934.name: Caprihorn
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A934.effect: [LV2] (When Attacks) This spirit gets +1000 BP for each unexhausted spirit your opponent controls until end of turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A934.flavor: Most of the guys in the woods are not interested in the world tree. See? This guy right here is happy just blowing his horns even though the woods will never be changed back to what it used to be.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A935.name: Cast Off (Card)
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A935.effect:
(Your Main Phrase) Destroy target "Parasite" spirit you control. In that case, summon a spirit card from your hand with a cost of five without paying the cost.

(Flash Step)(Your Main Phrase) Target spirit gets +2000BP until end of turn.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A936.name: Chagamaru
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A936.effect: [LV3] (Opponent's Attack Step) When this Spirit is destroyed by opposing Spirit/Magic/Nexus effects, by sending all but one core on this Spirit to the Trash, it returns to the field, refreshed.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A936.flavor: Even though they are cute, be careful not to pet them too much. They sometimes get mad if it's too much. I guess if it's a little bit, it shouldn't be a problem, is it?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A937.name: Chauw
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A937.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Permanent) Each time 1 or more cores are put on this spirit due to an effect, increase the number by 1.

[LV2] (Permanent) Each time 1 or more cores are moved from a spirit to its owner's Reserve, due to an effect, increase that number by 1.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A937.flavor: He knows how to be liked by people. For example, he always gets more food than others do. I wish I had that skill.

BS02-051.name: Chunpopo
BS02-051.flavor: Aren't they super cute? I wish I could neglect my job and idle away with them.

BS02-088.name: Cross Fire
BS02-088.effect:
[Main]
Each player chooses and destroys a Nexus they control. This effect can't be used unless each player controls at least one Nexus.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +1000 BP.

BS02-003.name: Dinohound
BS02-003.flavor: This is not an earthquake, but the rumble from the march. Before the dragons moved, the dinosaurs made the first action. This war never ends till either of them are annihilated. The eve of a big war has just begun.
sets: Let'S Play Battle Spirits!! Starter Kit

BS02-096.name: Divine Wind
BS02-096.effect:
[Main]
Summon a Spirit card from your Hand with a Cost equal or inferior to the number of cores in your Trash, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirit summoned by this effect can't activate.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

BS02-092.name: Energy Drain
BS02-092.effect:
[Main]
Send a core from any opposing Nexus/the opposing Reserve to their Trash.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +1000 BP.

BS02-008.name: Fisdragoon
BS02-008.flavor: It really hurts when you are hit with a fist, doesn't it? The fool dragons mistook the Fisdragoon for large fists and ran away.
sets: Let'S Play Battle Spirits!! Starter Kit

BS02-110.name: Heavy Gate
BS02-110.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, all Cost 1 or less Spirits can't attack nor block.

BS02-015.name: Humpdump
BS02-015.effect:
[LV2] [Curse] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked when the battle resolves at the end of battle.
BS02-015.flavor:
When Ogre Wizards are destroyed, they leave eggs.
Eggs which never are born.

BS02-050.name: Koristal
BS02-050.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Battles)
At the end of battle, destroy this Spirit.
BS02-050.flavor: They will punish us if we can't find the key? Isn't that ridiculous? There are some people who have gone bad because of that.

BS02-020.name: Lady-Frankelly
BS02-020.kanji: レディ・フランケリー
BS02-020.effect:
[LV2][LV3] [Curse] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked when the battle resolves at the end of battle.

[LV3] (When Destroyed)
Return this Spirit to your Hand.
BS02-020.flavor: I am just an onlooker. I neither obey the king nor the rebel. You are like me, aren't you?

BS02-099.name: Life Chain
BS02-099.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy a Spirit you control. Put a number of cores from the Void to your Reserve equal to the cost of the destroyed Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A949.name: Liorider
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A949.effect: [LV2] (During Opponent's Battle Phase) Each time this spirit defeats a spirit, if this spirit is exhausted, refresh this spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A949.flavor: He took the wheels into his body. The never stopping wheels carry the refugees till he falls in battle.

BS02-001.name: Lizardedge
BS02-001.flavor: He charges anybody for a couple of meat chops. That's why the battlefield is in chaos now.
sets: Let'S Play Battle Spirits!! Starter Kit

BS02-040.name: Lobsterk
BS02-040.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Armor: Red]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects of the specified color.
BS02-040.flavor: His scissors are the symbols of resistance. He cut the sea with those scissors and makes his way through it to prevent further intrusions.
sets: Let'S Play Battle Spirits!! Starter Kit

BS02-108.name: Magic Book
BS02-108.effect:
[Main]
By putting any number of Magic cards from your Hand onto the Removed Zone, for each card you put, draw a card.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +4000 BP.

BS02-093.name: Mind Control
BS02-093.kanji: マインドコントロール
BS02-093.effect:
[Main]
Both players send a total of four cores from Spirits they control to the owner's Trash.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A954.name: Mind Flare
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A954.effect:
Main- If the opponent controls two or more Spirits with the same name, leaving off one Spirit for each different name, and destroy all the other Spirits.

Flash- During this turn, give a Spirit gets +4000 BP.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A955.name: Mummella
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A955.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Move 1 core from target spirit your opponent controls to its owner's Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A955.flavor: The ones outside the reach of the king have woken up. Can they be the hope for the traitors or just despair?

BS02-097.name: Nature Forces
BS02-097.effect:
[Flash]
Send every core from your Trash to a Spirit you control. This effect can't be used during the Main Step.

BS02-004.name: Orcaria
BS02-004.effect:
[LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can target and attack an opposing refreshed Spirit.
BS02-004.flavor:
I've never seen the burning swamp. The companion stopped me and said "Even a peek will be enough to take your life". I wonder what's in there?
-from the 2nd paragraph in chapter Red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS02-058.name: Pentan
BS02-058.effect:
[LV1]
While you control three or more Yellow Spirits/Nexuses, give all your Magic cards [Yellow Core] reduction symbol.

[LV2]
While you control three or more Yellow Spirits/Nexuses, give all your Magic cards [Yellow Core][Yellow Core] reduction symbols.
BS02-058.flavor: Those kids said that one of the keys were in a part of reception... Do you have any idea what it means?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A959.name: Phantasma
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A959.flavor:
The beast that showed up right in front of me disappeared all of a sudden. Is this real? Or, am I dreaming? I now feel that I am in the strange world.
-from the first paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A960.name: Piyon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A960.flavor: No. Don't look them in the eyes. If you do, they will take to you and follow you anywhere. We are busy searching for the key. Lets ignore them now.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A961.name: Porkne
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A961.effect: [LV2][LV3] (Permanent) All "Drifting Spirits" you control are unaffected by the effects of spells your opponent controls.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A961.flavor: You are searching for the key, aren't you? Not food?

BS02-103.name: Reload Cores
BS02-103.effect:
[Main]
For each "Armed Machine" family Spirit you control, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A963.name: Rom
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A963.flavor: There are a total of seven keys. Only one of them has been found so far.

BS02-095.name: Sacrifice
BS02-095.effect:
[Flash]
By destroying a Nexus you control, send every core from all opposing Nexuses to their Trash.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A966.name: Scorpede
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A966.effect: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) You may deploy target white or green nexus card from your Trash without paying its cost.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A966.flavor: Not all the Dukes are violent. Some of them treasure the woods.

BS02-091.name: Seventh Crimson
BS02-091.effect:
[Main]
By sending all cores from a 7000 BP or more Spirit you control to the Void, send seven cores from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A968.name: Sheeple
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A968.flavor:
Creatures that look like sheep are eating grass. The outside of the woods is a lot quieter. However, the silence has ended suddenly. Those creatures reacted fast. I felt the rumble from far coming towards us.
-From the 1st paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A969.name: Skuldia
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A969.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Refresh Step) This spirit cannot be refreshed.

[LV2][LV3] (When Exhausted) Select an exhausted spirit your opponent controls. In that case, while this spirit is exhausted, that spirit cannot be refreshed.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A969.flavor: The future takes everything from everyone. Even the ones from the strange world stop their moves.

BS03-014.name: Skull-Fish
BS03-014.effect:
[LV1] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can't block opposing Spirits.

[LV2] [Curse] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked at the end of battle.
BS03-014.flavor: They have lost their lives, but gained wisdom from the snake. Those fish bones swim in the air.

BS02-016.name: Slimy
BS02-016.effect:
[LV3] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, send the core from the opposing Life to the Void, instead of the Reserve.
BS02-016.flavor: The death is not given only to Humans. The plants that were burned in dark flames turn themselves into liquid monsters.

BS02-111.name: Spirit Illusion
BS02-111.kanji: スピリットイリュージョン
BS02-111.effect:
[Main]
Choose a color among the colors of either player's Spirits. During this turn, every Spirit of the chosen color is treated as being at its highest Level.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

BS02-089.name: Spirit Link
BS02-089.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit you control: "[Awaken] During Flash Timing, you can put any number of cores from Spirits you control to this Spirit."

BS02-002.name: The Acrobat Juggline
BS02-002.kanji: ナイフ投げのジャグリーン
BS02-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
While you control two or less Spirits, this Spirit is treated as being at LV3.
BS02-002.flavor: She is known as an odd one. She has dinosaurs as her pets. She says they are chubby and cute.

BS02-061.name: The Angelia Angu
BS02-061.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Refresh a Yellow Spirit you control.
BS02-061.flavor: The angels are acting cute. But, I know that they are here to watch us. Why? Because they are the errand angels of the god.

BS02-X08.name: The ArcAngelia Mikafar
BS02-X08.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
For each Yellow Spirit/Nexus you control, reveal a card from your decktop. Add every Magic card among them to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2]
You can use Magic cards from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost.
BS02-X08.flavor: Hey, don't even think about it. The ArcAngelia knows everything. It's not going to be only the keys but also other unreasonable demands.

BS02-082.name: The Artifact Plant
BS02-082.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Give all your Cost 2 White Spirits the "Armed Machine" family.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Armed Machine" family Spirits are exhausted, put a core from the Void to your Reserve for each of those exhausted Spirits.
BS02-082.flavor:
The broken gate that connects this world to the strange world. Stay far away from it for your safety. It may transform your body into something else.
-from the Places of Interest 16/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A978.name: The BalloonMan Barball
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A978.flavor: They sent out some guy to stop them from finding the key. The reason why they did that was just because those people needed some trials. Can you believe it?

BS02-069.name: The BlackTiger Kuron
BS02-069.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can deploy a Purple Nexus card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BS02-069.flavor:
"Do you know that there is a white tiger and a black tiger in this world..." At that moment, a black tiger showed up right behind him and crossed the path. Then, he said "Let me know when you find them." By that time, the tiger was already gone. I guess I should keep this a secret.
-from the 4th paragraph in chapter Yellow of "Record of the Strange World" by Wander Lolo"-

BS02-084.name: The Blessed Sanctuary
BS02-084.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Yellow Spirits are destroyed, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Yellow Spirits are destroyed, draw a card.
BS02-084.flavor:
A small church that has a look of a fairyland. So many people are on the waiting line to have a wedding at this church.
-from the Places of Interest 711/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A981.name: The BlossomChild Lip
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A981.effect: [LV2] (During Your Battle Phase) Each time a spirit your opponent controls blocks a yellow spirit you control, if you control a combination of three yellow spirits or yellow nexuses, that blocking spirit is treated as being at LV1 until end of turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A981.flavor: There is a kid who can talk with flowers. Isn't that wonderful? However, if all flowers talk, it may make me sick.

BS02-038.name: The Buckler Langlies
BS02-038.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
This Spirit can't attack.

[LV2] (When Destroyed)
Target a Spirit you control. Send all cores from this Spirit to the targeted Spirit you control instead of the Reserve.
BS02-038.flavor:
That guy swung the large scissors down on it. However, the scissors were reflected by its hard armor. A living thing against a machine... this is not fair.
-from the 3rd paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS02-081.name: The Budding Plain
BS02-081.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When you use a Magic effect, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Give every "Parasite" family Spirit card in your Hand the effect: "[High Speed] This Spirit can be summoned from the Hand during Flash Timing. Both the cost and the cores to be put onto this Spirit must be from the Reserve."
BS02-081.flavor:
The field that lies around the woods of the World Tree. The blowing wind brings comfort and makes the noise of the woods disappear.
-from the Places of Interest 855/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A984.name: The CavalryBeast Sleiphorse
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A984.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (During Your Battle Phase) Each time this spirit gets an addition to its BP due to the effects of a green spell, this spirit gets an addition +2000BP until end of turn.

[LV3] (During Your Battle Phase) Each time another green spirit you control gets an addition to its BP due to the effect of a green spell, it gets an additional +2000BP until end of turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A984.flavor: There are 12 guardian beasts protecting the elders. But, they are a little difficult and unapproachable.

BS02-005.name: The Charger Dragno
BS02-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can't block opposing Spirits.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +2000 BP.
BS02-005.flavor: Even though they were retreating, they charged the enemy, to my surprise. The reckless warriors struggled and helped the others survive.

BS02-060.name: The Clown Clan
BS02-060.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Start Step)
If you control three or more Yellow Spirits/Nexuses, during this turn, all your Spirits are also treated as Cost 2 Spirits.
BS02-060.flavor: I'm the only one who is searching for the key seriously.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A987.name: The Conqueror Cendragos
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A987.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Each player selects 1 color among the spirits they control. Then, each player destroys all of their spirits except the ones with the selected color(s).

[LV2] (When Attacks) This spirit gets +4000BP until end of turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A987.flavor: The dinosaurs are so stupid that they woke up the ancient dragons who had been slumbering for 300 years.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A988.name: The Corridor of Mirrors
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A988.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (During the Battle Phase) Each time a spirit you control with Immunity: X would be defeated by an X color spirit, that spirit may remain on your Field exhausted instead.

[LV2] (During the Battle Phase) Each time your opponent plays a spell, negate that effect. Then, remove 2 cores from this nexus. This effect can be applied only once per turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A988.flavor:
The strange space where the images are reflected infinitely. Even though there is only one straight road, it leads you to stray somehow.
-from the Places of Interest 62/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS03-021.name: The Count Wyhl
BS03-021.effect:
[LV3] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, exhaust every Spirit with the same LV as that destroyed Spirit.
BS03-021.flavor: The king's camp is not as monolithic as believed. The enemies of our enemies can be our ally, even though we can't fully trust them.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A990.name: The DarkFeather Yatagross
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A990.effect: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed) Gain cores in your Reserve equal to the number of cores that were on this spirit when it was destroyed.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A990.flavor: Some say they bring us bad luck, but others say they bring us victory. I wonder what the truth is?

BS02-024.name: The DarkGeneral Bloody-Caesar
BS02-024.kanji: 暗黒将軍ブラッディ・シーザー
BS02-024.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
When the opponent declares to block this Spirit, you can send up to two cores from the blocking Spirit to the opposing Reserve.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an exhausted Spirit you or the opponent controls.
BS02-024.flavor: He mercilessly took the lives of the knights who fought back against him bravely. The king's victory became much more solid in that moment.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A992.name: The DragonBuster Archeorni
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A992.kanji: 竜狩りのアーケオルニ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A992.effect: [LV2] When Nexuses on your Field or the opposing Field are destroyed, for each Nexus destroyed, draw a card.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A992.flavor:
The companion grinned as he spoke. "You know what? They don't care which side they are on. They just show up and keep hunting every single dragon on the battlefield. They are more like berserkers rather than heroes"
-from the 4th paragraph in chapter Red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS02-048.name: The DragonTank Earthguard
BS02-048.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can summon a Spirit card with the same family as this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirit summoned via this effect can't activate.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked non-Cost 8 Spirits.
BS02-048.flavor: He won the first and only victory as he roared. Breaking the old gate was quite a splendid achievement.

BS02-078.name: The Evil Coffin
BS02-078.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Main Step)
Unless via Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects, when the number of cores on Spirits is increased, exhaust them.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Every LV3 Spirit you control can target and attack an opposing exhausted Spirit.
BS02-078.flavor:
The place where the rulers were buried. Even though it is abandoned now, you need nutrients when you come here. Otherwise, it will drain your energy and exhaust you right away.
-from the Places of Interest 554/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

TI-TANYA2.name: The FairyQueen Ti-Tanya
TI-TANYA2.kanji: 妖精女王ティ・ターニャ
TI-TANYA2.effect: [LV2][LV3] (Opponent's Battle Phase) At start of the Phase, you may move 2 cores from your Trash to this spirit.
TI-TANYA2.flavor: The queen seems to be depressed. The keys were found in other countries but not in her own.

BS02-053.name: The Fairy Tanya
BS02-053.flavor: I definitely think one of them is in the land of fairy. It looks like the fairies have been searching for it desperately.

BS02-079.name: The Forest of Amethyst
BS02-079.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit is destroyed by opposing Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects, by sending a core from that Spirit to the Void, it can return to your Field, refreshed.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When the step ends, if you control three or more refreshed Spirits, draw two cards.
BS02-079.flavor:
The place where the great snake with wisdom lives. The purple crystals purify the poison gas and heal the traces of the fierce battle.
-from the Places of Interest 410/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS02-X07.name: The Gigantic Thor
BS02-X07.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By exhausting one of your "Armed Machine" family Spirits, give this Spirit + (Exhausted Spirit's BP) BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Blocks)
When this Spirit blocks an opposing Red Spirit, it doesn't exhaust.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, by destroying one of your "Armed Machine" family Spirits, this Spirit refreshes.
BS02-X07.flavor: His appearance has the same meaning as despair. He brings destruction to everything turning his comrades into weapons.

BS02-075.name: The GreatAngelia Principearl
BS02-075.kanji: 天使長プリンシパール
BS02-075.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy a Cost 4 or less you control. Put a number of cores from the Void to your Reserve equal to the cost of the destroyed Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When a "BP+" Magic effect is used with this Spirit as target, this Spirit gains +3000 BP further.
BS02-075.flavor: What made the god mad is still unknown. The GreatAngelia seems to have told something on him.

BS02-036.name: The Great Kaiseleon
BS02-036.effect:
[LV1] (Your Attack Step)
This Spirit can't attack.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, send a core from the opposing Life to the Reserve.
BS02-036.flavor: He is the elder from another woods. They called for his help to kick the ruffians out.

BS02-063.name: The HellDog Cerru-Berus
BS02-063.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
This Spirit can't attack or block.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Start Step)
Move an opposing Cost 6 Spirit to your Field in the same state it is in. You can use the Spirit you moved during this turn as your Spirit. When you do, the cores on the moved Spirit are treated as that owned by its owner; cores can't be moved from that Spirit, or sent to that Spirit. When the turn ends, return that Spirit to the opposing Field in exhausted state.
BS02-063.flavor: People adore him so much for some reason. I understand why they can't help loving him.

BS02-073.name: The Kaiser Empereur
BS02-073.effect:
[LV3] (Either Start Step)
At the start of the step, by sending a core from your Reserve to the Void, during this turn, you can treat every opposing Nexus as being LV1.
BS02-073.flavor: It seems like the king has one of the keys. So, there are six more keys left out there.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1003.name: The LavaDragon Plesios
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) When both players control three or more colors of Nexuses in total, each player targets a color of Nexuses on their Field, and destroy every Nexus without that color.

[LV3] (When Attacks) If the opponent controls two or more colors of Nexuses, when this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, send an extra core from the opposing Life to the Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1003.flavor: They used what little intelligence they had and came up with attacks from the shore. The loud march has begun for the next decisive battle.

BS02-080.name: The Limestone Cave of Emerald
BS02-080.kanji: エメラルドに輝く鍾乳洞
BS02-080.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your Spirits with three or more cores on them get +1000 BP.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison with your Spirits with three cores or more on them, put a core from the Void to this Nexus.
BS02-080.flavor:
The mysterious land that grows green like a luminous moss. I've found only one place like this so far. They say that there are four more places like this in the woods of the World Tree.
-from the Places of Interest 808/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS02-022.name: The Marquis Cocytus
BS02-022.kanji: 魔界侯爵コキュートス
BS02-022.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Refresh Step)
When this Spirit would refresh, send a core from one opposing Spirit or one opposing Nexus to their Trash.

[LV3] (Your Refresh Step)
When this Spirit would refresh, send two cores from from one opposing Spirit or one opposing Nexus to their Trash.
BS02-022.flavor:
The noble of the evil world showed his true nature.
-from the 3rd paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo."-

BS02-064.name: The Melodybird Crewc
BS02-064.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Start Step)
During this turn, you can give "Song Bird" family Spirits you control and all "Song Bird" family Spirit cards in your Hand a family you like.
BS02-064.flavor: There is a bird in the land of rainbow that knows where the key is. Everybody is trying hard to catch it.

BS02-034.name: The OldSage Trenton
BS02-034.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can summon a Green Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirit summoned by this effect do not activate.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
BS02-034.flavor:
Then, the old sage pointed to his back slowly.
-from the 9th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS02-077.name: The Plateau of Duel
BS02-077.effect:
[LV1] (Opposing Start Step)
Refresh a Spirit with [Awaken] you control.

[LV2] (Opposing Start Step)
Refresh every Spirit with [Awaken] you control.
BS02-077.flavor:
The great land of the awakening. They say a legendary hero had been defeated here and turned himself into a dragon.
-from the Places of Interest 3/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1009.name: The PreciousBeast Carbulc
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed) Gain 1 core in your Reserve for each "Imaginary Beast" spirit you control.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed) Draw 1 card for each "Imaginary Beast" spirit you control.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1009.flavor: They say there is a beast that brings luck. If I take it with me, can I find the key?

BS02-007.name: The RiseDragon Balmung
BS02-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - [Awaken]
You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.
BS02-007.flavor: Have I told you about the curse of the dragonization? Look at him. He is a typical example of the failure.
sets: Let'S Play Battle Spirits!! Starter Kit

BS02-039.name: The Sacred Mjolnir
BS02-039.flavor: The hammer of the great emperor which brings destruction. It crushes everything regardless of whether it is a living thing or inanimate object.
sets: Let'S Play Battle Spirits!! Starter Kit

BS02-087.name: The Sealed Spellbook
BS02-087.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Turn)
You can change the target of Magic effects that target both players to either only you, or only the opponent.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When you draw via Spirit/Magic effects, double the total number of the cards you would draw. (This effect doesn't stack.)
BS02-087.flavor:
The spell book that has been succeeded to penguin country for ages. No one has ever read it. It has been displayed in the hall of the castle. They say that the real one has been stolen and they replaced it with a fake.
-from the Places of Interest 77/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS02-X06.name: The SevenShogun Destlord
BS02-X06.kanji: 魔界七将デストロード
BS02-X06.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Exhaust every LV2 Spirit.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, put a number of cores from the Void to your Reserve equals to the number of cores on that destroyed opposing Spirit.
BS02-X06.flavor: The ruler of fear froze the foes at the first sight, The traitors stopped resisting and threw themselves at their feet.

ZO-GOIN2.name: The SkullKnight Zo-Goin
ZO-GOIN2.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks) Move 1 core from target spirit your opponent controls to its owner's Reserve.

[LV3] (When Attacks) Randomly discard 1 card from your opponent's hand.
ZO-GOIN2.flavor: The knight who had the wisdom of the snake became the guardian of the traitors.

BS02-030.name: The Soldier Antman
BS02-030.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV2] (When Destroyed)
You can summon any number of "Parasite" family Spirit cards from your Hand, paying their costs. However, any (When Summoned) effects of those Spirits can't activate.
BS02-030.flavor: They come from underground. Not only that, they take the violent Dukes with them through a tunnel that they dug.

BS02-086.name: The Spiral Tower
BS02-086.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When the opponent would use a Magic effect, they must pay one extra cost.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When the opponent would use a Magic effect, they must pay the entire cost from the Reserve.
BS02-086.flavor:
A tower in the outskirts of the fairy land. It is abandoned now. However, it used to be used as a prison in the old days.
-from the Places of Interest 157/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS02-085.name: The Topaz Meteor
BS02-085.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Give every Nexus card in your Hand reduction symbols: [Yellow Core][Yellow Core].

[LV2]
You can treat every Nexus you control as LV2.
BS02-085.flavor:
The shooting star that can be seen on a clear day, at a certain time of a certain month. They say that seeing it 1000 times makes you become rich.
-from the Places of Interest 7/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS02-X05.name: The TwinRowdy Diranos
BS02-X05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
All your Spirits with [Awaken] gain +1000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
Give all your "Terra Dragon" family Spirits: "[Awaken] During Flash Timing, you can put any number of cores from Spirits you control to this Spirit."
BS02-X05.flavor: Dinosaurs are already aware. Don't run now. It's not dinosaurs but him who is right behind us getting impatient to take our lives.

BS02-023.name: The TwinSnake Hydram
BS02-023.flavor: They have wisdom in their right brain and the courage in their left brain. They nourished the bud of rebellion using those two brains.

BS02-068.name: The WhiteTiger Huck
BS02-068.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can deploy a White Nexus card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BS02-068.flavor: There is a white tiger and a black tiger that know the secret of the keys. But, it's so rare to encounter them since they live in an unusual place.

BS02-107.name: Time Reap
BS02-107.effect:
[Main]
Activate a (When Summoned) effect of a Spirit you control.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

BS02-018.name: Top Supra
BS02-018.effect:
[LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by LV3 Spirits.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by LV2/LV3 Spirits.
BS02-018.flavor: They are one as two. They come from the true darkness.

BS02-072.name: Trickster
BS02-072.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return a Magic card from your Trash to the Hand.
BS02-072.flavor:
"I can guide you to that place." That girl stood up with a smile and said "Can you help me find the key in return?"
-from the 1st paragraph in chapter Yellow of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1025.name: Xscissors
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1025.effect: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Start Step) The number of cores on target nexus you control is treated as the same as the number of cores on this spirit until end of turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1025.flavor: His jaws are noticeable, aren't they? But, they also have tremendous power.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1026.name: Anteater
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1026.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Destroy an opposing Spirit with "Antman" in its name.

[LV1][LV2] When this Spirit is destroyed due to the effects of an opposing Spirit, send all Cores from the Spirit who activated the effect to your opponent's Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1026.flavor: Those who are weak are always on the prowl for those weaker than them. This neverending hierarchy pyramid never changes, regardless of what world you're in.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1027.name: Bogies
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1027.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed) Send all but one of the Cores on one of your opponent's Spirits to his/her Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1027.flavor: Do the Armies of Oblivion have a main base of operations? Research has only just begun. The Old Tyrants can't seem to find another method of winning.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1028.name: Elefog
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1028.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed) For each color of Spirit/Nexus on the opposing field, send one core from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1028.flavor:
Due to past events, Kei had many supporters in Dark Shield. But considering recent disturbances, the policy of refusing refugees caused Kei's charisma to fade. Instead, the popularity of "The God-Slayer Hero" Manaka quickly mounted. His nickname of God-Slayer spread among this nation's people.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 643—

BS39-013.name: Execeed-Rebirth
BS39-013.kanji: エグゼシード・リバース
BS39-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can discard three cards from your decktop. When any "TwelveGodKing"-named Spirit card is discarded by this effect, send two cores from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit with three or more cores on it.
BS39-013.flavor: The approach to the heaven course is shrouded by mist, making vision poor and footing just as bad. Oh, I couldn't see it well, but I think a shadow of something just passed through...

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1030.name: Gagamoth
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1030.flavor: The snakes with weak eyesight rely on the scent of moth wingscales. To meet them, all one needs to do is follow the moths.

BS24-012.name: GasRabbit
BS24-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
For each Spirit/Ultimate you control, discard a card from the opposing Removed Zone.
BS24-012.flavor: They vanished again, like wisps of gas... P-Major has a lock on their signatures, but it's hard to analyze the Spirits of this region.

BS76-010.name: Gas Mouse
BS76-010.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) During your Main Step, if you control any Purple Flag Nexus, including those in pre-advent condition, you can set this card from the Trash. When you've done so, your counter +1.

[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Purple Core])]
[During Set]
While you control two or more "The DemonArmyFlagbearer Amon", including those in Trash/Soul State/pre-advent condition, all Purple "Bannerace" family cards in your Trash are unaffected by opposing effects. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.
BS76-010.flavor:
In the Uncharted Realm, banners known as "Flags" gather Spirits to form "Clans", and it is these Clans that govern the world.
―Uncharted Realm Log 01―

BS54-019.name: Gas Norbear
BS54-019.effect:
When this set card would be discarded by you, you can reveal and return it to the Hand.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Draw two cards. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.
BS54-019.flavor:
Around the "Grandstone", seemingly there are unfamiliar Spirits prowling around, attempting to take it. Those are undoubtedly enemies, I think.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 3:23―

BS31-013.name: Gas Owl
BS31-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
Send a core from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to their Reserve.
BS31-013.flavor:
Combat Era, January 561. The DarkArtsMagician returned at the height of the fourth battle.
―from the Kaminakajima Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BS47-013.name: Gas Turtle
BS47-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When cores from your Purple Grandwalker Nexus are sent to the Void by opposing effects, for each core sent to the Void, send one core from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to their Trash.
BS47-013.flavor:
On the far skies, on the center of the multiple worlds, Alex, who suddenly appeared, advented Grand-Siegfried onto herself.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 4:35―

BS63-023.name: Gasberix
BS63-023.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
While there are 20 or less cards in your Trash, cards in your Trash are unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
You can discard a card from your decktop. If that's a "Blood Crystal" family card, during this turn, all your Spirits can't be exhausted by opposing effects.
BS63-023.flavor:
Bat met Fallenhyde again at the ancient castle of Argamet. However, Fallenhyde was held captive by The-Devil via Devil Marshal. While Bat fought with the Devil Marshal and ultimately defeated him, his sword was tainted black. This wasn't the sword that he longed for. And The-Devil didn't miss out any of these.
―The Holy Evil Saga 02―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1037.name: Gasfrog
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1037.flavor:
The most disadvantaged country in the "Uprising of the Six Vanity Deities" was Dark Shield. Once sent there as an emissary of peace, Kei did not forgive this country and rejected its refugees. This crime against humanity was one of Kei's few failures before becoming Empress.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of the Hero Kei, Year 643—

BS38-009.name: Gasnaco
BS38-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve. If you control any Ultimate, also, draw a card.
BS38-009.flavor: The Evil God Army's destination is Japang, which is exactly the same place as the next BSGP's venue. Lord Daiteiou consulted with Lord Burning-Souldragon there, and Lord Burning-Souldragon consented to protect the race. Now we can say that the race will indeed be held! That's all from Tonio in Japang.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1039.name: Gastoras
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1039.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed) Send two cores each from two opposing Cost 1 or less Spirits to the Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1039.flavor:
We feared that the pursuer might be an incorporeal being. However, a gentle beast eased our anxiety by veiling us in fog.
-from the 4th paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wander Lolo"

BS65-010.name: Gaswallow
BS65-010.effect:
(Can't Stack) When your "Infernal Contract" family Spirits would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Trash.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1.
BS65-010.flavor:
Where is this place? We are searching for Legend Spirits, right? But we are going deeper and deeper into this weird forest....

It’s a forest. It’ll be fine~ Ah, look~ There is a castle over there~
―The Flower Partner, Frau―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1041.name: Ginroukaku
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1041.effect: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) You can summon a "Kinkokaku" from your Trash, without paying the cost.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1041.flavor:
Making the countries submit went quickly. This caused Kei misunderstandings. The government officials of Dark Shield were sacked so that the Fire Shield could continue with its own way of doing things.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of the Hero Kei, Year 645—

BS55-013.name: Godseeker YomiWing Doyokumono
BS55-013.kanji: ゴッドシーカー 黄泉ノ翼トヨクモノ
BS55-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add an exactly-named "Grandwalkers Izanagi & Izanami", and a "Spiritual Beast"/"Plant Spirit" family card, besides any "Godseeker"/"Pioneer", to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When you're summoning/deploying any "Spiritual Beast"/"Plant Spirit"/"Amahara" family Spirit card/Grandwalker Nexus card, treat one of its Green reduction symbols as fulfilled.
BS55-013.flavor: Letters written by Izanami reach Izanagi's place day by day, day by day.

BS01-037.name: Illusiona
BS01-037.effect:
[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target an opposing exhausted Spirit and attack it.
BS01-037.flavor: Whenever someone speaks ill of the king, the prison guard always rushes to that place. There always was a small black cat near the victims.

SD41-005.name: Jadgas
SD41-005.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Purple Core][Purple Core])]
Send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve. Then, by paying one cost, send two cores from an opposing Spirit to their Reserve. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.
SD41-005.flavor: Ninjas, then Astral Dragons...We earned new comrades again. Now the only thing left is to collect the holy relics. Let's return, to the Red World!

BS34-011.name: Kemurineko
BS34-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit to their Reserve.
BS34-011.flavor:
The Nightlings that controlled Onmyou Territory brought the Ogre Wizards with them to the Six Heaven Army faction. The only ones from Violet Spectre Province that sided with the GenjiEightKnights faction were really the Spiritual Beasts. Of course, their only reason was probably just that they didn't like the Six Heaven Army.
―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―

BS33-013.name: Kemuriten
BS33-013.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Draw a card from your deck. If you have Soul Core in your Trash, the opponent cannot activate their Burst due to this effect.
BS33-013.flavor:
The day after the Six Heaven Army reinforcements arrived, the Heaven Squad rendezvoused with Blue Seas Province's Azure Fang Squad.
―from the Battle of Nagashino Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BS31-021.name: Kemurizaru
BS31-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
Send three cores from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to their Reserve. If there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Spirit, also, draw three cards.
BS31-021.flavor: The DarkArtsMagician was deeply wounded in the second battle. Being a master of magic, healing the wound would be easy, but it would require him to step away from the battlefront and go dormant.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1048.name: Kinkokaku
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1048.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) You can summon a "Ginroukaku" from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step) Spirits can't be returned to the Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1048.flavor:
Some of the sacked government officials had held popular sentiment. All that they had would later tide over to Manaka.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of the Hero Kei, Year 645—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1049.name: Kitsunaby
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1049.effect: [LV1][LV2] This Spirit is also treated as a Red Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1049.flavor:
"I wasn't able to meet with my guide, but if I find them, I should be okay; I'm just following behind them after all. I need to see the Dark Snakes once again. What am I able to do before we engage toward an end to this conflict? Now that I learned the whole story behind this world, it's time to start getting some answers.
-from the 2nd paragraph on the final chapter in "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1050.name: Kouenko
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1050.effect: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) For each "Spiritual Beast" family Spirit you control, send a core from one opposing Spirit to the Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1050.flavor:
Had the God-Slayer Hero Manaka been with the Flame Shield camp, there likely would have been more cooperators within Dark Shield.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of the Hero Kei, Year 645—

BS68-011.name: Leo-Smog
BS68-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Petit Bat", you can discard a card from your decktop. When you've done so, by paying two costs, your counter +1. Then, if there are four or more cards with [True-Curse] in your Trash, draw a card.

[LV2] [True-Curse] (Your Turn)
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
BS68-011.flavor:
Bat was separated from Dan when they were under the attack of the primordial deities, and ended up in Dionysus' world.
―"Theogonic Record" Fragment―

BS26-012.name: Lynxsmoker
BS26-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
The opponent discards a card from their Hand. When destroyed by an opposing Ultimate, also, the opponent discards a card from their Hand.
BS26-012.flavor: If the Ultimates are going to be wiped out by the foreign Spirits, can't we leave them alone now? Or is that out of the question?

BS37-014.name: Mist Bat
BS37-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
After your [Accel] effect resolves, you can put a core from your Reserve to your Life. This effect doesn't stack.
BS37-014.flavor: From here we can see the scene of the accident in an uproar, and the audience seems disturbed too. It seems to have been caused by racers Exeseed and Ourovorius colliding. Both racers have already been brought in to the relief area, but there's no word on their condition.

BS54-011.name: Mist Monkey
BS54-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When you're deploying a "Mega-Grandstone"-named Nexus card, this Spirit gains an extra Yellow symbol.

[LV2]
All your Purple Grandstone Nexuses gain an extra Purple symbol.
BS54-011.flavor:
There have been fragments of gems. Was the vanished area returned because the gem was shattered? Or, was it because that certain Imagine appeared? Or...There are too many things we still don't understand. We must collect more information.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 3:19―

BS37-019.name: Mist Wyvern
BS37-019.flavor: Many conjectures float about from the testimonies at the site, such as Racer Exeseed's tumbling causing the accident, or that Racer Ourovorius' attack was the source of it.

BS01-042.name: Mistweasel
BS01-042.flavor: A small spiritual beast that battles against the envoys from the evil world. It gives a light of hope to the traitors and disappears before they know it.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1058.name: Necrow
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1058.effect: [LV1][LV2] Curse (During Your Battle Phase) Each time this spirit is blocked, destroy the spirit that blocked this spirit at End of Battle Step.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1058.flavor: Once a "blade of death" that opposed all Demonkin, now they're subordinates working under some of Demon World's generals. Having rejected and repelled the Oblivion Army before, how will their relationship develop?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1059.name: Onigumon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1059.flavor:
Written records on the Star Core and the Twelve Zodiac Deities are surprisingly few and far between. In other words, they've turned into children's fairy tales where no one knows if they truly exist or not. Still, it's a story that easily charms even the most ambitious.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

SD32-005.name: Origamiantler
SD32-005.effect:
[When Braved] (When Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve. Then, put a core from the Void to your White Spirit with Soul Core on it.
SD32-005.flavor:
Bonnouji was set fire to during the attack, and nothing could be found among the ashes. A sudden betrayal by a trusted vassal, and a missing corpse. There are many strange things about the Incident at Bonnouji.
―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―

BS31-075.name: Origamibird
BS31-075.effect:
This Brave card in Trash is treated as Cost 2.

[When Braved] (When Attacks) You can target and attack an exhausted opposing Spirit. If there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Spirit, also, destroy an opposing braved Brave.
BS31-075.flavor: It seems Onmyou Territory has devised a spell to seal Spiritual Beasts into paper and have them do their bidding.

BS31-076.name: Origamihorse
BS31-076.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Send cores from an opposing Spirit to their Reserve until only one remains on it.

[When Braved] (When Battles)
By discarding a card from your Hand, send a core from any opposing Spirit to their Reserve.
BS31-076.flavor: The DarkArtsMagician was the inheritor of soul magic and the legitimate head of Onmyou Territory.

BS32-057.name: Origamimonkey
BS32-057.effect:
[When Braved] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts.
BS32-057.flavor: Origami are born by imitating the form of something, with their souls surrounding their bodies in the form of purple smoke.

BS67-018.name: Pegasusmog
BS67-018.effect:
When your "Curse"-named effect activates, you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, send three cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] [True-Curse] (Your Turn)
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
BS67-018.flavor:
Finally, Desparado! Then we will send out Kingtaurus. Siegfrieden, everything is ready! It's time. This is your stage!
―Contractor Χ―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1066.name: Phantom Hound
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1066.effect: [LV1][LV2] Flash- (Either Attack Step) By destroying this Spirit, destroy all Braves from 1 opposing Brave Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1066.flavor: If we can get to Darkness Hole, we'll be able to solve all of this... right? If Antarc's research is correct, that'll be the case.

BS32-012.name: Purple Smoke Boar
BS32-012.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) By discarding a Spirit card from your Hand, draw a card from your deck.
BS32-012.flavor:
The Six Heaven Army blended with the rain and slipped through Gandala's surveillance, successfully advancing their troops to the close proximity of the Supreme Beast Army camp.
―from the Oukehazama Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BS33-012.name: Purple Smoke Butterfly
BS33-012.flavor: The Six Heaven Army sent a messenger to Violet Spectre Province and requested a deployment of troops from Onmyou Territory.

BSC25-012.name: Purple Smoke Crocodile
BSC25-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your End Step)
Return a "Nightling"/"Spiritual Beast" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.
BSC25-012.flavor: Racer Ourovorius has covered Racer Exeseed with a new, unknown technique, and now Racers Andaluzia and Lipitzzaner have fallen out of the scuffle for the lead!

P15-03.name: Purple Smoke Deer
P15-03.effect:
This Spirit card in Trash is treated as Cost 1.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
If this Spirit is summoned from the Trash, draw a card.
P15-03.flavor: The interpretation of "death" for Onmyou Territory is a little different from our understanding of it. Going to the underworld is not a loss of something, but a gain. To be precise, you're bringing something else along with you.

BS31-022.name: Purple Smoke Dragon
BS31-022.effect:
This Spirit card in the Trash is treated as Cost 3.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, also, destroy an opposing exhausted Ultimate.
BS31-022.flavor:
In the second battle, the DarkArtsMagician was wounded by the Blue Seas WisdomKing's strike. His sword is still passed on as a treasure.
―from the Soldier's Biography of "Sengoku Obscurities" by Kuroe―

BS34-018.name: Purple Smoke Eagle
BS34-018.flavor: In a strange turn, the general of the Spiritual Beasts, Amehoshi-no-Mikoto, sealed away Onmyou Territory's army and opened the warpath for Burning-Souldragon.

BS36-014.name: Purple Smoke Fish
BS36-014.effect:
[When Braved] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve.
BS36-014.flavor: The last stretch of the course is once again a Monaca city. The tired and wounded racers are greeted by warm applause from the audience. That's all from Tonio's course report.

BS35-020.name: Purple Smoke Kirin
BS35-020.effect:
This Spirit card in Trash is treated as Cost 3.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
For each "Spiritual Beast" family Spirit card in your Trash, send a core from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Reserve.
BS35-020.flavor: After the attack, Ourovorius stalls, then goes to the rear of the second group as if watching the situation!

BS33-019.name: Purple Smoke Lion
BS33-019.effect:
When summoning this Spirit card, you can discard up to three cards from your decktop. For each card discarded by this effect, this Spirit card's cost gets -1 cost.

[LV2][LV3]
For both players, when non-Purple Spirit card/Brave card would be summoned via effects, unless five extra costs is paid, it can't be summoned.
BS33-019.flavor:
The united forces of "Heaven" that had set out to siege the military castle collapsed against the all-out attack by the Six Heaven Army.
―from the Battle of Nagashino Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BS35-013.name: Purple Smoke Spider
BS35-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
If [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.
BS35-013.flavor: The last spurt is developing into a three-way struggle! Now, on whose head will the crown of victory shine on for BSGP's opening battle, the Norse-Trio GP?!

BS32-016.name: Purple Smoke Tiger
BS32-016.effect:
When this card is sent to the Trash from deck by opposing Ultimate-Trigger/either player's "deck discarding" effects, you can summon it, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By discarding up to three cards from your Hand, for each card discarded, send a core from an opposing Spirit to their Trash.
BS32-016.flavor: Having heard of what the "Master" commanded, Yakumo besieged the third fort, taking only a few soldiers with him.

BS01-036.name: Sha-Zoo
BS01-036.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
Exhaust up to two Spirits.
BS01-036.flavor: Its distorted death cry sullies the soul. Once you hear it, you'll faint and if it's close, it'll take your life.

BSC42-018.name: Sha-Zoo LT
BSC42-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
Exhaust up to two Spirits/Ultimates.
BSC42-018.flavor: Its distorted death cry sullies the soul. Once you hear it, you'll faint and if it's close, it'll take your life.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1081.name: Smog-Cock
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1081.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent) Exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1081.flavor:
Thanks to Hera's bold decision, Hermes was able to return to Zeus' side in an instant.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 3:33―

SD41-003.name: Smog Hand
SD41-003.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 3 ([Purple Core][Purple Core])]
Summon a Cost 1 or less Purple Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.
SD41-003.flavor: You move just like a ninja! Would it be possible that you actually came from the Ninja Village ?!

BS44-015.name: Smog Phynx
BS44-015.effect: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent) This Spirit returns to your hand. Also, if you control a Nexus, send one core from any opposing Spirit(s) to the Reserve.
BS44-015.flavor:
Other than Lolo, who had just received the accolade as a Grandwalker like us, none were aware of that.
―"Genesis Records" Prologue 02―

BS26-009.name: Smog Sheep
BS26-009.effect: [LV1][LV2][LV3] When your Spirits are destroyed by opposing effects, by sending a core from any opposing Ultimates to the Reserve, the destroyed Spirits remains on your Field, exhausted.
BS26-009.flavor: That tiny thing's the one giving the Ultimates such a hard time? These guys from somewhere-or-other are amazing.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1085.name: Smoggoat
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1085.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve. This effect cannot bring the cores on the opposing Spirit to 0.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1085.flavor: He can weaken anyone who looks at him. It is indeed a terrifying ability but I wonder how effective it will be against them, who are stronger than demons. The hopeless battle will continue.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1086.name: Smogpecker
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1086.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed) Draw a card from your deck.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1086.flavor: There's poison gas here too!? ...No, I'm wrong. It seems that he himself is a gaseous being. Really, that's just in poor taste.

BS64-013.name: Smoke Baboon
BS64-013.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Purple Core])]
[During Set]
Once per turn, when your “Blood Crystal” family Spirit would leave the Field due to your effect or an opposing effect, you can summon a “Blood Crystal” family Spirit card from your Hand.

[LV1][LV2]
While you control any “The PartnerMusha Oboro”, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, increase the limit of your "X core or less Destruction Effect" by +1.
BS64-013.flavor:
Bat~ Our fight has yeeeet to be settled~ I believe~ in you. We must see each other once again~
―The PartnerMusha Oboro―

BS61-012.name: Smoke Brown Bear
BS61-012.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Curse Contract, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Your counter +1. Then, you can destroy a Spirit/Ultimate you or the opponent controls with two cores or less on it.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Destroyed)
Once per turn, by banishing a "Blood Crystal" family card from your Trash, summon one of your "The PartnerMusha Oboro" that is in Soul State/pre-advent condition.

BS67-008.name: Smoke Edge Bat
BS67-008.kanji: スモークエッジバット
BS67-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
While there is any cards with "Curse"-named effects in your Trash, every "Blood Crystal" family card in your Trash is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV2] [True-Curse] (Your Turn)
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
BS67-008.flavor: It all started with Chronos' invasion on "Grand-Lolo", the war that is also called the Chrownos War. The world was successfully protected by the Oracle Spirits and the inhabitants of the world, but something went wrong. A bug has occurred on The-Judgment.

BS11-009.name: Smokeloco
BS11-009.flavor:
The earth lightly trembles, when suddenly—BOOM!!! An explosive thud resounds with enough force to rock the planet to its core. Following the impact is an enraged roar loud enough to shatter your eardrums! The 'Black Supernova' has risen... In the final stages of the Great Wall of the Shield invasion, the armies of the Solar Militia fell to pieces in a devastating burst.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1091.name: Smokujira
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1091.effect: [LV1][LV2][LV3] When your Cost 3 Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, you can destroy a Cost 3 or less Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1091.flavor: The whale floating in the peach-colored sky dissolving the dark night became a place of refuge. It took the injured upon its back and returned them as soon as they were healed.

CB05-011.name: Tapirmon
CB05-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Add one "Ultimate"/"Mega" family Spirit card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] [Digivolve: Red/Purple] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Red/Purple "Champion" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB05-011.flavor:
[Rookie. Sacred Beast. Vaccine]
A Digimon modeled after the dream-eating creature.

BS28-018.name: The BlackCorpseDragon Shadurga
BS28-018.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Brave's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Draw two cards. After this effect resolves, if your Life is at three or less, you can summon this Spirit card.

[LV2] (When Battles)
Send one core each from every opposing Spirit to their Rreserve.
BS28-018.flavor: The astral spirits' invasion is finally calming down. Of course. If two continents collide, everything will be gone.

BS60-024.name: The BlackSmokeDragon Fognir
BS60-024.effect:
During your Main Step, if you control any "The PartnerKnight Bat", including being in Soul State/pre-advent, by discarding this card from your Hand, discard up to three cards from your decktop.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Send four cores from the opposing Reserve to the Trash. Then, when summoned from the Trash, during this turn, a Purple Spirit with [Contract Advent] you control is fixed as having three Purple symbols.
BS60-024.flavor:
The skies of the Darkness Capital is the territory of the smoke clan.
―The PartnerKnight Bat―

BS32-X02.name: The DivineSpiritKing Amehoshi-no-Mikoto
BS32-X02.kanji: 神霊王アメホシノミコト
BS32-X02.effect:
This card in Trash becomes Cost 4.

[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4]
While there is [Soul Core] on this Spirit, increase the LV cost of every opposing Cost 0/2/4/7 Spirit by +3.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
Return a Purple card from your Trash to the Hand. When a "Lord"/"Vassal" family Spirit card is returned, the opponent destroys a Spirit they control.
BS32-X02.flavor: "The Six Heaven... they are an obstruction in my path to sovereignty."

BSC47-X01.name: The KamiumiYomiBird Amenotorifune
BSC47-X01.kanji: 神産ノ黄泉鳥アメノトリフネ
BSC47-X01.effect:
[Yo Unleash: 1] [Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Nexus' (When Summoned/Deployed) effect resolves]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, draw two cards. Then, by sending one core from any of your "Izanami" Grandwalker Nexus to this Spirit, send up to two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve.

[Ka Unleash: 1] [Burst: After your Life is reduced]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, by sending one core from any of your "Izanagi" Grandwalker Nexus to this Spirit, heavy exhaust up to two opposing Spirits.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
If you control any "Izanagi & Izanami", you can activate one of this Spirit's [Yomi Unleash]/[Kamiumi Unleash].
BSC47-X01.flavor:
The Divine Wings we bore. Fulfil the contract!
―Grandwalkers Izanagi & Izanami―

SD41-002.name: The MakaiFogDragon Mistwurm
SD41-002.kanji: 魔界霧竜ミストヴルム
SD41-002.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By discarding two cards from your Hand, summon this card from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost.
SD41-002.flavor: The Snakes asked you guys for help? Having accomplished a mutual trust, you guys are so reliable!

BS05-004.name: The MysteriousFox Cubic
BS05-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
You can summon a Purple Cost 5/6/7 Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirit can't activate.
BS05-004.flavor:
Why could that reinforcement of the dead scare the terra dragons? It was the spells of the mysterious fox that reversed the situation completely.
-from the 5th paragraph in chapter Red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BSC42-007.name: The MysteriousFox Cubic LT
BSC42-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
You can summon a Cost 5/6/7 Purple Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. Then, if you control any Purple Spirit, you can send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve.
BSC42-007.flavor:
Why could that reinforcement of the dead scare the terra dragons? It was the spells of the mysterious fox that reversed the situation completely.
-from the 5th paragraph in chapter Red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS15-018.name: The PhantomBeastEmperor Ten-Qoo
BS15-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your End Step)
Summon a number of Cost 4 or less Purple Spirit cards from your Trash, without paying the cost, up to the number of colors of Spirits/Nexuses on the opposing Field.

[LV2]
For each "Spiritual Beast" family Spirit you control, this Spirit gets +1000 BP.
BS15-018.flavor: Until we arrived, they held back the Vanity Deity's invasion by fighting to the death. It is an amazing method that the Flame Shield cannot hope to imitate.

BS01-044.name: The PhantomBull Smowg
BS01-044.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target an opposing Spirit with only one core on it and attack it.
BS01-044.flavor: The traitors' regretful souls came back to life as evils that were burning with hatred.

BS53-021.name: The PurpleSmokeWatchdog Cerberusmog
BS53-021.kanji: 紫煙の番犬 ケルベルスモッグ
BS53-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve, and send the opposing [Soul Core] from the Field/Reserve to the Trash. Also, if you have three counters or more, until the next opposing End Step, the opponent can't move their [Soul Core] from their Trash to the Field/Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] [Rebirth3]
When this Spirit attacks, it can flip.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with two cores or less on it.
BS53-021.flavor: That's the guard dog for the Azure Duke right? I would give you snacks, so please behave!

SHA-ZOO.name: The Rogue Sha-Zoo
SHA-ZOO.flavor: Hunting the rogue ghosts was how I first trained. Even a child was plenty able to defeat them, but they were fast and I remember them tiring me out.

SD57-002.name: The Six Heaven Falcon
SD57-002.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Either put a core from the Void each to two Purple Spirits you control, or put two cores from the Void to a Grandwalker Nexus with two colors or more you control. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2]
This Spirit’s color and symbol are also treated as Purple.
SD57-002.flavor:
Seated at where the head of the territory should be was not the SixAbsoluteDeity of Greed, but Rikudou.
-Two-

BSC48-013.name: The Six Heaven Falcon LT
BSC48-013.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Either put one core from the Void each to two "God-Sechs" you control, or +2 cores in total of any of your "Heavenly Demon King" family Grandwalker Nexuses.

[LV2]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Purple.
BSC48-013.flavor:
Seated at where the head of the territory should be was not the SixAbsoluteDeity of Greed, but Rikudou.
-Two-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1106.name: The SmokeWolf Noroshi
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1106.flavor: Kei's name was already legend in this country, and many spirits were her fans. We were the same age, so I instinctively remembered it.

BS36-018.name: The Third's Purple Smoke Giant
BS36-018.effect:
When this set card is discarded by the opponent, you can activate it, ignoring the Burst condition.

[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the opponent]
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate and an opposing braved Brave. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP.
BS36-018.flavor: Is this the same Spellbind that Racer Ourovorius broke out in the second match? The intense fervor of the FiveGoodDragonEmperors is weakening!

BS62-024.name: The TwinkleSpiritHorse Shrazire
BS62-024.kanji: 煌霊馬シュラーザイヤー
BS62-024.effect:
Main - [Contract Advent: Blood Contract/Spiritual Beast & C4 or more, (Your Main Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
You can discard three cards from your decktop. After this effect resolves, you can return a "Blood Crystal" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by banishing five "Blood Crystal" family cards from your Trash, this Spirit refreshes.

BS14-021.name: The VioletPhoenix Fognix
BS14-021.effect:
Immortality: Cost 4/5 (Either Attack Step) - This Spirit card in your Trash can be summoned when your Cost 4/5 Spirit is destroyed.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) Draw from your deck the same amount of cards as this Spirit's level.
BS14-021.flavor: There is an immortal bird worshiped in the country of Dark Shield. I think I was 14 when I was once blessedly fortunate enough to see it.

BS66-013.name: The WolfGirl Rizera
BS66-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1, and draw a card.

[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, by putting an "Infernal Contract" family Spirit card from your Hand onto the Removed Zone, it remains on the Field, exhausted.
BS66-013.flavor:
Dear Rizera,
I still haven't found the item stolen from the school. That bug has never showed up again before us since then. I'm kinda troubled. But the journey with Toa is fun. For example, we've recently fought against a Spirit which seems to be the boss of the Judgment Beasts.
―The Infernal Partner, Camus―

BS55-014.name: The YomiBeast RaiunGame
BS55-014.kanji: 黄泉ノ獣ライウンガメ
BS55-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
While [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, it can't attack, and is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2]
All six-colored pre-Rebirth Nexuses can't flip. Also, when the [Grand Skill] of a six-colored Grandwalker Nexus would activate, unless the owner sends four cores from their Field/Reserve to the Trash, it can't activate.
BS55-014.flavor:
Seemingly, Grandwalkers would take the spirits which are tainted with their colors the most as their kins. And the kins of Izanami are those thundercloud-like, "Raiun" spirits that live in the Purple World.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 4:05―

BS55-023.name: The YomiBeast RaiunGyuu
BS55-023.kanji: 黄泉ノ獣ライウンギュウ
BS55-023.effect:
When your Spirits are summoned via an effect, you can activate this set card, ignoring the Burst condition.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Send three cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't block unless they send two of their Lives to the Trash.
BS55-023.flavor:
“Wait, Alex! What's the matter? Explain it to me!” I wondered, as I, along with Izanami's kins, followed Alex on the way.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 4:12―

BS56-013.name: The YomiBeast RaiunHyou
BS56-013.kanji: 黄泉ノ獣ライウンヒョウ
BS56-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, discard a random card from the opposing Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
By exhausting another "Yomi"/"Kamiumi"-named Spirit you control, draw a card. This effect can only be used once per turn.
BS56-013.flavor:
Thanks to the volunteered help from the Spirits under Izanami for the search, we finally managed to track down the traces of the "Guest" abductor.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5:02―

BS55-022.name: The YomiBeast RaiunShishi
BS55-022.kanji: 黄泉ノ獣ライウンシシ
BS55-022.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can summon a Cost 5 or less "Yomi"/"Kamiumi" Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost. This effect doesn't trigger [Core Charge].

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send three cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve, and when depletes, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BS55-022.flavor:
I finally got to meet Alex again, but something seemed off about her. Alex quickly took something from Izanami and left the place.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 4:11―

BS57-016.name: The YomiBeast Tenko
BS57-016.effect:
During your Attack Step, when your "Yomi"/"Kamiumi"-named Spirits are summoned from the Trash, you can summon this card from the Trash without paying the cost. This effect doesn't trigger [Core Charge]. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Send a core from the opposing Reserve to the Trash.
BS57-016.flavor: Izanagi and Izanami have given birth to numerous spirits. Among them, it is said that Onogoro was the first child. However, there is also this rumor going around that there was spirit who was born before him.

BS55-012.name: The YomiBeasts RaiunKomainu
BS55-012.kanji: 黄泉ノ獣 ライウンコマイヌ
BS55-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card. Also, for each opposing six-colored Cost 3 or less Nexus, send two cores from the opposing Reserve/Trash/Spirits to the Void.

[LV1][LV2] [Rebirth3]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can flip it.
BS55-012.flavor: The Grandwalker Duo, Izanagi and Izanami. They are the pair of Kamiumi Grandwalkers, who would bore many divine beings, and would, eventually, give birth to "Amahara", also Amaterasu, Tsukuyomi and Susanoo. Izanami, the female deity, is the empress who rules the Yomi World. Normally, she resides at her place underground, but it is said that she kept monitoring every single movement of Izanagi in the upper world.

BS56-021.name: The YomiEmperorSnake RaiunOrochi
BS56-021.kanji: 黄泉ノ皇蛇ライウンオロチ
BS56-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can return a "Yomi"/"Kamiumi"-named card from your Trash to the Hand. When you've done so, send two cores from the opposing Field/Reserve to the Trash.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can summon a "Yomi"/"Kamiumi"-named Spirit card from your Trash.
BS56-021.flavor:
"RaiunOrochi, would you please strangle Izanagi?"
"Um..milady Izanami? That smile looks pretty scary..."

[LV1][LV2] While your opponent doesn't have a set Burst, all your "Armed Machine" family Spirits gain +3000 BP. When you control any Ultimate, instead, all your "Armed Machine" family Spirits/Ultimates gain +5000 BP.

[LV1][LV2] (When Blocks) Put a core from the Void to an "Armed Machine" family Spirit you control other than this Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1303.flavor: Unbeknownst to the Grand Council, the Armed Machine Team's bigshots brought along Grey Garm, as if they were scheming something. You're involved in this too; would you trade me some information for my live photos?

BS26-024.name: Tank-Mobil-Leopard
BS26-024.kanji: タンク・モービル・レオパルト
BS26-024.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Red
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.

[When Braved] [LV2] (When Brave Attacks)
Return an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit to the Hand.
BS26-024.flavor: They manufactured Spirits to combat the Ultimates in the White Region, didn't they? Weren't they unable to ship them over here for defensive purposes? If they were dispatched here, we'd have been able to settle this in seconds. What a pity.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1305.name: Tank-Mobil-M6
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1305.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step) All your "Mobil"-named Spirits get +2000 BP.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) All your "Mobil"-named Brave Spirits' (When Brave Attacks) effect activates at (When Blocks) as well.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1305.flavor: I know that the continents falling are being guided by the hand of those star guys. But their methods and reasons, even where they came from, are all unknown. We're already in a desperate situation, you know?

BS28-035.name: Tank-Mobil-Maus
BS28-035.kanji: タンク・モービル・マウス
BS28-035.effect:
[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]
Return an opposing Spirit to the decktop. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card.

[LV2]
When this Spirit is destroyed by opposing Ultimate effects, it can remain on the Field, exhausted.
BS28-035.flavor: The enemy is trying to destroy the Space-Time Bonding Point even at the cost of sacrificing itself! We've got to travel to the past, no matter what!

BS27-026.name: Tank-Mobil-Sherman
BS27-026.kanji: タンク・モービル・シャーマン
BS27-026.effect:
[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Mobil"-named Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, you can return those Spirits to your Hand.
BS27-026.flavor: I'm getting deja vu -- this is the third time at that. It's the way this tank corps makes its appearance. No... the same scene has just repeated itself three times. Is the key to the riddle of the astral spirits here? There it is!

BS27-032.name: Tank-Mobil-Tiger
BS27-032.kanji: タンク・モービル・ティーガー
BS27-032.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
All your "Mobil"-named Spirits can brave with any Braves, ignoring the Brave Conditions.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
By discarding an opposing Burst, return an opposing Ultimate to the Hand.
BS27-032.flavor: Nothing strange happens to the tanks?? I'd laugh, but I can't afford to.

BS30-026.name: Tank-Mobil KV-2
BS30-026.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP.

[During Brave] [LV2] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Ultimate to the Hand.
BS30-026.flavor: A bombardment's on the way! Everyone, take cover behind me!! We need to buy time until Antarrc's forbidden technique completes!!

CB02-029.name: Tankmon
