[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2] [Warp Digivolve: White] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a White "Ultimate" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB02-029.flavor:
[Champion. Cyborg. Data]
A Cyborg Digimon which has the appearance of a tank. Tankmon holds the alias of "Mercenary Digimon", since it will assist both Vaccine and Virus Digimon if it becomes profitable to do so.

BS24-034.name: The 90th Tank-Mobil

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Blocks)
This Spirit gains +3000 BP. Also, if you control any Ultimate, return a Brave on an opposing Brave Spirit to the Hand.
BS24-034.flavor: Listen up, Euro-san. The data doesn't need to include whether the 90th is cooler than the 89th or not, it just needs the performance difference between their interim transformations from mobile to combat mode.

Let's make it flashy! A great gamble that is once in a lifetime!
―The PartnerBurai Vrick―

MechaGodzilla, with increased mobility after combining with Garuda.
―Godzilla vs MechaGodzilla (1993)―

BS75-034.kanji: 白銀の煌人ドロイデン

Beyond the chaos, at its deepest part...there resided Gradnwalker Khaos.
―Divine World Log 04―

The Phantom Star Dragon is being purified... Does it recognize us?
―Divine World Log 04―

The SupernovaDragon and the DoomKnightLord were battling within the Empty Sky. There, the PhantomStarDragon, which should never have appeared, blocked their path and engulfed both of them.
―Divine World Log 04―

When an opposing 10000 BP or more Spirit/Ultimate attacks, you can summon this card from the Hand/Removed Zone at Cost 6.

I hate it...But it's true that Lecoulis has to be destroyed if this is the case. And it is impossible to re-create Lecoulis. But there should be plans ahead right? The true ending that you want to obtain at the cost of tricking even the two of us.
―Grandwalker Tezcatlipoca―

BS10-070.name: The ArmoredHorse Alfothr

An indomitable knight. Brave and be infused with a will of iron!

The invaders and the divas have joined forces. This is probably one of the best symbols.
-from the 10th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

The Dark Pyroxene Army, which forced the retreat of the Makai Empire Army, appears to be slightly stronger than the Noble Order main army. Thanks to having a top-notch commander, however, they hadn't fallen yet; but they were stuck in a stalemate.
-from final section of "New Record of the Strange World" chapter Pyroxene Three-

BS40-037.name: The BraveShine Mechasmanian Devil
BS40-037.kanji: 勇輝メカスマニアデビル

No hint leading towards the legendary Saviour was found in the Green World. Alex searched for the Gate and stepped into the next world. Lying beyond was a silver world which seemed to be frozen in time.
-from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter White-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1359.name: The CannonHecatoncheiresGigantic Kottos

The strongest army, made of three machines only, the Hecatoncheires. Even Athena acknowledges their power.
"They're not quite like my Steel Knights, but they do make a pretty good job."

BS31-045.name: The CleverMachineGeneral Gyouten

Usukane Striker was the one who made the behind-the-scenes arrangements for arbitration in the fifth battle. Since both sides were waiting for progress with the arbitration, it would not have been a very violent fight.
―from the Soldier's Biography of "Sengoku Obscurities" by Kuroe―

―from the Oukehazama Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

Return two opposing Spirits to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing End Step)
If your Life wasn't reduced this turn, return every opposing Nexus to the decktop, in any order.
BSC30-X03.flavor: Not only one of the Four Great Generals, he is also the first clever machine, the model which originated the Genji Eight Knights.

BS34-031.name: The GenjiEightKnights Genta
BS34-031.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
For each "Genji"-named Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.
BS34-031.flavor: The GenjiEightKnights were a veteran group of fighters that existed since before the Great Sengoku Era. Tycoon governed the province by cooperating with the well-liked GenjiEightKnights.

BS34-039.name: The GenjiEightKnights Hachiryou
BS34-039.effect:
For each "Genji"-named Spirit you control, this Spirit card in your Hand gets -1 cost.

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block while exhausted.

[LV2]
While [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, the LV and BP and symbol of all "Genji"-named Spirit you control become the same as this Spirit.
BS34-039.flavor: "The GenjiEightKnights shall dispose of the Clever Machine ruffians."

BS31-041.name: The GenjiEightKnights Hikazu Defender
BS31-041.kanji: 源氏八騎 日数ディフェンダー
BS31-041.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Purple/Blue
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Blue Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2]
Give every "Genji"-named Spirit you control: Purple/Blue.
BS31-041.flavor:
Combat Era, year 552. Onmyou Territory sensed an impending invasion from the Gandala and Flame War Province united forces, and requested a dispatch of troops from Ninja Gale Village.
―from the Kaminakajima Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BS32-035.name: The GenjiEightKnights Hizamaru Buster
BS32-035.kanji: 源氏八騎 膝丸バスター
BS32-035.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts. After that Burst activates, during this battle, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing Magic effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Genji"-named Spirit attacks, return an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to that Spirit's to the Hand.
BS32-035.flavor: "Though you are my enemy, I must commend you for fighting in a way that does not disgrace your post as commander of such a large army."

BS33-038.name: The GenjiEightKnights Omodaka-the-Bushido
BS33-038.kanji: 源氏八騎 沢瀉・ザ・ブシドー
BS33-038.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Give every "Genji"-named Spirit you control: "(When Attacks) By returning an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand, this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Spirits."
BS33-038.flavor: "Three days! Keep them at bay, even if you must exhaust the shells and provisions!"

BS33-040.name: The GenjiEightKnights Tatenashi Fortress
BS33-040.kanji: 源氏八騎 楯無フォートレス
BS33-040.effect:
[Burst: s] (After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks)
Summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by all effects except those of "Genji"-named Spirits.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing End Step)
If your Life wasn't reduced during this turn, you can summon one "Genji"-named Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BS33-040.flavor: "Now that ten thousand troops and a fortified castle have been prepared, we shall not be disgraced by the flag of Heaven."

BS32-032.name: The GenjiEightKnights Tsukikazu Lancer
BS32-032.kanji: 源氏八騎 月数ランサー
BS32-032.effect:
[Kagemusha]
When your Spirit with Soul Core on it becomes the target of an opposing effect, you can summon this Spirit card from your hand. Then, change the target of that effect to this Spirit only.

[LV2]
When your "Genji"-named Spirits are destroyed, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.
BS32-032.flavor: "To think that Gyuumonji had a force of this size..."

BS31-044.name: The GenjiEightKnights Usukane Striker
BS31-044.kanji: 源氏八騎 薄金ストライカー
BS31-044.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard an opposing Burst. When this effect discards a Burst, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Spirit, give all your "Genji"-named Spirits: "(When Attacks) At the end of battle, once per turn, this Spirit can refresh."
BS31-044.flavor: "I, Usukane, bear the task of ending this battle."

BS31-048.name: The GiantArmCleverMachineMusha Rakan
BS31-048.kanji: 巨腕の機巧武者ラカン
BS31-048.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
For each "Clever Machine" family Spirit you control, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block even while exhausted.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
Every opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit must attack this Spirit if possible.
BS31-048.flavor: Clever Machine Province tended to appoint people to posts by measure of their talent, rather than their social standing.

BSC42-X04.name: The GiganticFortress Thor-Castle
BSC42-X04.kanji: 巨神要塞トール・キャッスル
BSC42-X04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each symbol on either player's Field, you can discard a card from the opposing decktop. When you've done so, you can put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can return a Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom. When you've done so, this Spirit can refresh.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
For each three Nexuses both players control in total, this Spirit gains an extra Blue symbol.

BS64-XV04.name: The Gigantic Thor XV
BS64-XV04.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Zero Contract/White Contract Spirit & C6 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
For each four counters you have, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus to the deckbottom. Then, once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.

[During Advent & During Brave] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When the opponent uses any Magic card/[Accel], before that effect activates, by destroying a Spirit you control with an equal or higher cost, immediately negate that effect.
BS64-XV04.flavor: His appearance has the same meaning as hope. Turning his comrades into weapons, he brings forth victory.

SD39-009.name: The GloryWarrior O-Superia
SD39-009.kanji: 栄光の機士オー・スペリア
SD39-009.effect:
When this Spirit card is discarded from your deck, you can summon it without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By returning an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand, during this turn, this Spirit can't be blocked.
SD39-009.flavor: The last trial is to defeat you? ...Okay, understood. I would defeat you and become Siegfried!

BS19-X04.name: The GoldenKnightLord Finn-Maclan
BS19-X04.kanji: 黄金騎神フィン・マックラン
BS19-X04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Heavy Armor: Red/Purple/White]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit's symbol becomes two White symbols.

[LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When opposing Spirits are returned to the Hand, refresh a Spirit you control.
BS19-X04.flavor: The golden knight parades. One kneels without knowing it in his dazzling presence.

BS31-X04.name: The GreatCleverMachineMusha Kongou
BS31-X04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Turn)
All your "Clever Machine" family Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Ultimate effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate without [Soul Core] on it to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
While there is [Soul Core] on this Spirit, any opposing Spirit/Ultimate that would return to the Hand is returned to the deckbottom instead.
BS31-X04.flavor: Though there are many Sengoku soldiers, there is no other Clever Machine who has finished a battle without a scratch.

BS23-036.name: The GreatImperialMachine ISS
BS23-036.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
For each "ImperialMachine"-named Spirit you control, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Charge]
Your "Spirit-refreshing effect" refreshes +1 bodies.

[LV2][LV3]
Besides [The GreatImperialMachine ISS], treat the LV1/LV2/LV3 BP of all your "ImperialMachine"-named Spirits the same as this Spirit's BP.
BS23-036.flavor: Though they have lost their master, the ImperialMachines still continue to function. Their control system ISS recognized the ShineDeity as their master and stood against the great collapse.

SD43-005.name: The GunDeity Phoenix-Stellar
SD43-005.kanji: 砲凰機神フェニック・セイザー
SD43-005.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Return two opposing Spirits to the Hand. Or, return two opposing Nexuses to the Hand. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed) You can summon a Brave card from your Hand by paying one cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks) Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.
SD43-005.flavor:
It is said Hindida solves all through singing and dancing, but much of it is shrouded in mystery.
―Holy Book Fragment―

BS40-040.name: The GunEmperorMachine Siegmund
BS40-040.effect:
When the card which is [During Advent] over this card would leave the Field, you can summon this pre-Advent card, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate that is not during-advent to the Hand. When you've done so, send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to any of your Spirits.
BS40-040.flavor: This atmosphere is getting heavier by the day? Isn't that simply a huge problem?!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1421.name: The GunKnight Heavybarrel
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1421.flavor: The invader fired his guns with great accuracy. The bullets penetrated the top of the distant tower.

BS63-045.name: The GunMachine Revol-Fighter
BS63-045.kanji: 銃機リボルファイター
BS63-045.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Steel Contract, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1, and put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, if you have five counters or less, your counter +1.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] Flash - [Fast Draw: 1] (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, by discarding a facedown card under your "The PartnerBurai Vrick", including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition, return an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the Hand.

BS19-073.name: The GunMachine Toradoll
BS19-073.effect:
[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
Return an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand.
BS19-073.flavor: Having several patterns of transformation, it can also brave as well. Its high level of adaptability seems to be the major reason that it is used as a part of the main-force.

BS32-028.name: The GunSoldier Tanegashima
BS32-028.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Cards can't be discarded from either player's deck. While [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, also, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus effects.
BS32-028.flavor:
The general they called "Master" was but a commander of a small contemporary province.
―from the Soldier's Biography of "Sengoku Obscurities" by Kuroe―

BSC48-014.name: The GunSoldier Tanegashima LT
BSC48-014.effect:
When this card would be discarded by an opposing "Deck-discarding effect", before sending it to the Trash, you can summon it.

This card in Hand/Trash is unaffected by opposing effects, and can be summoned when your deck would be discarded by an opposing "Deck-discarding effect", before that effect activates.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Cards can't be discarded from either player's deck. Also, while you control any "Contractor Dairokuten Maou", if it's the opposing Turn, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Brave/Nexus effects.
BSC48-014.flavor:
The general they called "Master" was but a commander of a small contemporary province.
―from the Soldier's Biography of "Sengoku Obscurities" by Kuroe―

BS23-030.name: The GunStrikeWarrior Maclir
BS23-030.effect:
[LV2] Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
By exhausting this Spirit, return an opposing attacking non-braved Spirit to the Hand.
BS23-030.flavor: The decisive battle between ShineDeity of Light and the TwinDragon of Darkness begins. The Light Sword Master led by the saviour confront the Six Darkness Sword Master. The Sacred Sword War caused by the great collapse now reaches its final turn.

BS73-X05.name: The HeadAttendant Forest-Orchid
BS73-X05.kanji: 筆頭近侍フォレスト・オーキッド
BS73-X05.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Dairokuten Maou" & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

This card in Trash is unaffected by either player's effect.

(Once per Turn: Same Name) By returning a "Heavenly Demon King" family card from your Trash to the Hand, [Mani] this card from the Hand, treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can return an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the deckbottom. If you control any LV2 "Dairokuten Maou", this effect can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Heavy Armor].
BS73-X05.flavor: "Master, I have brought you the prize. Please wield your power to your heart's content."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1428.name: The Heaven'sDeity Glorious-Solute
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1428.kanji: 天戒機神グロリアス・ソリュート
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1428.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return every opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand. For each Spirit returned to Hand by this effect, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit effects.

[LV2][LV3] [Holy Life] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1428.flavor: His commanding blade that purifies the world absorbs stars and generates life.

BS65-052.name: The HeavenGuideRide Vertige
BS65-052.kanji: 天導騎ヴェルテージュ
BS65-052.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control no Spirits & have 0 Spirit cards in your Trash]

[LV3][LV4]
Your Cost 5 or less Ultimates can block while exhausted.

[LV4]
Give all your "Holies"/"Incarnate" family Ultimates: "[Heavy Armor: Red/Purple/White] This Ultimate is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects."
BS65-052.flavor: "We are ready to confront the Evil God army. Come at us!"

BS66-058.name: The HeavenSteelMachine Servaas
BS66-058.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control no Spirits & have 0 Spirit cards in your Trash]

[LV3][LV4]
Give all your "Holies"/"Incarnate" family Ultimates: "[Heavy Armor: Red/Green/White] This Ultimate is unaffected by opposing Red/Green/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects."

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4] (Start of Your Attack Step)]
(Can't Stack) When Ultimate Trigger hits, after the step ends, an extra Refresh Step occurs, once and only once.
[utb]
BS66-058.flavor: "Our army's new weapon is apparently constructed by imitating of one of the Ultimate Dragons in the distant past."

BS53-040.name: The HeavyArmorMobile Shieldias
BS53-040.kanji: 重装機動シールディアス
BS53-040.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Blocks)
You can return an opposing Nexus to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Heavy Armor: Green/White/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Green/White/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
Once per turn, by putting a core from the Void to this Spirit, refresh it. Also, if you have three or more counters, return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.
BS53-040.flavor: You protected this world for us? Thank you so much.

GOL-MACK.name: The HeavyArmoredKnight Gol-Mack
GOL-MACK.kanji: 重装騎士ゴル・マック
GOL-MACK.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Charge - Increase the number of bodies to be refreshed by your “Spirit-refreshing effects” by +1.

[LV2] (When Attacks) You can reveal four cards from your decktop. For each "Armed Machine" family Spirit card among them, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. Discard the revealed cards.
GOL-MACK.flavor: That equipment and presence. Because he is so very different from myself, I cannot help but admire him.

BS12-032.name: The HeavyBootsEmperor Vidar
BS12-032.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Purple/Green/White/Yellow (Opposing Turn)
When the opponent uses a Purple/Green/White/Yellow Magic effect, by exhausting this Spirit, negate that effect.

[LV2][LV3]
When you use this Spirit's [Ice Wall] effect, by sending a core from this Spirit to your Trash, refresh this Spirit.
BS12-032.flavor: The remaining Invaders took the lead. They gave everything up and left through the gate.

BS44-048.name: The HecatoncheiresGigantic Briareos
BS44-048.kanji: 百腕巨神機ブリアレオース
BS44-048.effect:
When your Life would be reduced by two or more at once by the opponent, if there are only White cards in your Trash, you can summon this Spirit card from the Hand by paying one cost. When you've done so, your Life won't be reduced.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
When summoned by paying cost, return opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the deckbottom until the opponent controls as many Spirits/Ultimates as you do.
BS44-048.flavor: The most powerful army that consists of only three machines, the "Hecatoncheires". This is one of them.

SD60-002.name: The HellSacredWarrior Gungnir
SD60-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card. Then, if you have two or more cards set, send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Your attacking "Arthur"/"Woden"-named Spirit gains +5000 BP. This effect doesn't stack.

[LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as White.
SD60-002.flavor: "Arthur, you say? Interesting. Let's try and see can you actually master me."

SD60-007.name: The HellSacredWarrior Gungnir -Evil Spear Mode-
SD60-007.kanji: 冥機士グングニル -魔槍モード-
SD60-007.effect:
[LV1]
The color and symbol of this Brave in Spirit condition are also treated as White.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with two cores or less on it.
[Rush: White]
(While you have a White symbol, the following effect activates next)
[White Core]: Put a core from the Void to any Purple/White "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" family Spirit you control.
SD60-007.flavor: The new weapon of Arthur who now wields both the power of Purple and White.

BS58-009.name: The HellSacredWarrior Tyrfing
BS58-009.kanji: 冥機士ティルヴィング
BS58-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
Draw a card.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By discarding a card from the opposing Removed Zone, this Spirit refreshes.
[Rush: White]
(While you have a White symbol, the following effect activates next)
[White Core]: During this battle, this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Cost 4 or less Spirits/Ultimates.
BS58-009.flavor: It seems that there is an increase of cases where rusted robots were possessed by shadows and being turned into Evil Shadow spirits.

BS08-031.name: The HellSacred Gungnir
BS08-031.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
When summoning a Spirit card with [Tribute], this Spirit's cost gets +3.
BS08-031.flavor: What was once silver has now fallen to darkness... And out of a golden halo, a winged god is born.

BS29-025.name: The HeroSwordMaster Sigurd
BS29-025.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing non-braved Ultimate to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can brave with any of your "Exalted Sword" family Brave, ignoring its Brave Condition.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by braving an "Exalted Sword" family Brave you control to this non-braved Spirit, refresh this Spirit.
BS29-025.flavor:
It appears that the Saviour Lolo has already traveled through the Six Realms.
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, Past Records: Day 3—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1441.name: The HieroglyphBirdArmor Ibis Bird
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1441.kanji: 聖刻鳥鎧イビスバード
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1441.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned/Advents) resolves]
Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom, and put two cores from the Void to any of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Thoth." After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[During Brave]
Treat this Brave as Cost 0.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1441.flavor: A brave which is the Hieroglyph Regiment's formal gear.

BS47-081.name: The HieroglyphCavalry Ace-Arquive
BS47-081.kanji: 聖刻騎兵エース・アークイブ
BS47-081.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Armed Machine Spirit/Ultimate]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
Discard an opposing Burst. Then, if the opponent has any Burst set, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

[LV4][LV5] (Your Attack Step)
Your "Armed Machine" family Ultimates can't be blocked.

[LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
Once per Attack Step, refresh an "Armed Machine" family Ultimate you control.
BS47-081.flavor:
And thus concludes the war between Olym and Egyt.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 4:43―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1443.name: The HieroglyphCavalry Ace-Hejeul
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1443.kanji: 聖刻騎兵エース・ヘジェウル
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1443.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Armed Machine Spirit/Ultimate]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned)
You can send all cores from every opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void. This effect can only be used once per game.

[LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to any of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Thoth". Also, while braved to a Saga Brave, this Ultimate can't be blocked.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1443.flavor: "Power without knowledge is non-existant. You shall taste the full brunt of this power I received from Lord Thoth. From now on, if you don't also use your head in war, you'll never win."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1444.name: The HieroglyphCavalry Cavalry-Ahnejeu
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1444.kanji: 聖刻騎兵キャバルリー・アーネジェウ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1444.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at two or more]

[LV3][LV4][LV5]
"Armed Machine" family Ultimates you control are unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (End of Either Attack Step)
Refresh all your "Armed Machine" family Ultimates.

[LV4][LV5] (Opposing Attack Step)
Each opposing Spirit/Nexus can only reduce your Life by one each turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1444.flavor: The Hieroglyph Cavalry is the most powerful segment of the Hieroglyph Regiment.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1445.name: The HieroglyphCavalry Commander-Deshret
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1445.kanji: 聖刻騎兵コマンダー・デシュエルト
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1445.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Egyt Grandwalker Nexus]

[LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by returning an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom, this Ultimate refreshes.

[LV4]
While you control four or more differently-named "Egyt" family Grandwalker Nexuses, this Ultimate gains four extra Ultimate Symbols.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1445.flavor: "Let's have the Jehuties work for the sake of Supreme God Horus from now on."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1446.name: The HieroglyphCavalry Proto-Iahf
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1446.kanji: 聖刻騎兵プロト・イアーフ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1446.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Armed Machine Spirit/Ultimate]

[Double Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks/Blocks)]
For each Ultimate Trigger hit, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. [Double Hit] Also, when the Ultimate Trigger hits twice, return an opposing Ultimate to the deckbottom.
[wutb]

[LV4][LV5] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per step, by exhausting this Ultimate, activate one of its [Double Ultimate Trigger].
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1446.flavor: A testbed machine equipped with the Trigger technology brought by Antarc.

BS57-057.name: The HieroglyphCavalry Space-Mufkat
BS57-057.kanji: 聖刻騎兵スペース・メフェケア
BS57-057.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at two or more]

[Mirage: Cost 2 ([White Core])]
[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
When opposing Spirits are returned to the Hand/deck, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned)
Send four cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void.

[LV4] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Return an opposing Spirit with one core on it to the Hand.
BS57-057.flavor: "A Grandwalker who controls time...I wonder is there anyone else who does so other than me...If there is, I would like to meet him or her one day."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1450.name: The HieroglyphHunter Jet-Beik
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1450.kanji: 聖刻猟兵ジェット・ベイク
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1450.effect:
Flash - [Advent: White and Cost 3 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
By returning an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand, put a core from the Void to this Spirit. This effect can only be prevented by "remains on Field" effects.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per Step, refresh a White "Worldswalker"/"Avatar" family Spirit/Ultimate you control.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1450.flavor: "Horus, the wind is changing directions, let's proceed cautiously."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1451.name: The HieroglyphHunter Raider-Iahf
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1451.kanji: 聖刻猟兵レイダー・イアーフ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1451.effect:
[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can reveal a card from your decktop. If it's an "Armed Machine" family Spirit/Ultimate card, you can pay one cost to summon it. Discard any remaining cards.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1451.flavor:
Artemis, together with Apollon, visited Athena. Both were against Zeus-Lolo's principles. The way it's called may have changed, but what he was doing was the same as what caused the war with Ra. Their wish is to split Zeus and Lolo apart and return them to their original forms. And if they'll do that, now is the time for them to rise up... Athena, learning of their determination, sneaks behind Hermes' sight and consults Thoth concerning rallying Egyt once more.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 3:03―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1452.name: The HieroglyphMachineDeity Jehutic-Thoth
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1452.kanji: 聖刻神機ジェフティック＝トト
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1452.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Armed Machine Spirit/Ultimate]

[Unleash: 2] [LV3][LV4][LV5] Flash - (Your Turn)
By sending two core from any of your White Grandwalker Nexuses to this Ultimate, during the next opposing Core Step, Draw Step and Refresh Step, the same Step occurs for you. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
You can return an opposing Spirit with three or less cores on it to the deckbottom. When you've done so, this Ultimate refreshes.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1452.flavor: "Shall we measure the weight of your soul? Using my Avatar, Jehutic-Thoth, of course."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1453.name: The HieroglyphPrincess Quin-Seshat
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1453.kanji: 聖刻妃クイン・セシャト
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1453.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at two or more]

[LV3][LV4]
When this Ultimate is destroyed by opposing effects, it remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV4]
When the opponent would activate an effect that makes an extra turn occur, change the "Your Turn" written in that effect to "Opposing Turn".
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1453.flavor: As the Head Librarian of the Hieroglyph Temple, she is a special machine that gives Thoth support.

BS47-044.name: The HieroglyphSoldier Airman-Jeiath
BS47-044.kanji: 聖刻兵エアマン・ジェイアス
BS47-044.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Heavy Armor: Red/Purple/White]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.

[LV2] (Your Core Step)
If every Spirit/Ultimate you control has "Armed Machine" family, put two cores from the Void to this Spirit. This effect doesn't stack.
BS47-044.flavor:
The Grandwalker Thoth shares the same ideals as Horus.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 4:19―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1455.name: The HieroglyphSoldier Commander-Nejem
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1455.kanji: 聖刻兵コマンダー・ネジェム
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1455.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 10000 BP to the deckbottom. For each Spirit returned by this effect, put one core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
For each exactly-named "The HieroglyphSoldier Trooper-Arje" you control, this Spirit gains an extra White symbol.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1455.flavor:
Why was there no spacetime quake even though Horus and Thoth's connected their worlds?
―"Genesis Records" Volume 4:21―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1456.name: The HieroglyphSoldier Defender-Gelef
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1456.kanji: 聖刻騎兵ディフェンダー・ゲレフ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1456.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life at two or more]

When you have used a White Magic card from your Hand/activated a White Magic card Burst, after that effect resolves, you can pay one cost to summon this card from your Hand. When you've done so, refresh three "Armed Machine" family Ultimates you control.

[LV4] (Your Attack Step)
While there are three or more White-only Magic cards in your Trash, every White Ultimate you control gains an extra White symbol. This effect doesn't stack.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1456.flavor: The Hieroglyph Regiment's fearsome technology allows even the teleportation of machines.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1457.name: The HieroglyphSoldier Early-Jehuty
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1457.kanji: 聖刻兵アーリー・ジェフティ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1457.effect:
[Unleash: 1, Minor] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
Once per turn, when your "Armed Machine" family Spirit is summoned, by sending a core from any of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Thoth" to the Trash, immediately activate that Grandwalker Nexus' [LV1][LV2] [Grand Field], changing the "Ultimate" text written in the effect into "Spirit" and treating core as being sent to the Void.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Nexus/Purple Spirit effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1457.flavor: Supposedly an early version made before Jehutic-Thoth's rollout.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1458.name: The HieroglyphSoldier Fortress-Neseni
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1458.kanji: 聖刻兵フォートレス・ネセニ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1458.effect:
While there is any "Armed Machine" family card in your Trash, this set card is unaffected by opposing effects.

[Burst: After an Opposing Spirit/Ultimate Attacks]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, until your next End Step, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Either End Step)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. You can pay one cost to summon a "Hieroglyph"-named Ultimate card among them. Return any remaining cards to the decktop in any order.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1458.flavor:
And that turned into the blow that announced the end of the war.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 4:38―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1459.name: The HieroglyphSoldier Gunner-Iuaht
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1459.kanji: 聖刻兵ガンナー・イウアート
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1459.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning a "Hieroglyph"-named card, add an extra White symbol to this Spirit and every exactly-named "Grandwalker Thoth" you control.

[LV2]
While [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, every exactly-named "The HieroglyphSoldier Gunner-Iuaht" you control is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1459.flavor:
Zeus-Lolo declares their victory, and the Uru Grandwalkers run towards him. "Congratulations, Lolo. We... won, right?"
―"Genesis Records" Volume 4:42―

BS48-043.name: The HieroglyphSoldier Paratrooper-Mehat
BS48-043.kanji: 聖刻兵パラトルーパー・メエヘイト
BS48-043.effect:
When your White-only Saga Brave is summoned, you can pay one cost to summon this card from your Hand.

[LV1][LV2] [Heavy Armor: Green/White/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Green/White/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects. Also, while braved to a Saga Brave, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing Ultimate effects.

[LV2] (When Blocks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP.
BS48-043.flavor:
There are Olymian Grandwalkers which symphatize with Egyt. They also ought to be made into allies.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 1:42

BS47-043.name: The HieroglyphSoldier Sargeant-Meshua
BS47-043.kanji: 聖刻兵サージェント・メシュア
BS47-043.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit with three cores or less on it to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Draw Step)
Put a core from the Void to any of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Thoth" that has four or less cores on it.

[LV2] [Heavy Armor: Red/Purple]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
BS47-043.flavor:
Thoth, together with Horus, prepared to ambush Egyt when they let their guard down. This is Athena's first scheme.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 4-20―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1462.name: The HieroglyphSoldier Shielder-Jenes
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1462.kanji: 聖刻兵シールダー・ジェネス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1462.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When your "Hieroglyph"-named Spirits/Ultimates are depleted/destroyed by opposing effects, you can put any amount of cores from your Reserve to those Spirits/Ultimates. The Spirits/Ultimates which this effect puts cores on remain on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Draw Step)
After the Step ends, if all your Spirits/Ultimates are "Hieroglyph"-named, your Draw Step occurs once and only once more.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1462.flavor:
Enraged by Horus and Thoth's betrayal, Ra moves.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 4:30―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1463.name: The HieroglyphSoldier Sleeper-Uahb
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1463.kanji: 聖刻兵スリーパー・ウアーブ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1463.effect:
When the opponent activates an effect which makes an extra turn occur, by paying one cost to summon this card from the Hand, the extra turn doesn't occur.

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn)
Your Life can only be reduced by one per turn via opposing effects.

[LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By exhausting this Spirit, until your next Main Step, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1463.flavor:
Other than about Alex's treatment, Horus also told the other Uru Grandwalkers about the situation they're in. It was during that process it came to his knowledge that Hindida's Supreme Deity, Brahma, had contacted Alex.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 1:26―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1464.name: The HieroglyphSoldier Sniper-Beik
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1464.kanji: 聖刻兵スナイパー・ベイク
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1464.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Discard an opposing Burst. Also, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest cost to the deckbottom.

[LV2] While you control any Saga Brave, this Spirit gains: "Heavy Armor: Red/Purple/Yellow - This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/Yellow Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Maigc effects."
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1464.flavor:
The Egytian Grandwalkers obeyed Horus' decision, Thoth included.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 2:15―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1465.name: The HieroglyphSoldier Trooper-Arje
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1465.kanji: 聖刻兵トルーパー・アージュ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1465.effect:
When your Life would be reduced by an opposing effect, by discarding this card from your Hand, your Life won't be reduced. After this effect resolves, you can pay one cost to summon this discarded card. This effect doesn't trigger [Core Charge].

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Blocks)
Put one core from the Void to your Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1465.flavor: The Hieroglyph Army ― It refers to a Spec Ops Squad formed by the Grandwalker Thoth. Those who have Hieroglyphs carved onto their bodies execute many operations under Thoth's command. They also took part on the decisive battle with Olym, but their muzzles were aimed at Ra.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1466.name: The HieroglyphWarMachine Rebellion-Nehejet
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1466.kanji: 聖刻戦機リベリオン・ネヘジェト
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1466.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Armed Machine Spirit/Ultimate]

While you control any White-only Grandwalker Nexus, this set card is unaffected by opposing effects.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Return two opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the deck, one to the top and one to the bottom. After this effect resolves, summon this card, ignoring the summon condition and without paying the cost.

[LV4][LV5] (When Blocks)
At the end of battle, refresh this Ultimate. Also, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1466.flavor: Thoth's most recent creation is a machine that will become the shield to protect Egyt from the Grandwalkers.

SJ14-16.name: The HolyKnight Sacred-Blader
SJ14-16.kanji: 聖騎士セイクリッド・ブレイダー
SJ14-16.effect:
When your [Sacred-Blaster] is destroyed by the opponent, you can summon this Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can brave with [The HolySword Sacred-Sword] and [The HolyShield Sacred-Shield], one of each.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
When only the opposing Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by comparing BP, send a core from the opposing Life to their Reserve.
SJ14-16.flavor:
With darkness covering the world, a holy knight appeared.
-Story of the Holy Knight, Second Chapter-

BS21-032.name: The HoundMachine Asterio-Venera 9
BS21-032.kanji: 猟犬機アステリオ・ベネラ9号
BS21-032.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit attacks, refresh an "Astral Soul" family Spirit you control.
BS21-032.flavor: Since the power of the stars manifested, the commonplace ImperialMachines gained supreme hunting abilities similar to a hound's.

P21-G03.name: The IceRideDeity Vibryndi
P21-G03.kanji: 氷騎神ヴィブリンディ
P21-G03.effect:
Only one copy of this card can be put into the deck.

Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
You can summon this card from the Hand. When you've done so, when this battle ends, end the Attack Step. This effect can only be used once per game.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By exhausting this Spirit, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's to the deckbottom.
P21-G03.flavor: The shield of aurora takes in every fight, and the lance of gold pierces through every life. I am the IceRideDeity of Shield. Even if my body is now a machine, it is my fate to fight on.

BS20-030.name: The IceShieldGuardian Ohshin
BS20-030.kanji: 氷楯の守護者オーシン
BS20-030.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Cost 3 or less Spirits are destroyed by opposing effects, they can remain on the Field, exhausted.

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Main Step)
When the opposing Hand increases, for each card increased, the opponent discards a card from their Hand.
BS20-030.flavor: The inheritor of the bow passed down for generations in the country encased in ice. He made the winds change direction when a sudden gust was blowing everything in its path away and protected the city from harm.

BS19-038.name: The ImperialMachine Curiosity
BS19-038.kanji: 近衛機キュリオシティ
BS19-038.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Cards can't be discarded from either deck.

[LV1][LV2] [Charge]
Your “Spirit-refreshing effects” refresh +1 bodies.
BS19-038.flavor: Currently, due to the malfunctioning of the machines in the Country of Silver, we cannot reach the place where the Sword is kept.

BS21-033.name: The ImperialMachine Geneshield
BS21-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Charge]
Your “Spirit-refreshing effects” refresh +1 bodies.

[LV2][LV3] (When Blocks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.
BS21-033.flavor:
The reparations have progressed to the point where all the machines in the country are once again functional. We can at last continue out hunt.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, Third Day of the Fourth Month-

BS22-061.name: The ImperialMachine Hullnote No.1
BS22-061.effect:
[When Braved]
Your Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.
BS22-061.flavor: If you're exploring a land with a lot of obstacles or going underground, I recommend this! Its prided drill can break up anything and dig through the ground.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1475.name: The ImperialMachine Mariner No.2
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1475.flavor:
While the city was in ruin due to the abnormalities, the sword was tightly safeguarded. The sword of the Country of Silver was completed without incident.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, Fifth Day of the Fourth Month-

BS20-061.name: The ImperialMachine Messenger
BS20-061.kanji: 近衛機メッセンジャー
BS20-061.effect: [When Braved] (When Brave Attacks) Once per turn, refresh a Spirit you control with a cost lower than this Spirit's.
BS20-061.flavor: According to Lapis, "It's optimized to explore unknown places. It's a supply unit and is capable of the most minute operations." ...She's right!

OATH-ME.name: The ImperialMachine Ohsu-Mi
OATH-ME.flavor:
Even if its body burns to a shell, it does not lose its resolve to complete its mission.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, Second Day of the Fourth Month-

BS23-029.name: The ImperialMachine Ranger No. 6
BS23-029.kanji: 近衛機レインジャー6号
BS23-029.flavor:
The city of machines continues to show motivated action. Their next destination is apparently the world on the other side of the sky.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, Future Days-

BS19-036.name: The ImperialMachine Viking-No.1
BS19-036.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Heavy Armor: White/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing White/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit attacks, refresh a Spirit you control.
BS19-036.flavor:
The Country of Silver is full of machines.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, First Day of the Fourth Month-

BS09-X38.name: The ImpregnableKnightLord Odin Type-X
BS09-X38.kanji: 要塞騎神オーディーンType-X
BS09-X38.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
If the opponent has six or more cards in Hand, return three opposing Spirits without [Tribute] to the decktop in any order.

[LV3] [Armor: Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.
BS09-X38.flavor: The Invader who vanished from the threshold returns, enveloped in a divine radiance.

SD01-026.name: The IronKnight Yggdrasill
SD01-026.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return every 3000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3]
Give every White Spirit you control: "[Armor: Red/White] - This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/White Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects."
SD01-026.flavor: His right arm repels any counterattack. The time has come, and the tower falls silent.

BS06-046.name: The KeyMaul Valgrind
BS06-046.kanji: 鍵鎚のヴァルグリンド
BS06-046.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The cost of all "Vanity Deity" family Spirit cards in your Hand becomes 6.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2] (When Blocks)
When this Spirit blocks an opposing 4000 BP or more Spirit, it refreshes.
BS06-046.flavor: Awakened by a deity of the Empty Sky, another enemy of the world has unveiled himself.

BSC45-053.name: The KeyMaul Valgrind LT
BSC45-053.kanji: 鍵鎚のヴァルグリンドLT
BSC45-053.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2]
The cost of all your "Vanity Deity" family cards becomes 6.

[LV2] (Start of Opposing Attack Step)
You can target an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. During this turn, that target must attack if possible.
BSC45-053.flavor: Awakened by a deity of the Empty Sky, another enemy of the world has unveiled himself.

BS58-070-A1488.name: The Knight and Machine's Grandstone
BS58-070-A1488.effect:
[GSTrule]

[Release:: (Summon/Rebirth of your Cost 3 or more "Evil Shadow"/"Armed Machine" family Spirit)]
◆When the Release condition is fulfilled, you can put one core from the Void to this Nexus.

[LV1] [Rebirth3]
When the number of cores on this Nexus becomes three or more, this Nexus can be flipped (all cores on it are sent to the Void). When it is, this now-Reborn Brave either brave to your Spirit, or stay in Spirit condition.

[Grand Mystery] [LV1]
All "The Chariot"-named or "Evil Shadow"/"Armed Machine" family Spirits you control gain "[Heavy Armor: White/Blue] This Spirit is unaffected by opposing White/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects."

BS09-033.name: The LanceKnight Gautr
BS09-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by an opposing Spirit, refresh three of your Yellow Spirits.
BS09-033.flavor: Once an Invader, now he's part of the Singing Diva's advanced guard. He inspires his comrades-in-arms as he awaits the Braver's arrival.

BS42-037.name: The LanceWarrior Hundingle
BS42-037.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Heavy Armor: Purple]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[Lv1][LV2]
While [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, this Spirit gains [Heavy Armor: Blue].
BS42-037.flavor:
The Dinosaur Alliance didn't abide either. They made a mess in the Blue world, called for the Vanity Army, and made an alliance with them. And so, the fact that the Dinosaur Alliance and the Vainty Army allied were revealed.
-from the 3rd section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Red-

P13-12.name: The LightMachine Mjolnir
P13-12.effect:
[When Braved] (When This Spirit Brave Attacks)
When blocked by an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit, refresh a Brave Spirit you control.
P13-12.flavor: Regardless of the size of its target, the transforming hammer swings down impartially and relentlessly.

SD61-003.name: The LightShieldSacred Helmberi
SD61-003.kanji: 光盾神機ヒャールムベリ
SD61-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, if summoned from the deck, you can put a core from the Void to your Trash.

[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit would leave the Field by opposing effects, by sending a core from this Spirit to the Trash, it remains on the Field, exhausted.
SD61-003.flavor:
Chronos' thereat has reached even this world. Together with the Noble Order, Yggdrasil has sworn to fight against Chronos.
-"Ripped Record of the Strange World" 02-

BS13-032.name: The LightSpeedKnight Hermod
BS13-032.kanji: 光速の騎士ヘルモード
BS13-032.effect:
[Tribute: Armed Machine → Void]
After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all core from one of your "Armed Machine" family Spirits to the Void.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return all opposing Nexuses to the Hand.

[When Braved] [LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing 6000 BP or more Spirits.
BS13-032.flavor:
Over there! In the sky above the Observatory, we've found the Water Carrier Deity trapped on the side of the Sextant!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

X13-04.name: The LionMachineArmorDeity Walhalance-Leo
X13-04.kanji: 獅機鎧神ヴァルハランス・レオ
X13-04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Heavy Armor: Purple/Green/White/Yellow]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Green/White/Yellow Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit attacks, refresh a Spirit you control.

[LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
By exhausting a White Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +(BP of the exhausted Spirit) BP.
X13-04.flavor: The mechanical knight we met in the Country of Silver told us the location of the stolen sacred sword.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1495.name: The MachineGunDeity HeimCannon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1495.kanji: 砲神機ヘイムキャノン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1495.effect: [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step) When your Ultimate-Trigger is guarded, you can refresh 1 of your Ultimates in battle. During this turn, that Ultimate cannot attack.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1495.flavor: I just thought of something frightening... If the Ultimates are wiped out... what will happen to this continent? Won't it fall towards our continent?

BS43-039.name: The MachineTaskForce Black Grizzly
BS43-039.kanji: 機械戦隊ツキノワグリズリー
BS43-039.effect:
Flash - [Advent: White] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] [Tw Catl: White] (When Advents)
Immediately activate one of your White Soul Bursts. After that Burst activates, you can set a card with Burst effects from your Hand.

[During Advent] [LV2] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit without [Advent] to the Hand.
BS43-039.flavor: The emergence of the Machine Task Force has caught us in surprise. However, considering that there are six Dark Pyroxene Generals in total, we should already be thankful that not all of them have come.

BS43-045.name: The MachineTaskForce Mammogeyser
BS43-045.kanji: 機械戦隊マンモガイザー
BS43-045.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon a "Machine Beast" family Spirit card without paying the cost. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

Egyt originated as a small force on a world of deserts, but with the power of machinery they quickly grew in power, eventually becoming a force comparable to Olym.
─Holy Book Fragment─

This robot was developed by the Mysterians for public service, but was used to conquer Earth. Its armor is made of Mysteroid Steel, 200 times stronger than regular steel. ―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 4:23―

[Flash]

This Spirit card in Trash is treated as [The ApeMan Mongoku].

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2575.name: The Hanged Gogyo Mountain

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2575.flavor:
One of the 7 baffling Amethyst places; I have no idea of who made this, or what they had in mind. As the gravity here is reversed, the mountains can hang down.
-from the Places of Interest 240/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2576.name: The LionDragon Tribhanga
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2576.effect:

Brahma, who promptly entered Uru's sphere of influence, aimed to meet with Alex as soon as possible, and tell her of the oncoming dangers. However, as he overprioritized dealing with the matter at hand, he forgot how young Grandwalkers have a Spirit-like impulsive consideration for others. Brahma only became aware of how impatient he had been, and regretted his actions, after Alex suffered injuries so heavy she stood at death's door.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 1:20―

You do look quite stylish. But my feathers won't lose to you~
―The PartnerBird Feaniel―

A few months had passed since the battle against the Primordial Deities, and there was a series of mysterious disappearances occurring in Olym.
―Divine World Log 01―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2584.name: Acro Squirrel
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2584.effect:

We found the one that stole the sword... but they ran...
-The Murmurs of Rutile, Fifth Day of the Tenth Month-

CB25-033.name: Akatsuki［Oowashi Equipped］
CB25-033.kanji: アカツキ[オオワシ装備]
CB25-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Yata-no-Kagami]
When this Spirit would become the target of an opposing Spirit/Nexus effect, this Spirit is unaffected by that effect. After that effect resolves, you can return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard an opposing Burst. Then, if the opponent has a Burst set, return an opposing Nexus to the deckbottom.

[LV3] Flash - (When Blocks)
Once per turn, you can immediately end the battle.
CB25-033.flavor: A mobile suit that embodies Orb's ideology. It has a beam-reflecting armor, Yata-no-Kagami.

BS52-011.name: Armor Bat
BS52-011.effect:
Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
If the opponent controls any "can't be blocked" Spirit, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Trash.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit can block opposing "can't be blocked" Spirits.
BS52-011.flavor:
The snake people are said to be the wisest species in the Purple World. However, they seclude themselves deep into the ground, so it's hard to meet them.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 1:16―

CB29-015.name: Akatsuki［Shiranui Equipped］
CB29-015.kanji: アカツキ[シラヌイ装備]
CB29-015.effect:
When your White "Orb"/"Mothership" family Nexuses would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand. When you've done so, all those Nexuses remain on the Field, exhausted, and return an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Yata-no-Kagami]
When this Spirit would become the target of an opposing Spirit/Nexus effect, this Spirit is unaffected by that effect. After that effect resolves, you can return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, at the end of battle, this Spirit can refresh.
CB29-015.flavor: Akatsuki equipped with the "Shiranui" Space Pack which makes use of the DRAGOON System.

CB16-054.name: Akihiro Altland
CB16-054.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[During Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with two cores or less on it, and this Spirit gains +3000 BP. Also, if you control another Purple-only "Pilot" family Brave, send three cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void.

BS19-072.name: Akkeshigumo
BS19-072.effect: [LV1] (When Summoned) Put a core from the Void each to every Spirit with Rush you control.
BS19-072.flavor: This spider looks very scary at first look. However, it can be relied on to silently handle any invaders.

CB13-042.name: Al-Saachez's AEU Enact Custom［Moralia Development Experiment Type］
CB13-042.kanji: サーシェス専用AEUイナクトカスタム［モラリア開発実験型］
CB13-042.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit can brave with an exactly-named "Ali al-Saachez", ignoring the Brave Condition.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning an exactly-named "Ali al-Saachez" from the Hand, treat all its reduction as fulfilled.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.
CB13-042.flavor: A modified form of Enact developed by the Republic of Moralia's PMC Trust. It suppressed the Gundams despite having a much lower spec in the battle with excellent fighting techniques.

P13-21.name: Albino-Cyclo-Winder
P13-21.kanji: アルビノ・サイクロワインダー
P13-21.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
For each Purple Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When the number of cores on opposing Spirits becomes 0 due to your Spirit effects, draw a card.
P13-21.flavor: It is said that the white snake brings joy with it, but I find it hard to believe. In the midst of these events, I can't think that there are factors of happiness.

CB30-068.name: Alchemist Academy
CB30-068.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a "Chemy", or a "Kamen" & "Creator" family card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, when your "Kamen" & "Creator" family Spirit attacks, you can return a "Chemy" from your Trash to the Hand.
CB30-068.flavor: An alchemy academy located inside Furasu High School.

BS53-CP06.name: Alezan - King of the Deep
BS53-CP06.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
By sending up to three cores, except [Soul Core], from your Field/Reserve to the Void, for each core sent, summon one Spirit card from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirits can't activate.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Send an opposing Spirit to the Removed Zone.

26RBS03-033.name: Algodon
26RBS03-033.effect:
[LV1-2] When Blocks Once Per Turn
This Spirit can refresh.

[LV2]True Release During Block Once Per Turn
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
26RBS03-033.flavor: With one of the suns gone, the plants and trees were gradually growing in the softened sunlight. And those who could transform that light into strength were also growing.

AL-SAACHEZ.name: Ali al-Saachez
AL-SAACHEZ.kanji: アリー・アル・サーシェス
AL-SAACHEZ.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy either an opposing Brave, or an opposing non-"Primal" family Grandwalker Nexus.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, this Spirit can refresh. When this Spirit reduces the opposing Life, you can activate this Brave's (When Summoned) effect.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2830.name: Aliegon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2830.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Death Dragon" family Spirit attacks, you can discard a Green/White/Blue card from the opposing Removed Zone.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2830.flavor:
The reason behind his anger was that he was left behind. Had he been taken along, he would have at least landed a hit on the enemy general, he says. However, that was the very reason he was left behind.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 1:36

BS44-023.name: Alien Viper
BS44-023.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step) When you are summoning a "Dark Snake" family Spirit card, this Spirit's symbols become three Purple symbols.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks) Send every core from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with two symbols or more to the Reserve.
BS44-023.flavor:
A continent larger than any continent in Grand Lolo. And from there, it swarmed an army of Dark Snakes.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 1:04―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2832.name: AllRounder ShiningHeavenCleverMachine Soldier
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2832.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Give all your "War Dragon"/"Clever Machine" family Spirits: "[Heavy Armor: Red] - This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects."

[LV2] (Opposing End Step)
If your Life wasn't reduced this turn, put one core from the Void to this Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2832.flavor:
Zeus-Lolo draws ever closer. The last lightning he releases has Alex use her own body as a shield to guard me, who jumps down from Unite. Finally, I've arrived before the enemy.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 4:20―

P14-46.name: All Star Draw
P14-46.effect:
[Main]
Draw two cards.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Red Spirit/Ultimate +5000 BP.

SD53-008.name: Allelujah Haptism
SD53-008.kanji: アレルヤ・ハプティズム
SD53-008.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can draw two cards. When you've done so, discard a card from your Hand. Then, you can pay one cost to summon a Cost 3 Blue "CB" family Spirit card from your Hand.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing originally Cost 5 or less Spirits.

CB29-057.name: Allelujah Haptism & Soma Peries
CB29-057.kanji: アレルヤ・ハプティズム＆ソーマ・ピーリス
CB29-057.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[During Brave]
Once per turn, when opposing Spirits are destroyed by this Spirit, you can refresh this Spirit.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by returning two Cost 5 or more "CB"/"Federation" family cards from your Trash to the deckbottom, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2837.name: Armored Shiki
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2837.effect:
Immortality: 0/1/2 - (Either Attack Step) You can summon this card from your Trash when your Cost 0/1/2 Spirit is destroyed.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks) Send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve.
[Rush: Yellow]
(While you have a Yellow symbol, the following effect activates next.)
[Yellow Core]: During this battle, an opposing Spirit can't block.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2837.flavor:
Tsukuyomi's actions were lightning fast, they outclassed Alex and every Hindida Grandwalker by far.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 3:16―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2838.name: Armored Soul
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2838.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed) If [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2838.flavor:
Tsukuyomi, together with Susanoo, received Hermes' secret letter, and weighed one offer against the other. First, their meeting with Hindida and Alex. He doesn't know what they misunderstood, but for some reason, they treat the most ancient force, Amahara, as their equals. And even worse, the leadership was handed to a little girl with no history, and they ornate the reason for that with meaningless pretense. Meanwhile, Zeus has a grip on reality. He promises to hail us as kings of the same rank as him. It was obvious which one they would ally themselves with.
ー"Genesis Records" New Volume 3:41ー

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2839.name: Arms Impact
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2839.effect: Flash - When your Spirit is blocking an opposing Spirit, destroy a Cost 4 or less Spirit you control, and you can destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to the cost of your destroyed Spirit.

BS14-099.name: Arms Shock
BS14-099.effect:
[Burst: After an oppposing Spirit/Brave's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. Then by paying the cost, activate this card's Main effect.

[Main]
Put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control.

BS26-004.name: Aroblader
BS26-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.

[When Braved] [LV2] (When Brave Attacks)
Increase the limit of this Spirit's "BP Destruction effects" by 6000.
BS26-004.flavor: Hey, wait! We're Spirits! We're your allies! Why are you attacking us!?

BS53-CP01.name: Arondai - Origins 02
BS53-CP01.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
By putting up to two cards from your decktop face-down onto the Field, and putting one core, except [Soul Core], from your Trash to each of them, until the end of the game, those cards are treated as Red Spirits with "Cost 1/"Minion" family/<1>LV1: 1000 BP/[Red Core]". (Those Spirits can't be switched in places, and are discarded when sent to the Hand/Removed Zone/Deck)

[LV2] (When Attacks)
During this turn, when your Spirit is blocked, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BS53-CP01.flavor: The prototype of the mass-produced "Golems" is called "Origins".

BS17-056.name: Aroundizar
BS17-056.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Send two cores from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve. After this effect activates, summon this Brave card.

[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.
BS17-056.flavor: The weapon granted to whom heed the KnightHero's imperial command.

BS44-082.name: Arrival at the Divine World
BS44-082.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Worldswalker"/"Avatar" family Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, draw one card.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you deploy any Grandwalker Nexus, once per turn, put a core from the Void to that Grandwalker Nexus.
BS44-082.flavor:
For the sake of birthing the new Grandwalker, as Lolo ordered to the yellow-colored clown, that person was guided to a beautiful dusk world.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 001―

BS53-027.name: Bat-Eared Fox
BS53-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
By banishing one card from the opposing Trash, put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, if you have two/three counters, heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit.
[heb]

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't activate Burst effects.
BS53-027.flavor:
If it is a disaster beast like last time, there is no way we can fight it without Alex. We can only resort to escaping.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 2:14―

BS18-029.name: Bat-Holliday
BS18-029.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
This Spirit can't attack.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
The opponent must attack at least once per turn if possible.
BS18-029.flavor: The reserve forces of the Five Nation Alliance ...were truly to stay reserved only. They had no motivation to fight. If it weren't for the armistice, we really would have been wiped out.

BS57-076.name: Bat Disaster
BS57-076.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Purple Core][Blue Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, when your "Proximate" family Spirit attacks, you can summon a Purple/Blue "Astroblazer" family Spirit card from your Trash.

[Flash]
Destroy two opposing Spirits/Ultimates with three cores or more on it. If you control any "Bal-Masque"-named Spirits/Nexuses, treat this card as colorless.

BSC42-027.name: Bathopper LT
BSC42-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BSC42-027.flavor: They used to just be hopping around. Ever since the World Tree appeared, they are more energetic than ever. I wonder if the new air in the woods changed them?

BS24-015.name: Batknight
BS24-015.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card. If you control any Ultimate, also, draw a card.

[LV2] [Curse] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked when the battle resolves at the end of battle.
BS24-015.flavor: He and Thunder-Million plan to go against the Ultimates by themselves? That's rash! Ozzania! Attack with that bat knight, and don't waste any time in between! Don't let a courageous hero like that die!

BS24-109.name: Battle Cancel
BS24-109.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit attacks]
Send a core from any of your Spirits to your Life. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
When the battle resolves, end the battle without comparing BP.

CB18-060.name: Atros Burst
CB18-060.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed by the Opponent]
You can summon a Cost 6 or less "Kaiju"/"Seijin"/"Zetton"-named Spirit card from your Trash without paying the cost. Then by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Send all but one cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve. Then, if you control any "Belial"-named Spirits/Grandwalker Nexuses, send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve.

LM16-04.name: Battle Spirits Burning Soul (Card)
LM16-04.kanji: バトルスピリッツ 烈火魂
LM16-04.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit with Soul Core on it attacks, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your Spirits with Soul Core on it gain an extra Red Symbol.
LM16-04.flavor: For as much soul as you have, battles can be found!

26RSD04-003.name: Arsinus
26RSD04-003.effect:
[LV1-2] [Invoke: Main]
Exhaust this Spirit ▶ Reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Cost 6 or more "Mineroid" family Spirit card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.
26RSD04-003.flavor:
The new world is harsh, but there is no going back to the old world. We have no choice but to make a life here.
―from the Foreigner's Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2854.name: Attache Caliber
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2854.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Kamen" family Spirit effect, or sent to the Trash by the effects of your Green Grandwalker Nexus, you can add it to the Hand.

[During Brave]
When replacing it via your [Change], this Brave's cost becomes 0.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
By exhausting an opposing Spirit, put a core from the Void to your Trash.

LM16-05.name: Battle Spirits Double Drive (Card)
LM16-05.kanji: バトルスピリッツ ダブルドライブ
LM16-05.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirit is summoned, draw a card. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[During Seal] [LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced, for each reduced Life, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.
LM16-05.flavor: V-V- and keen! The double heroes' great adventure!

CB16-079.name: Attachment
CB16-079.effect:
When opposing "Gundam"-named Spirits are summoned, you can return this card from the Trash to the Hand. This effect doesn't stack.

[Flash]
Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total cost of 6. Also, refresh a Spirit with [Top Gun]/[Bushido] you control.

BS43-089.name: Attack! Roaring Azure Pirate Fleet
BS43-089.kanji: 出撃！ 爆蒼海賊艦隊
BS43-089.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Roaring Azure" family Spirit attacks, that Spirit gains +5000 BP.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
Your Life can't be reduced by the attacks of opposing Spirits with "can't be blocked" effects.
BS43-089.flavor:
Not just the sea, it is a fleet that can travel even on land. It is said that the crews are all very caring while responsible.
-from the Places of Interest 392/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

P21-14.name: Battle Spirits Mirage (Card)
P21-14.kanji: バトルスピリッツミラージュ
P21-14.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
While your one-symbol “Proximate”/“Astroblazer” family Spirit is attacking as the first attack of the turn, that Spirit can't be blocked.

[Flash]
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2859.name: Attack! The Pirate Ship Greedog
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2859.kanji: 襲撃！ 海賊船グリードッグ号
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2859.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing non-braved Spirit would attack, unless the opponent sends a core from their Reserve to their Trash, it can't attack.

[LV2]
While your "Pirate"-named Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate their Burst.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2859.flavor:
The flagship of the Three-Headed Pirate Gang, which is led by the December End God. While I thought their looting behaviors would be condemned, the December End God replied that "it is also a part of luck and fortune."
-from the Places of Interest 178/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

P14-18.name: Battle Spirits with Everyone!
P14-18.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirits are blocked, draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
When your Ultimate is summoned, destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2861.name: Attacker ShiningHeavenCleverMachine Tajikarao
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2861.kanji: 攻性・天照機巧タジカラオ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2861.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks) Put one core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, if [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2] Heavy Armor: Red/Purple - This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2861.flavor:
I unleashed all the power I had stored until now straight towards Zeus-Lolo. And without him giving an inch of struggle, it completely envelops him...
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 4:21―

26RSD04-001.name: Atun
26RSD04-001.effect:
[LV2] True Release When Blocks
Target an "Mineroid" family Nexus you control. Put a core from the Void to it.
26RSD04-001.flavor: "Was this my uncle's arm... or my aunt's leg?"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2863.name: Battleship-Moa
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2863.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Neither player's decks can be discarded.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks) Discard an opposing Burst. If you have a Burst set, also, return an opposing Cost 3 or lower Spirit to the Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2863.flavor: According to data, that mechanical bird is a battleship. Apparently it's powerful enough to blow away an entire mountain with one strike from its main battery.

CB16-051.name: Audrey Burne
CB16-051.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

This card/Brave is also treated as being exactly-named "Mineva Lao Zabi", and one copy of it can brave to a Spirit you control that's braved to a "Pilot" family Brave, ignoring the number of Braves on it.

[LV1] (Start of Your Attack Step)
If there's any opposing Spirit, you can draw a card.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
This unblocked Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects.

BS10-076.name: Bazooka-Arms
BS10-076.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can deploy a Blue Nexus card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[When Braved] [Assault: 1] (When Brave Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting a Nexus you control.
BS10-076.flavor:
If he's a friend, then of course you can trust him!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS18-050.name: Augusdos
BS18-050.effect:
[LV1] (Your Attack Step)
This Spirit can't attack.

[LV1][LV2]
Cards can't be discarded from either player's deck.
BS18-050.flavor:
They must have been in a rush to grasp the chance to kill both Manaka and Kei. After their failed attempts to assassinate the two of them, the Sect of Zeyon's plots and betrayal were discovered and unveiled. The one who tracked down the runaway fugitives were Lord, who had completed its Tribute Summon, and Manaka.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 648—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2867.name: Baihumon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2867.effect:
Flash - [Advent: [[Ultimate (Family)] (Ultimate]], (Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

This card can also [Advent] from the Removed Zone.

Flash- [Accel: Cost 5 ([White Core][White Core][White Core])]
Return any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 12000 BP to the Hand. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up on the Removed Zone.

[LV2] [During Advent] (Start of Opposing Attack Step)
You can target an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. During this turn, the targeted Spirit/Ultimate can't attack.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2867.flavor:
[Mega. Holy Beast. Data]
One of the Four Holy Beats, guardian of the West and holder of the Metal property.

X13-09.name: Beach Trickster
X13-09.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return a Magic card from your Trash to the Hand.

BS69-062.name: Bakuon Boar
BS69-062.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Blue Core])]
[During Set]
When Spirits/Ultimates you or the opponent controls heavily exhaust, if you control any "Contractor Huracan", you can draw a card. When you've done so, discard a card from your Hand. You can [Mani] a "Devotee"/"Concluser" family card discarded via this effect.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can, ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit/Ultimate.
BS69-062.flavor:
Let's go bros! It's time to raid Olymmmmm!!
―Grandwalker Huracan―

CB06-002.name: Auto Vajin Battle Mode
CB06-002.kanji: オートバジン バトルモード
CB06-002.effect:
When your "Faiz"-named Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
When summoned via an effect, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 7000 BP.

[LV2]
This Spirit and your "Kamen"/"Infernal Lord" family Spirits can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.
CB06-002.flavor: Auto Vajin's robot form. Fights many Orphnochs as Faiz' partner, but is destroyed on the battle with Ark Orphnoch.

BS10-068.name: Beam-Beetle
BS10-068.effect:
[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS10-068.flavor:
There are even Braves who protect the forest.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS69-060.name: Bakuon Bok
BS69-060.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your "Roaring Azure" family Spirit heavy exhausts, you can discard two cards from the opposing decktop. When you've done so, during this turn, give one of your Spirits +3000 BP.
BS69-060.flavor:
Gaia, who fell behind the speedy attacks of Hermes and Huracan in perfect synchronization, activated her hidden ace. She proceeded to summon the legendary beast that was rumored to have defeated even Zeus, the GreatPhantomDemonBeast Typhodeus, and planned to crush the entire land of Hercadia. Seeing that Gaia had revealed her hidden ace, the two spread out, with Hermes facing Gaia, and Huracan dealing with Typhodeus, launching a two-point simultaneous attack.
―Theogonic Record Volume 2―

BS36-029.name: Beam-Erkat
BS36-029.effect:
[When Braved] [LV1][LV2]
When Braved to a symbolless Brave, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit effects.

―Theogonic Record Volume 2―

The fated 6. The first to know of their coming was my pet.

Hades watched from a distant place over the battle where Hermes and Huracan won. Could these all be determined results from this man's palm?

Gaia and Typhodeus were defeated by the two-point attack of Hermes and Huracan. Olym had somehow survived the second wave of attack of the primordial deities.

Dare to show up during the meeting of us Vulrica Grandwalkers shows that you aren't some random person. Who are you? ―Grandwalker Huracan―

The first ones to respond to Manaka's call were the snakes.

26RBS03-061.name: Bochack

―Grandwalker Kinich-Ahau―

-from the 10th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

Usually, spirits would not be aware that a creator, in other words, a Grandwalker, exists, and would not even feel the slightest influence from the power of the Grandwalker. ―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 4:03―

The place we finally arrived was surrounded by hustle and bustle. Fragments of shattered gems were lying on the ground, and Spirits were fighting around them while protected by an Imagine.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 3:16―
