BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3552.flavor: HAAI, HAAI, HAI HAI HAI. HOOHOOOOOOO! YAAAAAY! HAI HAI HAI! UUUUUUH HAI!

BS61-069.name: Cutting Blood Strings
BS61-069.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Blood Crystal" family Spirit effect destroys opposing Spirits/Ultimates, you can return this card from the Trash to your Hand.

[Flash]
Destroy a Spirit/Ultimate you or the opponent controls with 1/3/5 cores on it.

CB29-078.name: Confession
CB29-078.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core])]
[During Set] (Your Start Step)
By putting a "School" family Spirit card/Magic card from your Hand onto the Removed Zone, draw a card from the deckbottom.

[Flash]
During this turn, the symbol of an opposing Spirit is fixed as zero. Also, during this battle, if your Life is reduced, draw a card from the deckbottom.

BS57-075.name: Cutting Core
BS57-075.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Purple Core])]
[During Set]
When your "Bal-Masque"-named Spirit would activate a "core removal"/"X cores or less destruction" effect, treat that Spirit as colorless.

[Flash]
Send the opposing [Soul Core], or a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve, and when any Spirit/Ultimate is depleted, draw a card.

BS31-098.name: Conflagration Slash
BS31-098.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy an opposing braved Brave. After this effect resolves, when [Soul Core](Soul Core) was used to pay the cost, destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3557.name: Cyanite-Golem
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3557.kanji: カイヤナイト・ゴレム
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3557.effect:
[LV1][LV2] This Spirit can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2] Except for [Soul Core], neither player can put cores to their Life through effects. Also, the Life of either player can only be reduced by one per Grandwalker Nexus each turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3557.flavor:
Hermes was also taken aback by Hephaestus sudden appearance. Why Hephaestus, who was supposed to accompany Zeus-Lolo, was here? And Hermes' confusion expands even further, as the one Hephaestus attacks is Hermes' army.
ー"Genesis Records" New Volume 3:29ー

BS66-023.name: Conifer-Hedgehog
BS66-023.kanji: コニファー・ヘッジホッグ
BS66-023.effect:
During your Main Step, by showing a "The Flower Partner, Frau" from your Hand to the opponent, summon this card from the Hand, treating all reduction symbols as filled.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS66-023.flavor:
Waha~ Puni-puni~ That's so soft and so squishy~ You're so cute~ ―花相棒フラウ―
Ehehe~ It tickles~ Let me jump! ―Petit Lampo―
I've pictured that Green Spirits would get along well with each other...And turns out it is exactly what I expected~

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3559.name: Cyber-Shepherd
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3559.kanji: サイバー・シェパード
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3559.effect:
[LV2] (When Attacks) Return an opposing Nexus to the Hand.
[Rush: Purple]
(While you have a Purple symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Purple Core]: Send cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve until only one core remains.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3559.flavor: Fric, you're up. Act as support for that Machine Beast. Please, Fric. Don't run!

BS33-074.name: Conjuration
BS33-074.effect:
[Flash]
Summon a "Nightling" family Spirit card from your Trash without paying the cost. Also, during the opposing turn, if [Soul Core] was used to pay the cost, summon a Cost 2 or less Spirit card from your Trash without paying the cost.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3561.name: Cyberdramon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3561.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Heavy Armor: Purple/Green/Yellow]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Green/Yellow Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
If possible, this Spirit must attack/block. At the end of your Attack Step, refresh this Spirit.

[LV2] (Opposing End Step)
If this Spirit is in refreshed state, send an opposing Life to their Reserve. This effect doesn't stack.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3561.flavor:
[Ultimate. Cyborg. Vaccine]
A Dragonoid Cyborg Digimon.

BS03-148.name: Construction
BS03-148.effect:
[Main]
Deploy every Red/Green/Blue Nexus cards from your Trash, without paying the costs.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

PX24-02.name: Contractor Kai
PX24-02.effect:
[Core Charge: (Scarlet Flame/Blood Crystal/Jade Thunder/Silver Zero/Golden Cloud/Azure Wave) (Core Charge via summon/advent only once per turn)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2]
Add a card with [Contract Advent] that was sent to the Trash by this Nexus' [Core Charge] to the Hand.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When the opponent uses a card from their Hand outside of Flash Timing, before that effect activates, by sending four cores from this Nexus to the Void, immediately negate that effect.

BS22-035.name: Dark-Bison
BS22-035.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Blocks)
This Spirit gains +4000 BP.
[Rush: Purple]
(While you have a Purple symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Purple Core]: Destroy an opposing exhausted Cost 5 or less Spirit.

[LV2] [Heavy Armor: Red/Green/White]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Green/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
BS22-035.flavor: A mighty beast races across the melting mountain snow.

P13-14.name: Dark-Cerbelord
P13-14.kanji: ダーク・ケルベロード
P13-14.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Assault: 1] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.
[Rush: Red]
(While you have a Red symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Red Core]: The opponent must block if possible.
P13-14.flavor: Its enormous strength wasn't something that could be restricted from the start. In the middle of battle it suddenly went berserk and begun its conversion to darkness.

SD17-002.name: Dark-Dinonychusaw
SD17-002.kanji: ダーク・ディノニクソー
SD17-002.effect:
[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is also treated as a Green Spirit.
SD17-002.flavor: Vanguard of the dark surges ahead to cut open a path for the rear guard. This scenario never changes, no matter what world you're in.

BS22-029.name: Dark-Dober
BS22-029.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Blocks)
Return an opposing Spirit with [Charge] to the Hand.
BS22-029.flavor: As the earth has crumbled due to the abnormalities, maps were of no use. Our journey became life-threatening when we were shipwrecked. At that moment, a dog with an excellent sense of smell sniffed out the right way and guided us.

BS50-040.name: Dark-Dober X
BS50-040.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block while exhausted.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Blocks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] [Heavy Armor: Red/White]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
BS50-040.flavor:
News of Ares defeat on the opening battle travelled instantly from supporters to Artemis. Her decision after that was quick.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 3:02―

SD11-005.name: Dark-Gadphant
SD11-005.kanji: ダーク・ガドファント
SD11-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing 2000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] [Heavy Armor: Red/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
SD11-005.flavor: The people of this country say that the berserk monsters seem to have increased in number since the great incident that rocked the world. Either way, I want to run away from this dangerous place.

BS21-043.name: Dark-Iberix
BS21-043.kanji: ダーク・アイベリックス
BS21-043.effect:
[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing LV1/LV2 Spirits.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: Exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS21-043.flavor: This is the worst possible turn of events... The Dark Green Army already made off with this country's sword before we could get to it.

P13-23.name: Dark-Liorider V Twin
P13-23.kanji: ダーク・ライオライダーVツイン
P13-23.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Blocks)
This Spirit gains +3000 BP.
[Rush: Purple]
(While you have a Purple symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Purple Core]: Draw a card.

[LV2] (When Blocks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, refresh this Spirit.
P13-23.flavor: As a high-mobility tactical weapon, he continues to fight, repair after repair. Will the war end first, or will he fall apart before then?

BS19-024.name: Dark-MachG
BS19-024.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.
[Rush: Blue]
(While you have a Blue symbol, the following effect activate next)
[Blue Core]: Destroy an opposing Cost 2 or less Spirit.
BS19-024.flavor:
Spirits who gone berserk... The Black Orbs... Every time they appear at the same time...
-The Murmurs of Rutile, First Day of the Ninth Month-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3573.name: Dark-Squalo X
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3573.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard two cards from the opposing decktop. Also, this Spirit has 0 symbols.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Put one core from the Void to this Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3573.flavor: Triton and Dolphillippos sail the Charybdis together and arrive at Grand Lolo. There, they'll look for Grand Lolo's treasures and even develop a rivalry with the Dragon Emperor's Pirate crew. But that is a story for a different time.

BS19-014.name: Dark-Swordoll
BS19-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.
[Rush: Yellow]
(While you have a Yellow symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Yellow Core]: During this turn, this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing LV1 Spirits.

[LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Yellow.
BS19-014.flavor: A being that looked like a magician's familiar guided us to the castle.

X13-13.name: Dark-Tyrannosaura-Overrex
X13-13.kanji: ダーク・ティラノザウラー・オーバーレックス
X13-13.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Target and attack an opposing Spirit.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, send a core from the opposing Life to the Reserve.
X13-13.flavor:
The war with no foreseeable end united the forces of darkness.
"If light strengthens, darkness too will grow even stronger!"

SD11-010.name: Dark-Uranus
SD11-010.effect:
[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is also treated as a Green Spirit.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
By exhausting an opposing 7000 BP or more Spirit, refresh this Spirit.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: Put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.
SD11-010.flavor: Those of the black species are very threatening in the dark.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3577.name: DarkAnkillersaurus
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3577.kanji: ダークアンキラーザウルス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3577.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Phase) When this Spirit is sacrificed for a Tribute Summon, you can instead exhaust this Spirit to bring the Tribute Summon Spirit to the Field without paying its Tribute Cost.

[LV2][LV3] (During Your Opponent's Turn) When your opponent draws a card at any time other than his/her Draw Phase, destroy an opposing Spirit with 4000BP or less.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3577.flavor:
There's a company in the ranks that is so brutal, they are unable to discern ally from foe... But as of right now, that's just the kind of strength needed.
-from the 6th paragraph in chapter Red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

P13-20.name: DarkBrontrident
P13-20.kanji: ダーク・ブロントライデント
P13-20.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
For each Spirit with [Rush] you control, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: Exhaust an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit.
P13-20.flavor: Its violently swinging three-pronged headbutt is as sharp as a knife and has as much impact as a blunt weapon.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3579.name: DarkChunpopo
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3579.effect:

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3579.flavor: They're definitely not what I expected... They're still cute, of course, but....

BS19-025.name: DarkDio-Mantis
BS19-025.kanji: ダーク・ディオマンティス
BS19-025.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can send up to three cores from your Spirits to your Reserve.
[Rush: Blue]
(While you have a Blue symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Blue Core]: This Spirit is treated as being on its highest level.
BS19-025.flavor:
The Country of Dark Green... a forest of black insects that blend into the darkness...
-The Murmurs of Rutile, First Day of the Ninth Month-

BS16-008.name: DarkKnight-Dragon
BS16-008.kanji: ダークナイト・ドラゴン
BS16-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
By sending a core from your Life to the Void, destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit.

Manaka's survival was confirmed. However, he was on the opposing camp.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of the Hero Kei, Year 646—

P13-03.name: DarkMitsujarashi
P13-03.kanji: ダーク・ミツジャラシ
P13-03.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.
[Rush: Blue]
(While you have a Blue symbol, the following effect activates next.)
[Blue Core]: During this turn, the opponent can only use Magic cards with the same color as the symbols on their Field.
P13-03.flavor: Changes in the ecosystem came along with the global abnormalities. And some beings were tainted with darkness.

P13-02.name: DarkRib-Reaper
P13-02.kanji: ダーク・リブリーパー
P13-02.effect:
[LV2] (When Destroyed)

[Rush: Yellow]
(While you have a Yellow symbol, the following effect activates next.)
[Yellow Core]: Once per turn, this Spirit remains on the Field, refreshed.
P13-02.flavor:
Light and darkness battle in this world... It all began on the day when the global abnormalities occurred...
-The Murmurs of Rutile, First Day of the Eighth Month-

BS19-022.name: DarkSkullpione
BS19-022.kanji: ダーク・スカルピオーネ
BS19-022.effect:

When blocked by opposing Spirits, the opponent discards a card from their Hand.
[Rush: Yellow]
(While you have a Yellow symbol, the following effect activates next)

BS19-022.flavor: The world steadily marches towards its destruction...

P13-04.name: DarkSnopard

[LV1][LV2]
The attacks of 4000 BP or less Spirits can't reduce either player's Life.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)

P13-04.flavor: A different power lies within the ones cloaked with darkness. I didn't feel it when they mingled with similar creatures.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3586.name: DarkTyrannomon

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)

Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3586.flavor:
[Champion. Dinosaur. Virus]
A Dinosaur digimon whose body was invaded by Computer Viruses. Its "Fire Blast" releases a super powerful breath of fire and turns its surroundings into a sea of flames.

SD14-004.name: DarkZiga-Wasp

Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.
[Rush: Blue]
(While you have a Blue symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Blue Core]: Destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.
SD14-004.flavor: The ones that lost and left in the previous war were reincarnated in the darkness and awakened new powers.

BS32-074.name: Dark Initiation
BS32-074.kanji: ダークイニシエーション
BS32-074.effect:
[Main]
By destroying any number of Spirits you control, for each of your Spirits destroyed, return a Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

CB01-021.name: Dark Lugiel
CB01-021.effect:
Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
When you or the opponent controls any "Ultraman"-named Spirit, you can summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By destroying an opposing exhausted Spirit, draw two cards.
CB01-021.flavor:
A powerful being of darkness who turned Ultraman, Kaijus, and Aliens into Spark Doll using the gigantic Dark Spark in the past.
―Ultraman Ginga―

BS30-074.name: Dark Matter
BS30-074.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by the opponent]
Return up to six Purple cards from your Trash to either your decktop or deckbottom only, in any order. Then, draw a card. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing braved Brave.

BS25-005.name: Dark Matter Dragon
BS25-005.kanji: ダークマタードラゴン
BS25-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return a Cost 5 or less Red Spirit card/Ultimate card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Cores on this Spirit can't become 0 due to any player's effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Treat all your "Gai-Asura"-named Ultimates as being on LV6.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3592.name: Dark Power
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3592.effect: Flash- During this turn, for each exhausted Spirit you control, all "Dark"/"Black"-named Spirits you control gain +2000 BP.

BSH-006.name: Dark Sanctuary
BSH-006.effect: Main- During this turn, all opposing effects can't be activated.

BS24-103.name: Cycle Power
BS24-103.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit/Ultimate +2000 BP.
[Rush: Yellow]
(While you have a Yellow symbol, the following effect activates next.)
[Yellow Core]: At the end of battle, return this Magic card from the Trash to your Hand. This effect can't be activated during the Main Step.

BS67-081.name: Dark Shoot
BS67-081.effect:
Including being in Soul State, while you control any Spirit with "Curse"-named effects, this card in Hand becomes Cost 5.

[Flash]
Treat this card as colorless, and send two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve. After this effect resolves, (Once per Turn: Same Name) if the opponent controls any Spirit/Ultimate, you can return this card to the Hand.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3596.name: Dark Snake Demon-God
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3596.effect:
This brave doesn't exhaust, and when in spirit condition, can't attack or block.

[When Braved on Right/Left] (When Attacks) Send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve.

BS20-065.name: Cyclo-Arms
BS20-065.effect:
[When Braved] (When Destroyed)
By destroying a Nexus you control, this Spirit remains on the Field, exhausted.
BS20-065.flavor: A machine intended for surveillance and defense, shooting a beam of light as soon as it detects hostility.

CB22-059.name: Dark Zeperion Ray
CB22-059.kanji: ダークゼペリオン光線
CB22-059.effect:
[Flash]
Send two cores from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve. If you have ten or less cards in your deck, instead, send three cores from any opposing Spirits to the Trash.

CB15-017.name: Cyclone Dopant
CB15-017.kanji: サイクロン・ドーパント
CB15-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can discard three cards from your decktop. Draw a card for each "Eternal"/"Dopant"/"W"-named card among them.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Turn)
When "Eternal"/"Dopant"/"W"-named cards are sent to your Trash, discard a random card from the opposing Hand. This effect can only be used once per turn.
CB15-017.flavor: The dopant Maria S. Cranberry transformed into using the power of Cyclone Memory. It can manipulate wind to attack.

BS72-059.name: Darkling Demon-God
BS72-059.effect:
This Brave doesn't exhaust, and while in Spirit condition, can't attack or block.

When summoning this card, by sending two cores from any of your "Contractor Nyx" Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void, treat all reduction symbols as fulfilled.

[During Right Brave] (When Attacks)
You can send a core from the opposing Field to the Reserve.

[During Left Brave] (When Attacks)
If you control any "Contractor Nyx", you can pay one cost to summon a "Darkling" family card from your Trash.

BS37-036.name: Cynognathus
BS37-036.effect:
Flash- [Accel: Cost 2 ([White Core][Red Core])]
During this turn, give all your Spirits +3000 BP. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.
BS37-036.flavor: For this race, "Scuderia Maclarn" seems to have prepared an astounding secret weapon, other than the favorite Racer Glorious-Sheep. It might have to do with the new equipment, Accel...

BSC24-030.name: Darklops Zero
BSC24-030.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
If [Soul Core](Soul Core) was used to pay for the summon cost, during this turn, this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Spirits.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
The opponent can return one of their Spirits to the Hand. When none are returned, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BSC24-030.flavor:
An experimental machine for invasion made based on Ultraman Zero.
―OV Ultra Galaxy Legend Gaiden: Ultraman Zero vs Darklops Zero―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3603.name: D-Ark
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3603.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your "Rookie"/"Champion"/"Ultimate"/"Mega" family Spirit is summoned/[advents], you can draw a card. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2] Flash - [Card Slash]
Discard one "Rookie"/"Champion"/"Ultimate"/"Mega" family Spirit card from your Hand. Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with BP equal or inferior to the LV1 BP of the discarded card.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3603.flavor: The Tamers' Digivice. Its special function is Card Slash, which consists of letting it read a card to Digivolve or strenghten the Partner Digimon.

SD44-005.name: Darkness-Cocadrille
SD44-005.kanji: ダークネス・コカドリーユ
SD44-005.effect:
Flash- [Accel: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core][Core])]
Return an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit to the deckbottom. When any Spirit is returned to the deckbottom by this effect, put a core from Void to any Red-only Grandwalker Nexus you control. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up on your Removed Zone.
SD44-005.flavor:
Divine World has long been in equilibrium. However, with "Uru" born in the strategic point where the 4 powers meet, the time for changes has come.
─Holy Book Fragment─

CB07-044.name: D-Reaper ADR-01 Juri
CB07-044.kanji: デ・リーパーADR-01 ジュリ
CB07-044.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing "Rookie"/"Champion"/"Ultimate"/"Mega" family Spirit effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Turn)
When your "Reaper"-named Spirit's "Opposing Deck Discarding" effect discards any Spirit card, draw two cards. Then, discard a card from your Hand.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard five cards from the opposing decktop.
CB07-044.flavor: The first Agent D-Reaper that appeared, based on a sample from Juri. It analyzed Juri's memories while she was captures and categorized humans as unnecessary beings.

CB07-043.name: D-Reaper ADR-02 Searcher
CB07-043.kanji: デ・リーパーADR-02 サーチャー
CB07-043.effect:
You can put up to 20 copies of this card in deck.

[Burst: After the Opposing Hand increases via an Opposing effect]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, for each card the opponent added when this Burst activates, discard one card from the opposing decktop. Also, you can set a card with Burst effects from your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

Reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add to your Hand one of each "Diva" family Spirit card and Magic card, each with a card name different from this card's. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[Flash]
Target one of your Spirits. During this turn, give it +3000 BP.

BS66-077.name: Different Draw
BS66-077.kanji: ディフェレントドロー
BS66-077.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Red Core])]
[During Set] (When Set)
Your counter +1. Then, destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit.

[Main]
Draw two cards. Then, including being in pre-advent condition, if you control any "Petit Glow", you can reveal four cards from the decktop. You can summon a Red Cost 5 or less Spirit card/Brave card among them, without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

CB02-061.name: Digi-Egg
CB02-061.effect:
You can put any number of copies of this card in your deck.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning a "Rookie" family Spirit card, this Nexus' symbol is also treated as Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

[LV2]
When your "Champion"/"Ultimate"/"Mega" family Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, by destroying this Nexus, return that Spirit to the Hand.
CB02-061.flavor: Eggs of Digimons. Baby I Digimons are born from these eggs. Digimons of Champion level or above could leave a Digi-Egg when they reach the end of their life.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3775.name: Death Curse Maker
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3775.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve. Or, you can discard a card from the opposing Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
You can pay one cost to summon one Cost 6 "Ogre Wizard" family Spirit card from your Hand/Trash. This effect doesn't trigger [Core Charge].
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3775.flavor:
A world without a Grandwalker faces the peril of extinction. The world can be rebuilt, but the time lost does not return. A world which has lost its scenery also loses how much power it can offer its Grandwalker. In exchange for her own power, Hera decided to bet on Olym's future.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 3:32―

CB07-013.name: Devidramon
CB07-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
By sending a core from any opposing Spirit/Nexus to their Reserve, draw a card.

[LV2] [Warp Digivolve: Red/Purple] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Red/Purple "Ultimate" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB07-013.flavor:
[Champion. Evil Dragon. Virus]
A feared evil dragon digimon called the Compound Eye Devil. Its finisher move, Crimson Nail, consists of ripping the enemy apart with its gigantic claws and splattering their blood around.

BSC18-045.name: Diva Symphony
BSC18-045.kanji: ディーバシンフォニー
BSC18-045.effect:
[Type: Song]

[Flash]
Separate every Brave on an opposing Brave Spirit/Brave Ultimate. However, the opponent decides how the cores are moved in the separation. After this effect resolves, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit/Ultimate -7000 BP. Destroy any Spirit/Ultimate that was brought to 0 BP by this effect.

CB07-049.name: Digignome
CB07-049.effect:
When you're summoning a "Rookie" family card, the symbol of this card in your Removed Zone is treated as being on the Field, and is also treated as Red/Purple/Green/White/Blue.

Main - [Accel: Cost 2 ([Core])]
Reveal five cards from your decktop. Add a "Tamer" family Nexus card and an exactly-named "D-Ark" among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.
CB07-049.flavor: A being different from Digimon that has existed since the birth of the Digital World.

26RSD05-004.name: Divaes
26RSD05-004.effect:
[LV2]True ReleaseWhen Attacks
Target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, give it -2000 BP. Then, if it has 0 BP, destroy it.
26RSD05-004.flavor: As dragons grow, they become increasingly skilled at manipulating lightning. It is said that some dragons even use lightning like bullets.

BS70-015.name: Death Deigos
BS70-015.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
Once per turn, your counter +1. Then, you can discard two cards from your decktop.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
For every three Purple "Devotee"/"Concluser" family cards in your Trash, send a core from a single opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve.
BS70-015.flavor:
At the Twelve Olymian Council, the question of who was going to lead the main army to fight against Uranus had become an issue. While most opinions suggested that Hades should take the lead, Hera, who had been uncooperative until then, stepped forward and volunteered for the role. ―Theogonic Record Volume 3―
I'll take the lead. Hades, don't forget what you said. ―Grandwalker Hera―

CB07-054.name: Digital Monster Card Game
CB07-054.kanji: デジタルモンスターカードゲーム
CB07-054.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your "Rookie" family Spirits are depleted/destroyed by opposing effects, you can return them to the Hand instead of sending them to the Trash.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed when comparing BP with your "Rookie"/"Champion"/"Ultimate"/"Mega" family Spirit, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
CB07-054.flavor: A competitive Trading Card Game. By "Card Slashing" with the D-Ark, your Digimon are powered up.

P14-02.name: Death Demon
P14-02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Send one core each from every opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit to their Reserve. If you control any Ultimate, the cores that this effect would send to Reserve are sent to the Trash instead.
P14-02.flavor: I think it's wrong. To say that we can use our power because Ultimate is there. I think it's wrong.

CB02-063.name: Digivice
CB02-063.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
If you control any "Rookie" family Spirit, by exhausting this Nexus, draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Champion" family Spirit attacks, return an "Ultimate"/"Mega" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.
CB02-063.flavor: The holy device that enables Digimon to evolve. It has the function of opening up the path to the Digital World, and letting Digimons evolve.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3784.name: Dive-Arms
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3784.effect:
[LV1] While this Brave is in Spirit condition, this Spirit gains an extra Blue symbol.

[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks) Return a Nexus card from the Trash to your Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3784.flavor: This submarine probe arms sets off on its mission to investigate the sea floor in order to find out if the global abnormalities have had any impact on the seafloor.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3785.name: Death Harpy
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3785.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy a Spirit you control. When this effect destroys, the opponent destroys a Spirit they control.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
You can pay one cost to summon a Cost 5 "Ogre Wizard" family Spirit card from your Hand/Trash. This effect doesn't trigger [Core Charge].
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3785.flavor:
The one to notice Isis' change was Lolo. Because it reminded him of how they acted while waiting for Zeus.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 3:13―

CB29-024.name: Dilanza Sol
CB29-024.effect:
[LV!][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add "Darilbalde"/ "Schwarzette"/ "Duel", one of each, to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can return up to four "Guel"/"Lauda" from your Trash to the Hand.
CB29-024.flavor: A Heavy Assault Mobile Suit used by Jeturk Heavy Machinery. Even the CEO of Jeturk Heavy Machinery, Vim Jeturk, rode on one.

BS73-082.name: Divine Dance Draw
BS73-082.effect:
When this card is sent to Trash from deck by the effect of your "Contractor Yamato Takeru", you can add it to the Hand. When you've done so, +1 core to one Grandwalker Nexus you control.

[Main]
If you control any "Contractor Yamato Takeru", draw three cards. When you've done so, reveal three cards from your Hand. If all those cards have "Devotee"/ "Machine"/ "Force Fighter"/ "Grandwalker" family, return one of them to your Hand. Return the remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a "Concluser" & "Machine"/"Force Fighter" family Spirit you control +10000 BP.

BSC25-047.name: Death Hazard
BSC25-047.effect:
[Flash]
The opponent sends three cores from any of their Spirits to their Reserve. If you control any Brave Spirit that is braved to an "Imagine" family Brave, instead, the opponent sends four cores from any of their Spirits to the reserve.

BS19-110.name: Divine Field
BS19-110.kanji: ディバインフィールド
BS19-110.effect:
[Main]
For both players, cards can't be discarded from deck, and Spirits can't be refreshed by effects. This Magic card remains on your Field until your Life is reduced by the attacks of opposing Spirits, and during so, this effect remains active. When this effect is negated, discard this card.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

CB29-021.name: Dilanza ［Felsi Use］
CB29-021.kanji: ディランザ [フェルシー機]
CB29-021.effect: When your Spirits braved to "Guel"/Lauda" would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand. When you've done so, all those Spirits remain on the Field, exhausted.
CB29-021.flavor: A multi-purpose mobile suit produced by Jeturk Heavy Machinery. Felsi rode on this and rushed to Guel and Lauda's battle. It also comes with extinguishant.

BS34-076.name: Divine Might Wind
BS34-076.effect: Flash- Exhaust an opposing Spirit. Or, return up to three cards with the same name from the opposing Trash to the deckbottom.

BS10-005.name: Dilophoza
BS10-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash Awaken - You can put any number of cores from Spirits you control to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Clash (When Attacks) The opponent must block if possible.
BS10-005.flavor: It's no use dealing with the Dinosaurs anymore. They've fallen so far into despair, they've lost sight of themselves.

BS65-016.name: Death Maiden
BS65-016.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate, and when destroys, draw a card. While braved to a Brave, this effect is treated as colorless.
BS65-016.flavor:
Miss Zantoinette teaches History of Magic in the Dominanerio Magic School. The history of magic is also the history of the shadowy part of the world...How sophisticated.
―The Infernal Partner, Camus―

BS74-082.name: Divine Oracle
BS74-082.effect:
You can use this card from Soul State.

[Flash]
Reveal three cards from your decktop. Swap any number of "Contractor Mitra" and "Awakened Dragon" family card from among them, with your cards in Soul State. Return the revealed cards to the deckbottom. Then, (Once per Turn: Same Name) you can summon/deploy one of your "Contractor Mitra" or Cost 5 or less "Awakened Dragon" family cards from Soul State, without paying the cost.

BS24-102.name: Death Massacre
BS24-102.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.
[Rush: White]
(While you have any White symbols, the following effects activate next)
[White Core]: Refresh a Purple Spirit you control.
[White Core][White Core]: Discard an opposing Burst. This effect can't be activated during the Main Step.

BS73-079.name: Divine Shield Radiance
BS73-079.effect:
When this card is sent to Trash from deck by the effect of your "Contractor Yamato Takeru", you can add it to the Hand. When you've done so, +1 core to one Grandwalker Nexus you control.

[Flash]
During this turn, your Life can't be reduced by opposing Spirits/Ultimates that aren't Cost 3~6. Then, by sending two cores from any of your "Contractor Yamato Takeru" Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3797.name: Death Nightwalker
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3797.kanji: デスナイトウォーカー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3797.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon Cost 4 and Cost 6 "Ogre Wizard" family Spirit cards, one of each, from your Hand, paying one cost for each. This effect doesn't trigger [Core Charge].

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send two cores from any opposing Spirits/the opposing Reserve to their Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3797.flavor:
Hera was the first one to crumble. She let go of her own world, and shared her power with Zeus to recover him. It's no surprise it turned out like this.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 4:11―

BS32-081.name: Divine Spirit Beam
BS32-081.effect:
[Flash]
Target an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. During this turn, that Spirit/Ultimate can't attack/block. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) was used to pay the cost, change the target of effect to: for each "War Princess" family Spirit you control, target an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3799.name: Death Python
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3799.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) When opposing effects decrease your life, send one opposing Life to the Trash. This effect does not stack.

[LV2] When this Spirit is destroyed by opposing effects, if your Life is 4 or less, by putting one core other than [Soul Core] from your Trash to your Life, this Spirit remains on the field, exhausted.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3799.flavor:
Hera, upon getting a detailed report of the situation, makes a bold decision. She left her world and moved to Hermes' world, carrying only the minimum of her forces.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 3:31―

SD42-015.name: Dimension Kick
SD42-015.kanji: ディメンションキック
SD42-015.effect:
While your "Decade"-named Spirit is attacking, this Magic card in your Hand is treated as Cost 2.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit. If you control any "Kamen" family Spirit, instead, destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3801.name: Diyadokari
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3801.effect:
[LV1] This brave cannot attack when it is in spirit condition.

[When Braved] (When Blocks) This Spirit gets +5000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3801.flavor: The enemy braved, right before my eyes!? That's playing dirty in a one-on-one fight!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3802.name: Dimension Shield
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3802.kanji: ディメンションシールド
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3802.effect:
☼<nowiki>[ </nowiki>Burst: After Your Life is Decreased<nowiki> ]</nowiki>
At the end of this battle, end the attack step. After that, by paying the cost, activate this card's flash effect.

Flash - During this battle, when your Life is decreased by opposing non-braved Spirit/non-braved Ultimate, destroy the Spirit/Ultimate. Alternatively, destroy 1 opposing non-braved Spirit/non-braved Ultimate that caused the activation of this Burst.

BS60-088.name: Death Resurrection
BS60-088.effect:
[Flash]
Summon a Cost 3 or less "Blood Crystal" family Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost. Increase the cost of the card to be summoned by this effect by +1 for every three counters you have.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3804.name: Djungaree
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3804.flavor:
The Eight Astral Dragons are making their move?! There's no mistaking it if the messengers make the announcement.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS61-071.name: Dimension Shift
BS61-071.kanji: ディメンションシフト
BS61-071.effect:
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, you can use this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

Including being in Soul State/pre-advent, while you control any "The PartnerMachine Stark", this card in your Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.

[Flash]
Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

SD41-001.name: Death Returner
SD41-001.effect:
[Immortality: Cost 0/3] (Either Attack Step)
This Spirit card in your Trash can be summoned when your Cost 0/3 Spirit is destroyed.
SD41-001.flavor:
The Shinobi Village links to every world. After attacking the Shinobi Village, the Vanity Army attempted to escape through the Purple gate. However, what appeared on the other side was a new Purple army. Even though a lot of men were lost in previous battles, the Purple Astral Dragon and co. remained.
-from the 3rd section of "New Record of the Strange World" chapter Shinobi-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3807.name: Do it, Spirit! Go Go!
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3807.kanji: いけいけスピリットやってちょーだい
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3807.effect:
[Main]
Target a Spirit you control. If it has [Crush], during this turn, its [Crush] discards one extra card per Blue symbol you control. If it has [Great Crush], during this turn, treat it as being at its highest Level, and when it reduces the opposing Life, discard five cards from the opposing decktop.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

BS16-080.name: Dimension Sword
BS16-080.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing Spirit that reduced your Life during this battle. Or, destroy an opposing Spirit that reduced your Life when this Burst activates.

SD34-014.name: Death Shoot
SD34-014.effect:
[Flash]
Send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is used to pay the cost, instead, destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less exhausted Spirit/Ultimate.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3810.name: Dimetrodoron
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3810.flavor: It is not easy to secure an escape route while fighting a losing battle. It is brave of him to bring up the rear.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3811.name: Dimorpho
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3811.flavor: I often see flying creatures in the sky on my travels. It seems like they have control of the air in this region.

BS40-017.name: Death Stalker
BS40-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to their Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return a Spirit card with [Advent] from your Trash to the Hand.
BS40-017.flavor: You'll lend us the power of pyroxene? Thank you. I'll do something to end this uprising quickly, for your sakes as well.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3814.name: Dimorpho-no-Suke
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3814.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.
[Rush: Blue]
(While you have a Blue symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Blue Core]: Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
By discarding two cards from the opposing Removed Zone, this Spirit refreshes.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3814.flavor:
Zeus-Lolo can't be allowed to continue the way he is, so Alex, despite feeling very pressured, accepted to be responsible for negotiations.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 2:29―

BS40-012.name: Death Twins
BS40-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Draw a card.
BS40-012.flavor:
Though this is now the Red World, it used to be a single realm. These Spirits who were visiting the Red World at the time of the Great Collapse were unable to return to their own worlds, with many left stranded.
-from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Red-

CB07-014.name: Dobermon
CB07-014.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 3 ([Core])]
You can [Advent] a "Mega" family Spirit card with [Advent] from your Hand onto a Spirit you control, treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash. This effect can only be used once per turn, and can only be used during (Your Attack Step). After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2] [Warp Digivolve: Purple] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Purple "Ultimate" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB07-014.flavor:
[Champion. Demon Beast. Vaccine]
Alice McCoy's Partner Digimon. He hands down the power of the Four Holy Beasts to Takato and the Tamers.

CB15-012.name: Dodo Magia
CB15-012.effect:
You can put up to five copies of this card in your deck.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Discard three cards from your decktop. Among them, for each "Kamen Rider Jin"/"Magia"-named card, send a core from any opposing Spirit(s) to the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
You can summon an exactly-named "Dodo Magia Custom" from your Hand, without paying the cost.
CB15-012.flavor: While originally an Assassin Humagear, it turned into this form by inserting the Dodo Zetsumerisekey into Zetsumeriser.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3818.name: Death Warrior
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3818.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
You can pay one cost to summon one Cost 4 "Ogre Wizard" family Spirit card from your Trash. This effect doesn't trigger [Core Charge].
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3818.flavor:
Healed from his wounds, Zeus divides his recovered power between Hermes, who lost his vitality, and more importantly, Hera, who saved his life.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 3:35―

SD17-015.name: Dino Crisis
SD17-015.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 5000 BP.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: Refresh two of your Spirits with only one symbol.

CB15-021.name: Dodo Magia Custom
CB15-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
For each exactly-named "Dodo Magia" in your Trash, draw a card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Magia"-named Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, discard a random card from the opposing Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each "Magia"-named card in your Trash, send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve.
CB15-021.flavor: The form mastering assassination, evolved using the "Lost Model" holding the data of the extinct bird, Dodo.

BS65-017.name: Devil Shooter, Camus
BS65-017.kanji: デビルシューター カミュ
BS65-017.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Infernal Contract & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

This card can [Contract Advent] from the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, you can pay one cost to summon a Purple Brave card from your Hand/Removed Zone/Trash. When you've done so, you can send two cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, you can refresh a Spirit you control.

BS23-073.name: Dino Reborn
BS23-073.effect:
[Main]
Return up to two "Fencer"/"Terra Dragon" family Spirit cards from the Trash to your Hand.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: The opponent exhausts two Spirits they control.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3823.name: Dinonychusaw
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3823.flavor: I'll say this once again: DO NOT go anywhere near the actual wargrounds. Search for a place where you can watch from a safe distance. If you get caught in a battle, run away immediately. There are some cowards around here; if you see them flee, you run with them, even if you don't feel a threatening presence. Never forget that you're gambling with your life on the line.

BS40-001.name: Dinoragon
BS40-001.flavor: Even after the Grand Collapse, the world did not die out. The world is amazing. But lots of problems developed. Mainly, the discord between species. The issue is with the inhabitants.

BS18-045.name: Doktor-Faust
BS18-045.kanji: ドクトル・ファウスト
BS18-045.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed by the opponent]
If a Yellow/White Cost 5 or more Spirit is destroyed when this Burst activates, summon this Spirit card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
When summoned via a Burst effect, you can reveal five cards from your decktop. You can summon a Spirit card among them, without paying the cost. Return the non-summoned and the remaining cards to your deckbottom in any order.
BS18-045.flavor: Thank you for cancelling my debt. How generous of you!

BSC25-033.name: Dinosaur Demon-God
BSC25-033.effect:
This Brave doesn't exhaust, and while in Spirit condition, can't attack or block.

[When Braved on the Right] (When Attacks)
If there are four or more cores on this Spirit, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.

[When Braved on the Left] (When Attacks)
Put two cores from the Void to a "Terra Dragon" family Spirit you control.

DOKU-LIZARD.name: Doku-Lizard
DOKU-LIZARD.flavor: In this area, there's a frequently occurring festival. The Dragons hold a fighting tournament to determine who's the strongest.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3828.name: Dinosaur Greeed
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3828.effect:
While there is any exactly-named "Cell Medal" on your Field, this card in your Hand/Trash becomes Cost 5.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can send two cores from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve. For each exactly-named "Cell Medal" on your Field, this effect sends +2 cores to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By discarding three exactly-named "Cell Medal" from your Field, this Spirit's symbol becomes three Purple symbols.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3828.flavor: Maki Kiyoto's form when turning into a Greeed after inserting a Dinosaur-type Core Medal unto himself.

BS64-065.name: Dinowing
BS64-065.effect:
[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, besides [Soul Core], send two cores from your Trash to this Spirit. Also, while braved to "Terad", when it's not blocked, you can also activate this Spirit's "when blocked" effects.
BS64-065.flavor: A crossbow deployed in the Grambalt Airborne Troops. Terad is very good at using this weapon, and can hit his target in any posture.

BS11-030.name: Dolphing
BS11-030.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
At the start of the step, you can target an opposing Brave Spirit. During this turn, the targeted Brave Spirit can't attack.
BS11-030.flavor:
They send information by emitting their messages as sound waves indecipherable by other beings. Fellow Dolphins scattered across the world receive the message simultaneously, and the Spirit closest to the message's destination relays it to the addressee. In the battle for intelligence, these Spirits are undoubtedly ahead of the pack.
—from the Delphinus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS08-020.name: Dio-Mantis
BS08-020.flavor:
Who is an ally? Who is a foe? No one knows in this war. They may have received orders to battle side-by-side, but just as there are those fully willing to cooperate with others, there are also those who draw their swords on anyone in sight. It's chaos to the utmost extreme. But they each agree on one thing: the Dragons are the true enemies in this scenario.
=from the 10th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BSC49-032.name: Dolphing LT
BSC49-032.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 2 ([White Core])]
Target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, your Life can't be reduced by the attack of that target. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

During this turn, an opposing Brave Spirit/Brave Ultimate can't attack.
BSC49-032.flavor:
They send information by emitting their messages as sound waves indecipherable by other beings. Fellow Dolphins scattered across the world receive the message simultaneously, and the Spirit closest to the message's destination relays it to the addressee. In the battle for intelligence, these Spirits are undoubtedly ahead of the pack.
—from the Delphinus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3834.name: Dionysus' Wine Cellar Temple
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3834.kanji: ディオニュソスの酒蔵神殿
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3834.effect:

All of Olym's madness comes from this place.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 107―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3835.name: Dolphino
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3835.flavor:
Why can't they see the seriousness of the situation? Despite the destruction of the West country by the army of the Empty Sky, the rebels are still carrying out terrorist attacks in the North country. Not individual countries but the entire world may vanish due to the Empty Sky. I must tell everything I've seen to Master Unicorn.
-from the 8th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

A magic school that teaches dark magics. It has a long history, and has given birth to many magicians. It is said that the current chairman of the school is a very famous spirit.
―Travelogue of the Collapsing World 616―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3838.name: Domination Mirage
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3838.kanji: ドミネイションミラージュ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3838.effect:

BS18-013.flavor: If there is one good thing to say about the warriors of Dark Shield, it is their perseverance and their will to never surrender. It is not until they became our comrades-in-arms that I realize such quality they possess.

Olym is governed by Twelve Grandwalkers, it is the greatest force, with many worlds under its rule.

The fierce clash among Contract Spirits, Grandwalker, and Oracles attracted even The-Moon's attention that she showed up herself. Feaniel obtained her power and the fight was eventually settled. While they started to get hold of the key to save the world, the existence of an enemy force also came to surface.

BS20-046.name: Doratfish

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4255.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
During this turn, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4255.flavor: During the mid-course, they wade through the tropical rainforest characteristic of archipelagos and proceed on a path without a road. Racers Gale-Phoenix and Mistral-Bit, two powerful competitors, enter a dead heat of chasing at each others' backs!!

BS11-011.name: Flyskull
BS11-011.effect:
[LV2] (When Destroyed)
Send one core each from two opposing Spirits to their Reserve.
BS11-011.flavor:
A stench that pierces the nose; a corpse-like figure that makes you want to look away... It may be hard to believe, but battlegrounds whose flames have died become mountainous feasts for this creature. To use more refined terms, his vulgar job would be called "aftermath management."
—from the Musca chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BSC49-011.name: Flyskull LT
BSC49-011.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
If you control another "Devotee"/ "Astral Soul"/ "Galaxian" family Spirit/Nexus, you can draw a card.

[LV2] (When Destroyed)
Send one core each from two opposing Spirits/Nexuses to the Reserve.
BSC49-011.flavor:
A stench that pierces the nose; a corpse-like figure that makes you want to look away... It may be hard to believe, but battlegrounds whose flames have died become mountainous feasts for this creature. To use more refined terms, his vulgar job would be called "aftermath management."
—from the Musca chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS03-136.name: Focus Light
BS03-136.effect:
[Main]
For each Spirit with [Brilliance] you control, draw a card.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

BSC42-013.name: Foger LT
BSC42-013.flavor: Wherever the traitors hide, the shadow will track them down and terminate them.

BS68-002.name: Fogna-Blader
BS68-002.kanji: フォグナ・ブレーダー
BS68-002.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Red Core])]
[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, when your “Scarlet Flame” family Spirit is summoned, you can [Contract Advent] a "Blade Contract" family Spirit card from your Hand, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[During Set] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
If you control any "The UltraBladeEmperorDragon Gladi-Bladra", you can summon this Mirage. When you've done so, draw a card.
BS68-002.flavor: After sending off Dan to the Divine World, Toa remained in Lecoulis, and supported the restoration work. And Kai, who had gone missing after the final Judgment Day, suddenly showed up.

SD68-003.name: Folk-StarDragon
SD68-003.kanji: フォーク・スタードラゴン
SD68-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return a non-Cost 4 "Astral Dragon"/"Olym" family card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Hand increases via your "Astral Dragon"/"Olym" family effect, you can destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. For each core on all your "Contractor Apollon" combined, increase the limit of this "BP Destruction effect" by +2000.
SD68-003.flavor: It is decided that Dan and his Contract Spirits would stay at Delpo-Nairaka while Apollon is gathering the information of Contract Grandwalkers for him. Dan and his Contract Spirits can finally take a good break. Exactly at this time, however, a bunch of never-before-seen Spirits flooded the world.

BS68-061.name: Folly-Golem
BS68-061.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Crush] (When Attacks)
Discard a number of cards equal to this Spirit's level from opposing decktop.

[LV2] (Your Turn)
When Spirit cards/Ultimate cards are discarded from the opposing deck by your [Crush], once per turn, your counter +1. When Nexus cards are discarded, once per turn, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.
BS68-061.flavor:
Dan is caught in the war against the Olym primordial deities. Which means that the search for Contract Granwalkers could only be postponed until the war is over. And at this point of time, a mysterious Grandwalker, Kinich-Ahau, suddenly shows up before Dan. What is he after?
―Theogonic Record Volume 1―

BS35-032.name: Folofolou
BS35-032.flavor: Racer Gale-Phoenix, who was plagued by the cruel weather of the mountainous area, makes miraculous gains by the middle of the race and pokes at the back of the leading group!

BSC16-016.name: Fongneena
BSC16-016.effect:
[team: Absolutes]

[LV1][LV2] [On Stage] (Your Attack Step)
Instead of attacking with this Spirit, by returning this Spirit to the deckbottom, summon a "Stage Style" family "Fongneena" from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost, and draw a card.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put one core from the Void to this Spirit.
BSC16-016.flavor: On such a fine day as this, I'll limit myself to dancing to the park.

BS13-059.name: Forbbid-Vulture
BS13-059.kanji: フォビッド・バルチャー
BS13-059.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Deploy every Purple/Green/Blue Nexus cards from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[When Braved] (Either Attack Step)
When the battle of an attacking Cost 4 or less Spirit ends, end the Attack Step.
BS13-059.flavor:
It's futile to make the lovers of war leave behind their ways even after the war's end.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

EXG5-002.name: Forbidden Extreme
EXG5-002.kanji: 禁忌のエクストリーム
EXG5-002.effect:
This card can't be used on Your Turn, and is banished from the game after its effect resolves.

When the number of cards in your deck becomes zero due to the opponent, you can immediately use the following effect.

█ Return all your banished cards and cards in your Trash to the deck and shuffle it. Then, during this turn, increase the LV cost of every opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus by +2.

BS26-075.name: Forbidden Grave
BS26-075.kanji: フォビドゥングレイヴ
BS26-075.effect:
[Flash]
Summon a "Next Generation"/"Ogre Wizard" family Ultimate card from your Trash, without paying the cost and ignoring its summon condition.

CB13-036.name: Forbidden Gundam
CB13-036.kanji: フォビドゥンガンダム
CB13-036.effect:
When your Spirits would become the target of an opposing Cost 5 or more effect, you can summon this card from the Hand by paying one cost. When you've done so, the target of that effect becomes a single Spirit you control, other than this one. This effect doesn't stack.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] LV1
This Spirit is unaffected by the effects of opposing LV1 Spirits.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Send one core from any opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit to the Reserve. Or, send three cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void.
CB13-036.flavor: A mobile suit named after taboos. By bending the trajectory of beams, it rends attacks powerless.

BS32-079.name: Force Cloak
BS32-079.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. If this Burst was activated via [Catalyze], also, during this battle, your attacking Spirit can't be blocked. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Return all opposing Spirits/Ultimates with two or more symbols to the Hand.

CB16-032.name: Force Impulse Gundam
CB16-032.kanji: フォースインパルス ガンダム
CB16-032.effect:
Flash - Silhouette System (Either Attack Step)
By putting a core from the Void to your "Impulse"-named Spirit, this card in Hand changes places with that Spirit in the same condition. [Exchange] can only be used once per turn.

[LV2][LV3] [VPSa: Cost 5 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 5 or less effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When blocked, this Spirit refreshes.
CB16-032.flavor: Impulse in Force Silhouette. A form specialized in high mobility.

CB16-033.name: Force Impulse Gundam (CB16-033 (A))
CB16-033.kanji: フォースインパルス ガンダム
CB16-033.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
If you control any "ZAFT" family Nexus, you can summon this card from the Hand. When you've done so, discard an opposing Burst. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2] [VPSa: Cost 5 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 5 or less effects.

[LV2] [Zero Rebirth]
When this Spirit attacks/blocks, you can flip it.
CB16-033.flavor: With the Deuterion Beam Energy Transfer System, it can receive a recharge of energy while in battle.

26RDB01-053.name: Fortress Stage
26RDB01-053.kanji: フォートレスステージ
26RDB01-053.effect:
[team: Blue Beat]

[LV1-2] [Invoke: Main]
Exhaust this Nexus ▶ Target one of your [Blue Beat] Spirits. During this turn, treat it as LV2.

[LV2] True ReleaseOpposing Main Step
When the opponent would summon any Cost 3 or less Spirit card, they can't summon it unless they pay one extra cost.
26RDB01-053.flavor:
Go go, let's go! Avalanche-Bison Charge!
Gail "Er, that's just part of the set...right?"
Tia "Hmm~~...It has got the crowd going, so let's just go with it."

CBX01-008.name: Force Impulse Gundam Spec II
CBX01-008.kanji: フォースインパルスガンダムSpecⅡ
CBX01-008.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Compass & C2 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Either return an opposing Brave/Nexus to the deckbottom, or discard an opposing Burst.

[LV2] [VPSa: Cost 5 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 5 or less effects.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, you can send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to the Reserve.

CB33-058.name: Fortune & Strength
CB33-058.kanji: フォーチュン＆ストレングス
CB33-058.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Mochizuki Ryouji" & C7 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Manifests/Attacks)
Discard a card from the opposing decktop. When any Spirit card is discarded by this effect, destroy an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit card; When any Nexus card is discarded, draw two cards; When any Magic card is discarded, this Spirit refreshes.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can't be destroyed by opposing Spirit effects.
CB33-058.flavor: The tenth and eleventh large-scale Shadow that appeared at Iwatodai Station during the Dark Hour of October's full moon.

CB29-014.name: Force Impulse Gundam ［Operation Angel Down］
CB29-014.kanji: フォースインパルスガンダム[エンジェルダウン作戦]
CB29-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By discarding a Cost 5 or more "ZAFT" family card from your Hand, this Spirit refreshes.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [VPSa: Cost 5 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 5 or less effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Brave to the Hand. After this effect resolves, return either an opposing Spirit with the highest BP, or an opposing "Orb" family Spirit to the deckbottom. This effect also activates when this card changes places from the Hand.
CB29-014.flavor: Tenacity has finally struck down the wings of freedom.

BS07-075.name: Fordia Slash
BS07-075.kanji: フォーディアスラッシュ
BS07-075.effect:
Main- During this turn, opposing Spirit/Nexus/Magic's "BP Increase" effects can't activate.

Flash- During this turn, give a "Braver"-named Spirit you control +5000 BP.
BS07-075.flavor:
The Celestial Blade Fordia, a legendary weapon that suddenly emerged from within a sacred tree more than a millennium old. The Elders have custody of this weapon, and only permit its use through a unanimous decision.
-from a literary fragment in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo.-

BS19-026.name: Fosser
BS19-026.flavor: After the abnormalities occurred, changes happened all around the world. For example, some parts of the countries vanished. And that phenomenon is still expanding now.

BS09-052.name: Forest-Golem
BS09-052.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
If you control any Green Spirit, destroy opposing Cost 3/4 Spirits, one of each.

[LV2] [Assault: 1] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.
BS09-052.flavor:
Why is this...? As strong as the Sapphire Spirits are, they should be able to win against the forces of Empty Sky easily... Instead they waste their energies in killing each other, forcing them down the spiraling path to certain self-destruction...
-from the 12th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS52-059.name: Fossil-Golem
BS52-059.effect:
When your counters increase to two or more, you can activate this set card, ignoring the Burst condition.

[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]

[LV2][LV3] (When Blocks)
Once per turn, refresh this Spirit.
BS52-059.flavor:
I screamed, and at the same time, Alex, who was on by side, launched an attack on the mechanical soldiers.
――"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 1:41―

BS09-074.name: Forest Charge
BS09-074.effect:
[Flash]
During this battle, when only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by your "Blade Beast"/"Giant Beast" family Spirit via BP comparison, refresh that Spirit you control.

CB30-064.name: Foundation X
CB30-064.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
By discarding an "Enemy" family card from your Hand, your counter +1, and draw two cards.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When opposing Spirits/Ultimates would leave the Field due to your effects, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Enemy" family Spirit, your counter +1.
CB30-064.flavor: A mysterious organization that supports various organizations and individuals. In order to counter "Zein", an A.I. that learns from humans' benevolence, Foundation X launched "Project Outsiders", which involves reviving various evil Kamen Riders from the past.

BS55-032.name: Forest Cougar
BS55-032.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Green "Rouse Emperor" family Spirit card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't activate any Burst effects. Also, if you have one counter or more, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BS55-032.flavor:
Guided by the local spirits, we head towards where Izanagi's kins are. While our wounds from previous battles haven't even healed, we can't afford to slow down. If Izanagi's power is also taken, there would really be nothing we can do.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 4:17―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4283.name: Forest Mirage
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4283.kanji: フォレストミラージュ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4283.effect:

Among them, you can summon a Green/Yellow "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" family Spirit card without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV1] (Your End Step)
Put a core from the Void to any Green/Yellow "Astroblazer" family Spirit you control. This effect doesn't stack.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4284.name: Four Cards
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4284.effect:
(Your Main Phrase) If you control 4 or more "Magician" spirits, all spirits your opponent controls are treated as LV1 until end of turn.

(Flash Step)(Your Main Phrase) Target spirit gets +2000BP until end of turn.

BS35-084.name: Forest of the Giant Faced Stones
BS35-084.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Cards in both players' Trash are unaffected by all effects except this one, and can't activate their effects.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
You can draw two cards. When you've done so, discard cards from your Hand until it's three or less.
BS35-084.flavor:
A strange forest with giant rock faces scattered everywhere. It is a sacred ground for Fusion Beast Spirits, as well as their living space. Without exception, those who take a step in are assaulted by Fusion Beast Spirits and never return.
―From Visit Global Ruins by Monthly BSGP―

CB14-054.name: Four Star Academy
CB14-054.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning a Spirit card with [Star Appeal], this Nexus gains two extra Yellow symbols.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
By paying one cost, switch a card in your Hand with a Spirit card with [Star Appeal] in your Trash. This effect can only be used once per turn.
CB14-054.flavor: An idol school managed by the headmaster, Moroboshi Hikaru. One specialty of it is the categorisation of Flower Song Class, Bird Theatre Class, Wind Dance Class, and Moon Beauty Class. There are both female and male campuses, in which the top students are called S4 and M4 respectively.

BS10-059.name: Fort-Golem
BS10-059.effect:
While you control any Nexus, this Spirit card in Hand becomes Cost 4.

[LV1][LV2] [Assault: 1] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.
BS10-059.flavor:
Unfortunately, the Grand Tournament has been cancelled indefinitely until further notice. The building that was supposed to serve as the main arena for the event is now battling right in front of my eyes. For the future of the Tournament and the world, I can only pray that the arena does not get destroyed.
-from the 9th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

SD55-013.name: Fourth Bright Draw
SD55-013.kanji: フォースブライトドロー

During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.
sets: Battle Spirits Dream Deck Cup Souvenir

BSC49-048.effect:

[LV2] (When Attacks)

BSC49-048.flavor:
Unfortunately, the Grand Tournament has been cancelled indefinitely until further notice. For the future of the Tournament and the world, I can only pray that the arena does not get destroyed.
-from the 9th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS03-118.name: Fourth Draw
BS03-118.effect:
[Main]
Draw until you have four cards in Hand.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

BS29-024.name: Foxsaber
BS29-024.effect:
When this Spirit card is sent to the Trash from your deck by an opposing Ultimate Trigger, Guard that Ultimate Trigger. Then, add this card to your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your [Ultimate-Griffon] battles, once per turn, you can refresh that Ultimate.
BS29-024.flavor: The seven of them apparently want to get to somewhere called... Darkness Hole? Even so, I don't know where that is or how to get there.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4292.name: Forthros
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4292.flavor: They say that in there are some beasts that eat the magical power in the land of beast. That's why the land of beast is closed now.

BS35-060.name: Foxydeer
BS35-060.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy all Cost 3 or less Spirits. If you have zero cards in Hand, instead, destroy all opposing Cost 10 or less Spirits.
BS35-060.flavor: I found him. It's Racer Ricky-Mouchuu, sneakily running alongside Racer Dos-Daimos and using his giant body as a windbreaker.

BS41-090.name: Fortress Guard
BS41-090.effect:
[Flash]
During this battle, one of your Spirits can block while exhausted. Also, if that Spirit is [During Advent], during this battle, that Spirit gains +5000 BP. After this effect resolves, return this Magic card to your deckbottom.

BS37-057.name: Frankenman
BS37-057.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Put a core from the Void to your Life. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.
BS37-057.flavor: After the race, Racer Revol-Tiger is going to vent his rage at "Team Turon", but Racer Hanumerlin and other God-Kings advise against it! Could "Team Turon" really be at fault for the accident?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4296.name: GODZILLA Godzilla
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4296.flavor:
A giant kaiju that has inhabited the earth since ancient times. When he fires a heat ray, his dorsal plates steadily begin to emanate light. The blue ray he shoots from his mouth destroys everything.
—GODZILLA (2014)—

CB26-017.name: GOLDEN RYAN
CB26-017.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Ryan"/"GOLDEN RYAN", (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Discard three cards from the opposing decktop.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw two cards, then discard a card from your Hand. Then, you can [Contract Advent] from your Hand a "BLUE ROSE" next to this Spirit, or to any others besides this Spirit, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.
CB26-017.flavor: Its true name is Ryan Goldsmith. His NEXT power can increase the gravity within a certain range (around 30m radius).

CB26-018.name: GOLDEN RYAN ［2］
CB26-018.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Ryan"/"GOLDEN RYAN", (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost, and when destroys, discard three cards from the opposing decktop.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can [Contract Advent] from your Hand a "BLUE ROSE" next to this Spirit, or to any others besides this Spirit, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.
CB26-018.flavor: "My suit is perfectly gold, and your crime has been put completely on hold!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4299.name: Funambulist Mouse
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4299.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
For each Cost 2 Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +2000 BP.

[During Seal] [LV3]
Give all your Cost 2 Spirits the "Ten Crown" family.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4299.flavor: Hm, rather than fighting, racer Mouchuu... is it just my imagination, or is he relaxing?

CB13-021.name: GOOhN
CB13-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to an opposing effect, you can put it on the Removed Zone.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
If you control two or more "Marine" family Spirits, you can return an opposing Nexus to the deckbottom.
CB13-021.flavor: ZAFT's main aquatic MS. It has various armaments like the 7-barrel torpedo launchers and phonon maser cannon equipped on its forearms for underwater fights. It was deployed to attack the Archangel which was heading towards Alaska at the Red Sea and Indian Ocean.

CB25-030.name: GOUF Ignited［Heine Custom］
CB25-030.kanji: グフイグナイテッド[ハイネ専用機]
CB25-030.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "FAITH" family Brave card/Nexus card to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Target one opposing Spirit. Exhaust that Spirit, and until the next opposing Refresh Step, it can't refresh. If you control any "Zaku" Spirit, the "target one" written on this effect is changed to "target two".
CB25-030.flavor: The new mobile suit with heavy armaments developed by ZAFT after Zaku. And this is Heine's custom unit.

BS74-081.name: Fungus Attack
BS74-081.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When you would activate any "sending out 'Fungal Bed' " effects, you can return this card from your Trash to the Hand instead.

When using this card from the Hand, by destroying one of your "Fungal Bed", this card becomes Cost 4.

[Flash]
Exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates. For each target exhausted by this effect, you can banish a card from the opposing Trash. Then, you can return an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

CB29-080.name: GUND-ARM, Inc.
CB29-080.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Yellow Core])]
[During Set]
When you're summoning/deploying "School" family cards, fulfill one of its reduction symbols.

[Flash]
During this turn, your Life can't be reduced by opposing refreshed Spirits/Ultimates. Also, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Gundam", during this turn, every opposing Spirit/Ultimate can't attack.

CB02-011.name: Gabumon
CB02-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Add a "Champion"/"Ultimate" family Spirit card among them to the Hand. If you control any exactly-named "Agumon", reveal three cards instead. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] [Digivolve: Purple] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Purple "Champion" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB02-011.flavor:
[Rookie. Reptile Type. Data]
Partner Digimon of Yamato "Matt" Ishida. Although it is covered by a fur pelt, it is clearly a Reptile Digimon.

26RBS03-095.name: Furious Anger
26RBS03-095.kanji: フューリアスアンガー
26RBS03-095.effect:
[Flash]
If all your Spirits are Cost 2/4/6/8 with the "Topaz" family, target an opposing Spirit. During this step, it loses one of its symbols. (You choose the symbol)
26RBS03-095.flavor: I've heard that there's someone among the Wailwraiths who is capable of putting enemies to flight with nothing but her rage...

BS19-077.name: Fuscina-Arms
BS19-077.kanji: フェスキーナ・アームズ
BS19-077.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
