You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Sleeves" family card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to either the decktop or deckbottom only. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2][LV3]
Besides this Spirit, when your "Unicorn"-named or "Sleeves" family Spirits are destroyed by opposing effects, they can remain on the Field, exhausted.
CB13-007.flavor: A MS that belongs to the Garencieres team. It shielded the cornered Sinanju from attacks, and was shot down by Unicorn's beam magnum.

BS33-075.name: Fuurin Kazan
BS33-075.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
During this turn, unless they send one core from the attacking/blocking Spirit/Ultimate to the Void, they can't attack/block. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) was used to pay the cost, destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate.

BS18-057.name: Gearzelle
BS18-057.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can summon a Spirit card with two symbols from your Hand, without paying the cost. However, that Spirit can't activate any (When Summoned) effects.

[When Braved] (When Battles)
Exhaust an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.
BS18-057.flavor: The brave has called for and brought forth reinforcements! We'll defend this place to the last!

BSC48-020.name: Fuurin LT
BSC48-020.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
You can return a Magic card from your Trash to the Hand. Or, (Once per Turn: Same Name) you can summon up to three "Fuurin" from your Trash.

[LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By sending the [Soul Core] from this Spirit to your Trash, discard any number of "Fuurin" from your Hand/Removed Zone. For every two cards you discarded via this effect, during this turn, all your "Fuurin" gain an extra Yellow symbol.
BSC48-020.flavor: Flowering Yellow Province intended to decide the successor by lottery, but the Youkai made the winning ticket disappear as a prank.

PC05-005.name: Fuyutsuki Kozo
PC05-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, besides any “Fuyutsuki Kozo”, add a “NERV” family card, and an “Ikari Gendo”/“Ikari Yui” to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can summon/deploy an “EVANGELION”/“Spear”/“Ikari Gendo” from your Hand/Trash
PC05-005.flavor: The Deputy Commander of NERV. He understands Ikari Gendo well, and always stays by his side. He confronted the approaching WILLE which aimed to stop the First Impact.

BS12-055.name: Gecko-Glider
BS12-055.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
During this turn, the Spirit braved with this Brave can't be blocked.

[When Braved] [Heavy Armor: Purple/Yellow]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Yellow Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
BS12-055.flavor:
The paratroopers that were training on the snowy mountain are being dispatched to the Skyscraper to eradicate the guerrillas.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BSC49-067.name: Gecko-Glider LT
BSC49-067.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
During this turn, all your Brave Spirits can't be blocked.

[During Brave] [Heavy Armor: Purple/Yellow]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Yellow Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
BSC49-067.flavor:
The paratroopers that were training on the snowy mountain are being dispatched to the Skyscraper to eradicate the guerrillas.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

CB13-020.name: GINN
CB13-020.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to an opposing effect, you can put it on the Removed Zone.
CB13-020.flavor: ZAFT's main mass-production MS. It boasted high versatility, being capable of using a wide variety of weapons. A lot of variations of this unit also exists. It demonstrated its high specs at the dawn of the war despite being heavily outnumbered and showed its advantage over Earth Alliance's MA.

BS25-044.name: Gecko-Golem
BS25-044.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
This Spirit gains two White symbols.
BS25-044.flavor: Inputting data into P-Major... Sorry, I don't know how to work this. Euro-chaaan, Euro-chaaaan, take a look at this.

CB13-048.name: GN-X
CB13-048.effect:
You can put up to 29 copies of this card in your deck.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
While the opponent controls any originally Cost 2/3 "CB"/"Gundam Meister" family Spirit/Brave/Nexus, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects and has five Blue symbols.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can draw two cards. When you've done so, discard two cards from your Hand. Then, you can summon a "GN-X" Spirit card from your Hand.
CB13-048.flavor: Mobile Suits with Pseudo Solar Reactors with the purpose of bringing destruction to Celestial Being.

BS70-003.name: Gecko Geozard
BS70-003.kanji: ゲッコー・ジオザード
BS70-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your "Primordial" family Nexuses are destroyed by your effect, by destroying this Spirit, one of those Nexuses remains on the Field, in the same condition.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, draw a card.
BS70-003.flavor:
Following Gaia's retreat, the main forces of the Primordial Deities finally made their move. The one who led the army was Grandwalker Uranus, the chief of the Primordial Deities. He advanced with full confidence leading a large force of over a million from the center. He had also deployed forces of 600,000 troops in various parts of Olym. Olym was forced to disperse its forces.
―Theogonic Record Volume 3―

CB29-036.name: GN-X IV
CB29-036.effect:
While you have three counters or more, this card in Trash becomes Cost 5.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
Your counter +1. Then, you can return a "CB"/"Federation" family card from your Trash to the deckbottom. When you've done so, draw two cards, then discard two cards from your Hand.
CB29-036.flavor: The standard unit used by the Earth Sphere Federation. It is now undergoing mass-production to be used as the main unit. It has high versality, and can change its armament with respond to different missions.

BS70-CP02.name: Gekiha Wall
BS70-CP02.effect:
When this card is sent to the Trash from deck by the effect of your "Contractor Dan", you can add it to the Hand. When you've done so, +1 core to one of your Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Then, including being in Soul State, if you control "Contractor Dan", during this turn, your Life can only be reduced by one by opposing Cost 4 or more Spirits/Ultimates.

CB16-042.name: GN Archer
CB16-042.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit/Brave is destroyed by the opponent]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit.

[LV1][LV2]
When your "CB" family Spirit would activate [0Rebirth], the number of your counters is treated as zero.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, refresh an "Arios"-named Spirit you control.
CB16-042.flavor: An supporting unit developed to aid Arios Gundam. To take her revenge, Soma Peries boarded the unit.

CB02-046.name: Gekomon
CB02-046.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Neither player can use [Accel] from their Hand.

[LV2] [Warp Digivolve: Blue] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Blue "Ultimate" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB02-046.flavor:
[Champion. Amphibian. Virus]
An Amphibian Digimon that charms those around it with a pleasant voice that is hard to imagine by looking at its bizarre appearance.

CB13-054.name: GN Armor Type-D［Gundam Dynames］
CB13-054.kanji: GNアーマー TYPE-D [ガンダムデュナメス]
CB13-054.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks]
Destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less "Mothership" family Nexus. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
You can summon a Cost 5 or less "CB" family Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total Cost of 6.
CB13-054.flavor: The form equipped with GN Armor that focuses on ranged bombardments in view of anti-fleet combats. Despite sinking numerous vessels from the UN Force, it was ultimately destroyed in the battle with Saachez's Throne Zwei.

CB13-053.name: GN Armor Type-E［Gundam Exia］
CB13-053.kanji: GNアーマー TYPE-E [ガンダムエクシア]
CB13-053.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned/Advents) effect resolves]
By summoning this card without paying the cost, until your next End Step, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Ignoring the cost of Brave, destroy an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, by returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Cost 7 or less "CB" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
CB13-053.flavor: The form equipped with GN Armor which can also do close combats. It fought bravely against Alvatore.

CBX01-001.name: Gelgoog Menace ［General Use］
CBX01-001.kanji: ゲルググメナース［一般機］
CBX01-001.effect:
(Can't Stack) When your "Compass" family Spirit [Contract Advents], you can summon this card from the Hand without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing End Step)
If you have any "Compass" family Brave/Nexus/Mirage, you can +1 counter.

CBX01-002.kanji: ゲルググメナース［ルナマリア機］
CBX01-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void each to your Trash and another "Compass" family Spirit/Nexus you control.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By exhausting this Spirit, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

SD53-012.name: GN Arms Type-E
SD53-012.effect:
When your "Exia"-named Spirit is summoned, you can return this card from the Trash to your Hand. This effect can only be used once per turn.

One and only copy of this card/Brave can be braved to a Spirit that is braved to a "Pilot" family Brave you control, ignoring the amount of Braves on it.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, refresh a Blue Nexus you control.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4458.name: Gemini Smile
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4458.effect:
This card has "Galaxian" family.

[Flash]
Target an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. During this turn, that Spirit/Ultimate can't attack. Or, if you control any "Galaxian" family Grandwalker Nexus, during this battle, a "Galaxian" family Spirit you control can't be blocked.

CB16-048.name: GN Flag
CB16-048.effect:
Flash - [TopG: Cost 4 ([Blue Core][Blue Core])]
If you control no Spirits other than Braves, you can summon this card from the Hand as Cost 4 ([Blue Core][Blue Core]).

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, for each "Flag"-named card in your Trash, discard two cards from the opposing decktop (Max. 10).

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When the opponent would use a card from their Hand, if there are three or more "Flag"-named cards in your Trash, they can't use it unless they pay two extra costs.
CB16-048.flavor: This feeling is...without a doubt, love!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4460.name: Gemini Zodiarts
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4460.kanji: ジェミニ・ゾディアーツ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4460.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
If you control no other exactly-named "Gemini Zodiarts", you can summon an exactly-named "Gemini Zodiarts" from your Hand/Trash without paying the cost. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2] Flash - (When Attacks)
By destroying another "Gemini"-named Spirit you control, destroy an opposing Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4460.flavor: Yami Yuuki's transformed form when using the Gemini Zodiarts Switch. She can control high energy and use her doubles as bombs.

26RSD01-002.name: Gen-Bor
26RSD01-002.effect:
[LV2]True ReleaseDuring Attack
This Spirit gains +2000 BP.
26RSD01-002.flavor: The chance for a falling attack comes but once; miss it, and there will be no second. The target must be chosen with care...

26RBS02-X01.name: Gene-Rose
26RBS02-X01.effect:
[LV1-2] Start of Your Attack Step
Target one of your Red Spirits. During this turn, give it +3000 BP.

[LV2] True ReleaseYour Attack StepOnce Per Turn
When the opposing Life is reduced by your 10000 BP or more Spirit, you can reveal a card from your decktop. If that's a "Red Cloud" family Spirit card, add it to the Hand. Return any remaining card to the deckbottom.
26RBS02-X01.flavor: If anyone is to spot an intruder in the Realm of Red Clouds, Gene-Rose is the one for the job. After all, she is present throughout the entire sky.

BS28-009.name: General-Dragon
BS28-009.kanji: ジェネラル・ドラゴン
BS28-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy all opposing 3000 BP or less Spirits. If you have a Burst set, also, destroy an opposing Nexus.
BS28-009.flavor: Oh no, there isn't enough energy!? If this goes on, the Tri-Dragon Deities will...! Somebody, won't some other dragon help them!?

BS33-047.name: General Setodaishou
BS33-047.effect:
This Spirit card is also treated as a Magic card.

[Flash] (This effect can't be used while on the Field.)
During this battle, instead of comparing BP, compare levels instead. Destroy the Spirits/Ultimates with an equal or lower level.
BS33-047.flavor: After the Battle of Oukehazama, Kashaneko disappeared without a word to his vassals. Setodaishou covered for his absence and kept the Youkai Folk together.

BS32-CP02.name: General Transmigration
BS32-CP02.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is Destroyed by the Opponent]
Summon a "War Dragon" family Spirit card that was destroyed when this Burst activated from your Trash, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirit don't activate. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a "War Dragon" family Spirit you control +5000 BP.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4466.name: Generate Fire
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4466.kanji: ジェネレートファイア
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4466.effect:
Main- Destroy all opposing 3000 BP or less Spirits. After this effect resolves, you can summon a Spirit card from your Hand, treated as one cost being paid for each Spirit destroyed by this effect.

Flash- During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4467.name: Gengoron
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4467.flavor: We might lose one of the few precious watering places in the woods. The Elder looked unusually worried.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4468.name: Genin-Suzume
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4468.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed) The opponent exhausts two Spirits they control.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4468.flavor:
<tabber>
First Edition = The low-ranking ninja sparrows run about taking orders from their commanders. Seeing it reminds me of the times when I was just starting out.

26RCB01-060.name: Genm Corporation
26RCB01-060.kanji: 幻夢コーポレーション
26RCB01-060.effect:
[LV1-2] When Deployed
You can show up to two "EX-AID" family cards from your Hand to the opponent. Return them to the deckbottom in any order. For each card returned, draw a card.

[LV2] True ReleaseYour End Step
You can target one of your "EX-AID" family Spirits. Refresh it.
26RCB01-060.flavor: A game company that Masamune Dan built from scratch to become the market leader in Japan. Masamune's primary goal was to complete the ultimate game, "Kamen Rider Chronicle", and roll it out globally.

BSC44-014.name: Gerbera Field
BSC44-014.effect:
[Type: Flower] <sub>(While on the Field, the following effect remains active)</sub>
█ Your "BP- effects" decrease 2000 further.

[Flash]
Return an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom. If you have six counters or more, and control any "Contractor Aphrodite", return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom instead. Then, put this card onto your Field.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4471.name: Gerenuuk
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4471.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Cards can't be discarded from either deck.

[LV2] (Opposing Turn) All your exhausted Spirits gain +2000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4471.flavor: It's a little late, but I wonder what the girls that accompany me are constantly writing memos about. Whenever they see something strange, they write something down.

BS18-031.name: Geronimond
BS18-031.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Cards can't be discarded from either player's deck.

[LV1][LV2] [Heavy Armor: Red/White]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2]
Give all your non-braved Spirits: [Heavy Armor: Red/White].
BS18-031.flavor: The war cry filled with grief stopped both waves and flames.

CB13-075.name: Getting Payback
CB13-075.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit. If there are three or more "MS"/"Pilot" family cards in your Trash, this effect can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Armor]. Or, if you control a "Banagher"-named Brave, target an opposing Spirit. When this battle ends, if that Spirit is still on the Field, end the Attack Step.

BS22-026.name: Ghost-Mantis
BS22-026.kanji: ゴースト・マンティス
BS22-026.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, exhaust any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of Cost 8.
[Rush: Yellow]
(While you have a Yellow symbol, the following effect activates next.)
[Yellow Core]: When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.
BS22-026.flavor: Latent power can awaken on the verge of death, but I didn't possibly expect for it to show its real power after it died.

BS36-035.name: Giant-Panguard
BS36-035.kanji: ジャイアント・パンガード
BS36-035.flavor: Warm applause and shouts from the audience go out to all the racers who made the goal line! It was a wonderful race. I, Harold, would again like to salute the racers who protected Monaca and finished the race! Congratulations on staying till the end!

BS41-095.name: Giant Tidal Wave
BS41-095.kanji: ジャイアントタイダルウェーブ
BS41-095.effect:
[Flash]
Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total of Cost 6. When this effect destroys any Spirit/Ultimate, during this battle, the opponent can't activate their Burst.

CB22-053.name: Giants of Darkness' Gathering Place
CB22-053.kanji: 闇の巨人の集まる場所
CB22-053.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Purple Core])]
[During Set]
When cards are being banished from your deck, you can add a "Thor"-named card and an "Infernal Lord" & "Fighting Spirit" family card among them to your Hand, instead of banishing them.

[LV1]
When cards are banished from your deck, for each card banished, you can send a core from a single opposing Cost 4 or less Grandwalker Nexus to the Void.
CB22-053.flavor: The mysterious space that Carmeara, Darrgon and Hudram gathered.

BSC44-011.name: Gibeon-Golem
BSC44-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
By heavy exhausting this refreshed Spirit, deploy a "Hephaestus" Grandwalker Nexus card from your Trash.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Artificial Soldier" family Spirit attacks, you can reveal a card from the opposing decktop. Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a cost equal or inferior to that card's. Return the revealed card to either the decktop or deckbottom.
BSC44-011.flavor:
Hmm, couldn't really see Dite these days.
―Grandwalker Hephaestus―

CB24-040.name: Giff
CB24-040.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Purple Core][Purple Core])]
[During Set]
(Once per turn: Same Name) When your Purple-only Cost 5 or more “Enemy” family Spirit is summoned, you can draw a card. When you've done so, send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with four cores or more on it, and when destroys, you can summon a Cost 5 or less “Enemy” family Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.
CB24-040.flavor: Absorbing numerous Deadmans and humans, the original form of Giff revived.

BS69-081.name: Gifted Spear
BS69-081.effect:
(Once per Game: Same Name) When your Purple pre-Rebirth Spirit is reborn, you can return this card from your Trash to the Hand.

[Flash]
During this turn, treat one of your Purple Spirits as [During Brave], and give it +5000 BP. Or, (Once per Turn: Same Name) if you control any "Dragonic-Arthur", and it is the Attack Step, you can immediately use the Flash effect of a "Seize Glory" from your Trash, without paying the cost.

PB08-013.name: Giga Battle Nizer
PB08-013.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks)
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve, and when depletes, draw a card.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Skill: 3] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name, send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) Summon a "Kaiju"/"Seijin"/"Zetton" from your Trash, without paying the cost.
PB08-013.flavor: The Battle Nizer given to Ultraman Belial by the Rayblood Seijin.

CB28-002.name: Gigan Miles
CB28-002.effect:
You can put any number of copies of this card in deck.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Turn)
The number of cores on this Spirit can't be brought to less than one by you. Also, for each "Gigan" you control, this Spirit gains +2000 BP.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Gigan Rex" to the Hand, and you can summon a "Gigan Miles". Discard any remaining cards.
CB28-002.flavor: The group of Gigans that suddenly invaded Earth with Gigan Rex in the lead.

CB28-017.name: Gigan Rex
CB28-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Besides "Gigan Rex", you can summon an "Astral Dragon"/"Machine Beast" family Spirit card, or up to three "Gigan Miles" from your Hand/Trash.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Astral Dragon"/"Machine Beast" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't end Attack Step via effects.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
By destroying six "Gigan Miles" you control, send up to two opposing Lives to the Reserve.
CB28-017.flavor: The red Gigan who led an army of Gigan Miles and attacked Earth. By using the cores of multiple Gigan Miles, it can release powerful laser.

26RDB01-063.name: Gigan Song
26RDB01-063.effect:
Legacy
[team: Blue Beat]

[Flash]
If all your Spirits/Nexuses have [Blue Beat], target an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit. Destroy it. When used using Legacy, the targeting cost becomes 6 or less instead.

BS68-058.name: Gigant Hammer
BS68-058.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate's (When Summoned/Advents) effect resolves]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, return opposing LV1/LV3/LV5 Spirits/Ultimates, one of each, to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] [Ultra Holy Life] (When Attacks)
When blocked, draw a card from the deckbottom; when not blocked, put a core from the Void to your Life.
BS68-058.flavor:
You mean where do I come from? Sorry but I can't tell you that.
―Grandwalker Kinich-Ahau―

SD28-001.name: Gigantea-Kamikiri
SD28-001.kanji: ギガンティア・カミキリー
SD28-001.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.
SD28-001.flavor: Seems that only Antarc and I fell from the Darkness Hole. Sorry Antarc, I got you caught up because I tripped and pushed... we were still falling while I thought that.

CB25-063.name: Gigi Andalucia
CB25-063.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Green Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Flash" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't move cores from their Nexuses.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
Once per turn, besides [Soul Core], by sending a core from your "Flash" family Spirit to the Void, draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Turn)
While you control "Hathaway"/"Kenneth", the opponent can't activate Burst effects.
CB25-063.flavor: A beautiful young maiden who greatly sways the destinies of Hathaway and Kenneth.

CB16-073.name: Gilbert Durandal
CB16-073.kanji: ギルバート・デュランダル
CB16-073.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (White & "Impulse"/"Core Splendor"/"Zaku", FAITH) (FAITH & Brave)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit/Brave, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Grand Field] [LV1][LV2] (End of Your Attack Step)
By sending three cores from this Nexus to the Void, after this step ends, an extra Core Step or Draw Step or Refresh Step occurs, once and only once.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
Every opposing Spirit is treated as LV1, and every opposing Ultimate is treated as LV3. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

BS16-031.name: Gilles-de-Rais
BS16-031.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Red/Blue (Opposing Turn)
When the opponent uses a Red/Blue Magic effect, by exhausting this Spirit, negate that effect.

[LV2] (When Blocks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, refresh this Spirit.
BS16-031.flavor: If you have to say that, let bygones be bygones. But why are these guys keep looking down at us?

26RBS01-011.name: Gino-Ankh
26RBS01-011.effect:
[LV1-2]When Summoned
Target an opposing Nexus. Destroy it
26RBS01-011.flavor: To solve this Spirit's riddle requires both considerable knowledge and nerve.

BS58-052.name: Giotto-Golem
BS58-052.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" & "Artificial Soldier" family Spirits would leave the Field by opposing effects, discard a card from the opposing decktop, and if a Spirit card is discarded, they remain on the Field in the same state. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2] (When Blocks)
Put a core from the Void to any Nexus you control.
BS58-052.flavor:
Grandwalker Chronos knew the ways to travel between the past and the future. Hence, he had already set things up to crush the routes. Yes, not just the kins, but even Tower itself had already been taken in by Chronos.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 7:23―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4492.name: Giraffer
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4492.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed) Your opponent exhaust a Spirit they control.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4492.flavor:
Preceded in death by his wife during his last years, Manaka retired to Wind Shield. While being the least bonded with among all lands, the denizens were very kind to outsiders. Surrounded by gentle spirits, he gracefully passed on.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Imperial Year 21—

CB16-076.name: Give Me More
CB16-076.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your Purple-only effect, you can add it to the Hand.

[Flash]
Discard three cards from your decktop, and for each "Tekkadan" family card discarded, send one core from the opposing Field to the Reserve. Also, by sending one core from your exactly-named "Orga Itsuka" to the Void, this effect can't be prevented by "Armor"-named effects.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4494.name: Glaakie
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4494.flavor: This has become a dangerous situation. Southern Land soldiers are withdrawing from the Middle Kingdom Army. Could this cause a rupture in the alliance?!

BS14-105.name: Glacial Slash
BS14-105.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Return an opposing Spirit to the decktop. Then by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Refresh all your Spirits. During this turn, your Spirits refreshed via this effect can't attack.

BS18-049.name: Gladdy-Squalo
BS18-049.kanji: グラッディ・スクアーロ
BS18-049.flavor: Along with Zeyon, many denizens of Ocean Shield were labeled as enemies of the state.

BS36-002.name: Gladiator Dragon
BS36-002.kanji: グラディエータードラゴン
BS36-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal five cards from the your decktop. Add a "The FiveGoodDragonEmperors"-named Spirit card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.
BS36-002.flavor: The city course has set up something to spice up the race. As such, you can see how carefully the racers are running in the opening stretch!

BS70-087.name: Gladiolus Field
BS70-087.kanji: グラジオラスフィールド
BS70-087.effect:
[Type: Flower] Flash - (While on the Field, you can activate it)
█ You can send three cores from your "Aphrodite" Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void. When you've done so, during this turn, give one of your Spirits +5000 BP.

[Flash]
During this battle, when opposing Spirits/Ultimates would leave the Field, (Once per Turn: Same Name) put a core from the Void to your Life. Then, put this card onto your Field.

SD22-007.name: Gladitiger
SD22-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All Spirits/Ultimates with [High Speed] you control get +3000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void each to two Spirits/Ultimates with [High Speed] you control.
SD22-007.flavor:
Even wingless ones have at last come in the ranks of the invaders.
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, 670 Days Remaining—

26RSD10-005.name: Glan-Silus
26RSD10-005.effect:
[LV2]When Attacks
You can target an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit. Exhaust it.
26RSD10-005.flavor: Even if you spot something long and slender by the water's edge, it's best not to touch it or step on it. Doing so will only attract the big mouth that lies beyond.

SD01-022.name: Glasscargot
SD01-022.flavor:
I had to face another tragedy here. The one who tried to circulate a warning by clinging to the dragon's body noticed a greater danger, but he never returned.
-from the 7th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

SD38-004.name: Glasswallow
SD38-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
The opponent exhaust one of their Spirits.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
SD38-004.flavor:
A long time ago, before all ages, the world was split into six. In the flow of history, it was only comparatively recently that the world became one.
-from the introduction of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BS11-013.name: Glasyahound
BS11-013.effect:
[Immortality: Cost 5/6] (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this Spirit card from the Trash when your Cost 5/6 Spirit is destroyed.

[LV1][LV2]
Give every Spirit card with [Immortality] in your Trash a [Purple Core] reduction symbol.
BS11-013.flavor:
Whoever determined that dogs are the definition of loyalty? I already understood this Spirit's instincts as soon as I laid eyes on it; the only thing this creature is loyal to is its own desires. Of course, it's most likely impossible to classify this Spirit as a dog...
—from the Canes Venatici chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BSC49-013.name: Glasyahound LT
BSC49-013.effect:
[Immortality: Cost 2/4/6] (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this card from the Trash when your Cost 2/4/6 Spirit is destroyed.

[LV1][LV2]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When summoning cards via your "Immortality"-named effects, you can summon it, without paying the cost.
BSC49-013.flavor:
Whoever determined that dogs are the definition of loyalty? I already understood this Spirit's instincts as soon as I laid eyes on it; the only thing this creature is loyal to is its own desires. Of course, it's most likely impossible to classify this Spirit as a dog...
—from the Canes Venatici chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

26RBS03-074.name: Glazboil
26RBS03-074.flavor: It is a spirit that hunts its prey by sensing vibrations in the ground. If you don't want to be eaten, your only option is to stay completely still and wait for it to pass.

26RBS01-007.name: Glitail
26RBS01-007.effect:
[LV1-2]When Destroyed
Target an opposing Spirit with the same BP as this Spirit. Destroy it.

[LV2] [Clash]During Attack
Opposing Spirits must block if possible.
26RBS01-007.flavor: He charges again and again with astonishing boldness. Perhaps it's because he got a worthy rival close to him.

PB18-U06.name: Glitter Tiga
PB18-U06.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Blue & Cost 6 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

This card/Spirit is also treated as being exactly-named "Ultraman".

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When the opponent would use card from their Hand, unless they send two cores from their Reserve to the Trash, they can't use it. While this Spirit is [During Advent], this effect sends +2 cores to Trash.
PB18-U06.flavor:
Revived by the light of humans and glittering in gold, the strongest form of Tiga.
―Ultraman Tiga―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4508.name: Glitter Tiga ［2］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4508.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as “Ultraman”-named.

Flash - [Change: Cost 6 ([Blue Core][Blue Core][Red Core][Red Core])]
Destroy an opposing Cost 3/6/9 Spirit. After this effect resolves, either discard this card, or replace a Red-Blue dual color “Ultraman”-named, or a Cost 6 or less "Tiga"-named Spirit you control with this card in refreshed state.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4508.flavor: While being petrified by the Evil God Gatanothor, it revived in this miraculous form thanks to people's light.

CB22-009.name: Glitter Trigger Eternity
CB22-009.kanji: グリッタートリガーエタニティ
CB22-009.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Red-Blue dual color & "Ultraman" & Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

This card/Spirit is also treated as "Ultraman"/"Multi"/"Power"/"Sky"-named.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Destroy two opposing Nexuses, and for each Nexus destroyed, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When the opponent would use Magic cards/[Accel], unless they pay two extra costs, they can't use it.
CB22-009.flavor: The miraculous form of Ultraman Trigger obtained after absorbing the lights from the fragment of the Eternity Core.

CB18-062.name: Glitter Zeperion Ray
CB18-062.kanji: グリッターゼペリオン光線
CB18-062.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit with (When Summoned) effects. Also, if your "Glitter Tiga"-named Spirit is attacking, during this turn, that Spirit can't be blocked.

BS37-047.name: Glorious-Sheep -Android Mode-
BS37-047.kanji: グロリアス・シープ -機人モード-
BS37-047.effect:
When your "Glorious-Sheep"-named Spirit would be destroyed/returned to the Hand/Deck due to the opponent, you can summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block while exhausted and, if possible, every opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit must attack this Spirit.
BS37-047.flavor: It can instantly respond with a zone-adapted form when thrown into a predicament!?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4512.name: Glorious Shield
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4512.effect:
[Type: Song]

This card in Trash is unaffected by any effect.

[Flash]
During this turn, when your Life would be reduced by the opponent, you can banish six cards from your decktop. If all of those cards are Yellow-only, your Life won't be reduced. Then, you can put this card on your Field.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4512.flavor: This is the wall around my heart. Loria's heart is made of glass, so use this to protect her, ok?

BS66-008.name: Glow & Heat Riser
BS66-008.kanji: グロウ＆ヒートライザー
BS66-008.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Heat Contract & C1 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Advents)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. Add a Red Brave card among them to the Hand. Also, when this Spirit is [advented], add a "Scarlet Flame" family card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. While braved to "ContractSword", this effect draws +1 card.

BS62-071.name: Gluttonic Core
BS62-071.effect:
When this card was either revealed from deck, or sent to the Trash from deck by your "Dark Snake" family effect, you can add it to your Hand. When added from the Trash to Hand via this effect, +1 core to one of your Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Flash]
Treat this card as colorless, and send a core from the opposing Field to the Reserve. Then, if the [Soul Core] is in your Counter Area, by sending two cores from one of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Kukulkan" to the Void, return this card to the Hand.

LM18-G06.name: Godzilla (2016) Fourth Form
LM18-G06.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as being exactly-named "Shin-Godzilla (Fourth Form)".

Flash- [Change: Cost 7 ([Red Core][Red Core][Red Core][Red Core])]
Destroy an opposing 30000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace one of your Cost 6 or more "Godzilla" Spirit with this card in refreshed condition.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By discarding a card from your Hand, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.
LM18-G06.flavor:
It intercepts the flying vehicles that approach it with the radioactive rays released from its dorsal fin.
―Shin Godzilla(2016)―

26RBS02-072.name: Gnutarius
26RBS02-072.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2] When Summoned
For each EX Symbol banished via this Legacy, you can target one of your Nexuses. Put one core from the Void to each of them.

[LV2]During Attack
For each Nexus you control, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
26RBS02-072.flavor: It was ready to charge at a moment's notice, no matter when or where the enemy appeared.

PB02-G02.name: Godzilla (2016) Second Form
PB02-G02.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as being exactly-named "Shin-Godzilla (Second Form)."

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add an exactly-named "The God Incarnate Godzilla", and a Red "Godzilla" Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning/deploying a "Godzilla" Spirit card/Grandwalker Nexus card, this Spirit gains two extra Red symbols.
PB02-G02.flavor:
A form which has started to adapt to walking on land. The fluid dripping from its gills not only releases a putrid stench, it also contains radioactive substances.
―Shin Godzilla (2016)―

CB21-060.name: Go! Shinji-kun
CB21-060.effect:
[Flash]
Summon a "Unit-01"-named Spirit card from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost. Or, flip a pre-Rebirth "Unit-01"-named Spirit you control.

LM18-G02.name: Godzilla (vs King Ghidorah)
LM18-G02.kanji: ゴジラ（対キングギドラ）
LM18-G02.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. Also, if you control another "Godzilla"/"Ghidorah"-named Spirit, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2]
All your "Godzilla"/"Ghidorah"-named Spirits can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.
LM18-G02.flavor:
Godzilla and Anguirus, earthling Kaijus, make a stand against the Spatial Kaijus Gigan and King Ghidorah, called by the M Space Hunter Nebula Aliens.
-Godzilla vs. Gigan (1972)-

BS52-X09.name: God Break
BS52-X09.effect:
[Type: Field] <sub>(While on the Field, the following effects are active)</sub>
█ The symbols of either player's Grandwalker Nexuses are fixed as zero.
█ Neither player's deck can be discarded by non-"Primal" family Spirit/Ultimate effects.

[Flash]
Draw a card. Also, destroy an opposing non-"Primal" family Grandwalker Nexus. This effect can't be prevented by [Grandphosis]. Then, put this card onto your Field.

CB04-018.name: Go-Badaa-Ba
CB04-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit with two cores or less on it. Also, while [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, this Spirit gains +5000 BP.
CB04-018.flavor: A Gurongi grasshopper kaijin belonging to the Go group. He calls himself Ktokugin-Sagizaza, which means "frightening Rider" in the Gurongi language.

LM18-G01.name: Godzilla (vs Mothra)
LM18-G01.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Green.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Godzilla"/"Mothra" Spirit attacks, you can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
LM18-G01.flavor:
Godzilla, who attacked Nagoya, defeated Imago Mothra, but is defeated by the twins Mothra larvae that hatch thanks to the Shobijin's prayers.
-Mothra V.S. Godzilla (1964)

BS05-073.name: God Speed
BS05-073.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, the cost of every Cost 6 or more Spirit card with [High Speed] in your Hand becomes 4. This effect can't be used during Main Step.

CB04-022.name: Go-Gadoru-Ba
CB04-022.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Unless the opponent discards a card from their Hand, they can't block.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
You can summon an exactly-named "N-Daguva-Zeba" from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Send all cores from an opposing Spirit to their Reserve.
CB04-022.flavor: A Gurongi kabuto kaijin belonging to the Go group. The strongest warrior of the Go group, he can change his body into some different combat forms to fit the situation.

LM18-G05.name: Godzilla (✕ MechaGodzilla)
LM18-G05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a "Godzilla"/"Type-3 Kiryu" Spirit card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. When this effect adds any Spirit card to the Hand, discard an opposing Burst.

[LV2][LV3]
All your "Godzilla"/"Type-3 Kiryu" Spirits are unaffected by opposing Spirit/Ultimate effects.
LM18-G05.flavor: Type-3 Kiryu Kai causes a blackout on the entire Kantou territory to gain energy and face Godzilla for the decisive battle.

CB30-066.name: Goddess of Genesis
CB30-066.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced, you can summon a "Kamen" & "Imp" family Spirit card with a cost equal or inferior to your number of counters from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
You can summon one of your "Geats" Contract cards from Soul State/pre-advent condition by paying two costs. When you've done so, discard an opposing Burst.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4528.name: Go-Jaraji-Da
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4528.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Put a random card from the opposing Hand face-up onto their Removed Zone. When this effect puts a Cost 4 or less card, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing End Step)
Target a card on the opposing Removed Zone. You can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a cost equal or inferior to that card's.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4528.flavor: A Grongi hedgehog phantom which belongs to the Go group. The goal of his Gegeru is to murder 90 Midorikawa High School sophomores within 12 days.

CB28-006.name: Godzilla Amphibia 〈S.P〉
CB28-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can reveal two cards from your decktop. Add either a "Godzilla", or every "S.P" among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit. Then, by returning this Spirit to the deckbottom, summon a "Godzilla Terrestris" from your Hand, without paying the cost.
CB28-006.flavor: Chasing after a swarm of Manda, 1st form of Godzilla which appears amid red dust. It released gas-like substance from its mouth, and caused great explosion.

BS14-045.name: Goristal
BS14-045.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, destroy this Spirit.

[LV3] (When Destroyed)
Draw a card.
BS14-045.flavor: On the road, there were people betting on fights. The people of this country are fancy, but greedy as well.

CB28-001.name: Godzilla Aquatilis 〈S.P〉
CB28-001.kanji: ゴジラアクアティリス〈S.P〉
CB28-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Add either a Cost 3 or more "Godzilla", or every Cost 3 or more "S.P" among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. Then, by returning this Spirit to the deckbottom, summon a "Godzilla Amphibia" from your Hand, without paying the cost.
CB28-001.flavor: Having a face like crocodile, the 0th form of Godzilla. It appeared in the Tokyo Bay, chasing after a swarm of Manda.

BS21-055.name: Gornic-Eagle
BS21-055.kanji: ゴルニック・イーグル
BS21-055.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.

[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP.
BS21-055.flavor: Gornic-Eagle's wind-cutting feathers were forged in the Country of Vermillion from a thousand swords.

CB28-XX01.name: Godzilla Earth
CB28-XX01.effect:
Besides via "Godzilla Filius", this card can't be summoned via effects. Also, when summoning this card, if you or the opponent controls any "Godzilla"/"Ghidorah", it gets -2 cost for each counter you have.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
This Spirit can't have its cores moved, or be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy every opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's, and when destroys, send three opposing Lives to the Reserve.

CB25-076.name: Goddess of Victory
CB25-076.effect:
While your “Flash” family Spirit is attacking, when the opponent uses a Flash effect of a card from Hand, before that effect activates, if you control “Hathaway”/“Kenneth”, and “Gigi” Nexus/Mirage, by paying the cost and discarding this card from your Hand, immediately negate that effect.

[Main]
Reveal five cards from your decktop. Among them, summon/deploy “Hathaway”/“Kenneth”/“Gigi”, one of each, without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4535.name: Gorongoro
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4535.effect: [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step) All your "Shellman"/"Blade Insect" family Spirits/Ultimates gain +3000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4535.flavor: Now I know why the butterfly flew away from the pillar. It's not a pillar, it's a sword. A giant one at that. Isn't this the sword that holds up the world that we heard about in town!? I thought it was a legend, but it was a true story!?

CB28-019.name: Godzilla Filius
CB28-019.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1, and put a core from the Void each to this Spirit and another "Godzilla" Spirit you control.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit's attack ends, or when this Spirit is destroyed by an opposing effect, you can summon a "Godzilla Earth" from your Hand, and -10 for its cost.
CB28-019.flavor: A mini-size Godzilla derived from Godzilla Earth after cell division.

BS35-048.name: GoGo Ghost
BS35-048.flavor: BSGP's opening battle already has had up to ninth place decided. As point awarding occurs, which racer will become tenth place? Oh, that blazing mane is Racer Blazoma! And now, gooooaaaal! But, wait, there's someone holding onto the horn, isn't there? Whoa, it's Racer Rickey-Mouchuu!! Tenth place was the Rat God-King, Rickey-Mouchuu!

BS44-005.name: Godseeker-Alpharegion
BS44-005.kanji: ゴッドシーカー・アルファレジオン
BS44-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add an exactly-named "Grandwalker Apollon" and a Red "Worldswalker"/"Avatar" family Spirit card to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV1][LV2]
Besides via Burst effects, neither player can summon Spirit cards/Brave cards without paying the cost.
BS44-005.flavor: Apollon has many star dragons as followers. He loves to mobilize the dragons and go conquer the sea of stars, but once warring, he stands on the frontlines as commander and takes down more foes than anyone else.

CB06-031.name: Goat Orphnoch
CB06-031.effect:
When your "Faiz"/"Kaixa"/"Delta"-named Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, you can pay two costs to summon this card from the Hand. When you've done so, all your destroyed Spirits remain on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Spirits with three or less cores on them.
CB06-031.flavor: An Orphnoch with goat traits. Smartbrain Inc's ex-CEO's Hanagata transforms into it. He specializes in a fighting style which uses extraordinary explosiveness.

CB30-074.name: Gotchardriver
CB30-074.kanji: ガッチャードライバー
CB30-074.effect:
When this card was revealed from deck by your "Gotchard"/"Majade"/"Chemy"/"Alchemist Academy" effect, you can add it to the Hand.

[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Blue Core])]
[During Set]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Gotchard" [Contract Advents], you can separate all Braves from that Spirit. When you've done so, you can summon any number of "Chemy" from your Hand to directly brave to that Spirit, paying one cost each.

[Main]
Return differently-named "Chemy", one of each, from your Trash to the Hand. (Max. 3) Then, if you don't have a Mirage set, you can set this card.

BS44-018.name: Godseeker-Hajarcobra
BS44-018.kanji: ゴッドシーカー・ハジャルコブラ
BS44-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
You can reveal 3 cards from your decktop. Among these cards, add an exactly-named "Grandwalker Osiris" and a Purple "Worldswalker"/"Avatar" family Spirit card to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV1][LV2]
Besides via Burst effects, neither player can summon Spirit cards/Brave cards without paying the cost.
BS44-018.flavor: Osiris is the King of Kings in Egyt. He is imposing and dignified. He controls and manipulates everything from the Netherworld. Egyt is prosper today because of Osiris' leadership.

CB07-011.name: Goblimon
CB07-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing exhausted Cost 4 or less Spirit.

[LV2] [Digivolve: Purple] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Purple "Champion" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB07-011.flavor:
[Rookie. Ogre. Virus]
A Digimon that loves evildoings and takes the shape of a troublesome goblin. Cowardly yet clever, it never acts alone, always forming packs and hiding within the shadows of trees or buildings to attack. Its finisher move, Goblistrike, consists of throwing a fireball at Mach 1 on the opponent.

BS29-013.name: Gothic-Grave
BS29-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw two cards.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
By discarding two Purple cards from your Hand, this Spirit remains on the Field, refreshed.
BS29-013.flavor: It's called "Braving"? This is the first time I've seen it! Even if the world is destroyed, at least this should remain.

CB28-010.name: Godzilla Junior［2］
CB28-010.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Godzilla" & C2 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit. When you've done so, if you have five counters or less, your counter +1.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Increase the limit of this Spirit's "BP destruction effect" by +10000. Also, once per turn, when opposing Spirits are destroyed, draw two cards.

CB02-027.name: Gotsumon
CB02-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Add a White "Champion"/"Ultimate" family Spirit card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] [Digivolve: White] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a White "Champion" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB02-027.flavor:
[Rookie. Ore. Data]
An Ore Digimon that is clad in ore data from the fields that has high defenses.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4546.name: Godseeker-Jagua-Barba
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4546.kanji: ゴッドシーカー・ジャガ・バルバ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4546.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add an exactly-named "Grandwalker Hermes", and a Green "Worldswalker"/"Avatar" family Spirit card to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2]
Besides via Burst effects, neither player can summon Spirit cards/Brave cards without paying the cost.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4546.flavor: Hermes is Olym's fastest and the Supreme Deity Zeus' messenger. In one single dash he goes from the divine world to any other place. He commands the Seven Great Hero Beasts, and today as well heads to different worlds with them.

CB28-011.name: Godzilla Terrestris 〈S.P〉
CB28-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Your counters +2, and destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw two cards. Then, by returning this Spirit to the deckbottom, summon a "Godzilla Ultima" from your Hand, without paying the cost.

CB04-001.name: Gouram
CB04-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return a "Kamen" family Spirit card/Ultimate card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Kuuga"-named Spirits/Ultimates gain +3000 BP.
CB04-001.flavor: A kuwagata-shaped mecha created by an ancient civilization that supports Kamen Rider Kuuga.

BS44-040.name: Godseeker-Negasbok
BS44-040.kanji: ゴッドシーカー・ネガズボック
BS44-040.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
You can reveal six cards from your decktop. Among these cards, add an exactly-named "Grandwalker Artemis" and a White "Worldswalker"/"Avatar" family Spirit card to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV1][LV2]
Besides via Burst effects, neither player can summon Spirit cards/Brave cards without paying the cost.
BS44-040.flavor: The Machine Beast Goddess Artemis is Apollon's Twin. While Apollon prefers shooting one powerful arrow, Artemis prefers shooting streams of arrows.

BS61-036.name: Godseeker ArmoredPriest Upatl
BS61-036.kanji: ゴッドシーカー 鎧装神官ウパトル
BS61-036.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Put a “Grandwalker Tezcatlipoca”, and a non-“Godseeker” “Armored Beast” family card from among them to your Removed Zone. Return the remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2] Flash -
Once per turn, you can swap a card from Hand with an “Armored Beast” family card on your Removed Zone.
BS61-036.flavor: Tezcatlipoca is a Grandwalker that appears in Lecoulis. He takes cactus fields and obsidian forests as his territory. Leading an army of Armored Beast, he stands in the way of Dan.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4551.name: Godseeker Aura Quartz Golem
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4551.kanji: ゴッドシーカー アクアオーラ・ゴーレム
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4551.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add an exactly-named "Grandwalker Hephaestus", and a Blue "Celeste"/"Avatar" family card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] (Your Turn)
Add any amount of Blue-only Saga Brave cards revealed by your effects to the Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4551.flavor: The one who manufactures all the weapons and armors of the Olymian Grandwalkers is the blacksmith god, Hephaestus. He may look hideous, but the equipment he creates is unimaginably beautiful.

CB28-X01.name: Godzilla Ultima 〈S.P〉
CB28-X01.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When opposing Spirits are destroyed via your "Godzilla" effects, or your "Godzilla" are depleted/destroyed by opposing effects, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit with the highest BP. By banishing a "Godzilla" from your Hand/Trash, Spirits/Braves can't remain on the Field via this effect.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) Unless the opponent sends two cores from their Life to to the Reserve, they can't use Cost 4 or less Magic cards.
CB28-X01.flavor: The third form of Godzilla evolved from Godzilla Terrestris. It can release a number of light rings from its mouth, and launch atomic beam by compressing the rings.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4553.name: Godseeker BreatherSoundBeast Chinchillast
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4553.kanji: ゴッドシーカー 休音獣チンチラスト
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4553.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add an exactly-named "Grandwalker Saraswati", and a Green "Celeste"/"Avatar"/"Saga" family card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2] (Your Turn)
Add a "Brahma"-named card revealed from the deck by your Green effect to the Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4553.flavor: Sarasvati is the goddess of music and science. She is surrounded exclusively by animals and may seem to only be playing music, but she actually was also involved in the development of the Armored Dragons.

BSC26-003.name: Godzilla［1954］
BSC26-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Green.
BSC26-003.flavor:
The first Godzilla who attacked Japan. It's hypothesized that he surfaced because hydrogen bomb experimentation took away his safe territory.
―Godzilla (1954)―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4555.name: Godseeker CatGoddess Bastet
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4555.kanji: ゴッドシーカー 猫女神バステト
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4555.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add an exactly-named "Grandwalker Ra", a Yellow "Worldswalker"/"Avatar" family Spirit card, and a Yellow "Worldswalker" family Brave card to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Imaginary Beast" family Spirit is summoned, send a core from any opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4555.flavor: Egyt's God of the Sun as well as its Supreme Deity. Pushing forward industrialization and mass production lines, he cheers for the domination of the Divine World.

CB34-058.name: Gouram ［2］
CB34-058.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
(Can't Stack) When you used [Chou Henshin], if [Soul Core] was used to pay for the cost, you can draw a card.

[LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) You can send up to two cores, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to "Kuuga"/ "TryChaser". When cores are sent to "TryChaser" via this effect, you can use the [Chou Henshin] of a "Kuuga" from your Hand, without paying the cost.
CB34-058.flavor: The "horse armor" taking a form of beetle that is the result of the advanced technology of the Rinto, a super ancient peaceful tribe. It can freely change into various forms, and attach itself to Kuuga's vehicle, becoming its armor.

BSC26-004.name: Godzilla［1965］
BSC26-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Green.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.
BSC26-004.flavor:
Fought together with Radon against King Ghidorah, sent by the Xiliens. A humorous Godzilla not seen in other works.
―Great Kaiju War (1965)―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4558.name: Gozdemon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4558.effect:
☼<nowiki>[ </nowiki>Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed by the opponent<nowiki>]</nowiki>
By returning a "Ogre Wizard" family Spirit card from your Trash to your Hand, summon this Spirit card.

[LV2] Curse (When Attacks) At the end of battle, destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked this Spirit when the battle resolved.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4558.flavor:
Due to the first Emperor Kei's early death, Kunimi took the throne and became the second emperor. The Emperor is far too young for this Empire that is far from achieving stability. It's inevitable that there will be rebellion.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Kunimi, Imperial Year 12—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4559.name: Godseeker CleverMachineMiko Sarume
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4559.kanji: ゴッドシーカー 機巧巫女サルメ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4559.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add an exactly-named "Grandwalker Amaterasu" and a Red/White "Celeste"/"Avatar" family card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
This Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4559.flavor: IT is said that while hidden, Amaterasu writes a record of everything that has happened, not only in Amahara, but in all of the Divine World.

26RBS01-048.name: Goztaurus
26RBS01-048.effect:
[LV1-2] During Attack/Block
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, if you control any "Meztaurus", you can draw a card.

Pay one cost ▶ For each "Leucomyst" family Spirit you control, during this battle, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
26RBS01-048.flavor: I suppose he and his partner will continue to serve as guardians of the realm.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4561.name: Godzilla［1971］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4561.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return a Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand. Also, if [Soul Core] is on your Green Spirit, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4561.flavor:
Chasing after Hedorah who had revived from a desiccated state, Godzilla acquired the ability to use his heat rays to fly into the sky.
―Godzilla vs. Hedorah (1971)―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4562.name: Godseeker DancingDragon Nataraja
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4562.kanji: ゴッドシーカー 舞踊龍ナタラージャ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4562.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add an exactly-named "Grandwalker of Destruction Shiva" and a Purple "Celeste"/"Avatar"/"Saga" family card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to either only the decktop or deckbottom, in any order.

[LV1][LV2]
No more than three cards can be discarded from either player's deck per turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4562.flavor: Shiva is one of the Trimurti, the God which administers destruction. He's feared for his coarse behavior, but actually he loves dancing like no one else does.

BS23-023.name: Grace Caterpillar
BS23-023.kanji: グレイスキャタピラー
BS23-023.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Draw Step)
Instead of drawing, you can reveal a card from your decktop. When that card is a Cost 8/9 Spirit card, put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Add the revealed card to your Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
You can summon a "Butterfly"-named Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BS23-023.flavor: Even for the one who will become Empress, the first step is taken as an earth-crawling caterpillar.

CB16-046.name: Graham's Union Flag Custom
CB16-046.kanji: グラハム専用ユニオンフラッグカスタム
CB16-046.effect:
Flash - [TopG: Cost 3 ([Blue Core])]

You can summon any number of exactly-named “Graham Aker" from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, by destroying an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
CB16-046.flavor: A being that surpasses even Asura.

BSC26-015.name: Godzilla［1989］
BSC26-015.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit. When you target attacked the opposing Spirit with the highest BP via this effect, this Spirit gains +10000 BP.

BSC26-015.flavor:
Godzilla awoke from his five year long slumber in the caldera of Mount Mihara and headed to Lake Ashi to fight with the clone created from his own cells, Biollante.
―Godzilla vs Biollante (1989)―

BS51-002.name: Godseeker DragonMiko Uzume
BS51-002.kanji: ゴッドシーカー 竜巫女ウズメ
BS51-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
This Spirit gains an extra White symbol.
BS51-002.flavor: Amaterasu is the Miko of the Divine World's sun and the Supreme Deity of Amahara. Appearing for the first time in centuries, she announces she'll end this war.

P14-44.name: Godzilla［2000］
P14-44.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can't be destroyed.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit and an opposing Nexus.
P14-44.flavor:
After the death of the first-generation Godzilla (1954), the second Godzilla attacked all across Japan. He has characteristic green skin with giant purple dorsal plates. The heat ray he fires from his mouth can wreak havoc upon an entire city.
—Godzilla 2000: Millennium (1999)—

BS52-040.name: Godseeker DruidFortuneteller Salem
BS52-040.kanji: ゴッドシーカー ドルイドの占い師セイラム
BS52-040.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add an exactly-named "Grandwalker Demeter" and a Yellow non-"Godseeker"-named "Primal"/"Avatar" family card to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2]
Your Cost 4 or more "Dark Artes" family Spirits can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.
BS52-040.flavor: Grandwalker Demeter is a mysterious goddess, as she rarely ever appears before others. Her function is to create worlds. Legend goes that she created the Divine World too, but no one knows if that's the truth or not.

CB16-065.name: Graham Aker
CB16-065.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

BS62-018.kanji: ゴッドシーカー 羽蛇神官クルワカン
BS62-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)

CB29-058.name: Graham Aker ［CB］
CB29-058.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Draw two cards, then discard a card from your Hand.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can refresh an opposing Spirit. Also, opposing Spirits must block if possible.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4573.name: Godseeker GrandflowerFairy Primula
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4573.kanji: ゴッドシーカー 神華の妖精プリムラ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4573.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add an exactly-named "Grandwalker Aphrodite", and a Yellow "Celeste"/"Avatar"/"Saga" family card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to either only the decktop or deckbottom in any order.

[LV1][LV2]
Neither deck can have more than four cards discarded from it per turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4573.flavor: Aphrodite is the Goddess of Love and Beauty. Her figure as she admires flowers enchants thousands of men. She is seen as a woman experienced in love, but she also has an unexpected romantic maiden side...

BS52-058.name: Granat-Golem
BS52-058.effect:
When the opponent [Advent], you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand. When you've done so, end this turn. Also, if you have two counters or more, destroy the Spirit which [Advent].

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, by destroying an opposing Spirit with the highest cost, this Spirit refreshes.
BS52-058.flavor: A machine which was once known as the Red Granat. Ever since it appeared on the Blue World, he's constantly taken top spots in athletic competitions

BS12-008.name: Grand-Dragcastle
BS12-008.kanji: グランド・ドラグキャッスル
BS12-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack a Spirit with the highest BP on the opposing Field.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each "Ancient Dragon" family Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.
BS12-008.flavor: My own home was ceremoniously stuck to the biggest Ancient Dragon. How do they have so much trouble with handling the Dragons?

26RBS03-089.name: Grand Theft

[Soul Magic: p]
[Flash]
Target an opposing Spirit with one core on it. Destroy it. If your Life was reduced this turn, target two Spirits instead.
26RBS03-089.flavor: Such polished thieving skills are now indistinguishable from magic.

BS16-005.name: Goemon-Thief-Dragon
BS16-005.kanji: ゴエモン・シーフ・ドラゴン

BS16-005.flavor: It looks like the chief of the scouting patrol is personally searching for me.

SD48-013.name: Grandraw
SD48-013.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate's (When Summoned) effect resolves]

By exhausting a Nexus you control, refresh this Spirit.
BS32-061.flavor: In the Great Sengoku Era, Braves with tough defense were just as important as offensive ones. You never knew when an enemy would attack.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4580.name: Godseeker GrandseaPirate Bandous
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4580.kanji: ゴッドシーカー 神海賊バンドウス

You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among these cards, add an exactly-named "Grandwalker Poseidon," a Blue "Worldswalker"/"Avatar" family Spirit card, and a Blue "Worldswalker" family Brave card to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Discard two cards from the opposing decktop.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4580.flavor: Poseidon is Zeus' older brother and the Divine King of the Oceans. Boasting the greatest power in Olym, he is one of the very few who can reprove Zeus. It is said the reason he hides his face with a rustic helmet is to not show his tears.

BS11-021.name: Gokurakucho

Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
BS11-021.flavor:
A bird whose color is nothing like anything seen in this world and a chirp ever so mysterious. Is it just a dream? Or can this creature be real? It's like gazing upon the ultimate mirage.
—from the Apus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4584.name: Godseeker HeavenKnight Aureich
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4584.kanji: ゴッドシーカー 天騎士オールリィチ

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4585.kanji: 創界神アレックス＝ロロ
