[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
Your counter +1. Then, (Once per Turn: Same Name) you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a Purple "Sorcerer" among them to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit/Ultimate attacks, including being in Soul State, if you control any "Contractor Hades", you can send a core from the attacking target to the Trash.
BS68-070.flavor:
The main temple located at the center of Elies, the majestic temple city in Hades' world. The Nether doesn't exactly refer to a physical world, but an intangible world connected by the spiritual part of various worlds.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 609―

26RBS01-119.name: Guard Effect
26RBS01-119.effect:
Legacy
[Flash]
Target one of your White Spirits. During this battle, it can't be targeted by opposing Magic effects.
26RBS01-119.flavor: "At that rate, you won't make it even if you spent the whole day on it"

BS66-039.name: Gun-Eagle
BS66-039.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks]
Return every opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2] Flash - [Fast Draw: 5] (When Attacks)
By discarding five facedown cards under your "The PartnerBurai Vrick", including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition, send up to two opposing Lives to their Reserve.
BS66-039.flavor:
This is my secret weapon, Legend Spirit, the ImpregnableFortress Odin. Don't you think it is a Spirit that fits me pretty well?
―The PartnerBurai Vrick―

BS36-004.name: Haflingam
BS36-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon an "Imagine" family Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost. When this effect summons any symbolless Brave, destroy an opposing Nexus.
BS36-004.flavor: This is an emergency bulletin from Tonio, on site. In the middle of the course, it seems that the racers in the lead were attacked from outside the race by a group calling themselves The FiveGoodDragonEmperors!

CB13-041.name: Gundam Kyrios［Flight Form］
CB13-041.kanji: ガンダムキュリオス［飛行形態］
CB13-041.effect:
Flash - [Arm Int: Cost 4 ([Blue Core][Blue Core][Blue Core])] (Opposing Attack Step)
You can summon this card from the Hand at Cost 4 ([Blue Core][Blue Core][Blue Core]).

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit. Also, if summoned via [Armed Intervention], destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit.
CB13-041.flavor: Kyrios's most prominent feature is its transformation mechanism. While in flight form, it is attached with a Tail Unit of various functions, and is hence capable to cope with different missions.

CB20-027.name: Haouken Xross Saber
CB20-027.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit. Also, when summoned by your “Fencer” family Spirit effect, draw two cards.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can activate a (When Summoned)/[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks) effect written on an “Exalted Sword” family Brave you control as this Spirit's effect.
CB20-027.flavor: The legendary Holy Sword that brings forth the ending to stories. It can freely unleash the powers of the 10 Holy Swords inhibited in its blade.

BS18-058.name: Gun-Horse
BS18-058.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Nexus to the Hand.

[When Braved] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block opposing Spirits without [Tribute] while exhausted.
BS18-058.flavor: Ice Shield compensates for their weakness of being slow-witted by braving?!

CB14-062.name: Happy Crescendo
CB14-062.kanji: ハッピィクレッシェンド
CB14-062.effect:
This card has "Idol" family.

This card in Trash is unaffected by any effects.

[Type: Song]

[Flash]
During this turn, your Life can't be reduced by the attacks of Cost 4 or more Spirits. Also, if you control any "Otoshiro Noeru"/"Otoshiro Seira"/"Saegusa Kii"/"Kazesawa Sora"/"Himesato Maria", and your Life is three or less, put a core from the Void to your Life.

BS63-042.name: Gun Dog
BS63-042.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Load: 1] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1. Then, you can put a card from your decktop facedown under your "The PartnerBurai Vrick", including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit to the Hand.
BS63-042.flavor:
It seems that I got no luck to meet that White guy over there this time.
―The PartnerBurai Vrick―

CB24-071.name: Happy Spa
CB24-071.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
By exhausting this Nexus, during this turn, two "Kamen" & "Beast Head" family Spirits you control are treated as being on their highest levels.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit/Ultimate would attack, unless the opponent sends a core from their Reserve to the Trash, it can't attack.
CB24-071.flavor: 五十嵐家の経営する銭湯。

SD61-008.name: Guard Mirage
SD61-008.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([White Core][White Core])]
[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, when your "Armed Machine" family Spirit is summoned, put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control.

[LV1] (Either Attack Step)
Neither player's Life can be reduced by the attacks of 4000 BP or less Spirits.

BSC16-039.name: Hard Beat
BSC16-039.effect:
[Flash]
By returning any number of "Diva" family Spirits you control to the deckbottom, for each Spirit returned, reveal a card from your decktop. From among them, summon any number of "Diva" family Spirit cards, without paying the costs. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirits can't activate. Discard the remaining cards.

CB24-025.name: Hagane Taka
CB24-025.effect:
While this card is in your Removed Zone, all your "Armed Hibiki" can't be blocked by opposing Spirits with two cores or less on them.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 6 ([Purple Core][Purple Core][Purple Core])]
Send three cores from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve, and when depletes, put a “Machine” & “Machine Beast” family card from your Trash onto your Removed Zone. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.
CB24-025.flavor: The powered-up form of being an Armed Disc Animal that Akane Taka, one of the Disc Animals, obtained via the sound waves released by the Ongekizofukuken Armed Saber.

26RBS02-080.name: Guard Tower
26RBS02-080.effect:
[LV1-2] Start of Opposing Attack Step
Target one of your "Leucomyst" family Spirits. During this turn, give it +2000 BP.

[LV2] Either Attack Step
All your Cost 6 or more Spirits with [Amplify] gain +2000 BP.
26RBS02-080.flavor: "Boost the power of the protective barrier! Don't let a single one go through!"

BS31-004.name: Haganewurm
BS31-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit activates [True-Clash]/ [Consecutive Blade], you can choose the Spirits/Ultimates the opponent blocks with. When you do, you can also target opposing exhausted Spirits/Ultimates.

[LV2] [True-Clash] (When Attacks)
The opponent must block with their Spirits/Ultimates if possible.
BS31-004.flavor: With their formation all ready for the first battle of Kaminakajima, the allied forces of Flame War Province and Gandala were ambushed by the ArmoredMothShinobi that very night.

CB27-005.name: Gundam Lfrith
CB27-005.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
[During Set] (Your Main Step)
(Once per turn: Same Name) You can summon a "School" family card from your Hand, fulfilling up to three of its reduction symbols. When you've done so, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -4000 BP, and destroy it when its BP reaches 0.

[LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Your counter +1. Then, during this turn, give three opposing Spirits -3000 BP, and destroy them when their BP reach 0.
CB27-005.flavor: A mobile suit using the innovative technology, GUND format.

CB27-011.name: Gundam Lfrith Thorn
CB27-011.kanji: ガンダム・ルブリス・ソーン
CB27-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing LV1 Spirit to the deckbottom. Then, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -10000 BP, and destroy it when it is brought to 0 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw two cards from the deckbottom.

[During Brave] [LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, while braved to "Norea", this Spirit can refresh.
CB27-011.flavor: The mobile suit owned by the witches from Earth. Its pilot is Norea Du Noc.

CB15-067.name: Hardboiler
CB15-067.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Kamen" family "W" Spirit is summoned, you can return this card from the Trash to your Hand.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. Also, if the opposing Life is three or more, put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control.
CB15-067.flavor: The personal motorbike of Kamen Rider W. By docking with the RevolGarry, it can swap out part of the bike and change into various forms.

CB27-009.name: Gundam Lfrith Ur
CB27-009.kanji: ガンダム・ルブリス・ウル
CB27-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card from the deckbottom. Then, while braved to "Sophie", return an opposing Nexus to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Gundam" attacks, during this turn, you can give an opposing Spirit -7000 BP, and destroy it when its BP is brought to 0.
CB27-009.flavor: The mobile suit owned by the witches from Earth. Its pilot is Sophie Pulone.

BS73-006.name: Haganewurm X
BS73-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, you can target and attack an opposing Spirit..

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When your "Rekka" family Spirit destroys any opposing Spirits, you can draw a card.
BS73-006.flavor: Burning-Souldragon and Samurai-Dragon-Amatsu actually standing side by side...Never imagined that I would see that one day.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4762.name: Guard Vent
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4762.effect:
This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Red.

This card in Trash is unaffected by all effects.

[Flash]
During this battle, a Spirit you control is unaffected by opposing effects. Also, if there are two or more "Kamen" & "Mounted Warrior" family Spirit cards in your Trash, during this turn, your Life can only be reduced by one.

SD53-004.name: Gundam Nadleeh
SD53-004.effect:
When your "Virtue"-named Spirits would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand/Trash, without paying the cost. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
Refresh three "CB" family Spirits you control.
SD53-004.flavor: The suit hidden inside of Virtue. Equipped with the Trial Sistem, it is a suit that can link with Veda -- Which means it can put every Gundam under its control, and can also fight in this form too. In order to protect the project from being ruined, it temporarily controlled Trinity's Gundam Throne.

26RBS03-003.name: Hargris
26RBS03-003.effect:
[LV1-2]
Besides this Spirit, for each "Purgatory Wings" family Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
26RBS03-003.flavor: As the battles intensified, a group of Spirits capable of refining flames more powerfully naturally came into being. They are known as the Purgatory Wings.

CB27-X04.name: Gundam Aerial (Rebuild)
CB27-X04.kanji: ガンダム・エアリアル（改修型）
CB27-X04.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: School & Cost 5 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
During this turn, you can give every opposing Spirit -10000 BP. Then, you can destroy all opposing Spirits with 0 BP, and you can draw a card from the deckbottom for each Sprit destroyed.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While you control any "Suletta", all your "Aerial"'s symbols are fixed as three Yellow symbols.

BS19-028.name: Hagoromochou
BS19-028.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Refresh a "Parasite" family Spirit you control.
BS19-028.flavor: The numbers of berserkers increased after the abnormalities. Their common trait is that Black Orbs have been seen floating around them. There's no concrete connection, but this gives me bad feelings that something unlucky is going to happen.

CB25-041.name: Gundam Pharact
CB25-041.kanji: ガンダム・ファラクト
CB25-041.effect:
When your Hand increases to five or more via your Yellow-only effect, you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, during this turn, treat every opposing Spirit as being at LV1.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
During this turn, you can give an opposing Spirit -5000 BP, and either destroy it or return it to the deckbottom when its BP is brought to 0. If you control any Brave, you can activate this effect once more.
CB25-041.flavor: Its pilot is Elan Ceres, the head of Peil House.

BS31-077.name: Hagurugama
BS31-077.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned) Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[When Braved] (When Attacks) While there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Spirit, the opponent cannot activate their set Burst.
BS31-077.flavor: Despite its appearance, it's surprising that it is able to keep up with the speed of a Ninja Gale.

CB29-026.name: Gundam Pharact ［Rumble Ring］
CB29-026.kanji: ガンダム・ファラクト［ランブルリング］
CB29-026.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon an "Elan" from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By returning a "Norea" from your Trash to the deckbottom, this Spirit refreshes.

[During Brave] [LV3] (When Attacks)
You can return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom. At the end of battle, destroy one of this Spirit's Braves.
CB29-026.flavor: Pharact that joins the Rumble Ring, a battle royale format duel event.

26RCB01-065.name: Guard Vent (26RCB01-065)
26RCB01-065.effect:
[Flash]
If all your Spirits/Nexuses have the "RYUKI" family, target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, your Life can't be reduced by its attack.

CB29-032.name: Gundam Schwarzette
CB29-032.kanji: ガンダム・シュバルゼッテ
CB29-032.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) If a Cost 5 or more Spirit is attacking, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
During this turn, you can give an opposing Spirit -5000 BP, and destroy it when its BP is brought to 0. For every two Yellow Braves/Nexuses you control, you can activate this effect once more.

[During Brave] [LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Your exhausted Brave Spirits can heavy exhaust to attack.
CB29-032.flavor: A next generation concept model mobile suit developed by Jeturk Heavy Machinery utilizing the "GUND FORMAT" technology. It is equipped with GUND-Bits like Aerial.

BS21-020.name: Harimoguri
BS21-020.flavor: They are small, but they have a secret to winning: sudden camouflage attacks that wear the opponent out.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4773.name: Guardian-Dragon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4773.kanji: ガーディアン・ドラゴン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4773.effect: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Battles) Destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit. When this effect destroys any Spirit, and it is the (Opposing Attack Step), refresh this Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4773.flavor: Just because it's peaceful now doesn't mean they've lost their purpose. In preparation for the next disaster, they must not lower their guard.

CB02-028.name: Hagurumon
CB02-028.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to another "Rookie" family Spirit you control.

[LV2] [Digivolve: White] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a White "Champion" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB02-028.flavor:
[Rookie. Machine. Virus]
A mutant Machine Digimon shaped like a gear. Hagurumon possesses the special ability to send a computer virus to its opponents in order to manipulate them at will, and that ability is exploited by fiendish Digimon.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4775.name: Guardromon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4775.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
All your White "Champion"/"Ultimate" family Spirits are unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.

[LV3] [Warp Digivolve: White] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a White "Ultimate" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4775.flavor:
[Champion. Machine. Virus]
Shioda Hirokazu's partner digimon. A machine digimon which guards the defensive walls of computer networks.

26RBS03-012.name: Guardy
26RBS03-012.effect:
[LV1-2]When Summoned
Target an opposing Spirit with three cores or less on it. Send cores from it to the Reserve until one core remains. (The opponent chooses which cores to send)
26RBS03-012.flavor: Whether he is angry or sad, it is impossible to tell from his deeply furrowed face.

SD54-012.name: Haro
SD54-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Add a Red "MS"/"MA"/"Mothership"/"Support Fighter"/"Pilot"/"Captain"/"Crew" family card among them to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
Besides [Soul Core], send up to three cores from your Trash to a Red "MS" family Spirit you control.
SD54-012.flavor: The Haro that accompanies Banagher. It displays some exclusive features, such as when it pretended to be a bomb when Audrey was being chased by Marida.

CB29-X05.name: Gundam Aerial (Rebuild) ［Permet Score Eight］
CB29-X05.kanji: ガンダム・エアリアル（改修型）［パーメットスコア・エイト］
CB29-X05.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: School & C6 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can summon any number of Yellow "Gundam"/"Gundnode" from your Hand, without paying the cost. Then, you can return an opposing LV1/LV2 Spirit to the deckbottom for each Spirit you control.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
The opponent can't use Spirit cards/Magic cards with a cost equal or inferior to the number of Yellow "Gundam"/"Gundnode" you control.

CB27-006.name: Guel's Dilanza
CB27-006.kanji: ディランザ グエル専用機
CB27-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Besides "Guel's Dilanza", add a "Suletta"/"Miorine"/"Guel" among them to your Hand. Return the remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, you can give an opposing Spirit -3000 BP, and destroy it when its BP reaches 0.
CB27-006.flavor: A Dilanza that specifically tuned for Guel. Not only does it has a superior specification, but it is also painted with magenta color and ornamented with elegant decorations.

CB29-028.name: Gundam Aerial (Rebuild) ［Quiet Zero］
CB29-028.kanji: ガンダム・エアリアル（改修型）[クワイエット・ゼロ]
CB29-028.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: School & C1 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can summon a "Gundnode" from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When this Spirit, or your "Gundnode" attacks/blocks, you can draw a card.

BS07-032.name: Hail-Garf
BS07-032.flavor:
It's been almost a day since the Invaders' assault suddenly ceased. The Nanovirus Dispersion device was destroyed in front of the great tower. The Singing Diva has stopped singing and is now coming down the tower with her guardian pet...
-from the 8th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS22-042.name: Harpy-Girl
BS22-042.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Holy Life] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing LV2/LV3 Spirits.
[Rush: Red]
(While you have a Red symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Red Core]: Destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit.
BS22-042.flavor:
The collapse of a country... The beasts have been swallowed up too... Everything is dying out...
-The Murmurs of Rutile, Sixth Day of the Eleventh Month-

CB27-010.name: Gundam Aerial ［Battle VS. Michaelis］
CB27-010.kanji: ガンダム・エアリアル[VS.ミカエリス戦]
CB27-010.effect:
When your "Aerial" is depleted/destroyed by the opponent, you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit attacks]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, during this turn, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
During this turn, an opposing Spirit can't attack/block.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, you can give an opposing Spirit -12000 BP, and destroy it when it is brought to 0 BP.
CB27-010.flavor: During the duel against Shaddiq, Aerial's shell units shone in blue lights and demonstrated their amazing specs.

BS19-046.name: Hakkubishin
BS19-046.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Cards can't be discarded from either deck.
BS19-046.flavor: Most people doubted the very existence of the SwordsSaints. I wonder why they appeared in each of the countries after the abnormalities.

CB25-042.name: Gundam Aerial［Beam Blade］
CB25-042.kanji: ガンダム・エアリアル[ビームブレイド]
CB25-042.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: School & Cost 5 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
During this turn, you can give up to two opposing Spirits -10000 BP, and destroy them when their BP are brought to 0. While braved to "Suletta", you can activate this effect once more.

[During OC] [LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to your Life.

CB13-045.name: Gundam Throne Drei
CB13-045.kanji: ガンダムスローネドライ
CB13-045.effect:
When your "CB" family Spirits are destroyed by an opposing effect, you can summon this card from the Hand. When you've done so, one of the destroyed Spirits remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "CB" family Spirits are attacking, opposing non-"Mothership" family Nexuses can't activate their effects.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Opposing non-"Pilot" family Braves can't activate their effects.
CB13-045.flavor: The third mobile suit in the Throne series. The pilot is Nena Trinity.

CB25-055.name: Guel Jeturk
CB25-055.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
Draw a card from the deckbottom.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
During this turn, you can give an opposing Spirit -4000 BP, and destroy it when its BP is brought to 0.

CB25-038.name: Gundam Aerial［Beam Saber］
CB25-038.kanji: ガンダム・エアリアル[ビームサーベル]
CB25-038.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: School & Cost 3 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a "School" family card among them to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
You can summon/deploy a "School" family Brave card/Nexus card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

CB29-055.name: Guel Jeturk ［CEO］
CB29-055.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[LV1] Flash - (Your Turn)
Once per turn, if this Brave is in Spirit condition, you can summon a "Darilbalde"/"Dilanza"/"Desultor"/"Prodoros" from your Hand, without paying the cost. When you've done so, during this turn, all your Spirits braved to "Guel" gain an extra Yellow symbol.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

CB29-022.name: Gundam Aerial［Bit On Form］
CB29-022.kanji: ガンダム・エアリアル[ビットオンフォーム]
CB29-022.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: School, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing LV1 Spirits.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2]
Every "School" family card in your Hand can be used as a Cost 3 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core]) Magic card with "(Flash) Draw a card from the deckbottom."

P13-22.name: Hakubishamon
P13-22.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Charge]
Increase the number of bodies to be exhausted by your “opponent-targeting exhaustion effects“ by +1.

[LV1][LV2]
For each Spirit with [Charge] you control, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
P13-22.flavor: For a long time, he has protected the holy land. Over time he cleared his mind until at last he himself reached the mental state of a god.

BS25-018.name: Hakubisword
BS25-018.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [SSoul: Green]

BS60-090.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Green Core])]
[During Set]
While you have six counters or more, the effects of every opposing heavily exhausted Spirit/Nexus can't activate, and those Spirits/Nexuses can't refresh.

[Main]
Discard your entire Hand. When this effect discards any “Jade Thunder” family cards, draw a card for each card in the opposing Hand/Removed Zone. The opponent can't activate Nexus effects via this effect.

26RBS03-052.name: Inctus
26RBS03-052.flavor: "Those Mineroids weren't really much of a threat. I suppose we might just end up conquering the whole territory at this rate..."

BS66-086.name: Indiscrimate Sword
BS66-086.kanji: インディスクリメイトソード
BS66-086.effect:
This card can't be used unless you control no Spirits & have 0 Spirit cards in your Trash.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a cost equal or inferior to your number of counters. Then, you can discard a card from the opposing decktop. When any Spirit card/Ultimate card is discarded by this effect, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest cost. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

BS75-068.name: Indra's Heavenly Thunder Temple
BS75-068.effect:
When this card is sent to the Trash from deck by the effect of your "Contractor Indra", you can add it to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, when your "Thunderive" family Spirit attacks, you can draw a card from the deckbottom.

[LV2] (Your Turn)
Once per turn, when your "Thunderive" family Spirits would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can put a core from the Void to your Life.
BS75-068.flavor:
The temple of Indra, where thunder constantly rains down from the heavens.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 783―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5129.name: Indramon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5129.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Give all your "Ultimate"/"Mega" family Spirits: "(When Attacks) Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible. At the end of a blocked battle, send an opposing Life to their Reserve."

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit attacks, destroy it.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5129.flavor:
[Ultimate. Holy Beast. Virus]
One of the Deavas, an Ultimate Digimon with the appearance of a horse. Its finisher move is Adhomukha, where it uses its tremendous lung capacity to blow the conch shell, generating ultrasonic waves.

SD14-003.name: Inegobatta
SD14-003.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to any of your Spirit.
[Rush: Blue]
(While you have a Blue symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Blue Core]: During this battle, the opponent can't use White Magic cards.
SD14-003.flavor: The Country of Dark Green is overgrown with trees and appears to be calm. This country has been afflicted with little damage, and appears to be isolated from the rest of the world.

BS38-068.name: Infection Shoot
BS38-068.effect:
[Flash]
Send a core from one opposing Spirit to their Reserve. If this effect depletes any Spirit, send two cores from one opposing Spirit to their Reserve. Then, if this effect depletes two Spirits, send three cores from one opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve.

CB02-057.name: Infermon
CB02-057.effect:
The color of this card in Hand is treated as colorless.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Send two cores from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can't be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When any opposing Spirit would activate [Digivolution]/[Super Digivolution], the opponent must send a core from that Spirit to the Trash.
CB02-057.flavor:
[Ultimate. Species Unknown. Unknown]
An Ultimate Digimon whose appearance resembles a long-legged spider.

BS38-071.name: Infernal Wind
BS38-071.kanji: インファナルウィンド
BS38-071.effect:
[Flash]
Exhaust two opposing Spirits, and put a core from the Void each to every Ultimate you control. If your Soul Core is banished, instead, exhaust every opposing Spirit, and put three cores from the Void each to every Ultimate you control.

BS04-096.name: Inferno Eyes
BS04-096.effect:
[Main]
Each player sends four cores from their Spirits/Nexuses to the Void. This effect can't be used unless you control a Spirit with two or more symbols.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit with two or more symbols +5000 BP.

CB27-X03.name: Infinite Justice Gundam
CB27-X03.kanji: インフィニットジャスティスガンダム
CB27-X03.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Return an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the deckbottom. If you control any White "Orb"/"Mothership" family Spirit/Nexus, this effect can't be prevented by opposing effects. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [VPSa: Cost 7 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 7 or less effects.

[LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.
CB27-X03.flavor: Athrun's mobile suit, carrying out his infinite justice with him.

CBX01-X02.name: Infinite Justice Gundam Type II
CBX01-X02.kanji: インフィニットジャスティスガンダム弐式
CBX01-X02.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, for each "Compass" family Spirit you control, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [VPSa: Cost 7 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 7 or less effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Put two cores from the Void to your other "Compass" family Spirits/Nexuses.

CB29-017.name: Infinite Justice Gundam ［Meteor Equipped］
CB29-017.kanji: インフィニットジャスティスガンダム[ミーティア装備]
CB29-017.effect:
This set card can't be discarded by opposing Cost 7 or less effects.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, ignoring the cost of Braves, return every opposing Cost 6/7/8 Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [VPSa: Cost 7 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 7 or less effects.

[LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, this Spirit refreshes, and discard a random card from the opposing Hand.
CB29-017.flavor: The Infinite Justice Gundam obtaining a firepower equivalent to a moving fortress.

CB02-064.name: Infinity Mountain
CB02-064.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Purple Spirit activates [Digivolution], send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.

[LV2]
The LV costs of all your Purple "Champion"/ "Ultimate"/ "Mega" family Spirits get -1. However, the LV costs can't become zero.
CB02-064.flavor: The mountain located at the center of File Island. One can have a good view of the entire Field Island climbing up the mountain. A shrine of Digimons existed at the peak, and black gears flew to there from various regions.

BS60-063.name: Ino Racer
BS60-063.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Blue Core])]
[During Set]
When you draw via your "Azure Wave" family effect, the opponent can't activate "when draw/when increase Hand" effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, draw two cards, then discard two cards from your Hand. If this effect discards any "Azure Wave" family cards, your counters +2.
BS60-063.flavor:
Watch out! Dan, dodge! Hey, Daphnel! Didn't I tell you to stop modifying the spirits huhhhh!!!
―The PartnerShark Shack―

BS35-061.name: Inohyou Elephant
BS35-061.flavor: The reason why the crew of "Terra Stampede" have physiques as good as the racers is to stop the racers who are on a rampage as they come into the pit. Oh, that tremor means... Ah! Here it comes! It's Racer Dos-Daimos' rampage, or rather, his pit stop! He's coming right this way! Gyaah, I'm going to get pulled in!

BS35-057.name: Inotsuchi Pig
BS35-057.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw two cards. Then, discard two cards from your Hand.

[LV1][LV2]
While your Hand is three or less, this Spirit gains +5000 BP.
BS35-057.flavor: "Terra Stampede" is called the Kings of the Land. Starting with the Pig God-King, Racer Calamity-Boar, they have other powerful racers like Dos-Deimos registered. However, if we're talking where this team stands out, it's of course, the best part of BSGP, big crashes!

CB13-003.name: Jesta ［Daryl Use］
CB13-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When a "Jesta"-named Spirit you control would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can draw a card.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit.
CB13-003.flavor: A unit of the Tri-Star elite MS team from the Londo Bell flagship Ra Cailum, piloted by Daryl McGuinness.

BS12-077.name: Insect Aura
BS12-077.effect:
[Main]
During this turn, when your "Parasite"/"Shell Insect"/"Shellman" family Spirit attacks, put a core from the Void to your Reserve, or that Spirit.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

CB13-005.name: Jesta ［Nigel Use］
CB13-005.kanji: ジェスタ［ナイジェル機］
CB13-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add every "Ra Cailum"/"Jesta"/"Jegan"-named cards among them to your Hand. Discard any rmaining cards.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can summon up to two "Jesta"-named Spirit cards from your Hand, without paying the cost. When this effect summons at least one, destroy three opposing 8000 BP or less Spirits.
CB13-005.flavor: A unit of the Tri-Star elite MS team from the Londo Bell flagship Ra Cailum, piloted by Nigel Garrett and entrusted by his commander Bright Noa.

CB30-059.name: Insect Chemy Antrooper
CB30-059.kanji: インセクトケミー アントルーパー
CB30-059.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Brave must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit, and put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits. While braved to "Wrestler G", instead, heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit, and put two cores from the Void to any of your Spirits.
CB30-059.flavor: A Chemy composed of many ants.

CB13-009.name: Jesta ［Watts Use］
CB13-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By exhausting this Spirit, besides this Spirit, refresh a "Jesta"/"Unicorn"-named Spirit you control.
CB13-009.flavor: A unit of the Tri-Star elite MS team from the Londo Bell flagship Ra Cailum, piloted by Watts Stepney. It was dropped onto the Unicorn Gundam, which was being transferred to Garuda, as a stepping stone in the air.

CB34-055.name: Insect Chemy Crosshopper
CB34-055.kanji: インセクトケミー クロスホッパー
CB34-055.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Your counter +1. Then, put one core from the Void each to two "Gotchard"/"Chemy" Spirits/Nexuses you control.

[During Brave] (Your Attack Step)
The opponent can't activate Burst effects.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
During this battle, the opponent can't use cards outside Flash Timing. Also, while braved to "Tenliner", heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit.
CB34-055.flavor: The level number 10 form that the Insect Chemy, Hopper 1, transformed into through a re-transmuting process that concentrated Ichinose Houtaro's yell and the power entrusted to him by the 10 level number 10 Chemies.

SD11-011.name: Jet-Gannet
SD11-011.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Nexus to the Hand.

[When Braved] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing 4000 BP or more Spirit attacks, refresh this Spirit.
SD11-011.flavor: The flying object appeared suddenly. It carried us to the country we needed to go to next.

CB30-058.name: Insect Chemy Hopper1
CB30-058.kanji: インセクトケミー ホッパー1
CB30-058.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1. Then, you can summon one of your "Gotchard" Contract Cards that is in Hand/Soul State/pre-advent condition, treating all its reduction symbols as fulfilled.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
While braved to "Steamliner", this Spirit gains an extra Blue symbol. While braved to an originally Cost 7 "Gotchard", this effect adds +1 symbol.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't activate Burst effects.
CB30-058.flavor: The first Chemy that becomes friends with Houtaro Ichinose.

PC11-001.name: Jet Jaguar -ver. JA02-
PC11-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. From among them, you can deploy a "WILLE" family Nexus card without paying the cost, and add a "WILLE" family card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step)
Besides [Soul Core], you can send up to five cores from your Trash to any of your "WILLE" family Spirits/Nexuses. Then, you can discard a "WILLE" family card from your Hand. When you've done so, discard an opposing Burst.
PC11-001.flavor: The revived Jet Jaguar after having its damaged parts repaired.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5151.name: Insect Mirage
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5151.kanji: インセクトミラージュ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5151.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 4 ([Green Core][Green Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
While your “Blade Insect” family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't move cores, besides [Soul Core], on their Field.

[LV1] (Either Main Step)
Every Cost 3 or less Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Grandwalker Nexus is fixed as having zero symbols. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

CB28-022.name: Jet Jaguar Beta 〈S.P〉
CB28-022.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Android"/"Machine Beast" family Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand/Trash.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Return any number of opposing Spirits up to a total cost of this Spirit's cost to the deckbottom. When this effect returns, return this Spirit to the Hand.
CB28-022.flavor: An AI robot that Yun moves Jet Jaguar to which can fight autonomously. It uses a lance modified from Anguirus's horn as a weapon to fight.

SD14-008.name: Insects Assemble
SD14-008.kanji: インセクトアッセンブル
SD14-008.effect:
[Flash]
Refresh three "Parasite" family Spirits you control.
[Rush: Blue]
(While you have a Blue symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Blue Core]: Destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.

CB28-021.kanji: ジェットジャガー プロトタイプ〈S.P〉
CB28-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1, and put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, if you have six counters or more, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can reveal four cards from your decktop. Add an "Android"/"Machine Beast" family card among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

BS14-097.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Brave's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Main effect.

[Main]
Summon a Cost 4 or less Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effect of the Spirit can't activate.

CB28-026.name: Jet Jaguar 〈S.P〉
CB28-026.effect:
[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
For every two cards in the opposing Hand, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits. Then, if the opponent has six or more cards in Hand, return three opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Cost 7 or more Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.
CB28-026.flavor: The gigantic form Jet Jaguar grew to after Pelops II calculated the protocol for Jet Jaguar to become the strongest, and combining with Yung using the code from the Orthogonal Diagonalizer.

BSC20-017.name: Inugami
BSC20-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Spirit, when you use a Magic card, after its effect resolves, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
By discarding a Magic card from your Hand, this Spirit remains on the Field, refreshed.
BSC20-017.flavor: The winning ticket was taken from Flowering Yellow Province and placed in the protection of Kashaneko, but it was lost during the war.

BS31-084.name: Jet Karura
BS31-084.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Draw two cards. Then, discard two cards from your Hand. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) was used to pay the summon cost, this effect draws +1 cards.

[When Braved] (When Battles)
This Spirit gains +4000 BP.
BS31-084.flavor: In the fourth battle, the Purifying Knowledge WisdomKing died in action. The plan fell apart, but they made a frantic effort and still made the battle above par.

SD70-004.name: Io
SD70-004.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Blue & Lovers Arcana, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Then, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

[LV2] (When Blocks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Then, refresh a Spirit you control.

BS48-094.name: Iris Field
BS48-094.effect:
[Type: Flower] (While on the field, the following effect remains active)
█ While your "Fairy" family Spirits are attacking, when any player would use a non-Yellow Magic card/[Accel], it can't be used unless one extra cost is paid.

[Flash]
During this turn, your Life can't be reduced by the attacks of opposing 5000 BP or more Spirits and 10000 BP or more Ultimates. Then, put this card on your Field.

BS67-033.name: Jet Nodon
BS67-033.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Machine Contract & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Your counter +1. Then, if you have four counters or more, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
During this battle, this Spirit gains +5000 BP. Also, once per turn, while braved to a Brave, this Spirit refreshes.

IRON-GOLEM2.name: Iron-Golem
IRON-GOLEM2.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Blocks) By discarding a Nexus card from your Hand, this Spirit gains +4000 BP.

[LV2] (When Attacks) By discarding a Nexus card from your Hand, this Spirit gains +4000 BP.
IRON-GOLEM2.flavor: We have another classic golem. Its features clearly tell us that it was made in Bagin's workshop. The top ranks of the artificial soldiers competitive exhibition are currently dominated by soldiers created by Bagin's workshop.

BS74-074.name: Jewel Garden
BS74-074.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When you use a "Prismwing" family Magic card, after its effect resolves, you can deploy this card from the Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2]
Cards can't be discarded from either player's deck, and your "Contractor Morrigan" Grandwalker Nexuses can't be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV2] (Your Turn)
When you would use any "Prismwing" family Magic card, by exhausting this Nexus, treat as up to two costs being paid from your Reserve.
BS74-074.flavor:
A Divine Botanical Garden, where gemstone trees are cultivated.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 974―

BS26-011.name: Jibakku-Armor
BS26-011.kanji: ジーバック・アーマー
BS26-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Ultimates are exhausted by opposing effects, by sending one core from any opposing Spirits to their Trash, refresh the Ultimates.
BS26-011.flavor: You're saying we should take a page from the other Spirits and talk things out with the Ultimates? Fric, you come up with some half-baked stuff. Huh? You all agree with him!?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5165.name: Iron Phalanx
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5165.kanji: アイアンファランクス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5165.effect: Flash- Destroy an opposing Spirit with a Cost equal to or less than the total number of Blue symbols on your field.

BS13-049.name: Irritaban
BS13-049.effect:
[LV1]
While this Brave is in Spirit condition, you can brave this Spirit with a Brave you control.

[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
You can activate the (When Brave Attacks) of a Spirit-condition Brave or a Brave on a Brave Spirit you control as this Spirit's effect.
BS13-049.flavor:
Braves used to be uncommon, but now they're breaking out in popularity!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS54-022.name: Jigsaw Longhorn
BS54-022.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When you're deploying a "Mega-Grandstone"-named Nexus card, this Spirit gains an extra White symbol.

[LV2]
All your Green Grandstone Nexuses gain an extra Green symbol.
BS54-022.flavor:
Some time before, with the rampage of the horned disaster beast, I had been panicking what I should do if the world vanished. It turns out that be it the lab, or the areas around, nothing is gone. Even the signature divine tree still flourishes and thrives as usual. I'm so relived. Let's quickly move on to search through the books in the lab!
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 3:26―

BSC49-051.name: Irritaban LT
BSC49-051.effect:
[LV1]
You can brave this Spirit condition Brave with a Brave you control.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can activate one of the (When Attacks) effects written on one of your Braves as this Spirit's effect.
BSC49-051.flavor:
Braves used to be uncommon, but now they're breaking out in popularity!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

CB33-044.name: Jin
CB33-044.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Dark Hour" family card with a different name to this Spirit to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. If your number of counters is an odd number or 13 or more, this effect can add +1 card to the Hand.
CB33-044.flavor: A boy who speaks in a Kansai dialect, and a member of Strega, a three-member group which uses Dark Hour to exact revenge on behalf of others. He is highly intelligent and runs a revenge agency website. He is good at gathering information.

BS17-039.name: Irus-Bird
BS17-039.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Brilliance] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, return all Magic cards you used during this battle to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When you use a Magic card, after its effect resolves, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS17-039.flavor: The hero would not help us herself, but lent us her maids. Truly the best part about her was that she wouldn't charge a fee.

CB33-046.name: Jin & Moros
CB33-046.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Purple & Hermit Arcana & C4 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) During this turn, give a Spirit you or the opponent controls +10000 BP, and an extra Purple symbol. At the end of the battle of that target, destroy that target.

[LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, you can discard three cards from your decktop. When you've done so, look at the contents of an opposing Burst, and if that's a Magic card, discard it.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5172.name: Ishida Yamato
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5172.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Red/Purple & Rookie/Champion/Ultimate/Mega)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2]
This Nexus' symbol is also treated as Red.

[Grand Skill: 3] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) Destroy an opposing Spirit with three or less cores on it.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Red/Purple "Mega" family Spirit refreshes, you can send an opposing Life to their Reserve. This effect doesn't stack.

BS17-060.name: Jinn-Arms
BS17-060.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
During this turn, when the opponent uses a Magic card, unless they discard a card from their Hand with a cost equal or higher than the Magic card's, they can't activate its effect.
BS17-060.flavor: The genie that failed to carry out the assassination immediately chose to brave.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5174.name: Ishvara Shoot
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5174.effect:
This card in Trash is unaffected by all effects.

When this card is revealed from the deck, if the opponent controls any Ultimate, you can add it to the Hand.

[Flash]
Either destroy an opposing Spirit with two or less cores on it, or two opposing Ultimates with five or less cores on them. This effect can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Armor].

LM15-01.name: Jinrai War Lizard
LM15-01.kanji: ジンライイクサトカゲ
LM15-01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
While [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, all "Lord"/"Vassal" family Spirits you control gain +5000 BP.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [True-Clash] (When Attacks)
The opponent must block with their Spirits/Ultimates if possible.
LM15-01.flavor:
The War Lizard clan studied the fighting styles of those they fought with on the battlefield and passed them down to the next generation.
―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Shiva―

SD70-005.name: Isis
SD70-005.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Blue & Lovers Arcana & C2 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Refresh two other Spirits you control. Also, if this Spirit [Contract Advents], you can immediately end the battle.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Then, put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control.

SD29-004.name: Jinraidragon
SD29-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +3000 BP. While this Spirit has [Soul Core](Soul Core) on it, this Spirit gains: "[True-Clash] Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible."
SD29-004.flavor: Famed spirits across the country are each competing for the title! Who will control the world? The Great Sengoku Era now begins!!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5178.name: Isis' Garden Temple
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5178.effect:
When this card is revealed from the Deck by your Yellow effect, it can be added to your Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Draw Step)
Instead of drawing, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Divine Spirit" family Spirit/Ultimate card to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
The level cost of the Lv2 of all your exactly-named "Grandwalker Isis" gets -1.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5178.flavor:
Enshrined on the most beautiful garden of Enubilia, Isis saves the souls of those who fell to tragedy.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 405―

P15-14.name: Jinraidragon-True
P15-14.kanji: ジンライドラゴン・真
P15-14.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. While [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, also, it gains "[True-Clash] Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible."
P15-14.flavor: The glory of a proud general comes after they compile their small victories one by one.

BS73-005.name: Jinraidragon X
BS73-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Rekka" family card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. When cards are added to the Hand via this effect, your counter +1.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit. Also, by sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, during this battle, this Spirit gains +10000 BP.

BS53-030.name: Jisaidori
BS53-030.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom, and put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't activate Burst effects. Also, at the end of battle, if you have two/three counters, once per turn, refresh this Spirit.
BS53-030.flavor:
Fleeing desperately, we tried our best to travel through the places with obstacles. However, the horned disaster beast did not mind them, and destroyed everything in his way to chase after us. Everything, including even his underlings that followed him, was caught in the destruction.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 2:15―

CB30-057.name: Job Chemy Apparebushido
CB30-057.kanji: ジョブケミー アッパレブシドー
CB30-057.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Nexus' (When Summoned/Deployed) effect resolves]
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Nexus with one symbol or less. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's. Also, while braved to "Skebows", draw two cards.
CB30-057.flavor: A samurai Chemy that is good at sword skills.

BS07-053.name: Island-Golem
BS07-053.effect:
[Tribute: Cost 3 or more → Trash]
After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from a Spirit you control with a designated or higher cost to the targeted area.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Crush] (When Attacks)
Discard a number of cards from the opposing decktop equal to this Spirit's LV.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When cards are discarded from the opposing deck due to [Crush] effect, it discards +3 cards.
BS07-053.flavor:
A mechanized warrior created to defy the gods... Its gigantic size far exceeds the imagination.
-from the 12th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

CB30-062.name: Job Chemy Wrestler G
CB30-062.kanji: ジョブケミー レスラーG
CB30-062.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost.

[LV1]
When this Spirit-condition Brave attacks, you can destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost. Also, while braved to "Antrooper", during this battle, this Spirit gains an extra Blue symbol.

LM16-06.name: It's New Year's! Battle Spirits
LM16-06.kanji: お正月だよ！バトルスピリッツ
LM16-06.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Give all your Brave Spirits: "Purple/Blue This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Blue Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects."

[LV2] (Your End Step)
Refresh a Brave Spirit you control.
LM16-06.flavor: Happy New Year's! Let's play Battle Spirits this year as well!

CB13-065.name: Johann Trinity
CB13-065.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

This card in Trash is unaffected by any effect.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can summon three differently named "Throne"-named Spirit cards from your Trash, without paying the cost. However, their (When Summoned) effects can't activate.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
For each "Throne"-named Spirit you control, increase the cost of every Magic card in the opposing Hand by +1.

BS34-047.name: Ittan Momen
BS34-047.effect:
This Spirit card is also treated as a Magic card.

[Flash] (This effect can't be used while on the Field.)
During this battle, when comparing BP, if the level of your battling Spirit/Ultimate is equal to or higher than the opposing blocking Spirit/Ultimate's Level, without comparing BP, treat the attack as not being blocked.
BS34-047.flavor: Don Nurarihyon, an elder of the Youkai Folk, called together Youkai lurking in every land to the hidden village.

SD50-CP01.name: Johnny Bepp
SD50-CP01.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Idol & Cost 3 or more)]
◆When you Summon/Advent a target Spirit, you can put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Field] [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When your "Idol" & "School Style" family Spirit is summoned, if your Hand is five or less, draw a card. This effect doesn't stack.

[Grand Skill: 2] [LV2] (Your Main Step)
(Send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) During this turn, treat one "Idol" family Spirit you control as being one level higher.

CB26-031.name: Ivan Karelin
CB26-031.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add an "ORIGAMI CYCLONE"/"ROCK BISON"/"Photobombing Professional" among them to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "ORIGAMI CYCLONE"/"ROCK BISON" attacks, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
CB26-031.flavor: Origami Cyclone. Graduated from Hero Academy and stays active as a hero with his shapeshifting abilities. He forms buddies with ROCK BISON.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5190.name: Joker
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5190.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
For each Life reduced when this Burst activated, send a core, besides [Soul Core], from one opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Void. When this effect depletes, draw two cards. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit. You can activate one of the (When Attacks) effects of the destroyed Spirit, ignoring the Levels, as this Spirit's effect.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5190.flavor: An Undead that is an ancestor to no creature.

BS03-127.name: Ivy Cage
BS03-127.effect:
[Main]
Exhaust every 2000 BP or less Spirit.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

CB04-074.name: Joker Extreme
CB04-074.kanji: ジョーカーエクストリーム
CB04-074.effect:
While your "W"-named Spirit is attacking, this Magic card in Hand is treated as Cost 3.

[Flash]
Exhaust two opposing Spirits. Then, if you control any "Kamen" family Spirit, return two opposing exhausted Spirits to the Hand.

BS52-022.name: Ivytail
BS52-022.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, if you have one counter or more, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2]
When this Spirit would be returned to the Hand/Deck due to opposing effects, it can remain on the field, in the same condition.
BS52-022.flavor:
We somehow run away from the burning dragons and go through the gate, returning to the Green World. This world is our base. While researching immortality, we accidentally discovered the world's gates, and realized the world had gone crazy. Odd as it may sound, the world's residents don't understand this situation.
――"Record of Wordly Matters" Volume 1:10―

BS22-024.name: Jounin-Tonbi
BS22-024.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Charge]
Your “opponent-targeting exhaustion effects“ exhausts +1 bodies.

[LV1][LV2] [Bunshin: 1] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
By placing one card from your decktop onto the Field facedown and putting at least one core from the Reserve onto it, until the end of the game, it is treated as "Cost 0/"Bunshin" family/LV1: 1 core, 3000 BP/[Green Core]" Green Bunshin Spirit. (Bunshin Spirits can't be braved, and are discarded when returned to the Hand/Deck.)
BS22-024.flavor: For his village, and for his ninja pride. A single bird ninja carries out his mission to the very end.

BS09-040.name: Iwasaal
BS09-040.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Blocks)
Exhaust two opposing Cost 3 or less Spirits.

[LV2]
This Spirit is also treated as a Purple Spirit.
BS09-040.flavor: He may be violent, but he's a great help in times of emergency. Let's pass on the Beast Kingdom and move on to the Magic Kingdom; there we may find some tools to help in our research, or at least some weapons to protect ourselves.

BSC45-061.name: Iwasaal LT
BSC45-061.effect:
Main- [Accel: Cost 4 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
Summon "Kikasaal"/"Misaal", one of each, from your Trash, without paying the cost. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By exhausting your "Kikasaal"/"Misaal" Spirits, one of each, both players discard their entire Hand. When you've done so, both players draw four cards.
BSC45-061.flavor: He may be violent, but he's a great help in times of emergency. Let's pass on the Beast Kingdom and move on to the Magic Kingdom; there we may find some tools to help in our research, or at least some weapons to protect ourselves.

BS55-027.name: Izanagi's Kamiumi Temple
BS55-027.effect:
[Brave Symbol +1]

[LV1][LV2] (When Reborn)
Put a core from the Void to each this Nexus and a "Spiritual Beast"/"Plant Spirit" family Spirit you control. Also, for each opposing six-colored Cost 3 or less Nexus, the opponent discard two cards from their Hand.

[LV2]
Effects of opposing Spirits that would leave the Field due to your "Spiritual Beast"/"Plant Spirit" family Spirits can't activate.
BS55-027.flavor:
The temple of Izanagi, located in the Green World. Completely blended into the sea of trees, it is difficult to find. Is there someone trying to conceal its existence?
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map Draft―

BS55-012-A5198.name: Izanami's Yomi Temple
BS55-012-A5198.kanji: イザナミの 黄泉神殿
BS55-012-A5198.effect:
[Brave Symbol +1]

[LV1] (When Reborn)
Draw two cards. Also, for each opposing six-colored Cost 3 or less Nexus, send two cores from the opposing Reserve/Trash/Spirits to the Void.

[LV1]
The [Grand Field] of every six-colored Grandwalker Nexus can't activate.
BS55-012-A5198.flavor:
The temple of Izanami, located in the Yomi World. In fact, it is where information concerning the upper world is collected and promptly delivered to Izanami, something like the headquarter of the Yomi Intelligence Agency.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map Draft―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5199.name: J
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5199.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Machine/Armed Machine/Dragon Emperor/Worldswalker/Avatar & Cost 3 or more)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 3] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) During this turn, a "Machine"/"Armed Machine"/"Dragon Emperor" family Spirit/Ultimate you control can't be blocked.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
When your "Machine"/"Armed Machine" family Spirits/Ultimates are destroyed by effects, by paying one cost, they remain on the Field, exhausted.

P16-01.name: Jacall
P16-01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each “Emperor Beast” family Spirit you control, destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit.
[During Seal] Also, draw a card.
P16-01.flavor: The 216th Twelve God-King Battle Survival Grand Prix opens now! Be you Emperor Beasts! Or War Dragons! Give all you've got to aim for the goal!!

BS36-041.name: Jack O'Lantern
BS36-041.kanji: ジャックオーランタン
BS36-041.effect:
When summoning this Spirit card, all opposing Spirits lose their effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
Draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
By exhausting this Spirit, target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, that Spirit loses all its effects and can't gain any new ones.
BS36-041.flavor: Racer Hanumerlin, one of the current God-Kings, is using its secret arts to fight Aurelius!

BS44-072.name: Jackal-Arms
BS44-072.kanji: ジャッカル・アームズ
BS44-072.effect:
[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. Then, discard a card from your Hand. When a Blue card is discarded by this effect, ignoring the cost of the Brave, destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit.
BS44-072.flavor: On an industrialized world such as Egyt, this Brave is used as a labor force. However, its technology can easily turn it into a weapon.

BS19-076.name: Jackkuri
BS19-076.effect: [When Braved] (When Brave Attacks) When you use a Magic card, after its effect resolves, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -2000 BP.
BS19-076.flavor: It looks cute, and then shows its battle potential by braving. Its selling point is its twofold deliciousness.

BS17-026.name: Jadobaljar
BS17-026.effect:
This Spirit card is summoned in exhausted state.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Treat this Spirit as a Spirit with no printed effects.
BS17-026.flavor:
Circling around the right flank of the enemy, the Flame Shield Army added fuel to the fire of Wind Shield's fighting spirit. From the start, the strength of their individual units were no worse than the generals from the Flame Shield.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of the Hero Kei, Year 647—

CB25-009.name: Jagd Doga ［Gyunei Custom］
CB25-009.kanji: ヤクト・ドーガ[ギュネイ専用機]
CB25-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By paying one cost, reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a “NZ” family Brave card/Nexus card among them to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - [Funnel: 5000] (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 5000 BP. Also, by paying one cost, during this turn, increase the limit of your “NZ” family Spirits' “BP Destruction Effects” by +7000.
CB25-009.flavor: A special Mobile Suit designed to be used by the Neo Zeon’s Newtype and Cyber-Newtype pilots. Its basic frame inherits that of Geara Doga's, and is equipped with six funnels.

CB29-001.name: Jagd Doga ［Sleeves］
CB29-001.kanji: ヤクト・ドーガ [袖付き]
CB29-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, besides any "Jagd Doga ［Sleeves］", add a “Sleeves"/"NZ” family card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] Flash - [Funnel: 5000] (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 5000 BP. By paying one cost, during this turn, increase the limit of your “Sleeves"/“NZ” family Spirit's “BP Destruction Effect” by +5000.
CB29-001.flavor: A MS made specifically for the Newtypes and Cyber-Newtype of Newborn Neo Zeon. Its damaged arm from previous battle was repaired using that of Geara Doga's.

CB25-008.name: Jagd Doga［Quess Custom］
CB25-008.kanji: ヤクト・ドーガ[クェス専用機]
CB25-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can return a "Char" Brave card/Nexus card, or a Cost 5 or more Spirit card with [Funnel] from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] Flash - [Funnel: 5000] (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 5000 BP. Also, by paying one cost, draw a card.
CB25-008.flavor: Quess' custom unit. The shape of its head and the coloring of the unit is different from that of Gyunei's.

BS13-012.name: Jainagant
BS13-012.effect:
[Immortality: Cost 7/8] (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this Spirit card from the Trash when your Cost 7/8 Spirit is destroyed.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
Send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Trash.
BS13-012.flavor:
The dancing mad magician surrenders its body to the burning flames, guiding the targeted soul to a pitch-black hell far darker than the forest abyss.
—from the Serpens chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BSC49-014.name: Jainagant LT
BSC49-014.effect:
[Immortality: Cost 3/5/7] (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this card from the Trash when your Cost 3/5/7 Spirit is destroyed.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Trash, and draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit with "Immortality"-named effect attacks, you can activate one of this Spirit's (When Destroyed) effects without destroying it.
BSC49-014.flavor:
The dancing mad magician surrenders its body to the burning flames, guiding the targeted soul to a pitch-black hell far darker than the forest abyss.
—from the Serpens chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BSC31-014.name: Jakomina Kit
BSC31-014.kanji: ジャコミーナ・キット
BSC31-014.effect:
[teams: Absolutes Sacred Swords]

[LV1][LV2] [On Stage] (Your Attack Step)
Instead of attacking with this Spirit, by returning this Spirit to the deckbottom, summon a "Stage Style" family "Jakomina Kit" from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost, and draw a card.
BSC31-014.flavor: To think that...munch munch...you can please me...munch munch...by buying me donuts...munch munch...is nonsense~ Munch munch...Hey, you got another one?

BS41-084.name: Jurassic Spear
BS41-084.effect:
This Magic card in Trash is unaffected by all effects.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with two or more symbols. Effects of the Spirit/Ultimate destroyed by this effect can't activate. After this effect resolves, you can add up to two "Terra Dragon" family Spirit cards from your Hand as pre-Advent cards to beneath one of your "Terra Dragon" family Spirits with [Advent].

BS45-086.name: Isis' Power
BS45-086.effect:
When this card was revealed from the deck, or sent to the Trash from the deck by your Yellow effect, you can add it to the Hand. When added from the Trash to your Hand by this effect, put one core from the Void to any of your Yellow-only Grandwalker Nexus.

[Flash]
Draw one card. Then, you can summon a Cost 6 or less "EgytianAngelia"-named Spirit/Ultimate card from your Hand by paying one cost.

CB23-050.name: Just Don't Get on an EVA, Please
CB23-050.kanji: エヴァにだけは乗らんでくださいよ
CB23-050.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Red Core][Red Core])]
[During Set] (When Set)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can return a "Pilot" family card from your Trash to the Hand.

[Flash]
Separate all Braves from an opposing Brave Spirit. However, the opponent decides how to move the cores during the separation. When you've done so, draw a card.

BS69-011.name: Island Geotortoise
BS69-011.kanji: アイランド・ジオトータス
BS69-011.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Red Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Primordial" family Spirits gain +5000 BP.

[During Set] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By destroying one of your "Primordial" family Nexuses, pay one cost to summon this Mirage. When you've done so, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.
BS69-011.flavor:
Would you mind handing back the control of Olym's lands to me, Demeter?
―Grandwalker Gaia―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5215.name: Jakonezu
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5215.flavor:
Whatever the outcome of the battle is, I cannot let the forest not be saved. After passing on the blade, we will take the last secret mission the Elder gave us, to "Let the oldest tree in this forest eat the fruit of the World Tree." "A tree eating fruit?" I said with my head tilted, as a large tree passed by my side. I see, that's how it is.
-from the 10th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS64-088.name: Just as Calculated
BS64-088.kanji: ジャスト・アズ・カリキュレイテッド
BS64-088.effect:
[Main]
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "The PartnerCat Fermat", your counter +1. Then, either draw a card, or summon a Cost 1~5 "Golden Cloud" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[Flash]
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit/Ultimate -3000 BP, and return it to the Hand when its BP reaches 0.

BS22-033.name: Jakou-Cat
BS22-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.
[Rush: Purple]
(While you have a Purple symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Purple Core]: Draw a card.

[LV2]
Your Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.
BS22-033.flavor: Wagging its shining tail, the beast showed us the path to safety. When it waves vertically, it's a signal of impending danger; it was quite easy to understand.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5218.name: Justice Burst
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5218.kanji: ジャスティスバースト
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5218.effect:
This card can only be used by a card battler acknowledged by "Justice."

☼<nowiki>[ </nowiki>Burst: After Your Life is Decreased<nowiki> ]</nowiki>
When your life is 1, you may summon as many spirit and brave cards as you like from your hand. After that, by paying the cost, you can activate this card's flash effect.

Flash - When your life is 1, you can add cores from the void to make it 5.

BS11-049.name: Jambi-Olepis
BS11-049.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
During this turn, every opposing Spirit is treated as not having [Armor] and they can't gain new ones.

[When Braved] Flash - [Awaken]
You can put any number of cores from Spirits you control to this Spirit.
BS11-049.flavor:
I met the Brave Fused Sun Dragon at the Dragon's Nest. He was quite terrifying, but he was also super cool!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS53-035.name: Jammer Owl
BS53-035.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The opponent can't use reduction symbols when summoning Cost 3 or less Spirit cards.

[LV2]
When your pre-Rebirth Spirit/pre-Rebirth Nexus is reborn, put a core from the Void to your Reserve. This effect can only be used once per turn.
BS53-035.flavor:
Now that we couldn't return to the lab, I tried to think about other safe places to go, and only one such place came to my mind: the White World that Alex created. I could only hope that it would be an unknown place to those beings.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 2:18―

26RDB01-001.name: Jane Bow
26RDB01-001.effect:
[team: Red Stella]

[LV2] During Attack
If you control two or more exhausted [Red Stella] Spirits, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.
26RDB01-001.flavor:
I've been invited to join an amazing team~ Muusha doesn't seem to realise it, but this is actually a really big deal~ Oh dear...I wonder if I'll really be able to keep up with this team...
Muusha "Jane-chan, smile! Don't forget about that!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5222.name: Jangohebi
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5222.effect: [LV2][LV3] Curse (When Attacks) Destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked when the battle resolves at the end of battle.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5222.flavor:
The snake predicted that disaster would fall upon this country.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, Second Day of the Second Month-

SD52-X01-A5223.name: Justice Gundam
SD52-X01-A5223.kanji: ジャスティスガンダム
SD52-X01-A5223.effect:
Flash - [Advent: White & Cost 5 or more] ((Your Turn))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Cost 7 or less
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Cost 7 or less effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return the opposing blocking Spirit to the deckbottom. Then, once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.

They walk the streets of Davao Air Base, following the reports of illegal residents, and fire warning shots. From the view point of Davao's residents, Man Hunter's tyranny is exactly what they hope Mafty could defeat.

CB13-008.kanji: ジェガン［エコーズ仕様 コンロイ機］

Because of that serious problem, Lord sparked a chivalrous spirit inside of us and we came to Wind Shield. The travelers carried conspicuous military equipment, motivated by the hints of animosity in neighboring countries.

Together with my division, I took a detour in the skies, and we were engaging the enemy from the rear. Having sandwiched and divided the enemy forces from the front and the back, we rallied for an all-out barrage on the central troops. The Dragons in our advance guard crash into the enemy one after the other....
