You can reveal five cards from your decktop. Among them, add every "Birth"/"Cell Medal"-named card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2]
Once per turn, when any exactly-named "Cell Medal" is put on your Field, send a core from your Trash to this Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5316.flavor: A bio-powersuit developed mainly by Maki Kiyoto from the Kougami Biological Laboratory. By using Cell Medals it can transform and attack.

CB24-057.name: Kamen Rider Birth X
CB24-057.kanji: 仮面ライダー バースX
CB24-057.effect:
Flash- [Advent: Kamen & "Birth"] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Return any number of "Cell Medal" from your Field/Trash to the Hand, and for every three cards returned, ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
By discarding three "Medal" from your Hand, during this battle, this Spirit gains an extra Blue symbol.
CB24-057.flavor: The form that Shintaro Goto transforms into using "Birth Driver X" and the newly made Core Medals: Ebi, Kani, and Sasori.

CB17-053.name: Kamen Rider Birth［2］
CB17-053.effect:
[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]
For each card in the opposing Hand, ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By discarding a "Medal"-named card from your Hand/your Field, or destroying a "Medal"-named Nexus you control, refresh this Spirit.
CB17-053.flavor: After Akira Date stepped down from his brilliant career as the user, Shintaro Goto, inheriting his ideals and the Birth Driver, started his battle as the second Kamen Rider Birth.

CB24-CP01.name: Kamen Rider Black Sun
CB24-CP01.effect:
This card/Spirit gains the “Showa” family.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned/Advent) effect resolves]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit. Then, you can return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your “Kamen” family Spirit is attacking, besides [Soul Core], the opponent can't move cores from their Spirits/Grandwalker Nexuses.
CB24-CP01.flavor: The rider that Kotaro Minami transforms into. Born on the day of the solar eclipse, he was altered to become a candidate for the Creation King.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5320.name: Kamen Rider Blade
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5320.kanji: 仮面ライダーブレイド
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5320.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Magician" family card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -4000 BP, and destroy it when it is brought to 0 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5320.flavor: The second Rider System developed by BOARD. Kenzaki Kazuma, who was scouted by BOARD, transforms by donning the powered suit Blade Armor.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5321.name: Kamen Rider Blade Jack Form
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5321.kanji: 仮面ライダーブレイド ジャックフォーム
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5321.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 5 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -10000 BP. When this effect brought its BP to 0, destroy it, and you can activate one of the (When Summoned) effects written on that Spirit as this card's [Change] effect. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace one of your Cost 6 or less "Kamen" family Spirits with this card in refreshed condition. If the Spirit is currently battling, continue the battle.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Opposing LV2/LV3 Spirits can't block.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5321.flavor: A powered-up form obtained from using the Rouze Absorber to harness the power of the J and Q of Spade.

CB31-017.name: Kamen Rider Blade Jack Form ［3］
CB31-017.kanji: 仮面ライダーブレイド ジャックフォーム ［3］
CB31-017.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Kamen Rider Blade", (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
You can put a "Kamen" family card from your Hand onto your Removed Zone. When you've done so, draw a card.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -5000 BP, and return it to the deckbottom when it is brought to 0 BP.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5323.name: Kamen Rider Blade Jack Form［2］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5323.kanji: 仮面ライダーブレイド ジャックフォーム［2］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5323.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
Either discard this card or replace one of your Cost 6 or less "Kamen" family Spirits with this card in refreshed condition. If the Spirit is currently battling, continue the battle.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Put a "Magician" family card from your Trash face-up onto the Removed Zone.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5323.flavor: = By stretching the orichalcum wings formed on its back, it can take flight at a speed of 300 km/h, while its punch power and kick power are also increased.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5324.name: Kamen Rider Blade King Form
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5324.kanji: 仮面ライダーブレイド キングフォーム
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5324.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Yellow & Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Put up to five "Magician" family cards from your Hand/Trash face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
You can discard a card from your Removed Zone. When you've done so, this Spirit refreshes, and, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -13000 BP. Then, destroy all opposing 0 BP Spirits.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5324.flavor: A powered up form obtained from gaining the powers of the Spade Q and the Spade K.

CB31-X04.name: Kamen Rider Blade King Form ［3］
CB31-X04.kanji: 仮面ライダーブレイド キングフォーム ［3］
CB31-X04.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Kamen Rider Blade" & C6 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
During this turn, you can give up to two opposing Spirits/Ultimates -20000 BP, and return them to the deckbottom when they reach 0 BP.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
For every four counters you have, this Spirit gains an extra Yellow symbol. Also, when this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, by discarding two cards from your Removed Zone, it remains on the Field, exhausted.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5326.name: Kamen Rider Blade King Form［2］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5326.kanji: 仮面ライダーブレイド キングフォーム ［2］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5326.effect:
During either Attack Step, for each card in your Removed Zone, the [Change] cost of this card in Hand gets -2. (Max. -12)

Flash - [Change: Cost 13]
During this turn, give every opposing Spirit/Ultimate -20000 BP. Return them to the deckbottom in any order when this effect brought their BP to 0. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace a "Kamen" & "Magician" family Spirit you control with this card in refreshed condition. If the Spirit is currently battling, continue the battle.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5326.flavor: He battled the Undead using the Heavy Rousing Sword Kingrouser and his finishing moves, such as Royal Straight Flush.

CB17-011.name: Kamen Rider Blades King Lion Daisenki (Lion Mode)
CB17-011.kanji: 仮面ライダーブレイズ キングライオン大戦記（ライオンモード）
CB17-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing braved Brave. After this effect resolves, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.

[During Brave] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, for each "Fencer"/"Exalted Sword" family card, send an opposing Life to the Reserve. Discard the revealed cards.
CB17-011.flavor: The form Kamen Rider Blades King Lion Daisenki transformed into in response to the operation of King Lion Daisenki Wonder Ride Book.

CB15-062.name: Kamen Rider Blades Lion Senki
CB15-062.kanji: 仮面ライダーブレイズ  ライオン戦記
CB15-062.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card, then discard a card from your Hand. If the discarded card is a "Kamen" family card, destroy an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
CB15-062.flavor: The form Rintaro Shindo transformed into using the Seiken Swordriver and Lion Senki Wonder Ride Book. It is equipped with Suiseiken Nagare.

CB17-002.name: Kamen Rider Blades Lion Senki［2］
CB17-002.kanji: 仮面ライダーブレイズ ライオン戦記 [2]
CB17-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Fencer"/"Exalted Sword" family card, except an exactly-named "Kamen Rider Blades Lion Senki", to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.
CB17-002.flavor: The base form of Kamen Rider Blades. Using the Holy Sword of Water, it fights with soft and flexible techniques like flowing streams.

CB20-007.name: Kamen Rider Blades Tategami Hyoujuusenki
CB20-007.kanji: 仮面ライダーブレイズ タテガミ氷獣戦記
CB20-007.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Nexus's (When Summoned/Deployed) effect resolves]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. For each “Exalted Sword” family Brave card among them, during this turn, an opposing Spirit can't attack. Discard the revealed cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can return a “Kamen” family “Saber”/“Blades”/“Espada”-named card from your Trash to the Hand.
CB20-007.flavor: The form Rintaro Shindo transforms into using the Seiken Swordriver and Tategami Hyoujuusenki Wonder Ride Book.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5331.name: Kamen Rider Blade［2］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5331.kanji: 仮面ライダーブレイド［2］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5331.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can put a "Magician" family Spirit card from your Hand onto the Removed Zone. When you've done so, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Ignoring the levels, you can activate one (When Attacks) effect of a "Magician" family Spirit card on your Removed Zone as this Spirit's effect.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5331.flavor: Due to Kenzaki's incredibly high fusion coeffiency, the Rider System's Power and Speed can be brought to a high level.

PB42-012.name: Kamen Rider Decade Complete Form 21
PB42-012.kanji: 仮面ライダーディケイド コンプリートフォーム21
PB42-012.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your Cost 7 or more "Kamen" family Spirit [advents], you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
By destroying an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's, draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can summon a "Kamen" family card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
PB42-012.flavor: Kamen Rider Decade's transformed form obtained using K-Touch21.

CB30-010.name: Kamen Rider Brain
CB30-010.effect:
When your Spirit is blocked, you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy any number of Spirits you and the opponent controls, up to a total of 20000 BP, and the effects of the destroyed opposing Spirits can't activate.

[LV2][LV3]
When your Spirits, or opposing Spirits are destroyed by your "Kamen"/"Enemy" family Spirits, send five cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void.
CB30-010.flavor: The form that the recovering Brain assumes using the Brain Driver when he wandered into a world that is on the boundary of reality.

CB04-X03.name: Kamen Rider Decade Violent Emotion
CB04-X03.kanji: 仮面ライダーディケイド 激情態
CB04-X03.effect:
[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]
Send three cores from an opposing Spirit to their Reserve. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV3] Flash - (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can use the [Change] of s Spirit card from your Hand without paying the cost. When you've done so, instead of switching the card onto the field, summon it without paying the cost.
CB04-X03.flavor: The dimension warrior Kadoya Tsukasa transformed into after accepting his role as a terminator that destroys everything.

CB24-X01.name: Kamen Rider Drive Type Tridoron
CB24-X01.kanji: 仮面ライダードライブ タイプトライドロン
CB24-X01.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your Spirit braved to an exactly-named "Tridoron" would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Ultra Clash] (When Attacks)
Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit is blocked, this Spirit refreshes. When the opposing battling Spirit is depleted/destroyed, send two opposing Lives to the Reserve.
CB24-X01.flavor: The strongest form born from fusing Mr. Belt's consciousness data and completing the revival.

SD42-CP08.name: Kamen Rider Build RabbitTank Form
SD42-CP08.kanji: 仮面ライダービルド ラビットタンクフォーム
SD42-CP08.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 3 ([Red Core][Blue Core])]
Destroy an opposing braved Brave.
After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace it with a Cost 6 or less "Kamen" family Spirit you control in refreshed state.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a "Kamen" family Spirit card among them to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards.
SD42-CP08.flavor: This is the form that Sento Kiryuu can transform into using the Build Driver, the Rabbit fullbottle and the Tank fullbottle.

CB30-008.name: Kamen Rider Drive Type Tridoron ［2］
CB30-008.kanji: 仮面ライダードライブ タイプトライドロン [2]
CB30-008.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Kamen & Roaring Azure & Cost 5 or more] ((Your Turn))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP. Also, when the opponent would use cards from their Hand during Flash Timing, unless they send a Life to the Trash, they can't use it.

[LV2][LV3] [Ultra Clash] (When Attacks)
Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.
CB30-008.flavor: The strongest form of Kamen Rider Drive. It is a form where Shinnosuke, Belt-san, and Tridoron become one, and a form that can be fully controlled by not only Shinnosuke, but also Belt-san.

P17-24.name: Kamen Rider Build RabbitTank Form ［2］
P17-24.kanji: 仮面ライダービルド ラビットタンクフォーム［2］
P17-24.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 3 ([Red Core][Blue Core])]
During this battle, your attacking Spirit gains +2000 BP. After this effect resolves, either discard this card, or replace one of your Cost 6 or less "Kamen" family Spirits with this card in refreshed state. If it was in battle, the battle continues.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.
P17-24.flavor: One of Kamen Rider Build's Best Matches and his most basic form. Nicknamed "The Steel Moonsault."

CB10-038.name: Kamen Rider Deep Specter
CB10-038.kanji: 仮面ライダーディープスペクター
CB10-038.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Purple & Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit. When this effect destroys, draw a card.

[During Advent] [LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit depletes/destroys any opposing Spirits, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
CB10-038.flavor: Fukami Makoto's form when transforming using the Ghost Driver and the Deep Specter Ghost Eyecon.

CB30-031.name: Kamen Rider Exceed Gills
CB30-031.kanji: 仮面ライダーエクシードギルス
CB30-031.effect:
This card/Spirit's reduction symbol and symbol are also treated as Red.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates. Then, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Kamen" family Spirit/Nexus, return up to two opposing exhausted Spirits/Ultimates to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit. Then, once per turn, if you have eight counters or more, this Spirit can refresh.
CB30-031.flavor: Kamen Rider Gills' new form after obtaining a power equivalent to Agito's.

CB06-001.name: Kamen Rider Faiz
CB06-001.kanji: 仮面ライダーファイズ
CB06-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a "Faiz"/"Kaixa"/"Delta"/"Orphenoch"-named Spirit card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Purple.
CB06-001.flavor: A warrior adorning the special reinforcment suit which uses the Faiz Gear. Only the Orphenoch can become Faiz.

CB06-005.name: Kamen Rider Faiz Accel Form
CB06-005.kanji: 仮面ライダーファイズ アクセルフォーム

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy two opposing Spirits/Ultimates with one symbol. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's. When this effect destroys, draw a card.
CB06-005.flavor: Kamen Rider Faiz' reinforced acceleration form after using the Faiz Accel.

CB06-011.name: Kamen Rider Delta
CB06-011.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 4 ([Red Core][Purple Core])]
Treat this card's color as colorless, and destroy an opposing Brave. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace one of your "Kamen"/"Infernal Lord" family Spirits with this card in refreshed condition. If the Spirit is currently battling, continue the battle.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit.
CB06-011.flavor: A warrior donning the power suit which uses the Delta Gear. It was the first one to be released, in a set of 3.

CB06-010.name: Kamen Rider Faiz Accel Form ［2］
CB06-010.kanji: 仮面ライダーファイズ アクセルフォーム [2]
CB06-010.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 4 ([Red Core][Purple Core])]
Destroy any amount of opposing Spirits up to a total of 7000 BP. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace one of your "Faiz"/"Wolf Orphnoch"/"Horse Orphnoch"-named Spirits with this card in refreshed condition. If the Spirit is currently battling, continue the battle.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
By paying one cost, this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing 20000 BP or less Spirits. When you've done so, at the end of battle, this Spirit returns to your Hand.
CB06-010.flavor: Activating Accel Mode unlocks power and speed which greatly surpasses usual levels, but after 35 seconds a cooldown period is necessary.

CB34-002.name: Kamen Rider Delta ［3］
CB34-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can discard any number of cards from your Hand. For each card discarded, send two cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void. After this effect resolves, (Once per Turn: Same Name) if you control any "Faiz", including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, you can draw until your Hand is three.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, by discarding a card from your Hand, send two cores from one single opposing Spirit to the Reserve.
CB34-002.flavor: The form of those who wore the first battle-use special suit developed by Smart Brain. It has less equipment when compared to Faiz and Kaixa, but has a higher spec when compared to the two.

CB34-006.name: Kamen Rider Faiz Accel Form ［4］
CB34-006.kanji: 仮面ライダーファイズ アクセルフォーム ［4］
CB34-006.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Faiz"/"Orphnoch", (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit. By discarding a card from your Hand, increase the limit of this "BP Destruction Effect" by +5000.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw two cards.

CB06-014.name: Kamen Rider Build RabbitTank Form ［3］
CB06-014.kanji: 仮面ライダービルド ラビットタンクフォーム ［3］
CB06-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add one of each "Build"/"Cross-Z"/"Grease"/"Rogue"-named Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When you're using [Change], this Spirit's symbol becomes two Red symbols and two Blue symbols.
CB06-014.flavor: He uses the transforming weapon Drill Crusher, which can change into Blade Mode and Gun Mode.

CB34-009.name: Kamen Rider Faiz Accel Form ［5］
CB34-009.kanji: 仮面ライダーファイズ アクセルフォーム ［5］
CB34-009.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Faiz"/"Orphnoch" & C1 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
By discarding a card from your Hand, draw two cards.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By sending the [Soul Core] from your Trash to this Spirit, this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Spirits with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5349.name: Kamen Rider Delta［2］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5349.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 6 ([Red Core][Red Core][Purple Core][Purple Core])]
Treat this card's color as colorless, and destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace one of your "Kamen"/"Infernal Lord" family Spirits with this card in refreshed condition.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with two or less cores on it.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5349.flavor: Many humans and many Orphnochs used it, but, ultimately, the one to take this form the most was Mihara Shuji.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5350.name: Kamen Rider Faiz Accel Form［3］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5350.kanji: 仮面ライダーファイズ アクセルフォーム ［3］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5350.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 5 ([Red Core][Red Core][Purple Core])]
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. The effects of a Spirit/Ulimate destroyed by this effect can't activate. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace one of your Cost 6 or less "Kamen"/"Infernal Lord" family Spirits with this card in refreshed condition.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of the battle, once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5350.flavor: Kamen Rider Faiz's speed form. Other than its proper wielder, Takumi Inui, it was also used by Kiba Yuji.

CB24-019.name: Kamen Rider Demons Spider Genome
CB24-019.kanji: 仮面ライダーデモンズ スパイダーゲノム
CB24-019.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
By sending a core from your Life to the Void, draw two cards. You can't activate Burst effects/[Rebirth] via this effect.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit effects.
CB24-019.flavor: The form that Hiromi Kadota transforms into using the Demons Driver and Spider Vistamp.

CB04-045.name: Kamen Rider Den-O Ax Form
CB04-045.kanji: 仮面ライダー電王 アックスフォーム
CB04-045.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core])]
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace a Cost 6 or less "Kamen" family Spirit you control in refreshed state.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block while exhausted.

[LV2][LV3] [Heavy Armor: Red/Green/White]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Green/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
CB04-045.flavor: The form of Kamen Rider Den-O when possessed by Kintaros. It has outstanding power.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5353.name: Kamen Rider Faiz Blaster Form
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5353.kanji: 仮面ライダーファイズ ブラスターフォーム

When you would [Advent] an "Ex-Aid"-named card, you can treat this Spirit as Cost 7.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5507.name: Kamen Rider Ex-Aid Double Action Gamer Level X

CB30-056.name: Kamen Rider Ultimate Revi ［2］
CB30-056.kanji: 仮面ライダーアルティメットリバイ [2]
CB30-056.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per turn: Same Name) Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 8 or less Spirit. For each two Spirits you control, increase the number of targets by +1.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't use any cards outside of Flash Timing.
CB30-056.flavor: Kamen Rider Revi's final form. By linking with the Revice Driver equipped by his buddy, Kamen Rider Ultimate Vice, the ultimate Revice system is completed.

CB10-054.name: Kamen Rider Scissors
CB10-054.kanji: 仮面ライダーシザース
CB10-054.effect:
This card's/Spirit's symbol and reduction symbols are also treated as Red.

[LV1][LV2] [Heavy Armor: Red/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2]
Your Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.
CB10-054.flavor: One of the thirteen riders that fights within the Mirror World, Sudou Masashi's transformation. He specializes in consecutive attacks through Scissors Pinch and Scissors Visor.

CB24-X03.name: Kamen Rider Ultimate Vice
CB24-X03.kanji: 仮面ライダーアルティメットバイス
CB24-X03.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Demon Contract & C6 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

You can put any number of copies of this card in deck.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Discard up to five cards from your decktop. Then, summon any number of "Ultimate Revi"/"Ultimate Vice" from your Hand/Trash without paying the cost.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
For each Spirit you control, send two cores from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve.

26RCB01-025.name: Kamen Rider Scissors (26RCB01-025)
26RCB01-025.kanji: 仮面ライダーシザース
26RCB01-025.effect:
[LV1-2]When Destroyed
Target one of your Spirits. During this turn, give it +2000 BP.
26RCB01-025.flavor: The form that Sudou Masashi transforms into using V Buckle and Card Deck (Scissors).

CB30-027.name: Kamen Rider Ultimate Vice ［2］
CB30-027.kanji: 仮面ライダーアルティメットバイス ［2］
CB30-027.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Demon Contract & C7 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) For each Spirit you control, during this turn, an opposing Spirit/Nexus' LV cost increases by +1.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, you can summon a "Revi" from your Trash, without paying the cost.

CB24-CP02.name: Kamen Rider Shadowmoon
CB24-CP02.effect:
This card/Spirit gains the “Showa” family.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Send two cores each from every opposing Spirit to the Reserve, and for each Spirit depleted, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your “Kamen”/"Enemy" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.
CB24-CP02.flavor: The rider that Nobuhiko Akizuki transforms into. Born at the same time, another candidate for becoming the Creation King.

CB24-030.name: Kamen Rider Vail
CB24-030.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with three cores or less on it, and when destroys, draw a card.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an "Enemy" family Spirit you control. When you've done so, the opponent destroys a Spirit they control.
CB24-030.flavor: The form that Genta Igarashi transforms into using the Vail Driver and Kabuto Vistamp.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5853.name: Kamen Rider Sigurd Cherry Energy Arms
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5853.kanji: 仮面ライダーシグルド チェリーエナジーアームズ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5853.effect:
This card's/Spirit's symbol and reduction symbols are also treated as Yellow.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void each to every "Kamen" family Spirit you control. This effect can only be used once per game.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Spirits with equal or inferior amount of core on them than this Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5853.flavor: Sid's form when using the Sengoku Driver and the Cherry Energy Lockseed to transform.

PB42-006.name: Kamen Rider Valen Chocodon Form
PB42-006.kanji: 仮面ライダーヴァレン チョコドンフォーム
PB42-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Gavv" Nexus card, and a "Confection" family card, besides any "Chocodon Form", to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Purple.
PB42-006.flavor: The form that Hanto Karakida transforms into by inserting Chocodon Gochizo into the henshin device & weapon, Valenbuster.

26RCB01-006.name: Kamen Rider Sigurd Cherry Energy Arms (26RCB01-006)
26RCB01-006.kanji: 仮面ライダーシグルド チェリーエナジーアームズ
26RCB01-006.flavor: Sid's form when using the Sengoku Driver and the Cherry Energy Lockseed to transform.

PB42-007.name: Kamen Rider Valen Frappe Custom
PB42-007.kanji: 仮面ライダーヴァレン フラッペカスタム
PB42-007.effect:
When your counter reduces and is four or more, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can send one core each from two opposing Spirits to the Reserve. Then, during this turn, you can give an opposing Spirit -12000 BP, and return it to the deckbottom when it is brought to 0 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can draw a card from the deckbottom.
PB42-007.flavor: The form that Hanto Karakida transforms into by inserting Frappeis Gochizo into the Vrastumgear.

CB15-029.name: Kamen Rider Sin Specter
CB15-029.kanji: 仮面ライダー シンスペクター
CB15-029.effect:
During your Main Step, by banishing seven Purple-only "Kamen"/ "Evil Shadow" family cards from your Trash, summon this card from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Treat this Spirit's color as colorless, and send three cores from any opposing Spirit(s) to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Treat this Spirit's color as colorless, and destroy an opposing Spirit with two cores or less on it.
CB15-029.flavor: The forms that Makoto Fukami trasnforms into using Ghost Driver and Sin Specter Ghost Eyecon. Acknowledging his seven sins, it is a form that born from his determination to live on bearing those sins.

CB34-038.name: Kamen Rider Valkyrie Justice Serval
CB34-038.kanji: 仮面ライダーバルキリー ジャスティスサーバル
CB34-038.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Also, if you have six counters or more, banish every card from the opposing Trash.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing exhausted Spirit. When you've done so, when the blocked Spirit is depleted/destroyed, put two cores from Void to any of your Spirits.
CB34-038.flavor: Yua Yaiba's transformed form obtained by inserting the Serval Tiger Zetsumerise Key into the AIMS Shot Riser.

CB04-034.name: Kamen Rider Skull
CB04-034.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this Spirit card from your Trash. In that case, the cost of this Spirit and the cores to be put on this Spirit must be paid or moved from your Reserve.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit to their Reserve. When this effect depletes any Spirit, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Purple.
CB04-034.flavor: The form Narumi Sokichi transformed into using the Lost Driver and Skull Memory. It uses the Skull Magnum as weapon to fight.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5860.name: Kamen Rider Valkyrie Lightning Hornet
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5860.kanji: 仮面ライダーバルキリー ライトニングホーネット
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5860.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 4 ([Green Core][Green Core])]
Exhaust any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total cost of 10. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace one of your Cost 6 or less "Kamen" family Spirits with this card in refreshed condition. If the Spirit is currently battling, continue the battle.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By returning an opposing exhausted Spirit to the Hand, this Spirit refreshes.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5860.flavor: A.I.M.S. technical advisor, Yua Yaiba's form when transforming using the AIMS Shot Riser and the Lightning Hornet Progrise Key.

CB15-034.name: Kamen Rider W CycloneJoker (CB15-034 (B))
CB15-034.kanji: 仮面ライダー W サイクロンジョーカー
CB15-034.effect:
[+0]

[LV1][LV2] (When Reborn/Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to your Hand, you can summon a "Xtreme"-named Spirit card from your Hand.
CB15-034.flavor: One of the transformed forms of Kamen Rider W. Having the speed of Cyclone and the combat power of Joker, it is a balanced form.

CB15-049.name: Kamen Rider Valkyrie Lightning Hornet［2］
CB15-049.kanji: 仮面ライダーバルキリー ライトニングホーネット［2］
CB15-049.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 4 ([Green Core][Green Core])]
By exhausting an opposing Spirit, put a core from the Void to your Reserve. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace one of your Cost 6 or less "Kamen" family Spirits with this card in refreshed condition.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Kamen" family Spirit attacks, the opponent can't block unless they exhaust a Spirit they control.
CB15-049.flavor: One of the transformed form of Kamen Rider Valkyrie. It specializes in kicking skills mixed with lightning bolts, and its hissatsu is Lightning Blast Fever.

CB31-013.name: Kamen Rider Skull ［3］
CB31-013.effect:
This set card can't be discarded by the opponent.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks]
Including being in Soul State, for each "Kamen" family Spirit you control, send a core from the opposing Field to the Reserve. This effect can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Heavy Armor]. Also, during this turn, the opponent can't add cores from the Void to their Nexuses/Reserve. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
CB31-013.flavor: The kamen rider that Sokichi Narumi transforms into. Taking in the power of Skull Memory, from its bones to its entire body, its body parts are greatly strengthened.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5864.name: Kamen Rider Valkyrie Rushing Cheetah
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5864.kanji: 仮面ライダーバルキリー ラッシングチーター
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5864.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, put a core from the Void to another "Kamen" family Spirit you control.

[LV1][LV2]
The number of cores on your "Kamen" family Spirits can't be brought to less than one by opposing effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5864.flavor: A.I.M.S. technical advisor, Yua Yaiba's form when transforming using the AIMS Shot Riser and the Rushing Cheetah Progrise Key.

CB15-044-A5865.name: Kamen Rider W CycloneJoker (CB15-044 (A))
CB15-044-A5865.kanji: 仮面ライダーW サイクロンジョーカー
CB15-044-A5865.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
If there is any "W"-named card in your Trash, you can summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit, and exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] [Zero Rebirth]
When this Spirit attacks/blocks, it can be flipped.
CB15-044-A5865.flavor: One of the basic forms of Kamen Rider W. It can handle close combat in high speed and launch attacks that wrapped in winds.

CB15-037.name: Kamen Rider Skull［2］
CB15-037.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can summon a "W"-named Spirit card from your Hand by paying one cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of that Spirit can't activate.

[LV2][LV3]
While this Spirit, or your Cost 4 or more "W"-named Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.
CB15-037.flavor: The Kamen Rider Sokichi Narumi transformed into. He transformed under the attack of Terror Dopant at the laboratory of Museum and nullified the attack by firing through Skull Magnum.

CB34-033.name: Kamen Rider Valkyrie Rushing Cheetah ［2］
CB34-033.kanji: 仮面ライダーバルキリー ラッシングチーター ［2］
CB34-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, put a core from the Void to your Trash.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. If you have six counters or more, instead, heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit.
CB34-033.flavor: The Kamen Rider that Yua Yaiba transforms into. It can move in high speed like a cheetah, and is good at disruption combat using leg techniques.

CB06-044.name: Kamen Rider W CycloneJoker ［2］
CB06-044.kanji: 仮面ライダーW サイクロンジョーカー ［2］
CB06-044.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve. Also, if the opposing Hand is five or more, put a core from the Void to your Trash.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
If it's the first attack of your Turn, this Spirit refreshes.
CB06-044.flavor: One of Kamen Rider W's forms, it has the speed-oriented "Wind Right-Half" and the CQC-oriented "Trump Card Left-Half" become one.

CB30-X05.name: Kamen Rider Valvarad
CB30-X05.kanji: 仮面ライダーヴァルバラド
CB30-X05.effect:
This set card can't be discarded by the opponent.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks]
Discard three cards from the opposing decktop, and destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a cost equal or inferior to the total cost of the discarded cards. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When this Spirit or your Brave Spirit attacks, put a core from the Void to that Spirit.
CB30-X05.flavor: The gachanko form of Supana Kurogane using the Machwheel and Daiohni Ride Chemy Cards in the Valvaradriver.

CB17-004.name: Kamen Rider Slash Hanselnuts and Gretel
CB17-004.kanji: 仮面ライダースラッシュ ヘンゼルナッツとグレーテル
CB17-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Besides an exactly-named "Kamen Rider Slash Hanselnuts and Gretel", you can return a "Fencer"/"Exalted Sword" family card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit. Or, destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit.
CB17-004.flavor: The form Tetsuo Daishinji transforms into using the Hanselnuts And Gretel Wonder Ride Book, and the Onjuuken Suzune. Using the Holy Sword of Sound, it fights with an unique style.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5871.name: Kamen Rider Snipe Hunter Shooting Gamer Level 5
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5871.kanji: 仮面ライダースナイプ ハンターシューティングゲーマー レベル5
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5871.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Give every "Ex-Aid"/"Brave"/"Snipe"/"Lazer"-named Spirit you control the effect: "Red/White This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/White Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects."

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit attacks, put a core from the Void to this Spirit, and this Spirit refreshes.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5871.flavor: Hanaya Taiga takes this form when transforming and leveling up after using Bang Bang Shooting and Drago Knight Hunter Z Gashats.

CB15-038.name: Kamen Rider W CycloneMetal
CB15-038.kanji: 仮面ライダーW サイクロンメタル
CB15-038.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The number of cores on all your "W"-named Spirits can't become less than one due to opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Heavy exhaust an opposing exhausted Spirit, and when heavy exhausts, send three cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexus(es) to the Void.
[heb]
CB15-038.flavor: One of the transformed forms of Kamen Rider W. While it is good at wielding the shaft wrapped with wind, it sacrifices the agility of Cyclone due to the heaviness of Metal.

CB34-052.name: Kamen Rider Valvarad Kurogane
CB34-052.kanji: 仮面ライダーヴァルバラド黒鋼
CB34-052.effect:
When your "Gotchard" attacks, if you have five counters or more, you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Draw two cards, then discard one card from your Hand. When this effect discards any "Chemy", destroy an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can brave with up to two "Chemy" Braves.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can summon/deploy a "Chemy" from your Trash.
CB34-052.flavor: The gachanko form of Supana Kurogane obtained by inserting Metal Machwheel and Metal Daiohni into the Valvaradriver Kurogane.

CB15-034-A5874.name: Kamen Rider W CycloneTrigger
CB15-034-A5874.kanji: 仮面ライダー W サイクロントリガー
CB15-034-A5874.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "W"/ "Accel"/ "Skull"-named card, and a "W"-named Rebirth card to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] [Zero Rebirth]
When an opposing Spirit is exhausted, you can flip this Spirit.
CB15-034-A5874.flavor: One of Kamen Rider W's forms. By shooting bullets wrapped with wind, it can fire at a very wide range.

CB15-045.name: Kamen Rider Verde
CB15-045.effect:
This card/Spirit's symbol and reduction symbols are also treated as Red.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your Cost 5 or more "Kamen" & "Mounted Warrior" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked.
CB15-045.flavor: One of the 13 Kamen Riders who fight in the Mirror World that Itsuro Takamizawa transforms into. With its abilities of mimicry, turning transparent and more, it fights with dirty and crafty tactics.

26RCB01-043.name: Kamen Rider Snipe Hunter Shooting Gamer Level 5 (Full Dragon)
26RCB01-043.kanji: 仮面ライダースナイプ ハンターシューティングゲーマー レベル5（フルドラゴン）
26RCB01-043.effect:
[LV1-2] [Level Up] When Attacks/Blocks
If this is the first attack/block of the turn, during this battle, this Spirit is treated as LV2.
26RCB01-043.flavor: Hanaya Taiga's form after transforming and leveling up when using the Gamer Driver, the Bang Bang Shooting Gashat, and the Drago Knight Hunter Z Gashat.

CB04-047.name: Kamen Rider W FangJoker
CB04-047.kanji: 仮面ライダーW ファングジョーカー
CB04-047.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 5 ([Green Core][Green Core])]
Return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace one of your Cost 6 or less "Kamen" family Spirits with this card in refreshed condition.

[LV1] (Your Attack Step)
This Spirit must attack if possible.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return every opposing exhausted Spirits to the Hand.
CB04-047.flavor: This is the form that Kamen Rider W can transform into using the Fang Memory and Joker Memory.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5878.name: Kamen Rider Snipe Shooting Gamer Level 1
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5878.kanji: 仮面ライダースナイプ シューティングゲーマー レベル1
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5878.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When switching this Spirit with a "Gamer"-named card's [Change], return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. When switching via the [Change] of a "Snipe"-named card, instead, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

[LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
By sending four cores from this Spirit to the Trash, return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5878.flavor: Hanaya Taiga's form when transforming using the Gamer Driver and the Bang Bang Shooting Gashat.

CB24-034.name: Kamen Rider Vice Barid Rex Genome
CB24-034.kanji: 仮面ライダーバイス バリッドレックスゲノム
CB24-034.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Demon Contract & C2 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Treat this Spirit's color as colorless. Also, your counter +1. Then, send two cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Kamen" & "Beast Head" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't use Magic cards/[Accel].

CB06-048.name: Kamen Rider Snipe Shooting Gamer Level 2
CB06-048.kanji: 仮面ライダースナイプ シューティングゲーマー レベル2
CB06-048.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to any of your "Ex-Aid"-named Spirit, or to your Trash.
CB06-048.flavor: Hanaya Taiga's form after transforming and leveling up when using the Gamer Driver and the Bang Bang Shooting Gashat.

CB31-011.name: Kamen Rider W FangJoker ［3］
CB31-011.kanji: 仮面ライダーW ファングジョーカー [3]
CB31-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can put one core from the Void each to this Spirit and another "Kamen Rider W"/"Kamen Rider Skull" Spirit you control. When you put two cores via this effect, your counter +1.

[LV2][LV3]
When your "Kamen Rider W" [Contract Advents], return an opposing exhausted Spirit to either the Hand or the deckbottom.
CB31-011.flavor: Kamen Rider W's form when using Fang Memory and Joker Memory. It is the only form that uses Philip's body as base, with Shotaro Hidari's consciousness transferred into Philip's body.

CB24-028.name: Kamen Rider Vice Rex Genome
CB24-028.kanji: 仮面ライダーバイス レックスゲノム
CB24-028.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Demon Contract, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1, and destroy an opposing Spirit with one core or less on it. Also, if you control any "Kamen Rider Revi", draw a card.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve, and when depletes, draw a card.

CB15-048.name: Kamen Rider W FangJoker［2］
CB15-048.kanji: 仮面ライダーW ファングジョーカー [2]
CB15-048.effect:
When your Green Nexus is destroyed by an opposing effect, you can summon this card from the Hand by paying one cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
The opponent discards one card from their Hand. Also, if there are two or more opposing Spirits, heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits.
[heb]

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.
CB15-048.flavor: The transformed form using Fang Memory and Joker Memory. When first transformed into this form, Philip couldn't resist the power of the Memory and went rampage.

PB42-004.name: Kamen Rider Vram A La Mode Mode
PB42-004.kanji: 仮面ライダーヴラム アラモードモード
PB42-004.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Kamen" & "Confection" family Spirits would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, during this turn, you can increase the LV cost of an opposing Spirit/Nexus by +2. Then, including being in Soul State, if you control any "Gavv", you can -1 your counter. When you've done so, you can return an opposing LV1 Spirit to the deckbottom.
PB42-004.flavor: The form that Rakia Amarga transforms into by inserting Puddinte Gochizo into Vrastumgear.

26RCB01-039.name: Kamen Rider Snipe Shooting Gamer Level 2 (26RCB01-039)
26RCB01-039.kanji: 仮面ライダースナイプ シューティングゲーマー レベル2
26RCB01-039.effect:
[LV1-2] [Level Up] When Attacks/Blocks
If this is the first attack/block of the turn, during this battle, this Spirit is treated as LV2.
26RCB01-039.flavor: Hanaya Taiga's form after transforming and leveling up when using the Gamer Driver and the Bang Bang Shooting Gashat.

PB42-001.name: Kamen Rider Vram Pudding Custom
PB42-001.kanji: 仮面ライダーヴラム プリンカスタム
PB42-001.effect:

Everyone in the investigation team is now dreadfully weary. While I've said it's fine to leave the rest to me and take a break, you've all gathered here. Lolo, Antrac, please look at us; Look at our final struggle!
―Nord's Note―

Olym's vanguard far surpassed Shiva's expectations.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 2:36―

(Once per turn, send one core from this Nexus to the Void) Draw a card. Then, discard a card from your Hand.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Beast Head" family Spirit/Ultimate attacks, you can destroy an opposing Cost 1 or less Spirit. For each Spirit card in the opposing Trash, this effect destroys +1 cost.

P16-05.name: Knight Swallow
P16-05.effect:
[During Seal] (Either Attack Step)
This Spirit card in your Hand is Cost 2.

Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.
P16-05.flavor: Fordelia Wings is ordered so that racer Gale-Phoenix is supported by four other racers.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6161.name: Kyubimon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6161.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
During this turn, you can give every opposing Spirit -5000 BP. Exhaust every Spirit whose BP is brought to 0 by this effect.

[LV2][LV3] [Warp Digivolve: Yellow] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Yellow "Ultimate" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6161.flavor:
[Champion. Mystic Beast. Data.]
A Mystic Beast Digimon which looks like a giant nine-tailed fox.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6162.name: Koto Furunushi
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6162.flavor:
Alex disappeared after that. No traces of her remained within Lolo, who had become one with her, when and where she vanished is unknown. Both Hindida's Brahma and me can't hide our dejection, as the queen whom we wanted to entrust the next generation to has disappeared. However, just like how she never gave up hope, perhaps we too will not give up either. I'll continue writing, and start a new record. So that when Alex comes back, I can talk to her and tell her of everything that has transpired. The Genesis Records end here, and a new history begins now.
ー"Genesis Records" Finー

BS70-025.name: Kyukondori
BS70-025.effect:
[LV1][LV2]

[LV2] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
Discard a random card from the opposing Hand.

Finished collecting information about the Contract Mediation Agency, Toa and her Contract Spirits searched for ways to travel to the Divine World. Picking Fenleaf's brain for ideas, they realized that a certain magic item kept at the Dominanerio Magic School might help. Having obtained the approval from Versroy the principal, Toa and her Contract Spirits departed for the Divine World using the Mirror of Teleportation.
―"Theogonic Record" Fragment―

BS24-027.name: Knighteagle
BS24-027.effect:

By placing one cards from your decktop onto the Field facedown and putting at least one core from the Reserve onto it, until the end of the game, it is treated as "Cost 0/"Bunshin" family/LV1: 1 core, 3000 BP/[Green Core]" Green Bunshin Spirits. Treat all your Bunshin Spirits' LV1 BP as 11000.
BS24-027.flavor: He cut the great tree to pieces!? Do his afterimages have mass?

BS16-015.name: Kotsugaizi
BS16-015.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw until your Hand has three cards.

[LV2] (When Destroyed)
Return a "Great General"/"Zombie" family Spirit card from your Trash to your Hand.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6166.name: Kathakali Dragon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6166.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)

[During Brave] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By putting two cards from your Hand facedown onto the Removed Zone, draw four cards.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6166.flavor:
An alliance was successfully formed with Egyt. The problem lied on how the other armies would act.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 1:41―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6167.name: Knocknmole
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6167.flavor:
I suppose it must have understood Master Lilia's words. Intense light emanated from the giant Mother Core, and made a new daytime for the world. It quickly lost its light, and looking up, the stars in the vault of heaven stirred. Suddenly I felt a warm light, and looked towards the east. It's the sun, the morning sun has risen! Master! The future where everyone can coexist is now here... the curtains have risen on the new world!!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS33-050.name: Kyuubi Fox
BS33-050.effect:

BS33-050.flavor: "Lord Bakelkatze, should we welcome the outsiders into the hidden village?"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6169.name: Kowdeen
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6169.effect:

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6169.flavor: It would be all right if it were just me. But against Lord, this self-serving situation is unforgivable! However... I can't let my personal feelings get in the way of negotiation.

PC10-003.name: L.L. Audun
PC10-003.effect:
When summoning this card from the Hand, if there is a total of 17 or more cards in your Trash and the opposing Trash, this card becomes Cost 5.

This Spirit can refresh.

BS10-110.name: Knockout
BS10-110.effect:
[Flash]
When the battle resolves, instead of BP, compare the costs, and the Spirit with a lower cost is destroyed. If the costs are the same, both players' Spirits are destroyed.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6172.name: Kramen
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6172.flavor:
A chaotic land crowded with strange creatures... it is called the Country of Deep Blue...
-The Murmurs of Rutile, First Day of the Twelfth Month-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6173.name: La-Diablord
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6173.effect:

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6173.flavor: Is their prowess in battle limitless? At this rate, not even the Alliance can stand a chance against them.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6174.kanji: クリシュナの月冠神殿

The God which supports the Trimurti, the Tri-deity of Hindida, loves the night and guards the slumber of his residents.

The decisive final battle. The first battle cry came from the Five-Nation Alliance.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of the Hero Kei, Year 647—

Brahma entrusts Alex to Krishna and lets her focus on recovering.

—Authentic History: Chronicles of the Hero Kei, Year 628—

Just like Hindida, Amahara has three deities. However, as the Supreme Deity has become a shut-in, the secondary Grandwalker is the one in charge, apparently.

Vishnu's army, unable to focus on the enemy right in front of them, was gradually being pushed into a dilemma.

Vishnu and Krishna's cooperation is perfect. Had the two not been together, certainly this battle would have ended in our loss already.

[LV1]
This Spirit can't attack.

[LV2]When Destroyed
Target an opposing 2000 BP or less Spirit. Destroy it.
26RBS03-001.flavor: With its tail resembling a fuse and its round shape, it is known as the "bouncing bomb".

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6188.name: Krishnaga-Iksath
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6188.kanji: クリシュナーガ・イクサト
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6188.effect:

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6188.flavor:
"Lord Vishnu, I've interacted with Alex. The details are on the data I'm sending you.
...My impressions? That there might be hope."

BS57-021.name: Lacombe
BS57-021.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Green Core][Green Core])]
[During Set]
Once per turn, when your Green-only Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, put a core from the Void to your Spirit/Reserve.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Yellow.
BS57-021.flavor:
"Polluc?! Are you really Polluc?" Alex's cry resounds in the air. So Alex knew who this blindfolded man is? But it seems that Alex is also in shock? Umm...I don't understand what is going on.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 6:01―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6190.name: Krishnaga-Pacaas
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6190.kanji: クリシュナーガ・パチャース
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6190.effect:

"Honey, spitting on wounds is all you have to do to heal them." Despite these words, Krishna's treatment was thorough and adequate.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 2:22―

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6192.name: Krishnaga-Rig-Ganna
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6192.kanji: クリシュナーガ・リグ・ガンナ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6192.effect:

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6192.flavor:
Krishna's absentminded and cheerful personality helped Alex's heart recover after being sent to a dark place by Zeus-Lolo's betrayal.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 2:23―

CBX01-012.name: Lacus Clyne ［C.E. 75］
CBX01-012.effect:

One copy of this card/Brave can brave to a Spirit you control that's braved to a "Kira Yamato", ignoring the number of Braves on it.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6194.name: Krishnaga-Sathr
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6194.kanji: クリシュナーガ・サトラェ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6194.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
For each three cards in the opposing Hand/Removed Zone combined, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] [Heavy Armor: Red/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6194.flavor:
On her conversation with Krishna while she was healed, Alex learned many things. For an example, that Hindida is administered by a council of three Supreme Deities equal in power.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 2:24―

CB29-076.name: Lacus Times Two
CB29-076.effect:
When this card is revealed or sent to the Trash from the deck via your "Orb" family effect, you can set it without paying the cost. When you do, return your originally set Mirage to the Hand.

[Mirage: Cost 6 ([White Core][White Core][White Core])]
[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
The [Grand Field] of every Cost 3 Grandwalker Nexus can't activate.

[Flash]
Return an opposing Nexus to the deckbottom.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6196.name: Krishnaga-Unhattar
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6196.kanji: クリシュナーガ・ウンハッタル
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6196.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Heavy Armor: Yellow/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Yellow/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced, exhaust an opposing Spirit.

Were Ares the only attacking them, perhaps they could have managed. However, lightning from an unknown location kept hitting Vishnu's vital points. Badly injured from Ares and the lightnings, Vishnu was at a loss, but Krishna became his shield and he successfully separated his world. Somehow, he managed to retreat.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 3:38―

P15-18.name: Lady Kejorou
P15-18.effect:
This Spirit card is also treated as a Magic card.

[Flash] (This effect can't be used while on the Field.)
During BP comparison, end the battle without comparing BP.

SD54-009.name: Kshatriya

Besides [Soul Core], put any amount of cores from your Trash to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
You can send one core from this Spirit to the Trash. When you've done so, destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.

SD54-009.flavor: The Sleeves' Psycommu System Mobile Suit. It fought constantly, being repaired and improved over and over.

CB13-004.name: Kshatriya Besserung
CB13-004.kanji: クシャトリヤ・ベッセルング
CB13-004.effect:
This card is also treated as being exactly-named "Kshatriya".

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return either a "Sleeves" family Spirit card, or a Red "Pilot" family Brave card from the Trash to your Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Zero Rebirth]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can flip it. When it is, you can put one core from your Field/Reserve to this now-Reborn Spirit.
CB13-004.flavor: A repaired version of the previously destroyed Kshatriya. Its pilot is Marida Cruz.

CB13-004-A6200.name: Kshatriya Repaired
CB13-004-A6200.kanji: クシャトリヤ・リペアード
CB13-004-A6200.effect:
[+0]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
Put any amount of cores from your Trash to any of your Red "MS" family Spirits.
