BS15-037.name: Kudagitsunen
BS15-037.flavor:
Having obliterated four Vanity Deities, when Manaka finally reached this country, it had been almost a year since the advent of the Deities. The domain was ruined beyond ruin, but in truth, it was not the same case at all for the mortal cost. The denizens all became mercenaries and scattered through the lands. It is difficult to understand, but they abandoned their country.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 643—

CB25-069.name: Kudelia & Atra
CB25-069.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Tekkadan) (Tekkadan & Brave)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit/Brave, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 5] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Send five cores from this Nexus to the Void) Return a "Tekkadan" family card from your Trash to the deckbottom, and refresh a "Tekkadan" family Spirit you control.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
(Can't Stack) When cards are discarded from your deck by a "Tekkadan" family effect, you can return a Purple card from your Trash to the deckbottom. When you've done so, you can draw a card.

CB02-016.name: LadyDevimon
CB02-016.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit. When you've done so, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your Spirits would leave the Field due to opposing effects, send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Trash.
CB02-016.flavor:
[Ultimate. Fallen Angel. Virus.]
A fallen angel Digimon in the form of a female with noble presence.

26RSD02-007.name: Lady Lamica
26RSD02-007.effect:
[LV1-2]When Summoned
If you control any exhausted "Bloodrouse" family Spirit, target an opposing Spirit. Send a core, besides [Soul Core], from it to the Reserve.

[LV2] True ReleaseDuring Attack
This Spirit gains +2000 BP.
26RSD02-007.flavor: There is no escaping that scythe. Nor would you want to.

SD22-002.name: Ladybird
SD22-002.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.
SD22-002.flavor:
He's sooo fast! He breaks the laws of speed!
He's sooo intense!
Flippin' skirts with no heed! Once he's caught he's in trouble for his punishment is doubled!

BSC39-013.name: Laeva Teen
BSC39-013.effect:
[team: Absolutes]

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your [Absolutes] Spirits are summoned by an effect, exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[LV2] [Show Up] {Stage Style & "Laeva Teen"}
By not attacking with this Spirit and returning it to the Hand, summon a target card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BSC39-013.flavor:
I am Laeva, the sword that protects Princess Ragnalia – in other words, her bodyguard. I've heard that there are unsavory beings in this idol industry. I must protect my princess from them.
Ragnalia "Laeva, thank you so much as always. But it'd be even better if you can help me meet with Noah earlier."

CB16-053.name: Lafter Frankland
CB16-053.kanji: ラフタ・フランクランド
CB16-053.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[During Brave] (Your Attack Step)
This unblocked Spirit can't be destroyed by the opponent.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, refresh another "Tekkadan"/"Teiwaz" family Spirit you control.

BS14-067.name: Lagian
BS14-067.effect:
[When Braved] Flash - [Awaken]
You can put any number of cores from Spirits you control to this Spirit.
BS14-067.flavor: At Lord's call, a single spirit dashes up to him... the- they Braved!?

26RDB01-046.name: Laika Ronsir
26RDB01-046.effect:
[team: Blue Beat]

[LV1-2]During Attack
For each [Blue Beat] Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
26RDB01-046.flavor:
Welcome to our stage. Blue Beat is a team where everyone competes to win first prize. If that works out for the best, I'm sure we'll put on a brilliant show.
Riolu "Laika-chan's vibe, feels a bit like Rio's. There is some sort of connection I feel between us."
Laura "Well then, I suppose that means I have a similar vibe too?"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6210.name: Laila April (Card)
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6210.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Song Bird) (Song Bird & Ultimate/Brave) (Core Charge via Summon/Advent only once per turn)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit/Ultimate/Brave, put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 1] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
(Send one core from this Nexus to the Void) During this battle, a "Song Bird" family Spirit/Ultimate you control can't be blocked by opposing LV2/LV3 Spirits.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
All opposing Spirits/Ultimates can't activate their effects, and are treated as "Yellow/Cost 0/"Pentan"-named/Family: Song Bird, Drifting Spirit/Level 1: 1 core, 1000 BP/[Yellow Core]" Spirits.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6211.name: Lailaps-Chaser
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6211.kanji: ライラプス・チェイサー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6211.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent) Return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom, and return this Spirit to your Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6211.flavor:
A machine hunt dog fated to capture whatever it hunts. Artemis was curious regarding what would happen if it faced someone fated to never be caught, so she consulted Hermes.
"Hmm, that sounds interesting. Let's find it out!"
It is said that Artemis actually didn't expect Hermes would really go for such a search.

BS53-066.name: Lakshmi's Muscle Temple
BS53-066.kanji: ラクシュミーの筋肉神殿
BS53-066.effect:
When this card would be sent to Trash by your exactly-named "Grandwalker Lakshmi"'s effect, instead of sending it to Trash, you can deploy it.

[LV1] [Rebirth3]
When your Cost 5 or more "WBS"-named Spirit/exactly-named "Grandwalker Lakshmi" attacks, you can flip this Nexus. When it is, you can send a core from your Field/Reserve to this now-Reborn Spirit.

[LV1]
All your "WBS"-named Spirits gain +3000 BP.
BS53-066.flavor:
The thing that supported the "Trimurti". And it is muscle.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 906―

26RSD09-001.name: Lalyre
26RSD09-001.effect:
[LV1-2]
While this Spirit has no [Soul Core] on it, it can't attack.
26RSD09-001.flavor: A new light has been kindled under Red Cloud. Though small and fleeting, its radiance holds the promise of countless possibilities.

26RBS02-023.name: Lamenting Larona
26RBS02-023.effect:
[LV1-2] [Shaman: Dark Puce & Cost 4 or less] When Summoned
You can target a Cost 4 or less "Dark Puce" family Spirit card in your Trash. Summon it.

[LV2]True ReleaseWhen Destroyed
You can activate this Spirit's [Shamanism].
26RBS02-023.flavor:
"Where is my husband…? And my children…? Where is my family…?" That lament brought back unpleasant memories.
―from the Foreigner's Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

26RBS01-101.name: Lamp Line
26RBS01-101.effect:
[LV1-2] When Destroyed by the Opponent
You can target up to two of your "Mineroid" family Spirits. Refresh them.

[LV2] Your Attack Step
All your Cost 6 or more "Mineroid" family Spirits gain +1000 BP.
26RBS01-101.flavor: There's not all bad in a desolate land. At least you can get a clear view.

BS66-024.name: Lampo & Thunder Edge
BS66-024.kanji: ランポ＆サンダーエッジ
BS66-024.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Jade Contract, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't activate Burst effects. Also, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Then, once per turn, while braved to "ContractBlade", this Spirit can refresh.

BS08-028.name: Lampsquid
BS08-028.flavor:
The Singing Diva, protected by her attendants, is inside the giant vessel together with the mysterious Machines. Outside the windows, countless Lampsquid float in the surrounding skies, shimmering like a sea of diamonds. It may feel like a strange, unbalanced contrast, but the setting is unexpectedly fitting. It's enough to make me forget that we'll be approaching the decisive battle soon...
-from the 10th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

26RSD10-007.name: Lamydoneus
26RSD10-007.effect:
[LV1-2]When Summoned
You can target an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit. Exhaust it.
26RSD10-007.flavor: Those who came from the bottom of the sea were a reassuring reinforcement, but it seems like one simply cannot bring oneself to leave one's rear in their hands.

26RBS03-055.name: Lamykin
26RBS03-055.effect:
[LV2]True Release
If all your Spirits are Cost 2/4/6/8 with the "Topaz" family, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.
26RBS03-055.flavor: The thunder frill can be used for intimidation, attack and defence.

BS55-038.name: LanRyou-Kuwagata
BS55-038.kanji: ランリョウ・クワガタ
BS55-038.effect:
This card in the Hand is unaffected by opposing effects, and when your Life is reduced, you can summon it as Cost 6. When you've done so, return an opposing exhausted battling Spirit to the deckbottom. Also, if your Life is reduced by an opposing effect, during this turn, your Life can't be reduced.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While this Spirit, or your Green “Rouse Emperor”/“Fierce King” family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.
BS55-038.flavor:
Let's follow Izanagi's kins!
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 4:20―

BS54-005.name: Lance Iguanas
BS54-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Ultimate.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.
BS54-005.flavor:
The Spirits protected by the Imagine defeated their enemies. At that instance, the world is bathed in light, and a split second after, the supposedly vanished ground has revived.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 3:17―

SD17-010.name: Lancemosaurus
SD17-010.flavor: We've finally discovered the location of the sword, and are heading to the underground caves of the Country of Crimson's biggest volcano. Along with a dinosaur escort, we are at once pushing our way towards our goal.

BS09-068.name: Land Mine
BS09-068.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy an opposing Spirit with [Awaken]/[Curse]/[High Speed]/[Brilliance]/[Crush]. If this Magic card was discarded from your deck by an opposing Spirit/Nexus/Magic effect, immediately activate this effect without paying the cost.

CB25-012.name: Landman Rodi
CB25-012.effect:
[LV1] (Your Attack Step)
The symbol of this Spirit's Brave is fixed as zero.

[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit, and draw a card.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can discard a card from your decktop, and if a "Tekkadan" family card is discarded, destroy an opposing Spirit with one core or less on it.
CB25-012.flavor: A mobile suit modified from Man Rodi for Earth use that was deployed to Tekkadan's Earth branch.

CB25-051.name: Lane Aim
CB25-051.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can pay one cost to summon a “Penelope” from your Hand. When you've done so, put two cores from the Void to your Reserve.

[During Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit, and put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6226.name: Lantern Ghost
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6226.flavor:
Meanwhile, someone came in contact with the Alex & Hindida camp. Amahara's Tsukuyomi had come.
ー"Genesis Records" New Volume 3:07ー

BS38-042.name: Lantern Lizard
BS38-042.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card. Then, discard a card from your Hand.

[LV1][LV2] [SSoul: Blue]
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains [Blue Core] (an extra Blue Symbol).
BS38-042.flavor: The Evil God made continuing the Malysia GP impossible. What will happen to this tournament, opening in the maelstrom of its attacks!?

BS63-061.name: Laplace Devil
BS63-061.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Number Contract, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, during this turn, you can give an opposing Spirit -6000 BP, and return it to the deckbottom when it is brought to 0 BP.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Your Turn)
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, while you control any “The PartnerCat Fermat”, all Magic cards in the opposing Hand/Removed Zone become Cost 6.

CB26-046.name: Lara Tchaikoskaya
CB26-046.kanji: ラーラ・チャイコスカヤ
CB26-046.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
You can draw a card from the deckbottom.

[LV2]
When you are summoning/deploying/using a "DRAGON KID"/"MAGICAL CAT"/"Kid's Amulet", fulfill one of its reduction symbols.
CB26-046.flavor: An active hero using the name, MAGICAL CAT. She forms buddies with DRAGON KID.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6230.name: Laser Gravitational Beam
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6230.effect:
[Flash]
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is used to pay the cost, also, refresh a "Ghidorah"-named Spirit you control.

BS56-073.name: Laser Volley
BS56-073.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Red Core][Red Core])]
[During Set] (When Set)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. Then, if you control any Red symbols, destroy an opposing Nexus.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Or, negate an opposing active White Magic/[Accel] effect, other than on-field effects.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6232.name: Laserpanda
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6232.flavor: Not many are brave enough to stand up to the dragons, so I want to support boys like him.

BSC24-048.name: Lava Beam
BSC24-048.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy every Nexus you control or the opponent controls. For each Nexus destroyed by this effect, destroy an opposing 8000 BP or less Spirit.

BS54-001.name: Lava Flying Fish
BS54-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When you are deploying a "Mega-Grandstone"-named Nexus card, this Spirit gains an extra Blue symbol.

[LV2]
All your Red Grandstone Nexuses gain an extra Red symbol.
BS54-001.flavor:
Things that are similar to the gem we saw in the "Blue World" may exist somewhere else as well. We should search around the lost areas of the various worlds. And first, we arrived at the "Red World". While the talisman shows no response for the moment, I wonder how things would go.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 3:14―

BS11-083.name: Lead Voice
BS11-083.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy every opposing Spirit with "can't be blocked" effects.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6236.name: Lead Wall
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6236.effect: (Flash) During this turn, all of your spirits can block the spirit with "Cannot be blocked" effect.

BS28-029.name: Leading-Orix
BS28-029.kanji: リーディング・オリックス
BS28-029.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [SSoul: White]
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains [White Core] (an extra White Symbol).

[LV2][LV3]
After your Attack Step ends, if you control no non-White Spirits/Ultimates/Nexuses, Draw Step occurs. This effect can only be used once per turn.
BS28-029.flavor: You're going to stand in the way of not only the search for the bonding point, but of us traveling too? What good it does to you?!

BS43-091.name: Leading Sieg
BS43-091.effect:
[Main]
Draw a card. Then, reveal six cards from your decktop. Among them, add one of each differently named "Sieg" Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

P14-36.name: Leaf-Pigeon
P14-36.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
When summoned during (Either Attack Step), put a core from the Void each to every "Galaxian" family Spirit you control.
P14-36.flavor:
Here I will write of the Eight Planetary Deities that reside with the eighty-eight constellations. They are divine constellations that eclipse even the Twelve Galaxian constellations.
—from the foreword of "Scrolls of Eight Planetary Deities" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS30-077.name: Leaf Bind
BS30-077.effect:
[Flash]
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When any Ultimate is exhausted by this effect, that Ultimate can't be refreshed in the next (Opposing Refresh Step).

P14-03.name: Leaf Blager
P14-03.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to any of your Ultimate.
[Rush: Red]
(While you have a Red symbol, the following effect activate next)
[Red Core]: Destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.
P14-03.flavor: Hey maaan! The Ultimates have some rude power, and that's something they're ready to glower, rah rah ra rowr! Check it out!

BS46-093.name: Leaf Hide Pass
BS46-093.effect:
[Flash]
Heavy exhaust three opposing Spirits/Ultimates. When you heavy exhaust via this effect, refresh a "Winged Beast" family Spirit/Ultimate you control.
[heb]

BS53-072.name: Leaf Jammer
BS53-072.effect:
When the opponent uses a Magic card in your Attack Step, before the effect activates, by paying the cost and discarding this card from your Hand, immediately negate that effect.

[Flash]
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

BSC16-018.name: Leafa-Sears
BSC16-018.effect:
[team: Absolutes]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [On Stage] (Your Attack Step)
Instead of attacking with this Spirit, by returning this Spirit to the deckbottom, summon a "Stage Style" family "Leafa-Sears" from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost, and draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, you can summon a "Private Wear" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BSC16-018.flavor: Hilda, come over here, Neena, don't dance! Agh, don't just move as you please~

BS76-064.name: Lotus Bow
BS76-064.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1, and reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Parvati", or a "Hunter Beast" family card with [Mani] to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[During Nexus Brave] [Contract Field]
This Nexus can't be destroyed by opposing effects. Also, this Nexus gains the "Hunter Beast" family.

26RBS01-027.name: Leben-Leichnam
26RBS01-027.effect:
[LV2] [Invoke: Main]
Destroy this Spirit ▶ Target a "Dark Puce" family Spirit card in your Trash. Return it to the Hand.
26RBS01-027.flavor: Multiple souls were placed within the empty body, and it began to walk once more.

BSC48-053.name: Light Wings Sword LT
BSC48-053.effect:
(Once per Game: Same Name) When your Cost 5 or more White Spirits/Ultimates are summoned, you can return this card from your Trash to the Hand.

[Flash]
During this turn, give one of your Spirits/Ultimates +5000 BP. Then, during this turn, that target can block while exhausted, and when it blocks, you can draw a card.

CB07-CP02.name: Lee Jianliang
CB07-CP02.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (White & Rookie/Champion/Ultimate/Mega)]
◆When you Summon/Advent a target Spirit, put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 2] [LV1][LV2] Flash -
(Send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) During this turn, give one Spirit you control +3000 BP. Then, if that Spirit has 10000 BP or more, once per turn per Spirit, refresh it.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
When one of your "MegaGargomon"-named Spirits would leave the Field due to the opponent, by sending three core from this Nexus to that Spirit, it remains on the Field, refreshed.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6249.name: Lightning Attack
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6249.kanji: ライトニングアタック
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6249.effect:
Flash - During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -3000 BP.
[Rush: Purple]
(While you have a Purple symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Purple Core]: Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit with 5000 BP or less.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6250.name: Lightning Aura
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6250.effect: (Flash Step)(Your Main Phase) Attacking spirits you control without Rage get +1000BP until end of turn and those with Rage get +3000BP until end of turn.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6251.name: Lou-Koutyu
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6251.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
By sending two cores from your Reserve to your Trash, the opponent can't activate their Bursts.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6251.flavor:
The search-and-destroy battle that occurred at Chounansaka was delayed beyond measure by a shower of arrows let loose from afar.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of the Hero Kei, Year 646—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6252.name: Lightning Blast
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6252.kanji: ライトニングブラスト
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6252.effect:
While your "Blade"-named Spirit is attacking, this card in Hand is Cost 3.

[Flash]
During this turn, give every opposing Spirit/Ultimate -6000 BP. If you have both Cost 5 and Cost 6 cards in your Removed Zone, instead, give every opposing Spirit/Ultimate -12000 BP. Spirits/Ultimates whose BP are brought to 0 by these effects are destroyed.

BSC28-058.name: Love Wins
BSC28-058.effect:
[Type: Song]

[Flash]
During this turn, give every opposing Spirit -3000 BP. Destroy any Spirit whose BP was brought to 0 by this effect. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) was used to pay the cost, instead, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -7000 BP. Destroy the Spirit when its BP is brought to 0 by this effect. Then, you can put this Magic card onto your Field.

CB16-X04.name: Legend Gundam
CB16-X04.effect:
This card in Hand/Removed Zone is unaffected by opposing effects, and you can summon it as Cost 5 during the Flash Timing of opposing Attack Step. When you've done so, return up to eight opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [VPSa: Cost 7 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 7 or less effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can return an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit/Nexus to the deckbottom.
CB16-X04.flavor: Aiming to erase the splendid result of mankind's dream and mankind's future, the unit piloted by Rey Za Burrel.

CB24-067.name: Lovekov
CB24-067.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Kamen Rider Jeanne"/"Igarashi Sakura" is summoned/deployed, you can return this card from the Trash to your Hand.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve. Also, while braved to an originally Cost 5 or more "Kamen Rider Jeanne", this Spirit gains an extra Purple symbol.
CB24-067.flavor: The demon that lives within Igarashi Sakura. It doesn't have any ability to fight and needs to be protected by the others.

PB33-006.name: Legend Tachibana ~And Thus Into Legend~
PB33-006.kanji: レジェンド立花 ～そして伝説へ～
PB33-006.effect:
This card can't be used unless by paying its original cost, and it is unaffected by all effects in Trash other than its own.

[Flash]
Destroy every opposing Spirit/Ultimate, and draw a card for each Spirit/Ultimate destroyed. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects, and the effects of the Spirits/Ultimates destroyed by this effect can't activate.
PB33-006.flavor: "Take a good look at the power of legend!"

CB06-029.name: Lovelica Bugster
CB06-029.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When this Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, it remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2] (Opposing Refresh Step)
Opposing Spirits that refreshed can't attack during this turn.
CB06-029.flavor: A Bugster which holds the data for the Dating Game "Tokimeki Crisis." Physical attacks are nullified, but weak against psychological attacks that hurt him.

CBX01-007.name: Lightning Buster Gundam
CBX01-007.kanji: ライトニングバスターガンダム
CBX01-007.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this card is revealed from deck by your "Compass" family effect, you can pay one cost to summon it.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Blocks)
You can return an opposing Nexus to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [VPSa: Cost 5 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 5 or less effects.

BSC23-020.name: Leiya Quattro
BSC23-020.effect:
[team: Twilight Gothic]

[LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By destroying this Spirit, summon a "Stage Style" family "Leiya Quattro" from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost.

[LV2]
When summoning a "Stage Style" family "Leiya Quattro" via this Spirit's effect, you can summon up to three Spirits.
BSC23-020.flavor:

BS65-081.kanji: マグネティックウォール
BS65-081.effect:
This card can't be used unless you control no Spirits & have 0 Spirit cards in your Trash.

[Flash]
Return an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the deckbottom. Then, you can discard a card from the opposing decktop. When any Spirit card/Ultimate card is discarded via this effect, when this battle ends, end the Attack Step.

26RSD09-002.name: Marugris
26RSD09-002.flavor: Though it had no wings and could not wield fire skillfully, Red Cloud accepted this Spirit nonetheless. It was won over by its single-minded devotion to the sky.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6430.name: Medium Phynx
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6430.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks) You can summon an "Imaginary Beast" family Spirit card from your Hand. When you've done so, if your field only has Yellow/God Symbols, draw a card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Turn) You can't make cores on this Spirit become 0.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Every opposing Spirit/Ultimate gets -3000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6430.flavor: A slightly more adult Small Phynx. Perhaps it calmed down as it aged, but it seems he doesn't go crazy calling friends over anymore. Are you happy with that, Medium Phynx?!

CB30-CP04.name: Masked Soul
CB30-CP04.effect:
When this card is revealed from your deck, or sent to the Trash via your "Kamen" family [Core Charge], you can add it to the Hand.

Unless there are two or more "Kamen" family cards in your Trash, if you don't discard a "Kamen" family card from your Hand, you can't use this card.

[Flash]
During this turn, your Life can only be reduced by one.
sets: April 2025 Rider Cup in Aichi Promo

SD47-002.name: Medjeowl
SD47-002.effect:
This card/Spirit gains the "Ten Crown"/"Winged Beast" families.

[LV1][LV2] [Seal: Mystery Seal] (When Summoned)
You can exchange one of your Life cores for [Soul Core] on your Reserve.

[Seal: During Seal] [LV1][LV2]
The number of cores on your "Winged Beast" family Spirits/Ultimates can't be brought to 0 by opposing effects.
SD47-002.flavor: Medjed exists everywhere. Nobody knows why is that. Sometimes as a bird, sometimes as a snake, sometimes as a robot. This being without a specific form or a name had unawarely been named Medjed.

BS67-067.name: MercurBlade-Teardrop
BS67-067.kanji: マーキュルブレード・ティアドロップ
BS67-067.effect:
[Excite: 5] (Can't Stack: [Excite: 5] ) When the opposing Life is reduced by your "Zero Contract" family Spirit, if you have five counters or more, you can return this card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1. Then, you can reveal two cards from your decktop. Switch any number of "Silver Zero" family cards among them with cards in your Hand. Discard the revealed cards.
BS67-067.flavor: A brave that ejects mercury with ultra high pressure, forming a blade that cuts through everything.

CB29-064.name: Meer Campbell
CB29-064.effect:
This card/Nexus is also treated as "Lacus Clyne".

[LV1][LV2]
(Can't Stack) Your “ZAFT” family "Deck-Revealing effects" reveal +1 card. Also, you can add a "Durandal" revealed by your "ZAFT" family effect to the Hand.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
All your "ZAFT" family Spirits gain +3000 BP, and can block while exhausted.
CB29-064.flavor: A substitute of Lacus prepared by Durandal when she has gone missing.

26RCB01-036.name: Magnugiga
26RCB01-036.effect:
[LV1-2]When Summoned
If you control any "Kamen Rider Zolda", target an opposing Spirit. Return it to the Hand.
26RCB01-036.flavor: A Mirror Monster resembling a buffalo. It has a heavy, mechanical appearance, and its body is extremely sturdy.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6436.name: Meerbat
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6436.effect:
Flash- (Either Attack Step) By discarding this Spirit card from your Hand, during this turn, target Spirit gains +2000 BP. This effect is treated as a Spirit effect.

Immortality: Cost 4 (Either Attack Step) - This Spirit card in your Trash can be summoned when your Cost 4 Spirit is destroyed.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6436.flavor: To be brutally honest, I don't like this country; they were the ones who betrayed me, after all. Yet still, I can't just sit silently and watch as the citizens fall unto oblivion. I decided to obey my teachings alone. Even though if Lord Dragon were here, I'd probably go with him....

CB30-073.name: Magnum Boost Grand Victory
CB30-073.kanji: マグナムブーストグランドビクトリー
CB30-073.effect:
When using this card from the Hand, for each core on all your "DGP" combined, this card's cost gets -1. (Max. -6)

[Flash]
Return two opposing Spirits and two opposing Ultimates to the deckbottom.

PC03-X01.name: Mefilas ［Alien］
PC03-X01.effect:
This set card can't be discarded by the opponent.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon Cost 2/4/6 Spirit cards from your Trash, one of each, without paying the cost. For each Spirit this effect summoned, draw a card. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks/Blocks)
By returning this Spirit to the deckbottom, when this battle ends, end the Attack Step.
PC03-X01.flavor: An alien who plotted to manage people on Earth and keep them to his own by using the Beta System.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6439.name: Mahavasuki
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6439.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
Choose one "Dark Snake" family Spirit card from your Trash and return it to your Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6439.flavor: The snakes believe knowledge makes the world go round. However, the situation did not allow for this.

BS03-020.name: Mega-Humpdump
BS03-020.flavor: Ogre wizards also lay eggs when they perish. Bigger eggs than the ones they lay when they are born.

BS40-024.name: Masked Tanager
BS40-024.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV2] (When Destroyed)
By exhausting an opposing Spirit, return this Spirit to the Hand.
BS40-024.flavor:
Led by the birds, the Searcher Alex reacher the red "Origin Pyroxene". The pyroxene hero and their followers awaited them there, to pass on an important mission...
-from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Red-

BSC49-015.name: Mahavasuki LT
BSC49-015.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Purple Core][Core])]
The opponent destroys a Spirit they control. Then, you destroy a Spirit you control. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
Return a Purple "Devotee"/"Dark Snake" family card from your Trash to the Hand.
BSC49-015.flavor: The snakes believe knowledge makes the world go round. However, the situation did not allow for this.

26RBS03-017.name: Maskthorn
26RBS03-017.effect:
If the opponent controls any Cost 3 or less Spirit, this card in Hand becomes Cost 4.

[LV1-2]When Destroyed
Target an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit. Send a core each from it to the Reserve. If it's the opposing turn, target three Spirits instead. (The opponent chooses which cores to send)
26RBS03-017.flavor: To those who thirsting for blood, the battlefield is no different from a table laden with food.

BSC18-031.name: Mai Asuka
BSC18-031.effect:
[team: Twilight Gothic]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
For each "Private Wear" family Spirit you control, target one opposing Spirit. During this turn, all the targeted opposing Spirits can't block.
BSC18-031.flavor: Don't call me small! My body is small, but my heart is big!

BS12-084.name: Mercury Goblet
BS12-084.kanji: マーキュリーゴブレット
BS12-084.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy a Spirit with the lowest cost on the opposing Field.
BS12-084.flavor:
A great black hole in space that devours whoever... its way out is imagined. Neither common sense nor science can entirely explain the mysterious goblet.
—from the Crater chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS22-023.name: Mega-Neura
BS22-023.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to any Red/White Spirit you control.
BS22-023.flavor: Ever since we've entered the Dark Green forest, I've constantly felt stares at my back. I can also hear the flapping of giant wings. Taking a cursory look behind me, I saw a enormous insect monitoring us from a reasonable distance.

BS68-010.name: Mega-StarDragon
BS68-010.kanji: メガ・スタードラゴン
BS68-010.effect:
When this card is revealed by the [Contract Field] of your “Contractor Apollon”, you can set it.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total of 15000 BP, and effects of the destroyed targets can't activate.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Refresh a Red-only "Devotee"/"Concluser" family Spirit you control.
BS68-010.flavor:
I've never expected that I would be saved by Hades one day...
―Grandwalker Apollon―

CB22-060.name: Mega-Ton Tail
CB22-060.effect:
During your End Step, if you control any "First Generation Ultra Kaiju"-named Spirit/Nexus, you can return this card from the Trash to your Hand by sending a core, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to the Void. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[Flash]
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. After this effect resolves, if you control any "Kaiju"-named Spirit, or have any "Kaiju"-named Mirage set, you can return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6449.name: Masquerade
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6449.effect:
[team: Masquerade]

This card in Trash is unaffected by all effects.

Besides "Masquerade", when your "Idol" & "Stage Style" family Spirits would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost. When you've done so, return one of those Spirits that would leave the Field, besides any "Masquerade", to your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Blocks)
If it's the turn this Spirit was summoned via its own effect, immediately end the opposing Attack Step.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6449.flavor: A legendary idol unit which concealed their faces with masks.

CB02-X04.name: MegaKabuterimon
CB02-X04.kanji: アトラーカブテリモン
CB02-X04.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Exhaust two opposing Spirits. Or, return two opposing exhausted Spirits to the Hand.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, for each "Ultimate" family Spirit you control, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
CB02-X04.flavor:
[Ultimate. Insect. Vaccine]
An evolution of Kabuterimon that was discovered within the tropical region of the Net Area

BSC49-102.name: Mercury Goblet LT
BSC49-102.kanji: マーキュリーゴブレットLT
BSC49-102.effect:
(Can't Stack) When your Blue Nexus is exhausted, you can return this card from the Trash to your Hand.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest cost. This effect can't be prevented by opposing Cost 5 or less effects.
BSC49-102.flavor:
A great black hole in space that devours whoever... its way out is imagined. Neither common sense nor science can entirely explain the mysterious goblet.
—from the Crater chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

CB04-014.name: Masquerade Dopant
CB04-014.kanji: マスカレイド・ドーパント
CB04-014.effect:
You can put any number of this card in your deck.

[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Add a "Dopant"-named Spirit card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.
CB04-014.flavor: The lowest form of Dopant, transformed into with the Masquerade Memory's power. As members of Museum, they appeared in numerous situations.

CB02-050.name: MegaSeadramon
CB02-050.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Ignoring the Cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit.

[LV2] [Assault: 2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to twice per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.
CB02-050.flavor:
[Ultimate. Aquatic. Data.]
Seadramon-species that survived the harsh environment of the Folder Continent area evolved into this form in order to outlive others in the Digital World where the weak are food for the strong.

CB07-025.name: Maildramon
CB07-025.effect:
Flash - [Armor Digivolve: Rookie/Champion]
By returning a "Rookie"/"Champion" family Spirit you control to the Hand, pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can discard a card from your decktop. By returning an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to the discarded card's to the Hand, add the discarded card to your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] [Heavy Armor: Purple/White]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
CB07-025.flavor:
[Armor. Cyborg. Free]
A Cyborg Armor Digimon which evolved with the Digi-Egg of Miracles. Its finisher move is Iron Press, in which it presses down the opponent with its massive body.

26RBS03-098.name: Massive Grow
26RBS03-098.effect:
Legacy

[Flash]
During this turn, all your Blue Spirits with no printed effects gain +2000 BP. Then, target one of your Cost 6 or more Blue Spirits with no printed effects. During this turn, it has two Blue symbols. Its number of symbols can't be increased except via this effect.
26RBS03-098.flavor: No one could mock it as a defenseless pose anymore.

CB02-032.name: Megadramon
CB02-032.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return every opposing 8000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] [Heavy Armor: Red/Purple/Green]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/Green Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
CB02-032.flavor:
[Ultimate. Cyborg. Virus]
A dark dragon Digimon that is said to boast the strongest, wickedest power among Dragon-type Cyborg Digimon of the Ultimate level.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6457.name: Massive Up
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6457.effect: (Flash Step)(Your Main Phase) Target blue spirit with 3 Levels is treated as being at LV3 until end of turn.

26RBS02-062.name: Megalodias
26RBS02-062.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2] Your Attack StepOnce Per Turn
When your "Wailwraith"/"Hexcraft" family Spirit attacks, target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, give it -2000 BP. Then, if it has 0 BP, destroy it.
26RBS02-062.flavor: On days when there are frequent lightning strikes, it's best to stay away from the peaks. That's because creatures that feed on lightning would appear.

26RBS01-X08.name: Mermaidia Princess
26RBS01-X08.kanji: マーメイディア・プリンセス
26RBS01-X08.effect:
[LV1-2]When Summoned
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2]True Release [Current: Oceanic Green & Cost 8 or more] Your Attack Step [Invoke: Flash]
Exhaust this Spirit ▶ Target one of your Cost 8 or more "Oceanic Green" family Spirits. During this battle, it gains an extra Green symbol.
26RBS01-X08.flavor: She was fully aware of her status as a princess, and her pride shone through.

BS29-006.name: Megiddo-Dragon
BS29-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy any number of opposing Ultimates up to a total of 13000 BP. For each Ultimate destroyed by this effect, send a core from your Trash to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - [Awaken]
You can send any number of cores from Spirits you control to this Spirit.
BS29-006.flavor: This is bad! That Dragon is in full combat stance!!

26RBS01-051.name: Meztaurus
26RBS01-051.effect:
[LV1-2] [Amplify: Leucomyst +1000] During Attack/Block[Invoke: Flash]Once Per Battle
Pay one cost ▶ For each "Leucomyst" family Spirit you control, during this battle, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.

[LV2] During Attack
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, target one of your Spirits. Put a core from the Void to it.
26RBS01-051.flavor: I suppose he and his partner must have served as the guardian of the realm for a long time.

CB33-075.name: Megidolaon
CB33-075.effect:
When using this card during either Attack Step, if the opponent controls two or more Spirits/Ultimates, this card becomes Cost 4.

[Flash]
Destroy four opposing Spirits/Ultimates with a cost equal or inferior to that of one of your "Persona"/"Navigator" family Spirits. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

BS53-076.name: Mertipressure
BS53-076.kanji: メルティプレッシャー
BS53-076.effect:
This card has "Primal"/"Dark Artes" family.

When your Life is reduced by the opponent, if there is any Yellow-only card in your Trash, you can use this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[Flash]
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -10000 BP, and destroy if it reaches 0 BP. If you have one counters or more, this effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

BS68-049.name: Maimai Measure
BS68-049.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Holy Life] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, (Once per Turn: Same Name) if the opposing Life is at four or more, and you control any "Contractor Kinich-Ahau", during this battle, this Spirit can't be blocked, and is unaffected by opposing effects.
BS68-049.flavor:
Kinich-Ahau, a Grandwalker from Vulrica, sneaked into Olym chasing after Dan. However, Dan was then caught in the fight caused by the Olym primordial deities.
―Thenogonic Record Volume 1―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6465.name: Megidramon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6465.effect:
While there is any "Ruin Dragon" family card in your Trash, this set card is unaffected by opposing effects.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned/Advents) effect resolves]
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 15000 BP. Effects of Spirits destroyed by this effect can't activate. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6465.flavor:
[Mega. Evil Dragon. Virus]
Among the Dragon Digimon, this one is most vile and most cruel one.

CB16-050.name: Masurao
CB16-050.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Zero Rebirth]
When this Spirit attacks, you can flip it.

[LV1][LV2] [Bushido] (Start of Your Attack Step)
You can compare the BP of this Spirit and an opposing Spirit. Destroy the Spirits with the same or lower BP, and when only the opposing Spirit is destroyed, activate the following effect:
█ If the opposing Hand has five or more cards, the opponent discards from their Hand until there are three cards left.
CB16-050.flavor: Based on the Union Flag series, a prototype model developed under the lead of Billy Katagiri to be the Earth Sphere Federation Army's next generation mobile suit. Its pilot is Mister Bushido.

BS24-016.name: Mezudemon
BS24-016.effect:
[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By discarding a Purple card from your Hand, send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.
[Rush: Red]
(While you have Red symbols, the following effects activate next)
[Red Core]: Destroy an opposing Nexus.
[Red Core][Red Core]: Draw a card.
BS24-016.flavor: I asked Fric about it, and he said he thought it was impossible. So he won't be our go-between with the Ogre Wizards... hey wait, how about Asia instead?

BS38-001.name: Messenger Dragon
BS38-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [SSoul: Red]
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains [Red Core] (an extra Red symbol).

[LV2] (When Attacks/Destroyed)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.
BS38-001.flavor: The venue of the 216th BSGP's tenth match is the country of history and samurai, Japang. The beautiful blue mountains watch over their race.

CB16-050-A6469.name: Masurao ［Trans-Am］
CB16-050-A6469.effect:
[+0]

[LV1][LV2] (When Reborn/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost.

[LV1][LV2] (Your End Step)
Flip this Spirit back into a pre-Rebirth Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While this Spirit or your Spirit with [Top Gun]/[Bushido] is attacking, the opponent can't use any Magic cards from the Hand.
CB16-050-A6469.flavor: Being a pseudo solar furnace mobile suit, it is equipped with and is finally able to use the Trans-Am System.

CB25-024.name: Messer Type-F01
CB25-024.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1. Then, you can pay one cost to summon one of your "Xi Gundam" that is in Soul State.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, including being in Soul State, if you control any "Xi Gundam", your counter +1.
CB25-024.flavor: A mobile suit operated as the main force machine of Mafty. It specializes in guerrilla warfare, and is used in Davao's night assault. Its pilot includes Gawman and some others.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6471.name: Matadora
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6471.effect: [When Braved] (When Destroyed) Your opponent target a color out of the colors of their Spirits Destroy all opposing Spirits/Nexuses not of the targeted color.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6471.flavor: Among them, there's a guy who seems more like a parasite than a Brave.

CB25-026.name: Messer Type-F02 Mine Layer Equipped［Riding on Galcezon］
CB25-026.kanji: メッサーF02型マインレイヤー装備［ギャルセゾン搭乗］
CB25-026.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to your Trash. Also, if it's either Attack Step, refresh a "Flash" family Spirit you control.
CB25-026.flavor: The form equipped with Mine Layer Units. Can't fly on its own within the Earth's atmosphere, Messer is used together with Galcezon the sub-flight system.

BSC26-020.name: Matango
BSC26-020.flavor:
Mushrooms mutated from radiation exposure on a solitary Pacific island, and mysterious creatures living on the same island. Humans who eat Matango gradually decompose and become Matango kaijin. Matango kaijin try to make humans eat this mushroom and increase their numbers.
―Matango (1963)―

BS39-033.name: Mainda & Dvivida
BS39-033.kanji: マインドラ＆ディヴィク
BS39-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Blue.

[During Seal] [LV2]
Your "Monkey"-named Spirits can't be returned to the Hand/deck by opposing effects.
BS39-033.flavor: The fight against the FourDemonLords was rough. Racers Glorious-SHeep, Calamity-Boar, and Hanumerlin are focusing on recuperation for the time being. Ah, two monkeys have come to deliver a message from racer Hanumerlin.

CB25-025.name: Messer Type-F Naked［Commander Type］
CB25-025.kanji: メッサーF型ネイキッド［指揮官機］
CB25-025.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, once per turn, reveal a card from your decktop. Add a "Flash" family card among them to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards. If your have five counters or more, this effect can reveal +2 cards.

[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Xi Gundam" [Contract Advent], you can immediately brave a "Hathaway" you control to that Spirit in the same state as that Spirit.
CB25-025.flavor: The commander type Messer used to retrieve Xi Gundam in the air.

BS10-028.name: Matangol
BS10-028.flavor:
After running nonstop, I finally collapsed. My throat hurt so much I couldn't breathe properly. Before my eyes was a giant mushroom, but I dared not to bite into it. Lowering my gaze, I spotted a tiny tree sapling growing. There, a fruit seed was growing.
-from the 9th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS15-034.name: Mibrock-Genius
BS15-034.kanji: ミブロック・ジーナス
BS15-034.effect:
[Burst: After Your Spirit is Destroyed by the Opponent]
If the Spirit destroyed when this Burst activates was 5000 BP or more, summon this Spirit card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
While there are only White Spirits/Nexuses on your Field, the effects of all Nexuses can't activate.

[LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
Return an opposing Spirit without a Burst effect to the Hand.
BS15-034.flavor: According to what the messenger said, there are some comparatively moderate heroes aligned with Ice Shield.

BS52-030.name: Metal'raj
BS52-030.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2]
Every Grandwalker Nexus has zero symbols.
BS52-030.flavor:
We joined the fray just as mechanical beasts and mechanical soldiers which didn't exist in the books were fighting each other. It's good that the purple assassins also got swallowed by the battlefield, but I have the feeling we're in an even greater pinch now.
――"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 1:23―

BS17-054.name: Majin-Golem
BS17-054.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
All your [Roc-Aladdin] are unaffected by opposing Magic effects.

[LV2] (When Destroyed)
While you control any [Roc-Aladdin], this Spirit remains on your Field, exhausted.
BS17-054.flavor: The genie that would only take three orders a day took the last order of the day from its master. "Defeat the enemy that I struck."

BS16-029.name: Mibrock-Patrol
BS16-029.kanji: ミブロック・パトロール
BS16-029.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your "Mibrock"-named Spirit, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.
BS16-029.flavor: The scouts of Ice Shield are excellent. If we had them as our ally, we would have no trouble securing an escape route.

BS67-026.name: Metal-Shako
BS67-026.effect:

[Grand Skill: 2] [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)

CB07-047.name: Mother D-Reaper
CB07-047.kanji: マザー デ・リーパー
CB07-047.effect:
When the opposing deck only has 20 cards or less, this card in Hand becomes Cost 1.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit is blocked, discard one card from both player's decktop. Then, you can pay one cost to summon a Cost 9 or less "Reaper"-named Spirit card from your Trash.

Your "Reaper"-named Spirits can't be destroyed by BP comparison, and are treated as being on their highest levels.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6638.name: Mogeira
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6638.flavor: The beasts searched with us, thinking it might be underground. Sorry, but I think it's probably not there.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6639.name: Mothleaf
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6639.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Battles) When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] (When Battles) When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6639.flavor: I heard that the rowdies have found a way of controlling insects in the woods. The Elder is concerned because there are lots of poisonous insects.

CB24-078.name: Muscle Galaxy Finish
CB24-078.kanji: マッスルギャラクシーフィニッシュ
CB24-078.effect:
When using this card, the symbols of all your "Build"/"Cross-Z"/"Grease"/"Rogue" Spirits are also treated as Purple/Blue.

While your “Kamen Rider Cross-Z Evol” is attacking, this card in Hand becomes Cost 5.

[Flash]
Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy two opposing Cost 8 or less Spirits. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6641.name: Mothpede
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6641.effect: [LV1][LV2] Treat this spirit as a Green Spirit as well as a Purple Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6641.flavor:
An intelligence operative's work becomes all the more important the more likely a war is about to begin. Though many people have stereotyped ideas about spies, the truth is that there are many different kinds of secret agents: from those who simply blend into the background unnoticed to those who boldly take action while disguised as the enemy. By making friends with these different snoopers, I'm able to get all sorts of interesting tidbits.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

SD24-015.name: Muscle Wall
SD24-015.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, your Life can't be reduced by the attacks from opposing Spirits in refreshed state. Or, destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.

BS74-046.name: Moonlite Chamois
BS74-046.kanji: ムーンライト・シャモア
BS74-046.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Artemis" & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)

[LV2][LV3]
When your "Machine Beast" family Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BS74-046.flavor:
So in the end, who was the one that found the Grandwalker of Contracts?
―Grandwalker Artemis―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6644.name: Mogrunner
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6644.effect:

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6644.flavor: There is a rumor that the Elders are using him as a special messenger to communicate with each other.

BS72-036.name: Moonlite Coyote
BS72-036.kanji: ムーンライト・コヨーテ
BS72-036.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. You can switch any number of White "Machine Beast"/"Imagine"/"Olym" family cards among them with cards from your Hand. Return the revealed cards to the deckbottom. When cards are switched via this effect, your counter +1.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Machine Beast" family Brave Spirit attacks/blocks, you can send four cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void.
BS72-036.flavor:
To gather information on the disappearances in Olym, Artemis sought help from Hermes and Demeter, who had their own intelligence network.
―Divine World Log 01―

CB28-018.name: Mothra (Larva Form) (1968)
CB28-018.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Green Core][Red Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Either Attack Step)

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void each to this Spirit and one of your "Godzilla" Spirits. Then, when summoned via an effect, heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit.
CB28-018.flavor: Together with Godzilla and the other Kaijus on the Earth, they fought against King Ghidorah.

BS72-042.name: Moonlite Eagle
BS72-042.kanji: ムーンライト・イーグル
BS72-042.effect:
When your White Nexuses are depleted/destroyed by opposing effects, you can summon this card from the Hand by paying one cost. When you've done so, if it's the opposing turn, immediately end this step.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)

BS72-042.flavor:
Hfufufu...I exist everywhere, but I also exist nowhere....You shall live in fear of my shadow...
―Grandwalker Nyx―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6648.name: Motomiya Daisuke
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6648.effect:

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Turn)

BS72-037.name: Moonlite Fennec
BS72-037.kanji: ムーンライト・フェネック
BS72-037.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent]
You can return a Spirit card that was depleted/destroyed when this Burst activates from your Trash to the Hand. Then, you can summon a Cost 5 or less "Machine Beast"/"Imagine" family card from your Hand, without paying the cost. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your White Cost 5 or less Spirits can't be blocked
BS72-037.flavor:
Investigate Nyx? In short, you want me to save Dan, correct?
―Grandwalker Artemis―

BS14-031.name: Musha-Apewhip
BS14-031.kanji: ムシャ・エイプウィップ
BS14-031.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
If you have a Burst set, put two cores from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)

BS14-031.flavor:
As the emissary of the Dark Shield, Manaka was widely accepted by the denizens of the Wind Shield.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 641—

BS13-053.name: Mokubaoh
BS13-053.effect:
[LV1] (Either Attack Step)

BS13-053.flavor:
After the Castle Tower tree flew away, this horse was there.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS13-023.name: Mountain-Seikai
BS13-023.kanji: マウンテン・セイカイ

Refresh all your LV2 or higher Spirits.

The 12's Star Core flashed in sync intensely, and maintaining some distance, began to circle. In an instant they accelerated, and at the moment they formed a circle of light... the legendary Mother Core appeared! As if she were sleeping, Master Lilia slowly closed her eyes and whispered something.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS14-029.name: Musha-Geo
BS14-029.flavor: Because Bear and the horse himself were both large, a certain spirit led us to the master of the forest.

26RSD03-005.name: Mola Moula
26RSD03-005.flavor: Once it possessed no scales and had soft flesh, but through resolute determination to protect its kin, it was forged into a state of hardened resolve, attaining a solidity.

BS34-015.name: Musha Devil

—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS33-005.name: Mushaceratops
BS33-005.flavor: The Heaven Squad intended to take their injured troops and run to the Youkai Folk's hidden village in the event that they were chased by Onmyou Territory's army.

CB26-052.name: Mr. BLACK

BS55-058.name: Moldavite-Golem
BS55-058.kanji: モルダバイト・ゴレム

[LV1][LV2]
When your Blue Brave is summoned, put a core from the Void to this Spirit. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2]

BS55-058.flavor:
It seems that ever since that battle, Hephaestus started to show his true form before others more and more. Isn't that a good thing? Hiding does nothing good to you. As an expert on hiding, I am fairly sure about that statement.
―"Genesis Records" Curious Rumors 03―

CB26-X06.name: Mr. BLACK & HE IS THOMAS
CB26-X06.effect:

(Once per Turn: Same Name) By returning an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the deckbottom, put two cores from the Void to any of your Spirits.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your other "Mr. BLACK"/"HE IS THOMAS" attacks/blocks, this Spirit refreshes.
CB26-X06.flavor: No one knows the weight of another's burden.

SD29-002.name: Mushadaryu

CB26-053.name: Mr. BLACK［2］
CB26-053.effect:

By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV2]
Give all your “Mr. BLACK”/“HE IS THOMAS” the effect: "[Heavy Armor: Red/Purple/Blue] This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects."
CB26-053.flavor: "I would quickly finish this and come over."

PC12-005.name: Moment and Heart Together

(Once per turn: same name) During either Attack Step, when your "Evangelion" with reduction symbols of two or more colors is summoned, you can return this card from your Trash to the Hand.

[Flash]
During this turn, you can attack simultaneously with two "Evangelion" that have the same cost. The opponent can block one of them, but the other can't be blocked (Both battles conclude at the same time).

BS48-025.name: Mridangam Dragon
BS48-025.kanji: ムリダンガムドラゴン
BS48-025.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)

BS48-025.flavor:
Fortunately, Olym is distant from Hindida. There isn't a lot of time to prepare, but it will be sufficient.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 1:40

SD29-007.name: Mushadraco

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add one "War Dragon" family Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

CB21-047-A6668.name: Nagisa Kaworu -Mark. 06 Plugsuit-

CB21-X05.name: Nagisa Kaworu -Unit-13 Plugsuit-

CB23-047.kanji: 渚カヲル -人類のはざまを紡ぐ-

CB23-047.flavor: He comes to help for countless times, just to make Shinji happy. And he finally realized, making Shinji happy is exactly what makes himself happy too.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6671.name: Nairaka-Hydra
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6671.kanji: ナイラック・ハイドラ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6671.effect:

[Burst: After your Spirit is Destroyed by the Opponent]
Destroy opposing Cost 5/7/9 Spirits, one of each. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Put one core from the Void to your Nexus.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6671.flavor:
Set and Apollon's battle was, compared to the battle with Osiris, much more relentless. Because both were Grandwalkers which govern war.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 2:21―

BSC23-015.name: Momo Gyuumonje
BSC23-015.kanji: モモ・ギュウモンジェ

[team: Absolutes]

[LV2][LV3]

CB25-060.name: Nanai Miguel
CB25-060.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)

CB25-060.flavor: Director of the Newtype Institute. She is entrusted with Quess by Char, and has carried out enhancements on her.

26RBS02-065.name: Mu-Stella

[LV1-2]When Destroyed
Target a "Cyantree" family Nexus card in your Trash. Deploy it without paying the cost.
26RBS02-065.flavor: Sensing something was amiss, the little creatures had also emerged from their burrows.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6675.name: Momongul
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6675.flavor:
The wind in this world is not supposed to be strong, but I sometimes feel overwhelmed as if an invisible mass of air is pressing me. The sixth place I visited was more beautiful and extraordinary than any other places I had visited.
-from the 2nd paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

26RSD01-001.name: Mushakko
26RSD01-001.effect:
[LV2]During Attack
At the end of battle, if your Hand is five or less, draw a card.

BS38-004.name: Nanotyra

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [True-Clash] (When Attacks)

SD29-CP02.name: Mushamosaurus
SD29-CP02.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. Also, while [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, it gains +2000 BP.

CB04-023.name: Nasca Dopant
CB04-023.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each LV of this Spirit, send two cores from one opposing Spirit to their Reserve.

[LV3]
Cores sent to the opposing Reserve via this Spirit's effect are sent to opposing Trash instead.

BS72-019.name: Mud Foot
BS72-019.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When the opponent increases cores from the Void with their effect, if you control any "Contractor Nyx", by summoning this card from your Hand/Trash without paying the cost, during this turn, the opponent can't increase cores from the Void with their effects.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can draw a card. Then, by sending two cores from one of your "Contractor Nyx" Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void, draw a card.
BS72-019.flavor:
Nyx penetrated deep into Olym, using Uranus' advance as cover. Very few are aware of this.
―Divine World Log 01―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6687.name: Musharex
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6687.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash- Awaken - You can put any number of cores from Spirits you control to this Spirit.

[LV3] (When Attacks) While there is [Soul Core] (Soul Core) on this Spirit, this Spirit gains an extra Green symbol.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6687.flavor: The SengokuDragon Souldragon was a rare and ferocious general in charge of Flame War Province. At the end of the Great Sengoku Era, his secret technique Consecutive Blade was passed on and evolved further.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6688.name: Nasuno-Archer
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6688.effect:
☼<nowiki>[ </nowiki>Burst: After Your Life is Decreased<nowiki> ]</nowiki>
When you have four or more Purple cards in your Trash, summon this Spirit card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed) Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.

[LV3] (When Destroyed) Return this Spirit to your Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6688.flavor:
The one-on-one match between the famous Braver and Manaka became the climax of the "Fight of the Dragon Wall."
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 640—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6689.name: Mushatanuki
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6689.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed) Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
[Rush: Red/White]
(While you have Red/White symbols, the following effects activate next)
[Red Core]: Destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.
[White Core]: Return an opposing Nexus to the Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6689.flavor:
The culprit is the TwinDragon of Darkness that came from another dimension. The page of the Dark Green commander who we saved from death told the shocking truth. They caused the great collapse and sought to exterminate us.
-The Murmurs of Blacksmith Guren-

BS12-046.name: Nata-Golem
BS12-046.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When the opponent would pay the cost for Magic cards, they can't pay with cores on their Spirits.

[When Braved] [LV2]
Treat this Spirit as a Spirit without printed effects.

Amazing! His agility is enough to match the spider girl's own unique speed! This guy uses a strange technique, too. Kong fu? Kung fu? Whatever it is. In any case, if that pretty guy with the eyepatch hadn't come along, she wouldn't still be alive.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS31-001.name: Mushatokage
BS31-001.flavor:
After the Battles of Kaminakajima, there was an individual who left Flame War on his own. At the time he was a mere soldier without any fame, and was called Takemaru.
―from the Soldier's Biography of "Sengoku Obscurities" by Kuroe―

—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS17-010.name: Mudoolo

Due to various events, Dark Shield had provoked the wrath of Flame Shield the most. As if luring Kei's charge, Manaka placed Dark Shield's forces in the middle. Of course, that was not just a feint operation. Dark Shield is also specialized in trickery and illusions... Indeed, the trap prepared by the Five Nation Alliance was a battle formation meant to lure Kei's army in and surround it.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 647—

BS77-029.name: Moonlite Gazelle

The country requested for Guren-san to repair the sword. I came along.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, Second Day of the First Month-

BS73-035.name: Moonlite Giraffe
BS73-035.kanji: ムーンライト・ギラッファ

Leave the fighting to me. And I leave all the other messy stuff to you. Those were Shiva's thoughts on the matter.

―"Genesis Records" New Volume 1:21―

Zeus-Lolo will surely one day invade Hindida.
