The red sky looks like it reflects burning flames.
―Soul Spot 20/47―

BS33-062.name: No. 21 Divergence Hill
BS33-062.kanji: No.21 ダイバージェンスヒル
BS33-062.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Turn)
While [Soul Core] is in your Trash, when a Cost 3 Spirit is summoned from your Hand, draw a card.

[LV2]
When an opposing effect reduces your Life, by putting [Soul Core] from this Nexus to a Spirit you control, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BS33-062.flavor:
Though the road regularly splits on a journey, this choice is particularly difficult. Will ogres or snakes come?... If you choose the wrong path, you're dead.
―Soul Spot 21/47―

BS31-089.name: No. 22 Silent Hill
BS31-089.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced, for each Life reduced, draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Nexus, cores on your Spirits/Ultimates/Nexuses can also be used for your [High Speed].
BS31-089.flavor:
A high peak that overlooks terraced fields. Apparently if you boil the flower that blooms at the peak and drink it, you'll gain perpetual youth and eternal life.
―Soul Spot 22/47―

BS34-062.name: No. 23 Love Wisdom
BS34-062.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Draw Step)
If there are ten or more cards in your Trash, increase the number of cards you draw by +1. This effect doesn't stack.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When any Purple Spirit is summoned from your Trash, by sending the Soul Core from your Spirits/Reserve to your Trash, destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.
BS34-062.flavor:
There is said to be a tree in a vast skyscraper that bears the fruit of knowledge. Those brave enough to taste it may as well try to find it.
―Soul Spot 23/47―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6844.name: No. 7 Good Luck Island
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6844.kanji: No.7 グッドラックアイランド
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6844.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Your "Emperor Beast" family Spirits get +3000 BP.

[During Seal] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When the opposing Life is reduced, the core is sent to the Void rather than the Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6844.flavor:
Flowers in full glorious bloom, as if celebrating the race's start. Be careful to not be too enraptured and miss the start signal.
―Soul Spot 7/47―

BS39-063.name: No. 24 Triple Heavy
BS39-063.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
Your Life can only be reduced by a total of one by the attacks of opposing Cost 4 or less Spirits/Ultimates.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
While [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is on this Nexus, when you're summoning a Spirit card/Brave card, this Nexus' symbols become three White symbols.
BS39-063.flavor:
A technical circuit where many BSGPs were once held. A great number of famous matches took place at this ground.
―Soul Spot 24/47―

BS36-068.name: No. 8 Thorn Castle
BS36-068.kanji: No.8 ソーンキャッスル
BS36-068.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your End Step)
Refresh all your Cost 7 or less Brave Spirits. If there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Nexus, also, refresh all your Cost 3 or less Spirits.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing non-braved Spirit attacks, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS36-068.flavor:
An ancient castle abandoned in a war long ago. Eventually it was grown over and forgotten along with the war.
-Soul Spot 8/47-

BS32-065.name: No. 25 Grow Celebration
BS32-065.kanji: No.25 グロウセレブレーション
BS32-065.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step) When your Spirit is summoned, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step) While there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Nexus, all your "Ninja Gale" family Spirits gain +5000 BP.
BS32-065.flavor:
The defense of the castle tower upon the precipice is flawless, and its view superb.
―Soul Spot 25/47―

BS38-062.name: No. 9 Horse-Chestnut Tree
BS38-062.kanji: No.9 ホースチェスナットツリー
BS38-062.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Spirits are returned to the Hand, exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

[During Seal] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
The opponent can't activate their Bursts.
BS38-062.flavor:
Stepping forward and marking your way by the massive tree with foliage spreading across the sky, an extravagant mausoleum said to house a past general of Japang comes into view.
-Soul Spot 9/47-

BS32-071.name: No. 26 Capital Capital
BS32-071.kanji: No.26 キャピタルキャピタル
BS32-071.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Deploy this card without paying the cost.

[LV1] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit/Ultimate without [Soul Core] on it would attack, unless the opponent sends a core from their Reserve to the Trash, it can't attack. While [Soul Core] is on this Nexus, this effect sends +1 core to the Trash.
BS32-071.flavor:
An airborne city where many temples are crowded. It's said that without a referral from a resident, one cannot even enter.
―Soul Spot 26/47―

BSC16-009.name: Noa Fleur
BSC16-009.effect:
[team: Shiny Hearts]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [On Stage] (Your Attack Step)
Instead of attacking with this Spirit, by returning this Spirit to the deckbottom, summon a "Stage Style" family "Noa Fleur" from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost, and draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Besides this Spirit, each "Stage Style" family "Noa Fleur" you control gains an extra Yellow symbol.
BSC16-009.flavor: I want to convey these sparkling bright emotions to everyone!

BSC48-047.name: No. 26 Capital Capital LT
BSC48-047.kanji: No.26 キャピタルキャピタルLT
BSC48-047.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Deploy this card without paying the cost. Then, if this Burst was activated via a "Catalyze"-named effect, refresh a Blue Spirit you control.

[LV1] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit/Ultimate without [Soul Core] on it would attack, unless the opponent sends a core from their Reserve to the Trash, it can't attack. While [Soul Core] is on this Nexus, this effect sends +1 core to the Trash.
BSC48-047.flavor:
An airborne city where many temples are crowded. It's said that without a referral from a resident, one cannot even enter.
―Soul Spot 26/47―

BS16-001.name: Nodeppo
BS16-001.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) When you have a Burst set, destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit.
BS16-001.flavor: How long has it been since I defeated the last Vanity Deity? I've been hearing some unpleasant rumors. Though they themselves are most familiar with the terror of being invaded, Flame Shield is now invading other countries. What's wrong with Kei? I must recover quickly.

BS35-083.name: No. 27 Big Slope
BS35-083.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Start Step)
If your Hand is two or less, put a core from the Void to this Nexus.

[LV2] (Either Main Step)
While [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is on this Nexus, increase the cost of every non-Blue Spirit card in both player's Hand by +1.
BS35-083.flavor:
A heart-breaking slope which shatters the spirits of runners. Preparing beforehand is very important.
―Soul Spot 27/47―

CB18-012.name: New Generation Ultraman Taiga
CB18-012.kanji: 新世代ウルトラマンタイガ
CB18-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can send two cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void. Also, if you control any "Ultraman"-named Nexus, you can draw a card.

[LV2] [Rebirth3]
When your "New Generation"-named Spirit attacks, you can flip this Spirit.
CB18-012.flavor: A member of the Tri-Squad and the son of Ultraman Taro. It has a strong sense of justice, and fight alongside Hiroyuki for the sake of bringing peace to the Earth.

26RBS01-089.name: Nodorien
26RBS01-089.effect:
Legacy

[LV1-2] [Rumble: 7] [During Attack]
At the end of battle, discard seven cards from the opposing decktop. For each cost of the Spirit card that blocked in the opposing Trash, it discards -1 card.

[LV2][During Attack]
If you control two or more Blue symbols, this Spirit gains +2000 BP.
26RBS01-089.flavor: Trees are, by nature, in competition with one another. The larger ones do not hesitate to trample the smaller ones underfoot.

CB18-022.name: New Generation Ultraman Taiga Photon-Earth
CB18-022.kanji: 新世代ウルトラマン タイガ フォトンアース
CB18-022.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 6 ([Red Core][Red Core][Red Core])]
Destroy an opposing Brave. After this effect resolves, destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, either discard this card, or replace a Cost 6 or less “Ultraman”-named Spirit you control with this card in refreshed state.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
At the end of the battle of your "New Generation"-named Spirit, send an opposing Life to the Reserve. This effect doesn't stack.
CB18-022.flavor: The powered-up form Taiga transforms into after obtaining the mysterious power lying dormant on Earth since the ancient times.

BS36-069.name: No. 28 Soldier Storehouse
BS36-069.kanji: No.28 ソルジャーストアハウス
BS36-069.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
Reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Brave card to the Hand. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) was used to pay for the deploy cost, also, add an "Android" family Spirit card to the Hand. Then, discard the remaining cards.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit attacks, put a core from the Void to any of your "Android" family Spirits.
BS36-069.flavor:
The fortress is in a state of high alert no matter the time of day. There are a lot of excessive labels in the fortress. Safety first, Keep clean, Fingerprint identification... They seem to run a tight ship.
-Soul Spot 28/47-

BS70-004.name: Nogihara Geozard
BS70-004.kanji: ノギハラ・ジオザード
BS70-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Primordial" family Nexus card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. If you have six counters or more, this effect reveals +1 card.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Nexuses would leave the Field, you can draw a card.
BS70-004.flavor:
Olym's Grandwalkers were fighting Uranus' forces at their worlds individually. And Apollon entrusted the right to command his army to Dan.
―Theogonic Record Volume 3―

BS36-070.name: No. 29 Apple Good
BS36-070.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
All your "Drifting Spirit" family Spirits gain +3000 BP.

[LV2] (Your Turn)
While [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is on this Nexus, all opposing Cost 3/6/9 Spirits lose their effects and can't gain new ones.
BS36-070.flavor:
A fruity temple that smells like sweet apples. It's a culturally important structure, so don't bite into it.
-Soul Spot 29/47-

BS60-089.name: Noir Shoot
BS60-089.effect:
While you have five or more counters, this card in Hand is Cost 4.

[Flash]
Discard four cards from your decktop, and for each "Blood Crystal" family card discarded, send a core from the opposing Field to the Reserve. Also, if you have four or more counters, this card is treated as colorless.

BS33-070.name: No. 2 Blue Forest
BS33-070.kanji: No.2 ブルーフォレスト
BS33-070.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Beast Head" family Spirit/Ultimate effect destroys opposing Spirits, put two cores from the Void to your Spirits/Ultimates/Nexuses.

[LV2] (Opposing End Step)
If the [Soul Core] is on your Field, the opponent must discard cards from their Hand until it it is three or less.
BS33-070.flavor:
A blue forest with a mysterious atmosphere. It's not clear whether the statues that stand at its entrance are welcoming or warning the visitor...
―Soul Spot 2/47―

BS28-033.name: Noisy Raven
BS28-033.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this Spirit card. Then, you can set a card with Burst effects from your Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Spirit to their Hand.

[LV2] Red
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.
BS28-033.flavor:
In the absence of the Tri-Dragon Deities, the success of the mission has been entrusted to the Ultimate Dragons.
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, 286 days remaining—

BS34-068.name: No. 30 Total Song Mountain
BS34-068.kanji: No.30 トータルソングマウンテン
BS34-068.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Yellow Spirits are depleted/destroyed by the opponent, draw a card.

[LV2] (Start of Opposing Main Step)
By sending the Soul Core from your Spirits/Reserve to your Trash, during this turn, the symbols of all opposing Spirits with two or more colors of reduction symbols become zero.
BS34-068.flavor:
The flowers blooming on the trees are fragrant, allowing one to appreciate the charming scenery. Although the poems the Pentan recites don't make sense.
―Soul Spot 30/47―

BS34-056.name: Nokogiriwolf
BS34-056.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison with your "Fusion Beast"/"Beast Head" family Spirit, destroy an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to that of your battling Spirit.
BS34-056.flavor: The battle between Gandala's Senju and Azure Fang Squad's Shironagasu was violent and splendid to an earth-gouging extent.

BS36-066.name: No. 31 Bird Hunting
BS36-066.kanji: No.31 バードハンティング
BS36-066.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Give all your Brave Spirits +5000 BP. While [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Nexus, instead, give all your Spirits +5000 BP.

[LV2]
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, either destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit, or destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less "Winged Beast"/"Song Bird" family Spirit.
BS36-066.flavor:
Don't think you'll be allowed to fly over these dunes because "the footing is bad".
―Soul Spot 31/47―

SD22-004.name: Nokogiru Kuwagata
SD22-004.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV2] (When Destroyed)
If you control any Ultimates, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
SD22-004.flavor: This kuwagata's pincers have pincers between. Just like our world - upper continent, lower continent. Cross them and they'll be crushed, is it hell or heaven?

BS32-063.name: No. 32 Island Root
BS32-063.kanji: No.32 アイランドルート
BS32-063.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
Draw a card.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit attacks, by sending the [Soul Core] from this Nexus to your Spirit, send two cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve.
BS32-063.flavor:
A shrine upon distant seas that rejects infidels. All approaching ships are caught in the reefs and run aground.
―Soul Spot 32/47―

BS53-CP11.name: Nonoin Nillon
BS53-CP11.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Cost 3 or more) (This Nexus can only hold up to 5 cores)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) Refresh a Spirit you control.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
All your Spirits can't be blocked by opposing LV1 Spirits. Also, all your "Minion" family Spirits can't be blocked by opposing LV2 Spirits.

BSC48-040.name: No. 32 Island Root LT
BSC48-040.kanji: No.32 アイランドルートLT
BSC48-040.effect:
(Can't Stack) When an opposing originally Cost 3 or less Spirit/Ultimate attacks, you can deploy this card from your Trash.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
Draw a card.

[LV2] Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
By sending the [Soul Core] from this Nexus to a Spirit/Ultimate, send up to two cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve.
BSC48-040.flavor:
A shrine upon distant seas that rejects infidels. All approaching ships are caught in the reefs and run aground.
―Soul Spot 32/47―

26RSD04-002.name: Nonril
26RSD04-002.effect:
[LV1-2] When Summoned
Put a core from the Void to your Trash.

[LV2]During Block
If you have three or more White symbols, this Spirit gains +5000 BP.
26RSD04-002.flavor: He decided to hide it on himself to prevent it from being stolen.

BS35-077.name: No. 33 Hill Mountain
BS35-077.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When either player summons a Cost 4 or less Spirit card without the "Winged Beast" family, it is summoned in exhausted state.

[During Seal] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison with your "Winged Beast" family Spirits, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BS35-077.flavor:
Walking down a footpath between trees drooping with fruits. Somewhere around here should be a Fruit of Heroes.
―Soul Spot 33/47―

BS34-045.name: Noppera Girl
BS34-045.effect:
This Spirit card is also treated as a Magic card.

[Flash] (This effect can't be used while on the Field.)
During this turn, a Spirit/Ultimate loses all its effects and can't gain any new ones.
BS34-045.flavor: After the war, the lost Throne Inheritance ticket was found in the Youkai Folk Village. The lot's result was...

BS31-095.name: No. 34 Large Island
BS31-095.kanji: No.34 ラージアイランド
BS31-095.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Nexus, when your Blue Spirit attacks, discard a card from the opposing decktop, and during that battle, that Spirit gains +5000 BP.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
Treat all "WisdomKing"-named Spirit cards in your Hand as Cost 6.
BS31-095.flavor:
Glimpsing at the austere form of the architecture on the water, one's heart quiets and the spirits too calm down.
―Soul Spot 34/47―

CB25-049.name: Norba Shino
CB25-049.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

(Can't Stack) When your "Ryusei-Go" is summoned, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost. When you've done so, destroy an opposing Spirit with two cores or less on it.

[During Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, by discarding a card from your Hand, draw two cards.

BS34-070.name: No. 35 Mountain Mouth
BS34-070.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Spirit with no printed effects is summoned, draw two cards. Then, discard two cards from your Hand.

[LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By sending the Soul Core from your Spirits/Reserve to your Trash, during this turn, when your Spirit with no printed effects attacks, the Attack Step can't be ended by opposing effects.
BS34-070.flavor:
A cave which suddenly opened its mouth on an empty grassland. I can understand being interested, but entry is forbidden.
―Soul Spot 35/47―

CB27-016.name: Norea Du Noc
CB27-016.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[During Brave] (Your Attack Step)
Every opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit can't block.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -3000 BP, and destroy it when it reaches 0 BP. Then, while braved to "Gundam", during this battle, this Spirit gains an extra Yellow symbol.

BS38-065.name: No. 36 Virtuous Island
BS38-065.kanji: No.36 バーチャスアイランド
BS38-065.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Hand is discarded due to any player's effects, put a core from the Void to this Nexus. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
While [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is on this Nexus, all your Spirits/Ultimates are treated as being on their highest level.
BS38-065.flavor:
Gaze at the whirling waves as cross the deceptively stout bridge, heading toward the old shrine. The shrine is the start point of the 88 Mini-Soul Spot pilgrimage.
-Soul Spot 36/47-

BS60-018.name: Noroilicca
BS60-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
(Once Per Turn: Same Name) You can discard a card from your decktop. When you've done so, you can draw a card. When this effect discards any "Blood Crystal" family card, this effect draws +1 card.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can discard a card from your decktop. After this effect resolves, destroy an opposing Spirit with two cores or less on it.
BS60-018.flavor:
"Huff. Da...Dan...Master Dan! There is something chasing us from behind! Don't turn your head! Never!"
―The PartnerKinght Bat―

BS33-068.name: No. 37 Fragrance River
BS33-068.kanji: No.37 フレグランスリバー
BS33-068.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your End Step)
If there is Soul Core on your Field, return a "Youkai" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2]
Give all your "Youkai" family Spirits: "[Brilliance] (When Attacks) At the end of battle, return every Magic card you used in this battle from your Trash to the Hand."
BS33-068.flavor:
Should this really be called a river? It's a bizarre stream that raises an insatiable appetite with its mysterious smell.
―Soul Spot 37/47―

BS10-033.name: Northernbeard
BS10-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Blocks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BS10-033.flavor: Whipping out his strong arms, white fur soon becomes dyed in red. <br—from the Ursa Major chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS31-094.name: No. 38 Love Princess
BS31-094.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When you use a Magic card, draw a card.

[LV2]
While there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Nexus, all opposing Nexuses without "No." in their names lose all their effects.
BS31-094.flavor:
Cross the long suspension bridge and a fantasy world unfolds. Welcome to Paradise!
―Soul Spot 38/47―

BSC50-012.name: Northernbeard LT
BSC50-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Blocks)
You can put a core from the Void each to this Spirit and a White "Astral Deity" family Spirit you control.

[LV2] Flash -
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Swap any "Astral Deity" family card among them with cards from your Hand. Return the revealed cards one by one to either the decktop or deckbottom.
BSC50-012.flavor: Whipping out his strong arms, white fur soon becomes dyed in red. <br—from the Ursa Major chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS38-064.name: No. 39 High Wisdom
BS38-064.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you [Seal: Seal], if your Life is five or less, put a core from the Void to your Life.

[LV2]
Treat all your Brave Spirits as being Cost 2.
BS38-064.flavor:
A statue of a great man sits deserted on a cliff where raging waves break. What does he see beyond the horizon?
―Soul Spot 39/47―

26RBS02-035.name: Northersteller
26RBS02-035.effect:
[LV1-2] During Attack
When the opposing Life is reduced, you can target an opposing Spirit. Exhaust it.

[LV2] During Attack
At the end of battle, you can target an opposing exhausted Spirit. Return it to the Hand.
26RBS02-035.flavor: It unleashes a barrage of projectiles while flooding the impact site. It's the perfect ability for an offensive assault.

BS31-088.name: No. 3 Rock Hand
BS31-088.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Draw Step)
By discarding an "Ogre Wizard" family Spirit card from your Hand, increase the amount of cards you draw by +2.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
You can summon “Ogre Wizard” family Spirit cards from your Trash by using [Soul Core] as part of their summon cost.
BS31-088.flavor:
The giant rock beckons you further and further inside. Those that accept its invitation never come back again.
―Soul Spot 3/47―

BSC29-006.name: Nothing Ventured, Nothing Gained
BSC29-006.kanji: コケツにいらずんばコージを得ず
BSC29-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Your Spirits can target and attack an opposing 10000 BP or more Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit.
BSC29-006.flavor: "I get it, that I can understand. It's like Balgard's saying, 'if you want a zazang, lick a gennygamay', right?"

BS34-066.name: No. 40 Good Luck Hill
BS34-066.kanji: No.40 グッドラックヒル
BS34-066.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed) Return an opposing Nexus to the decktop.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step) When your effects would return opposing Spirit(s) to the Hand, by sending the Soul Core from your Spirits/Reserve to the Trash, return all the Spirits that would return to the Hand to only the opposing decktop or deckbottom in any order you want.
BS34-066.flavor:
Still, it's hard to believe there's such a happy-looking fort.
―Soul Spot 40/47―

BS16-021.name: Nouzenserval
BS16-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When summoning Spirit cards from your Hand via [High Speed], by exhausting this Spirit, treat up to two costs as being paid from your Reserve.
BS16-021.flavor:
After leaving Ocean Shield, Manaka headed to the land of Wind Shield, as a messenger had arrived at Angelias' place, telling him of the coming danger the land might face.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 646—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6889.name: No. 41 Support Celebration
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6889.kanji: No.41 サポートセレブレーション
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6889.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Brave Spirit attacks, you can draw a card. When you've done so, discard a card from your Hand.

[During Seal] [LV2] (Either Attack Step)

[Mirage: Cost 3 ([White Core][White Core])]

While there is Soul Core on your field, return every "Technique"-named Magic cards from the Trash to your Hand.
BS33-064.flavor:
A beautiful castle that suddenly reveals itself in the forest. Surrounded by plants, there's no visible entrance to the inside.
―Soul Spot 12/47―

BS31-049.name: One-Eyed Priest
BS31-049.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
Refresh a "Youkai" family Spirit you control.
BS31-049.flavor:
If you borrow money from the Youkai folk, it'll all turn into leaves and leap out of your hands.
―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―

SD29-012.name: No. 13 East Capital
SD29-012.kanji: No.13 イーストキャピタル
SD29-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit, or an opposing 10000 BP or less Ultimate.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is on this Nexus, when your Red Spirits are blocked by opposing 3000 BP or less Spirits, refresh them.
SD29-012.flavor:
A capital of strangely shaped rocks that prospers to the far east. I've always wanted to see the rock mountain called Sky Tree.
―Soul Spot 13/47―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6996.name: One Draw!
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6996.effect:
[Main]
Draw a card.

[Flash]
Pay one cost to summon an exactly-named "Shikitsuru" from your Trash.

BS24-011.name: One Eyed Demon
BS24-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [SSoul: Purple]
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains [Purple Core] (an extra Purple Symbol).
BS24-011.flavor: I believe that at least more than half of the members of our team should pay closer attention to the Purple Region. That area is taking the fiercest assaults from the Ultimates, yet the inhabitants have the most efficient countermeasures to control the amount of damage. I've been told that the Ogre Wizards who live in the area possess the strength to make this possible. Places that suffer the most damage should get top priority in our mission....

BSC24-047.name: One Trillion Degrees Fireball
BSC24-047.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. If you control any "SpaceDinosaur"-named Spirit, also, destroy an opposing 20000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

BS39-074.name: No. 14 God Apple River
BS39-074.kanji: No.14 ゴッドアップルリバー
BS39-074.effect:
When this Nexus card is revealed by [Mealtiply], you can deployed it, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2]
Cards can't be discarded from either player's deck.
[During Seal] Also, this Nexus can't be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Yellow Spirit is destroyed, draw a card.
BS39-074.flavor:
The sacred territory of Fruitsels where the golden fruit is enshrined. The water that runs in this river is said to be as sweet as nectar.
―Soul Spot 14/47―

BS33-066.name: No. 15 New Lagoon
BS33-066.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Main Step)
By putting an Ultimate card from your Hand face-up onto your Removed Zone, draw a card.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
When there is Soul Core in your Trash, refresh three White Spirits/Ultimates you control.
BS33-066.flavor:
A tidal flat is intended to protect the soil and provide nourishment for ocean life. This particular one even furnishes energy.
―Soul Spot 15/47―

BS31-091.name: No. 1 North Sea Road
BS31-091.kanji: No.1 ノースシーロード
BS31-091.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When your White Spirit is summoned first this turn, put a core from the Void to that Spirit.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
While [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Nexus, your Life can't be reduced by opposing 20000 BP or less Ultimates.
BS31-091.flavor:
A wintery land where everything is frozen. This glittering icy spectacle is worth seeing, but don't forget to bring a coat.
―Soul Spot 1/47―

BSC37-010.name: No No! Don't Come Here
BSC37-010.kanji: ダメダメッ！こないでー
BSC37-010.effect:
[Type: Song]

[Flash]
During this turn, all "Diva" family Spirits you control gain +5000 BP, and can block while exhausted. Or, during this turn, an opposing Spirit/Ultimate can't attack. Then, you can put this card onto your Field.

BS33-072.name: One-Shot Sure-Hit Draw
BS33-072.effect:
[Main]
Reveal five cards from your decktop. Add a Spirit card with [Awaken]/[True-Clash]/[Showdown]/[Consecutive Blade]/[Infinite Blade] among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit/Ultimate +2000 BP.

CB17-060.name: Ongekibou Rekka
CB17-060.effect:
[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve, and destroy it when its number of cores becomes one. If braved to an originally Cost 6 or more Spirit, instead, send two cores from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve, and destroy them when the number of cores on each of them becomes two or less.
CB17-060.flavor: A pair of Ongeki weapons with the shape of taiko drumsticks. They can be used to defeat the Makamous.

CB17-073.name: Ongekiko Soubitai
CB17-073.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Kamen" & "Ogre Wizard" family effect, or "Machine" & "Machine Beast" family effect, you can put it onto your Field.

[Type: Driver] <sub>(While on the Field, the following effects are active)</sub>
█ Once per turn, during either Attack Step, you can use the [Accel] of a "Machine" & "Machine Beast" family card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[Flash]
You can discard two cards from your decktop. Then, summon/deploy a Cost 4 or less "Hibiki"-named card from your Trash, without paying the cost. Then, put this card onto your Field.

CB24-068.name: Ongekizofukuken Armed Saber
CB24-068.kanji: 音撃増幅剣・装甲声刃
CB24-068.effect:
When this card is revealed from deck by your "Kamen" & "Ogre Wizard" family, or "Machine" & "Machine Beast" family effect, you can add it to your Hand.

[During Brave] Flash - (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, you can use the [Accel] of a "Machine" & "Machine Beast" family card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[During Brave]
While braved to "Armed Hibiki", this Spirit gains two Purple symbols.
CB24-068.flavor: The sword-form Ongeki Weapon created by Kogure Konosuke. It can generate special sound waves to increase the power of an Oni.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7007.name: Onisiroman
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Put a random card from the opposing Hand on the Removed Zone.

[LV2] (When Attacks) Put a core from the Void to this Spirit for each card on the opposing Removed Zone. This effect can only be used once per turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7007.flavor:
In later years, there would be theories stating that Hermes lead the entire conspiracy, but they are mistaken. The one pulling strings was, of course, Zeus-Lolo, and Hermes was naught but a pawn. He just happened to be an excellent pawn. Bringing Anubis to their side, sending a letter to Susanoo, he led everything in a way that would put his lord, Zeus-Lolo, in an advantageous position.
ー"Genesis Records" New Volume 3:25ー

BS10-075.name: Oniyurin
BS10-075.effect:
[When Braved] [Holy Life] (When Brave Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.
BS10-075.flavor:
A young girl Brave?! Th-that's a first!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS32-011.name: Onmyou Child
BS32-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
While [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, this Spirit can't attack, and is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2] (Either Main Step)
When a player would increase core from the Void via an effect, instead of the Void, the core is taken from the Life of the owner that activated the effect. Neither player can activate Burst even if the Life is reduced due to this effect.
BS32-011.flavor: The first fort that the Supreme Beast Army attacked had only a few troops stationed there.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7010.name: Onmyou Talisman
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7010.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks)
Send a core from the opposing Field to their Trash. Also, while braved to a Spirit whose original Cost is 3 or less, this Brave's symbol becomes zero.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Skill: 4] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) Summon a Cost 4/5/8 "Evil Shadow"/"Youkai" family Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost. This effect doesn't trigger [Core Charge].

BS61-009.name: Onmyouja
BS61-009.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Purple Core][Purple Core])]
[During Set] Flash -
You can discard this Mirage. When you do, the opponent destroys a Spirit they control. Then, destroy a Spirit you control.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
Draw a card.
BS61-009.flavor:
Dear adviser, could you lend me your wisdom? That Wander Dan just won't go down...He that would the daughter win, must with the mother first begin! I wonder which Contract Spirit should I first deal with ... Hmm, how about starting from that knight?
―The PartnerMusha Oboro―

BS11-020.name: Onmyoyamasemi
BS11-020.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can summon a Brave card from your Hand to directly brave it to this Spirit.
BS11-020.flavor:
It is said the onmyoji of the Great Tree's forest has divinated the end result of this war. But it turns out that after his ritual, he couldn't see anything. Could this be a sign that the world's end is near? Or is it simply a conclusion that no one can predict...?
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS61-008.name: Onnendama
BS61-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Besides via Burst effects, when either player would summon a Spirit card without paying the original cost, unless the original cost is paid, it can't be summoned.

[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
Your counter +1. Then, you can destroy an opposing Spirit with one core or less on it.
BS61-008.flavor:
We are called the "Kijins", and came from a village at the far far East. Owing to unavoidable circumstances, we are now the enemies of this world. From this point onwards, our mission would be to seek the Contractor out, and eliminate him.
―The PartnerMusha Oboro―

BS12-053.name: Oodsutsunanafushi
BS12-053.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can discard your entire Hand (at least one card). When you've done so, draw cards from your deck equal to the number of cards in the opposing Hand.

[During Brave]
When the opponent draws, refresh this Spirit.
BS12-053.flavor:
It isn't strong enough to kill, but its accuracy is 99.8% - the top ranking among both forces combined!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BSC49-062.name: Oodsutsunanafushi LT
BSC49-062.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can discard your entire Hand (at least one card). When you've done so, draw a card for each card in the opposing Hand.

[During Brave]
Once per turn, when the opposing Hand increases, or cards are put onto the opposing Removed Zone, this Spirit can refresh.
BSC49-062.flavor:
It isn't strong enough to kill, but its accuracy is 99.8% - the top ranking among both forces combined!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BSC21-011.name: Ookurikara
BSC21-011.effect:
When your Cost 8 Ultimate is summoned, return this Brave card from your Trash to the Hand.

[When Braved]
Treat this Brave as Cost 2.
BSC21-011.flavor: The sea dragon on the favored blade of the one-eyed warrior looks in four directions to widen its master's field of vision.

SD29-003.name: OosodePtera
SD29-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit is blocked, draw one card.

[LV2]
While [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is on this Spirit, this Spirit gains +4000 BP.
SD29-003.flavor: Combat Era year 443. The seventh shogun died suddenly. Six years later, his younger brother became the eighth shogun. However, the eighth shogun was young, and the real power rested with his advisers the military commanders. Twenty years since, the eighth shogun lost interest in politics, and the world fell into ruin.

BS22-059.name: Ootoki Kite
BS22-059.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Exhaust two opposing Cost 4 or less Spirits. Or, exhaust an opposing Brave Spirit.
BS22-059.flavor: There are numerous methods to achieve flight. However, the proclaimed shinobi seem to prefer using this kite for some reason.

BS73-068.name: Orbital Elevator, Kandata
BS73-068.kanji: 軌道エレベーター・カンダタ
BS73-068.effect:
[LV1] [Rebirth4m]
At the start of your Attack Step, by sending a core from your "Contractor Yamato Takeru" Grandwalker Nexus to this Nexus, flip this Nexus.

[LV1] (Opposing Turn)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect, if you control any "Contractor Yamato Takeru", you can put a core from the Void to any of your Nexuses. When you've done so, return a card from the opposing Trash to the deckbottom.
BS73-068.flavor:
The world of Yamato Takeru is a world where force-powered Machines, unlike Clever Machines, are developed. The orbital elevator Kandata, which symbolises such a world, is an inter-world transportation device that connects different worlds.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 207―

P17-12.name: Ophanimon Falldown Mode
P17-12.kanji: オファニモン フォールダウンモード
P17-12.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Purple/Yellow & Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
By returning a pre-advent card beneath this Spirit without [Advent] to the Hand, draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attack)
By destroying an opposing exhausted spirit, put a core from the Void to your Life.

P18-03.name: Ordinemon
P18-03.effect:
Flash - ⚞Advent⚟: Mega (Either Attack Step)
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your hand onto your target spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks) You can add one Spirit you control as a pre-Advent card to this Spirit. When you've done so, this Spirit refreshes.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks) You can return one of this Spirit's pre-Advent cards to the deckbottom. When you've done so, destroy an opposing exhausted spirit, and put two cores from the Void to this Spirit.

BS60-XX02.name: Oracle 0 Over Fool
BS60-XX02.kanji: オラクル0 オーバーフール
BS60-XX02.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2]
[During Set]
Your set Burst is unaffected by opposing effects. Also, when your "The Fool" would leave the Field due to opposing effects, one of them can remain on the Field, exhausted.

[Main]
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve. Then, if you have at least three more counters than the opponent, draw two cards.

BS61-003.name: Orencheetah
BS61-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [SSoul: Red Red]
When you are summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains two extra Red Symbols.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
All your Ultimate symbols are also treated as Red/Yellow/Blue.
BS61-003.flavor:
While there is not much time left before the operation begins, we've obtained the help from the Ryuumans. Six hours till the completion of Euro's new weapon, the Contract Armor... We could only rely on the power of the Ultimates now.
―The Investigator Fric―

PB39-003.name: Oracle 3 Over Penpress
PB39-003.kanji: オラクル3 オーバーペンプレス
PB39-003.effect:
This card is also treated as "Pentan".

[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Yellow Core])]
[During Set]
Once per turn, when your Green/Yellow "Song Bird" family Spirit is summoned/[advents], you can draw a card.

[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
The symbol of every attacking Spirit/Ultimate on its lowest LV that isn't in the "Song Bird" family is fixed as 0.

[Flash]
During this turn, an opposing Spirit/Ultimate can't attack/block.

CB16-072.name: Orga Itsuka
CB16-072.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Tekkadan/Teiwaz) (Tekkadan/Teiwaz & Brave)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit/Brave, you can put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV1][LV2] (Start of Either Attack Step)
(Send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) Summon a "Tekkadan" family card from your Trash, without paying the cost. This effect doesn't trigger [Core Charge].

[Grand Field] [LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, by discarding three cards from your decktop, draw a card, and during this turn, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

BS56-077.name: Oracle III Over Empress
BS56-077.kanji: オラクルIII オーバーエンプレス
BS56-077.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Yellow Core])]
[During Set]
Once per turn, when your Green/Yellow "Proximate" family Spirit is summoned, you can draw a card. If you control any "The Empress" Spirit, this effect draws +1 card.

[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
The symbol of every attacking LV1 Spirit is fixed as 0.

[Flash]
During this turn, an opposing Spirit/Ultimate can't attack/block.

BS10-113.name: Orion Power
BS10-113.effect:
[Main]
During this turn, when the attack of your "Fighting Spirit"/"Astral Soul" family Spirit reduces the opposing Life, discard ten cards from the opposing decktop.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

BS62-073.name: Oracle II Over High Priestess
BS62-073.kanji: オラクルII オーバーハイプリエステス
BS62-073.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Silver Zero" family Spirit effect, you can set it without paying the cost. When you do, return your originally set Mirage to the Hand.

[Mirage: Cost 2 ([White Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
Every "The High Priestess" you control gains an extra White symbol.

[During Set] (Opposing Turn)
When the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect, you can draw a card.

[Flash]
Refresh a "Silver Contract"/"Astroblazer" family Spirit you control.

BSC49-100.name: Orion Power LT
BSC49-100.effect:
When this card is discarded from your Hand by your Blue effect, you can activate its Main/Flash effect.

[Main]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) During this turn, when the attack of your "Astral Soul"/ "Galaxian"/ "Fighting Spirit" family Spirit reduces the opposing Life, discard ten cards from the opposing decktop.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit/Ultimate +3000 BP.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7030.name: Oracle IV Over Emperor
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7030.kanji: オラクルIV オーバーエンペラー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7030.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 4 ([Red Core][Red Core][White Core])]
[During Set]
While your "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects, and while you control any "The Emperor"-named Spirits, the life reduction due to the attack of that Spirit can't be prevented by opposing White Magic effects.

[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
Neither player can summon "Primal" family Spirit cards from their deck via effects.

[Flash]
Destroy every opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

CBX01-018.name: Orphee Lam Tao
CBX01-018.kanji: オルフェ・ラム・タオ
CBX01-018.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
Besides "Orphee Lam Tao", put a core from the Void each to every "Foundation" family Spirit you control.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by exhausting a White-only Spirit you control, refresh this Spirit.

BS14-046.name: Pam
BS14-046.flavor:
The country of Light Shield was also known as "The Betrayer Country." All things in this land were caused by money. It would ally itself with those who offered more money than their enemies. It would later be the starting point where Manaka planned his comeback, but when he first visited the country, he had no idea of the destiny lying in store for him.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 629—

SD70-001.name: Orpheus
SD70-001.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Blue & Wild, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit/Ultimate.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7034.name: Pandal
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7034.effect: [LV1][LV2] Windstorm: 1 - (When Attacks) When this Spirit is blocked, your opponent exhausts the specified number of Spirits they control.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7034.flavor: The Vanity Deity of Wind Shield appeared and concealed itself in a region of bamboo groves called the "Flowered Woods." The spirit who came to guide me there did not have a tough appearance.

BSC16-020.name: Ortina Clan
BSC16-020.kanji: オルティーナ・クラン
BSC16-020.effect:
[team: Absolutes]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
If you control three or more "Private Wear" family Spirits, draw a card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [On Stage] (Your Attack Step)
Instead of attacking with this Spirit, by returning this Spirit to the deckbottom, summon a "Stage Style" family "Ortina Clan" from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost, and draw a card.

CB06-075.name: Pandora's Box
CB06-075.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When you're summoning "Kamen" family Spirits/ using the [Change] of "Kamen" family cards, this Nexus' symbol is also treated as Red/Purple/Green/Yellow/Blue

[LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Draw three cards. Then, if it's (Opposing Turn), end the turn.
CB06-075.flavor: A mysterious object brought from Mars. Due to the Sky Walls created by the light it released, the Japanese Archipelago was divided in three.

BS59-073.name: Oracle IX Over Hermit
BS59-073.kanji: オラクルIX オーバーハーミット
BS59-073.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 4 ([Purple Core][Purple Core][White Core])]
[During Set] (Start of Your Attack Step)
You can send a core from the opposing Field to the Reserve.

[During Set] (Start of Opposing Attack Step)
The opponent sends cores from a Spirit/Ultimate they control to the Reserve until only one core remains. If you control any "The Hermit"-named Spirit, the cores to be sent to Reserve by this effect are sent to the Trash instead.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with three cores or more on it.

BS39-025.name: Pangon
BS39-025.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
While [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, this Spirit can't attack and is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2]
When summoning Cost 3 or less Spirit cards/Ultimate cards, neither player can use reduction symbols to reduce the costs.
BS39-025.flavor: "Scuderia Maclarn"'s vanguard is probing the course. This data is immediately analyzed and fed back to the racers. That's the secret of "Scuderia Maclarn"'s strength.

BS61-067.name: Oracle I Over Magician
BS61-067.kanji: オラクルI オーバーマジシャン
BS61-067.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Red Core])]
[During Set] (Start of Your Attack Step)
If you control any Red “Proximate”/“Astroblazer”/“Scarlet Flame” family Spirit/Nexus, your counter +1. Then, return up to three cores from your Trash to “The Magician”.

[During Set] (Start of Your Attack Step)
You can destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[Flash]
Ignoring any "BP+" and "give +BP" effects, destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

BS18-082.name: Panic Voice
BS18-082.effect:
[Flash]
Exhaust an opposing non-attacking Spirit, and block with it. This effect can only be used on the Flash Timing before block during the (Opposing Attack Step).

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7041.name: Pantera's Heart and Life
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7041.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed by the Opponent]
Reveal a card from your decktop. If that card is an exactly-named "The SupernovaDragon Siegwurm-Nova", you can summon it without paying the cost and without [Tribute]. Add any remaining cards to the Hand. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit. Also, refresh an exactly-named "The SupernovaDragon Siegwurm-Nova" you control.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7042.name: Pantomeister
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7042.effect: [LV2] (Permanent) The cost of "Ice Princess" spirit cards in your hand are treated as 5.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7042.flavor:
Clowns are neutral. I heard that they would never join the battle. The only exception is the yellow girl and one more guy. It is so heartwarming to see him bustle about for his princess of glass.
-from the 3rd paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

SD60-010.name: Panzer Aura
SD60-010.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks]
During this battle, when only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via comparing BP with your Purple/White Spirit, send an opposing Life to the Reserve. Then by paying the cost, activate this card's flash effect.

[Flash]
During this turn, every Purple/White Spirit you control gains +3000 BP. Also, if it is the opposing Attack Step, refresh every Spirit you control.

PAO-PEIR2.name: Pao-Peir
PAO-PEIR2.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed) By exhausting an "Imaginary Beast" family Spirit you control, this Spirit remains on the Field, refreshed.

[LV3] All your "Vanity Deity"/"Deified General" family Spirits are treated as being on their highest Levels.
PAO-PEIR2.flavor: Either all the Keys will be gathered or the world will get pulverized before that happens... I've had just about enough of this war! Gimme a break!!

BSC45-064.name: Pao-Peir LT
BSC45-064.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
By exhausting another "Vanity Deity"/"Deified General"/"Imaginary Beast" family Spirit you control, draw a card, and this Spirit remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV3]
All your "Vanity Deity"/"Deified General" family Spirits are treated as being on their highest LVs.

BS62-072.name: Oracle XIV Over Temperance

[Flash]
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit. Then, if you have six counters or more, refresh a “Jade Thunder” family Spirit you control.

It is often called the Country of Ninjas, but its official name is the Country of Willow.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, First Day of the Third Month-

26RBS02-026.name: Phindol
26RBS02-026.effect:
[LV2] When Attacks
Put a core from the Void to your Trash.
26RBS02-026.flavor: She carries no weapons and wears no armors. Instead, she possesses some of the greatest speed among the Vortexite.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7108.name: Ourovorius-Rebirth
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7108.kanji: ウロヴォリアス・リバース

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7108.flavor: Is that... Racer Ourovorius....? No, no way.....Tonio, is that your doing?

BS18-033.name: Outlaw-Kid
BS18-033.effect:
[LV2] (Opposing Start Step)
Target up to two opposing exhausted Spirits. Those targeted Spirit(s) can't refresh during the next (Opposing Refresh Step).

After reigning ten years as the Empress, Kei abdicated from the throne. Over the next year, she and Manaka left on a trip around the world together with their children. After returning to her homeland, she passed away some six months later. Having sacrificed everything in her life for the sake of her country ever since childhood, in her recent disease-ridden state, this was the one time she finally did something purely for herself.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Imperial Year 11—

BS61-052.name: Phoenix-Feaniel

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7133.name: Pigeonheadiless

The Seventh Shogun's army vanished in an instant. The dragons of the empty sky displayed their overwhelming strength again. The demon's pigeons flew away in all directions to report their defeat. I felt an urge to run away before another deity might descend from the sky.
-from the 10th paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7134.name: Pentaceratop

BSC45-015.name: Pigeonheadiless LT

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7139.flavor:
An Olymian Grandwalker attacked Nairaka, a world which was left empty due to Osiris' expedition.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 1:27―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7140.flavor:
The pacifist citizens of Flame Shield already were close to worshiping the Hero Dragon and Manaka. Losing both of them at the same time caused the whole of Flame Shield to go berserk, but it was sadly ironic that the former pacifists were the most active.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 644—

With also the help from the denizens of the Yellow World, we have searched desperately for any traces Alex or the three disaster beasts remained. It ended up in vain, however.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 3:03―

BSC42-058.name: Pentan LT

◆When you Summon/Advent a target Spirit, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2]
This Nexus' symbol is also treated as Yellow.

[Grand Skill: 2] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) Draw a card. Then, refresh a "Diva" family Spirit you control.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
When your "Diva" family Spirit is summoning Spirit cards without paying the cost, effects of every opposing Spirit can't activate.

BS39-051.name: Purple Demon-God
BS39-051.effect:
This Brave can't exhaust, and while in Spirit condition, can't attack nor block.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve.

[During Left/Right Brave] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7257.name: Producer Saraswati
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7257.kanji: プロデューサーサラスヴァティー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7257.effect:
[Core Charge: ([Grand Siesta] , Diva & Cost 5 or more)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Nexus with the same card name as this card, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 3] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) Refresh a [Grand Siesta] Spirit you control.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
When your "Diva" family Spirits would leave the Field due to an opposing effect, by sending four cores from this Nexus to the Void, one of those targets remains on the Field, exhausted.

EXG4-002.name: Purple Flash's Extreme
EXG4-002.kanji: 紫電のエクストリーム
EXG4-002.effect:
This card and you are unaffected by any effect other than this card's effect, this card can't be used on Your Turn, and is banished from the game after its effect resolves.

[Flash]
Treat this card as colorless, and send all cores from every opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve. Then, during this turn, increase the LV cost of every opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus by +2.

BSC46-X08.name: Producer and Manager, Purin Garfield
BSC46-X08.kanji: プロデューサー兼マネージャープリン・ガーフィールド
BSC46-X08.effect:
[Core Charge: ("Rei-Ohba") (Yellow-only & Brave) (This Nexus can only hold up to 6 cores)]
◆When you Summon/Advent a target Spirit/Brave, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
(Once per turn, send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) Summon a Cost 4 or less "Rei-Ohba" from your Hand/Soul State, without paying the cost.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
The opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects. Also, when your "Rei-Ohba" that is braved to two Braves is blocked, for each symbol that Spirit has, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

BS19-102.name: Purple Haze
BS19-102.effect:
[Flash]
Send a core from an opposing Spirit to their Reserve. When this effect brought the number of cores on that Spirit to 0, return this Magic card to your Hand.

BSC29-012.name: Professor Battle Usagi's BS Course!
BSC29-012.kanji: バトルウサギー先生のバトスピ講座！
BSC29-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Draw Step)
At the start of the step, by discarding a Yellow Spirit card from your Hand, increase the number of cards you draw by +1.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Yellow Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, by discarding a Magic card from your Hand, one of those destroyed Spirits remains on the Field , exhausted.
BSC29-012.flavor: "This nexus lets you increase your draws by discarding one spirit card from your hand during your draw step. Discard the cards you don't need and draw out your key spirit!!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7262.name: Pygmygator
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7262.flavor:
The worst awaits ahead of the fleeing lizards.
I mount Ikazuchi and rush ahead. I must catch up to Lord in the lead.

P13-10.name: Ray-Python
P13-10.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
By destroying an opposing exhausted Cost 3 or less Spirit, draw a card.

[LV2] (When Destroyed)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve.
P13-10.flavor: There is a reason why the snakes are so wise. It is because they share information between themselves and deepen their knowledge. Since there is so much knowledge among them, there are even snakes who can see the future.

BS44-063.name: Pyramid-Golem
BS44-063.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks) Put one core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, once per turn, by sending one core from any of your Grandwalker Nexus to the Void, this Spirit refreshes.
BS44-063.flavor:
Osiris and the Dark Snakes returned to the defensive, and then decided it was reckless to continue fighting. They abandoned Nairaka and retreated to a different Egytian territory.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 1:32―

LM16-08.name: Professor Battleskii's BS Course!
LM16-08.kanji: バトルスキー先生のバトスピ講座！
LM16-08.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
During this turn, treat a Spirit you control as being on its highest LV.

[LV2]
When your Spirit is destroyed by opposing effects, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
LM16-08.flavor: This nexus can treat one of your spirits as its highest level when deployed. If you calculate when to deploy it, you can use all the effects of whatever spirit you want. When the LV rises, so does the BP. But it's only at it's highest level for that turn, so watch out.

BS44-083.name: Pyramid Atop The Sapphire Sea
BS44-083.kanji: サファイアの海上ピラミッド
BS44-083.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Cards in either Trash are unaffected by all effects other than this one, and their effects can't be used.

[LV2] (Start of Your Draw Step)
By revealing a Blue card in your Hand and returning it to the deckbottom, increase the number of cards you draw by +1.
BS44-083.flavor:
Countless worlds exist in Egyt, but pyramidal buildings are apparently their favorite. On the world occupied by the beast heads citizens, there's even a giant building atop the ocean.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 473―

BS11-004.name: Prominencewyvern
BS11-004.kanji: プロミネンスワイバーン
BS11-004.effect:
When your "Sun"-named Spirit is summoned, you can summon this Spirit card from the Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - [Awaken]
You can put any number of cores from Spirits you control to this Spirit.
BS11-004.flavor:
Looking from a distance, the Oort Dragon's Nest looks like a giant hourglass. Something sprinkles and falls from its center. As I turned my gaze downwards, I gasped; falling into a massive pile were the bodies of Lunar Brigade troops, all in miserable condition...
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

CB25-005.name: Re-GZ
CB25-005.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon one of your "Nu Gundam" that is in Soul State/pre-advent condition. Then, if it's the Attack Step, draw a card, and (Once per Turn: Same Name), you can send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to another "LB" family Spirit/Nexus you control.
CB25-005.flavor: A mass-production prototype redesigned from MSZ-006, the unit that made spectacular performance in the Gryps Conflict.

BS52-CP10.name: Promise Draw
BS52-CP10.effect:
[Main]
Draw a card. Then, if you control any "Dan" Grandwalker Nexus, draw two cards.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a "Sieg"/"Wurm" Spirit you control +10000 BP.

CB25-006.name: Re-GZ［BWS］
CB25-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a "LB" family card among them to your Hand. Return any remaining cads to the deckbottom. When this effect adds any card to Hand, your counter +1.

[LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can summon a Cost 6 or less "LB" family Spirit card/Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
CB25-006.flavor: Equipped with the "Back Weapon System", the MA form of Re-GZ.

BS22-003.name: Prophet-Dragon
BS22-003.kanji: プロフェット・ドラゴン
BS22-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
By revealing any number of Cost 8 or more Spirit cards from your Hand and putting them onto your Removed Zone, draw a card for each card revealed. The Spirit cards put onto the Removed Zone are still usable in the game as if they were in your Hand.
BS22-003.flavor:
"A ray of light shall shine upon a world ravaged by ruin. This light shall wield a sword of the stars and guide the world's people."
His predictions are never wrong. Hope still remains for us.

CB22-003.name: Re-Special Aircraft No.1 Space Sevenger
CB22-003.kanji: 特空機1号改 宇宙セブンガー
CB22-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to any "Trigger"/"Tiga"/"Zett"-named Spirit you control.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Blue.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.
CB22-003.flavor: The customized outer-space designated Special Aircraft No.1 Space Sevenger. Its right arm is equipped with drill-shaped Super Rigid Core Drill Fist.

RP26-02.name: Proplematis
RP26-02.effect:
Legacy

[LV2] During AttackOnce Per Turn
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, this Spirit can refresh.
RP26-02.flavor: If Proplematis sets its sights on you, it will chase you relentlessly. But if you keep running without giving up, it will eventually get bored and go away.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7274.name: Pyramid Boa
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7274.effect:
By discarding this card from your hand during (Your Draw Step), the number of card you draw is increased by +1.

This card in your Trash is treated as Cost 6.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) Send 3 cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve. If you control any Purple-only Grandwalker Nexus, instead, send 3 cores from an opposing Spirit to the Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7274.flavor:
Leaving the Delpo-Nairaka they conquered to the returning Osiris, Isis and Set immediately head to their next destination.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 2:37―

CB29-052.name: Prospera Mercury
CB29-052.kanji: プロスペラ・マーキュリー
CB29-052.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from the decktop. Among them, add "Ericht"/"Suletta"/"Quiet Zero"/"If You Run, You Gain One", one of each, to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, you can refresh a "Aerial"/"Lfrith"/"Gundnode" for every three counters you have.

BS76-055.name: Pyrite-Golem
BS76-055.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Hephaestus" & C4 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1-2-3] (When Manifests/Attacks)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Contractor Hephaestus" or a "Devotee" & "Artificial Soldier" family card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2-3] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Devotee"/"Concluser" & "Artificial Soldier" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects of Spirit cards.
BS76-055.flavor:
Well, I suppose there are Traitor Heroes in Tartarus too.
―Grandwalker Hephaestus―

CB33-003.name: Protagonist & Thanatos
CB33-003.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Blue & Wild & C3 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can send all cores from an opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void. You can draw a card for each two cores sent via this effect.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total cost of six.

BS24-050.name: Quartz-Golem
BS24-050.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
Discard a card from the opposing decktop.
BS24-050.flavor: The Sapphire Realm was the region with the fewest eyewitnesses to the assault of the Ultimates. Perhaps because of this, there are many here that disregard the Ultimates as a threat.

BS10-106.name: Protect Aura
BS10-106.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, all your blocking Spirits gain +2000 BP. Also, all your blocking Brave Spirits gain +3000 BP.

BS43-090.name: Quasar Rain
BS43-090.effect:
When Spirits are summoned via opposing effects, you can use this Magic card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit. If you control any "Wurm"-named Spirit, instead, destroy an opposing 20000 BP or less Spirit. The effects of the Spirit destroyed by this effect can't activate.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7281.name: Protector's Authority
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7281.effect:
When this card was either revealed from deck by the effect of your exactly-named "Godseeker Kamimusubi-Hydra", or sent to the Trash by the effect of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Susanoo", you can add it to the Hand. When you've done so, put a core from the Void to any Grandwalker Nexus you control.

[Main]
Draw three cards. Then, either discard a "Terra Dragon"/"Ocean Emperor" family Spirit card, or three other cards from your Hand. Then, by sending a core from any of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Susanoo" to the Void, opposing effects and opposing Bursts can't be activated via this effect.

BS26-016.name: Queen-Nightmare
BS26-016.kanji: クィーン・ナイトメア
BS26-016.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return all Brave cards from your Trash to the Hand. For each Brave card returned, send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
Unless the opponent sends a core from their Life to their Reserve, they can't block with their Ultimates. The opponent can't activate their Bursts via this effect.
BS26-016.flavor: This is an insane number of Braves! They're pouring out one after another!

SD54-005.name: ReZEL
SD54-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. Also, while braved to a "Pilot" family Brave, this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing 10000 BP or less Spirits.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.
SD54-005.flavor: The first mass produced transforming MS the Earth Federation created. Many were aboard the Nahel Argama and it is called the Romeo during operations. Riddhe Marcenas was one of the many who piloted it, and in Industrial 7, ReZEL was used to save Audrey, Takuya and Micott.

26RBS01-X05.name: Queen Babianaros
26RBS01-X05.kanji: クイーン・バビアナロス
26RBS01-X05.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2] [Shaman: Dark Puce & Cost 5 or less] When Summoned
You can target a Cost 5 or less "Dark Puce" family Spirit card in your Trash. Summon it.

[LV2]True ReleaseWhen Attacks
Target an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit. For each Spirit with [Shamanism] you control, send a core from it to the Reserve. (The opponent chooses which cores to send)
26RBS01-X05.flavor: "Looks like the punishment wasn't enough, eh?"

26RBS01-015.name: Protomaia
26RBS01-015.effect:
Legacy
[LV2] True Release [Clash] During Attack
Opposing Spirits must block if possible.
26RBS01-015.flavor: Do not underestimate it just because it is made of clouds. Its power can't be stopped even by steel.

CB24-036.name: Queen Bee Deadman Phase 3
CB24-036.kanji: クイーンビー・デッドマン フェーズ3
CB24-036.effect:
When summoning this card, by sending up to three cores from one of your exactly-named "The Queen of Evil Aguilera" to the Void, for each core sent, this card's cost gets -1.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send two cores each from two opposing Spirits to the Reserve.
CB24-036.flavor: The Phase 3 form known as Gifftex that Queen Bee Deadman evolves into using the power of Queen Bee Proto Vistamp.

CB13-011.name: ReZEL ［Commander Type］
CB13-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. Then, if you control another "Federation" family Spirit, you can draw a card.

[LV2][LV3]
When your "Federation" family Spirits are destroyed by an opposing effect, you can returned them to the Hand.
CB13-011.flavor: The commander type ReZEL owned by Nahel Argama. Its pilot is Norm Basilicock. It tried to help the ReZel piloted by Riddhe, but was eventually shot down by Sinanju.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7288.name: Providence Gundam
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7288.kanji: プロヴィデンスガンダム
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7288.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Cost 7 or less
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Cost 7 or less effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By paying two costs, during this turn, every opposing Spirit's cost gets -1. Then, return an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When the opponent uses a Cost 5 or less card from their Hand, before that effect activates, by discarding a "ZAFT" family card from your Removed Zone, immediately negate that effect.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7288.flavor: This is mankind's dream, mankind's desire, mankind's destiny!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7289.name: Reactive Barrier
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7289.effect:
When your Life would be reduced by an opposing effect, by discarding this Magic card from your Hand, your Life would only be reduced by one. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
When this battle ends, end the Attack Step.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7290.name: Provocation
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7290.effect:
At the end of the opposing Main Step, you can use this Magic card from your Hand.

Flash- Target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, that Spirit must attack, if possible.

BS05-071.name: Reanimate
BS05-071.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, when your Spirits with [Curse] are destroyed by opposing Spirits via BP comparison, they return to your Field, exhausted.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7292.name: Queen Demon-God
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7292.effect:
This Brave doesn't exhaust and, while in Spirit form, can't attack nor block.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

BSC42-082.name: Reanimate LT
BSC42-082.effect:
[Main]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Summon a Cost 3 or less Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[Flash]
During this turn, when your Spirits with [Curse] are destroyed by opposing Spirits via BP comparison, they can remain on the Field, exhausted.

SD57-X01.name: Queen Oichi
SD57-X01.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
If you control any six-colored Spirit/Nexus, you can summon this card from the Hand by paying two costs.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
During this turn, treat this Spirit's color as colorless, and send two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can summon a six-colored Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.
SD57-X01.flavor:
We, the Six Heaven Army, would follow brother lord, to wherever he goes!
-The End-

CB25-045.name: Quess Paraya
CB25-045.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

(Once per Turn: Same Name) During either Attack Step, when Spirit is summoned via your "NZ" family effect, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[During Brave]
The effects of opposing Spirits/Nexuses destroyed by the effects of your Spirits with [Funnel] can't activate.

CB33-062.name: Psyche
CB33-062.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Blue & Hierophant Arcana & C2 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

(Once per Turn: Same Name) Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Aigis", you can [Contract Advent] this card from the Hand, treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents)
You can destroy any number of opposing Spirits, up to a total of Cost 6.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can return a pre-advent card of your other Spirits to the Hand.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7297.name: Racing Pentan
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7297.effect:
When your Life would be reduced by an opposing effect, by discarding this card from the Removed Zone, your Life is not reduced.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
During this turn, an opposing Spirit/Ultimate's symbol is fixed at zero. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7297.flavor: The racer who got into the rankings at Monaca GP has removed its costume and entered Serious Mode. That earnest gaze staring at the goal.... But wait, that's not the right road, you know?!

CB25-071.name: Psycho-Frame
CB25-071.effect:
[Main]
Draw two cards.

[Flash]
Send five cores from an opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void. Or, including being in Soul State, if you control any "Nu Gundam"/"Sazabi", send five cores each from two opposing Cost 3 or less Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void.

CB07-046.name: Reaper
CB07-046.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard eight cards from the opposing decktop.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Turn)
When your "Reaper"-named Spirit's "Opposing Deck Discarding" effect discards any cards: If among them there is any Spirit card, put two cores from the Void to any of your Spirits; If there is any Brave card/Nexus card, exhaust three opposing Spirits; If there is any Magic card, then, destroy an opposing Cost 8 or less Spirit.
CB07-046.flavor: The final form of the D-Reapers. Its all-erasing figure is truly befitting of the name "Reaper."

BS53-026.name: Racket Hummingbird
BS53-026.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing turn)
When the opponent would summon any Ultimate cards/Cost 3 Spirit cards, they are summoned in exhausted state.
BS53-026.flavor:
Naive. Too naive. How come I never considered that they would have reached even the Green World. Not so far away from the lab, a horned disaster beast awaited. The whale-like monster was from the sea, and the horned one was from the land?
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 2:13―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7301.name: Pteranodon Yummy (Male & Female)
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7301.kanji: プテラノドンヤミー（♂・♀）
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7301.effect:
When your exactly-named "Dinosaur Greeed" is summoned, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand/Trash

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
You can discard three cards from your decktop. Then, return up to three exactly-named "Cell Medal" from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy two opposing Spirits with one core or less on them.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7301.flavor: Birthed by the Greeed-turned Maki Kiyoto. With "Returning everything to nothingness" as their objective, they assault the city dwellers one after another.

CB15-031.name: Quetzalcoatlus Dopant
CB15-031.kanji: ケツァルコアトルス・ドーパント
CB15-031.effect:
When summoning this card from the Hand, if there are five or more "Dopant"-named cards in your Trash, this card becomes Cost 5.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
While there are ten or more "Dopant"-named cards in your Trash, this Spirit has three Purple symbols.
CB15-031.flavor: The form that a Macaw transforms into after Shinkuro Isaka stabbing it with a copied Quetzalcoatlus Memory. It takes on a giant pterosaur form.

26RSD05-012.name: Rebirth Thunder
26RSD05-012.effect:
When your "Thunder Dragon" family Spirits are destroyed, you can return this card from the Trash to your Hand. You can only use this effect of the same card name once per turn.

[Flash]
Target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, give it -2000 BP. Then, destroy it if it has 0 BP.
26RSD05-012.flavor: It is said that a dragon skilled in handling thunder can transform itself into thunder itself, and thereby attain thunder-like speed.

CB09-067.name: Radar Module
CB09-067.effect:
[During Brave]
This Spirit can Brave with up to four "Module"-named Braves.

[During Brave]
Once per turn, when the opposing Hand is increased via an opposing effect, you can draw a card.
CB09-067.flavor: A module which was equipped on Fourze's left arm by using the Radar Switch.

BS21-019.name: Quick-Mosqui
BS21-019.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.
BS21-019.flavor: It's some small mercy that the insects had no interest in the spheres or their materials. We managed to obtain just the materials.

BS56-004.name: Radome Dragon
BS56-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Besides any exactly-named "Radome-Dragon", return a "Machine Dragon" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. Then, by discarding one of your Red/White Mirage, return this Spirit to the Hand.
BS56-004.flavor:
The fight using "Mirage" became a seesaw play. The teamwork of Astra and the mecha-dragons was superb that they were nowhere near defeat. While the Spacetime Police still had the advantage, I didn't think it would be easy to finish off the battle.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5:35―

BS42-094.name: Quick Draw
BS42-094.effect:
[Flash]
