[Main]
Draw two cards. Then, reveal four cards from your decktop. Add an exactly-named "Grandwalker Dan" among them to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. While you control any exactly-named "Grandwalker Dan," increase the limit of this "BP Destruction effect" by +10000 BP.

SD25-001.name: Rukbart-Dragon
SD25-001.kanji: ルクバート・ドラゴン
SD25-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [SSoul: Red]
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains [Red Core] (an extra Red Symbol).

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your Spirits gain +1000 BP.
SD25-001.flavor: Agh, being a guest at these talks is just... I'd rather be a ghost. ...What, Euro? Don't look at me like that. Let me make my puns.

CB09-X03.name: Sagittarius Nova
CB09-X03.kanji: サジタリウス・ノヴァ
CB09-X03.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Purple & Cost 6 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
Send up to 12 cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Zodiarts"/"Nova"-named Spirit depletes/destroys any opposing Spirit/Ultimate, by paying one cost, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
CB09-X03.flavor: The ultimate form of the Sagittarius Zodiarts, who evolved with the power of the Supernova.

BSH-004.name: Rule Reversal
BSH-004.effect:
(Main) Until end of turn, all Spirits/Ultimates the BSH player controls gain +10000 BP. Additionally, reverse the attacking order of the BSH player.

(Flash) During your opponent's turn, at the end of this battle, end the attack step.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7537.name: Sagittarius Zodiarts
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7537.kanji: サジタリウス・ゾディアーツ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7537.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw two cards. Then, you can pay one cost to summon a "Zodiarts"-named card from your Hand/Trash.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
You can [Advent] an exactly-named "Sagittarius Nova" onto this Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7537.flavor: Mitsuaki Gamou's transformed form when using the Sagittarius Zodiarts Switch. He rules as the top of the Horoscopes.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7538.name: Rumpkin
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7538.flavor: The land of magic held off the search for their own key and is helping the land of trump search theirs first. Isn't that cunning? I'm sure that they are putting the people in the land of the trump under the debt of gratitude and to drive them hard in the future.

SD49-006.name: Sagittonova Arrow
SD49-006.kanji: サジットノヴァアロー
SD49-006.effect:
This card has "Galaxian" family.

[Flash]
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total of 12000 BP. If you control any "Galaxian" family Grandwalker Nexus, draw a card for each Spirit/Ultimate destroyed by this effect.

BS70-090.name: Run Wild
BS70-090.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When Spirits/Ultimates you or the opponent controls heavily exhaust, if you control any "Contractor Huracan", you can return this card from the Trash to the Hand.

[Flash]
For each counter you have, during this battle, give a "Roaring Azure" family Spirit you control +1000 BP. Then, if the target has 30000 BP or more, during this battle, that target gains an extra Blue symbol.

CB17-069-A7541.name: Sai, Gorilla, Zou Core Medal
CB17-069-A7541.kanji: サイ・ゴリラ・ゾウ コアメダル
CB17-069-A7541.effect:
[LV1] [Zero Rebirth]
When this Nexus/your “OOO"-named Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can flip this Nexus. When you do, you can put one core from your Field/Reserve to this now Reborn Spirit.

[LV1]
Besides your exactly-named "Sai, Gorilla, Zou Core Medal", all "Core Medal"-named Nexuses and exactly-named "Henshin!! Kamen Rider OOO" you control can't be destroyed by opposing effects.
CB17-069-A7541.flavor: By inserting them into the OOO Driver and scanning them, one can transform into Kamen Rider OOO Sagohzo Combo.

BS40-013.name: Rune-Python
BS40-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
You can summon a Cost 1 or less Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.
BS40-013.flavor: I know. Our mission is to find the legendary Saviour. ...But I can't just abandon the Spirits who can't return to their own worlds and are now caught up in battle, can I!?

BS34-033.name: Saiborg
BS34-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Red.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
For each symbol color you have, this Spirit gains +2000 BP.
BS34-033.flavor: Combat Era Year 598. The lord of Clever Machine Province, Tycoon, ceases functioning.

BS25-012.name: Rune Master Naga
BS25-012.kanji: ルーンマスターナーガ
BS25-012.effect:
During (Your End Step), you can summon this Spirit card from your Trash.

[LV1][LV2] [Curse] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked when the battle resolves at the end of battle.
BS25-012.flavor: The curses haven't worked so far, but does that mean that Ultimates are absolutely unaffected by magic? ...Huh? Did I say something strange again?... Ah, that's good. The snake person over there is standing up and clapping.

BSC48-017.name: Saiborg LT
BSC48-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can put a core from the Void to your Trash. Then, (Once per Turn: Same Name), if you control any LV2 "Contracter Dairokuten Maou", you can put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Red.

[LV2]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Yellow.
BSC48-017.flavor: Combat Era Year 598. The lord of Clever Machine Province, Tycoon, ceases functioning.

BS40-082.name: Rune Summon
BS40-082.effect:
[Flash]
You can summon a "Dark Snake" family Spirit card from your Trash. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirit can't activate.

BSC23-004.name: Saika Undine
BSC23-004.kanji: サイカ・ウンディーネ
BSC23-004.effect:
[team: Shiny Hearts]

[LV1][LV2] [On Stage] (Your Attack Step)
Instead of attacking with this Spirit, by returning this Spirit to the deckbottom, summon a "Stage Style" family "Sakia Undine" from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost, and draw a card.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
All your [Shiny Hearts] Spirits gain +3000 BP.
BSC23-004.flavor: Uh, um... Er, ca- can I be of any help...? Ah, on my head? Th-This is, my friend, you see...

BS12-028.name: Sailfish
BS12-028.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Heavy Armor: White]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2] (Opposing Main Step)
All your White Spirits are unaffected by opposing Brave effects.
BS12-028.flavor:
Radiating seven-colored light and group swimming in the sea of the sunrise's glow, the golden meteor shower grants wishes.
—Astral Scholar Lyria, Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights, the Volans Chronicles—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7549.name: Ruriruri
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7549.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Exhaust all Cost 3 or less Spirits.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7549.flavor: Looking to heighten our efficiency, Lord and I began to operate separately. Bear came with me, likely out of concern. We followed the birds in front of us that headed towards the forest.

BSC49-030.name: Sailfish LT
BSC49-030.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] (Opposing Turn)
All your "Astral Soul"/"Galaxian" family Spirits are unaffected by opposing Brave/Nexus effects.
BSC49-030.flavor:
Radiating seven-colored light and group swimming in the sea of the sunrise's glow, the golden meteor shower grants wishes.
—Astral Scholar Lyria, Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights, the Volans Chronicles—

BS24-110.name: Saint Breeze
BS24-110.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, give two opposing Spirits -3000 BP.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: Exhaust all opposing 5000 BP or less Spirits.

SD17-016.name: Rush Draw
SD17-016.effect:
[Main]
Draw two cards. Then, reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Spirit card/Brave card with [Rush] to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the decktop in any order.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

BS40-080.name: Saint Flame
BS40-080.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy an opposing braved Brave. After this effect resolves, destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total of 10000 BP.

26RBS02-090.name: Rush Out
26RBS02-090.effect:
[Soul Magic: w]
[Main]
Target a "Leucomyst" family Spirit you control. During this turn, it can't be blocked.

[Flash]
Target one of your Spirits. During this turn, give it +2000 BP.
26RBS02-090.flavor: This phantom legion is supported by tiny spirits.

PC10-004.name: Saito-san
PC10-004.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2]
[During Set]
Once per turn, when opposing Spirits/Nexuses would leave the Field, or become heavily exhausted due to your effects or your Spirits, you can send the [Soul Core] from your Trash any of your "NEXT" family Spirits.

[LV1]
When your "WILD TIGER"/"BARNABY BROOKS Jr." would leave the Field due to the opponent, besides [Soul Core], by sending three cores from your Trash to the Void, up to two of those Spirits remain on the Field in the same condition.

CB26-016.name: Ryan Goldsmith
CB26-016.kanji: ライアン・ゴールドスミス
CB26-016.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
(Can't Stack) When cards are discarded from the opposing deck via the effect of your "GOLDEN RYAN", if there is any Spirit card among them, draw a card, then discard a card from your Hand. If there is any Nexus card, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits. If there are any other cards, destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as White.
CB26-016.flavor: GOLDEN RYAN. Having left Sternbild once, he returned due to a certain incident. He forms buddies with BLUE ROSE.

BS13-021.name: Saizorong
BS13-021.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
Refresh a Spirit you control.
BS13-021.flavor:
There were also those who fell protecting me. I must recall the painful memories as well. In order to reconstruct everything.
-from the 3rd paragraph of the Final chapter in "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

CB17-026.name: Ryoku Oozaru
CB17-026.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 6 ([Purple Core][Purple Core][Purple Core][Purple Core])]
Destroy an opposing Spirit with three cores or less on it. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Kamen" & "Ogre Wizard" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.
CB17-026.flavor: Sealed with the soul of Ape, a kind of Disk Animals. It is very strong and hence can take up the guard duty. It also has a higher intelligence comparing with the other Disk Animals.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7559.name: Sakebibird
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7559.flavor:
It is heavily theorized that the "Hero's March" that Kei implemented was part of Zeyon and Ocean Shield's conspiracy. But it is undeniable that world unification was Kei's own purpose.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of the Hero Kei, Year 647—

BSC16-022.name: Ryune Mato
BSC16-022.effect:
[team: Absolutes]

[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] [On Stage] (Your Attack Step)
Instead of attacking with this Spirit, by returning this Spirit to the deckbottom, summon a "Stage Style" family "Ryune Mato" from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost, and draw a card.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] (Your Attack Step)
All [Absolutes] Spirits you control gain +2000 BP.
BSC16-022.flavor: "W-Wait, isn't this a bit too short?"

26RCB01-057.name: Sakura Hurricane
26RCB01-057.effect:
[LV1-2] Your Attack StepCSOPT
When the BP of your "GAIM" family Spirit is increased due to your "BP+" Flash effects, if your Hand is four or less, you can draw a card.

[LV2] True ReleaseYour End Step
You can target one of your "Kamen Rider Gaim". Send up to two cores, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to it.
26RCB01-057.flavor: A bike designed exclusively for Armored Riders. Whilst in motion, it can create rifts in space, allowing the rider to travel to the Helheim Forest.

CB16-013.name: Ryusei-Go ［Graze Custom II］
CB16-013.effect:
When your "Tekkadan" family Spirits would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand/Removed Zone without paying the cost. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.
CB16-013.flavor: An unit modified by Teiwaz from the Graze Custom and hence equipped with the Alaya-Vijnana System. Its characteristic coloring is what requested by its pilot, Norba Shino.

CB07-X06.name: Sakuyamon
CB07-X06.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Yellow & Cost 6 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
During this turn, treat four opposing Spirits as LV1, and every opposing LV1 Spirit can't attack/block, nor activate its effects.

[During Advent] [LV3] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, by discarding one card from your Hand, refresh one of your Spirits, and during this battle, that Spirit gains an extra Yellow symbol.
CB07-X06.flavor:
[Mega. Shaman. Data]
A Digimon which carries the role of being the priestess that executes the will of God.

CB04-060.name: Ryutaros
CB04-060.effect:
This Spirit-condition Brave can be switched by the [Change] of your exactly-named "Kamen Rider Den-O Gun Form".

[When Braved]
When switching with your [Change], this Brave becomes Cost 0.
CB04-060.flavor: Possessing Ryotaro, it can transform into Kamen Rider Den-O Gun Form.

26RBS01-034.name: Salakka
26RBS01-034.effect:
[LV1-2]When Summoned
Put a core from the Void to your Trash. If you control any Spirit with [Current], put the core to this Spirit instead.
26RBS01-034.flavor: He may look as though he is just playing around, but his magical powers are very real.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7566.name: Ryutaros［2］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7566.effect:
[LV1]
You can [Advent] a "Den-O"-named card onto this Spirit-condition Brave, ignoring the condition. When you [Advent] onto this Brave, you can brave this pre-advent card to that Spirit.

[LV1]
This Spirit-condition Brave can't be destroyed by opposing effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7566.flavor: One of the Imagine which has boarded into the DenLiner. A lover of dancing, art and animals, his personality is whimsical and pure as a child's.

CB02-038.name: Salamon
CB02-038.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
By exhausting an opposing Spirit, this Spirit remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2][LV3] [Digivolve: Yellow] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Yellow "Champion" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB02-038.flavor:
[Rookie. Mammal. Vaccine.]
A Holy-species Digimon child characterized by its lop ears.

BS60-003.name: Ryuukin
BS60-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can destroy either an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit, or an opposing Nexus. If you control any "The PartnerDragon Glow", including being in Soul State/as pre-advent, the effects of the Spirit/Nexus destroyed by this effect can't activate.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
If you have six counter or more, by banishing this Spirit, draw three cards.
BS60-003.flavor:
You see that guy flying in the sky? That guy is extremely dangerous. When he goes rampage, no one can stop him. That being said, he is pretty attached to me so he would listen to what I say.
―The PartnerDragon Glow―

BS27-001.name: Ryuuman-Skysword
BS27-001.kanji: リューマン・スカイソード
BS27-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add all "Tri-Dragon Deity" family Ultimate cards to your Hand. Return the remaining cards to your deckbottom in any order.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Spirit Soul: Red - When you are summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.
BS27-001.flavor: I think it's futile... trying to stop the continents from crashing. No matter how strong the Tri-Dragon Deities may be.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7570.name: Salamon［2］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7570.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Yellow "Champion"/"Ultimate"/"Mega" family Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] [Digivolve: Yellow] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Yellow "Champion" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7570.flavor:
[Rookie. Mammal. Vaccine.]
The form before Tailmon. Perhaps she was influenced by her surroundings when evolving, but when in this form, she speaks more politely than when she's Tailmon.

BS24-010.name: Ryuuman-Blade
BS24-010.kanji: リューマン・ブレイド
BS24-010.effect:
While you control any Ultimate, this Spirit card in Hand becomes Cost 5.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy all Spirits with two or more symbols.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains an extra Red Symbol, and for each symbol this Spirit has, it gains +5000 BP.
BS24-010.flavor: He won in a match of power with an Ultimate!? Amazing! Have P-Major analyze Blade! Input terrain, climate, and the hour all as data!

BS61-006.name: Ryuuman-StarBreaker
BS61-006.kanji: リューマン・スターブレイカー
BS61-006.effect:
This card in Hand is unaffected by opposing effects, and if you control any “Incarnate” family Spirit, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, during the Flash Timing of Either Attack Step, you can summon this card from the Hand by paying Cost 4 ([Red Core][Red Core]).

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy every opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit, and the effects of the destroyed Spirits can't activate.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.
BS61-006.flavor:
To be honest, we really need some manpower. We are so thankful for the help from the Ryuumans.
―Nord's Note―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7573.name: Salvage
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7573.effect:
(Your Main Phase) Reveal the top 5 cards of your Deck. If there are 1 or more nexus cards among them, select 1 of them and move it to your hand. Then, return the rest to the bottom of your Deck in any order. If not, return them in the same order.

(Flash Step)(Your Main Phase) Target spirit gets +3000BP until end of turn.

SD26-002.name: Ryuuman-Charger
SD26-002.kanji: リューマン・チャージャー
SD26-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.

[LV2][LV3]
All your "Ryuuman"-named Spirits/Ultimates gain +1000 BP.
SD26-002.flavor: The progenitors of my race are here in this world, right? If they look completely different, I wouldn't be able to tell if it was them.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7575.name: Same Tired
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7575.effect: Flash- Exhaust opposing Spirits until they control the same number of exhausted Spirits as you do.

BS30-042.name: Ryuuman-Swordbreaker
BS30-042.kanji: リューマン・ソードブレイカー
BS30-042.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or higher Spirits]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned)
Destroy a Brave on an opposing Brave Spirit/Brave Ultimate.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Ultimate's.
[utb]
BS30-042.flavor: Five minutes left! To all Dragons: finish this as soon as possible!!

BS31-008.name: Samurai-Dragon
BS31-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - [Awaken]
You can send any number of cores from Spirits you control to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When [Soul Core](Soul Core) is sent to this Spirit via [Awaken], once per turn, this Spirit refreshes, and during this turn, it gains +5000 BP.
BS31-008.flavor: "Those going any further will become rust on my sword 'Flame Bolt'."

BS25-004.name: Ryuuman-Tiger
BS25-004.kanji: リューマン・ティーガー
BS25-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Dragon"/"Astral Dragon" family Spirits get +3000 BP. While you control any Ultimate, instead, all your "Dragon"/"Astral Dragon" family Spirits/Ultimates get +5000 BP.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Dragon" family Ultimate attacks, draw a card. This effect doesn't stack.
BS25-004.flavor: "Even if first-class muscle isn't enough, bunched muscles should blow them away!" This was the first statement made at the most recent convening of the Grand Council. Ozzania is amazing, being able to create that much silence and stay unconcerned.

BS73-012.name: Samurai-Dragon X
BS73-012.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Rekka Yukimura" & C1 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest BP. Also, once per turn, if you have eight counters or more, you can send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your [Soul Core] is sent to the Trash, destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's, and once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.
BS73-012.flavor: "This is my secret Tachi. Burn it into your memory!"

BS24-006.name: Ryuuman-Vulca
BS24-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Treat all of your "Ruin Dragon" family Spirits as being 1 LV higher.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Red Spirit attacks, you can target and attack an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.
BS24-006.flavor: As to be expected of descendants of the same ancestors, the Dragons and Ozzania have similar personalities. They're short-tempered, violent, cry easily, and surprisingly shrewd.

LM15-02.name: Samurai-War Lizard
LM15-02.kanji: サムライ・イクサトカゲ
LM15-02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - [Awaken]
You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When [Soul Core](Soul Core) is sent to this Spirit via [Awaken], once per turn, refresh all your "Lord"/"Vassal" family Spirits.
LM15-02.flavor: The War Lizard clan studied the techniques, and in time they changed to fit them. Their improvements upon Samurai-Dragon's sword technique was quite a thing to behold.

SD26-003.name: Ryuuman-Wisword
SD26-003.kanji: リューマン・ウィソード
SD26-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[When Braved] [LV2]
This Spirit gains +5000 BP.
SD26-003.flavor: Braves don't exist? That's ridiculous! Then when did Braves come into our world!?

BS60-095.name: Sanctified Light
BS60-095.kanji: サンクティファイドライト
BS60-095.effect:
While you have six counters or more, and you control any Yellow Contract Spirit, including those in pre-advent condition, this card in Hand is Cost 4.

[Flash]
During this battle, every opposing Spirit/Ultimate can't block, and the opponent can't use cards without the Yellow color from the Hand/Removed Zone. If you have six counters or more, the "during this battle” written on this effect is changed to “during this Attack Step”.

BS30-X04.name: Ryuuman-the-Formula
BS30-X04.kanji: リューマン・ザ・フォーミュラー
BS30-X04.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control two or more Cost 3 or higher Spirits]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, by destroying an opposing 15000 BP or less Ultimate, send a core from the opposing Life to their Reserve. After Ultimate Trigger, also, if your Life is at three or less, proceed to Cross Ultimate Trigger.

[Cross Ultimate Trigger] When Cross Ultimate Trigger hits, by destroying an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit, refresh this Ultimate.
[xutb]
BS30-X04.flavor: Please! Cut down the root of all this!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7585.name: Sand-Daemon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7585.effect: [LV1][LV2] All of your opponent's Ultimates get -1 cost for each card under that Ultimate.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7585.flavor: What the Ultimates really thought was that if our continent was destroyed, they'd be saved. So they just said "Let's wreck it!" and attacked? We've joined forces now, but we still need to be ready for betrayal at any moment.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7586.name: Ryzard
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7586.effect: [LV2](When Attacks) This Spirit gets +1000 BP for each Red Spirit you control.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7586.flavor:
The first year that the Dragon Knight Manaka's name appeared on the front stage of history was in this year's "Battle of the Winged Dragons." Accompanying the Hero Dragon, Manaka pierced through the enemy ranks and played the part of fighting one-on-one with the commander.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 638—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7587.name: SEELE
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7587.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, deploy an exactly-named "Ikari Gendo" without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards either all to decktop or all to deckbottom.

[LV2] (Your Draw Step)
Instead of drawing, you can put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7587.flavor: The secret organization behind NERV that is in-charge of its operation and decision-making.

BS72-017.name: Sand Mouth
BS72-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
You can send a core from your "Contractor Nyx" Grandwalker Nexus to the Void. When you've done so, discard a card from your Hand, and draw a card.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
+1 core to one of your "Contractor Nyx" Grandwalker Nexuses.
BS72-017.flavor:
The survivors of the Primordial Deities still lurked in the shadows of Olym. Most of them are insubstantial, and even when they were found, they quickly dissipated. While being considered harmless at first, they were gradually increasing in number and beginning to engulf the Spirits of Olym.
―Divine World Log 01―

CB14-061.name: SHINING LINE*
CB14-061.effect:
When your "Idol" family Spirit has left the Field due to the opponent, you can use this card from your Hand.

[Type: Song]

[Flash]
Summon a Cost 7 or less "Idol" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects can't activate. Then, if this Magic card is used when your Spirit has left the Field, return one of such Spirit cards that has left the Field from your Trash to the Hand.

BSC26-026.name: Sanda
BSC26-026.effect: When your Green Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, you can summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost. Then, if the destroyed Spirit was [Gaira], it remains on the Field, refreshed.
BSC26-026.flavor:
Born from Frankenstein's immortal heart in Tokyo's Stuart Laboratory. A gentle kaiju who loves humans and peace.
―Frankenstein's Kaiju: Sanda vs Gaira (1966)―

CB26-027.name: SKY HIGH
CB26-027.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Keith"/"SKY HIGH", (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can [Contract Advent] from your Hand a "FIRE EMBLEM" next to this Spirit, or to any others besides this Spirit, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[During Advent] [LV3] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, during this turn, every Spirit you control gains +3000 BP.
CB26-027.flavor: Its real name is "Keith Goodman". His NEXT power can control wind.

CB07-015.name: Sandiramon
CB07-015.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Ultimate"/"Mega" family Spirits are destroyed by opposing effects, besides any exactly-named "Sandiramon", you can pay one cost to summon a "God-King" family card from your Trash.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit or an opposing Nexus to their Reserve.
CB07-015.flavor:
[Ultimate. Holy Beast. Virus]
One of the Deavas, an Ultimate Digimon with the appearance of a snake. When using its finisher move, Krishna, it thrashes its body around and then vomits a spear with great force, impaling the enemy.

CB26-028.name: SKY HIGH ［2］
CB26-028.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Keith"/"SKY HIGH", (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
Return up to one opposing Spirit to the Hand. After this effect resolves, if the opponent has five cards or more in their Hand + Removed Zone, the opponent discards a card from their Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can [Contract Advent] from your Hand a "FIRE EMBLEM" next to this Spirit, or to any others besides this Spirit, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.
CB26-028.flavor: "We are still on the way to become the strongest buddy."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7594.name: Sandman
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7594.flavor: Both city and countryside are dangerous. The only difference is whether the one who gives us fear is the king or the former ruler.

BS06-006.name: Sabecaulus
BS06-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - [Awaken]
You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your Spirits with [Clash] gain +1000 BP
BS06-006.flavor: You can't defeat them even when you outnumber them, not to mention when you are alone.

BSC45-008.name: Sabecaulus LT
BSC45-008.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Red Core][Core])]
Destroy a 5000 BP or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - [Awaken]
You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Ultra Clash] (When Attacks)
Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.
BSC45-008.flavor: You can't defeat them even when you outnumber them, not to mention when you are alone.

BS36-030.name: Saber-Phoneus
BS36-030.kanji: サーベル・フォネウス
BS36-030.effect:
[When Braved] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit to the Hand.
BS36-030.flavor: Relaying from the scene of the attack in the middle of the race. The racers of "Scuderia Maclarn" have raised their shields and are protecting the spectators from the fierce attacks of the FiveGoodDragonEmperors!

CB05-007.name: SaberLeomon
CB05-007.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Red & Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Destroy every opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's. Effects of the Spirits destroyed by this effect can't activate.
CB05-007.flavor:
[Mega. Ancient Animal. Data.]
An Ancient Animal Digimon said to be capable of achieving Mach Speed.

BS25-019.name: SaberSeseri
BS25-019.effect: When this Spirit card is sent to the Trash from your deck due to the Ultimate Trigger of an opposing Cost 7 or less Ultimate, guard that Ultimate Trigger.
BS25-019.flavor: The Ultimates have pretty inconsistent power levels. They can make some critical mistakes at the worst possible timing. Is there a trick to making them miss? Ozzania would be pumped up, Leader would act by the book, Fric would say it's impossible, but what would Euro-chan think?

BS70-002.name: Saber Gurnard
BS70-002.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Red Core])]
[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
Your "Scarlet Flame" family Spirits can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy two opposing Cost 3 or less Nexuses. Including being pre-advent, if you control any "Glow", effects of the Nexuses destroyed by this effect can't activate.
BS70-002.flavor:
What a guy. This old man is more than just an old man. ―The PartnerDragon Glow―
Glow, who got separated from Dan, was saved by a mysterious old man. ―"Theogonic Record" Fragment―

BS35-017.name: Saber Snake
BS35-017.flavor: Oooh! I couldn't see it very well from over here, but it seems there was a mysterious attack from Racer Ourovorius in the back!

BS24-023.name: Saberhornet
BS24-023.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV2] (When Destroyed)
The opponent exhausts a Spirit they control. If you control any Ultimate, you choose which Spirit this effect exhausts.
BS24-023.flavor: Where did he fly off to?! He's so fast that P-Major's analysis can't keep up!!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7603.name: Sandsea Demon-God
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7603.effect:
This Brave doesn't exhaust, and while in Spirit condition, can't attack or block.

[During Left/Right Brave]
This Brave is treated as Cost 0.

[During Left/Right Brave] (When this Spirit/Ultimate Attacks)
Put one core from the Void to another "Beast Head" family Spirit/Ultimate you control.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7604.name: Sandstone-Golem
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7604.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step) When you are summoning an "Artificial Soldier" family Spirit, this Spirit gains an extra Blue symbol.

[LV2] (When Attacks) By sending one core from your Blue Grandwalker Nexus to the Void, discard three cards from the opposing decktop.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7604.flavor:
A different world connected itself to Grand Alexa, only three days after Alex's world creation.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 2:38―

BSC18-036.name: Santa Costume
BSC18-036.effect:
[When Braved] (Your Attack Step)
If the Spirit it braved to is originally in the "Stage Style" family, this Spirit gains an extra Yellow symbol. If the Spirit it braved to is originally in the "Private Wear" family, this Spirit gains the "Stage Style" family.
BSC18-036.flavor: I'm Santa Ange. What is it you want? If it's a song, I'll give you any number of them!

BS32-006.name: Sanzokku-Bear
BS32-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. When [Soul Core](Soul Core) is used to pay the summon cost, also, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.
BS32-006.flavor: The lord of the Supreme Beast Army, Gyuumonji, was a commander from a military family with a lineage that could be traced back more than a hundred years to the founding of the Six Shogunate.

BSC48-008.name: Sanzokku-Bear LT
BSC48-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest BP.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step)
Send up to five cores, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to any "Vassal"/"Lord" & "Emperor Beast" family Spirits. Then, if [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, you can summon an "Ash-Lion" from your Hand/Trash.
BSC48-008.flavor: The lord of the Supreme Beast Army, Gyuumonji, was a commander from a military family with a lineage that could be traced back more than a hundred years to the founding of the Six Shogunate.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7608.name: Saphir-Golem
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7608.effect:
During your End Step, if there are four or more "Artificial Soldier" family cards in your Trash, you can return this card from the Trash to the Hand. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
If you control any Blue-only Saga Brave, during this battle, this Spirit gains an extra Blue symbol.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7608.flavor: "Don't... look at me... You should only look at my creations..."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7609.name: Sapphire Erode
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7609.effect: Flash- Destroy an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or less than the total number of Nexuses you control.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7610.name: Saraswati's Music Temple
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7610.kanji: サラスヴァティーの音楽神殿
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7610.effect:
This card has "Celeste" family.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Hindida" family Red/Green Grandwalker Nexus card, and a Red/Green Saga Brave card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Your Grandwalker Nexuses in [Grandphosis] state gain +2000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7610.flavor:
The Goddess that supports Trimurti births the flux and envelops the souls of their residents with kind tone.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 905―

BS77-063.name: Saraswati's Root Bridge
BS77-063.kanji: サラスヴァティーのルートブリッジ
BS77-063.effect:
When this card is sent to the Trash from deck by the effect of your "Saraswati" Grandwalker Nexus, you can add it to the Hand.

[LV1-2] (When Deployed)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can put one core from the Void each to two "Imp" family Spirits you control.

[LV2]
When your Spirits with "Sound Speed"-named effects are summoned, you can send two cores from an opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void.
BS77-063.flavor:
It's the bridge of roots that Saraswati built across the river in the Sea of Trees. She used to quickly turn the Spirits she'd tamed here into her followers.
―Expedition Record 386―

BS61-028.name: Sasa-CrestedMurrelet
BS61-028.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Nexus. When you've done so, you can summon one of your Green Contract cards that's in Soul State/pre-advent condition, without paying the cost.
BS61-028.flavor:
Hey hey! Are you someone from Dynastes Duke's mansion? ―The PartnerWolf Lampo―
Huh? What's this little dog doing here. He wants to play with me? ―The PartnerBug Gataru―

BS33-056.name: Sasorizan
BS33-056.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
By sending the [Soul Core](Soul Core) from any of your "Shellman" family Spirit to the Trash, destroy an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to that Spirit with Soul Core on it.
BS33-056.flavor: Tidal-Blue shouted at the Azure Fang Squad cowering at the Clever Machine warship, destroyed the military castle with one stroke of his sword, and opened the way for the charge.

BS16-058.name: Satellide-Bird
BS16-058.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned) During this turn, neither player can summon a Spirit through Burst effects.

[When Braved] Heavy Armor: Red/Green/White- This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects of the listed colors.
BS16-058.flavor: My first Brave, was a bird as large as a satellite.

CB15-069.name: Satellite Ark
CB15-069.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add Purple Cost 4 or more "Horobi"/"Naki"/"Jin"/"Ikazuchi"/"Ark"-named cards, one of each, to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2]
When your "Horobi"/"Naki"/"Jin"/"Ikazuchi"-named Spirit(s) are destroyed by an opposing effect, they can remain on Field in the same condition.
CB15-069.flavor: An artificial satellite that Hiden Intelligence and ZAIA Enterprise took part in its development. It was originally scheduled to be sent to the Space 12 years ago, but was terminated when it grew hatred towards humans. However, it was recovered by somebody.

CB15-071.name: Satellite Zea
CB15-071.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add an exactly-named "The Hiden Intelligence CEO Secretary Izu" and a "Zero-One"-named card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2]
When your "Zero-One"-named Spirit(s)/Grandwalker Nexus(es) or exactly-named "The Hiden Intelligence CEO Secretary Izu" are destroyed by an opposing effect, they can remain on the Field in the same condition.
CB15-071.flavor: The communication satellite owned by Hiden Intelligence. It allows the data of the life forms kept inside the Progrise Keys to appear as date images, the Rider Models, and hence enables one to transform into Kamen Rider Zero-One.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7617.name: Saterat
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7617.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Cards can't be discarded from either deck.

[LV2] Heavy Armor: Purple/Blue - This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7617.flavor: The duty of the noncombatant rat is to obtain information and assist its allies. Just as its small body suggests, it is very quiet.

BSC30-012.name: Satori Monkey
BSC30-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
The opponent has to keep their Burst face-up (Flip the facedown Burst face-up).

[LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
You can discard an opposing Burst. When you've done so, this Spirit remains on the Field, exhausted.
BSC30-012.flavor: Alice seems to have obtained the power of all six Dark Pyroxenes. Although her source of power is clear now, her reason of betrayal remains a mystery.

BSC15-003.name: Satoridemon
BSC15-003.effect:
After your Burst activates, return this Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Send cores from every opposing Spirit to the Reserve until only one core remains on each of them. After this effect resolves, if you control any Ultimate, summon this Spirit card.
BSC15-003.flavor: Remember this, I have not once lost to my father at arm wrestling. Ye who have lost to my father have no chance against one such as I!

BSCO-001-A7620.name: Saturn Rex
BSCO-001-A7620.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Red/Purple & Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Advents)
Destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit, or an opposing Nexus, and the effects of the destroyed Spirit/Nexus can't activate. Also, if this Spirit was [advented], draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, at the end of battle, this Spirit can refresh.

BS63-083.name: Saurays Force

[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Red Core][Red Core])]
[During Set]
Including in pre-advent condition, while you control any "The PartnerWingedDragon Terad", all your Red-only Spirits gain the effect: "(When Attacks) You can target and attack an opposing Spirit."

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. If you have six counters or more, increase the limit of this "BP destruction effect" by +10000, and this "BP destruction effect" can only be prevented by "Armor"-named effects.

BS64-064.name: Savage Axe
BS64-064.effect:

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV1-2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Show a "Divine Attendant" family Contract Spirit card from your Hand to the opponent, or if you have any "Divine Attendant" family Contract Spirit, including those in Removed Zone/Soul State/pre-advent condition, you can reveal three cards from the decktop. Add a card with the same family as this Spirit to the Hand, or put it onto the Removed Zone. Discard any remaining cards. When the number of cards in Hand/Removed Zone increases via this effect, your counter +2.
PX26-10.flavor:
Wow, what a cute little cat! Fancy coming to our place?
―Contractor Toa―

CB16-028.name: Saviour Gundam
CB16-028.effect:
[+0]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn/Attacks)
Return an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit to the Hand. While braved to an "Athrun"-named Brave, return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom instead.

[LV2][LV3] [VPSa: Cost 6 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 6 or less effects.
CB16-028.flavor: Your power would only stir up chaos in the battlefield!

CB16-028-A7626.name: Saviour Gundam ［MA Mode］
CB16-028-A7626.kanji: セイバーガンダム［MA形態］
CB16-028-A7626.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your "ZAFT"/"FAITH" family effect, you can put it onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2] [VPSa: Cost 6 or less]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing originally Cost 6 or less effects.

[LV2] [Zero Rebirth]
When this Spirit attacks/blocks, it can be flipped.

Given to Athrun who became a member of FAITH and scored lots of success together with the Minerva teams, but ultimately being completely destroyed without a mean to struggle by the frantic Kira.

SAW-SNAKE1.name: Saw-Snake
SAW-SNAKE1.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned) During this turn, when your Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects sent cores from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve, exhaust all those opposing Spirits.

[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks) Send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7628.name: Sawgrizzly
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7628.effect:
☼<nowiki>[ </nowiki>Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed/depleted by the opponent<nowiki> ]</nowiki>
Exhaust two opposing Spirits. After this effect resolves, if you control any Ultimate , summon this Spirit card.

[LV2] (When Battles) The opponent can't activate their Bursts.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7628.flavor: He told me, "Well, do something on your own about it" while playing with bears. I expected it, but what a cold response... Father's such a nuisance.

BSC16-005.name: Saya Shain
BSC16-005.effect:
[team: Shiny Hearts]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [On Stage] (Your Attack Step)
Instead of attacking with this Spirit, by returning this Spirit to the deckbottom, summon a "Stage Style" family "Saya Shain" from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost, and draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
While you only control "Private Wear" family Spirits, this Spirit can block while exhausted.
BSC16-005.flavor: U-umm... Did you listen to my song...? How embarrassing...

CB25-X01.name: Sazabi

[LV2][LV3] Flash - [Funnel: 12000] (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 12000 BP. Also, by paying one cost, during this turn, every "NZ" family Spirit you control gains an extra Red symbol.

CB29-003.name: Sazabi ［Double Horn Funnel］

CB29-003.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By sending three cores from any of your "Char" Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void, pay two costs to summon this card from the Hand.

Ignoring the "BP+" of Braves, you can destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - [Funnel: 12000] (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 12000 BP. By paying one cost, this effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

CB27-X02.name: Sazabi ［Long Rifle］
CB27-X02.kanji: サザビー［ロング・ライフル］
CB27-X02.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned/Advents) effect resolves]

Once per turn, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 12000 BP. Also, by paying one cost, draw a card.

BSC26-048.name: Scales & Prism Beam
BSC26-048.effect:
[Flash]
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. Then, if you control "Mothra"-named Spirit and "Battra"-named Spirit, one of each, return an opposing exhausted Spirit to their deckbottom.

BS76-024.name: Scarab-Radar
BS76-024.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Green Core])]
[During Set]
While you control any "Contractor Ra-Harakhti", including those in Soul State, you can add a "Weapon Insect" family card with [Mani] revealed from the deck by your effect to the Hand.

BS76-024.flavor:
This is our chance. These Eyes of Horus won't let it slip by!
―Grandwalker Ra-Harakhti―

BS56-025.name: Scarab Beetle Drone
BS56-025.kanji: スカラベビートルドローン
BS56-025.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Green Core])]
[During Set]
Neither player can draw via Yellow/Blue Spirit/Brave effects.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can destroy all opposing non-"Primal" family Grandwalker Nexuses. After this effect resolves, banish all Grandwalker Nexus cards from the opposing Trash.

As we shared mutual interests, we decided to join force with the Spacetime Police. Let's return to the lab. There maybe something relevant in the literature.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5:10―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7636.name: Scartooth
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7636.effect: [LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step) While there are only Red cards in your Trash, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7636.flavor: My army is strongest in aerial battles. I too join the line of fellow troops and ride on Ikazuchi.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7637.name: School Story
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7637.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Diva" family Spirit effect, or sent to the Trash by the effect of your "Producer" Grandwalker Nexus, you can add it to the Hand.
