Kai challenges Dan to a fight with Judgement Dragon, a being belongs to The-Judgement's kin. An equal fight broke out between Kai and Dan. And at the same time, The-Judgement's judgement has begun.
―Otherworld Record: Chapter of Blade Wing 02―

BS23-007.name: Silver-Wurm
BS23-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Charge]
Increase the limit of your "BP Destruction effects" by +1000.

[LV2][LV3] [Charge]
Increase the limit of your "BP Destruction effects" by +1000.
BS23-007.flavor: In accordance with its rising status, its armor has become more ornate. Will the next armor it wears be gold?

BSC21-004.name: Shishio
BSC21-004.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. If this Burst was activated via [Catalyze], also, destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. After this effect resolves, summon this Brave card without paying the cost.
BSC21-004.flavor: The gallant lion ornament proclaims its master's style, and the light weight of the sword's blade gives its master lightning speed.

CB16-004.name: Silver Bullet ［Gael Use］
CB16-004.kanji: シルヴァ・バレト［ガエル機］
CB16-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your "Unicorn Gundam"-named Spirit would activate [0Rebirth], the number of your counters is treated as zero. Also, your Red "Pilot"/"Crew" family Braves can't be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit, and draw a card.
CB16-004.flavor: A modified MS based on Döven Wolf. Piloted by Gael Chan, the secretary to the Vist's, it helped Banagher Links who was under the attack of Neo Zeong.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7800.name: Shieldrhinos
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7800.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Ultra Armor: Red/Yellow/Blue - This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/White/Blue Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.

[When Braved] [LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) Your life can only be decreased by 1 per turn per opposing Spirit/non-braved Ultimate.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7800.flavor: My companion Dvergr says he'll be waiting in the White World with the beast he's tamed. I've got to come back to see the songstresses fight.

BSC48-030.name: Shishio LT
BSC48-030.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Then, when this Burst was activated via a "Catalyze"-named effect, destroy an opposing 20000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.
BSC48-030.flavor: The gallant lion ornament proclaims its master's style, and the light weight of the sword's blade gives its master lightning speed.

SD38-005.name: Silver Leaf Eagle
SD38-005.kanji: シルバーリーフイーグル
SD38-005.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.
SD38-005.flavor: The king spoke thusly. "Seek out the Legendary Saviour and restore the world to normal." That's all well and good, but am I seriously the one for the job!?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7803.name: Shiva's Destruction Temple
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7803.effect:
This card has the "Celeste" family.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Draw Step)
By putting a card from your Hand facedown onto the Removed Zone, increase the amount of cards you draw by +1.

[LV2]
Your Removed Zone is unaffected by opposing effects, and opposing effects can't include it when counting. Also, while your Removed Zone has three or more facedown cards, "Death Dragon" family Spirits you control can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7803.flavor:
Shiva, one of the Tri-deity of Hindida, turns his people's prayers into destruction, and returns all creation to nothingness.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 902―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7804.name: Shadow Yatagarasu
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7804.effect:
When an opposing Spirit is depleted, this card in your Trash can return to your Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn) Opposing effects can only reduce your Life by one each turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7804.flavor:
The ones facing Zeus-Lolo are Alex and the Hindida Grandwalkers. My little brother, Susanoo, and Ares are facing all the Egytian Gods, while the Olymian gods which have split in two different forces restrain one another.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 4:06―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7805.name: Sinanju
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7805.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
During this turn, your "Sleeves" family Spirits are unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit is blocked, this Spirit refreshes.

[During Brave] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While braved to an exactly-named "Full Frontal", this Spirit's symbols become three Red symbols.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7805.flavor: The return of the Red Comet. Full Frontal's Mobile Suit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7806.name: Shiva Catastrophe
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7806.kanji: シヴァカタストロフィー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7806.effect:
When this card was either revealed from deck by the effect of your exactly-named "Godseeker DancingDragon Nataraja", or sent to the Trash from deck by the effect of your exactly-named "Grandwalker of Destruction Shiva", you can add it to the Hand. When you've done so, put one core from the Void to any Grandwalker Nexus you control.

[Flash]
Send cores from every opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve until one core left on each of them. Also, if there are three or more facedown cards on your Removed Zone, during this turn, your Life can't be reduced by the attacks of opposing Spirits/Ultimates with one core or less on them.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7807.name: Shadowjuggler
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7807.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed) Draw a card.

[LV2] Curse (When Attacks) Destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked when the battle resolves at the end of battle.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7807.flavor: What is visible constitutes only part of the entire world. Watch out for the informers lurking in the shadows. They spy on everyone.

BS68-081.name: Shock Hammer
BS68-081.effect:
Including being in Soul State, while you control any "Contractor Kinich-Ahau", this card in Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.

[Flash]
During this turn, the symbol of an opposing Spirit/Ultimate is fixed as zero. After this effect resolves, by sending a core from any of your "Kinich-Ahau" Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void, during this turn, the symbol of an opposing Spirit/Ultimate is fixed as zero. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7809.name: Shieldybug
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7809.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Brave card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Brave must also be from the Reserve.

[When Braved] (When Battles)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, refresh this Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7809.flavor:
At the time of that war, this large bug became a shield for me.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

CB16-007-A7810.name: Sinanju (CB16-007 (A))
CB16-007-A7810.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Zero Rebirth]
During the Flash Timing of either Attack Step, by paying two costs, flip this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Besides [Soul Core], send three cores from your Trash to any "Sleeves" family Spirits you control. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
By destroying an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit, refresh this Spirit.
CB16-007-A7810.flavor: A prototype MS originally developed by the Anaheim Electronics but taken by the Sleeves. A part of it was made from Psycho-Frame materials, and those data were used in the development of Unicorn Gundams.

BS60-039.name: Shoebilloader
BS60-039.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Silver Contract, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Swap any number of "Silver Zero" family cards among them with cards from your Hand. Return the revealed cards to the deckbottom.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2]
All your "Silver Zero" family Spirits gain +5000 BP.

BSC49-061.name: Shieldybug LT
BSC49-061.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Brave must also be from the Reserve.

[During Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
When only the opposing Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by comparing BP, refresh this Spirit.
BSC49-061.flavor:
At the time of that war, this large bug became a shield for me.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BSC42-014.name: Shadowjuggler LT
BSC42-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
You can draw a card.

[LV2] [Curse] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked when the battle resolves at the end of battle.
BSC42-014.flavor: What is visible constitutes only part of the entire world. Watch out for the informers lurking in the shadows. They spy on everyone.

CB13-018.name: Sinanju ［Rocket Bazooka Equipped］
CB13-018.kanji: シナンジュ［ロケット・バズーカ装備］
CB13-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing non-"Primal" family Grandwalker Nexus.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Nexus, and draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When the opposing battling Spirit is depleted/destroyed, for each symbol on this Spirit, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
CB13-018.flavor: Sinanju when equipped with a weapon that shoots solid bullets. It got close to the the General Revil waiting for the Nahel Argama and Garanciere by itself, and completely dominated it in battle from start to finish.

BS18-046.name: Shaggai-Bug
BS18-046.effect:
[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your Spirit with two or more symbols, refresh that Spirit you control.
BS18-046.flavor: Zeyon's Ocean Shield conspirators withdrew from the Hero War all at once. Seemingly that this group of beings who had originally wished for mutual destruction had set up a camp hidden away from the battleground.

CB07-019.name: Sinduramon
CB07-019.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put two cores from the Void to your Reserve. Also, put a core from the Void to another "Ultimate" family Spirit you control.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit gains +1000 BP for each core on both players' Reserves.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by paying three costs, this Spirit refreshes.
CB07-019.flavor:
[Ultimate. Holy Bird. Data]
One of the Deavas, an Ultimate Digimon with the appearance of a rooster. It shoulders a vajra, like Kumbhiramon, and releases a powerful lightning strike from it, a finisher move called Púyaváha.

BS12-059.name: Shoggoleth
BS12-059.effect:
[When Braved]
Treat this Spirit as a Spirit with no printed effects.
BS12-059.flavor:
The Neptune Sacred Beast's transformation, and the Pirate King's revival. The oceans are not calm as before.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

P15-22.name: Sisters' Syndrome
P15-22.kanji: シスターズシンドローム
P15-22.effect:
[Type: Song]

[Flash]
During this turn, give two opposing Spirits/Ultimates -3000 BP. Spirits/Ultimates whose BP are brought to 0 by this effect are destroyed. Also, if [Soul Core](Soul Core) was used to pay the cost, refresh a [Shiny Hearts] or [Twilight Gothic] Spirit you control. Then, you can put this Magic card onto your Field.

BSC49-072.name: Shoggoleth LT
BSC49-072.effect:
[LV1]
This Spirit-condition Brave with one core on it can't attack/block.

[During Brave]
This Spirit is treated as a Spirit with no printed effects.
BSC49-072.flavor:
The Neptune Sacred Beast's transformation, and the Pirate King's revival. The oceans are not calm as before.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7820.name: Sitar Dragon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7820.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a card from your decktop facedown on the Removed Zone.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Death Dragon"/"Grandwalker" family Spirit/Grandwalker Nexus is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7820.flavor:
The first to make a move was Tsukuyomi. Having finished his meeting with Alex and co., he went to meet his little brother, Susanoo.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 3:15―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7821.name: Shifgator
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7821.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned) Send 1 core each from all opposing Spirits to the Reserve.

[When Braved] (When This Spirit Brave Attacks) Destroy an opposing Spirit with 2 or less cores on it.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7821.flavor: Seemingly that Kei has contracted with a Brave nine years ago.

BS54-068.name: Sixth Blaze
BS54-068.effect:
This card has the "Primal"/"Magibullet" family.

When your Life is reduced to three or less by the opponent, you can use this card from Hand without paying the cost.

[Flash]
Ignoring the "BP+" of Braves, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 12000 BP, or any opposing Ultimates up to a total of 26000 BP. Effects of the Spirits/Ultimates destroyed by this effect can't activate.

CB05-044.name: Shakkoumon
CB05-044.effect:
Flash - [DNA Digivolution] (Your Turn)
By returning two "Champion" family Spirits you control to the Hand, summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
During this turn, give every opposing Spirit -5000 BP. Destroy every Spirit whose BP is brought to 0 by this effect. Also, when summoned via [DNA Digivolution], this "BP Decreasal" effect decreases 15000 BP further.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing LV2/LV3 Spirit to the hand.
CB05-044.flavor:
[Ultimate. Mutant. Free]
A Mutant Digimon born from Ankylomon and Angemon's Jogress Digivolution.

CB02-051.name: ShogunGekomon
CB02-051.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
The (When Summoned) effects of opposing Spirits can't activate.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
Neither player can use [Accel] from Hand.

[LV3] (Either Attack Step)
Neither player can use Magic cards from Hand.
CB02-051.flavor:
[Ultimate. Amphibian. Virus.]
An upgraded version of Gekomon with an antenna resembling the chonmage of a feudal lord.

BS70-001.name: Shakson Geosoldier
BS70-001.kanji: シャクソン・ジオソルジャー
BS70-001.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your Nexus is destroyed, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing Nexus.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, draw a card.
BS70-001.flavor:
During the battle between Gaia and Hermes at Hermes' world, Hercadia, Huracan, the Vulrica Grandwalker, intervened. Despite being defiant at first, Huracan eventually cooperated with Hermes and helped force Gaia to retreat. At the same time, Dan had reunited with Kai.
―Theogonic Record Volume 3―

BS15-043.name: Shogunpentan
BS15-043.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
If you control three or more Yellow Spirits, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
Discard a card from your decktop. If the card discard via this effect is a Yellow Spirit card, this Spirit remains on the Field, refreshed. Also, if the discarded card is "Pentan"-named, add it to your Hand.
BS15-043.flavor: As I was relaxing after my victory, a fin-like hand struck the back of my neck.

BSC42-019.name: Skel-Viper LT
BSC42-019.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
You can draw a card.
BSC42-019.flavor: Even the dark snake cannot escape from the control of the king once it dies. The body just turns into a miserable slave.

BS44-085.name: Shamanic Draw
BS44-085.kanji: シャーマニックドロー
BS44-085.effect:
[Zero Counter]
When the opponent summons any Spirit/Brave without paying the cost, other than via Burst effects, you can immediately use the following effect of this card from the Hand without paying the cost.
█ Destroy an opposing Spirit. After this effect resolves, by paying one cost, return this card to the Hand.

[Main]
Draw two cards. Then, reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Worldswalker"/"Avatar" family card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

CB15-078.name: Shoot Vent
CB15-078.effect:
This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Red.

When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Kamen" family Spirit effect, you can add it to the Hand.

[Flash]
Return an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit to the Hand. Also, if you control any "Kamen" & "Mounted Warrior" family Spirit, return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.

BS61-010.name: Skeleton-Sorcerer
BS61-010.kanji: スケルトン・ソーサラー
BS61-010.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your “Blood Crystal” family effect depletes/destroys Spirits/Ultimates you or the opponent controls, you can summon this card from the Hand/Trash.

[LV2]
While there are ten or more "Blood Crystal" family cards in your Trash, every "Blood Crystal" family card in your Trash is unaffected by opposing effects.
BS61-010.flavor:
My sword fight against Oboro remains unsettled. How could I....Hmm? Sir Skeleton, you got anything to tell me? Oh? Magic? ...I see...If I couldn't win with swords then just fight with magic. Right!
―The PartnerKnight Bat―

BS44-006.name: Shamant-Baboon
BS44-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return a Grandwalker Nexus card from your Trash to your Hand.
BS44-006.flavor:
As their defeat only becomes more likely, another set of horrible news arrives: A new continent has appeared.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 1:13―

26RCB01-067.name: Shoot Vent (26RCB01-067)
26RCB01-067.effect:
[Flash]
If all your Spirits/Nexuses have the "RYUKI" family, target an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit. Return it to the deckbottom.

BS34-013.name: Skeleton Archbishop
BS34-013.flavor:
While there are existing historical documents that state the Master died in the Incident at Bonnouji, some archives claim that he appeared during the Battle of Senkigahara. Though they seem to contradict each other at first glance, both are likely true.
―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7834.name: Shooter ShiningHeavenCleverMachine Tamanoya
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7834.kanji: 砲性・天照機巧タマノオヤ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7834.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Heavy Armor: Purple/White - This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2] (Opposing End Step) If your Life wasn't decreased during this turn, you can return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7834.flavor:
Zeus-Lolo is splitting into two. Returning things to how they should be, that is the essence of my power. It was for this end that I came here. To recover the world's balance.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 4:22―

CB16-008.name: Shamblo
CB16-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Nexus, and draw two cards. After this effect resolves, if there's any opposing Nexus, by paying one cost, refresh this Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Marine" family Spirit attacks, destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit.
CB16-008.flavor: A gigantic MA developed by the Zeon remnants on Earth with the technical support and help from the Sleeves. It wiped out the Earth Federation's Headquarters in Dakar and trampled the city of Torrington.

BS39-004.name: Shooting Zebra
BS39-004.kanji: シューティングゼブラー
BS39-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When an Ultimate was targeted by this effect, this Spirit gains +10000 BP.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw two cards.
BS39-004.flavor: Oh my!! A storm of meteorites rains down on racer Execeburn ...but racer Amethyst-Dragon holds them back with his wings!! It's the last spurt now! Not even the threat of an evil god will put a damper on their contest!!

SD66-003.name: Skelton-Jaw 15th
SD66-003.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon/deploy a "Scarlet Flame" family Brave card/Nexus card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
SD66-003.flavor: If the Pinnacle Power is applied on you, things will really get out of hand.

BS10-001.name: Shamcaesar
BS10-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit is also treated as a White Spirit.
BS10-001.flavor:
War is spreading through every region of the land like wildfire! Should the Armies of the Sun gain victory, this world shall have everlasting daylight; if the Moon is victorious, this shall become a world of eternal night. Personally, I prefer the world as it is now, with day and night mutually alternating in turn. Well, all the Braves have been inspected and accounted for; now to get back to work!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7839.name: Shovel-Golem
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7839.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Crush] (when Attacks)
Discard cards from the opposing decktop equal to this Spirit's level.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit's [Crush]/[Great Crush] discards a card with Burst effects, also, discard two cards from the opposing decktop.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7839.flavor:
They're fixing the land destroyed in the battle with the Vanity Deity.
Huh? It looks more broken than before.

SKULL-GARUDA1.name: Skull-Garuda
SKULL-GARUDA1.effect: [LV1] (When Summoned) Draw a card from your deck.
SKULL-GARUDA1.flavor: It's rid itself of every inefficient part so it can fly higher and for longer. Almost as if symbolizing that very thought, a flying weapon was created with nothing but bones.

BS60-037.name: Shrim-Stopper
BS60-037.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Heavy Armor: Red/Purple/White]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2] (Start of Opposing Attack Step)
If you control any "The PartnerMachine Stark", including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, your counter can +1. When you've done so, target an opposing originally Cost 6 or less Spirit. During this turn, that Spirit can't attack.
BS60-037.flavor:
That flying object obtained such mechanical body it desired willingly. A mechanical body is convenient afterall.
―The PartnerMachine Stark―

BSC49-001.name: Shamcaesar LT
BSC49-001.effect:
When your Red/White Spirits would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can summon this card from the Removed Zone.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 3 ([Red Core][White Core])]
Destroy, or return to the deckbottom a Nexus you or the opponent controls. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as White.
BSC49-001.flavor:
War is spreading through every region of the land like wildfire! Should the Armies of the Sun gain victory, this world shall have everlasting daylight; if the Moon is victorious, this shall become a world of eternal night. Personally, I prefer the world as it is now, with day and night mutually alternating in turn. Well, all the Braves have been inspected and accounted for; now to get back to work!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

CB02-008.name: SkullGreymon
CB02-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Send one core each from three opposing Spirits to their Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy three opposing 7000 BP or less Spirits.
CB02-008.flavor:
[Ultimate. Undead. Virus]
A Skeleton digimon whose whole body has become nothing but bones.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7844.name: Shuddomell
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7844.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Nexus card to your Hand. Discard the remaining cards.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7844.flavor: Even though they have surrendered, those from the Ocean Shield don't seem to be willing to come along. On the other hand, however, if they told me that they would come along, I may feel awkward instead.

BS33-055.name: Shumokupanther
BS33-055.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Battles)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit. If there is [Soul Core] (Soul Core) on this Spirit, also, if the opposing Hand is four or more, the opponent must discard cards from their Hand until their Hand is three.
BS33-055.flavor:
The Azure Fang Squad was a ragged band of outlaws that repeatedly committed acts of pillage and destruction. They had a plan to build connections with other provinces and bring down Gandala.
―from the Soldier's Biography of "Sengoku Obscurities" by Kuroe―

CB05-018.name: SkullMeramon
CB05-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 8000 BP or less Spirit. When any Spirit is destroyed by this effect, draw a card.

[LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Discard a random card from the opposing Hand.
CB05-018.flavor:
[Ultimate. Flame. Data]
A Digimon evolved from a Meramon enveloped in high heat blue flames. As its flames burn even hotter than Meramon's, the flames that erupt from its body are also blue.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7847.name: Shumongo
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7847.flavor:
Was it because they were in a good mood, or was it strategic reasoning? The attacking Western Militia lent their assistance to the allied Central and Southern armies. It may have been the end that this decision beckoned for. A separate force from the Empty Sky approached the Central country from the empty North. But it should have all been fine, as long as the Master Unicorn was alive and well.
-from the 13th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

CB05-014.name: SkullSatamon
CB05-014.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed by the Opponent]
Send five cores from an opposing "Mega" family Spirit to their Reserve. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit to their Reserve.
CB05-014.flavor:
[Ultimate. Undead. Virus]
The remains of a Fallen Angel Digimon which fell to the Dark are while pursuing strength and destruction.

BS68-001.name: Shuriken Fish
BS68-001.kanji: シュリケンフィッシュ
BS68-001.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Wanderer Dan's Bladra", you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Wanderer Dan's Bladra", you can summon a Cost 3 or less "Scarlet Flame" family Spirit card from your Hand.
BS68-001.flavor: Apparently a war had broken out in the Divine World, and Dan was caught in that. Hearing that from Kai, Toa gathered her friends, and decided to travel to the Divine World.

BS10-003.name: Shurikeraptor
BS10-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the same BP as this Spirit.
BS10-003.flavor: Their reign over the skies has been completely stolen. And now the Dinosaurs are beginning to sacrifice themselves—apparently fighting in losing battles are becoming more common

26RBS01-112.name: Skull Blast
26RBS01-112.effect:
[Flash]
Target a "Dark Puce" family Spirit you control. Destroy it. If you've done so, target an opposing Spirit. Send two cores from it to the Reserve. (The opponent chooses which cores to send.)
26RBS01-112.flavor: "It will be useful right, right to the very end."

BSC49-004.name: Shurikeraptor LT
BSC49-004.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Draw a card. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit with the same BP as this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
During this battle, you can give this Spirit +1000 BP.
BSC49-004.flavor: Have I told you about the curse of the dragonization? Look at him. He is a typical example of the failure.

CB05-025.name: Shurimon
CB05-025.effect:
Flash - [Armor Digivolve: Rookie]
By returning a "Rookie" family Spirit you control to the Hand, pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2]
While your "Ultimate"/"Mega"/"Armor" family Spirit is attacking, the opposing Burst can't activate.
CB05-025.flavor:
[Armor. Mutant. Free]
A Mutant digimon evolved from the power of the Digi-Egg of Sincerity.

BS36-017.name: Skull Dragon
BS36-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve, and return a "Death Dragon"/"Zombie" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.
BS36-017.flavor: Competing for the last two spots for victory are Racers Hanumerlin, Gale-Phoenix, and Wedgetail. Pay attention to their last fights before the goal!

BS28-079.name: Shut Out
BS28-079.effect:
[Trigger Counter]
When an opposing Ultimate Trigger hits, if this card is in the Hand, you can use the following effect before the "When hits" effect activates.

█ If the hit card is a White, treat the hit as a Guard.

[Flash]
When this battle ends, end the Attack Step.

BS39-017.name: Skull Sleeper
BS39-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [SSoul: Ultimate]
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains [Core] (an extra Ultimate Symbol).

[LV2]
While your Soul Core is banished, this Spirit gains +10000 BP and an extra Green symbol.
BS39-017.flavor: The Abul-Dharbi GP's toughest spot, the deep and dark underground cave of the hell section, is harboring some remnants of the EvilGod according to the information that just came in. Yet the race will go on. All racers, please exercise caution.

BS14-019.name: Shuten-Doga
BS14-019.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can summon a Cost 3 or less "Evil Shadow" family Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2]
Your Burst effects send +1 core from opposing Spirits to their Reserve/Trash.

[LV2]
While you have a set burst, for each "Evil Shadow" family Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +2000 BP.
BS14-019.flavor: Having lost to Lord Dragon once before, there is someone out there who bears a terrible grudge against Lord.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7858.name: Skulldemon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7858.effect: [LV1][LV2][LV3] Curse (When Attacks) Destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked when the battle resolves at the end of battle.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7858.flavor: The king has sent an assassin to the former rulers. It seems that their hostilities are now beyond reconciliation.

BS66-052.name: Sidewheel-Golem
BS66-052.kanji: サイドホイール・ゴレム
BS66-052.effect:
Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
If the opponent has five or more cards being banished, and including being in Soul State /pre-advent condition, if you control any "Petit Shack", you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand. When you've done so, destroy an opposing battling Spirit/Ultimate, and discard two cards from the opposing decktop.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Your counters +2, and put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7860.name: Skullgoyle
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7860.flavor: A Demon takes lives. The Empty sky takes the entire world.

CB04-062.name: Sieg
CB04-062.effect:
This Spirit-condition Brave can be switched by the [Change] of your exactly-named "Kamen Rider Den-O Wing Form".

[When Braved]
When switching with your [Change], this Brave becomes Cost 0.

[When Braved] (When Blocks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
CB04-062.flavor: Possessing Ryotaro, it can transform into Kamen Rider Den-O Wing Form.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7862.name: Skullion
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7862.effect: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) Send one core each from every opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit to their Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7862.flavor:
Both forces fought to fulfill a vision: the Sun Dragon Deity for a world of daylight, and the Moonlight Dragon Deity for a world of night. The Lilia Army had the Sun and Moon join hands to live together, and create a world where day and night would mutually alternate.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

P23-12.name: Siegwurm-SixFactor
P23-12.kanji: ジークヴルム・シックスファクター
P23-12.effect:
This card/Spirit gains the "Scarlet Flame"/"Blood Crystal"/"Jade Thunder"/"Silver Zero"/"Golden Cloud"/"Azure Wave" families.

Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any “Petit Glow”/“Petit Bat”/“Petit Lampo”/“Petit Stark”/“Petit Feaniel”/“Petit Shack”, you can summon this card from the Hand. When you've done so, either destroy an opposing Nexus, or destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest BP.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.
P23-12.flavor: The pathways brought about by the power of Dan's partners comes to fruition here.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7864.name: Skullzard
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7864.effect: [LV2] (Opposing Turn) When this Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, you can summon up to two Cost 1 or less Spirit cards from your Trash, without paying the cost.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7864.flavor:
By borrowing the power of the Evil Capricornus Deity, we of the Lilia Army were able to meet with those in the banished realm. And then, Master Lilia persuaded the Sun Dragon Deity and Moonlight Dragon Deity; to approve of a world where the Sun and Moon coexist, meaning that daylight and night come together as one day; and if they were to agree to come to an understanding, they would be given new life and reborn as Deities of the Zodiac. After a brief period of silence on both parts, they acknowledged each other's power and approved of the Master's plan.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

SD50-CP04.name: Signalize!
SD50-CP04.effect:
[Type: Song]

This card has "Idol" family.

During your Start Step, by paying two costs, return this card from the Trash to your Hand. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[Flash]
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -7000 BP. When this effect brought its BP to 0, you can return it to the Hand.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7866.name: Skunks
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7866.flavor: I can see that he's trying hard to drive off the rowdies. He's quite nimble and helpful, but everyone says they don't want to team up with him. If only his weapon was not gas!

BS10-107.name: Silent Lock
BS10-107.effect:
[Flash]
When the battle of a non-braved Spirit ends, end the Attack Step.

SD52-001.name: Skygrasper
SD52-001.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
If you control any "Mothership" family Nexus, you can summon this card from your Hand. When you've done so, during this turn, you can ignore the "[Exchange] can only be used once per turn" clause of your Striker Pack and use it once and only once more.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
Put a core from the Void to an "MS" family Spirit or a "Mothership" family Nexus you control.
SD52-001.flavor: The Archangel had two of these fighter jets made for flight within the atmosphere by the Earth Alliance. Mu La Flaga, Tolle Koenig and others piloted them.

BSC50-045.name: Silent Lock LT
BSC50-045.effect:

+1 core to one of your "Astral Deity" family Contract Grandwalker Nexuses. When you've done so, if it's the opposing Attack Step, unless an opposing Brave Spirit/Brave Ultimate is battling, immediately end the Attack Step.

CB16-027.name: Slash Zaku Phantom ［Yzak Use］
CB16-027.kanji: スラッシュザクファントム[イザーク機]
CB16-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon a "ZAFT" family Spirit card. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit to the Hand. For each two "ZAFT" family Spirit cards in your Trash, this effect returns +1 cost of Spirit.
CB16-027.flavor: Yzak Jule's unit. It fought with terrorists and the Phantom Pain to stop them from throwing the remains of Junius Seven onto Earth, showing a significant difference in class between his unit and the opponent's in the process.

BSC42-085.name: Silent Wall LT
BSC42-085.effect:
This card in Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.

[Flash]
When this battle ends, end the Attack Step. Or, during this battle, your Life can't be reduced. Then, banish this card.

BS58-018.name: Silk Moth Drone
BS58-018.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Green Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
You can summon/deploy a "Blade Insect" family card from your Hand.

[During Set] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this Mirage. When you've done so, you can set a Green/Yellow card with Mirage effect from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BS58-018.flavor:
Apparently, it is hard to control the Oracles even for a Grandwalker. Following what Parvati had told us, we headed towards a certain place.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 7:09―

BS20-007.kanji: スレイヴ・ガイアスラ

Neither player can remove the cores on this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - [Ultra Awaken]
You can put any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit. When you've done so, refresh this Spirit.
BS20-007.flavor: His very existence is an evil omen. Could he be foreshadowing the end of the world!?

BS72-082.name: Sleeping Shield
BS72-082.kanji: スリーピングシールド
BS72-082.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Nexus' (When Summoned/Deployed) effect resolves]

SD43-004.name: Slider Bear
SD43-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Red.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Heavy Armor: Red/Purple/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block while exhausted.
SD43-004.flavor:
Amahara governs their world with sorcery and is the most ancient force on the Divine World, it even once possessed enough power to control all of the Divine World.
─Holy Book Fragment─

Discard a card from the opposing decktop.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7876.flavor: Racer Dos-Deimos was blocked by "Scuderia Maclarn"'s formation. He couldn't move forward in the early stage of the course and seems to be at a loss on how to attack.

26RSD06-005.name: Slouth
26RSD06-005.flavor:
Talking to this Spirit is a real test of patience.
―from the Foreigner's Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7878.name: Small Phynx
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7878.effect:

The number of cores on this Spirit cannot become less than one by you.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Give every opposing Spirit/Ultimate -1000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7878.flavor: A Small Phynx calls for a Small Phynx, and that Small Phinx, too, calls for...

BS53-058.name: Smaragd-Golem
BS53-058.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can deploy a Blue Cost 4 or less Nexus card from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit. For each counter you have, the limit of this "Cost Destruction Effect" gets +1.
BS53-058.flavor: Last of the four Hephaestus' Gemstone Golems, the Green Smaragd. It's special for the magic waves released from his palms. For now, he is playing an active role in a separate team from Granat Golem.

CB06-072.name: Smart Brain, Inc.
CB06-072.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Draw Step)
By discarding an "Orphnoch"/"Faiz"/"Kaixa"/"Delta"-named card from your Hand, increase the amount of cards you draw by +2. This effect doesn't stack.

[LV2]
This Nexus' color and symbol are also treated as Red.
CB06-072.flavor: One of Japan's many big corporations. Many of its employees awaken as Orphnochs, and it becomes the base of operations for their human domination operations.

CB04-016.name: Smilodon Dopant
CB04-016.kanji: スミロドン・ドーパント
CB04-016.effect:
When your Life is reduced by opposing Spirits, you can summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +3000 BP, and send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.
CB04-016.flavor: A Dopant that the Sonozaki family's pet cat Mick transforms into with the Smilodon Memory. Not only does he act as the Sonozaki's guardian, he also eliminates those who defy Museum.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7882.name: Snake Orphnoch
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7882.kanji: スネークオルフェノク
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7882.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[LV1][LV2]
When you're summoning a "Horse Orphnoch"/"Crane Orphnoch"/"Faiz"-named Spirit, or using the [Change] of a "Faiz"-named card, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol and an extra Purple symbol.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7882.flavor: An Orphnoch with Snake traits. Naoya Kaidou turns into it. Unable to deem humans as the enemy, he ultimately makes the coexistence of Humans and Orphnochs which Horse Orphnoch hoisted his goal.

BS13-075.effect:
[Main]
During this turn, when your Spirits are destroyed, by sending a core from your Reserve to the Trash, summon a "Dark Snake" family Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost. However, (When Summoned) effects of that Spirit do not activate.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit you control +2000 BP.

[Flash]
Send cores from every opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve until one core left on each of them. Then, by sending a core from any of your Purple-only Grandwalker Nexus to the Void, send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve.

BS36-054.name: Snakiraffe
BS36-054.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard any number of cards from your Hand. For each card discarded, destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit.

BS36-054.flavor: Racer Fromage escapes Calamity-Boar's hot pursuit and reaches the goal!

26RBS01-068.name: Snakrowley
26RBS01-068.effect:
[LV1-2]When Summoned
If you used any "Topaz" family Magic card this turn, draw two cards.

[LV2]True ReleaseOpposing Attack Step

These bolts of lightning seemed to move as if possessed of a will of their own, and appeared capable of infiltrating objects and manipulating them.
―from the Foreigner's Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7887.name: Snakurse
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7887.effect: [When Braved] (When Brave Attacks) Send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7887.flavor: It looks cursed? Don't be silly. Its enemy is the one that's cursed. Like a toad being watched by a snake, its life force will be drained away.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7888.name: Snap-Dragonfly
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7888.flavor:
Egyt obtained Grand-Lolo and Delponia, two entire worlds. However, that is not the end of Ra's ambition.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 3:38―

26RBS02-009.name: Snay-Kloud
26RBS02-009.effect:
[LV1-2]When Summoned
Target one of your Spirits with [Clash]. Refresh it, and during this turn, give it +2000 BP.

[LV2] [Clash] During Attack
Opposing Spirits must block if possible.
26RBS02-009.flavor: As swift, ruthless and relentless as a snake on the ground.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7890.name: Sniping Blast
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7890.kanji: スナイピングブラスト
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7890.effect:

Flash - During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7891.name: Snow and Ice Circle
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7891.effect:
[Flash]
Target an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. During this turn, the targeted Spirit/Ultimate can't reduce your Life. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) was used to pay the cost, two Spirits/Ultimates are targeted by this effect.

BS54-035.name: Snowflake Sabel
BS54-035.kanji: スノーフレークサーベル
BS54-035.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, by banishing five cards from your decktop, it remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While this Spirit or your "Rouse Emperor" family Spirit is attacking, both players' Magic cards/[Accel] in Hand/Removed Zone get +5 costs.
BS54-035.flavor:
They said that "Grandstone" is the device to gather and accumulate energies released by the Spirits who fight in this world.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 3:33―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7893.name: Snowflaken
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7893.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) At the start of the step, by sending a core from your Reserve to your Trash, target an opposing Spirit. That Spirit must attack if possible.

[LV2] Ice Wall: Green - (Opposing Turn) When the opponent uses the effect of a Green Magic, by exhausting this Spirit, negate that effect.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7893.flavor: By all rights, we should have crossed the river and set up camp. However, while the enemy's advance squad were few in numbers, they would have had no mercy to anyone trying to wade across.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7894.name: Snowghost-Leopard
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7894.kanji: スノーゴースト・レオパルド
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7894.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Blade Beast Spirit]

[LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7894.flavor:
Alex and Lolo's are overwhelmingly weaker as Grandwalkers.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 2:45―

P17-16.effect:
[When Braved] (Start of Your Attack Step)
You can summon a Cost 4 or less Spirit card from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirit can't activate.

CB23-054.kanji: やはり、完成していたのね

[During Set]
When your Hand is discarded via your effect, you can send five cores from an opposing Grandlwalker Nexus to the Void.

Draw two cards. Then, reveal a card from the opposing decktop. If that card is Cost 8 or more, you draw a card. Return the revealed card to the decktop or deckbottom.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7897.kanji: 天翔ける創界神アレックス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7897.effect:
[GPGWrule]

BS52-055.name: Sodalite-Golem
BS52-055.kanji: ソーダライト・ゴレム

At first, I didn't know what that meant. A giant which brought with himself a mechanical soldier which certainly wasn't a golem did something towards the ocean. Taking a good look, I could notice a hole was opening in the ocean.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 1:39―

PC12-001.name: Sohryu Asuka Langley ［Second Children］
PC12-001.kanji: 惣流・アスカ・ラングレー ［セカンドチルドレン］
PC12-001.effect:

[During Brave]
Treat this Spirit as having the [Soul Core] on it.

[During Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can draw a card. Then, by discarding a card from your Hand, draw a card.

26RBS01-049.name: Sol-Shimmer
26RBS01-049.effect:
[LV1-2]When Summoned
Reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Spirit card with [Amplify] to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

BS11-074.name: Solar Breaker
BS11-074.effect:
[Main]
Destroy every opposing Spirit with [Clash]/ [Immortality]/ [Windstorm]/ [Ice Wall]/ [Holy Life]/ [Assault].

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +6000 BP.

BS58-069.effect:
[+1]

BS41-005.name: Solar Wind Dragon
BS41-005.kanji: ソーラーウィンド・ドラゴン
BS41-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit. The effect of the Spirit destroyed by this effect can't be activated.

BSC30-010.kanji: 九代目甲蛾頭首アケクワガ
BSC30-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. You can summon "Ninja Gale"/"Shellman"/"War Dragon" family Spirit cards among them, one from each family, without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
You can refresh a "Ninja Gale" family Spirit you control. When you've done so, send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to any of your Spirits.
BSC30-010.flavor: It is said that the ArmoredMoth ninjas are specialized in an operation called "Kusa" that infiltrates the other speicies.

BSC24-032.name: The AlternateDimensionSuperman Ace Killer
BSC24-032.kanji: 異次元超人エースキラー
BSC24-032.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit attacks, return an opposing Nexus to the Hand, and refresh this Spirit.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can activate a (When Attacks) effect of an opposing Spirit as this Spirit's effect.
BSC24-032.flavor:
It stole powers from the Ultra Brothers and used their finisher moves to assault Ace.
―Ultraman Ace―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8274.name: The 9th Apostle
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8274.effect:
When your "The 8th Apostle"-named Spirit has left the Field due to the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost. This effect doesn't stack.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
If there is [Soul Core] on this Spirit, discard four cards from the opposing decktop, and destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost. Also, once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8274.flavor: The 9th Apostle (Angel). It has possessed Evangelion Unit-03.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8275.name: The Alver Prairie
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8275.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) When your Green Spirit is destroyed, you can reveal 1 card from your decktop. If the revealed card is a Spirit card/Brave card with cost lower than the cost of the Spirit destroyed, you can summon the revealed card. If you choose to not summon or if that card cannot be summoned, discard it.

[LV2] All your "Shellman" family Spirits cannot be returned from the Field to your hand/deck by opposing effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8275.flavor:
A vast, unlimited prairie. From here, we can clearly see our continent in the skies.
—Green Forests Site No. 488 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

BS62-014.name: The Amanojaku Riku
BS62-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can summon a "The PartnerMusha Oboro" from your Hand. When you've done so, destroy this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
Your counters +1. Then, destroy an opposing exhausted Cost 4 or less Spirit.
BS62-014.flavor: The fight between Oboro and Bat remained unsettled. In order to obtain new powers, Oboro set off for the Dragon Paradise. It was a hellish place where hundreds of dragons lived. Overcoming various hardships and challenges, Oboro finally succeeded in contracting with a demonic dragon. When Oboro next shows himself, Dan and his group would witness that new power.

BS76-077.name: The Abandoned Monolith Quarry
BS76-077.kanji: 打ち棄てられた巨石採掘場
BS76-077.effect:
[LV1-2]
While your Hand is five or less, your Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
(Can't Stack) If you control any "Contractor Hephaestus", you can draw two cards. When you've done so, discard cards from your Hand until your Hand is three or less.
BS76-077.flavor:
The attack by the Primordial Deities has caused extensive damage to Hephaestus's world as well. Campabania, a mining site for precious ores, was no exception; it is closed and no one ventures near it now.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 848―

BS73-045.name: The AmberFairySummoner Amber
BS73-045.kanji: 琥珀の妖精召喚士アンバー
BS73-045.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Morrigan" & C1 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Manifests)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, you can pay one cost to immediately activate a Flash effect of a "Prismwing" family Magic card. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, by discarding a "Prismwing" family card from your Hand, activate this Spirit's (When Manifests) effect.
BS73-045.flavor:
Leave that Brigit alone and contract with me instead!
―Grandwalker Morrigan―

BS17-018.name: The AmethystSnake Zaum
BS17-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Curse] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked when the battle resolves at the end of battle.
BS17-018.flavor:
The trap set by the Five Nation Alliance was a success. The true might of Dark Shield's power was shone brightly enough. But even with that, the situation had just merely become a case of fifth-fifty. Kei's army was very strong.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of the Hero Kei, Year 647—

26RBS03-X07.name: The AberrantWhale DeepCaesar
26RBS03-X07.kanji: 怪鯨ディープシーザー
26RBS03-X07.effect:
[LV1-2] 1When Summoned
You can send out one of your "Swordish" Tokens. You can only use this effect of the same card name once per turn.

[LV2]True ReleaseYour Attack Step[Invoke: Flash]
Exhaust one of your "Swordish" Tokens ▶ Refresh this Spirit.
26RBS03-X07.flavor: Those shimmering swords in the water follow this aberrant whale with awe and reverence.

SD34-011.name: The Amethyst Ancient Palace
SD34-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Death Dragon" family Spirit card, or an "Imagine" family Brave card to the Hand. Return the remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2]
All your Spirits that activated a "When depleted/destroyed by the Opponent" effect return to your Hand rather than the Trash.
SD34-011.flavor:
An ancient palace made of amethyst floating in the skies above the 216th BSGP's season opener course, the Norse Trio Grand Prix. It's the pit for Team Turon this year.
―from the Naustlio GP United feature by Monthly BSGP―

26RSD10-X02.name: The AberrantWhale DeepCaesar-Abyss
26RSD10-X02.kanji: 怪鯨ディープシーザー・アビス
26RSD10-X02.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2] Either Attack Step
All your "Swordish" gain +2000 BP.

[LV2]When AttacksOnce Per Turn
You can send out one of your "Swordish" Tokens. When sending out the Token, you can return two cards from your Hand to the deckbottom. If two cards are returned, send out up to two Tokens instead.
26RSD10-X02.flavor: The way it swims through the deep sea as if it owns the place makes it look every bit the tyrant. No one can lay a hand on it.

BS55-XX01.name: The AbsoluteDragonDeity Amaterasu-Dragon
BS55-XX01.kanji: 絶対なる幻龍神アマテラス・ドラゴン
BS55-XX01.effect:
This card is unaffected by any effects.

[LV1]
This Spirit can't be braved, and is unaffected by any effects except its own effects. This Spirit's BP is equal to the number of cores on this Spirit x10000.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy all other Spirits.

BS05-057.name: The Amethyst Empty Sky
BS05-057.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When any Cost 1 or less Spirit is exhausted, send two cores from that Spirit to its owner's Trash.

[LV2]
Give all your Spirits with [Tribute] the effect: "(When Attacks) Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit."
BS05-057.flavor:
WARNING
There are some places in this world where you should never approach. This is one of the examples. Be alert!
-from the Places of Interest special section #4 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo-"

26RBS02-040.name: The AbsoluteShield Almarl
26RBS02-040.effect:
[LV1-2] [Amplify: Leucomyst +1000] During Attack/Block[Invoke: Flash]Once Per Battle
Pay one cost ▶For each "Leucomyst" family Spirit you control, during this battle, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.

[LV2] [Camou: 1]
When the opponent would target this Spirit with a Spirit effect, unless they pay one cost, they can't target it.

BS52-CP12.name: The Amethyst Star
BS52-CP12.effect:
When your "Superstar"/"Ogre Wizard" family Spirit is summoned/[Advent], you can return this card from the Trash to your Hand. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[Flash]
Send one core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve. Then, by sending one core from your "Mai"-named Grandwalker Nexus to the Void, send two cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexus(es) to the Void.

BS52-X03.name: The AbsoluteSoundBeast Nubiara-Vatis
BS52-X03.kanji: 絶対音獣ヌビアラ・ヴァティス
BS52-X03.effect:
Flash - [Absolute Sound Speed] (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this card from your Hand by including [Soul Core] when paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits. At the end of battle, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
[heb]
BS52-X03.flavor: "This one is really grumpy, he really doesn't become attached to me~"

18-1.name: The Amusement Paradise
18-1.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your Spirits get +2000 BP.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, draw a card.
18-1.flavor:
A shout echoes in the blue skies. It's the adventure zone unfolding in the Nasu highlands! Woopy's waiting for you all to come!
~Nasu Highland Park~

BS03-113.name: The Absorption Triumphal Arch
BS03-113.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The opponent can't use Magic cards that don't share the same colors as the symbols on their Field.

[LV2]
The opponent can't use Magic cards unless they pay the cost.
BS03-113.flavor:
A gate the was built to commemorate the 2nd competition meeting. A few people visit to see it and it is about to fall into ruin.
-from the Places of Interest 912/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS37-001-A8290.name: The AccelHero Revol-Red
BS37-001-A8290.kanji: 加速戦士リボル・レッド
BS37-001-A8290.effect:
Main- [Accel: Cost 3 ([Red Core][Red Core])]
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add every card with [Accel] among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each differently-named "AccelHero"-named Spirit, draw a card.
BS37-001-A8290.flavor: "As of my arrival, all evildoings are put to a stop! The red light is the sign to stop!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8291.name: The Ancient Arena
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8291.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (During Your Battle Phase) The effects of cards your opponent controls that increase the BP of 1 or more spirits are negated.

[LV2] (During Opponent's Main Phase) (When Summoned) effects of spirits your opponent controls are negated when they are summoned.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8291.flavor:
The crumbling ruins of an ancient arena, which now has no spectators. There are traces of fierce battles that took place here.
-from the Places of Interest 190/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS21-X08.name: The AbyssGiantSword Abyss-Apocalypse
BS21-X08.kanji: 深淵の巨剣アビス・アポカリプス
BS21-X08.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
During this turn, all your Spirits are treated as being at their highest levels.

[During Brave]
The opponent can only activate Bursts or use Magic cards that share the same color as the symbols on their Field.
BS21-X08.flavor: The colossal sword lying at the depths of the ocean shows itself as the water dries away.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8293.name: The AccelHero Yellow-Merlin
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8293.kanji: 加速戦士イエロー・マーリン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8293.effect:
When your Life would be reduced by an opposing effect, by discarding this Spirit card from your Removed Zone, your Life won't be reduced.

Main- [Accel: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add every card with [Accel] among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8293.flavor: "My arrival means pay attention!? The yellow light is an omen for trouble?"

BS56-TCP03-A8294.name: The AbyssGiantSword Abyss-Apocalypse X
BS56-TCP03-A8294.kanji: 深淵の巨剣アビス・アポカリプスX
BS56-TCP03-A8294.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
During this turn, every Spirit you control is treated as being on its highest level.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
The opponent can only activate Burst effects/use Magic cards/[Accel] of the same colors as the symbol colors on their Field.

[During Brave] [Rebirth5]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can separate and flip this Brave.
BS56-TCP03-A8294.flavor: The Abyss Giant Sword that once supported the world. However, its wielder is already gone.

BS67-066.name: The AccelSword Boost Blade
BS67-066.kanji: 加速剣ブーストブレード
BS67-066.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

[During Brave] (When Blocks)
Your counter +1, and put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control.
BS67-066.flavor: The standard equipment of the Winglass PMC. The booster on the blade can increase the speed of the sword. Ice Princesses that lack power are able to obtain remarkable results after using this sword.

BS24-088.name: The Ancient Battlefield of Ten Thousand Spears
BS24-088.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When opposing Spirits/Ultimates are exhausted, draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When you draw, send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.
BS24-088.flavor:
Was this a battlefield? The countless weapons sticking out of the ground look like grave markers. If so, then do Ultimates sleep below them?
—Purple Swamps Site No. 035 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8297.name: The AccelTenthBird AirEraser
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8297.kanji: 加速癸鳥エアイレイザー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8297.effect:
During your Attack Step, when the opponent uses a Magic card, before that effect activates, you can use the following [Accel] of this card from your Hand.

[Accel: Cost 5 ([Green Core][Green Core][White Core][White Core])]
Immediately negate that Magic effect. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8297.flavor: The super fast flight of Accel creates the whirlwind of victory.

BS27-071.name: The Ancient Captial Giudecca of Souls
BS27-071.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Treat every battling Spirit with [Poison Blade] you control as colorless, and when these Spirits are destroyed via BP comparison, they remain on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2]
When the opponent depletes their Spirits/Ultimates, for each card under those Spirits/Ultimates, the opponent discards a card from the Hand.
BS27-071.flavor:
The Poison Fang Knights, the first to leave our continent, seem to have occupied an Ultimate village.
—Purple Swamps Site No. 664 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

BS72-050.name: The AceDanaSoldier Madea
BS72-050.kanji: エースダーナ兵マディア
BS72-050.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Nuadha" & C1 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Manifests/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, you can deploy a "Scalostle"/"Celtica" family card without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards to only the decktop or deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's.
BS72-050.flavor: "Gah-gah-gah, let me join you in that fight!"

BS14-080.name: The Ancient Forest
BS14-080.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
For each opposing Spirit, all your Green Spirits gain +1000 BP.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
Refresh all your Green Spirits.
BS14-080.flavor:
What truly allowed Wind Shield to gain allies was that all throughout Dark Shield's invasion, they protected their shrines of worship. This was yet another great achievement of Kei.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of the Hero Kei, Year 641—

BS52-052.name: The AbyssGiant Curtis
BS52-052.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, draw two cards, then discard a card from your Hand.

[LV2]
When you draw via your Blue-only Spirit effects, the opponent can't activate effects which trigger upon draws/Hand increases.
BS52-052.flavor:
The edge of the ocean was a steep plain water surface. Almost as if on an aquarium, it is held in place, without flowing down.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 1:37―

BS58-021.name: The Acolyte Nicoleus
BS58-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void each to your Reserve and a Red/Green "Astroblazer" family Spirit you control.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Red.
BS58-021.flavor:
Probably because we were bringing along with us quite a few Oracles, we were warmly welcomed by the clerics at the Holy Capital. To no surprise, they also showed their sacred books to us willingly. Just like what Parvati has told, there are what called the power of "upright position" and power of "reversed position" for Oracles. And it seems that all Oracles possess both kinds of powers.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 7:11―

BS67-072.name: The Ancient Temple of Darkness
BS67-072.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn)
All your [True-Curse] also activate at (Opposing Turn).

[LV2] (Your Draw Step)
By discarding either a "Spectral Contract" family card, or a card with "Curse"-named effects from your Hand, draw +2 cards.
BS67-072.flavor:
Contracts that can't be made in public are established here. It's the oldest temple, and it's not wrong to say that its history is exactly the hidden history of the Contract Mediation Agency...Considering what happened to Toa, it is hard to say whether the agency is an ally or an enemy. But let's not talk about it now.
―Travelogue of the Collapsing World 002―

BSC42-002.name: The Acrobat Juggline LT
BSC42-002.kanji: ナイフ投げのジャグリーンLT
BSC42-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
While you control two or less Spirits, this Spirit is treated as being on LV3.
BSC42-002.flavor: She is known as an odd one. She has dinosaurs as her pets. She says they are chubby and cute.

BS14-085.name: The Admiring Pipe Organ
BS14-085.kanji: 賛美するパイプオルガン
BS14-085.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Cards from either players' deck can't be discarded during the Main Step.

[LV2] (Opposing Turn)
Destroy all Red/Green/White/Blue Spirits refreshed by a Spirit/Magic effect.
BS14-085.flavor:
Kei constructed a church to praise the Angelias who had saved her friend's life. Anyone can imagine how the monarch felt at this time.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of the Hero Kei, Year 644—

BS66-069.name: The Ancient Temple of Flames
BS66-069.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 4 ([Red Core][Red Core])]
[During Set] (Start of Your Attack Step)
Besides [Soul Core], you can send two cores from your Trash to any of your "Scarlet Flame" family Spirits. For every three counters you have, this effect sends +1 core.

[LV1]
When opposing Spirits/Ultimates/Nexuses are destroyed by your "Scarlet Flame" family effects, you can return a "Scarlet Flame" family Brave card from your Trash to the Hand.
BS66-069.flavor:
It is said that the World Salvation Contract was established here in the past.
―Travelogue of the Collapsing World 001―

BS63-068.name: The AdvancedFamiliar Cocatrix
BS63-068.kanji: 上級使い魔コカトリクス
BS63-068.effect:
When summoning this card from the Hand, if you've summoned for three times or more this turn, this card is Cost 6.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
During this turn, an opposing Spirit can't attack/block. Also, draw a card from the deckbottom.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
During this turn, you can give an opposing Spirit -8000 BP, and destroy it when its BP reaches 0.
BS63-068.flavor:
As a witch, it is a matter of fact that I can control familiars. All my familiars are controlled by Magical Functions that they can move in a perfectly coordinated manner.
―The PartnerCat Fermat―

BSC30-015.name: The Advent Douji
BSC30-015.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Fighting Spirit] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit. For each pre-advent card of this Spirit, this effect destroys +1 cost. After this effect resolves, you can stack a Blue Spirit card from your Hand onto this Spirit via [Advent], treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.
BSC30-015.flavor:
The four great generals were all focused on expanding their respective territories. And when the struggle for power had reached the climax, the war of determining the world leader had begun.
-from section 4 of "New Record of the Strange World" chapter Sengoku-

BSC30-017.name: The Advent Wisdom King
BSC30-017.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Fighting Spirit & Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Destroy an opposing Cost 8 or less Spirit. For each pre-advent card of this Spirit, this effect destroys +1 cost. After this effect resolves, you can stack a Blue Spirit card from your Hand onto this Spirit via [Advent], treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.
BSC30-017.flavor:
There were also people who attempted to profit from the war of determining the world leader.
-from section 4 of "New Record of the Strange World" chapter Sengoku-

BS23-038.name: The AdventureAngelia Turel
BS23-038.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
By putting up to three Yellow Brave cards from your Hand face-up onto your Removed Zone, for each Brave card put, draw a card. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
Your Life can't be reduced by attacks of opposing refreshed Spirits.
BS23-038.flavor: With her companion Pentan, she takes out her staff and recites an incantation. Through the coordinated effort of a person and a penguin, the door to the ruins opened.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8311.name: The AdventureGiant Jones
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8311.effect:
While any player controls a Grandwalker Nexus, this card in your Hand is Cost 4.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step) You can deploy a Nexus card from your Hand by paying one cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks) Once per turn, by exhausting a Nexus/Grandwalker Nexus you control, this Spirit refreshes. When a Blue Grandwalker Nexus is exhausted by this effect, put one core from the Void to this Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8311.flavor: An advennturer giant born in Grand Lolo. He ends up in Egyt, but being faced by a world with no shortage of adventures, he forgot to return to Grand Lolo.

BS23-039.name: The Adventurer Adopentan
BS23-039.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Reveal three cards from your decktop. Add all "Exalted Sword" family Brave cards among them to your Hand. Discard the remaining cards. If you control any "Turel"-named Spirit, this effect reveals five cards instead. This effect can only be used once per turn.
BS23-039.flavor: With a "Leave this to me!" sort of energy, the Pentan baffled us with his sudden appearance. Hm? Somebody's coming this way looking like they're in a rush...

26RBS02-005.name: The AerialSoldier Cornhilo
26RBS02-005.effect:
[LV1-2] When Summoned
Target one of your Red Spirits. During this turn, give it: "[Clash] During Attack Opposing Spirits must block if possible."

[LV2] True ReleaseYour Attack StepOnce Per Turn
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by your Spirit with [Clash] via BP comparison, you can refresh this Spirit.
26RBS02-005.flavor: He has refined his aerial combat skills, elevating them to the level of supreme mastery.

BSC25-025.name: The AeroKnight Gold-Pheasant
BSC25-025.kanji: 空の騎士ゴルド・フェザント
BSC25-025.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void each to two "Winged Beast" family Spirits you control.
BSC25-025.flavor: Racer Glorious-Sheep is steadily biting into the top group. It seems he's perfectly prepared for Vanrain with dust-proof equipment.

BSC25-026.name: The AeroKnight Silver-Crane
BSC25-026.kanji: 空の騎士シルバ・クレイン
BSC25-026.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. If you control any [The AeroKnight Gold-Pheasant], also, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BSC25-026.flavor: With a firm pace, racer Glorious-Sheep hasn't gotten ahead of racer Amethyst-Dragon, but escapes racer Blazel's hot pursuit and reaches the goal in 9th place!

BS54-057.name: The AeroSwordsman Justi-Eagle
BS54-057.kanji: 大空の剣士 ジャスティ・イーグル
BS54-057.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By returning a Blue-only Reborn Spirit you control to the Hand, summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can deploy a Blue-only Rebirth Nexus card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)

BS69-048.effect:

SD02-005.name: The Angelia Cherubim
SD02-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)

[LV3] [Brilliance] (When Attacks)

BS43-050.name: The Angelia Colelle
BS43-050.effect:
This Spirit card is also treated as a Magic card.

During this turn, an opposing Spirit's symbol becomes zero.

Through the cooperation of the Angelias and the Shinobis dispatched by Alex, Alice's hiding place was revealed, and her capture was a success.
-from the final section of "New Record of the Strange World" chapter Pyroxene Two-

EX13-05.name: The Angelia Coma

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

The shine of the golden hair she takes pride in, itself, as if having its own will, splendidly flutters and captures the enemy.
—from the Comae Berenices chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS40-044.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit can't attack.

[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Put a core from the Void to your Life.
BS40-044.flavor:
The Angelias left in the White World couldn't adapt to the increase in gravity caused by the Great Collapse and became unable to move. If they Advented, they would be able to move slightly at least... Alex and company guided the self-serving angels to the white Origin Pyroxene to teach them the method for it.
-from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter White-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8363.name: The Angelia Daruel
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8363.effect:

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8363.flavor: Teleport now? Right to where the leader of the rebellers is? That's how Father won the war? Wait, the fee is that high?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8364.name: The Angelia Dominia
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8364.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

SD02-003.name: The Angelia Dunamis

The only ones who can understand me are the Angels. They can truly sense one's pain.
-from the 10th paragraph in chapter Yellow of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing LV1 Spirits.

Return this Spirit to the deckbottom.

SD23-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

BS08-042.name: The Angelia Salaty

When leaving the Country of Yellow Sky, as proof of being one of them, I received an armament from an Angelia.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, Fourth Day of the Fifth Month-

BS21-045.name: The Angelia of Beauty Caphopeia

BS16-042.name: The Angelia of Grimm Cinderella

[LV2]

[LV2]
While you control any [The Angelia of Grimm Gratel], when this Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, it can remain on the Field, exhausted.
BS18-039.flavor:
"We couldn't possibly ask a penny from the husband of her Excellency the Emperor~"
All right, all right, I get it. I owe you enough for this.

BS16-039.name: The Angelia of Grimm Rapunzel
BS16-039.kanji: グリムの天使ラプンツェル

The limitless virtue of the Angelias saved Manaka and changed history.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 644—

P13-05.kanji: 光の天使エンジュ・ライト

BS12-037.name: The Angelia of Olimpics Bethor
BS12-037.kanji: オリンピアの天使ベトール

The rumors say that it's due to her that the charisma of the Eight Astral Dragons has fallen to darkness. She doesn't seem like a bad girl... Hm? She's carrying a forbidden spellbook in her arms!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS14-053.kanji: オリンピアの天使ハギト

Opposing Cost 2/4/6/8 Spirits can't attack.
BS14-053.flavor:
"We'll split this evenly: we get 60%, you get 40%! Deal?"
What is this, an agreement or a threat...? In any case, I somehow managed to get seven Angelias to assist me in my search for the Moon Stone.

[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Cost 0/1/4 Spirits can't attack.

[LV2]
Give every "Divine Spirit" family Spirit card in your Hand a [Yellow Core] reduction symbol.

She looks exactly like the girl I met on my journey who loved the Moonlight Dragon Deity! From what I heard, the two of them are twins, and they hate each other enough to fight whenever they see each other's faces. Incidentally, she's a fan of the Sun Dragon Deity... Well, they call that "getting along well enough to fight." Ah, that could apply to the Sun and Moon as well.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS12-038.kanji: オリンピアの天使ファレグ

BS12-038.flavor:
Suddenly bursting through, carrying out a single-person head-first sliding maneuver. She folds her arms and looks down. That was how we met.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS12-035.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
You can send a core from this Spirit to your Life.
BS12-035.flavor:
At a dangerous point in my travels, when I was crossing over the Ruler Mountains, I became acquainted with a young girl. From what I heard, she has undertaken a dangerous mission for the Moonlight Dragon Deity. She won't regret losing her life if it's for him? I'd like to be told that too.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

Someone has to do it!

It was on that moment that, within the minds of all Spirits, Grandwalker Lolo's voice echoed.
