Your “BP- effect” decreases 1000 further.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
Your Life can't be reduced by the attacks of opposing 4000 BP or less Spirits.

[LV3] (When Destroyed)
Return this Spirit to the Hand.
SD15-005.flavor: I taught Lapis the technique for repairing the sword in my place, as I could not undertake the training to become an Angelia.

BS03-X11.name: The ArcAngelia Valiero
BS03-X11.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Target a color between Green/Yellow. Return every Magic card with the targeted color from the Trash to your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] [Brilliance] (When Attacks)
At the end of the battle, return every Magic card you used during this battle to your Hand.
BS03-X11.flavor: I heard that the punisher army has been dispatched to the land of magic. It is getting even more serious.

BS06-041.name: The ArmoredBeast Audhumla
BS06-041.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Blocks)
Put a core from the Void onto this Spirit.
BS06-041.flavor: He supports the soldiers fighting in the front line against the Empty Sky. His dedication encourages his comrades and helps them to gain time, even if he cannot hold the line.

BS62-039.name: The ArmoredBeast BlackHorn
BS62-039.kanji: 鎧装獣ブラックホーン
BS62-039.effect:
When your "Armored Beast" family Spirits would leave the Field due to the opponent, by discarding this card from the Removed Zone, one of those Spirits remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can put this Spirit onto the Removed Zone. When you do, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.
BS62-039.flavor: That kuku lad, doing whatever he wants huh. Who do he think is there to clean things up for him afterwards? Well, seeing that even Dan is having trouble dealing with Kuku, I guess it's alright from the results. Work hard with the plan...And got a taste of my hardships too.

BS67-XV04.name: The ArcAngelia Valiero XV
BS67-XV04.effect:
The cost of this face-up card in your deck becomes Cost 5.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) For every three counters you have, return a "Golden Cloud" family Magic card from your Trash to the Hand. Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Petit Feaniel", change the "Magic card" written on this effect to "card".

[LV2][LV3] [Heavenly Light] (Either Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) At the end of the battle which you used any Magic card, return a "Golden Cloud" family Spirit card/Magic card from your Trash to the Hand.
BS67-XV04.flavor: I heard that Judgment Beasts have appeared in the land of fairies...I'll go and defeat them.

BS10-034.name: The ArmoredBeast Chimairon
BS10-034.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Red/Purple (Opposing Turn)
When the opponent uses any Red/Purple Magic effects, by exhausting this Spirit, negate that effect.

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced, this Spirit refreshes.
BS10-034.flavor: The Deity of Oblivion fires a red beam of light; the Singing Diva's shield deflects it away.

BSC43-XX02.name: The ArcAngelia of Visitation
BSC43-XX02.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Diva & Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

This card/Spirit has every team.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Advents)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can return any number of [Song] Magic cards from your Field/Trash to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
At the end of your "Diva" family Spirit's battle, return any number of Magic cards used in this battle from your Field/Trash to the Hand.
BSC43-XX02.flavor: Let's just say, congratulations, first. But this world is going to come to a new turning point.

BS10-048.name: The Angelia Power
BS10-048.flavor:
The Great Gates have been opened... The first Angel to fly out of those gates was more wild and rambunctious than I imagined.
-from the 14th paragraph in chapter Yellow of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS61-037.name: The ArmoredBeast Gray Wolf
BS61-037.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. Put a "Grandwalker Tezcatlipoca" among them to the Removed Zone. Return the remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2] Flash -
Once per turn, you can swap a card from Hand with an “Armored Beast” family card on your Removed Zone. When you've done so, during this turn, every “Armored Beast” family Spirit you control gains +3000 BP.
BS61-037.flavor: Soul Tablets...Can't be destroyed even with the power of mine...the power of a Grandwalker huh.

BS73-040.name: The ArcIceAngelia Leese
BS73-040.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractors Fremia" & C2 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand or deckbottom. When this effect couldn't return, you can send six cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When opposing Hand increases via your effect and is five or more, you can send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BS73-040.flavor: "Pruning of the branch world is completed. No openings are allowed in Lady Fremia's log."

BS20-041.name: The Angelia Prima
BS20-041.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
By discard a card from your Hand, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -1000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When opposing Spirits' BP reaches 0, destroy all those Spirits.
BS20-041.flavor: "I'll teach you the single most important thing to being an Angelia!" It seems a certain Angelia has been giving posing lessons...

BS43-057.name: The ArcTwinkleAngelia Mikafar
BS43-057.kanji: 大煌天使ミカファール
BS43-057.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Divine Spirit & Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
You can add any number of Magic cards from your Hand/Trash as pre-Advent cards underneath this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
By discarding one pre-Advent Magic card underneath this Spirit, activate the Flash effect of that Magic, without paying the cost. After this effect resolves, if that Magic is also a Spirit card, you can summon it without paying the cost.
BS43-057.flavor: You're the legendary ArcAngelia!! I never thought I would see you!!

BS04-040.name: The ArmoredBeast Gullin-Bullsty
BS04-040.kanji: 鎧装獣グリン・ブルスティ
BS04-040.flavor: His conspicuous horns are made of steel. They symbolize his courage.

26RSD09-005.name: The Archer Coupiel
26RSD09-005.flavor: She continues to pierce everyone's hearts, just as she always has. The only thing that has changed is perhaps the arrow nocked on her bow.

P14-05.name: The Angelia Protiel
P14-05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Draw a card. If you control any Ultimate, return this Spirit to your Hand.
P14-05.flavor: You're excited by the Ultimates? Don't go so far that you use up too much energy in reserve.

HEITH-RUNE2.name: The ArmoredBeast Heith-Rune
HEITH-RUNE2.kanji: 鎧装獣ヘイズ・ルーン
HEITH-RUNE2.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks) while the opponent controls no Red Spirits, this Spirit can't attack.

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) When an opposing Cost 1 or less Spirit attacks, this Spirit refreshes.
HEITH-RUNE2.flavor: His limbs creak as he moves. It is the whistle of a whip that encourages the timid beast to move forward.

SD68-004.name: The ArdentStarDragon Zon-Balphard
SD68-004.kanji: 烈星龍ゾン・バルファード
SD68-004.effect:
When this card is revealed by the [Contract Field] of your “Contractor Apollon”, you can summon it by paying one cost.

[Burst: After your Spirit/Nexus is destroyed by the Opponent]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. When summoned via an effect, this “BP Destruction effect” ignores “BP+” and “give + BP” effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.

BSC44-008.name: The ArmoredBeast Obsidia-Madillo
BSC44-008.kanji: 鎧装獣オブシディア・マジロ
BSC44-008.effect:
When this card is put onto the Removed Zone via switching in places/revealing by your "Armored Beast" family effect, you can return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand. If you have six counters or more, this effect returns +1 Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.
BSC44-008.flavor:
I am the god of destroy, you know. So I am naturally better that fighting in a war than sneaking in and do investigations. Well, I guess Hades got that covered. ―Grandwalker Tezcatlipoca―
So you think Kinich or Huracan can do this??
―Grandwalker Kukulkan―

BS54-028.name: The ArmoredMothGreatShinobi ArgidSawfly
BS54-028.kanji: 甲蛾上忍ルリチュウレンジ
BS54-028.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Bunshin: 1] (When Summoned/Attacks)
By placing one card from your decktop onto the Field facedown and putting at least one core from the Reserve onto it, until the end of the game, it is treated as a "Cost 0/"Bunshin" family/LV1: 1 core, 3000 BP/[Green Core]" Green Bunshin Spirit. (Bunshin Spirits can't be braved/advented onto/switched places with, and are discarded when sent to the Hand/Removed Zone/Deck.)

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Flip one of your Bunshin Spirits face-up, and if it's a Green Spirit card, summon it without paying the cost. Discard any remaining card.
BS54-028.flavor: "Are you...Muramasa Dragon? Where on earth is this place?"

BS58-043.name: The Angelia Reliel
BS58-043.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Once per turn, when you use a Yellow-only Magic card with Mirage effects, after that effect resolves, instead of sending it to the Trash, you can set it without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3]
This refreshed Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.
BS58-043.flavor:
The angelias immediately believed our words. It seemed that they had realized the possibilities of the world's balance collapsing due to both the disappearance and awakening of the Oracles.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 7:03―

BS61-046.name: The ArmoredBeast Obsidiagator
BS61-046.kanji: 鎧装獣オブシディアゲーター
BS61-046.effect:
This card in Removed Zone is Cost 5. When this card is summoned from the Removed Zone, return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard an opposing Burst, and when you can't discard, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains an extra White symbol.
BS61-046.flavor: So a cactus wasteland, with only cactus. What a desolate place...But well, that's fine. Civilization and whatnot are just nuisance. Leave me alone for now.

BS56-044.name: The Angelia Remiliel
BS56-044.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When you set a Magic card Mirage, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -3000 BP, and destroy it when its BP reaches 0. When this effect destroys, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, it can remain on the Field, exhausted.
BS56-044.flavor:
As the Spacetime Police is keeping them in check, we head towards the chamber where the Oracle Spirit is enshrined.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5:15―

BS31-036.name: The ArmoredMothGreatShinobi Bekkou
BS31-036.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) By putting a core each from the Void to two Spirits you control, exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2] (When Attacks) While there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Spirit, by exhausting an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit, or an opposing 20000 BP or less Ultimate, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BS31-036.flavor: "Even if the flames would light the darkness, you still won't be able to see behind you."

BS57-037.name: The Angelia Rimiel
BS57-037.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your effect sets a Magic card Mirage, draw a card. This effect can only be used once per turn.
BS57-037.flavor:
We have received contact from Alex and Polluc, who have been searching for "Justice". However, it seems that time is out. Megiddo-Zora is now standing right in front of us. Sorry, Alex. Our journey together may have been short, but it was fun...Megiddo-Zora took a deep breathe and inhaled. And it was at that moment, a streak of light pierced the air.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 6:34―

BS75-X07.name: The ArgentDoomKnightLord Ragna-Rock
BS75-X07.kanji: 白銀の終焉騎神ラグナ・ロック
BS75-X07.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Knight Contract & C6 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Either heavy exhaust up to three opposing Spirits/Ultimates, or once per turn, you can refresh up to three of your Spirits. Then, once per game, if there is any "Yggdrasil" among this Spirit's pre-advent cards, you can put six cores from the Void to this Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV2] (Your Turn)
The opponent can't activate Burst effects. Also, when your Spirits are refreshed via an effect, during this turn, all those targets gain an extra Green symbol.

BS41-050.name: The Angelia Ririel
BS41-050.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
By putting a Magic card from your Hand face-up onto the Removed Zone, draw a card.
BS41-050.flavor:
The Second Red War, which ocurred between the Angel-Astral Dragon coalition vs Terra Dragons ended with the Terra Dragons defeated. However, as history shows, the ambitions of Terra Dragons would not end here.
-from the 2nd section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Yellow-

26RBS01-X11.name: The ArgentIronDuke Lars-Beriberg
26RBS01-X11.kanji: 白銀鉄公ラーズ・ベリバーグ
26RBS01-X11.effect:
[LV1-2] [Amplify: Leucomyst +1000] During Attack/Block[Invoke: Flash]Once Per Battle
Pay one cost ▶For each "Leucomyst" family Spirit you control, during this battle, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.

[LV2] True ReleaseDuring AttackOnce Per Turn
When this Spirit's BP becomes 12000 or more, this Spirit can refresh.
26RBS01-X11.flavor: It boasts a level of rigidity that one would never expect from its dazzling appearance.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8479.name: The ArmoredBeast Oozuchi
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8479.effect: [LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) When your Life is reduced by opposing Spirits, refresh a Yellow Spirit you control.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8479.flavor: The heavens split as the Vanity Deities descend from the skies. Their power is too strong to stand up against. Yet still, there are those who willingly intercept them, believing that a new power will soon be born. A period of unexpected calm develops...

BS75-066.name: The ArgentLandingShip Hraesvelgr
BS75-066.kanji: 白銀の揚陸艦フレースヴェルグ
BS75-066.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, while you control any "Yggdrasil", cards can't be discarded from either player's deck, and if your Hand is five or less, your Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV2]
Once per turn, when your Spirits are exhausted via an effect, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon/deploy a Cost 6 or less "Argent" without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.
BS75-066.flavor:
The flagship of the IronKnight Yggdrasil, gleaming in argent splendour.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 030―

SD01-025.name: The ArmoredBeast Skoll
SD01-025.flavor: He resists the invaders blows with his strong body. Even when he cannot bear the singing, he never loses his fighting spirit.

BS32-058.name: The ArmoredBird Khirenjack
BS32-058.effect:
[When Braved] (When Attacks)
If this is the first attack of your turn, by sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to another Spirit you control, this Spirit refreshes.
BS32-058.flavor: Birds can get very aggressive and vicious towards anything they see.

BS31-X03.name: The ArmoredMothHead Kuwagaslayer
BS31-X03.kanji: 甲蛾頭首 クワガスレイヤー
BS31-X03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
By sending the [Soul Core] from this Spirit to your Reserve, reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, summon any number of "Ninja Gale" family Spirit cards/Brave cards, without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.
BS31-X03.flavor: Karmic retribution! The 64th Head of the ArmoredMothShinobi Troops brings the iron hammer of justice down upon the age of warring states.

BS61-034.name: The ArmoredBird Kongou Bird
BS61-034.kanji: 鎧装鳥コンゴウバード
BS61-034.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can put an "Armored Beast" family card from your Hand onto the Removed Zone. When you've done so, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can put it onto the Removed Zone.
BS61-034.flavor: "This world, Lecoulis, is such a faulty and disgraceful world. No way I've created such world...So who created it, you say? Hmm, let's ask, shall we?

BS75-027.name: The ArgentProvidence Hououga
BS75-027.kanji: 白銀の天帝ホウオウガ
BS75-027.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Argent" & C4 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Either summon this card without paying the cost, or [Contract Advent] it, treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
You can heavy exhaust three opposing Spirits/Ultimates.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, by sending a core, besides [Soul Core], from your Field/Trash to the Void, refresh one of your "Argent".

BS61-042.name: The ArmoredBird Obsidian Eagle
BS61-042.kanji: 鎧装鳥コンゴウバード
BS61-042.effect:
When this card is put onto the Removed Zone via switching in places/revealing by your "Armored Beast" family effect, you can immediately activate the following Burst.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned)/(When Advents) effect resolves]
Return two opposing 12000 BP or less Spirits to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] [Ultimate Heavy Armor: Red/Purple]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple effects.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked.
BS61-042.flavor: This time I just come to check things out. Didn't really plan to get serious. See you!

BS76-032.name: The ArgentTwinkleBird Kigna-Swan
BS76-032.kanji: 白銀の煌鳥キグナ・スワン
BS76-032.effect:
[LV1-2]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Green.

[LV1-2] (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, if this Spirit is exhausted by your "Argent" effect, during this turn, all your "Argent" Spirits gain +5000 BP, and can't be destroyed by opposing Burst effects.
BS76-032.flavor:
The fight between the SupernovaDragon and the DoomKnightLord reanimated in the Divine World. It seems to have lasted for just a moment, yet it also felt like an eternity.
―Divine World Log 04―

SD40-004.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Barakiri
SD40-004.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck, you can add it to the Hand.

Flash - (Either Attack Step)
This card can be summoned from your Removed Zone by paying the cost and putting cores onto it using cores from your Reserve.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Green Core][Green Core])]
Return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the Hand. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.
SD40-004.flavor: An intruder? Inside the Shinobi's Village? Not talking about us, right? Hiding themselves among ninjas who excel in carrying out secret operations...I wonder what kind of enemies they are.

BS66-033.name: The ArmoredBird Obsidian Turkey
BS66-033.kanji: 鎧装鳥オブシディアンターキー
BS66-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, either add a White Nexus card to the Hand, or set an "Armored Beast" family Mirage card, without paying the cost. When you do, return your originally set Mirage to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2] [Ultimate Heavy Armor: Purple/Green]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Green effects.
BS66-033.flavor: I'm abolishing this contract with Kai! I need to let him know the consequences now! Imagine trying to make Grandwalkers your enemies in this Lecoulis!

BS76-X09.name: The ArgentTwinkleEmperor Hououga
BS76-X09.kanji: 白銀の煌帝ホウオウガ
BS76-X09.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Knight Contract & C8 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1-2] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand for each of your "Argent", including those in pre-advent condition. Then, once per turn, you can refresh a Spirit you control.

[During Advent] [LV2] (When Attacks)
If you have fewer cards in Hand than the opponent, the opponent returns cards from their Hand to the deckbottom until they have the same number of cards in Hand as you, and for every two cards returned, send an opposing Life to the Reserve. (Max. 3)

BS43-052.name: The Angelia Risuelle
BS43-052.effect:
This Spirit card is also treated as a Magic card.

[Flash] - (This effect can't be used while on the Field)
Target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, that Spirit can't attack/block.

[LV1][LV2]
Cards can't be discarded from either deck, and this Spirit can't be destroyed by opposing effects.
BS43-052.flavor:
Alice has contracted with the Dark Pyroxene. It was the Angelias who found out the truth.
-from the final section of "New Record of the Strange World" chapter Pyroxene Two-

BS43-023.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Genmakogane
BS43-023.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck, you can add it to the Hand.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Green Core][Green Core])]
The opponent exhausts two Spirits/Ultimates they control. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Unless the opponent discards a card from their Hand, put two cores from the Void to this Spirit.
BS43-023.flavor: The Armored Moth Shinobi went to the Yellow World to catch Alice!

P17-20.name: The ArmoredBraveShine Rishou
P17-20.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
By discarding a card from your decktop, draw a card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3]
The number of core on this Spirit can't be brought to two or less due to opposing effects.
P17-20.flavor: An information network of the Purple World is constructed around Rashou and Rishou, the two brothers.

BSC25-029.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Higenaga
BSC25-029.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Exhaust two opposing Spirits. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is used to pay the summon cost, also, put three cores from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
If you control [The ArmoredMothShinobi Higenaga] and [The ArmoredMothShinobi Nokogiri], both braved, refresh all your Spirits besides [The ArmoredMothShinobi Higenaga].
BSC25-029.flavor: The middle course is a wasteland that a dry wind blows through. At times gigantic whirlwinds form and mercilessly crush the racers.

BS40-033.name: The ArmoredBushin Dynastes
BS40-033.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent]
Return four opposing exhausted Spirits to the Hand. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
During this turn, when the opposing Life is reduced by the attack of the Spirit that [Advent] onto this Spirit, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
BS40-033.flavor: Denizens of the Blue World!? They're the ones who took away the hero!?

BS31-025.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Hopper
BS31-025.effect:
Flash - High Speed - This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned. Both the cost and the cores to be put onto this Spirit must be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] While there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Spirit, this Spirit gets +3000 BP.
BS31-025.flavor: The ArmoredMothShinobi assisted the DarkArtsMagician's forces. They were neither self-righteous nor loyal, but there was no mercenary group that put in more work than they did.

BS75-040.name: The ArgentTwinkleKnight White Monoqueiroz
BS75-040.kanji: 白銀の煌騎士ホワイトモノケイロス
BS75-040.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Argent" & C2 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Blocks)
You can discard your entire Hand. When any "Argent" is discarded via this effect, banish all cards in the opposing Trash, and you draw three cards.

[During OC] [LV2]
You can pay one cost to summon a Cost 7 or less "Argent" discarded from the Hand via this Spirit's effect.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8498.name: The ArmoredBushin Girafa-Rando
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8498.kanji: 甲蟲武神ギラファ・ランドウ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8498.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Purple/White/Blue (Opposing Turn)
When the opponent uses a Purple/White/Blue Magic effect, by exhausting this Spirit, negate that effect.

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block opposing Spirits while exhausted.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, refresh this Spirit and exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8498.flavor: Apparently he's the guardian god of the eastern forest. No wonder he looked so smug about his strength.

BS42-060.name: The Angelia Rumiel
BS42-060.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Divine Spirit & Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
By adding a "Divine Spirit" family Spirit card from your Trash underneath this Spirit as a pre-advent card, during this turn, this Spirit can't be blocked.

[During Advent] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each of this Spirit's pre-advent cards, draw a card.
BS42-060.flavor: The Angelias also want Siegfried back...I can understand that feeling.

BS75-033.name: The ArgentTwinkleMaiden Valkyrie-Hildr
BS75-033.kanji: 白銀の煌乙女ワルキューレ・ヒルド
BS75-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.

[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit is exhausted by your effect, you can return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

[LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
By exhausting one of your "Argent", during this turn, one of your "Knight Contract" family Spirits can't be blocked.
BS75-033.flavor:
Green symbolises the budding of life, and the power of the World Tree. The Spirits bound to Yggrasil, clad in the Green Life Crystal, the crystallisation of life, rises once more.
―Divine World Log 04―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8501.name: The ArmoredDinoman Ankylong
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8501.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Start Step) You can return a Spirit with Ultra Awaken you control to your Hand.

[LV2] When using your Spirit's Ultra Awaken effect, instead of putting cores on it from your Spirits, you can also use cores from your Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8501.flavor:
The small dinosaurs are disappearing one after another with the worlds. However, I will not disappear, since my flesh is immortal.
-from the 2nd paragraph of the final chapter in "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer
Lolo"-

BS75-036.name: The ArgentTwinkleShielder Balder
BS75-036.kanji: 白銀の煌盾兵バルドル
BS75-036.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your "Argent" Spirits would become the targets of opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus effects, you can change the target to this Spirit only.

[LV2]
All your "Argent" gain +5000 BP, and can block opposing "can't be blocked" Spirits. Also, this refreshed Spirit is unaffected by opposing Magic effects.
BS75-036.flavor:
Have we come to this, then... What a bunch of hopeless people.
―Grandlkwar Nyx―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8503.name: The ArmoredDinoman Gaston
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8503.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed) Destroy an opposing Spirit/Brave with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8503.flavor:
The Solar Militia, who throw appearance and organization to the wind, have been labeled "guerrilla warfare masters from the jungle." As their loud triumphant cries when they defeat their foes resonate all the way to the Skyscraper where they intend to invade, they're practically telling their location to the enemy! It's a big flaw in their plans...
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS33-023.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Hyakude
BS33-023.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
During this turn, give all your "Ninja Gale" family Spirits: "(When Attacks) The opponent can't activate their Bursts." Also, if this Spirit was summoned from the deck after being revealed, during this turn, this Spirit can't be blocked.
BS33-023.flavor:
Three days after the bombardment of Nagashino Castle began, the Six Heaven Army reinforcements arrived and stopped the Heaven Squad's siege.
―from the Battle of Nagashino Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BS76-026.name: The ArgentTwinkleTree Gabunohashi
BS76-026.kanji: 白銀の煌樹ガブノハシ
BS76-026.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate's (When Summoned/Advents) effect resolves]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1-2] (When Summoned)
By heavily exhausting one of your "Argent", banish up to three cards from the opposing Trash.

[LV1-2] 1 (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
BS76-026.flavor:
Chaos can sometimes give rise to the unimaginable. Rather than becoming a DoomKnight Lord, Hououga underwent a unique evolution thanks to the Green Life Crystals. For the Crimson Dragons, this must have come as an unexpected ambush.
―Divine World Log 04―

BS74-030.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Hyakude X
BS74-030.effect:
(Can't Stack) When your "Ninja Gale" family Spirit attacks, you can return this card from your Trash to the decktop.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
During this turn, give all your "Ninja Gale" family Spirits: "(When Attacks) The opponent can't activate Burst effects." Then, when summoned from the deck, you can banish every Cost 3/6/9 card from the opposing Trash.
BS74-030.flavor:
August, year 599 of Combat Era. A meeting was held between the leaders of the Armored Moth, Strange Fang, and Wind Demon clans in preparation for the Battle of Sengigahara.
―from the Ninja Gale Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BS25-X01.name: The ArmoredDragonBattleship Enterprise
BS25-X01.kanji: 甲竜戦艦エンタープライズ
BS25-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Red/Purple/White/Yellow
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/White/Yellow Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.
[Rush: Blue]
(While you have Blue symbols, the following effect activates next)
[Blue Core][Blue Core]: Treat this Spirit as LV3, and all your Spirits' (When Blocks) effect also activates as (When Attacks).

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Blocks)
When only the opposing Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by comparing BP, refresh this Spirit, and send two opposing Lives to their Reserve.
BS25-X01.flavor: We'll give you all the data we've collected, so protect everybody.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8508.name: The ArgoHeroBeast Atalante
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8508.kanji: アルゴの英雄獣アタランテー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8508.effect:
This card in Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can send an opposing originally Cost 6/7/8 Spirit/Ultimate to the Removed Zone. When you've done so, this Spirit refreshes. This effect can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Armor].

[LV2] (When Attacks)
The opposing Bursts can't activate. Also, you can banish a Red/White/facedown card from the opposing Removed Zone.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8508.flavor: The swift Hero Beast which even Hermes takes his hat off to, not even God Ultimates escape from becoming her plaything.

BS75-025.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Kunoichi Madara
BS75-025.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your Green effect, or sent to the Trash via your [Core Charge], if you don't have a Mirage set, you can set it without paying the cost.

[Mirage: Cost 4 ([Green Core][Green Core][Green Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
Give all your Cost 4 or more "Ninja Gale" family Spirits: "[W Catl: Green] (When Attacks) By sending your [Soul Core], or a core from any of your Grandwalker Nexus to the Trash, immediately activate one of your Green Soul Bursts."
BS75-025.flavor:
That kunoichi has caused various factions to vie for power behind the scenes of history.
―from the Soldier's Biography of "Sengoku Obscurities" by Kuroe―

BS22-007.name: The ArmoredDragon Edmontsword
BS22-007.kanji: 鎧竜エドモントソード
BS22-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
For each "Terra Dragon" family Spirit you control, destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: Put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control.
BS22-007.flavor: They have begun to reclaim the land to rebuild their country and make new homes.

BS31-032.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Kusarikama
BS31-032.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Put two cores from the Void to your Reserve. If this Spirit was summoned from the deck, also, the opponent discards a card from their Hand.

[LV2] (When Battles) Exhaust two opposing Ultimates.
BS31-032.flavor: The ArmoredMothShinobi specialize in nighttime warfare. They can see well in the dark and can creep up on you without a sound. It must be hard for the War Dragons to fight an opponent that doesn't come from the front.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8512.name: The ArmoredDragon Maximillion
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8512.kanji: 鉄騎竜マクシミリオン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8512.flavor: A dragon equipped with an iron armor. He seems to be plotting to conquer the world of red with an army of a million soldiers. This is going to be interesting.

BS32-024.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Lunihel
BS32-024.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts.
BS32-024.flavor: "Great commander of the Emperor Beasts, please accept our tribute."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8514.name: The ArgoHeroBeast Meleagros
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8514.kanji: アルゴの英雄獣メレアグロス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8514.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Blade Beast" family Spirit attacks, put a random card from the opposing Hand face-up onto the Removed Zone. This effect doesn't stack.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can reveal one card from your decktop for each card on the opposing Removed Zone. You can summon any amount of "HeroBeast"-named Spirit cards from among them, paying one cost for each of them. Discard any remaining cards.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8514.flavor: A single call from Hermes gathered the Argonaut Hero Beasts.

BS61-047.name: The ArmoredDragon Obsidian Iguana
BS61-047.kanji: 鎧装竜オブシディアンイグアナ
BS61-047.effect:
When this card is put onto the Removed Zone via switching in places/revealing by your "Armored Beast" family effect, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
You can summon this card from the Removed Zone as Cost 5.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.
BS61-047.flavor: Have you mastered the power of Contract? ...This is your first judgement.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8516.name: The ArgoHeroBeast Peleus
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8516.kanji: アルゴの英雄獣ペーレウス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8516.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Blade Beast" family Spirit effect, you can summon it by paying one cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your "SevenGreatHeroBeasts"/"ArgoHeroBeast"-named Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by exhausting an opposing Spirit/Ultimate, refresh this Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8516.flavor: Argo's destination is the land of the final battle, where Grandwalkers are in conflict with one another. The true battle of the Hero Beasts has just begun.

BRAVE-TIGER.name: The ArmoredEmperorTigerDeity Brave-Tiger
BRAVE-TIGER.kanji: 鎧皇虎神ブレイヴ・タイガー
BRAVE-TIGER.effect:
[During Brave]
Neither player can gain cores from the Void though effects.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's, and effects of the destroyed Spirit/Ultimate cannot activate.
BRAVE-TIGER.flavor: The scorching heat which penetrates heaven and earth gives the fierce flames the power of the King. The light which vanished in times forsaken is reborn, and turned into a blade which destroys the armies of ice.

BS30-023.name: The ArmoredEvilDragon Fafner
BS30-023.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When an opposing 5000 BP or less Ultimate is summoned, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
By discarding an opposing Burst, this Spirit can't be blocked.
BS30-023.flavor: They're coming! The power of the forbidden technique is being released!!

BS61-038.name: The ArmoredFighter Warrior Jaguar
BS61-038.kanji: 鎧装戦士ウォーリアージャガー
BS61-038.effect:
When this card is put onto the Removed Zone via switching in places/revealing by your "Armored Beast" family effect, you can return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can reveal a card from your decktop. If that's an "Armored Beast" family card, put it onto the Removed Zone. Discard any remaining card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, you can swap a card from Hand with an “Armored Beast” family card on your Removed Zone.
BS61-038.flavor: Oh, so that's Dan...Having six Contract Spirits...My feeling is like: Is that even possible?

BS74-033.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Lunihel X
BS74-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can exhaust an opposing Spirit. Then, you can put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Then, when summoned from the deck, you can activate this Spirit's [War Catalyze].

[LV2][LV3] [W Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending your [Soul Core], or a core from your Grandwalker Nexus to the Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts.
BS74-033.flavor:
It is said that the Ninja Gale Village did not intervene in the Battle of Senkigahara, yet behind the scenes, the conflict with the Onmyou Territory raged fiercely.
―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―

SD31-002.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Namitento
SD31-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, also, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
SD31-002.flavor: Kirikage was an expert at the ninjutsu handed down through the ArmoredMoth clan. From basic ninjutsu to forbidden techniques, he mastered all of them, until at last Kirikage was enlightened to the secret teachings of ninjutsu.

BS43-028.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Nijuuboshi
BS43-028.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit, and put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
[Rush: Red]
(While you have a Red symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Red Core]: Draw a card.
BS43-028.flavor:
The ninjas have divided into three clans. The WindDemon Clan that send and transfer information. The ArmoredMoth Clan was deployed to the Yellow World to secure Alice. Finally, the StrangeFang Clan went to fight alongside Alex's army.
-from the 2nd Pyroxene Chapter of the Conclusion in "New Records of the Otherworld"-

BSC25-030.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Nokogiri
BSC25-030.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Shellman" family Spirit attacks, the opponent can't block unless they exhaust one of their Spirits.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
If you control [The ArmoredMothShinobi Nokogiri] and [The ArmoredMothShinobi Higenaga], both braved, exhaust all opposing Spirits/Ultimates.
BSC25-030.flavor: The ninja combination from the far east, said to be descendants of an old clan, are biting at the heels of the top group from the very start; will there be an unexpected upset!?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8524.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Nomikage
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8524.effect: Flash - High Speed - You can summon this Spirit card from your Hand by paying the cost from your Reserve and putting cores onto it from the Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8524.flavor: Kurohagane was the greatest in the Village at using concealed weapons. There was no escaping from the countless number of shuriken he threw.

BS75-022.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Onmitsubachi
BS75-022.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Houryokuin Kanetsugu", (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Manifests)
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. For every four counters you have, this "exhaustion effect" exhausts +1 target.

[LV1][LV2] Flash -
By exhausting this Spirit, reveal three cards from your decktop. You can deploy a "Houryokuin Kanetsugu" among them, without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.
BS75-022.flavor:
Many ninja gales scatter, yet the wind continues to blow.
―from the Ninja Gale Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BS32-026.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Ooshio
BS32-026.effect:
[Burst: s] (After After an opposing Spirit's/Brave's (When Summoned) effect resolves)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. If there are two or more colors of Spirits/Ultimates/Nexuses on the opposing Field, instead, exhaust every opposing Spirit/Ultimate. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3]
Your Spirit with Soul Core on it gains +10000 BP.
BS32-026.flavor:
So they used information about the forbidden technique for political purposes too.
―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―

BS31-031.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Shurikabuto
BS31-031.effect: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks) By sending the [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Reserve, reveal a card from your decktop. If that card is a "Ninja Gale" family Spirit card, you can summon it without paying the cost. If it is any other card or not summoned, return that card to your deckbottom.
BS31-031.flavor: The head of the ArmoredMothShinobi boasts of his shadow gathering technique. One person appears to be three people. When you realize it, you'll have been surrounded.

BSC20-009.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Tobikage
BSC20-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void each to every "Ninja Gale"/"Shellman" family Spirit you control.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, the opponent can't activate their Bursts.
BSC20-009.flavor: "Leader. I am prepared to lay down my life for the sake of my mission. I, Tobikage, will hasten to complete any order you give me."

BS31-028.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Tokkuriwasp
BS31-028.kanji: 甲蛾忍トックリワスプ
BS31-028.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Put a core from the void to this Spirit. If this Spirit was summon from the deck, also, exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
BS31-028.flavor: In the first battle, the War Dragons were injured and incapacitated by the ArmoredMothShinobi's nighttime assault. A drawn-out conflict was avoided and thus the scale did not escalate.

SJ15-10.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Zerokage
SJ15-10.effect:
[Burst: s] (After an opposing Spirit/Brave's (When Summoned) effect resolves)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. When this effect exhausts a 5000 BP or less Spirit, return that Spirit to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.
SJ15-10.flavor: "I will eliminate you for the sake of my mission! Prepare yourself!"

BS63-019.name: The ArmoredOgre Gashin
BS63-019.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "The PartnerMusha Oboro", your counter +1. Then, you can destroy an opposing Spirit with one core or less on it.
BS63-019.flavor: Tatsu-Oboro, the contract advent form obtained from the Dragon Paradise. And Gasha-Oboro, the contract advent form obtained for the final battle. Oboro has overcome numerous challenges to get ready for the final battle. And thus the long-waited battle between Oboro and his rival, Bat, has begun. Oboro risks everything he has as an ogre musha, treating himself as one who has already died, and strikes with his heavy sword.

SD49-002.name: The ArmoredPisces Pisce-Osteus
SD49-002.kanji: 甲冑双魚ピスケ・オステウス
SD49-002.effect:
This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Ignoring the "BP +" of Braves, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit and an opposing 10000 BP or less Ultimate. The effects of the Spirit/Ultimate destroyed by this effect can't activate.

[LV2][LV3]
Increase the limit of your "Galaxian" family Spirit's "BP Destruction effects" by +5000.
SD49-002.flavor:
Master says she needs the Twelve Reborn Zodiacs' help to defeat a certain enemy, and that's why she needs the Starpower.
―"Reborn Star Negotiation Memos" Second Clause 02―

BS61-044.name: The ArmoredRite Toxcatl-Turtle
BS61-044.kanji: 鎧装祭祀トシュカトル・タートル
BS61-044.effect:
When this card is put onto the Removed Zone via switching in places/revealing by your "Armored Beast" family effect, refresh an "Armored Beast" family Spirit you control.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can reveal a card from your decktop. If that's an "Armored Beast" family card, put it onto the Removed Zone. Discard any remaining card.
BS61-044.flavor: Hmm, so he can use the powers of the Spirits that are sealed within the Stone Tablets. And not just that. Summoning the dormant power of the Contract Spirits...Is that deck the key of all these?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8534.name: The ArmoredSnake Mithgarth
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8534.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Blocks) This spirit gets +1000BP for each "Giant Beast" spirit you control until end of turn.

[LV2] (During Opponent's Battle Phase) When this spirit defeats a spirit, if this spirit is exhausted, refresh this spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8534.flavor: There are some creatures who responded to the songs. He is waiting for the moment of showdown.

BS23-033.name: The ArmoredSwordMaster Minotauros
BS23-033.kanji: 機甲剣聖ミノタウロス
BS23-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Unsheathe] (When Summoned)
You can summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card that can brave with this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2]
When you draw cards via a [Rush] effect, draw one card.

[When Braved] [LV2] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand.
BS23-033.flavor: The fighting style of the strong-bodied SwordsSaint allows flesh and bone to be cut while still keeping it intact.

BS30-025.name: The ArmoredSwordsman Blizzard
BS30-025.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Return an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand.
[Rush: Blue]
(While you have a Blue symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Blue Core]: Draw two cards. Then, discard a card from your Hand.

[During Brave] [LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block while exhausted.
BS30-025.flavor: We aren't your enemy!! Now let's protect the pillar sword together!!

BS31-079.name: The ArmoredTank Hitterkabuto
BS31-079.kanji: 鎧戦車ヒッターカブト
BS31-079.effect:
[When Braved] White/Yellow
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing White/Yellow Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.

[When Braved]
While [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, this Spirit gains Purple.
BS31-079.flavor: If a Clever Machine braved, you'd have a hard time even scratching them.

BS31-017.name: The ArmoredWarOgre Rashou
BS31-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
By discarding four cards from your decktop, draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3]
While there is [Soul Core] in your Trash, increase the LV cost for all opposing Nexuses by +2.
BS31-017.flavor:
Combat Era, February 562. The ArmoredWarOgre obeys the army revived by soul magic, holding back the RedSwords WisdomKing's troops.
―from the Kaminakajima Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BS31-080.name: The ArmoredWing Fighter
BS31-080.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

[When Braved] Green/Blue
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Green/Blue Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.
BS31-080.flavor: There's an old anecdote saying that a braved Clever Machine defended the castle gates to the very end on his own.

SD14-X01.name: The ArmoredWoodGod Herac-Dinus
SD14-X01.kanji: 甲樹神ヘラク・ダイナス
SD14-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When this Spirit, or your Spirit with [High Speed] attacks, unless the opponent blocks with two Spirits, they can't block. When those Spirits block, choose one of them to battle against.

[LV2][LV3]
All your "Parasite" family Spirits gain +2000 BP.
SD14-X01.flavor: The head of the insects that rules the dark sea of trees is unsatisfied with this land alone, intending to expand his domain.

SD01-023.name: The Artifact Droiden
SD01-023.effect:
[LV2][LV3]
All your White Spirits gain +1000 BP.
SD01-023.flavor: The invading army has besieged the tower. He's the leader of the rear support unit.

BSC45-052.name: The Artifact Droiden LT
BSC45-052.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Or, return an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3]
Give every White Spirit you control +3000 BP.
BSC45-052.flavor: The invading army has besieged the tower. He's the leader of the rear support unit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8543.name: The Artifact Forseti
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8543.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Heavy Armor: Purple/Green - This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Green Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[When Braved] [LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) All your White Spirits gain +3000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8543.flavor:
With him at the entrance of the Skyscraper, breaking through from the front will be difficult. The operation headquarters of the Solar Militia is immediately changing its strategy; they've notified the front lines of using guerrilla tactics to slip into the moonlight.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8544.name: The Artifact Galar
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8544.effect: [LV1][LV2] Treat this spirit as a white spirit as well as a yellow spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8544.flavor:
The discovery of it was a pure coincidence. It could very well be the final piece of the puzzle. The Dragons, the Rowdy Vandals, the Angels, the Demonkin, the Giants, and the Invaders—just who or what were they? I must see the Dark Snakes once more. I must confirm the evidence I've gathered.
-from the 14th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BSC42-077.name: The Artifact Plant LT
BSC42-077.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your "Silver Zero"/"Armed Machine" family Spirits are exhausted, you can put a core from the Void to this Nexus for each of those Spirits.

[LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
By exhausting this Nexus, during this battle, an "Armed Machine" family Spirit you control, or a Spirit with "Armor"-named effects you control can't be blocked.
BSC42-077.flavor:
The broken gate that connects this world to the strange world. Stay far away from it for your safety. It may transform your body into something else.
-from the Places of Interest 16/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8546.name: The Artifact Vellnd
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8546.effect: [LV1][LV2] Armor:Blue -This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Blue Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8546.flavor: From defeating others to being the defeated... Though the tides of war may change, its mission remains forever constant: to protect its master, even unto its dying breath.

BS03-023.name: The ArtificialCreature No.44
BS03-023.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Curse] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked at the end of battle.

[LV2] (When Blocks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS03-023.flavor: The guards started to rise when the rulers returned to this world. As the snake predicted, the times are now splitting.

BS27-065.name: The AriesAstralArmored AriesBrave
BS27-065.kanji: 牡羊星鎧アリエスブレイヴ
BS27-065.effect:
[During Brave]
When the opponent would summon Ultimate cards, they are summoned in exhausted state.

[During Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
The opposing Bursts can't activate.
BS27-065.flavor: A sheep brave is here! I'd brave with that! I want to be a snake in sheep's clothing.

SD17-011.name: The ArmedMachineDragon Silveed
SD17-011.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Return a Spirit card with [Rush] from your Trash to the Hand.

[When Braved] [Clash] (When Brave Attacks)
The opponent must block if possible.
SD17-011.flavor: This sharp pointed armor gives the enemy a counter as rough as their attack.

BS66-065.name: The ArmorBreakingLongSword Ome-Acatl
BS66-065.kanji: 甲破の長剣オメ・アカトル
BS66-065.effect:
[During Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
If there are five or less cards in your Removed Zone, you can reveal a card from your decktop. If that's an "Armored Beast" family card, put it onto the Removed Zone, and when put, return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom. Discard any remaining cards.

[During Brave] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
You can summon an "Armored Beast" family Spirit card from your Removed Zone, without paying the cost.
BS66-065.flavor: A sword-type Brave called Macana that is created by Grandwalker Tezcatlipoca.

BS31-074.name: The ArmoredFlyingDragon Oosodelgar
BS31-074.kanji: 鎧飛竜 オーソデルガー
BS31-074.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned) Destroy three opposing 4000 BP or less Spirits/Ultimates. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) was used to pay the summon cost, also, destroy an opposing braved Brave.

[When Braved] True-Clash (When Attacks) The opponent must block with their Spirit/Ultimate if possible.
BS31-074.flavor: SengokuDragon, who took command of Flame War Province, set his eyes on the key passage of Kaminakajima. He may have sensed that his first campaign would be an undeniably significant fight.

BS22-056.name: The ArmorCuttingDragon Rugops
BS22-056.effect:
[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
When this Spirit is blocked by a Spirit with only one symbol, send a core from the opposing Life to their Reserve.
BS22-056.flavor: Get on its back and it'll charge. Its actions are the height of simplicity. If one were to pin down its weak point, it would be controlling it.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8553.name: The ArmoredFortress Barosauru-no-Nushi
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8553.kanji: 鎧要塞バロザウルノヌシ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8553.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your hand onto your target spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Destroy two opposing 10000 BP or less Spirits/Ultimates. Also, when [advented] onto a Blue Spirit, put two cores from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3]
Your "Terra Dragon"/"Ocean Emperor" family Spirits can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8553.flavor: Susanoo rides on Barosauru-no-Nushi's back and travels across Amahara.

BS32-055.name: The ArmorDragonBlade Gouten
BS32-055.effect:
[Burst: s] (After an opposing Spirit's/Brave's (When Summoned) effect resolves)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit, or an opposing Nexus. After this effect resolves, summon this Brave card without paying the cost.

[When Braved] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.
BS32-055.flavor: Despite it being part of the plan, even the "Master" was surprised at deeds done to destroy the fort.

BS19-042.name: The ArmoredFortress Sawback-Turtle
BS19-042.kanji: 機甲要塞ソーベック・タートル
BS19-042.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: You can summon any number of Brave cards from your Hand, up to a total cost of 12, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of Braves can't activate.
BS19-042.flavor: A mobile fortress took us in when we were on the move. Though, I can't stay calm with its random, showy, and extreme movements.

BS60-017.name: The Armor of Vainglory
BS60-017.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Blood Contract, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2]
When your “Blood Crystal” family Spirits would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can discard a card from your decktop. Once per turn, if that's a “Blood Crystal” family card, one of those Spirits can remain on the Field, exhausted.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Increase the LV costs of every opposing Nexus by +1

BS30-046.name: The ArmoredFortress Taimait
BS30-046.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or higher Spirits]

[Double Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4] (When Blocks)]
For each Ultimate Trigger hit, this Ultimate gains +5000 BP. [Double Hit]: If it hits twice, also, refresh this Ultimate.
[wutb]
BS30-046.flavor:
Thanks to the reinforcements, the opening that the technique is maintaining is secure.
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, Past Records: Day 12—

26RSD03-X01.name: The ArmoredHands Squid
26RSD03-X01.effect:
[LV1-2]When Summoned
You can target an opposing exhausted Spirit. Heavy exhaust it.

[LV2]During Attack Once Per Turn

At the end of battle, this Spirit can refresh.
26RSD03-X01.flavor: If you think that ink is merely to blind you, you'd better rethink.

P15-01.name: The ArmoredHornBeast Quadron
P15-01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) If [Soul Core](Soul Core) was used to pay the summon cost, destroy an opposing braved Brave.

[LV2][LV3] True-Clash (When Attacks) The opponent must block with their Spirits/Ultimates if possible.
P15-01.flavor: One hit from the horns of this creature living in Flame War Province is enough to pierce through armor, they say.

BS61-041.name: The ArmoredKing Tloque-Nahuaque
BS61-041.kanji: 鎧装王トロケ・ナワケ
BS61-041.effect:
When your Life would be reduced, by summoning this card from the Removed Zone, your Life isn't reduced.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Put every "Armored Beast" family card among them to your Removed Zone. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3]
Give every "Armored Beast" family Spirits you control: "[Ultimate Heavy Armor: Red/White] This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/White effects."
BS61-041.flavor: The Armored Beasts protect themselves with tough armor. There are attacks that go through only if one is protected well.

BS25-067.name: The Armored City Shieldonia
BS25-067.kanji: 装甲都市シールドニア
BS25-067.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Give all your LV3 or higher White Spirits/Ultimates: "Green This Spirit/Ultimate is unaffected by opposing Green Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects".

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
All your Spirits/Ultimates with [Ultra Armor] gain +3000 BP.
BS25-067.flavor: There's a plan to make the underwater ruins float in the sky and become the front line base for getting on the Reverse Continent. Yes, the land war alone is not looking good, but will it go well?

BS25-068.name: The Armored Dragons' Hunting Ground
BS25-068.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
All your "Armored Dragon" family Spirits/Ultimates gain +2000 BP.

[LV2] (Opposing Main Step)
The (When Summoned) effects of opposing Spirits/Braves can't activate.
BS25-068.flavor: Our data passed through the hands of many species, at last coming to rest in the hands of the white Armored Dragons. As they are highly skilled in guarding, we entrusted our last defense to them.

BSCO-004.name: The ArtificialVampire Drakstein
BSCO-004.kanji: 人造吸血鬼ドラクシュタイン
BSCO-004.effect:
(Once per Game: Same Name) When an opposing Spirit would activate a (When Summoned/Advents) effect, before that effect activates, by paying one cost to summon this card from your Hand, immediately negate that effect, and send every core from that Spirit to the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit to the Trash.

BS70-017.name: The AssassinDoll †Bellini†
BS70-017.effect:
When this card would be banished, you can summon it instead of banishing it.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
If you control any "Contractor Hera", you can draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
If you have eight counters or more, you can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
BS70-017.flavor: One of Hera's favorite dolls. Preparing for the decisive battle against Uranus, it is said that Hera has created quite a few new dolls.

BS03-003.name: The Assassin Dragno
BS03-003.effect:
[LV1] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by Spirits with [High Speed].

[LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by Spirits with [Curse] / [High Speed].
BS03-003.flavor: It seems that an assassin was sent out to assassinate the leader of the dinosaurs. Be careful when you go out at night.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8566.name: The Assassin Dragonaga
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8566.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Curse (When Attacks) Destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked when the battle resolves at the end of battle.

[LV2] (When Attacks) Treat this Spirit's color as colorless.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8566.flavor:
I visited the purple world once more. Without forces of Demonkin or Vanity Deities, all that was left was the snakes' palace.
-from the 2nd paragraph of the Final chapter in "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

26RBS03-009.name: The Assassin Nidree
26RBS03-009.effect:
[LV2]True ReleaseWhen Destroyed
Target an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit that is blocking this Spirit. Destroy it.
26RBS03-009.flavor: His small stature, which had long been looked down upon by his own people, proved to be a useful asset in the world of assassination.

SD02-006.name: The Assassin Weaseve
SD02-006.kanji: 鼬の暗殺者ウィゼーブ
SD02-006.effect:
[LV2] (When Destroyed)
You can deploy a Nexus card from your Trash, without paying the cost.
SD02-006.flavor: We are now at an interval. They are quietly repairing the equipment facility after it got damaged from the harsh tournament.... And no, I'm not trying to be fancy with my speech.

BSC45-073.name: The Assassin Weaseve LT
BSC45-073.kanji: 鼬の暗殺者ウィゼーブLT
BSC45-073.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can deploy a Nexus card from your Trash, without paying the cost.
BSC45-073.flavor: We are now at an interval. They are quietly repairing the equipment facility after it got damaged from the harsh tournament.... And no, I'm not trying to be fancy with my speech.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8570.name: The AssaultSoldier Norman
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8570.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed) You may deploy a blue nexus card from your hand without paying its cost.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8570.flavor: When this competition started, it took the place of the war. This is the 10th anniversary of this competition and this is the biggest event in the past 10 years. We are expecting many champions from other events in this event.

CB25-067.name: The Asticassia School of Technology
CB25-067.kanji: アスティカシア高等専門学園
CB25-067.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Once per step, when your "School" family Spirit is summoned/[Advent], if your Hand is four or less, draw a card.

[LV2]
When your Yellow "Pilot" family Braves would leave the Field due to opposing effects, by discarding a card from your Hand, they remain on the Field in the same state.
CB25-067.flavor: A.S.（Ad Stella）122 -- An era when a multitude of corporations have entered space and built a huge economic system. And this is a school ran by the Benerit Group, the leading figure in the Mobile Suit industry.

BS30-060.name: The AstralBattleStick Algieba
BS30-060.effect:
[When Braved] (When this Spirit Battles)
When battling with opposing Ultimates, this Spirit gains +5000 BP.

[When Braved] (When this Ultimate Battles)
Put a core from Void to this Ultimate.
BS30-060.flavor: It stopped the opposing attacks!? Again, it stopped them!

BS30-065.name: The AstralBayonet Antares
BS30-065.effect:
[LV1]
The (When Summoned) effects of Spirits can't activate.

[When Braved] (When this Spirit/Ultimate Brave Attacks)
This Spirit/Ultimate gains +3000 BP.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: This Spirit/Ultimate gains an extra Green symbol.
BS30-065.flavor: That's right! Shoot down that swordsman!! Focus your force!

SD28-011.name: The AstralBeastBlade Procyon
SD28-011.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to any Ultimate you control.

[When Braved] (When this Spirit Brave Attacks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP.

[When Braved] (When this Ultimate Brave Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.
SD28-011.flavor: Antarc, are you going to take that weapon and fight too!?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8575.name: The AstralBeastDragon Kyparissos
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8575.kanji: 星獣竜キュパリッソス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8575.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When [adventing] an "Astral Dragon" family Spirit card onto this Spirit, you can send two cores from your Trash to this Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8575.flavor:
The reason the chaos was kept to a minimum was mostly thanks to Apollon's way of governing. He didn't spread his influence across the entire world, Nairaka remained as a deserted world. Due to his consideration, he earned the inhabitants respect, and they submitted themselves to him. A method infinitely different from Zeus-Lolo's habit of dying everything with his own colors.
―"The Genesis Records" New Volume 1:08

BS29-059.name: The AstralBeastSpear Sirius
BS29-059.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
The opponent exhausts two of their Spirits.

[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve. By not activating this Ultimate's Ultimate-Trigger, also, this Ultimate gains +7000 BP.
BS29-059.flavor: Laten, when did you Brave!? If you wave it around like that, someone'll get hurt!!

BS29-061.name: The AstralGun Fomalhaut
BS29-061.kanji: 星銃フォーマルハウト
BS29-061.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing 8000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

[When Braved] (Your End Step)
Refresh this Spirit/Ultimate.
BS29-061.flavor: Braves really are amazing. By braving, you can become stronger. If the White World had these, they'd be able to drive out the Invaders...

BS30-059.name: The AstralHillHalberd Benetnasch
BS30-059.effect:
[When Braved] (When this Spirit Brave Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[When Braved] (When this Ultimate Brave Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Ultimate.
BS30-059.flavor: Logistical support weapons are a necessity as well.

P14-41.name: The AstralKingBlade Alphecca
P14-41.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy a Brave on an opposing Brave Spirit. If your Life is at three or less, instead, destroy a Brave on an opposing Brave Spirit/Brave Ultimate.

[When Braved] (When this Spirit/Ultimate Brave Attacks)
For each of your Brave Spirits/Brave Ultimates, this Spirit/Ultimate gains +2000 BP.
P14-41.flavor: The AstralKingBlade is fated to fall into the hands of the one who will be king.

BS29-055.name: The AstralKnightSpear Gacrux
BS29-055.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.

[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
Draw a card. By not activating this Ultimate's Ultimate-Trigger, also, this Ultimate gains +7000 BP.
BS29-055.flavor: So Ozzania can brave too! Amazing! Cool!!

BS74-004.name: The AstralLavaBlade Scapoonrhynchus
BS74-004.kanji: 星溶刃スカプーンリンクス
BS74-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1, and destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit. Then, (Once per Turn: Same Name) by sending your [Soul Core] to any "Contractor Ometeotl" Grandwalker Nexus, draw two cards.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Lava Fish" family Spirit/Ultimate attacks, you can send three cores from an opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.
BS74-004.flavor:
Ometeotl is the supreme deity of Vulrica, embodying both light and darkness.
―Divine World Log 03―

BS30-063.name: The AstralLyreFan Vega
BS30-063.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
During this turn, an opposing Spirit/Ultimate loses all of its effects, and can't gain new ones.

[When Braved] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
By returning this Brave to the Hand, this Spirit/Ultimate remains on the Field, exhausted.
BS30-063.flavor: Seeing such refined technique is like watching a dance... they aren't really dancing, right?

BS69-CX01.name: The AstralMaterContractor Gaia
BS69-CX01.effect:
[Neo-Core Charge:: (Reptile Beast/Primordial/Concluser & Cost 3 or more) (Primordial & Nexus)]
◆When your target Spirit/Nexus is summoned/deployed, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this Nexus is deployed, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Revive] Main - (Once per Turn: Same Name) You can deploy this card from Soul State.

[Contract Field] [LV1][LV2]
When your other "Primordial" family Nexus is deployed, your counter +1. (Max. up to 8 counters.) Then, (Once per Turn: Same Name) you can draw a card.

4 [LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) Destroy a Nexus you or the opponent controls, and when destroys, if your counter is six or more, you can refresh a "Primordial" family Spirit you control.

BS70-CX03.name: The AstralNightContractor Uranus
BS70-CX03.kanji: 星夜の契約神ウラノス
BS70-CX03.effect:
[Neo-Core Charge:: (Cloudbuilt/Primordial/Concluser & Cost 3 or more) (Primordial & Brave)]
◆When your target Spirit/Brave is summoned, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this Nexus is deployed, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Revive] Main - (Once per Turn: Same Name) You can deploy this card from Soul State.

[Contract Field] [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When your "Primordial"/"Cloudbuilt" family attacks/blocks, your counter +2. Then, by paying one cost, immediately activate one of your set "Primordial"/"Cloudbuilt" family Bursts.

3 [LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) You can set a Burst card from your Hand. When you've done so, once per turn, you can draw a card from deckbottom.

BS30-055.name: The AstralShieldSword Arcturus
BS30-055.kanji: 星盾剣アークトゥルス
BS30-055.effect:
[LV1] [SSoul: Red]
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains [Red Core] (an extra Red Symbol).

[When Braved]
This Spirit/Ultimate can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.
BS30-055.flavor: Spirits and Ultimates are sharing the same Brave!?

BS74-002.name: The AstralSpearShellfish Orthoceraspear
BS74-002.kanji: 星槍貝オルソセラスピア
BS74-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a total of one "Contractor Ometeotl" and "Lava Fish" family card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. By sending your [Soul Core] to any "Contractor Ometeotl" Grandwalker Nexus, this effect reveals +1 card and adds +1 card to Hand.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. If you control any "Contractor Ometeotl", this effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.
BS74-002.flavor:
What on earth...is that? That chaos is...
―Contractor Kai―

BS68-008.name: The AstralStagDragon Elafeed
BS68-008.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Red Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, when your Red-only “Devotee”/"Concluser" family Spirit attacks, you can draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Red “Devotee”/"Concluser" family Spirit attacks, you can destroy an oposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest BP.
BS68-008.flavor:
Be careful of Hades, Dan. He never put himself under the limelight, and took care of Olym affairs behind the scenes all this time. Even I can't tell what he is after.
―Grandwalker Apollon―

SJ14-28.name: The AstralTrident Aspidiske
SJ14-28.kanji: 星海槍アスピディスケ
SJ14-28.effect:
[When Braved] (When this Spirit Brave Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit.

[When Braved] (When this Ultimate Brave Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing non-braved Spirit.
SJ14-28.flavor: Hm? This gives different effects for myself and Antarc. So that's possible.

BS64-X09.name: The AstralZeroSword Foranswer
BS64-X09.kanji: 星零剣フォーアンサー
BS64-X09.effect:
[B Engage: Contract Advent Spirit with "The ZeroPartner, Wiz" as pre-advent]
(Once per Game: Same Name) When braving with the target, you can activate the following effect:
█ Draw four cards, then discard two cards from your Hand. The opponent can't activate Nexus effects via this draw.

[During Brave] Red/Purple
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple effects. Also, while you have six counters or more, this Spirit gains an extra White symbol.

[During Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, while braved to a "Zero Contract" family Spirit, if you have seven counters or more, this Spirit can refresh.

BS07-007.name: The Astrologist Dragron
BS07-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Choose and return a Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand. If that card is a "Soldier" family Spirit card, destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit.
BS07-007.flavor:
“What good will come of only just now divining the current battle situation? Apparently the Dragons don't have their priorities straight…”
-from the 5th paragraph in chapter Red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8591.name: The Astronomer Lilia
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8591.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit is also treated as a Green/White Spirit.

[LV1][LV2]
When the opposing Life is reduced, you can summon a "Galaxian" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2]
While you control [The Negotiator Mix], all your "Galaxian"/"Astral Soul" family Spirits are treated as being at their highest levels.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8591.flavor: Pull… raging father flash. Fill… quiet mother halo. And awaken, the new world where sun and moon coexist!

BS12-034.name: The Astronomer Pentan
BS12-034.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Start Step)
During this turn, give all your "Song Bird" family Spirits the "Astral Soul" family.
BS12-034.flavor:
When all of the Angels descend, the end will come to the world. The movement of the stars foretell this. It is an altogether ominous prophecy... Though the face of the teller made me laugh.
-from the 1st paragraph in chapter Yellow of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8593.name: The Atlaia Sea Empire
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8593.effect:
