When this Spirit's effect brings the BP of opposing Spirits to 0, destroy all those Spirits which had their BP brought to 0.
SD15-X01.flavor: "I accept you as an Angelia trainee."

BSC20-001.name: The BattleArrowDragon Byouha
BSC20-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Flash - [Awaken]
You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your other Spirits are depleted via [Awaken], destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit. Also, if [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, draw two cards.
BSC20-001.flavor: The SengokuGoldDragon was the shadow hero of the Battles of Kaminakajima. If he had not fended off the Ninja Gale reinforcement corps, the result of the war would be significantly different.

BS57-012.name: The Bal-Masque Baron Sauerland
BS57-012.kanji: バル・マスケ 男爵 ザウアーラント
BS57-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
By discard a card from your Hand, draw a card. Then, if you have a Mirage set, you can destroy an opposing Spirit with one core or less on it.

[LV1][LV2]
When the opponent would deploy a Nexus card from the Hand, unless they use [Soul Core] to pay the cost, they can't deploy it.
BS57-012.flavor:
The identity of the masked man was revealed. That man was the leader of "Bal-Masque", a group of vampire nobles. I've heard about them before. Something about "Bal-Masque" being a dangerous group that worships "death". Why do they join force with the Space Pirates?
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 6:27―

BS06-010.name: The BattleAxe Apollodinos
BS06-010.kanji: 戦斧のアポロディノス
BS06-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
The cost of all "Vanity Deity" family Spirit cards in your Hand becomes 6.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - [Awaken]
You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by your Spirit with [Clash] via BP comparison, refresh this Spirit.
BS06-010.flavor: We have an uninvited guest. Let's leave here.

PX25-01.name: The Bearer of Core Light, Suzuri Hideto
PX25-01.kanji: コアの光主・硯 秀斗
PX25-01.effect:
[Core Charge: (Blue) (Core Charge via summon/advent only once per turn)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
+2 cores to this Nexus. Then, (Once per Turn: Same Name) you can deploy a Cost 4 or less Blue-only Nexus card from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest cost.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8640.name: The Bal-Masque Castle Bloodrondo
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8640.kanji: バル・マスケ居城ブラッドロンド
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8640.effect:
[LV1] (When Deployed)
By discarding a "Nightling" family card from your Hand, draw two cards.

[LV1] [Rebirth3]
When opposing Spirits/Ultimates are depleted/destroyed, or when this Nexus would leave the Field by opposing effects, you can flip this Nexus. When you do, you can put a core from your Field/Reserve to this now-Reborn Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8640.flavor: The castle of the "Bal-Masque" who rules the night of the Purple World. While on first look it seems to be a normal ancient castle, it is in fact a castle demon.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8641.name: The BattleBeast Babeaver
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8641.flavor: The hiding competition is around the corner. The principle of this competition is the fairness. There are some other events in which the short competitors have more advantages.

BAL-MASQUE.name: The Bal-Masque Duchess Siegrune
BAL-MASQUE.kanji: バル・マスケ 女公爵 ジークルーネ
BAL-MASQUE.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with two cores or less on it, and when destroys, draw a card.

[LV2] [Rebirth3]
Either by paying one cost during the Flash Timing of Either Attack Step, or when this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can flip it. When you do, this Reborn Brave can either refresh and brave to a Spirit you control, or remain in Spirit condition by putting a core from your Reserve/Spirit onto it.
BAL-MASQUE.flavor: The Bal-Masques led by Bradford eventually joined us. "We've done our part," they said. I wonder what did that mean.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8643.name: The BattleBeast Babyrouza
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8643.flavor: It is said that the Eastern Kingdom relies heavily on teamwork in battle because their power is inferior to other kingdoms. Are rumors of the East allying with the Middle Kingdom true?

PX24-04.name: The Bearer of Core Light, Viole Mai
PX24-04.kanji: コアの光主・ヴィオレ魔ゐ
PX24-04.effect:
[Core Charge: (Purple) (Core Charge via summon/advent only once per turn)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
+2 cores to this Nexus. Then, you can draw a card.

[Grand Skill: 2] [LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) Send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve, and when depletes, your counter +1.

BS11-X06.name: The BalanceDeity Libra-Golem
BS11-X06.kanji: 天秤造神リブラ・ゴレム
BS11-X06.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Crush] (When Attacks)
Discard a number of cards from the opposing decktop equal to this Spirit's LV.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
When any Spirit card is discarded from the opposing deck by this Spirit's [Crush], refresh this Spirit.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
While this Spirit is in refreshed state, the opposing Life can't be reduced.
BS11-X06.flavor:
The weak are assisted and balance of the war situation is maintained. As long as he is in a battlefield, a battle does not finish.
—from the Libra chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BSC49-XV12.name: The BalanceDeity Libra-Golem XV
BSC49-XV12.kanji: 天秤造神リブラ・ゴレムXV
BSC49-XV12.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 5 ([Core][Core][Core][Core])]
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest cost. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Crush] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Discard a number of cards from the opposing decktop equal to this Spirit's LV.

[LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
When Spirit cards/Ultimate cards are discarded from the opposing deck, this Spirit can refresh.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
While this Spirit is in refreshed state, the opposing Life can't be reduced.
BSC49-XV12.flavor:
The Seventh Radiance is the Balance Deity of endless assault.
―"Secret Tales of the Eighty-Eight Constellations"―

BS03-071.name: The BattleBeast Bulltop
BS03-071.flavor: You shouldn't judge people by their appearance. That's what my grandma used to tell me which I think is very true. His submissive attitude is just like a faithful dog and will give you a great help in the upcoming competition meeting as an advanced guard of the north.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8648.name: The BalanceRobo Re-BuLa
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8648.effect: [LV1][LV2] (Your Turn) While [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, every "Galaxian" family Spirit/Ultimate you control gains +3000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8648.flavor:
There are some who say a negotiator must do what the client requested them to, regardless of it being right or wrong. But I am unable to betray my own beliefs!
―"Reborn Star Negotiation Memos" Second Clause 06―

BS19-088.name: The Beast's Ice Cavern
BS19-088.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Neither player's Life can be reduced by the attacks of 4000 BP or less Spirits.

[LV2]
When the opposing Hand increases via an opposing Spirit/Magic effect, for each card increased, you can draw a card.
BS19-088.flavor: The inside of the impassible ice cavern has two possible outcomes: be attacked by beasts, or die of frost. Thus, nobody knows what happens inside to this day.

BS41-052.name: The Balancing Shrewmouse
BS41-052.kanji: バランスのハネジーマウス
BS41-052.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
If you control fewer Spirits than the opponent, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.
BS41-052.flavor:
Trickster, who brought the mouses along with her, remembered the Legendary Savior. The legend was true.
-from the 2nd section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Yellow-

BUN-FFALO2.name: The BattleBeast Bun-Ffalo
BUN-FFALO2.kanji: 戦闘獣バン・ファロー
BUN-FFALO2.flavor: He is a new dark horse in the crushing competition. The favorite Dennis' first time was not that good. So, he might have a chance.

BSC05-015.name: The BeastArmor Megabison
BSC05-015.effect:
[During Brave] [Armor: Red/Green/White]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Green/White Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.
BSC05-015.flavor:
He's charging through like a reckless boar— no! Like a rampaging buffalo! Quick! Get out of the way!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8653.name: The BattleBeast Camerune
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8653.effect: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step) When you control three or less Spirits, this Spirit gets +2000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8653.flavor: He has the power to strongly inspire his allies, but it also comes with deep fury. It'll be troublesome to have it as an enemy, but it is too hard to approach it even if it is made ally.

CB01-054.name: The Baltan Seijin Spaceship
CB01-054.kanji: バルタン星人の宇宙船
CB01-054.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When you would put out Bunshin Spirits, instead of putting cores from the Reserve, you can put a core from the Void to those cards. This effect doest stack.

[LV2]
The LV2 cost of all your "Baltan Seijin"-named Spirits get -1. However, the LV cost can't become 0.
CB01-054.flavor:
The Baltan Aliens put twenty billion and thirty million comrades into a spaceship and flew to Earth.
―Ultraman―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8655.name: The BattleBeast Diatryma
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8655.kanji: 戦闘獣ディアトリマー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8655.flavor:
I could find all kinds of athletes in the queue leading to the stadium. Some were riding a battle beast as if parading, while some others were entering the stadium quietly as if avoiding the spectators. I enjoyed the sight greatly with the curious crowd.
-from the 3rd paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS43-082.name: The BambooShoot's Hidden Village
BS43-082.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Core Step)
By not putting a core from the Void to your Reserve, draw a card. This effect doesn't stack.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When the attack of your "Blade Beast" family Spirit reduces the opposing Life, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
BS43-082.flavor: It was the place where the second generation lord of the great empire from the past chose to retire and live a secluded life with his father. It is said that he had become a lord since very young, reigned for around 30 years, and retired at a rather young age. -from the Places of Interest 688/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8657.name: The BattleBeast Jacker
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8657.effect: [LV1][LV2] (Permanent) Each time a nexus you control would be destroyed, you may move all cores from this spirit to your Trash. In that case, that nexus remains on your Field instead.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8657.flavor:
The name "Battle Bowl" reminded me of a ball game. However, it turned out to be a fierce game in which a group of players kick unconscious opponents into their goal.
-from the 3rd paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8658.name: The BanditChief Higekoga
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8658.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can put a core from the Void to this Spirit. When you've done so, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8658.flavor: It seems that those who destroyed the Green World are aiming at the Shinobi Village next. It would be a big problem if we leave it alone.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8659.name: The BattleBeast Raygallop
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8659.kanji: 戦闘獣ライギャロップ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8659.effect: [LV1][LV2] This Spirit is also treated as Yellow Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8659.flavor:
The Solar Militia and the Lunar Brigade clash head on with each other near the Freezing Lake! Perhaps because they're so close to the main battle, those who crave high positions and glory are after the general's head in an 'every man for himself' free-for-all.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS06-033.name: The Baron Jacobino
BS06-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2] 1 (When Attacks)
When this Spirit is blocked, the opponent exhausts the specified number of Spirits they control.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
The Spirit gains +1000 BP for each "Plant Spirit" family Spirit you control.
BS06-033.flavor: He Blows away anyone who enters his territory. I hope he can do the same to those monstrous dragons.

RHINO-CEROS2.name: The BattleBeast Rhino-Ceros
RHINO-CEROS2.kanji: 戦闘獣ライノ・セーラス
RHINO-CEROS2.effect: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed) Move cards from the top of your opponent's Deck to their Trash equal to the number of cores on this spirit.
RHINO-CEROS2.flavor: The athletes from the South have been having painful lessons due to the lack of teamwork. Will they take their revenge in this year's Battle Bowl?

26RSD06-011.name: The Barrage Forest
26RSD06-011.effect:
[LV1-2] When Deployed
Target an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit. Destroy it.

[LV2] Opposing Attack StepCan't Stack
When an opposing LV1 Spirit would attack, unless the opponent pay one cost, it can't attack.
26RSD06-011.flavor: The threat in this forest isn't limited to the spirits that reside there. Even the plants are dangerous.

BSC50-025.name: The BeastArmor Megabison LT
BSC50-025.effect:
[During Brave] Red/Green/White
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Green/White Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.

[During Brave]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, during this turn, all your Spirit-condition Braves can't be blocked.
BSC50-025.flavor:
He's charging through like a reckless boar— no! Like a rampaging buffalo! Quick! Get out of the way!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS62-064.name: The Barrenrod Runway
BS62-064.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
(Can’t stack) Besides [Soul Core], by sending a core from your Trash to a “Sky Contract” family Spirit you control, during this turn, while your “Scarlet Flame” family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Red-only Spirit attacks, by paying one cost, during this turn, that Spirit gains +3000 BP.
BS62-064.flavor:
This Barrenrod is the military base of us, the Grambalt Airborne Troops. From here, we can fly to everywhere in this world.
―The PartnerWingedDragon Terad―

BS22-062.name: The BeastBomb Manatee-Marauder
BS22-062.kanji: 獣爆マナティ・マローダ
BS22-062.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. When this effect would return a Brave Spirit to the Hand, the Brave can't remain on the Field.
BS22-062.flavor: There is nothing that surpasses its sheer destructive power.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8666.name: The BarrierDancingDragon Natya-Dragon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8666.kanji: 障壁の舞踏龍ナーティヤドラゴン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8666.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, it remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When a Spirit/Ultimate which has attacked this turn is refreshed by an effect, during this turn, both player's Life can only be reduced by one.

[LV2]
Facedown cards on your Removed Zone are unaffected by opposing effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8666.flavor:
It will be very easy to imagine how much Shiva will regret not being able to take part in this battle.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 2:37―

CP14-X08.name: The BeastChild Panzer
CP14-X08.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Add an Ultimate card among them to your Hand. Return the remaining cards to your deckbottom in any order.

[LV1][LV2] Spirit Soul: Blue - When you are summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains an extra Blue Symbol.
CP14-X08.flavor: According to P-Major's calculations, there's a second force wrapped in your vital signature proper. I see, so this is the true form of the Ultimates' curse-seal... we have to analyze this data!

BSC42-069.name: The BattleBeast Rhino-Ceros LT
BSC42-069.kanji: 戦闘獣ライノ・セーラスLT
BSC42-069.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
For each core on this Spirit, discard a card from the opposing decktop.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, you can destroy this Spirit.
BSC42-069.flavor: The athletes from the South have been having painful lessons due to the lack of teamwork. Will they take their revenge in this year's Battle Bowl?

SD02-009.name: The BeastCommander Kuyultha
SD02-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit becomes the target of [Tribute], by returning this Spirit to the Hand, treat as having sent the cores on this Spirit to the designated area.

[LV2]
Give this Spirit and every Spirit with [Tribute] you control the effect: "(When Battles) This Spirit gains +2000 BP."
SD02-009.flavor: Ever heard of a "double-edged sword"? This guy is a living definition of the term as he knows everything about strong weapons. If he gets taken into an enemy camp, things will turn nasty real quick!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8670.name: The BattleBeast Wao
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8670.flavor: As if preparing for emergencies, even the most savage beasts are tamed and trained.

BS27-059.name: The BeastGeneral Cheedas
BS27-059.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or higher Spirits]

[LV3][LV4] (Your Attack Step)
When your Ultimate Trigger is guarded, return a Cost 3 or less Blue Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, give one of your "Next Generation" family Ultimates that would attack next +2 cost.
[utb]
BS27-059.flavor:
We have no time to hesitate. There are only 333 days left until the collapse.
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, 333 days remaining—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8672.name: The BattleBeast Zouuchi
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8672.effect: [LV1][LV2] (Permanent) While you control a "Beast Head" spirit, this spirit is treated as being at LV2.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8672.flavor: As King Randolph has announced, the Battle Olympia will continue whatever obstacles we may face. Today we have the Battle Bowl semifinals!

BS44-046.name: The BeastKingMachine Doldleon
BS44-046.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Heavy Armor: Purple/Green/White]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Green/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your Life is three or less, this Spirit can't be blocked.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
By sending a core from any of your White Grandwalker Nexus to the Void, this Spirit refreshes.
BS44-046.flavor:
An army of machine beasts comes forth from the new continent. The expression of all Spirits on the battlefield is covered with despair.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 1:15―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8674.name: The BattleBird Parakeet
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8674.effect: [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step) Battling "Fighting Spirit" family Spirits you control gain +2000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8674.flavor: First, we send your master, the Summon Bolt-using big boss, to the Reverse Continent. That master of yours will call us over there using the Summon Bolt Booster. After that, since these activities we're doing are secret, we'll have your master be called back by a different Summon Bolt-user over here. I thought of this plan myself, but to tell the truth I don't know how well it'll go... Hey bird, what do you think?

SD02-021.name: The BeastMachine Sai-Drill
SD02-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit becomes the target of [Tribute], return an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit without [Tribute] to the decktop.
SD02-021.flavor: The Invaders' tool of destruction: a vortex enveloping both friend and foe. The ability to create such a deadly tempest is a power most sinister.

SD03-007.name: The BattleDragon Elginius
SD03-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's symbol and color are also treated as Red.
SD03-007.flavor: I can't believe it! It's an upset victory! What an amazing fusion of power and technique! Team "Choose," the favorites to win the championship, have fallen as "Idosuko," the newly-made team from the Southern Lands, advances to the semifinals!!

BS03-030.name: The BeastMaster Rainer Bros.
BS03-030.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
For each Nexus you control, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BS03-030.flavor: I just make friends with them, but my brothers tame them. I'm not saying that I envy him.

BSC49-044.name: The BattleDragon Elginius LT
BSC49-044.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 3 ([Blue Core][Red Core])]
Destroy an opposing Cost 3/4 Spirit, and the effects of the target destroyed by this effect can't activate. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's symbol and color are also treated as Red.
BSC49-044.flavor: I can't believe it! It's an upset victory! What an amazing fusion of power and technique! Team "Choose," the favorites to win the championship, have fallen as "Idosuko," the newly-made team from the Southern Lands, advances to the semifinals!!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8679.name: The BeastPriest Ganes
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8679.effect: [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step) When this Spirit becomes the target of Tribute, put three cores from the Void to one of your Nexuses.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8679.flavor:
The enemy has taken down our ace-in-the-hole. Now it's the Beast Priest's turn to step up. The ritual to summon forth the Master Unicorn has begun...
-from the 12th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8680.name: The BattleDragon Wyvern
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8680.effect:
[LV1] (During Opponent's Battle Phase) This spirit cannot block

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks) This spirit cannot be blocked by LV1 spirits this turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8680.flavor: The latest news report says that someone broke into the North country while they were gone for the competition and destroyed the place.

SD02-011.name: The BeastPrince Bahamunt
SD02-011.effect:
[Tribute: Cost 3 or more → Trash]
After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from a Spirit you control with a designated or higher cost to the targeted area.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Look at the entire opposing Hand, and discard a Magic card among them.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
The opponent can't use Magic effects of the same color as the Magic cards in their Trash.
SD02-011.flavor: The previous champion of the track-and-field tournament is also a member of the Eastern Kingdom's imperial family... Having him lead the East's military force to battle against the Empty Sky Army would be tremendous!

SD16-004.name: The BattleMaul Gordon
SD16-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Crush] (When Attacks)
Discard cards from the opposing decktop equal to this Spirit's level.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit would attack, unless the opponent sends a core from their Reserve to their Trash, it can't attack.
SD16-004.flavor: The giants commenced repair on the collapsed buildings and roads, but taking advantage of this chance, a person coveting the sword appeared in this country as well.

BSCO-023.name: The BeastRuinDragon Bagin-Banka
BSCO-023.kanji: 獣滅龍バギン・バンカ
BSCO-023.effect:
[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]
Destroy two opposing Nexuses, and put a core from the Void to your Reserve. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's. Then, draw a card.

BS30-020.name: The BeastShellMan Maximus
BS30-020.effect:
While you control any Blue Spirit, when summoning this Spirit card from your Hand, treat it as Cost 3.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Shellman"/"Fusion Beast" family Ultimate attacks, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS30-020.flavor: He's too strong!! The defense line is being completely pushed back!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8685.name: The BeastSpear Giga-Galrave
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8685.kanji: 獣槍王ギガ・ガルレイヴ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8685.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void each to every Spirit you control.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8685.flavor: He used to be the guardian deity of the beast spear "Geiborg". However, he is now a tracker.

PX24-01.name: The BeastSpear Giga-Galrave XV
PX24-01.kanji: 獣槍王ギガ・ガルレイヴXV
PX24-01.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Jade Thunder & Three Lives or less, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Nexus. Then, including being in Soul State, if you control any "Belial" Grandwalker Nexus, your counter +1.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit, and when destroys, draw a card.
CB32-004.flavor: A Belial fusion monster that has both features of Red King and Gomora. A monster that boasts its power of being able to destroy anything.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8732.name: The BlackDeathWolf Deathbone-Garm
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8732.kanji: 黒死狼デスボーン・ガルム
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8732.effect:
When your "Worldswalker" family Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand at Cost 4.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each "Worldswalker" family Spirit you control, send one core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8732.flavor:
That person has travelled all over the world, has met with countless spirits, and has profound experience with the world's providence.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 2:04―

CB32-006.name: The BelialFusionMonster Thunder Killer
CB32-006.kanji: ベリアル融合獣サンダーキラー
CB32-006.effect:
The card/Spirit is also treated as "Kaiju".

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, by discarding a Red/Purple card from your Hand, draw two cards. When this effect discards any "Belial", +1 core to a "Belial" Grandwalker Nexus you control.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Kaiju"/"Zetton"/"Belial" attacks, send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve.
CB32-006.flavor:
A Belial fusion monster which consists of characteristics of both Eleking and Ace Killer.
It stores a large amount of electrical energy in its body and excels at discharge attacks.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8734.name: The BlackDragonDeity Geo-Duram
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8734.kanji: 黒龍神ゼオ・デュラム
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8734.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can draw a card for each "Dark Snake" family Spirit you control.

[LV1][LV2]
When you draw, for each card drawn, send a core from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Reserve.

[LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
By discarding three cards from your Hand, this Spirit remains on the Field, in the same condition.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8734.flavor: Even if one gathers all the wisdom of the entire world, they're still not as wise as he is.

CB32-010.name: The BelialGalacticEmpire Darklops Zero
CB32-010.kanji: ベリアル銀河帝国ダークロプスゼロ
CB32-010.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) During your Main Step, if you control any Red/Purple Grandwalker Nexus, you can pay three costs to summon this card from the Trash.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can send two cores from one opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve. Effects of the target depleted by this effect can't activate.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Turn)
Your originally Cost 4 or more "Kaiju"/"Seijin"/"Belial"/"Zetton" effects are treated as colorless.
CB32-010.flavor: The unit created as the prototype of Darklops, the hunter soldiers of the Belial Galactic Empire led by Kaiser Belial.

BSC25-020.name: The BlackDragonRider Darks
BSC25-020.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Discard a card from your Hand. For each cost of the card discarded, send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send three cores from the opposing Reserve to their Trash. When Soul Core is sent to their Trash via this effect, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
BSC25-020.flavor: Thanks to the appearance of the Imajin, collaboration within BSGP teams has become much more important!

CB32-049.name: The Belial Galactic Empire
CB32-049.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Red Core][Purple Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, you can summon a Red/Purple "Kaiju"/"Zetton" from your Hand/Trash. This effect doesn't trigger [Core Charge].

[LV1]
Your "Kaiju"/"Belial"/"Zetton" Spirits can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.
CB32-049.flavor: The empire built by Ultraman Belial who arrived at Another Space after the fight against Ultraman Zero. Its purpose is to conquer the entire space, including the Another Space, and revenge at the Land of Light.

BS03-010.name: The BlackDragon Vritra
BS03-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy every 2000 BP or less Spirit.
BS03-010.flavor: The ancient dragon's territory is in turmoil. A resistance must have awoken from them from their slumber. Even though it's a little far from the front line, this might reverse the situation.

BS74-CP01.name: The BenevolentContractor Houryokuin Kanetsugu
BS74-CP01.kanji: 仁愛の契約神 宝緑院 兼続
BS74-CP01.effect:
[Neo-Core Charge:: (Ninja Gale/Shellman & Cost 3 or more, Soul Burst) (Ninja Gale & Brave)]
◆When your target Spirit/Brave is summoned, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this Nexus is deployed, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Revive] Main - (Once per Turn: Same Name) You can deploy this card from Soul State.

[Contract Field] [LV1][LV2]
Once per turn, when your "Ninja Gale" family Spirit exhausts, by sending one core from this Nexus to your Field/Reserve, your counter +2. Then, (Can't Stack) if it's your Attack Step, you can immediately activate one of this Nexus' [Contract Skill].

2 [LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) Activate one of the Burst effects of one of your "Ninja Gale" family Spirits.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8740.name: The BlackFairy Ti-Tanya
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8740.kanji: 黒の妖精ティ・ターニャ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8740.effect: [LV1][LV2] (Permanent) While you control 3 or more yellow spirits, spell cards in your hand get 1 additional yellow Cost Reduction.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8740.flavor: What happened? The queen looks upset. Something may have happened in the fairy land. Or maybe her kids are going wrong?

BS36-055.name: The BentenPrincess Saraswati
BS36-055.kanji: 弁天姫サラスヴァティー
BS36-055.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Reveal five cards from your decktop. Among them, add two different-named "WisdomKing"-named Spirit cards to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV1][LV2]
All [The ThunderGod WisdomKing] and [The WindGod WisdomKing] in your Hand are treated as Cost 3.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 6/9/12 Spirit.
BS36-055.flavor: Although there are some doubts about resuming the race suspended due to the FiveGoodDragonEmperors' attack, we've been notified that by decree of Lord Daiteiou, the race will continue.

BS67-015.name: The BlackFlyingDragon Phillott
BS67-015.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Spectral Contract & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can send two cores from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When opposing Spirits/Ultimates are depleted/destroyed by your Spirits with "Curse"-named effects, this Spirit refreshes.

BS03-078.name: The Berserker Troll
BS03-078.flavor:
It seems like the construction of the stadium is progressing well. Many experts were summoned from all over to finish it up. Ever since the "Master Unicorn" started the competition, there has been no war... at least that's what they say.
-from the 1st paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS23-032.name: The BlackGoddess Nemhain
BS23-032.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
At the start of the step, by exhausting an "Ice Princess" family Spirit you control, during this turn, all the (Your Attack Step) effects of an opposing Spirit are negated.
BS23-032.flavor: Silver limbs protrude from jet-black garments. The contrasting colors make each stand out even more beautifully.

BS73-047.name: The BerylJewelShieldFairy Morgana
BS73-047.kanji: 緑柱石の宝盾妖精モルガナ
BS73-047.effect:
This card is also treated as a Magic card.

[Flash] (You can't use this effect while it's on Field)
During this turn, an opposing Spirit/Ultimate can't attack/block. After this effect resolves, (Once per Turn: Same Name) you can summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
+1 core to one of your Yellow Grandwalker Nexuses. Then, during this turn, an opposing Spirit/Ultimate can't block.
BS73-047.flavor: "Um, well, I, I'm not very confident in my attacks."

BS19-X07.name: The BlackInsectDemonBlade Usubakagero
BS19-X07.kanji: 黒蟲の妖刀ウスバカゲロウ
BS19-X07.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Brave card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Brave must also be from the Reserve.

[When Braved] (When Battles)
The opponent can't activate their Bursts.

[When Braved] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, send a core from the opposing Life to their Trash.
BS19-X07.flavor: I can instinctively tell from my experience with swords as a blacksmith that you must not carelessly touch this blade.

BS67-017.name: The BewitchingFlowerSerpent Cobuddleja
BS67-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Send cores from every opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve so that one core remains on each of them.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [True-Curse] (Your Turn)
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
BS67-017.flavor:
Good job, Kai-kun~ Although it is now impossible to re-create Lecoulis, if this is the only way then...Alright, it's fine to make up with you.
―Grandwalker Kukulkan―

BS56-TCP02.name: The BlackInsectDemonBlade Usubakagero X
BS56-TCP02.kanji: 黒蟲の妖刀ウスバカゲロウX
BS56-TCP02.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Brave must also be from the Reserve.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't activate Burst effects.

[During Brave] [Rebirth5]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, this Brave can separate and flip.
BS56-TCP02.flavor: The Black Insect Demon Blade that once supported the world. However, its wielder is already gone.

BS60-051.name: The BewitchingPrincess Mizua
BS60-051.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Until your next Start Step, the effects of every opposing Nexus/Grandwalker Nexus can't activate.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
Once per turn, including being pre-advent, you can activate the "revealing cards from deck" effect of your "The PartnerBird Feaniel", ignoring the (Once per turn: Same Name).

[LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
You can return this Spirit to the Hand.
BS60-051.flavor: "I ain't afraid of nothing! That short boy there, bow to me as well please."

BS56-TCP02-A8750.name: The BlackInsectDemonBlade Usubakagero X -Rebirth Incarnate-
BS56-TCP02-A8750.kanji: 黒蟲の妖刀ウスバカゲロウX -転醒化身-
BS56-TCP02-A8750.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] 4 (When Reborn)
Heavy exhaust four opposing Spirits/Ultimates.
[heb]

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When the blocking Spirit/Ultimate is depleted/destroyed, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BS56-TCP02-A8750.flavor: Now that its wielder is lost, it incarnates into a new form, and wanders around, searching for its next prey.

BS30-056.name: The BigAstralAxe Aldebaran
BS30-056.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy a Brave on an opposing Brave Spirit.

[When Braved] (When this Ultimate Brave Attacks)
When this Ultimate's Ultimate-Trigger is guarded, destroy an opposing 20000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.
BS30-056.flavor: Let's test which is stronger: our swords, or the enemy's Braves!

BS42-034.name: The BlackKingBeast Koku-Garou
BS42-034.effect:
[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]
2 Heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates.
[heb]
After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Blade Beast" family Spirit attacks, unless the opponent heavy exhausts a Spirit they control, they can't block.
BS42-034.flavor: You want the KingBeast Tribe to fight along the Noble Order right? Alright. I don't think there will be objections!...Though, we are often said to be following the orders without giving it second thoughts.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8753.name: The BlackNinthBeast BloodySaber
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8753.kanji: 黒壬獣ブラッディセイバー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8753.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy two opposing 6000 BP or less Spirits. For each Spirit destroyed by this effect, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8753.flavor: The cool sharp glint in the eyes of the "Speed Tiger" members, as if they're hunting down their prey, shows the zeal they've put into the race, and is really cool!

BS72-010.name: The BigAxeMartialArtist Chimeras
BS72-010.kanji: 大斧の武芸者キマイラス
BS72-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can destroy every opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. If you control any "Contractor Lugh", this effect can't be prevented by "Armor"-named effects.

[During Brave] [LV2] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing non-braved Spirit/Ultimate. When blocked by that target, this Spirit gains +15000 BP.
BS72-010.flavor:
I wish we could meet a Spirit that we couldn't hunt.
―Grandwalker Lugh―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8755.name: The BlackNinthDragon Obsidian-Dragon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8755.kanji: 黒壬龍オブシディアン・ドラゴン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8755.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
For each "God-King" family Spirit you control, send a core from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Trash.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate. This Spirit gains all the symbols of the Spirit/Ultimate destroyed by this effect.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8755.flavor: "Amethyst, you're the one who will become the Dragon Twelve God-King. His Spellbind is dispelled. Show your true power!"

BS74-052.name: The BlackOnyxFairy Blakyx
BS74-052.kanji: 黒瑪瑙の妖精ブラキス
BS74-052.effect:
This card is also treated as a Magic card.

[Flash] (You can't use this effect while it's on Field)
If you control any "Contractor Morrigan", reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Prismwing"/"Celtica" family card to the Hand. Discard any remaining card. After this effect resolves, (Once per Turn: Same Name) you can summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Turn)
While you control any "Contractor Morrigan", the opponent can't end Turn/Attack Step via effects.
BS74-052.flavor:
Be it Olym, Amahara, or Vulrica, I shall crush them all!
―Grandwalker Morrigan―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8757.name: The BigBirdman Bearded
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8757.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Assault: 1] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't use Magic cards with the same cost as your exhausted Nexuses.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8757.flavor: There are certainly some people who can't agree with the sudden ceasefire. If they want to go wild that much, why not let it out through sports?

BS67-010.name: The BlackRobeKnight Zahak
BS67-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can discard three cards from your decktop. After this effect resolves, you can return a "Spectral Contract"/"Engage" family card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] [True-Curse] (Your Turn)
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2] (Opposing Turn)
All your [True-Curse] also activate at (Opposing Turn).
BS67-010.flavor: "Hope that the lance skills I taught you would be useful. Good luck, Bat, my dear friend!"

BS18-026.name: The BigChief Jamuqa
BS18-026.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your "Great General" family Spirit, refresh it.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, for each "Great Generall" family Spirit you control, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS18-026.flavor: Wind Shield is tranquil. I have my former subordinates leave me alone here. My homeland, my own territory, former enemy country x2, the large debt... I have too deep a connection to the other lands.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8760.name: The BlackSuperstarApostle Blackwurm
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8760.kanji: 黒き超星使徒ブラックヴルム
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8760.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent]
If this Burst was activated when a "Superstar" family Spirit was depleted/destroyed, send two cores from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Trash, and when depletes, draw two cards. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by sending a core from any opposing Spirit to the Trash, refresh this Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8760.flavor:
I'm still such a greenhorn. My initial investigation was too lacking... But I won't hesitate anymore! Master Lilia, let's salve the universe together!
―"Reborn Star Negotiation Memos" Third Clause 05―

BS74-011.name: The BigLavaStar Megalord
BS74-011.effect:
While there is any [Soul Core] on your "Contractor Ometeotl", this card becomes Cost 4.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Then, if there is any [Soul Core] on your "Contractor Ometeotl", you can draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step)
Besides [Soul Core], send up to five cores from your Trash to any "Lava Fish" family Spirits/ Ultimates/ Nexuses.
BS74-011.flavor:
Only one may advance to the final stage.
―Contractor Kaiー

BS22-006.name: The BlackSwordDragon Rexsbeat-Saura
BS22-006.kanji: 黒剣竜レックスビート・ザウラー
BS22-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with [Charge].

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
Draw a card.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: Exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS22-006.flavor: Evil spirits began to appear around the devastated locales. But it's all right, the prophet predicted that a saviour would come.

SD26-012.name: The Big Flagship Dragnic
SD26-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Draw Step)
You draw +1 card.
SD26-012.flavor: We were lent a vehicle for our sojourn into the past. Knowing Ozzania, I had imagined dragons and technology as direct opposites, but I was surprised to receive a splendid battleship.

BS40-022.name: The BlackSwordOgre Dearcain
BS40-022.effect:
This set Burst is unaffected by opposing "Can't activate Burst" effects.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can't be exhausted by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By destroying an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate, refresh this Spirit.
BS40-022.flavor: So it was you guys!! You're the ones who incited the Terra Dragons!!

SD01-027.name: The Big Lavafalls
SD01-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Every attacking Spirit you control gains +1000 BP.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your Spirits with [Awaken]/[Clash], draw a card.
SD01-027.flavor:
During the first war between the dinosaurs and dragons, the dragons conducted an experiment here and changed the landscape to the current state. It is surprising that this place used to be a volcano.
-from the Places of Interest 103/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS21-X03.name: The BlackTreeDeity Kuwaga-Labuna
BS21-X03.kanji: 黒樹神クワガ・ラブナ
BS21-X03.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
The opposing Burst can't activate.
[Rush: Red/Blue]
(While you have Red/Blue symbols, the following effects activate next)
[Red Core]: Draw a card.
[Blue Core]: Up to once per turn, by exhausting a Nexus you control, refresh this Spirit.
BS21-X03.flavor: Its two horns, thick as trees, cut through any phenomena and matter.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8767.name: The BlackWind Panther
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8767.effect: [LV2] (When Attacks) This spirit gets +1000BP for each core in your Reserve until end of turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8767.flavor: Do you know an animal that is good at both running and climbing trees? Since the Elders have become more serious, they have been fighting as warriors.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8768.name: The Big Tree of Ryuketsu
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8768.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step) All your battling Spirits gain +2000 BP.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step) When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your "Parasite" family Spirits, send a core from the opposing Life to the Reserve. This effect doesn't stack.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8768.flavor: A big tree exists on the border between the Countries of Willow and Dark Green. Many species live under this tree and have established a mutualistic relationship with it.

BSC05-013.name: The BlackWingDragon Burn-Crow
BSC05-013.kanji: 黒翼竜バーン・クロウ
BSC05-013.effect:
[When Braved] (When Battles)
When this Spirit is destroyed by opposing Spirit via BP comparison, send an opposing Life to their Reserve. Then, the Brave of this Brave Spirit remains on the Field, and only the Spirit returns to the Hand.
BSC05-013.flavor:
Having finished resting his wings, the ominous raven soars, leading the misguided straight to Hell.
—from the Corvus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS20-051.name: The BillowSwordsman Akashi
BS20-051.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit.

[When Braved] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Blue Spirit attacks, destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.
BS20-051.flavor: His swordplay is as ever-changing as water. As if wielding two weapons, whether he comes from the front or from the skies, there's nowhere to hide.

BSC50-021.name: The BlackWingDragon Burn-Crow LT
BSC50-021.kanji: 黒翼竜バーン・クロウLT
BSC50-021.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Astral Deity" family Spirits are destroyed, by paying one cost to summon this card from the Hand in Spirit-condition, one of those targets remains on the Field, exhausted. When you've done so, you can brave this Brave to that target.

[During Brave] (Either Attack Step)
When this Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, you can send an opposing Life to the Reserve. Then, you can return this Spirit to the Hand.
BSC50-021.flavor:
Having finished resting his wings, the ominous raven soars, leading the misguided straight to Hell.
—from the Corvus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BSC26-X03.name: The BioKaiju Biollante
BSC26-X03.kanji: バイオ怪獣ビオランテ
BSC26-X03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Cores on both players' Spirits/Ultimates can't be removed.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. If the Spirit exhausted by this effect has two or less cores on it, refresh this Spirit.
BSC26-X03.flavor:
Biollante, evolved from a giant blooming Rose form into a Final form closer to Godzilla.
―Godzilla vs Biollante (1989)―

BS69-027.name: The BraveBeastMarquis Lycaon
BS69-027.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Green Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, when cards are put onto the opposing Removed Zone, you can refresh a Green Cost 5 or more "Blade Beast" family Spirit you control.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can send an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the Removed Zone. When you've done so, put a core from the Void onto this Spirit, or +1 core to a Green-only Grandwalker Nexus you control.
BS69-027.flavor:
Tens of thousands of Gaia's demon beasts approached Hermes' world, Hercadia. And Hermes asked Ares to come to his rescue.
―Theogonic Record Volume 2―

CB28-020.name: The BioKaiju Biollante (Plant Beast Form)
CB28-020.kanji: バイオ怪獣ビオランテ（植獣形態）
CB28-020.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as "Godzilla".

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Godzilla" is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects, and can't move cores from their Grandwalker Nexuses.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Your counters +2, and put two cores from the Void to any of your Spirits. Then, if you have six counters or more, heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits.
CB28-020.flavor: A BioKaiju created by Dr. Shiragami, an authority on genetic engineering. It has multiple tentacles, and has a head similar to Godzilla.

BS26-053.name: The BirdAstralArmored Shisobird
BS26-053.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy two opposing 4000 BP or less Spirits. By exhausting one of your Spirits, also, destroy an opposing Nexus.

[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
You can change the target of this Spirit's "BP Destruction effects" from Spirits to Ultimates.
BS26-053.flavor: It's got enough destructive force as to alter the terrain... you've got to be kidding me...

SD02-018.name: The BraveColonel Dragron
SD02-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit becomes the target of [Tribute], destroy two opposing 4000 BP or less Spirits without [Tribute].
SD02-018.flavor: Going as far as self-sacrifice to make a name for himself in battle, he's like an impatient moron with whom you could strike a bad bargain with.

BS20-X03.name: The BirdBushin Shishigui
BS20-X03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step) When your "Winged Beast" family Spirit attacks, exhaust an opposing Spirit with BP equal or inferior to the attacking Spirit.

[LV2]LV3] (Your Attack Step) For each "Winged Beast" family Spirit you control, all your Green Spirits gain +1000 BP.

[LV3] (Your End Step) Refresh all your "Winged Beast" family Spirits.
BS20-X03.flavor: With one word of authority from him, the "Willow Rebellion" began.

BS08-005.name: The BraveGeneral Catapuldos
BS08-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Vanity Deity"/"Deified General" family Spirit card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2][LV3] [Clash] (When Attacks)
The opponent must block with their Spirits if possible. However, Ultimates don't have to block.
BS08-005.flavor: We're losing our advantage in numbers... All of us, Dinosaurs and Dragons included, are in a tight pinch...!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8779.name: The BirdGiant Jatayu
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8779.effect:
Flash- [Accel: Cost 5 ([Blue Core][Blue Core][Yellow Core])]
Destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
For each Spirit card with [Accel] in your Removed Zone, destroy an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8779.flavor: Racer Dos-Deimos wasn't able to match up to this time's favored racer Vishuten, but was able to hold back "Felarl Racing"'s new star to reach 9th place.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8780.name: The BraveGeneral Crateros
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8780.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this Spirit card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Assault: 1 - (When Attacks) This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8780.flavor: I hear the great king has many skilled generals serving under him. Among them, Sir Crateros is called a "friend of the king".

CYC-BROS3.name: The BlacksmithKing Cyc-Bros
CYC-BROS3.kanji: 鍛冶王サイク・ブロス
CYC-BROS3.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Crush (When Attacks) Discard a number of cards from the opposing decktop equal to this Spirit's LV.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks) For each card discarded by this Spirit's Crush effect, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
CYC-BROS3.flavor: The Blacksmith King, whose brute strength and reputation far outclass those of his automated warriors, sallies forth! After suffering defeat in the first round of the Automaton Contest, his battling prowess is only paralleled by his sheer determination to adapt and learn from his mistakes.

BS18-048.name: The BraveGeneral Leonidas
BS18-048.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Neither player can increase Hand via Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV1][LV2]
For each Nexus you control, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
BS18-048.flavor: A whole year after the war ended, we finally captured the last remnants of Zeyon's Sect. No one would have imagined it would take this long. From brute generals to astute tacticians, it's solid proof that Zeyon had men of talent among his subordinates.

BS67-056.name: The BlueDragonArmorGiant BlueDrago
BS67-056.kanji: 青竜鎧の巨人ブルドラゴ
BS67-056.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Wave Contract & C5 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] [Crush] (When Attacks)
Discard a number of cards equal to this Spirit's level from opposing decktop.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] [Great Crush] (When Attacks)
For each LV this Spirit has, discard five cards from the opposing decktop, and when any card with Burst effects is discarded, destroy an opposing Spirit.

BS27-039.name: The BraveGuardian Ou-Ryute
BS27-039.kanji: 勇神将オウ・リュート
BS27-039.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning a "Vanity Deity" family Ultimate card from your Hand, treat it as Cost 5.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
Your Life can't be reduced by the attacks of opposing LV1 Spirits. While you control any Ultimate, also, your Life can't be reduced by the attacks of opposing LV3 Ultimates.
BS27-039.flavor: The odds have improved so much since the appearance of the Vanity Deities, they've become better than even... we'll be in trouble if the Vanity Deities are defeated.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8785.name: The Blacksmith Beta
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8785.effect: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step) When you summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave by paying its cost, you can deploy a Nexus card from your Hand, without paying the cost. This effect can only be used once per turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8785.flavor: The person who understands this journey the best, yet is the least agreeable. As we are both in the same line of business, she has her own claims that she will not concede.

BS05-053.name: The BlueDragonRider Azure
BS05-053.kanji: 蒼海の竜使いアズール
BS05-053.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit becomes the target of [Tribute], by exhausting this Spirit, treat all cores on this Spirit as being sent to the designated place.

[LV2]
Give this Spirit and every "Dragon Emperor"/"Vanity Deity" family Spirit you control the effect: "(When Battles) Discard five cards from the opposing decktop."
BS05-053.flavor: I see the someone in the back of the dragon. I think he just saw me. Oh, he turned around and is now approaching me!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8787.name: The BraveShineAngelia Creshiel
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8787.kanji: 勇輝天使クレシェール
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8787.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -4000 BP. Destroy any Spirit whose BP is brought to 0 by this effect. When any Spirit is destroyed via this effect, and you control any "Birthgem Deity" family Spirit, you can draw two cards.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8787.flavor: Even with the power of the November Moon Princess, we still can't take back Yellow Siegfried...

BS07-021.name: The BladeBraver Volza
BS07-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Neither player's Life can be reduced by the attacks of Cost 2 or less Spirits.

[LV2] (When Battles)
When only the opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, refresh this Spirit.
BS07-021.flavor: He has awakened from a 500-year sleep... He looks like an old man at first glance.

BS44-069.name: The BladeWolfArmor Belio-Wulf
BS44-069.kanji: 刃狼鎧ベリオ・ウルフ
BS44-069.effect:
[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Besides [Soul Core], neither player can remove cores from the battling Spirits/Ultimates. Also, when only the opposing Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by comparing BP, send two opposing Lives to their Reserve.
BS44-069.flavor: The oldtype brave that was used when Egyt invaded. It is said that the Wolf which it was modeled after participated in the battle between the Sun and the Moon.

BS42-050.name: The BraveShineAngelia Jiniel
BS42-050.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Divine Spirit"/"Birthgem Deity" family Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. If any "Birthgem Deity" family Spirit card is added to the Hand via this effect, draw a card.
BS42-050.flavor: The Blue Pirate crews, then the Purple Lorekeepers, and also you Angelias. I would sincerely hope that you can help us on our mission.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8791.name: The BirdMan Hawkeye
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8791.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (During Your Battle Phase) Each time this spirit deals any damage to your opponent's life, move the top 5 cards of your opponent's Deck to their Trash.

[LV2] (When Attacks) If you control a purple nexus, this spirit cannot be blocked this turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8791.flavor: There is a rumor that some of the athletes are gathering information of other athletes as spies.

BSC20-X03.name: The BlueFlamesWisdomKing Agnius
BSC20-X03.effect:
After the opposing Burst activates, you can summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2]
Your Bursts can also activate at: [Burst: con] (After your Life is reduced) / [Burst: con] (After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent).

[LV2] (When Attacks)
If [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's.
BSC20-X03.flavor: "If one knows there is something more important than oneself, there is no need to hesitate in battle."

BS42-005.name: The BraveShineBeast Climbing-Margay
BS42-005.kanji: 勇輝獣クライミング・マーゲイ
BS42-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can reveal a card from your decktop. If it is a Red card, add it to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the decktop.

[LV2]
While you control any "Birthgem Deity" family Spirit, when the opposing Life is reduced, draw a card.
BS42-005.flavor: Isn't the January Primary God rather active? Really hope that our Pyroxene hero can learn from that.

BSC45-038.name: The BladeBraver Volza LT
BSC45-038.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The cores on your "Braver" Spirits can't be moved by opposing Purple effects.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Braver" Spirit attacks/blocks, you can put a core from the Void to that target.
BSC45-038.flavor: He has awakened from a 500-year sleep... He looks like an old man at first glance.

BS41-028.name: The BraveShineBird KasumiRaicho
BS41-028.kanji: 勇輝鳥カスミライチョウ
BS41-028.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
While your "Birthgem Deity"/"Shinekind" family Spirits are battling, the opponent can't activate Bursts.
BS41-028.flavor:
The ones who hid Alex and escorts from the watchful eyes of the Ogre Wizards were the birds similarly fleeing the purple world. They chose days when the miasma was thin and flew at high altitudes to bring Alex's group to the OctoberKnightLord.
-from the 2nd section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Purple-

BS30-003.name: The BladeBristleDragon Yutyrannus
BS30-003.kanji: 刃毛竜ユーティラヌス

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

BS30-003.flavor: Numbers make right in times like these. We're overwhelming the enemy. All that's left is a race with time!

BS36-XX02.name: The BlueOriginDragon Pangaea
BS36-XX02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Your Nexuses are unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)

[During Seal] [LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects.
BS36-XX02.flavor: Blue filled the world with the sea. The sea fostered life, but at times, stole it.

BS07-008.name: The BladeDinosaur Bragasaur
BS07-008.kanji: 重刀竜ブレイガザウラー
BS07-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each "Soldier" family Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Give all "Terra Dragon" family Spirits you control the "Soldier" family.
BS07-008.flavor: Ever heard the saying: "There are no weak soldiers in a brave general's command"? If you're in his battalion, then surely your true strength must be beyond commendable.

26RBS02-004.name: The BirdTrio Sparrows
26RBS02-004.effect:
[LV1-2] When Summoned
If you control any exhausted Red Spirit, target a Cost 6 or more "Windfang" family Spirit card in your Trash. Return it to the Hand.
26RBS02-004.flavor:
"We are the Sparrows!"
"This dagger spares no one!"
"If you don't back off, you'll perish in the air!"

BS40-057.name: The BlueSearcher Kevin
BS40-057.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add every card with [Advent] to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When you would [Advent], this Spirit can become Cost 5.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When you would [Advent], this Spirit can become Cost 6.
BS40-057.flavor: One of my escorts is a lancer. He looks kind, but is quite the opposite. He once nonchalantly told me that his favorite thing is seeing others anguished...

BS42-010.name: The BraveShineCannonbull Melt Buffalo
BS42-010.kanji: 勇輝砲牛メルトバッファロー
BS42-010.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 5 ([Red Core][Red Core][Red Core][White Core])]
Destroy two opposing 5000 BP or less Spirits. Or, return an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
If you control any "Birthgem Deity" family Spirit, at the end of battle, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
BS42-010.flavor: With 2 bulls at his two sides, the January Primal God arrived in a fierce and wild manner. The Pyroxene Gem wouldn't break, I suppose...

BS03-008.name: The BladeDragon Stegorasaurus
BS03-008.kanji: 剣竜ステゴラーサウルス
BS03-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit is blocked by a Spirit with the same LV, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.
BS03-008.flavor: The attack of dragons was a failure and repelled by a gigantic shield.

BS15-X03.name: The BirdWarEmperor Suzacross-Soso
BS15-X03.kanji: 鳥武帝スザクロス・ソウソー
BS15-X03.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Battles)
The opponent can't activate their Bursts.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
For each Green Spirit you control, all your "Gaudy Trooper" family Spirits gain +1000 BP.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit becomes exhausted, this Spirit refreshes.
BS15-X03.flavor: Proud king who has chosen to be not a hero but an emperor, why do you obstruct our path!

BS25-025.name: The BladeEmperorInsect GrandeKuwaga
BS25-025.kanji: 剣皇蟲グランディクワガー
BS25-025.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP
[Rush: Red/Yellow]
(While you have Red/Yellow symbols, the following effects activate next)
[Red Core]: Destroy an opposing Nexus.
[Yellow Core]: This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing LV1 Spirits.
BS25-025.flavor: Isn't being so fast despite being so big a little unfair!?

BSC48-CX03.name: The BlueSeasContractor Gunjou Souun
BSC48-CX03.kanji: 蒼海の契約神 群青 早雲
BSC48-CX03.effect:

◆When your target Spirit/Nexus is summoned/deployed, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this Nexus is deployed, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Contract Field] [LV1] (After Your Burst Activates)
Once per turn, you can set a Burst card from your Hand.

[Contract Field] [LV1] (Your Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name, four or more cores on this Nexus) When your "LotusMonarch"/"WisdomKing" with [Soul Core] on it attacks, you can send 1-2 cores from this Nexus to that target. When you've done so, you can destroy every opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest cost.

LM19-03.name: The BladeKingBeastClaws Byak-Gaclaw
LM19-03.kanji: 剣王獣爪ビャクガ・クロー
LM19-03.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks)
Exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates. When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, return two opposing exhausted Spirits/Ultimates to the Hand.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By exhausting an opposing Grandwalker Nexus, put a core from the Void to this Green-only Nexus.

P14-37.name: The BlueSeasSwordMaster Mermarian
P14-37.kanji: 碧海の剣聖マーマリアン
P14-37.effect:
[When Braved] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
Draw two cards. Then, discard a card from your Hand.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
P14-37.flavor: It's a fantastic sword, but just using it to dissect fish... that's a waste.

BS07-X26.name: The BladeKingBeast Byak-Garo
BS07-X26.kanji: 剣王獣ビャク・ガロウ
BS07-X26.effect:
[LV1][LV2] 2 (When Attacks)
When this Spirit is blocked, the opponent exhausts two Spirits they control.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, by sending a core from your Reserve to your Trash, return two opposing Spirits without [Tribute] to the Hand.
BS07-X26.flavor: The eldest son has finally returned from harsh musha training! After 988 battles, he's maintained a record of no losses and only one draw...! Man, this guy's strong!

BS31-064.name: The BlueSeas Douji
BS31-064.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Crush] (When Attacks)
Discard a number of cards from the opposing decktop equal to this Spirit's Lv.
BS31-064.flavor: Gandala is constructed with the Fighting Spirits at its heart, and its doors are open to everyone.

BS27-018.name: The Bird of WesterlyWinds Zephalcon
BS27-018.kanji: 西風の鳥ゼーファルコン
BS27-018.effect:
High Speed (Flash) This Spirit card in your hand can be summoned during the flash timing by paying the cost and putting cores on it from your Reserve.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) When summoned during (Either Attack Step), you can look at the contents of the top card of the opposing deck.
BS27-018.flavor:
Hints to the answers we searched for were found in the forbidden writings and in the knowledge of a youth of the snake tribe.
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, 302 days remaining—

BS13-043.name: The Birdman Ikarosh
BS13-043.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When either player's Cost 3 or less Spirit would attack, unless the owner sends a core from their Reserve to their Trash, it can't attack.
BS13-043.flavor:
Together with the similarly injured winged ones, I reached the bone-shaped island. I wonder if it was coincidence that the gate to the next world was there, or whether it was inevitable.
-from the 14th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BSC45-XV03.name: The BladeKingBeast Byak-Garo XV
BSC45-XV03.kanji: 剣王獣ビャク・ガロウXV
BSC45-XV03.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 7 ([Green Core][Green Core][Core][Core])]
Send two opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Removed Zone. After this effect resolves, return up to one card from the opposing Removed Zone to the deckbottom. Also, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] [F Wind: 2] (Your Attack Step)
Unless the opponent exhausts two non-blocking Spirits they control, they can't block.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates/Nexuses, and put two cores from the Void to your Spirits.
BSC45-XV03.flavor:
Huh, undefeated in 988 fights and a draw in one fight against the Hero Beasts...That's something.
―Grandwalker Hermes―

P17-22.name: The BraveShineDiva Lemuriel
P17-22.kanji: 勇輝の歌姫レムリエル
P17-22.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Diva"/"Divine Spirit" family Spirit is destroyed, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3]
The number of cores on this Spirit can't be brought to two or less due to opposing effects.
P17-22.flavor: The angels were searching for ideas. What is the weakness of "Alice" that is the key of the Wonder Kingdom?

BSC48-024.name: The BlueSeas Douji LT
BSC48-024.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Gunjou Souun", and a "LotusMonarch"/"WisdomKing"/"Douji", or Blue Soul Burst card, besides any "The BlueSeas Douji", to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Crush] (When Attacks)
Discard a number of cards from the opposing decktop equal to this Spirit's Lv.
BSC48-024.flavor: TGandala is constructed with the Fighting Spirits at its heart, and its doors are open to everyone.

BS52-025.name: The BladeWolfKingBeast Gowlseed
BS52-025.kanji: 剣狼王獣ガウルシード
BS52-025.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2] (When Reborn)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit, and this Spirit refreshes.

[LV2]
While your Green "Primal" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.
BS52-025.flavor: "Vina, who's that? Is she related to those brutes wreaking havoc on the forest? If she's not, she's welcome here. You need the Fruit of Life? Eat as much as you want!"

BS12-061.name: The Birthplace of the Sword
BS12-061.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When you would [Tribute], by exhausting this Nexus, treat all the cores on a Cost 3 "Astral Soul" family Spirit you control are sent to the specified area.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
When Braves are summoned, you draw a card.
BS12-061.flavor:
There is said to be a legendary sword of unknown make and material that can withstand heat of any degree without melting. Collectors expect that the great war will be an impetus for it to appear in this world once again.
—from the Fornax chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS31-070.name: The BlueSeas WisdomKing
BS31-070.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Discard seven cards from the opposing decktop.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When cards are discarded from the opposing deck by this Spirit's effect, by sending [Soul Core] from this Spirit to the Trash, discard seven cards, but up to as many as possible, from the opposing decktop.
BS31-070.flavor:
One swing of his sword can blow away a mountain -- and he has four swords!
―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―

26RBS02-047.name: The BladeLeg Glassraner
26RBS02-047.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2] When Blocks
You can target an opposing 8000 BP or less Spirit. Return it to the Hand.

[LV2] Your End Step
You can target a Spirit you control. Refresh it.
26RBS02-047.flavor: If you find yourself gazing at those legs, your head and torso will end up separated.

BSC48-X06.name: The BlueSeas WisdomKing X
BSC48-X06.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "LotusMonarch"/"WisdomKing" is attacking, your set Soul Burst is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Discard seven cards from the opposing decktop.

[LV2] [True Catalyze] (When Attacks)
If [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, you can immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts. After that Burst activates, by sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, discard seven cards, but up to as many as possible, from the opposing decktop.
BSC48-X06.flavor:
One swing of his sword can blow away a mountain -- and he has four swords!
―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―

BSC05-014.name: The BladeWolf Beo-Wulf
BSC05-014.effect:
[When Braved] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, send two opposing Lives to their Reserve.
BSC05-014.flavor:
The wolf's own instinct spurs him on to battle.
—from the Lupus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS70-026.name: The BladeTiger Byakrode
BS70-026.effect:
When this card is put onto your Removed Zone via your effect, +1 core to one of your "Contractor Dan" Grandwalker Nexuses.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Gekiha" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.
BS70-026.flavor: One who inherited Byak-Garo's bloodline, but was still in his mischievous years.

BSC50-023.name: The BladeWolf Beo-Wulf LT
BSC50-023.effect:
[During Brave] (When Attacks)
When the opposing Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed via comparing BP, send two opposing Lives to the Reserve.

P17-23.flavor: Two Pirate gangs have sworn loyal to Alex. Apart from them, there are five other big Pirate gangs. And they have also moved. The time of being a spectator has ended.

BS40-027.name: The BraveShineSage Old Woodbacker
BS40-027.kanji: 勇輝の賢者オールドウッドバッカー
BS40-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void each to this Spirit and another "Shinekind" family Spirit you control.

[LV2][LV3]
While you control any "PyroxeneTwelveGem"-named Spirit, this Spirit gains +5000 BP.
BS40-027.flavor: The Red World couldn't rein in its denizens and entered a state of war. The Green World is facing a completely different issue. Shall I call it nature running wild? What's with this jungle and violent rainstorms!?

BSC42-078.name: The Blessed Sanctuary LT
BSC42-078.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Yellow Spirits are destroyed, for each of those Spirits, you can put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Yellow Spirits are destroyed, for each of those Spirits, you can draw a card.
BSC42-078.flavor:
A small church that has a look of a fairyland. So many people are on the waiting line to have a wedding at this church.
-from the Places of Interest 711/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS40-035.name: The BraveShine Clearnodon
BS40-035.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, and can block while exhausted.

[LV2] (When Blocks)
If you control any "PyroxeneTwelveGem"-named Spirit, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.
BS40-035.flavor: The White World seriously freaked me out. The atmosphere is nothing but heavy. I'm not talking about the social atmosphere here, see? It's physically heavy. Without a machine body, it takes a lot of effort just to move.

26RBS03-054.name: The BlindOgre Madoc
26RBS03-054.effect:
[LV1-2] When Summoned
Besides this Spirit, target one of your Spirits. During this turn, it can't be blocked by opposing 8000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2] True ReleaseDuring Attack
When blocked, target an opposing blocking Spirit. During this turn, give it -2000 BP. Then, if it has 0 BP, destroy it.
26RBS03-054.flavor: "Where everything is, who has done what... I can hear it all."

BS40-025.name: The BraveShine Duckweetyplus
BS40-025.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
If you control any "PyroxeneTwelveGem"-named Spirit, return this Spirit to the Hand.
BS40-025.flavor:
After passing through the Red World's Gate, they arrived in the Green World. They would realize something crucial there.
-from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Green-

BS31-042.name: The Blizzard Gozen
BS31-042.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn)
When the opposing Hand is increased due to an opposing effect, for each card increased, the opponent discards a card from their Hand.
BS31-042.flavor:
There was a Clever Machine called the "White Demon" in the Clever Machine Army whose ability was comparable to that of a fierce god. They say even soldiers of the same model were afraid of him.
―from the Soldier's Biography of "Sengoku Obscurities" by Kuroe―

BS40-003.name: The BraveShine Heathorn Dragon
BS40-003.kanji: 勇輝ヒートホーンドラゴン
BS40-003.effect:
When your "PyroxeneTwelveGem"-named Spirit is summoned, you can return this Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.
BS40-003.flavor: The Red World is only bounded by itself, and even the Winged Dragons cannot cross to the neighboring worlds.

BS68-021.name: The BloodAllianceThirteenMarquess Alvanshell
BS68-021.kanji: 血盟十三候アルヴァンシェル
BS68-021.effect:
Flash - (Your Attack Step)
(Once per Turn : Same Name) Including being in Soul State, if you control any Spirit with [True-Curse], by discarding this card from your Hand, discard up to three cards from your decktop.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Send three cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve.
BS68-021.flavor:
"Huh, so you're saying that you wanna quit being a member of the honorable Blood Alliance Thirteen Marquess? Poor you, Bat."
I...I only joined because I went with the flow anyway. And I didn't really attend the meetings too...No? It doesn't work?...I guess.
―The PartnerKnight Bat―

BS41-065.name: The BraveShine HeavyArmored Footsoldier
BS41-065.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
For each "Birthgem Deity"/"Shinekind" family Spirit you control, ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.
BS41-065.flavor:
It happened right after arrived at the Blue world. A group of Purple beings rose in front of Alex and co. Before they could identified who the they were, something extremely frightening had occurred. The surrounding islands were blown away and completely destroyed, along with the Spirits on them.
-from the 2nd section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Blue-

BS60-020.name: The BloodAllianceThirteenMarquess Fallenhyde

Increase the LV costs of every opposing Nexus by +1.

BS41-015.name: The BraveShine Hell Sorcerer
BS41-015.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
For each "Birthgem Deity"/"Shinekind" family Spirit you control, destroy an opposing braved Brave.
BS41-015.flavor:
In the miasma-shrouded Purple World, those who consume it strengthened their control and tried to expel all others. Alex and the escorts were no exception in their act to remove all outsiders.
-from the 2nd section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Purple-

BSC25-013.name: The BoneKeeper Escuda
BSC25-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your "BoneKeeper"-named Spirits are destroyed by opposing effects, they remain on the Field, exhausted.
BSC25-013.flavor: The BSGP committee has pronounced that summoning Imajin does not break the rules of the BSGP.

BS41-014.name: The BraveShine Rhinoedge Snake
BS41-014.kanji: 勇輝ライノエッジスネーク
BS41-014.effect:

BS41-014.flavor: There were six companions in Savior Lolo's journey. By gathering the relics of them all.... That's what will become the key to reviving Lolo, right? I'm glad we met. Your leader told me everything.

BSC25-014.name: The BoneKeeper Lancea
BSC25-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to their Reserve. If there is [Soul Core] (Soul Core) on this Spirit, also, you can summon a [The BoneKeeper Escuda] from your Trash, without paying the cost.
BSC25-014.flavor: It's essential for BSGP teams to make it into the top ten.

BS41-030.name: The BraveShine Tobikamikiri
BS41-030.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
