BS41-030.flavor: You weren't obeying the Ogre Wizards? If they find out you betrayed them, you might face an even worse fate... Thank you. I won't ever forget your help.

26RBS03-022.name: The BoneSprite Pisketona
26RBS03-022.effect:
When summoning this card, if all cards in your Trash are Purple, for each core in the opposing Reserve, you can fulfill one of its reduction symbols.

26RBS03-022.flavor: The Phantasprite, whose wings had been scorched and who had fallen to the ground, was awakening to a new power in the darkness.

BS19-082.name: The Bone Forest of Wandering Souls
BS19-082.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Spirits are destroyed, draw a card.

Your "Zombie" family Spirits can't be exhausted by opposing effects.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8884.name: The BraveWarHorse Pedasos-Z

Zeus and Lolo never separated. Olym and Uru became one, and his idea was for it to become the center of a new interdimensional world order.
―"The Genesis Records" New Volume 1:01

BS66-016.flavor: "The school is kinda quiet these days huh...Could that girl complete her mission?...I wonder. It's gonna be fun."

BS08-045.name: The Braver Phoenixpentan

[LV2]Your Attack Step

BS67-012.name: The BloodAllianceThirteenMarquess Strello
BS67-012.kanji: 血盟十三候ストレッロ
BS67-012.effect:

BS67-012.flavor: Bat has found a lance sticking out from the small floating island amid the Crystal Lake. Pulling out the lance that no one could have pulled before him, Bat grows bigger and changes his form. He changes into a form that embodies both light and darkness, the two elements that Bat's heart holds.

SD66-CP01.name: The BreakthroughBlade Battle-Saver
SD66-CP01.kanji: 突破刀バトル・セイヴァー

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8891.name: The BreatherSoundBeast Pigrest
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8891.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put one core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8891.flavor:
Having succeeded at splitting Zeus and Lolo, I let out a sigh of relief. That was a mistake. A voice yelling "Watch out!" and a shockwave hit me at the same time.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 4:23―

BS62-022.name: The BloodAllianceThirteenMarquess Vlad-Bat
BS62-022.kanji: 血盟十三候ヴラド・バット
BS62-022.effect:

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Send two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve.

BS12-063.name: The Brigade's Skyscraper
BS12-063.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
Draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)

The setting for the final decisive battle is a skyscraper veiled in darkness that the Lunar Brigade now occupies. Immediately after the fight began, the Solar Militia continued their steady advance, but the Lunar Brigade made the most of their geographical advantage and launched a fierce counter-assault. At that moment, the skies split into two contrasting sides of light and darkness! It seems the end has begun at last...
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS61-018.name: The BloodAllianceThirteenMarquess Weinrich
BS61-018.kanji: 血盟十三候ヴァインリヒ

BS61-018.flavor:
"The bottom seat of us, the Blood Alliance, has fallen off the grid. Trace him. This is an order."
Could it possibly be talking about Mr. Fallenhyde that we know of?
―The PartnerKnight Bat―

The setting for the final decisive battle is a skyscraper veiled in darkness that the Lunar Brigade now occupies. Immediately after the fight began, the Solar Militia continued their steady advance, but the Lunar Brigade made the most of their geographical advantage and launched a fierce counter-assault. At that moment, the skies split into two contrasting sides of light and darkness! It seems the end has begun at last...
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS65-018.name: The BloodAllianceThirteenMarquess Zantoinette
BS65-018.kanji: 血盟十三候ザントワネット

CB18-020.name: The BrutalSpaceKaiju Mother Kelbim［Ultra Kaiju 2020］
CB18-020.kanji: 宇宙凶険怪獣マザーケルビム［ウルトラ怪獣2020］

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
You can use the [Accel] of your "The BrutalSpaceKaiju Kelbim［Ultra Kajiu 2020］" from your Hand, without paying the cost.
CB18-020.flavor: Sensing the "D4" energy, it hid itself in the space debris outside the atmosphere. It bombarded the Earth with its offspring in egg forms and emitted gravitational waves to facilitate incubation.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8900.name: The BloodLinkSword Blood-Lady
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8900.kanji: 連血剣ブラッド・レディ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8900.effect:
[+1]

Discard two cards from your decktop, and draw two cards.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8900.flavor: Siegrune is the head of the Revelin family that funds the Bal-Masques. It is said that in order to keep her beauty, she would turn into a sword, and bath in blood.

26RSD03-011.name: The Bubble Cluster Realm

[LV2] Start of Your Main Step
If you control two or more exhausted "Armored Fish" family Spirits, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

SD55-010.name: The Bookshelf Canyon Where Sage Lives
SD55-010.effect:
[LV1] [Rebirth3]

BS03-093.name: The BuffaloMan Bulltania
BS03-093.flavor: He scored a point by an amazing rush! Will there be a big upset this time, in the Battle Bowl!?

BS64-066.name: The BloodOgreBlade Chishibuki

BS23-069.name: The Bug-Inviting Bewitching Flower Tower

BS55-004.name: The BoxingKing Dragno IronFist Daz-Bats
BS55-004.kanji: ドラグノ拳闘王 鉄拳のダズ・バッツ
BS55-004.effect:
[+1]

BS32-050.name: The Bull HermitPriest
BS32-050.flavor:
The "Master" expected a showdown with the Supreme Beast Army, and made preparations for it here and there. It would appear he had also calculated that Gandala would not make their move.
―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―

BS63-CP04.kanji: 灼熱神龍ゴッド・グロウ
BS63-CP04.effect:
Flash - [Ultra Contract Advent: "The PartnerDragon Glow" & C6 or more, (Your Turn)]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By stacking this card from your Hand onto its target, including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition, send your [Soul Core] to this Spirit.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit gains every effect of a "Glow-Kaiser" pre-advent card beneath this Spirit, ignoring levels.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing 30000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Then, you can add a Cost 8 or less "Flame Contract" family card from your Hand to beneath this Spirit as a pre-advent card. When you've done so, destroy every opposing Grandwalker Nexus.

BS06-056.name: The CatKnight Cait-Sith
BS06-056.kanji: 細剣の猫騎士ケット・シー
BS06-056.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
The cost of all "Vanity Deity" family Spirit cards in your Hand becomes 6.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Turn)
When the opponent uses any Magic effect that includes your Cost 2 Spirits as target, you can change the target of that Magic effect to only this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit gains +1000 BP for each Cost 2 Spirit you control.
BS06-056.flavor: This is nonsense!! We can't let them have their way anymore!

BS62-010.name: The BurningFlameDragonMachine Glow-Striker
BS62-010.kanji: 灼炎龍機グロウ・ストライカー
BS62-010.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Flame Contract/Machine Dragon & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. For each counter you have, increase the limit of this “BP Destruction effect” by +2000.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, when your “Machine Dragon” family effect destroys opposing Spirits/Ultimates, this Spirit can refresh.

BS61-005.name: The BurningFlameDragon Rise-Glow
BS61-005.kanji: 灼炎竜ライズ・グロウ
BS61-005.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Flame Contract/Winged Dragon & C1 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, by destroying an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit, draw a card.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by adding a “Scarlet Flame” family Spirit card from your Hand to underneath this Spirit as pre-advent card, this Spirit refreshes.

BSC45-066.name: The CatKnight Cait-Sith LT
BSC45-066.kanji: 細剣の猫騎士ケット・シーLT
BSC45-066.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
The cost of all your "Vanity Deity" family cards becomes 6.

[LV2][LV3]
For each of your Cost 2 Spirits and each of your "Vanity Deity"/"Deified General" family Spirits, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
BSC45-066.flavor: This is nonsense!! We can't let them have their way anymore!

BS66-X01.name: The BurningSwordEmperor Sword-Glow
BS66-X01.kanji: 灼熱剣皇ソード・グロウ
BS66-X01.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Heat Contract & C6 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit can brave with up to three Braves. Also, when your Brave Spirit attacks, for each Brave on that Spirit, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a number of symbols equal or inferior to this Spirit's. Also, during this turn, the cores to be sent from the opposing Life to their Reserve by your Spirit effects are sent to the Trash instead.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8965.name: The CatLady Abyssinia
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8965.flavor: She is certainly a resident of the East Country, but she seems quite informed about this area. I wonder where she is taking us.

BS34-065.name: The Burning Bonnouji Temple
BS34-065.kanji: 燃える梵能寺テンプル
BS34-065.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Turn)
When you Spirit activates [Catalyze], after the Burst activates, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand. Also, if the Burst activated was a White card, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

[LV2]
When the opposing Hand increases via an opposing Spirit/Magic effect, for each card increased, you can draw a card.
BS34-065.flavor:
The Battle of Senkigahara came to a close with a victory for the GenjiEightKnights faction.
―from the Battle of Senkigahara Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BS06-073.name: The Burning Canyon
BS06-073.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Draw Step)
Increase the amount of cards you draw by +1. After you draw, discard a card from your Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Every Spirit you control gains +1000 BP.
BS06-073.flavor:
This canyon was newly created when a deity descended from the Empty Sky. As it is a totally new landscape, you might be able to make new discoveries.
-from the Places of Interest 513/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

P15-20.name: The Catalyst Mejishi
P15-20.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Give all your "Ninja Gale" family Spirits: "[Catl: Green] (When Attacks) By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Green Soul Bursts".

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can send [Soul Core](Soul Core) from your Reserve to any of your Spirit.
P15-20.flavor: Generals from every province fought in the Battle of Senkigahara. It was a fitting cast for the act that would close the curtains on the Great Sengoku Era.

BS52-060.name: The Burning Duelist Dragno
BS52-060.kanji: 燃え盛るドラグノ決闘者
BS52-060.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your Red "Primal" family Spirits gain +5000 BP.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, besides an on-Field effect, you can negate an opposing active White Magic/[Accel] effect.
BS52-060.flavor:
Right after she showed a reaction, I felt the presence of an aggressive Spirit. This doesn't look good, we don't have time to prepare for anything!
―"Record of Wordly Matters" Volume 1:09―

BSC30-001.name: The CatalyzeMusha Hokushin
BSC30-001.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Red & Cost 2 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Tw Catl: Red] (When Advents)
Immediately activate one of your Red Soul Bursts. After the Burst activates, you can set a card with Burst effects from your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.
BSC30-001.flavor: The loss was quite a shock. However, it doesn't mean that we have lost everything. There is also gain. And it is that the War Dragons, who just wait and see what would happen at a side till now, are finally on the move.

SD26-011.name: The Burning Sacred Place of Dragons
SD26-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Ryuuman"-named Spirits/Ultimates are destroyed by opposing effects, they can remain on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your Red Spirits/Ultimates gain +3000 BP.
SD26-011.flavor:
This is not a record, this is a memory. There's no way I could forget it -- the falling figures of the Tri-Dragon Deities. The scene of the canyon set ablaze in the aftermath of their disappearance.
—Red Plains Site No. 999 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

BS24-086.name: The Burnt Out Battlefield
BS24-086.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When your Ultimate is summoned, draw a card. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced, for each core on this Nexus, destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.
BS24-086.flavor:
The finest Dragon warriors entered to suppress the Ultimates. The battle was so fierce as to burn the entire battlefield to nothing.
—Red Plains Site No. 574 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

BS38-005.name: The CatalyzeMusketeer Higan
BS38-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When the Burst effects activated via your [Catalyze] would target opposing Spirits, opposing Ultimates can be targeted as well.

[LV2][LV3] [Catl: Red/White/Blue] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Red/White/Blue Soul Bursts.
BS38-005.flavor: If Vandeel isn't stopped, the Evil God Army's reinforcements will keep coming with no end. Dragon with the giant gun over there, please do something about him!!

BS11-008.name: The BurstDragon Dragonicbeard
BS11-008.kanji: 爆竜ドラゴニックベアード
BS11-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
If both players control Spirits with 10000 BP or more, destroy every 10000 BP or more Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] [Clash] (When Attacks)
The opponent must block if possible.
BS11-008.flavor:
The Empty Sky Deity was destroyed, ambushed by the Ancient Dragons. But it was still too late...
-from the 1st paragraph of the final chapter of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8975.name: The CatmanSwashbuckler Birman
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8975.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Assault: 2 - (When Attacks) This spirit can, twice per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

[LV2] (When Attacks) This Spirit gets BP+ (Total BP of all your exhausted Ultimates).
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8975.flavor:
The council is absolutely essential. Whether they'll understand that is the question.
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, 399 Days Remaining—

BS25-007.name: The BurstFireElephant Maximus
BS25-007.effect: While you control any Red Ultimate, this Spirit card in Hand becomes Cost 3.
BS25-007.flavor: There's something that I've been constantly wondering about... That continent is gradually approaching here... Never mind, dealing with the Ultimates comes first for now.

BS40-010.name: The CavalierEvilDragon Va-Dwo
BS40-010.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy three opposing 10000 BP or less Spirits/Ultimates. If your Life is at three or less, also, summon up to two Red Cost 6 or less Spirit cards from your Hand, without paying the cost. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, all your Red Cost 5 or more Spirits gain an extra Red symbol.
BS40-010.flavor: In the world, there is a source of power called the "Original Pyroxene". It is protected by the chosen heroes and their descendants.

BS13-024.name: The BushinBeast Deerl-Yukimura
BS13-024.kanji: 武神獣ディアル・ユキムラ
BS13-024.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
For each "Imp" family Spirit you control, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
By exhausting an "Imp" family Spirit you control, this Spirit gains + (the exhausted Spirit's BP) BP.

[LV2]
Besides [The BushinBeast Deerl-Yukimura], when your Spirits are refreshed, this Spirit refreshes.
BS13-024.flavor:
"Ye creator of the world, Mother Core, pray grant the wish of I, Lilia..."
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BSC05-006.name: The BushinBeast Tigerd-Shingen
BSC05-006.kanji: 武神獣タイガード・シンゲン
BSC05-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Neither player can remove cores from the battling Spirits.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When the opposing Life is reduced, besides [The BushinBeast Tigerd-Shingen], refresh a Spirit you control.
BSC05-006.flavor:
Out of the corner of my sight, I saw the tiger general fighting a harsh battle. He was just too strong; I fled to keep my distance from him. I didn't know when I was safe, but my legs twisted and buckled from exhaustion. My traveling companion also looked close to his limit.
-from the 10th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

P25-02.name: The CavalierLanceMartialArtist Skeldon
P25-02.kanji: 騎槍の武芸者スケルドン
P25-02.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Lugh" & C1 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
For each Saga Brave you control, increase the limit of your "Martial"/"Celtica" family "BP Destruction Effects" by +3000.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.
P25-02.flavor:
Dan, that big Primordial Deities Spirit looks formidable. It looks like we can have some fun. So here's a suggestion. I want to fight together with your partners!
―Grandwalker Lugh―

BS11-024.name: The BushinBird Birdy-Kenshin
BS11-024.kanji: 武神鳥バーディ・ケンシン
BS11-024.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Winged Beast" family Spirits gain +3000 BP.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Refresh two of your Spirits with [High Speed].
BS11-024.flavor:
The faint mist surrounding the forest completely cleared, at the same time as I put the fruit in my mouth. That seems to have been the sign of the final battle. Truly the last.
-from the 9th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS14-049.name: The Butler Pentan
BS14-049.effect:
When this Spirit card is discarded by an opposing "deck discarding effect", during this turn, cards can't be discarded from your deck, and you can summon this Spirit card, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Pentan"-named Spirits are destroyed, draw a card.
BS14-049.flavor: It seems that in the past, Light Shield was split into seven countries. Even now, there are regions where traces of them remain.

SD24-004.name: The CavalryGeneral Philotas
SD24-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Assault: 1] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit with [Assault] is blocked by opposing Ultimates, that Spirit gains +10000 BP.
SD24-004.flavor: We headed to the talks together with his equestrian platoon...Ozzania, you really can't ride a giant-sized horse.

BS56-010.name: The ButterflyDragon Farfalla
BS56-010.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
If you have a Red/White Mirage set, you can summon this card from your Hand as Cost 4 ([Red Core][Red Core]).

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Machine Dragon" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.
BS56-010.flavor:
Behind the battlefield, far from everything else, was a man in green...that's the Time-alterer!! Alex, why are we drawing near such fellow?!
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5:40―

BSC47-005.name: The CavalryIceAngelia Ifessa
BSC47-005.kanji: 騎兵の氷天使イルフェッサ
BSC47-005.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([White Core][White Core])]
[During Set]
Once per turn, when your "Ice Princess" family Spirit is refreshed via your effect, you can summon an "Ice Princess" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, by returning an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the Hand, refresh this Spirit.
BSC47-005.flavor:
Chronos' arch enemy...The goddess who governs time and darkness, death and destruction, Kali...Well then, it is decided that Grandwalker Parvati will be the last one.
―Divine World Log XXX―

BS23-X03.name: The ButterflyEmpress Grace-Papillon
BS23-X03.kanji: 蝶の女皇帝グレイス・パピヨン
BS23-X03.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Summon any number of Cost 8/9 Spirit cards from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirits can't activate.
[Rush: Red/White]
(While you have Red/White symbols, the following effects activate next)
[Red Core]: Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.
[White Core]: For each Cost 8/9 Spirit you control, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.
BS23-X03.flavor: Having woken from a long and dark slumber, her form is magnificent and captivating.

BS67-022.name: The ButterflyPrincess Papilio
BS67-022.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Jade Thunder" family card is summoned/deployed, you can put this card from the Hand onto the Removed Zone. When you've done so, during this turn, when your Spirit attacks, you can put a core from the Void to any of your "Jade Thunder" family Spirit.

Flash - (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this card from the Removed Zone.
BS67-022.flavor:
Ah, so Toa and Kai are actually one Oracle Spirit~? ―The Flower Partner, Frau―
Nonononono...I've never heard about such thing! And what, Lo-lo-lo-lo-lovers?? Why it gotta be Lovers? Impossible...That guy and me are Lovers...the Oracle Spirit?? No way!

BS67-X02.name: The CavalryLanceEmperor Calibure-Bat
BS67-X02.kanji: 騎槍皇キャリバーレ・バット
BS67-X02.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Spectral Contract & C6 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can send up to 13 cores from the opposing Reserve to their Trash. You can summon any number of "Blood Crystal" family Spirit cards from your Hand/Trash without paying the cost up to the number of cores you sent via this effect. (Max. 6)

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
The opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects. Also, when your Spirits with [True-Curse] would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

BS22-053.name: The CalamityGeneral Nagurias
BS22-053.flavor:
"The three-headed dragon and the giant of light that protect the Empire... They are only legend."
The Sea Empire was not unaffected by the decreasing ocean water levels caused by the Great Abnormality. And the Sea Empire's general told us of a certain legend.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8990.name: The CelestialPriestessPrincess Trickster
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8990.kanji: 天の巫女姫トリックスター
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8990.effect:
This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Red/Purple/Green/White/Blue.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add one non-"Uru" family Grandwalker Nexus card, and every Saga Brave card to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order. Opposing Bursts can't activate via this effect.

[LV2]
Opposing Spirits/Ultimates can't be refreshed via effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8990.flavor:
"Haha, hello there, long time no see Alex. Welcome to Amahara!
It's not gonna fly, is it? Sorry for acting on my own. But... you're not the only one who wants to save Lolo."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8991.name: The Caldron of Destroy and Create
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8991.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed) Destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step) Treat all your Blue Spirits with 4 or more cores on them as having 2 Blue symbols.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8991.flavor:
After Zeyon's death, his conspirators were all arrested. In a public display, they were sentenced to execution in a boiling cauldron.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 648—

BS26-X07.name: The CancerAstralArmored BraveCancer
BS26-X07.kanji: 巨蟹星鎧ブレイヴキャンサー
BS26-X07.effect:
[During Brave] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't block unless they block with two Spirits or two Ultimates. When this Spirit is blocked, choose one to battle against.
BS26-X07.flavor: It Brave Fused and now has four arms!? It's an abomination!!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8994.name: The CancerBushin Cancerd
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8994.kanji: 巨蟹武神キャンサード
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8994.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Galaxian"/"Astral Soul" family Spirit attacks, the opponent can only block if they block with two Spirits, or one Ultimate. When that Spirit you control is blocked, choose one of the two to battle against.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
While you control any Brave Spirit, when this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8994.flavor:
For those who battle him, there is no "second time."
—from the Cancer chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BSC49-XV05.name: The CancerBushin Cancerd XV
BSC49-XV05.kanji: 巨蟹武神キャンサードXV
BSC49-XV05.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this card is discarded from your Hand via a Green-only effect, you can use the following Accel, without paying the cost.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 6 ([Green Core][Green Core][Core])]
During this turn, when the attack of your Cost 5 or more Spirit reduces the opposing Life, send an opposing Life to the Reserve. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your Spirits are attacking, the opponent can only block if they block with two Spirits, and you battle against only one of them. Also, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.
BSC49-XV05.flavor:
The Fourth Radiance is a battle-hardened, peerless warrior god with two pincers.
―"Secret Tales of the Eighty-Eight Constellations"―

PX15-03.name: The CancerNinja Cancerd
PX15-03.kanji: 巨蟹忍者 喜屋武鎖亜怒
PX15-03.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When this Spirit, or your Spirit with [Soul Core] on it attacks, the opponent can only block if they block with two Spirits or two Ultimates. When that Spirit is blocked, choose one of them to battle against.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.
PX15-03.flavor:
He crosses over
Tempestuous fields and plains
Walking the green path
To enter the shade of trees
And listen to insects cry

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8997.name: The CancerSacredSword Kanikiri
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8997.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks)
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Also, once per turn, if you control any Green-only Grandwalker Nexus, this Spirit refreshes.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field]
Your Green Spirits are unaffected by opposing Purple Spirit/Ultimate effects.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8998.name: The CancerTank Cancer-Chariot
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8998.kanji: 巨蟹戦車キャンサー・チャリオット
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8998.effect:
This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Red/Purple/White/Yellow/Blue.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can put a core from the Void to this Spirit. If there is any “Galaxian” family card on your Removed Zone, instead, you can put two cores from the Void to any "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" & “Galaxian” family Spirits you control.

[LV2] [Astmu: 1] (When Attacks)
You can put a card from your decktop to the Remozed Zone. When this effect puts any "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" & “Galaxian” family card, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8998.flavor: Taking on Cancer of the stars, the chariot strides forth.

BS19-084.name: The Candle Tower of Life
BS19-084.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Spirits with [Rush] are destroyed by opposing effects, discard a random card from the opposing Hand.

[LV2] (Opposing Main Step)
When cards would be discarded from your deck due to the opponent, unless the opponent sends ten cores from their Reserve to their Trash, cards can't be discarded from your deck.
BS19-084.flavor: The light of candlestick was extinguished from time to time, but nobody tried to rekindle it.

BS18-069.name: The Candy Residence
BS18-069.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, once per turn, you can summon a "Grimm"-named Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Divine Spirit" family Spirit is exhausted, draw a card.
BS18-069.flavor:
Begging with all his might, the troubled emperor of a troubled kingdom had the empress built this house. It smells so good.
-from the Places of Interest 575/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS28-044.name: The CannonAngelia Kanon
BS28-044.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
If your Life is three or less, during this turn, give every opposing Spirit/Ultimate -10000 BP. Destroy all opposing Spirits/Ultimates that are brought to 0 BP by this effect. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card.

[LV2][LV3]
When opposing Spirits/Ultimates are brought to 0 BP, destroy all those Spirits/Ultimates.
BS28-044.flavor: I dislike that there are so many Spirits in the Yellow Region who are inconsistent with the data. Like Asia or this Angelia... I don't know why her nickname is "Reset".

BS19-074.name: The CannonBeast Aquidry
BS19-074.effect:
[During Brave] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced, this Spirit refreshes.
BS19-074.flavor: The search for the thief who stole the sword is still continuing. The daytime search has been entrusted to those that know no fatigue.

BS56-055.name: The ChrownosSeniorTrooper High-ChronoTrooper
BS56-055.kanji: 時冠上級兵ハイ・クロノトルーパー
BS56-055.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, by paying one cost, it remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2]
Cards in either player's Trash are unaffected by non-"Chrownos" family effects, and can't activate their effects.
BS56-055.flavor:
The Purple Oracle Spirit is still missing. And that's not the only problem. Since the SpacePirates were criminals, so obviously they were to be cracked down. However, they weren't Time-alterers. The one Mandi is after is another spirit. We would have to look for the one, not the SpacePirates, who is truly aiming at the Oracle Spirits.

Tycoon's one-night castle is famed, but in truth his castle was not constructed so quickly. Rather, the castle suddenly appeared.
―from the Soldier's Biography of "Sengoku Obscurities" by Kuroe―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9049.name: The CherubAngelia Jophiel
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9049.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This refreshed Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
All your "Divine Spirit" family Spirits gain +3000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When you would [Advent], put a core from the Void to your Life.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9049.flavor: A companion, huh? Even if it's someone from really long ago, could they still be somewhere today? I felt it was incredible information, but it didn't really lead to anything in the end, did it...

BS35-043.name: The CleverMachineGeneral Daigongen
BS35-043.kanji: 機巧将軍ダイゴンゲン
BS35-043.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed by the opponent]
If the Spirit destroyed when this Burst activates was a White Spirit, return three opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Hand. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (Opposing End Step)
If your life wasn't reduced this turn, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits, and draw a card.
BS35-043.flavor: "After that country-splitting great decisive war, peace reigned over my province! I'll leave the rest to my machine successors and fulfill my one and only lament!"

BS25-014.name: The ChevalLancer Eligale
BS25-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw a card. If you control any Ultimate, also, destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.
BS25-014.flavor: Euro-chan found out that among those cooperating with the Ultimates, there are some not acting of their own volition, but have been cursed to serve them against their will.

BS07-033.name: The ChiefLibrarian Saga
BS07-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When your Life would be reduced by an opposing Spirit's attack, you can discard a card from your decktop. If that's a White Magic card, your Life won't be reduced.

[LV2][LV3]
When cards are discarded from your deck via this Spirit's effect, if it's a Magic card, add it to the Hand.
BS07-033.flavor: The Fountain of Wisdom—the Invaders have both suffered from and been guided by this invaluable resource.

BS34-009.name: The ChiefRetainer Ryuuzen
BS34-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon as many Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue "Lord" family Spirit cards, up to one of each, from your Hand without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Lord" family Spirit attacks, for each symbol color on your "Lord"/"Vassal" family Spirits, destroy an opposing 20000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate, and draw a card.
BS34-009.flavor: "A SengokuSixGeneral, hm... good grief, this will take some effort."

BS03-111.name: The Child's Room in Midnight
BS03-111.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Spirit with no printed effects is destroyed by an opposing LV1 Spirit via BP comparison, it returns to your Field, exhausted.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Spirit with no printed effects is destroyed by an opposing LV3 Spirit via BP comparison, it returns to your Field, exhausted.
BS03-111.flavor:
In the palace of the land of trump, pretending to be toys is considered to be the way to show their highest appreciation to the guests. All of a sudden, they start moving around at midnight.
-from the Places of Interest 171/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS62-054.name: The ChildOfGrandsea Dolph
BS62-054.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
All your “The PartnerShark Shack” are also treated as “GrandseaPirate”.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Discard two cards from the opposing decktop. Also, this Spirit's symbol is fixed as 0.
BS62-054.flavor: Beings that are called the Grandsea Pirates exist in the legends of Mu the Grandsea Empire. It is said that those pirates have reached their hands to even the sea of stars. No one in Mu doesn't know about that fairy tale. However, Dolph believes that those are real. He does have the memory of being a greenhorn captain. Shark slowly listens to his story without laughing at him or teasing him.

BS63-058.name: The ChildOfStars Starry
BS63-058.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can reveal a card from the opposing decktop. If that card's cost is an odd number, this Spirit can remain on the Field, refreshed. If it's an even number, you can return this Spirit to the Hand. Return the revealed card to the deckbottom.
BS63-058.flavor:
The battle to decide Lecoulis's future. The big final gamble. Let's finish it loud and sound! Did you sneer at me just now?! You would be in big, big trouble, I promise!
―The PartnerBird Feaniel―

BS05-048.name: The ChimeraDinosaur Dinozaur
BS05-048.kanji: 合成恐竜ディノゾール
BS05-048.effect:
[LV2]
Change the [Awaken] effect of your Spirits to: "[Awaken] During Flash Timing, you can send any number of cores from your Spirits or your Reserve to this Spirit."
BS05-048.flavor:
Having finished their matches, the powerful golems and giants quickly wiped out those who had destroyed the palace of the North country.
-from the 7th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wander Lolo"-

BS04-074.name: The ChimeraDragon Hydrus
BS04-074.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Either player can only use Magic effects once per turn.

[LV2][LV3]
Unless the opponent pay the cost, they can't use Magic effects.
BS04-074.flavor: Absolutely nothing remains of the palace. A dragon invaded the North country from the air and literally obliterated the palace.

BS08-054.name: The ChimeraSacredBeast Cthulhum
BS08-054.effect:
[Tribute: Cost 3 or more → Trash]
After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from one of your Cost 3 or more Spirits to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy all Spirits without [Tribute].
BS08-054.flavor: It seems that in the Southern Kingdom, there are great powerful heroes that did not make an appearance in the latest tournament; even the Single-Horned Sovereign can't help but take at least a glance!

BSC45-083.name: The ChimeraSacredBeast Cthulhum LT
BSC45-083.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Blue & Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Advents)
Besides this Spirit, destroy every Spirit/Ultimate without [Tribute].
BSC45-083.flavor: It seems that in the Southern Kingdom, there are great powerful heroes that did not make an appearance in the latest tournament; even the Single-Horned Sovereign can't help but take at least a glance!

BS41-XX02.name: The ClownDeity Dvergr
BS41-XX02.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
While the opposing Hand is five or more, the opponent can't add cards to their Hand from Deck/revealed cards/Trash .

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing End Step)
If the opposing Hand is four or more, and your Life isn't reduced this turn, the opponent discards a card from their Hand.

[LV2]
This Spirit can't attack, and is unaffected by opposing effects.
BS41-XX02.flavor: He chants the song of revival. The way isn't pointed at return, but only to bring forth light to this world. And a new power, shall be the guide.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9062.name: The ChivalrousRobber Mercurio
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9062.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw a card. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) was used to pay the summon cost, instead, return an "Imagine" family Brave card from your Trash to the Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9062.flavor: "I got the info about the Imajin. I couldn't let them monopolize something this useful."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9063.name: The ClownDeity Gingar
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9063.effect:
When this pre-Advent card is discarded by the effect of a Blue Spirit [During Advent] over this card, this card can be treated as two cards.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy all opposing Cost 7 or less Spirits/Ultimates. For each Spirit/Ultimate destroyed by this effect, discard two cards from the opposing decktop.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9063.flavor: Ooooh, that's a good question! A nice one from the new narrator, you just keep them coming! If I were to verbalize it, I'd say that "Lolo is the world, and the world is Lolo"!

BS06-022.name: The ChopSword Shadowslicer
BS06-022.kanji: 斬首刀のシャドウスライサー
BS06-022.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The cost of all "Vanity Deity" family Spirit cards in your Hand becomes 6.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Return a "Zombie" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2]
For each "Zombie" family Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
BS06-022.flavor:
The snakes called them the Empty Sky and said that they were the enemy of all existence.
-from the 10th paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS42-XX01.name: The ClownDeity Lady-Frankelly
BS42-XX01.kanji: 道化神レディ・フランケリー
BS42-XX01.effect:
You can also use this card's [Accel] from the Trash.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 3 ([Purple Core][Purple Core])]
Send a core from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Reserve. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2]
Give all your Purple Spirit cards without [Accel] in your Hand this Spirit's [Accel].
BS42-XX01.flavor: Lolo is always there next to us. His body makes the land, his thoughts are the stars that make the constellations. But what about his soul? Please help find his soul, as early as possible!

BSC45-022.name: The ChopSword Shadowslicer LT
BSC45-022.kanji: 斬首刀のシャドウスライサーLT
BSC45-022.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
All your "Vanity Deity" family cards become Cost 6.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Return a "Vanity Deity"/"Deified General"/"Zombie" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2]
For each "Vanity Deity"/"Deified General"/"Zombie" family Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.
BSC45-022.flavor:
The snakes called them the Empty Sky and said that they were the enemy of all existence.
-from the 10th paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS41-XX01.name: The ClownDeity Melt
BS41-XX01.effect:
When the opponent summons any Brave, you can summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Brave, and draw cards until your Hand becomes four.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By destroying an opposing braved Imagine Brave, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
BS41-XX01.flavor: Revive him? That's an interesting suggestion. If it's possible, I also want to see him again. Though I can pick up on his voice, it feels sad that I can't see him.

BS43-071.name: The ChosenSearcher Alex
BS43-071.kanji: 選ばれし探索者アレックス
BS43-071.effect:
This set card/card in Trash is unaffected by any effects.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, either draw a card, or put a core from the Void to your Reserve. When this battle ends, end the Attack Step.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Red/Purple/Green/Yellow/Blue.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9069.name: The ClownDeity Polluc&Castar
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9069.kanji: 道化神ポルック＆カスター
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9069.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
By discarding your entire Hand (at least one card), draw a card for each card in the opposing Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Turn)
(Can't Stack) When cores are added from the Void via your Green effect, after that effect resolves, you can activate that effect once and only once again.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9069.flavor: Lolo? It'd be good to meet him again. It has been so fun together! Though, is it really ok to revive him?

BSC35-A017.name: The Christmas Axe
BSC35-A017.effect:
[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can reveal a card from your decktop. If that card is Cost 5 or less, this Spirit gains +3000 BP. If it is Cost 6 or more, send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to any "Idol" family Spirit you control. Add the revealed card to your Hand.
BSC35-A017.flavor: The axe Ichigo used to cut down a tree in Angely Mountain when she decided to get a huge Christmas tree to cheer up her upset classmates on Starlight Academy's Christmas Party.

BS43-XX01.name: The ClownDeity Trickster
BS43-XX01.kanji: 道化神トリックスター
BS43-XX01.effect:
This Spirit card in Trash is unaffected by any effect.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Banish all cards in your Hand/Removed Zone. Then, draw four cards. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Spirits would compare BP, by discarding a card from your Hand, end the battle without comparing BP.
BS43-XX01.flavor: It's okay. If it's you, it would be possible to call forth Lolo. Please tell him this for me when you meet him: Welcome back.

BS56-056.name: The ChrownosMachineEmperor Kaiser-Chrono-Golem
BS56-056.kanji: 時冠機帝カイザー・クロノ・ゴレム
BS56-056.effect:
[Brave Symbol +1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn/Attacks)
Once per turn, draw two cards, then discard two cards from your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Steep)
Once per turn, when any "Chrownos" family card is discarded from your Hand, you can refresh a "Chrownos" family Spirit you control.
BS56-056.flavor: "SWITCHING TO ANNIHILATION MODE. TRANSFORMATION PROCESS, BEGINS. REINFORCEMENT PARTS, TOUCH-DOWN. DOCKING SEQUENCE BEGINS: 3...2...1...TRANSFORMATION COMPLETE."

BS47-016.name: The ClownDoll †Diki-Diki†
BS47-016.kanji: 道化ドール†ディキ・ディキ†
BS47-016.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
You can draw a card. Or, for each "Doll"-named Spirit you control, you can send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.
BS47-016.flavor: "Let's start the show! Go on, laugh! Hey... Laugh... Come on, why won't you laugh?!" The doll created just to make Hera laugh continues honing her skills today. What can she do to make Hera laugh? That's the only thing she doesn't know.

BS56-056-A9074.name: The ChrownosMachineSoldier Chrono-Golem
BS56-056-A9074.kanji: 時冠機兵クロノ・ゴレム
BS56-056-A9074.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing "Primal" family Spirits.

[LV2][LV3] [Rebirth3]
When your Life or the opposing Life is reduced, you can flip this Spirit.
BS56-056-A9074.flavor: "UNIT: Lombardia...DESTRUCTION CONFIRMED. ANNIHILATION OF VANGUARD TEAM, SIMULTANEOUSLY CONFIRMED. NOW PROCEED TO TIME TAMPERING. NOW PROCEED TO TIME TAMPERING..."

BS52-005.name: The ClownDragon Archeorni Dragon
BS52-005.kanji: 道化竜アーケオルニドラゴン
BS52-005.effect:
When cores are placed via an opposing "Unleash"-named effect, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand. When you've done so, send all those cores to the Void.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with [Core] reductions.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Red "Primal" family Spirit attacks, send a core from any opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void, and draw a card.
BS52-005.flavor:
The girl Alex met led the Clown Dragons, and her dragon friends called her Vina.
―"Genesis Records" Postscriptum 09―

SD55-004.name: The ClownDragon Drago-Frankelly
SD55-004.kanji: 道化竜ドラゴ・フランケリー
SD55-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit with one or less cores on it, and when destroys, draw a card.
SD55-004.flavor:
Lolo didn't notice, but there was a reason for that: While it was his world there, it was a world different from the one he remembers.
―"Genesis Records" Postscriptum 05―

SD55-003.name: The ClownDragon Dvergr Dragon
SD55-003.kanji: 道化竜ドヴェルグドラゴン
SD55-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Main Step)
The symbols of Grandwalker Nexuses on either Field are treated as being God symbols, and can't become any other colors due to other effects.

[LV1]
All your Cost 3 "Clown" family Spirits can't attack and are unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV2]
All your "Clown" family Spirits gain +3000 BP.
SD55-003.flavor:
Having no way to know of the plottings of other Grandwalkers, Lolo left the world he had visited, knowing no better.
―"Genesis Records" Postscriptum 03―

SD55-009.name: The ClownDragon Fool-Joker Dragon
SD55-009.kanji: 道化竜フール・ジョーカードラゴン
SD55-009.effect:
When your counters increase to two or more, you can activate this set card, ignoring the Burst condition.

[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent]
Destroy two opposing 12000 BP or less Spirits. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's, and when destroys, draw a card.
SD55-009.flavor:
A girl accompanied by Clown Dragons stood before the amnesiac Alex. And a new story now begins.
―"Genesis Records" Postscriptum 08―

SD55-008.name: The ClownDragon Gingar Dragon
SD55-008.kanji: 道化竜ギンガードラゴン
SD55-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, unless the opponent sends one of their Lives to the Trash, they can't use cards from their Hand/Removed Zone.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +2000 BP for each Spirit you control. At the end of battle, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
SD55-008.flavor:
After Lolo left, Alex woke up. Before the gate which connects all places in this world.
―"Genesis Records" Postscriptum 07―

BS52-009.name: The ClownDragon MCPanther Dragon
BS52-009.kanji: 道化竜MCパンサードラゴン
BS52-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit. Also, if you control any Reborn Spirit, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, you can refresh a "Clown" family Spirit you control.
BS52-009.flavor: "We'd like to watch over whatever hardships the girl without memories will go through from now on!"

SD55-002.name: The ClownDragon Melt Dragon
SD55-002.kanji: 道化竜メルトドラゴン
SD55-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing Nexus, and when destroys, besides [Soul Core], send three cores from your Trash to the Reserve.

[LV3] (Your End Step)
Draw until you have four cards in Hand.
SD55-002.flavor:
There was a reason for Lolo being unable to find Alex. A certain Grandwalker's plottings had to do with where Alex ended up.
―"Genesis Records" Postscriptum 02―

SD55-005.name: The ClownDragon Poldra&Castardra
SD55-005.kanji: 道化竜ポルドラ＆カスタードラ
SD55-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit, and when destroys, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
If you have one counter or more, put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control.
SD55-005.flavor:
There was a certain wonder to that place, a dull world with a few portions of land, sea and some cities. The jumbled continents floating on the ocean are all separated from the each other, and not even time flowed the same way across each of those continents, an extremely chaotic world.
―"Genesis Records" Postscriptum 04―

SD55-007.name: The ClownDragon Trickster Dragon
SD55-007.kanji: 道化竜トリックスタードラゴン
SD55-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step)
Besides [Soul Core], send three cores from your Trash to any of your "Primal" family Spirits.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by returning one Rebirth card from your Trash to the Hand, this Spirit refreshes.
SD55-007.flavor:
Had Lolo continued searching, had he met with some familiar-looking Spirits, perhaps things would have ended differently.
―"Genesis Records" Postscriptum 06―

BS12-039.name: The ClownPrincess Trickster
BS12-039.kanji: 導化姫トリックスター
BS12-039.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card, and return a card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] (When Blocks)
Destroy an opposing battling refreshed Spirit.
BS12-039.flavor: We finally see each other again, but it's a little sad that we have to part so soon. But that's fine. We'll meet again for sure!

BSC49-042.name: The ClownPrincess Trickster LT
BSC49-042.kanji: 導化姫トリックスターLT
BSC49-042.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw two cards. Or, (Once per Game: Same Name) return a card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, if you control any "Lolo" Spirit, or your Life is at two or less, you can refresh all your Spirits.
BSC49-042.flavor: We finally see each other again, but it's a little sad that we have to part so soon. But that's fine. We'll meet again for sure!

BSC20-019.name: The Cobalt Mitsumataorochi
BSC20-019.kanji: 青碧のミツマタオロチ
BSC20-019.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your Nexuses become exhausted, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a cost equal or inferior to the exhausted Nexus.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Assault: 2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to twice per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

[LV2][LV3]
While [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, all your Nexuses gain +2 cost.
BSC20-019.flavor: The teachings of Gandala are deep. By the way, what's "something more important than oneself" supposed to mean?

BSC24-013.name: The CoinKaiju Kanegon
BSC24-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
Unless you send a core from this Spirit to your Trash, destroy it.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Send one core from any opposing Spirit to their Reserve.
BSC24-013.flavor:
A kaiju born from a transformed boy greedy for money. Money is his favorite food, which he regularly eats. He dies when the counter on his left hand goes to 0.
―Ultra Q―

BS03-115.name: The Collapse of Battle Line
BS03-115.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When discarding cards from the opposing deck via [Crush] effects, discard +2 cards.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Every Spirit with [Crush] you control is treated as being on its highest level.
BS03-115.flavor:
A battle stadium where the battle royal-team battle takes place.
-from the Places of Interest 29/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BSC42-079.name: The Collapse of Battle Line LT
BSC42-079.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) Your [Crush] discards +3 cards.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your Spirits with [Crush] are treated as being on their highest levels.
BSC42-079.flavor:
A battle stadium where the battle royal-team battle takes place.
-from the Places of Interest 29/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS68-X08.name: The Colosseo Hyde-Crab
BS68-X08.kanji: 闘偽城ハイド・クラブ
BS68-X08.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When any Cost 8 or more cards are discarded/banished from the opposing deck via your [Crush]/[XV Crush], or your "Wave Contract" family effects, you can summon this card from your Trash by paying one cost. When you've done so, discard three cards from the opposing decktop.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Azure Wave" family Spirits are treated as being on their highest levels.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Crush] (When Attacks)
Discard a number of cards equal to this Spirit's level from opposing decktop.

BS10-095.name: The Colosseum with the Speed Star
BS10-095.kanji: 俊星流れるコロッセオ
BS10-095.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The opponent can only use Magic cards of the same colors as the symbols on their Field.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Opposing Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic's "BP+" effect do not activate.
BS10-095.flavor:
This is the battle arena where contests of speed take place. Yet even though the main focus is speed, how come competitions of muscle and power also occur here? Perhaps it's just part of this Gem Realm's tradition."
-from the Places of Interest 92/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS37-033.name: The CleverMachineMusha E-Naomasa
BS37-033.effect:
Flash- [Accel: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core])]
When this battle ends, end the Attack Step. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.
BS37-033.flavor: Under racer Glorious-Sheep's orders, Scuderia Maclarn recovered from the chaos after the accident and got back into formation. They're currently on the heels of racer Hanumerlin, who slipped away from the confused crowd.

CB01-015.name: The CombinationKingDemonBeast Zeppandon
CB01-015.kanji: 合体魔王獣ゼッパンドン
CB01-015.effect:
This Spirit/Spirit card is also treated as being exactly-named "Zetton".

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with one symbol. Also, by sending [Soul Core] from your Reserve/Spirit to the Trash, refresh one of your Spirits.
CB01-015.flavor:
A Fusion King Demon Beast born from Juggler putting "Zetton" and "Pandon" cards on the Dark Ring and inserting that power into Maga Orochi's tail.
―Ultraman Orb―

BS34-034.name: The CleverMachineMusha Zuiun
BS34-034.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Purple/Green/Blue
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Green/Blue Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2][LV3] [Catalyze: White] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to the Trash, immediately activate one of your White Soul Bursts.
BS34-034.flavor: When God-Sechs appeared, a messenger flew straight towards Clever Machine Province by Burning-Souldragon's order for the sake of releasing Daybreak-Third from the underground prison of the Six Heaven Castle.

CB18-016.name: The CombinationKingDemonBeast Zeppandon［Ultra Kaiju 2020］
CB18-016.kanji: 合体魔王獣ゼッパンドン［ウルトラ怪獣2020］
CB18-016.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Red/Purple & Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Advents)
Destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit, or an opposing Nexus, and the effects of the destroyed Spirit/Nexus can't activate. Also, if this Spirit was [advented], draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.
CB18-016.flavor: The form Juggler transforms into using the Dark Z Riser obtained after copying Haruki's Z Riser. It uses the medals of Maga-Orochi, Zetton, and Pandon.

BS34-035.name: The CleverMachineNinja Shiomaneki
BS34-035.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Red/Purple
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2]
Give all your Green Spirits: Red/Purple.
BS34-035.flavor: The Battle of Senkigahara was, in a way, a battle to destroy Six Heaven's Rush. The key to destroy Six Heaven's Rush is to defeat God-Sechs' army. In other words, fate rested upon each of the Six Provinces' battles.

BS41-003.name: The CometDragon Sungrazer
BS41-003.kanji: 彗星竜サングレーザー
BS41-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card, and destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit.
BS41-003.flavor: It wasn't just the Terra Dragons who were here!! I'm glad not all of them are with those ruffians.

BS34-036.name: The CleverMachinePriest Yatenkou
BS34-036.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
The color and symbol of every Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus either player controls is treated as White.

[LV2][LV3] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts. After that Burst activates, if the activated Burst was a White card, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.
BS34-036.flavor: "What's necessary for Six Heaven's Rush are spirits from each of the Six Provinces. The more spirits that are offered to it, the stronger its power becomes."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9099.name: The CometKaiju Jamila
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9099.flavor:
An Earthling astronaut who crashed in space and became a kaiju. He returned to Earth in an invisible spaceship and obstructed the International Peace Conference with fiery breath. As he was born on a planet without water, water is his weakness.
―Ultraman―

BSC21-002.name: The CleverMachineSwordMaster Ryoudan'ou
BSC21-002.kanji: 機巧剣聖リョウダンオウ
BSC21-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts. After the Burst activates, discard an opposing Burst.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BSC21-002.flavor:
Combat Era year 331, the Genkou War. The DemonBlade Murasame was brought from a foreign land during the strife, and the SwordsSaints of the five provinces gathered to consign the DemonBlade to hell.
―from the Genkou War Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9101.name: The CometKaiju Jamila［First Generation Ultra Kaiju］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9101.kanji: 棲星怪獣ジャミラ［初代ウルトラ怪獣］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9101.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits/your Trash. Or, if you control any other "First Generation Ultra Kaiju"-named Spirit/Nexus, by sending a core, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to the Void, draw a card.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing exhausted Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9101.flavor: While being an astronaut originally, he crash-landed on a planet without water due to accidents. During the time he waited for anyone to save him, he turned into a Kaiju that could live on without needing water.

BS33-067.name: The Clever Machine Warship Futsunomitama
BS33-067.kanji: 機巧戦艦フツノミタマ
BS33-067.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. After this effect resolves, deploy this Nexus card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2]
Neither player can put cores from the Void to their Life.

[LV2] (When Destroyed)
Return this Nexus to the Hand.
BS33-067.flavor: In the far away skies, Senryuukaku's slash that mowed down the first corps to set foot on the military castle came from the Clever Machine warship hidden by cloud cover.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9103.name: The Commander Dragno
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9103.effect:
[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Dragon"/"Winged Dragon" family Spirits gain +1000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9103.flavor: A veteran warrior who can fend off a thousand Dragon soldiers. He doesn't just have physical strength, he has a keen mind as well. If you value your life, don't make him your enemy.

BS43-083.name: The Cliff Fortress
BS43-083.effect:
When this Nexus card is revealed from the deck, you can deploy it, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2]
All your "Ninja Gale" family Spirits gain +2000 BP.

[LV2]
While your "Ninja Gale" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate their Burst.
BS43-083.flavor:
The biggest hidden fortress in the "Shinobi Village". It is also the place where the heads from the different groups hold summit meetings when it is needed to decide the policy of the Village.
-from the Places of Interest 336/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BS31-007.name: The Commander Liu Man
BS31-007.effect:
This Spirit/Spirit card is also treated as "Ryuuman"-named.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) was used to pay the summon cost, instead, destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Ultimate.
BS31-007.flavor: In the fourth battle, The Purifying Knowledge WisdomKing crafted a plan; a diversionary plan where the Onmyou Territory's army would be baited and rounded up all at once.

BS54-051.name: The ClockMechanic KloroKloro
BS54-051.kanji: 時計職人クロロクロロ
BS54-051.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When you're deploying a "Mega-Grandstone"-named Nexus card, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Turn)
The symbols of all opposing "Chrownos" family Spirits are treated as your symbols.

[LV2]
All your Blue Grandstone Nexuses gain an extra Blue symbol.
BS54-051.flavor:
Finally, we caught talisman's reaction at this "Blue World". As if to back it up, the denizens here have fallen into a big chaos.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 3:07―

BSC26-018.name: The CompleteLifeform Destoroyah
BSC26-018.kanji: 完全生命体デストロイア
BSC26-018.effect:
When summoning this Spirit card, by returning up to seven "Destoroyah"-named Spirit cards from your Trash to the Hand, for each card returned, this card gets -1 cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can discard five cards from your decktop. For each Spirit card among them, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.
BSC26-018.flavor:
The complete form of Destoroyah, evolved by an explosion at a thermal power plant.
―Godzilla vs Destoroyah (1995)―

BSC24-017.name: The CloneAlien Guts Seijin
BSC24-017.kanji: 分身宇宙人ガッツ星人
BSC24-017.flavor:
The self-styled "unbeaten in any fight, the invincible Guts Seijin." They have a cunning personality, throughly studying Seven and fighting him. They successfully captured and crucified Seven.
―Ultraseven―

26RBS02-X05.name: The Composed Molunar
26RBS02-X05.effect:
[LV1-2]When Summoned
You can target one of your Spirits with When Destroyed effects. Destroy it. If you've done so, target an opposing Spirit. Send a core from it to the Reserve. (The opponent chooses which cores to send)

[LV2]Your End StepCan't Stack
If your Purple Spirits were destroyed by your effects this turn, draw a card.
26RBS02-X05.flavor: "Everyone~ Let's give it one more push~"

CB01-016.name: The CloneAlien Guts Seijin Doppel
CB01-016.kanji: 分身宇宙人ガッツ星人ドッペル
CB01-016.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can summon all "Guts Seijin"-named Spirit cards from your Trash. However, (When Summoned) effects of those Spirits can't activate.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
The cost of every exactly-named "The OddMachineKaiju Diabolic" in your Hand gets -1.
CB01-016.flavor:
An alien that can manipulate the power of cloning who persistently chases after the SSP members in an alternate dimension.
―Ultraman Orb The Movie: Let Me Borrow the Power of Bonds!―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9111.name: The ConcaveKnight Kuwagadara
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9111.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When your exactly-named "The ConvexKnight Kabudrum"/"The ConcaveKnight Kuwagadara" would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can put two cores from the Void to each of them. Spirits which had core put on them by this effect remain on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9111.flavor:
If he resisted, perhaps he'd manage to deal heavy damage to Susanoo, but Ares willfully chooses to become his prisoner.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 2:50―

PB08-008.name: The CloneAlien Guts Seijin［2］
PB08-008.kanji: 分身宇宙人ガッツ星人［2］
PB08-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to an opposing effect, by discarding a "Kaiju"/"Seijin"/"Zetton"-named card from your Hand, it remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
This Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.
PB08-008.flavor: It was revived from the Kaiju Graveyard by Ultraman Belial's Giga Battle Nizer. A highly intelligent alien who has the ability to clone.

BS59-012.name: The ConcealSpearStaff Hermit-One
BS59-012.kanji: 隠の槍杖ハーミット・ワン
BS59-012.effect:
[+1]

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Send two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve.
[Rush: White]
(While you have a White symbol, the following effect activates next)
[White Core][White Core][White Core]: Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.
BS59-012.flavor: The SpearStaff Hermit-One passed down by the Hermit-Ritters. It is said that the staff lodges a magnificent ancient magician that is on a par with Badgerdulles.

CB32-026.name: The CloneAlien Guts Seijin［First Generation Ultra Kaiju］
CB32-026.kanji: 分身宇宙人ガッツ星人［初代ウルトラ怪獣］
CB32-026.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Bunshin: 2] (When Summoned)
By putting up to two cards from your decktop facedown onto the Field, and putting one or more cores from your Reserve onto them, during this game, those cards become Green Bunshin Spirits with "Cost 0/Family: Bunshin/<1>LV1 BP 3000/[Green Core]". (Bunshin Spirits can't be braved/advented onto/switched in place, and are discarded if returned to the Hand/Removed Zone/Deck.)

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your Green Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.
CB32-026.flavor: An invader with high intelligence. After purposedly wasting Seven's energy, he trapped Seven with its crystal cross, and announced to denizens on Earth that he was going to execute Seven when the sun rose.

BS30-031.name: The ConductorAngelia Maestel
BS30-031.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Disp: 2] (When Battles)
When you use a Magic card that targets one opposing Spirit/Ultimate, change the number of targets to two.

[LV2][LV3]
Give all your Spirits with [Dispersion]: "[Brilliance] (When Attacks) At the end of the battle, return all Magic cards you used during this battle to the Hand."
BS30-031.flavor: The victory parade conducted by the Angelias is beginning now! I'm glad, so glad that we worked so hard!

BS06-009.name: The CloudBladeDragon Swordlagoon
BS06-009.kanji: 雲刃竜ソードラグーン
BS06-009.flavor: Winged dragons are excellent as attackers but not as defenders. They can only use offensive tactics even when they know they cannot win.

BS13-070.name: The Constellation Barrier
BS13-070.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Neither player's Life would be reduced by the attack of Cost 3 or less LV1 Spirits.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by an opposing Spirit, by exhausting this Nexus, put a core from the Void to your life. This effect can only be used once per turn.
BS13-070.flavor:
The barrier that the Angelias strung up around the realm shut off the escape route of the Empty Sky, but at the same time they too would be unable to escape. They're trapped between a rock and a hard place.
-from the Places of Interest 757/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo-

BS64-X02.name: The CloudNumberBondDeity Frag-Judgment
BS64-X02.kanji: 雲数ノ絆神フラグジャッジメント
BS64-X02.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Golden Cloud & C1 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

This card/Spirit gains the families: "Golden Cloud"/"Cloud Contract"/"Number Contract".

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents)
Put a core from the Void to your Life. If you have six counters or more, the opponent can't activate Burst effects via this effect.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can send a core from your Life to any of your Spirits. When you've done so, until your next Start Step, the effects of every opposing Nexus/Grandwalker Nexus can't activate.

SD22-011.name: The Clouded Highlands
SD22-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Spirit/Ultimate with [High Speed] is summoned, during this turn, give that Spirit/Ultimate +4000 BP.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Spirit/Ultimate with [High Speed] is summoned, put a core from the Void to that Spirit/Ultimate. This effect can only be used once per turn.
SD22-011.flavor:
The waterfall is undoubtedly raining down. If viewed from our original continent, it rains up. If you forget about how complicated it is, the scenery can be taken in better.
—Green Forests Site No. 323 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

26RSD04-X01.name: The ContinentalShip Matanda
26RSD04-X01.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2]Your End Step
You can target up to two "Mineroid" family Spirits you control. Refresh them.

[LV2]True ReleaseDuring Attack
This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Cost 7 or less Spirits.
26RSD04-X01.flavor: In this place where everything is decaying, if there is one thing that is immortal, it must be this Continental Ship.

PX26-19.name: The Converging Sealed Lands
PX26-19.effect:
Flash - [Mani: terra, "Contractor Gaia" & C6 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to deploy this card from the Hand.

[LV1-2] (When Deployed/Destroyed)
Once per turn, if you control any "Contractor Gaia", you can destroy an opposing Grandwalker Nexus. Then, for each color of "Primordial" family Nexuses you control, besides those of six-color, you can destroy an opposing Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
Once per turn, by destroying another Nexus you control, summon a "Primordial" & "Reptile Beast" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
PX26-19.flavor:
Gaia gathered the Sealed Lands...and let them fall.
―Theogonic Record Volume 3―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9122.name: The ConvexKnight Kabudrum
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9122.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon a Saga Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost. Or, you can put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Also, during this turn, the opponent can't send [Soul Core] to their Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9122.flavor:
His real mission is to standby. However, Ares disregards that, and charges forward. He had a reason to do so.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 2:41―

BS24-X01.name: The ConvictionDownfallDragon﻿ Judgment-Dragonis
BS24-X01.kanji: 断罪の滅龍ジャッジメント・ドラゴニス
BS24-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Start of Either Attack Step)
By discarding a Red card from your Hand, during this turn, all of your Spirits get +5000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] [Clash] (When Attacks)
Opposing Spirits must block if possible.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
(Once per Game: Same Name) After this turn ends, (Your Turn) occurs once more.
BS24-X01.flavor: Don't open it! That door will distort the future!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9124.name: The ConvictionDownfallSword Judgment-Dragon-Sword
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9124.kanji: 断罪ノ滅刃ジャッジメント・ドラゴン・ソード
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9124.effect:
This card can't be summoned without paying at least two costs.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
After this turn ends, (Your Turn) occurs once more. This effect can only be used once per game.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9124.flavor: An evil sword which contains the power of the Downfall Dragon.

BS05-032.name: The CoralCrab Siomanekid
BS05-032.kanji: 珊瑚蟹シオマネキッド
BS05-032.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Armor: Red/White]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/White Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2]
Give all your Green Spirits: [Armor: Red/White].
BS05-032.flavor: The bubbles it blows form a rainbow. It is the only rainbow that can stop the encroaching tide.

BS10-090.name: The Coral Reef in the Sky
BS10-090.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn)
All your Spirits gain +1000 BP.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
When your "Flying Fish" family Spirit is summoned, return an opposing non-Braved Spirit to the Hand.
BS10-090.flavor:
Perhaps this is the homestead of the Flying Fish? It's hard not to imagine that to them the great skies are their 'great oceans.' But the fact that the coral itself also has the same sentiment comes to me as a surprise.
-from the Places of Interest 56/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS21-072.name: The Coral Sea of Trees
BS21-072.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Blue Spirits with [Rush] attack, you can draw a card. When you draw via this effect, discard a card from your Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
At the beginning of the Step, by sending a core from your Life to your Reserve, during this turn, neither player can activate Bursts.
BS21-072.flavor: It is said that there are parts of this seafloor overgrown with vivid coral. I'd like to visit the place after everything has been solved.

BS13-061.name: The Coronation Volcano
BS13-061.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When a 4000 BP or less Spirit attacks, destroy that Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
For each core in your Life, every Spirit you control with both "Terra Dragon" and "Dragon" families gain +1000 BP.
BS13-061.flavor:
From the moment this constellation was formed and began its existence, the Dragons worshipped this great volcano as holy ground. It is the dwelling and time-honored headquarters of the DinomanKing standing at the top of the hordes of Dragons.
—from the Corona Australis chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS62-028.name: The CorpseAsura Garyo
BS62-028.effect:
When your Spirits are destroyed by your “Blood Crystal” family effect, if you have three counters or more, you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Nexus's (When Summoned/Deployed) effect resolves]
Draw a card. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
Your counters +2, and destroy three opposing exhausted Spirits. Then, you can return this Spirit to the Hand.
BS62-028.flavor: "Save the Ogre General seat for me...Whoever you are, come at me!"

BS21-018.name: The CorpseBeastMarquis Bone-Cousseraux
BS21-018.kanji: 骸獣侯ボーン・クスロー
BS21-018.effect:
[Immortality: Cost 3/4] (Either Attack Step)
This Spirit card in your Trash can be summoned when your Cost 3/4 Spirit is destroyed.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Send a core from the opposing Field to their Reserve.
[Rush: White]
(While you have a White symbol, the following effect activates next)
[White Core]: Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.
BS21-018.flavor: Shifting between personalities, the marquis of the underworld commands the troops with a solemn attitude.

BS22-012.name: The CorpseDemon Imp
BS22-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Cards can't be discarded from either player's deck.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Main Step)
When any player would summon a Cost 4/6/7 Spirit card, unless the owner sends a core from their Reserve to the Void, it can't be summoned.
BS22-012.flavor: Under orders from the ruler of the underworld, the corpse familiar gathers many things. They range from ornaments to food and even souls.

SD13-005.name: The CorpseDragonEarl Decoux-Lon
SD13-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.
[Rush: Yellow]
(While you have a Yellow symbol, the following effect activates next.)
[Yellow Core]: Exhaust an opposing Spirit with the highest LV.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.
SD13-005.flavor: The fleshless army continually rose in revolt against the unsuspecting royals. These battles only invite new conflicts. However, I can understand their feelings.

BS26-015.name: The CorpseDustGeneral Mukuro
BS26-015.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon a "Galaxian"/"Astral Soul" family Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost. When a "Galaxian" family Brave is summoned via this effect, you can send a core from any opposing Ultimate to the Trash.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
Unless the opponent discards a Magic card from their Hand, they can't block this Spirit.
BS26-015.flavor: Are the Spirits in control? Or are they being manipulated by the Braves? What a weird bunch.

BS60-023.name: The CorpseEmperor Dvorak
BS60-023.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Purple Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, you can discard a card from your decktop. After this effect resolves, if you have four counters or more, you can summon a Cost 4 or less "Blood Crystal" family Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy two opposing Spirits/Ultimates with five cores or less on them.
BS60-023.flavor:
The stone tablet of the Violet Corpse Zone is under the Corpse Emperor's control.
―The PartnerKnight Bat―

BS12-016.name: The CorpseGiant Gi-Gasha
BS12-016.effect:
While there are five or more "Zombie" family Spirit cards in your Trash, this Spirit card in your Hand becomes Cost 3.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return any number of "Zombie" family Spirit cards, up to a total cost of 13, from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] (When Destroyed)
Exhaust every opposing Spirit.
BS12-016.flavor: By lending you a hand, I have broken the law. This is all I can do for you now. This world will end soon. Hurry, Lolo, you must leave and return to your world.

BS43-074.name: The CorpseGun Draghead
BS43-074.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 6 ([Purple Core][Purple Core][Purple Core])]
Send two cores from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Remove Zone. By discarding a card from your Hand, instead of putting it onto the Removed Zone, summon it without paying the cost.

[LV1] [Reload]
You can [Advent] onto this Spirit-condition Brave. When you [Advent] onto this Brave, you can brave this pre-Advent card to that Spirit.
BS43-074.flavor: A forbidden Gun Brave made merging the skull of immature Death Dragons using dark magics.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9137.name: The CorpseHorseman Rothschild
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9137.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card from your Hand/Removed Zone/Trash without paying the cost. When you've done so, draw a card.

[During Brave] [LV2] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't block unless they send a core from their Spirits to the Void.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9137.flavor:
Differently from the defensive battle until now, they are prepared even to face death and determined to sacrifice themselves if needed. They can't fend off all the lightning bolts, so Shiva, Brahma and the others shield us with their own bodies, suffering severe burns.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 4:19―

BSC17-X02.name: The CorpseKing Ultimate-Gi-Gasha
BSC17-X02.kanji: 骸皇アルティメット・ギ・ガッシャ
BSC17-X02.effect:

The name of the enemy is Zodiac... Wait a second, that's who hired me! Should I choose the money or my feelings...? No, wait, doesn't that mean either me or Master Lilia have been deceived?!

"It's a proposal from a woman. Don't have me feeling ashamed!"
Kei coyly laughs. Cheers erupted, led by the Twins.

BS18-043.name: The Creator Grimm-Wilhelm

BS18-043.flavor: "I've got a good proposal for you... Manaka! That is, become my husband!" Kei's sudden proposal even sent the chatterbox Twins into stunned silence.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)

BS75-007.name: The CrimsonDragonStar Ankillersaurus
BS75-007.kanji: 紅蓮の竜星アンキラーザウルス
