BS75-007.flavor:
Spirits are falling from the sky like meteors. Is this some sort of omen?
―Divine World Log 04―

BS75-011.name: The CrimsonDragonStar Balmung
BS75-011.kanji: 紅蓮の竜星バルムンク
BS75-011.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, during this turn, all your "Crimson"/"Wurm" gain +10000 BP. Then, if your Life is at three or less, refresh a Spirit you control.

BS75-011.flavor:
Chaos alters even the very origin. What you thought you knew may well become something unknown. What was the crimson lightning you knew like?
―Divine World Log 04―

BS75-003.name: The CrimsonDragonStar Erimakilizard
BS75-003.kanji: 紅蓮の竜星エリマキリザード
BS75-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Crimson"/"Wurm" attacks, you can send two cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void. Or, if your Life is three or less, you can send all cores from an opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void.
BS75-003.flavor:
Before Dan's eyes, chaos swallowed both the different layers of world and time itself. The battle against the Empty Skies from the legendary Record of the Strange World unfolded before him in dizzying succession. The Thunder Emperor Dragon's roar echoed across the world, summoning yet another realm of Divine World. It was the world of Grandwalker Indra, the place known as the Heavenly Thunder Divine Realm. Soon, it too was swallowed by the chaos. Yet, a Grandwalker remained there.
―Divine World Log 04―

BS75-001.name: The CrimsonDragonStar Goradon
BS75-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Crimson"/"Wurm" is attacking, opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible.
BS75-001.flavor:
Grandwalker Ometeotl tested whether Dan possessed the strength to fight against Chaos. Dan formed a provisional contract with Mitra, and demonstrated that power. At that moment, the Divine World was suddenly swallowed by Chaos.
―Divine World Log 04―

BS76-002.name: The CrimsonDragonStar Katanakasago
BS76-002.kanji: 紅蓮の竜星カタナカサゴ

BS76-002.flavor:
A scene glimpsed between reality and chaos. There, the Crimson Dragons led by the SupernovaDragon clashed with the Twinkle Knights led by the DoomKnightLord. Incredibly, the ThunderEmperorDragon, the StarEmperorDragon, the IronKnight, the ArmoredSacred, the WingedDeity, and even the Providence were all present at the same time, taking part in this battle.
―Divine World Log 04―

BS75-002.name: The CrimsonDragonStar Lizardedge
BS75-002.kanji: 紅蓮の竜星リザドエッジ

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)

BS75-002.flavor:
Choas is a force that alters the world. What ought to be loses its form, mingles in disorder, and becomes one.
―Divine World Log 04―

BS75-006.name: The CrimsonDragonStar Rainydle
BS75-006.kanji: 紅蓮の竜星レイニードル

Among them, add a "Crimson"/"Wurm"/"Kushina" to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. When any card is added to Hand via this effect, your counter +1.

[LV2]
While your Life is three or less, all your "Crimson"/"Wurm" gain +5000 BP.
BS75-006.flavor:
It pierced the earth like a single needle.
―Divine World Log 04―

BS75-005.name: The CrimsonDragonStar Rokceratops
BS75-005.kanji: 紅蓮の竜星ロクケラトプス

[LV1][LV2][LV3]

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Crimson"/"Wurm" attacks, you can destroy an opposing Nexus.
BS75-005.flavor:
You are Indra. I never imagined you would appear in the outer world.　―Grandwalker Mitra―
It seems that I was summoned by the roar of thunder. What on earth is this?　―Grandwalker Indra―

BS75-008.name: The CrimsonDragonStar Sabecaulus
BS75-008.kanji: 紅蓮の竜星サーベカウラス
BS75-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - [Awaken]
You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Wurm" reduces the opposing Life, you can return a "Crimson" from your Trash to the Hand.
BS75-008.flavor:
The wielder of the Thunder Emperor Dragon. Dan...Was it the name? It seems that we are linked in some way. Then let me ask, do you have the resolve to unleash my power and dispel this chaos?
―Grandwalker Indra―

BS76-003.name: The CrimsonDragonStar Tartargar

BS76-003.flavor:
The radiance of the stars will not lose to something like chaos...Thousands upon thousands of stars bear witness to this. O SupernovaDragon, show them. Show them your greatest radiance.
―The StarMedium Kushina―

BS21-030.flavor: Her figure dancing upon the battlefield is daring and resolute, but does not lose any grace.

SJ16-01.name: The CrimsonSacredHorse Execeed-Red
SJ16-01.kanji: 紅き神馬エグゼシード・レッド
SJ16-01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Seal: Seal] (When Attacks)
You can send the [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Life.

[Seal: When Sealed] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. At the end of a blocked battle, send an opposing Life to their Reserve, and draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +10000 BP.
SJ16-01.flavor: Execeed's ancestor who became a God-King in the 80th Tournament. Execeed inherits his pedigree in the current day.

BS76-007.name: The CrimsonTwinkleDragon Siegwurm-Altair
BS76-007.kanji: 紅蓮の煌星龍ジークヴルム・アルター
BS76-007.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Your counter +1. Then, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the same family as a card in the opposing Trash. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1-2-3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Nexus. Then, (Once per Turn: Same Name) you can summon one of your "Siegwurm" in Soul State/pre-advent condition.

[LV2-3] (When Attacks)
You can send four cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void.
BS76-007.flavor: The falling dragon star burns red as a crimson lotus.

BS75-063.name: The Crimson Crater
BS75-063.effect:
When your "Crimson Contract" family Spirit [Contract Advents], you can pay one cost to deploy this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2]
Effects of opposing Spirits/Ultimates destroyed by your "Crimson"/"Wurm" effects can't activate..

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Wurm" is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.
BS75-063.flavor:
The Crimson Spirits descended like shooting stars. What remained in their wake was a crater known as the "Dragon Star Scar".
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 021―

BS76-069.name: The Crimson Lavafalls
BS76-069.effect:
(Can't Stack) When your "Crimson"/"Wurm"/"Kushina" is blocked, you can deploy this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your attacking "Crimson"/"Wurm"/"Kushina" gain +3000 BP.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When any opposing Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by your "Crimson"/"Wurm"/"Kushina", you can draw a card.
BS76-069.flavor:
Lava flowed into the Crater and created a huge lavafall.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 387―

BS21-062.name: The CrossArrowBeast Cross-Bongo
BS21-062.kanji: 弩弓獣クロス・ボンゴ
BS21-062.effect:
[When Braved] (When Blocks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. If this Spirit has a Purple Symbol, send a core from the opposing Field to their Reserve.
BS21-062.flavor: To counter invaders, armed weapons were deployed all around the nation's border.

BS37-021.name: The CrossRiderDragon Crusades
BS37-021.kanji: 十字騎竜クルセイダス
BS37-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2](When Summoned)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Brave card and a "God-King" family Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[When Braved] [LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve. When this effect depletes any Spirit, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BS37-021.flavor: Racer Amethyst-Dragon has the real skill to continually support the God-Kings of "Team Turon" while still breaking into the rankings himself.

BS72-006.name: The CrossSpearMartialArtist Knuckle-Ravi
BS72-006.kanji: 十字槍の武芸者ナックル・ラヴィ
BS72-006.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Red Core])]
[During Set] (Your Turn)
Once per turn, when your "Devotee"/"Martial" family Saga Brave is summoned, you can draw a card.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1. Then, destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Nexus.
BS72-006.flavor:
Lugh came to Olym in search of a stronger prey, but the Primodial Deities were already defeated by Dan and the others. The disheartened Lugh wandered at the east side of the Divine World, in search of a new prey.
―Divine World Log 01―

EX13-01.name: The CrossStarDragon Southern-Cross-Dragon
EX13-01.kanji: 十字星竜サザンクロス・ドラゴン
EX13-01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Astral Dragon"/"Astral Soul" family Spirits gain +2000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.
EX13-01.flavor:
The dragon's breath fired from far off took the form of a flaming cross.
—from the Crux chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS34-003.name: The CrossbowDragon Suiha
BS34-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When Soul Core is sent to your Trash via your Spirit effects, once per turn, you can send the Soul Core from your Trash to this Spirit.

[LV3][ (When Attacks)
If there is [Soul Core] (Soul Core) on this Spirit, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.
BS34-003.flavor: Burning-Souldragon heard God-Sechs' secret from the messenger that returned from Clever Machine Province and formed a strategy to defeat Six Heaven's Rush.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9188.name: The Crossroads of Destiny
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9188.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (During the Battle Phase) Each time a spirit you control with no printed effects is defeated, draw 1 card.

[LV2] (During the Battle Phase) Each time a spirit you control with no printed effects defeats a spirit, exhaust target unexhuasted spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9188.flavor:
A crossroads which divides a road into two. One to a snake cave and the other to a noble's mansion. Either way won't give you the real hope. This place is so cruel in that sense.
-from the Places of Interest 544/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS63-069.name: The CrownFairy Clion
BS63-069.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Once per turn, when “Azure Wave” family cards are discarded from your Hand by your Blue effect, destroy an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to one of the discarded cards'.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw two cards, then discard two cards from your Hand. When this effect discards any “Azure Wave” family card, your counter +2.
BS63-069.flavor:
Shack arrived at Salgatraz the Seal City, where The-Hanged Man was sealed. And Raon awaited him there.
―Record of Sealing Sea 1―

BSC05-020.name: The Crown of the Starlit Sky
BSC05-020.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Life is reduced, you can reveal a card from your decktop. If it is a Cost 2 or less Spirit card, you can summon it without paying the cost. Add any remaining card to the Hand.

[LV2] (Opposing Turn)
Destroy every Red/Green/Blue Spirit refreshed by Spirit/Magic effects.
BSC05-020.flavor:
Stars of happiness, stars of sorrow, stars newly born, stars fading as they die... For a fleeting moment, this crown boldly reproduces the voices of the billions of stars that paint the night sky.
—from the Corona Borealis chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BSC49-082.name: The Crown of the Starlit Sky LT
BSC49-082.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Life is reduced, you can reveal a card from your decktop. If that's a Yellow-only "Astral Soul"/ "Galaxian"/ "Prismwing" family Spirit card, you can summon it without paying the cost. Add any remaining card to the Hand.

[LV2] (Opposing Turn)
You can destroy every opposing Spirit refreshed via Spirit/Magic effects.
BSC49-082.flavor:
Stars of happiness, stars of sorrow, stars newly born, stars fading as they die... For a fleeting moment, this crown boldly reproduces the voices of the billions of stars that paint the night sky.
—from the Corona Borealis chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9192.name: The Crumbling Uroko Mountain
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9192.kanji: 剥がれ落ちるウロコ山
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9192.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step) When your Spirits with Rush are destroyed/returned to the Hand by opposing effects, destroy an opposing Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step) All your Spirits with "Rush" gain +3000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9192.flavor: There are those who would try to scale this mountain, but they would repeatedly climb and slip, climb and slip all the way down. I only hope I don't have to climb this mountain.

SD03-011.name: The CrustDragon Groun-Giras
SD03-011.kanji: 鎧殻竜グラウン・ギラス
SD03-011.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Nexus
SD03-011.flavor:
The aim of my observations are the Braves who hold the key to victory in battle!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9194.name: The CrustaceanFighter Longhorn
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9194.kanji: 甲殻戦士ロングホーン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9194.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) Gain 1 core on each spirit you control with High Speed.

[LV2][LV3] (During Your Battle Phase) Cores on this spirit can be used to summon a spirit card with High Speed and/or put on a Spirit with High Speed as though they were in your Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9194.flavor: The rowdies have invaded deep into the woods. I wonder what will become of it.

SD34-008.name: The CrystalDragon Amethyst-Dragon
SD34-008.kanji: 水晶龍アメジスト・ドラゴン
SD34-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon an "Imagine" family Brave card from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost. When a Brave is summoned via this effect, draw two cards.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When any opposing Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the [When Braved] effect of the Brave braving to this Spirit, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
SD34-008.flavor: I found "Team Turon"'s racer, Amethyst Dragon! His true power is unknown but he's a favorite racer of mine! Give it your best!

BS22-031.name: The CrystalDragon Sillimanite
BS22-031.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Either player's Life can only be reduced by one per Spirit with two or more symbols per turn.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Heavy Armor: Red/Green/White]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Green/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2][LV3]
Give all your non-braved Spirits: [Heavy Armor: Red/Green/White].
BS22-031.flavor: The giant dragon that fused with mineral used its body as a shield to continually protect the sword.

BS10-036.name: The CrystalFish Crysteel
BS10-036.kanji: 水晶魚クリスティール
BS10-036.flavor:
To him, the great sea and sky are nothing more than mere puddles. Everything in his grasp is his territory.
—from the Dorado chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BSC42-048.name: The CrystalGoddess Freyr LT
BSC42-048.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit/Nexus is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
Your Life can't be reduced by the attacks of opposing Spirits with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

[LV2][LV3] Green
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Green Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.
BSC42-048.flavor: A goddess who is in captivity. She still creates a barrier around her that binds everything.

BS67-071.name: The Crystal Lake
BS67-071.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Purple Core])]
[During Set]
Once per turn, when opposing Spirits/Ultimates exhaust, draw a card.

[LV1] Flash -(Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, you can discard a card from your decktop. If that's a card with "Curse"-named effects, your counter +1, and send a core from the opposing Field to the Reserve.
BS67-071.flavor:
A tranquil lake inside the forest located at the suburbs of Camelot. There is a small island amid the lake, and a black cavalry lance sticks out from its ground.
―Travelogue of the Collapsing World 326―

BS30-068.name: The Crystal Sword Detector
BS30-068.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning a White Spirit card/Ultimate card, this Nexus' symbol is fixed as three White symbols.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By exhausting this Nexus, reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add a White "Exalted Sword" family Brave card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.
BS30-068.flavor: You must be the boss of the Machine Beasts. Everyone will be able to hear you through this frequency. Machine Beasts, take care of the pillar sword's defense please!

BS32-004.name: The Cub Tiger
BS32-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks) Draw a card from your deck.

[LV2][LV3] Catalyze: Red (When Attacks) By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to the Trash, immediately activate your set Red Soul Burst.
BS32-004.flavor:
While wandering the countries for training purposes, Muramasa met the runaway ninjas from Ninja Gale and had them teach him the forbidden technique.
―from the Soldier's Biography of "Sengoku Obscurities" by Kuroe―

CUMULO-NIMBUS.name: The Cumulo-Nimbus Mountain Range
CUMULO-NIMBUS.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your Green Spirit, refresh your that Spirit you control.

[LV2] (Your Turn) When your Spirit effect exhausts opposing Spirits, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.
CUMULO-NIMBUS.flavor: The clouds stretch so far as to obscure the view. In its innermost part, there is a hidden path that leads to the village where the shinobi live.

BS31-X02.name: The DarkArtsMagician Ogma
BS31-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] Flash- (Either Attack Step) By sending the [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Spirit to the Trash, summon any number of "Ogre Wizard"/"Spiritual Beast"/"Nightling" family Spirit cards/Brave cards from your Trash.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Destroyed by the Opponent) By discarding 4 cards from your decktop, this Spirit remains on the Field, in the same condition.
BS31-X02.flavor: The soul magic resurrects the ancient army lying beneath the DarkArtsMagician.

BS33-017.name: The DarkAscetic Kurama
BS33-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Battles)
You can summon a Cost 4 or less Purple Spirit card from your Trash. If Soul Core is in your Trash, treat all reduction symbols of the Spirit card to be summoned as filled.
BS33-017.flavor: "The Six Heaven Army has asked to form an alliance... let us accept their offer for the time being."

BS06-023.name: The DarkBishop Baculus
BS06-023.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Send cores from every Spirit to its owner's Reserve until only one core remains on each of them.
BS06-023.flavor: A wise man from the evil world laid lethal traps everywhere, but even they could not destroy the soldiers of the Empty Sky.

BSC42-X03.name: The DarkDragonEmperor Kaiser-Fried
BSC42-X03.kanji: 魔龍皇帝カイザー・フリード
BSC42-X03.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Red/Green & Cost 6 or more] ((Your Turn))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can put two cores from the Void to this Spirit. Then, you can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of a blocked battle, draw two cards, and send up to two opposing Lives to the Reserve.
BSC42-X03.flavor: Oh? This is the forest of that time? Oh no~ The forest is burning! We need to do something!

BS08-015.name: The DarkDragonRider Sabna-Rook
BS08-015.kanji: 闇帝竜騎サブナ・ルーク
BS08-015.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
Once per turn, you can summon a Spirit card with [Tribute] from your Hand without using [Tribute]. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirit can't activate.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Dragon Emperor" family Spirit attacks, send one core each from every opposing Spirit without [Tribute] to their Reserve.
BS08-015.flavor: Guided by the second herald, true fear has descended upon the land once again.

SD17-X01.name: The DarkDragon Dark-Tyrannosaura
SD17-X01.kanji: 闇龍ダーク・ティラノザウラー
SD17-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Terra Dragon" family Spirits gain +3000 BP.
SD17-X01.flavor: The dinosaur creeping forth from the darkness is the jet black ruler who erases all light.

SD11-X01.name: The DarkEmperor Ninetail-Dark
SD11-X01.kanji: 闇皇ナインテイル・ダーク
SD11-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Blocks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, refresh this Spirit, and during this turn, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

[LV3] (When Battles)
Return an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit to the Hand.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: Exhaust an opposing Spirit.
SD11-X01.flavor: From darkness into darkness, the nine-tailed beast swings down his blade.

BS69-014.name: The CupronickelDragonKnight Vandish
BS69-014.kanji: 白銅の竜騎士ヴァンディッシュ
BS69-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
(Once per turn: Same Name) You can return a "DragonKnight"/"Camelot" from your Trash to the Hand.
BS69-014.flavor:
There were once Dragon Knights who could change the color of the aura they wore after passing countless trials and overcoming challenges. They are called the lances of five colors.
―Epic of the Dragoon―

BSC42-035.name: The DarkFeather Yatagross LT
BSC42-035.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent]
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
For each core on this Spirit, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
BSC42-035.flavor: Some say they bring us bad luck, but others say they bring us victory. I wonder what the truth is?

26RBS01-098.name: The Current Corridor
26RBS01-098.effect:
[LV1-2] Either Attack Step [Invoke: Flash]
Exhaust this Nexus ▶ Target one of your Spirits with [Current]. During this battle, it gains +2000 BP.

[LV2] Once Per Turn
When your Spirit with [Current] is summoned, you can reveal a card from your decktop. If that's a Cost 7 or more "Oceanic Green" family card, add it to the Hand. Return any remaining card to the deckbottom.
26RBS01-098.flavor:
I've seen the sea in many different colours over the years, but this was the first time I'd ever come across a mode of transport like this.
―from the Foreigner's Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

PB41-010.name: The DarkGreatEmperor Kaiser-Darkness
PB41-010.kanji: 暗黒大皇帝カイザーダークネス
PB41-010.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as being exactly-named "Belial".

Flash -
By banishing four "Belial" in your Trash that are either Cost 7 or more or have the "Grandwalker" family, summon this card from the Hand/Trash without paying the cost. When you've done so, if it's the opposing Turn, you can send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
For each LV this Spirit has, you can send two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve. Then, you can destroy an opposing Nexus.
PB41-010.flavor: The form of Ultraman Belial's thought body possessing Armored Darkness.

BS70-CX01.name: The CurseConsortContractor Hera
BS70-CX01.effect:
[Neo-Core Charge:: (Ogre Wizard/Devotee/Concluser & Cost 3 or more)]
◆When your target Spirit is summoned, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this Nexus is deployed, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Revive] Main - (Once per Turn: Same Name) You can deploy this card from Soul State.

4 [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) Your counters +4. Then, by banishing an "Ogre Wizard" family Spirit card from your Trash, activate one of the (When Summoned) effects written on that card as this Nexus' colorless [Contract Skill].

[Contract Field] [LV2]
All "Devotee"/"Concluser" & "Ogre Wizard" family cards in your Trash are unaffected by opposing effects. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

BS22-X04.name: The DarkKingMachineBeast Darkness-Griffon
BS22-X04.kanji: 黒皇機獣ダークネス・グリフォン
BS22-X04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return up to two opposing Spirits to the Hand.
[Rush: Purple]
(While you have a Purple symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Purple Core]: Draw two cards.

[During Brave] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.
[Rush: Purple]
(While you have a Purple symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Purple Core]: Send two cores from any opposing Spirits to their Trash.
BS22-X04.flavor: Its wings of black steel block light and steep the world in darkness.

BS61-015.name: The CurseGrudgeOgreGeneral Bagrago
BS61-015.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your “Blood Crystal” family effect depletes/destroys Spirits/Ultimates you or the opponent controls, you can summon this card from the Hand/Trash.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
You can treat this Spirit's color as colorless. Then, you can send cores from every opposing Spirit to the Reserve until only one core left on each of them.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While you control any “The PartnerMusha Oboro”, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.
BS61-015.flavor: "The CurseGrudge OgreGeneral of the Kijins. That's me. May you savor my infernal hell firsthand!"

BS17-012.name: The DarkKnight Aglovale
BS17-012.effect:
[Immortality: Cost 4] (Either Attack Step)
This Spirit card in your Trash can be summoned when your Cost 4 Spirit is destroyed.

[LV2]
When your Cost 3 Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, send a core from any opposing Spirit/Nexus to their Reserve.
BS17-012.flavor: Faced with the fierce assault of the Flame Shield Army, numerous knights played dead. The destructive force of the enemy was unexpectedly strong, however, that some of them really lost their lives.

BS14-X02.name: The CurseHero Chaotic-Seimei
BS14-X02.kanji: 呪の覇王カオティック・セイメイ
BS14-X02.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed by the Opponent]
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to their Trash. Also, if this Burst is activated when a Purple Spirit is destroyed, draw a card. Then, return this card to your Hand.

[LV3] [Spell Blight] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
By sending an opposing Life to their Trash, this Spirit remains on the Field, refreshed.
BS14-X02.flavor: Even when clearly mortally wounded, the supreme hero who was more than a thousand years old still smiled.

BS13-014.name: The DarkKnight Agravain
BS13-014.kanji: 闇騎士アグラヴェイン
BS13-014.effect:
[Immortality: Dark Snake] (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this Spirit card from the Trash when your "Dark Snake" family Spirit is destroyed.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
When summoned via [Immortality], you can summon a Cost 7 or more Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirit summoned via this effect can't activate.
BS13-014.flavor:
The Sephirothic Sheep Deity gave the Sun Dragon Deity and Moonlight Dragon Deity life, and all greeted them as comrades.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS13-016.name: The CurseKing Dragonaga
BS13-016.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] When your "Dark Snake" family Spirit is summoned, draw a card from your deck.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step) When your "Dragon" family Spirits become exhausted, send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed) Return all "Dragonaga"-named Spirit card from your Trash to your Hand.
BS13-016.flavor:
Visiting this world with a one-of-a-kind body, I carry on the revelation of the snakes.

-from the 2nd paragraph of the final chapter in "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BSC49-016.name: The DarkKnight Agravain LT
BSC49-016.kanji: 闇騎士アグラヴェインLT
BSC49-016.effect:
[Immortality: Devotee/Dark Snake & Cost 7 or more] (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this Spirit card from the Trash when your Cost 7 or more "Devotee"/ "Dark Snake" family Spirit is destroyed.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can send two cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve. Then, when summoned via [Immortality], you can summon a Purple-only "Devotee"/ "Dark Snake" family Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.
BSC49-016.flavor:
The Sephirothic Sheep Deity gave the Sun Dragon Deity and Moonlight Dragon Deity life, and all greeted them as comrades.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

26RBS03-016.name: The CurseLady Pienetta
26RBS03-016.effect:
[LV1-2] When Summoned
Target an opposing exhausted Spirit. Send a core, besides [Soul Core], from it to the Reserve. If there are three or more cores in the opposing Reserve, the target becomes any opposing Spirit instead.

SD17-X02.name: The DarknessDemonSword Dark-Blade
SD17-X02.kanji: 暗黒の魔剣ダーク・ブレード
SD17-X02.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Nexus. When this effect destroys any Nexus, draw a card.

[When Braved] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit.
SD17-X02.flavor: One swing from the demon sword suffused with heat and the land will become scorched.

BS72-049.name: The Dana Magic Aidman
BS72-049.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Draw a card, then discard a card from your Hand.

[LV2]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can return it to the Hand.
BS72-049.flavor:
Toa and her party headed for the Eastern region of the Divine World to meet up with Lugh. There, they ran into the scene where Lugh was fighting against Dan. Toa tried to stop the fight, but Nuadha stopped him. Nuadha said that they were not fighting out of hatred for each other. He said that was just Lugh's bad habit. Eventually, Dan and Lugh, who fought with all their might, acknowledged each other.
―Divine World Log 01―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9271.name: The DarknessDemonSword Dark-Blade X
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9271.kanji: 暗黒の魔剣ダーク・ブレードX

[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing Nexus, and the effects of the Nexus destroyed can't activate. When this effect destroys, draw two cards.

You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

[During Brave] [Rebirth5]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can separate and flip this Brave.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9271.flavor: The Darkness Demon Sword that once supported the world. However, its wielder is already gone.

BS74-064.name: The Dana Sniper
BS74-064.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this card is discarded from the Hand by your "Scalostle" family effect, or sent to the Trash from deck by the effect of your "Contractor Nuadha", you can set it without paying the cost. When you do, return your originally set Mirage to the Hand.

[Mirage: Cost 5 ([Blue Core][Blue Core])]
[During Set]
Your "Contractor Nuadha" Grandwalker Nexuses can't be destroyed by opposing effects. Also, your "Destruction Effects" can't be prevented by opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit/Ultimate effects.

26RBS03-X01.name: The DeepRedBladessom Rittenia
26RBS03-X01.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2] When Summoned
Target an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit. Destroy it. For each EX Symbol of "Red Cloud"/"Purgatory Wings" family cards banished via this Legacy, the targeting BP gets +2000.

[LV2]True ReleaseYour End Step
You can send a core, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to this Spirit.

[LV1] (When Summoned)

[During Nexus Brave] 3 Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) Destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total cost of 6.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9275.name: The DarknessDemonSword Dark-Blade X -Rebirth Incarnate-
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9275.kanji: 暗黒の魔剣ダーク・ブレードX -転醒化身-
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9275.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
This Spirit refreshes. Also, during this turn, every Spirit you control gains +10000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Or, you can destroy an opposing Nexus.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9275.flavor: Now that its wielder is lost, it incarnates into a new form, and seeks true strength.

BS65-027.name: The DancerPrincess Hanaka
BS65-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
By discarding your entire Hand (at least one card), draw cards from your deck equal to the number of cards in the opposing Hand. Then, if you have three counters or more, you can exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Including being pre-advent, while you control any "The Flower Partner, Frau", the opponent can't use cards from their Hand outside Flash Timing.
BS65-027.flavor:
"Frau! Use the memory of this Soul Tablet!"
"Thank you, Hanaka~ I can fight on now with this~ Ack-choo~" ―The FlowerPartner Frau―

BS34-CP06.name: The DeepSeaCatalyzer Unato
BS34-CP06.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Catl: Blue] (When Summoned)
If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) was used to pay the summon cost, immediately activate one of your Blue Soul Bursts. After that Burst activates, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
You can set a card with Burst effect from your Hand.
BS34-CP06.flavor:
The guardian that watches over the Blue Seas Province from the coast of the country.
"Pointing your blades at us, is like trying to fight against the raging high tides!"

BS09-018.name: The DarknessEmperor Zanba
BS09-018.effect:
[Tribute: Cost 3 or more → Void]
After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from a Cost 3 or more Spirit you control to the Void.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send a number of cores from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve, equal to this Spirit's level.
BS09-018.flavor: When the Celestial Scythe is wielded by its rightful owner, innumerable lives turn into sparkling stars in one fell slice.

BS21-066.name: The DeepSeaDragon Lovliss
BS21-066.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Return all White/Blue Nexus cards from your Trash to the Hand.
BS21-066.flavor: Those who wander into his territory will fall prey to his sharp pointed teeth or his tail hard as a blunt weapon.

THE-DARKKNIGHT.name: The DarkKnight Palomides
THE-DARKKNIGHT.effect: Immortality: Cost 3 (Either Attack Step) - This Spirit card in your Trash can be summoned when your Cost 3 Spirit is destroyed.
THE-DARKKNIGHT.flavor: The soldiers that were overlooked by the Flame Shield Army while playing dead rose up simultaneously! The pursuit from behind towards the Flame Shield Army who broke through now begins!

BSC45-027.name: The DarknessEmperor Zanba LT
BSC45-027.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Red/Purple & "Braver"] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each LV this Spirit has, send a core from the opposing Field to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each "Braver" Spirit you control, destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate.
BSC45-027.flavor: When the Celestial Scythe is wielded by its rightful owner, innumerable lives turn into sparkling stars in one fell slice.

26RBS01-030.name: The DancingFox Charles de Peta

Legacy

You can target a Cost 7 or less "Dark Puce" family Spirit card in your Trash. Summon it.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9283.name: The Defender Nupia
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9283.effect:
[LV1][LV2] When this Spirit is destroyed by opposing effects, by discarding 5 cards from the opposing decktop, this Spirit remains on your Field, in the same condition.

[LV2] For each "Next Generation" family Ultimate you control, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9283.flavor: You're a Guardian General, aren't you! Fighting against the Ultimates is your duty! And yet you're siding with the Ultimates! Are you trying to betray us!? So you thought you wouldn't be found out on this continent!

BS18-017.name: The DarkKnight Perceval
BS18-017.effect:
[Immortality: Cost 3/4] (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this Spirit card form the Trash when your Cost 3/4 Spirit is destroyed.

[LV2]
When your "DarkKnight"-named Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS18-017.flavor: With the help of the Dark Knights, we were able to secure a place for the peace conference. An Imperial Court uniting the six countries would be established, with the first emperor becoming the head of Flame Shield! If this peace conference fails, war will start up again. That's the one thing I couldn't accept.

BS23-037.name: The DancingWitch Maya
BS23-037.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning a "Behemoth"-named Spirit card, by exhausting this Spirit, reduce its cost by 2.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is also treated as a Green Spirit.
BS23-037.flavor: The collapse and conflict have both stopped, and peace has come. The dance of blessing filled with prayers of hope for the future has begun.

BS68-013.name: The DarkKnight Sagramore

All your [True-Curse] also activate at (Opposing Turn).

BS19-057.name: The Defender of Light Adrian
BS19-057.flavor:
We've arrived at the Country of Pale Blue. Just as its name implies, the sky is bright blue.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, First Day of the Sixth Month-

BS72-020.name: The Dark Blue Water Spirit
BS72-020.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) During your Main Step, by sending one core from any of your "Contractor Nyx" Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void, summon this card from your Hand by paying one cost.

[LV2]

BS72-020.flavor:
You pass each other... before anyone notices...
―Grandwalker Nyx―

SD02-019.name: The DarkKnight Schwart

[LV1][LV2][LV3]

BS40-CP07.name: The DefenseEmperor Gunned Bison
BS40-CP07.kanji: 防衛皇ガンドバイソン

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
By discarding one of this Spirit's pre-Advent cards, this Spirit remains on the Field, refreshed.
BS40-CP07.flavor: It's alright! If it's your shield that we're talking about, no one can break it!

BS30-005.name: The DeitySwordDragon Falchion

Destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9292.name: The DarkKnight Tristan

When summoned via [Immortality], you can summon a Brave card from your Trash, without paying the cost.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9292.flavor: The Knights of the Round Table are searching for something. It seems that it might even have an impact on this battle.

BS06-X21.name: The Deity Catastrophedragon
BS06-X21.kanji: 激神皇カタストロフドラゴン

[LV3] (When Attacks)
When blocked by an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit, refresh this Spirit.

BS73-017.name: The Dark Blue Wind Spirit
BS73-017.effect:
Main - [Mani: "Contractor Nyx", (Your Main Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)

The power of contracts... Should we allow them to have a monopoly? I'm sure you, being so intelligent, understand, don't you?
―Grandwalker Nyx―

P23-08.flavor: Is that being who dropped from the crimson sky our true enemy?

P14-X05.name: The DarknessGuide Rutile

When Spirits with [Rush] you control are destroyed by the opponent, return this Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)

P14-X05.flavor: "I see... Today a lot of people are coming... I've got to work even harder than usual..."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9297.name: The Deity Sieg-Catastrophedragon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9297.kanji: 神龍皇ジーク・カタストロフドラゴン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9297.effect:
[LV3] (When Destroyed)
Put a core from the Void to your life.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9297.flavor: The Dragon Emperor ate the Deity? He's a surprising guy. I wonder if this is the beginning of the end he mentioned... Well, do your best to not destroy the world.

BS67-014.name: The DarkKnight Ywain
BS67-014.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 [Purple Core]]
[During Set] (End of Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, you can summon a Cost 5 or less Spirit card with "Curse"-named effects from your Trash, without paying the cost.

Cost 3 or less (Either Attack Step)

O Seven Shogun, please lend me your power if you could hear me! I am letting you fight with Kingtaurus, your destinied opponent!
―Petit Bat―

BS25-065.name: The Dark Capital Antenora
BS25-065.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)

We've confirmed the existence of the Ultimates' metropolis. I've heard that the ancient writings that were recently discovered are being deciphered here. We must infiltrate this city to obtain them.
—Purple Swamps Site No. 666 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

BS06-075.name: The Deity in the Sacred Mountains

[LV1][LV2]

BS06-075.flavor:
Fighters from different camps gathered here and vowed to fight together against the army of the Empty Sky.
-from the Places of Interest 333/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (When Attacks)
Once per turn, send three cores from opposing Spirits/Reserve to the Trash.

BSC21-005.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Spirit is Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
Send three cores from an opposing Spirit to their Reserve. After this effect resolves, summon this Brave card without paying the cost.

Once per turn, by sending a core from any opposing Spirit to another opposing Spirit, draw a card.
BSC21-005.flavor: This is the DemonBlade that was interred in a previous war by the master swordsmen wielding the Five Dominance Swords.

BS18-016.name: The DarkQueen Guinevere
BS18-016.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing End Step)
If the opponent didn't attack for at least once during this turn, you can activate your Purple Burst, ignoring its Burst conditions.
BS18-016.flavor:
After the birth of the Empire, answering the citizen's call, Dark Shield became the direct territory of Manka. However, Manaka, with no intentions to become a king, left the power of governance of the land to Arthur and his lady. Manaka's great act of selflessness cemented Arthur's loyalty, and thus an ideal administration was born.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Imperial Year One—

BSC48-032.name: The DemonBlade Murasame LT
BSC48-032.effect:
When your Purple-only Spirits are returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects, you can immediately activate this set card.

Send three cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve, and when this effect depletes, draw two cards. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

By sending a core from the opposing Field/Reserve to another opposing Spirit, draw a card.
BSC48-032.flavor: This is the DemonBlade that was interred in a previous war by the master swordsmen wielding the Five Dominance Swords.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9305.name: The DarkReefDiva Seiren

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9305.flavor: Nobody can escape from her tempting. Even so, that might still be fortunate. At least better than becoming the king's slave.

BS27-X01.name: The DarkRideDeity Nemesis

[LV1][LV2][LV3] 2 (When Battles)
Put two cards from the opposing decktop under any opposing Spirits/Ultimates facedown. When those Spirits/Ultimates would leave the Field, the cards under them are discarded.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit is blocked, for every three cards under opposing Spirits/Ultimates, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
BS27-X01.flavor: It's the king of the venom users! So that means the Poison Fang Knights are on this continent too!?

BS53-017.name: The DemonDragon Schwarzione
BS53-017.kanji: 魔竜シュバルツィオーネ

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)

BS53-017.flavor: Got lost in such a strange place...Hey, Alex! Calm down first before you move!

BS74-020.name: The Dark Purple Poison Spirit
BS74-020.effect:
Main - [Mani: "Contractor Nyx", (Your Main Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By destroying one of your "Moirai", send a core, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to your Life.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)

BS74-020.flavor:
The battle between Dionysus and Morrigan ended with Toa's stern rebuke.
―Divine World Log 03―

BS16-061.name: The Dark Clowdy Ogre Island

[LV1][LV2]
When you would destroy opposing Spirits via your Spirit/Magic effects, increase the BP of Spirits that can be destroyed by that effect by +1000 BP.

[LV2]
When your "Dragon Warrior" family Spirit attacks, you can target and attack an opposing Spirit.
BS16-061.flavor:
The Hero Dragon, Manaka's master, also came back from being unconfirmed as alive or dead. The island where he revived as a hero had a deep connection to his destiny.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 645—

BSC25-X02.name: The DemonGodDragonRider Gardea
BSC25-X02.effect:
When your Imagine Brave is summoned, you can summon this card from the Trash, without paying the cost.

[During Brave] [LV3] (When Attacks)
While braved to an Imagine Brave, destroy an opposing Spirit with three or more cores on it.
BSC25-X02.flavor: "It is impossible for novices to master an Imajin."

BS52-015.name: The DarknessKnight Durazal
BS52-015.kanji: 暗黒騎士デュラザール
BS52-015.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
Send the [Soul Core] from the opposing Field/Reserve to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Refresh Step)

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
By discarding a card from your Hand, this Spirit remains on the field, exhausted.
BS52-015.flavor:
Why do the nobles know Alex? With no time to question that, we are attacked by the ones looking for her.
―"Record of Wordly Matters" Volume 1:20―

BS21-068.name: The Dark Coffin Cave
BS21-068.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
All your Spirits' [Curse] becomes "[Curse] (When Blocks) Destroy an opposing Spirit that attacked when the battle resolves at the end of battle."

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When cores on opposing Spirits are brought to 0 by your effects, draw a card.
BS21-068.flavor: Here, it's common to suspend coffins upside-down instead of burying them. There's no real problem with it, except for the occasions when resurrected residents come crawling out.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9313.name: The DemonImperialSword Zanvat Sword
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9313.kanji: 魔皇剣ザンバットソード

At the end of a battle where this Spirit destroyed any opposing Spirit/Ultimate, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

SD17-013.name: The Dark Galaxy of Dust

All your "Terra Dragon" family Spirits gain +3000 BP.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
Refresh three "Terra Dragon" family Spirits you control.

BS22-018.name: The DemonKing Balor

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Separate all Cost 13 or less Brave Spirits. However, the owner moves the core during the separation.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
All Cost 7 or less Spirits can't brave.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By destroying an opposing exhausted Spirit, draw two cards.

SD44-006.kanji: 闇の剣聖トータルエクリプス

BS41-061.name: The DragonEmperor'sPirateCrew Musician Onaga
BS41-061.kanji: 龍皇海賊団 音楽家のオナガ
BS41-061.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The number of cores on each "Pirate"-named Spirit you control can't be brought to two or less by opposing effects.

[LV2]
"Pirate"-named Spirits you control can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.
BS41-061.flavor:
When Alex and co. thought they were done for, there was a group which arrived in front of them. They were the Pirates, who brought along the September Saint Moon-Gennaro.
-from the 2nd section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Blue-

BS10-035.name: The DoctorGoddess Eir
BS10-035.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return one opposing Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2]
When your "Astral Soul" family Spirits are destroyed, put a core from the Void to your Life.
BS10-035.flavor:
Was it just a voice? Or was it a song? The Singing Diva squeezed out one last sound from within her body before crumbling to pieces before my eyes. Her singing voice, the very embodiment of her self-sacrifice, harmonized with the voices of her fellow princesses and resonated throughout the world. As if this song became a worldwide prayer answered, it made the Empty Sky Deity who was destroying everything in sight suddenly stop in its tracks... And that single moment was all the Braver needed.
-from the 12th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS42-063.name: The DragonEmperor'sPirateCrew NavigatorRabu
BS42-063.kanji: 龍皇海賊団 航海士のラブ
BS42-063.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can deploy a Cost 4 or less Nexus card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BS42-063.flavor:
Under the Noble commander's order, Alex had to leave the crew temporarily. In order to support Lolo's revival, in order to gain help from the Blue pirates and the Purple lore keepers. The Blue world was the first destination.
-from section 3 of "New Record of the Strange World" chapter Blue-

BS27-069.name: The DogAstralArmored Tossa-Sirius
BS27-069.kanji: 犬星鎧トサ・シリウス
BS27-069.effect:
[When Braved] (When Brave Attack)
By destroying an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit, put a core from Void to this Spirit.
BS27-069.flavor: I think it's terrible, attacking the weak and absorbing their power.

BS41-060.name: The DragonEmperor'sPirateCrew Sailor Coburn
BS41-060.kanji: 龍皇海賊団 船員コバーン
BS41-060.effect:
When your "Pirate"-named Spirit [advents], you can summon this Spirit card from the Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to another "Pirate"-named Spirit you control.
BS41-060.flavor:
The power is so enormous that it's unimaginable, as the 6 individual Spirits Advents consecutively. The aftermath destroys the entire island. The 6 individuals are called the Vanity Deities. And they are after Alex' life.
-from the 2nd section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Blue-

BS08-041.name: The DogGeneral Cu-Sith
BS08-041.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Holy Life] (When Attacks)

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)

BS08-041.flavor: He's an enemy, right? Then what's with this calm air he puts on? Is this some strategy to win over young women's hearts?

BS41-068.name: The DragonEmperor'sPirateCrew Sniper BlueJoe
BS41-068.kanji: 龍皇海賊団 狙撃手ブルージョー

BSC45-067.name: The DogGeneral Cu-Sith LT

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Ultra Holy Life] (When Attacks)
When blocked, draw a card from the deckbottom; when not blocked, put a core from the Void to your Life.

BSC45-067.flavor: He's an enemy, right? Then what's with this calm air he puts on? Is this some strategy to win over young women's hearts?

BS42-069.name: The DragonEmperor'sPirateCrew Vice-Captain Aozack
BS42-069.kanji: 龍皇海賊団 副船長アオザック
BS42-069.effect:
When the opponent summons any non-"Divine Weapon" family Brave, you can destroy that Brave and summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put two cores from the Void to a Blue Nexus you control.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit. For each Nexus you control, this effect destroys +1 cost.
BS42-069.flavor: For us, the Pirate Crews have paid quite a heavy price after all... You don't really mind? Well, that...that is good to hear...

SD02-007.name: The DogPoliceman Bernald
SD02-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block opposing Cost 3 or less Spirits while exhausted.
SD02-007.flavor:
They said this will be a team battle, but usually when it comes to distance-throwing contests, the bigger you are, the greater the advantage. Looking at the competitors assembled, none of them have enough girth on them to make a significant difference. Does this have incredible rules like "Battle Bowl" after all?
-from the 4th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS41-063.name: The DragonEmperor's PirateCrew Lookout Nekojaja
BS41-063.kanji: 龍皇海賊団 見張りのネコジャジャ
BS41-063.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)

[LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)

BS41-063.flavor: Reinforcements? They're reinforcements? They'll face this fearsome enemy together with us!!? ...No, it's no time for crying! Let us fight too, together with those brave pirates!!

BS43-005.name: The DragonEmperorFlameShield Melt-Zestos
BS43-005.kanji: 龍皇の楯 炎のメルト・ゼストス
BS43-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Destroyed)
Draw a card.

[LV2]
When this Spirit would become a pre-advent card of a Cost 9 or less "Siegfried"-named card, you can ignore the advent condition.

With the escorts' advents, the Siegfrieds of six colors had arrived at the battlefield. Their war cry resonated with the twelve pyroxene stones, bringing about miracle. Six brilliances became one, and Grand-Siegfried appeared.
-from the final section of "New Record of the Strange World" chapter Pyroxene Three-

BS43-004.name: The DragonEmperorLightShield Phegaro-Phos
BS43-004.kanji: 龍皇の楯 光のフェガロ・フォス
BS43-004.effect:

Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Effects of the Spirit/Ultimate destroyed by this effect can't activate. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would become a pre-advent card of a Cost 9 or less "Siegfried"-named card, you can ignore the advent condition.
BS43-004.flavor: Now or never! Siegfried shall advent onto all 6 members at the same time!!

BS43-001.name: The DragonEmperorWaterShield Clio-Wasser
BS43-001.kanji: 龍皇の楯 水のクリオ・ヴァッサー
BS43-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Cards can't be discarded from either deck.

[LV2]
When this Spirit would become a pre-advent card of a Cost 9 or less "Siegfried"-named card, you can ignore the advent condition.
BS43-001.flavor:
The light overflowing from the true Siegfried wraps up the six Holy Relics. And then, the time has come. All the Holy Relics have shattered and the shock blew Alex's hood. A handstand stood up like a long hair overflowing and his fingertips touched the tip of the hair. Two overlapping shadows… The Savior has Advented upon Alex.
-from the 3rd Pyroxene Chapter of the Conclusion in "New Records of the Otherworld"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9517.name: The DragonEvilEmperor Evilfried

[outb]

[LV4][LV5] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Send one core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve.
SJ17-02.flavor: Shishi, the priestess who serves the Evil God-King, is nothing but a temporary form... Behold, my true form!!"

BS39-041.name: The DragonFruitsel Pitajya
BS39-041.effect:

Once per turn, by returning a "Drifting Spirit" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand, this Spirit refreshes.
BS39-041.flavor: This is "Fruits Kingdom"'s secret weapon, dragonfruit. Is it tasty?

BS66-062.kanji: 竜斧槍ドラグハルバード

"Hey bro, that Vina girl there, isn't she cute?"
"Take the fight seriously, little brother."

SD59-003.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Brave's (When Summoned) effect resolves]

SD59-003.flavor:
These foreigners who came from elsewhere are collectively called "the Guests". Seemingly that there is a great number of "Guests" existing in the world. And what surprised me most of all things, is that I seem to be considered a "Guest" as well.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5 Prologue 02―

BS56-014.name: The DragonKnight Haizillion
BS56-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve. While you have a card set, this effect sends +1 core to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] [Rebirth3]
When this Spirit attacks, if you have a Purple Mirage set, you can flip this Spirit.
BS56-014.flavor: "Sir Avalkein has issued the order of not to relax. And it seems that it has been totally correct. A few streaks of light fell from the crack in the sky. I am having a bad feeling about this."

BS56-014-A9531.name: The DragonKnight Haizillion -Dragon-Fused Rider-
BS56-014-A9531.kanji: 竜騎士ハイジリオン -竜合騎身-
BS56-014-A9531.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
Refresh this Spirit. Then, draw two cards.

Once per turn, you can exhaust a Spirit/Ultimate you or the opponent controls. When you've done so, send two cores from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Reserve.
BS56-014-A9531.flavor: A DragonKnight threw himself out from the back of the dragon he rode on. And following that, the dragon swallowed up the DragonKnight. This is the master art, "Dragon-Fused Rider".

SD59-002.name: The DragonKnight Halverdice
SD59-002.kanji: 竜騎士ハルヴァーディス
SD59-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, you can discard three cards from your decktop. Then, you can return a Purple-only card with Burst/Mirage effect from your Trash to the Hand, or set it.

[LV2][LV3] [Rebirth3]
When this Spirit attacks, if you have a set card, you can flip this Spirit.
SD59-002.flavor:
After everything was settled, I learnt a lot of new things. One of them being that the earth, spirits, and everything in the world were creations of Grandwalkers Izanagi and Izanami.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5 Prologue 01-1―

SD59-002-A9533.name: The DragonKnight Halverdice -Dragonized Crystal-
SD59-002-A9533.kanji: 竜騎士ハルヴァーディス -竜化絶晶-
SD59-002-A9533.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
You can refresh this Spirit. Then, you can send cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve until only one core remains.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, you can send two cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve. When this effect depletes, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
SD59-002-A9533.flavor:
However, there are also beings that are unrelated to the Grandwalkers. For example, Alex, and Lombardia.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5 Prologue 01-2―

BS55-015.name: The DragonKnight Hexette
BS55-015.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card. Then, by discarding a "DragonKnight"-named card from your Hand, draw a card.

[During Brave] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "DragonKnight"/"DragonRideEmperor"-named Spirit depletes/destroys any opposing Spirit/Ultimate, send an opposing Life to the Reserve. This effect doesn't stack.
BS55-015.flavor:
The DragonKnights did discover where one of the Grandwalkers was. However, when we reached there, it turned out to be Izanami, who was tied up and bound deep underground, with her power taken away from her.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 4:06―

P20-11.name: The DragonKnight Rabain
P20-11.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this card from the Hand. However, when summoning via this effect, you can only use the symbols of "Evil Shadow" family cards in your Trash for the summon cost reduction.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send one core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve. Then, you can return this Spirit to the Hand. If this Spirit is braved, the Brave remains on the Field in the same state.
P20-11.flavor: That DragonKnight came from the sky. Wait, no. He jumped into the sky...? Whatever. Appearing in front of someone out of nowhere all of a sudden is bad for the heart.

BS55-010.name: The DragonKnight Rideek
BS55-010.effect:
During your Main Step, if you control any Purple Grandstone Nexus, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand/Trash. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)

BS55-010.flavor:
If we are aiming at challenging Chronos head-on, we would need the help from some other Grandwalkers I guess. While I didn't even know such being exists before, the question now is: where are Izanagi and Izanami? ....Would the Dragon Knights happen to know...?
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 4:04―

SD59-004-A9537.name: The DragonKnight Rivalzeed
SD59-004-A9537.kanji: 竜騎士リヴァルジード
SD59-004-A9537.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2] (When Reborn)
Draw two cards. Then, put a core, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to this Spirit.

[LV2] Flash - (When Attacks)

SD59-004-A9537.flavor:
While Swordius drove the obstructors back, they had already completed their mission. The traces of Oracle's power were completely gone.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5 Prologue 07-2―

BS54-014.name: The DragonKnight Ullrich
BS54-014.effect:
Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)

BS54-014.flavor:
It seems that whenever an area vanishes in whatever place among the worlds, the radiance of the gem would increase. If that's true, there are chances that it is linked to the objective of our enemies.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 3:21―

P20-18.name: The DragonKnight Valjet
P20-18.kanji: 竜騎士ヴァルジェット

BS52-016.name: The DragonKnight Varenbaran
BS52-016.kanji: 竜騎士ヴァレンバラン

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

The secret hideout of the Dragon Emperor's Pirate Crew. It is also where the taken treasures are safeguarded. If they found you out, they would hang you onto the mast. So going for a visit is your freedom but go at your own risk.
-from the Places of Interest 150/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

However, the light emitted by the AbsoluteDragonDeity turned out to be destructive rays that wipe out even the mountains.
-Tale of the Dragon Deity 04-

Before seeing their work complete, many carvers had passed on. The tool that they had placed their will into gained new life and moves.

He is a pagan deity that gathers and revives corpses.

The Tenth Radiance is an Evil Deity that warps the boundary between here and beyond.
―"Secret Tales of the Eighty-Eight Constellations"―

From Lolo to Euro. Ahahahaha... ahahahaha.
