[LV1][LV2]
The cores on your Yellow Spirits can't be removed by the opponent.

[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Fairy" family Spirits are destroyed by opposing Ultimates via BP comparison, those Spirits you control remain on the Field, exhausted.
BS27-038.flavor: I wonder if there are idols with the astral spirits too. There are people who look like they could be, but they might just lose for a lack of idols.

BS10-049.name: The FairyPriest Andromeda
BS10-049.kanji: 妖精神官アンドロメダ
BS10-049.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return a Magic card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit gains +1000 BP for each card in your Hand.
BS10-049.flavor:
Because she's imprisoned, she knows what freedom is. Her desire for release calls forth a pulsating power from within.
—from the Andromeda chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9729.name: The FairyPrincess Hama-Dryas
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9729.kanji: 妖精の姫巫女ハマ・ドリュアス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9729.effect: [LV3] All of your "Fairy" Attribute Spirits gain the following effect: (When Attacks) When determining the battle's outcome, if the opponent's blocking Spirit is at Level 1, treat the situation as if you were never blocked, ignoring Battle Point difference.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9729.flavor:
"It's no use... My consciousness is... My life was just saved not too long ago...."
-from the 13th paragraph of chapter Yellow in "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS26-033.name: The FairyPrincess Perfume
BS26-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
At the beginning of the step, return a Purple/White/Yellow Magic card with [Trigger Counter] from your Trash to the Hand.

[When Braved] [LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your Brave Spirits that are braved to "Galaxian" family Braves can't be blocked by opposing Spirits.
BS26-033.flavor: The ones preparing for the second concert are here? They succeeded in composing a song, but what are they trying to do this time?

BSC42-057.name: The FairyQueen Ti-Tanya LT
BSC42-057.kanji: 妖精女王ティ・ターニャLT
BSC42-057.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 2 ([Yellow Core])]
Refresh a Cost 2 Spirit you control. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2][LV3] (Start of Opposing Attack Step)
Send two cores from your Trash to this Spirit.
BSC42-057.flavor: The queen seems to be depressed. The keys were found in other countries but not in her own.

BS69-X08.name: The FairySaint Mcloudia
BS69-X08.kanji: 妖精聖女マクラウディア
BS69-X08.effect:
Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
If every card in your Trash has "Golden Cloud" family, you can summon this card from the Hand, treating all reduction symbols as fulfilled. When you've done so, if there is any face-up card in your deck, during this turn, your Life can't be reduced by the attacks of opposing Cost 4 or more Spirits/Ultimates.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate that isn't on its lowest LV to the deckbottom, and when returns, draw two cards from the deckbottom.
BS69-X08.flavor: "Feaniel, if you ever got into a trouble, I will immediately come to your side!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9733.name: The Fairy Actia
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9733.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) When a battle resolves, if the opposing battling Spirit is 3000 BP or less, that Spirit's attack can't reduce your Life.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step) When a battle resolves, if the opposing battling Spirit is 3000 BP or less, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9733.flavor: Thad was scary... waahhh. I thought the Ultimade had godden you, Euro-chan... Dank you for saving me...... and by de way, do you have any tissues?

BS04-046.name: The Fairy Dorothy
BS04-046.flavor: A pair of glasses is the only thing you need to be popular with men. How simple.

BS03-058.name: The Fairy Tinguly
BS03-058.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
During this turn, all your Spirits are also treated as Yellow Spirits.
BS03-058.flavor: Before you enter the land of fairy, make sure to have someone sprinkle your body with special power. Or, you will get lost easily.

P16-14.name: The FakeGodKing Mikegami
P16-14.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Seal: Seal] (When Summoned)
You can send the [Soul Core](Soul Core) from your Reserve to your Life.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[Seal: When Sealed] [LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
You can summon a "Jade Emperor Dragon"/"God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
P16-14.flavor: An aloof, unaffiliated runner, who calls himself the Cat God-King. He joined the 216th Tournament in order to achieve revenge against Mouchuu.

BS26-008.name: The EmperorDragon Kaiserdragon
BS26-008.kanji: 皇帝龍カイゼルドラゴン
BS26-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal six cards from your decktop. Add any amount of Brave cards among them to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the decktop, in any order.

[When Braved] [LV2] (When Brave Attacks)
When blocked by opposing Spirits/Ultimates with a BP inferior to this Spirit's, send two opposing Lives to their Reserve.
BS26-008.flavor: What, you can read my next move!? Whatever I do, you'll know it in advance!!

BS07-056.name: The Fall of Meteorite
BS07-056.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Nexus is destroyed by opposing Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects, destroy every opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your Spirit with [Clash], destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit.
BS07-056.flavor:
The place where the legendary Meteor Dragon first landed. It became the epicenter of a great natural disaster, but afterwards, it became something amazing.
-from the Places of Interest 35/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

LM19-06.name: The EmperorGrandSpear Alexander Spear
LM19-06.kanji: 大帝神槍アレクサンダースピア
LM19-06.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks)
If this Spirit has two Blue symbols or more, once per turn, by exhausting one of your Grandwalker Nexuses, refresh this Spirit.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field] (Your Main Step)
By exhausting this Nexus, exhaust an opposing Grandwalker Nexus. During this turn, the opposing Grandwalker Nexus exhausted by this effect can't activate its [Grand Field].

BS63-065.name: The FallenAngeliaOfWisdom Raviel
BS63-065.kanji: 智慧の堕天使ラヴィエル
BS63-065.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Number Contract & C2 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can draw a card from the deckbottom. Then, if you've summoned for two times or more during this turn, you can return an opposing LV1 Spirit to the deckbottom.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
If your "Golden Cloud" family Spirit is attacking, you can immediately end the battle.

BS58-003.name: The EmperorSheep Urial
BS58-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as White.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Every Red “Proximate”/“Astroblazer” family Spirit you control gains +4000 BP. While you have a Mirage set, change the "+4000 BP” text of this effect to “+8000 BP”.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can return an "Emperor"-named card from the Trash to your Hand.
BS58-003.flavor: "My Emperor, I will follow you wherever you go, even if it's the far side of time!"

BS04-X15.name: The Emperor Kaiseratlas
BS04-X15.kanji: カイザーアトラス皇帝
BS04-X15.effect:
[Tribute: Cost 6 or more → Void]
After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from one of your Cost 6 or more Spirits to the Void.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, by sending a core from your Reserve to the Void, send two opposing Lives to their Reserve.
BS04-X15.flavor: Even those rowdies are fleeing, saying it's way too big! How could we fight a monster like that? The woods are in danger!

BS55-054.name: The FallenAngelia Lýdie
BS55-054.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card from the deckbottom. Then, by sending a core from your Life to this Spirit, return an opposing Nexus to the deckbottom. You can't activate Burst effects via this effect.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus effects.
BS55-054.flavor: "In our world, the world of Fallen Angelias, the time flows at a different speed. It may just be a short while for you, but to Elneze, it should have been a rather long journey..."

BS64-XV03.name: The Emperor Kaiseratlas XV
BS64-XV03.kanji: カイザーアトラス皇帝XV
BS64-XV03.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Flower Contract/Green Contract Spirit & C7 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Besides [Soul Core], the opponent can't move cores from their Field/Grandwalker Nexuses. Also, the cores on the opposing Spirits/Ultimates that leave the Field are sent to the Trash instead of the Reserve.

[During Advent & During Brave] [LV2] (When Attacks)
You can banish up to three opposing exhausted Spirits/Ultimates with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.
BS64-XV03.flavor: Even Kai's group is fleeing, saying it's way too big!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9746.name: The FallenAngelia Mikafar
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9746.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) Discard any number of cards from your Hand. For each card you discarded, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks) You can use a Yellow Magic card from your Trash as if it was from your Hand.

[LV3] (Either Attack Step) When a Magic effect is used, draw a card.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9746.flavor: She's changed... She's supposed to be an adult, yet she changed completely on a whim...

CB32-CX04.name: The Emperor of Belial Galactic Empire, Kaiser Belial
CB32-CX04.kanji: ベリアル銀河帝国皇帝カイザーベリアル
CB32-CX04.effect:
[Neo-Core Charge:: ("Kaiju"/"Seijin"/"Belial"/"Zetton" & Cost 3 or more, Enemy & Cost 6 or more)]
◆When your target Spirit is summoned, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this Nexus is deployed, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Revive] Main - (Once per Turn: Same Name) You can deploy this card from Soul State.

3 [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) Your counters +2, and return a Cost 3 or more "Kaiju"/"Belial"/"Zetton"/"Giga Battle Nizer" from your Trash to the Hand.

[Contract Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
At the end of the battle of your Cost 5 or more "Kaiju"/"Belial"/"Zetton", you can send a core, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to any Spirit. Then, (Can't Stack) you can send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

BS54-050.name: The FallenAngelia Monokriel
BS54-050.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
During this turn, you can give two opposing Spirits -10000 BP, and destroy them if reaches 0 BP. Then, you can put two cores from the Void to any of your Yellow Grandstone Nexuses.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card from the deckbottom. Also, while braved to a "Primal" family Brave, this Spirit can't be blocked.
BS54-050.flavor: "It is just a matter of time that the Magician Emperor sealed within the Mega-Grandstone would awake. Now pray, druids. That would become the key to save the world."

CB32-001.name: The EmpireMachineSoldier Legionoid
CB32-001.kanji: 帝国機兵レギオノイド
CB32-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Red. Also, when this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, by +1 core to one of your "Kaiser Belial" Grandwalker Nexuses, your counter +1.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.
CB32-001.flavor: A type of mass-produced robot of the Belial Galatic Empire. There are two types of them: α type for ground combats, and β type for space combats.

BS60-055.name: The FallenAngelia Rix-Tetra
BS60-055.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -5000 BP. For each three counters you have, this effect activates once more, and destroy any targets whose BP are brought to 0.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Your counters +2. Then, draw a card.
BS60-055.flavor:
"You want to know about the secrets behind the stone tablets, right? Then, entertain me!"
You want to play dice? Or poker cards?
―The PartnerBird Feaniel―

BS05-064.name: The Empire of Pentan
BS05-064.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn)
When your Yellow Spirits are destroyed, you can summon a "Pentan"-named Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of that Spirit can't activate.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your attacking "Pentan"/"Empereur"-named Spirit is blocked by an opposing Spirit with the same LV, refresh the attacking Spirit.
BS05-064.flavor:
The first royal capital I visited in this world. I think that "lovely" is the best word to describe this place.
-from the Places of Interest 752/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo-"

BS14-087.name: The Empire of Pentan:the Capital Empereur
BS14-087.kanji: ペンタン帝国：帝都アンプルール
BS14-087.effect:
[LV1] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By sending two cores from this Nexus to your Trash, when the battle resolves, compare LV instead of BP, and the Spirit with the lower level is destroyed. If the LVs are the same, both Spirits are destroyed.
BS14-087.flavor:
In all the world, this capital is probably the most peaceful, sweet, and boring.
At the start of the new year, there is a festival celebrating the change of the capital's name. This year, it's Empereur for the third time. Well, whatever works, I suppose.
-from the Places of Interest 717/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9753.name: The Endless Horizon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9753.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (During Your Battle Phase) The BP of each LV1 spirits you control is treated as their LV2 BP in the Showdown Step.

[LV2] (During Your Battle Phase) Each time a spirit you control with High Speed is defeated, you may move more 1 core from your Reserve to your Trash. In that case, the defeated spirit is moved to your hand instead of your Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9753.flavor:
This place is ruled by Hercules. If you wish to visit this place, get yourself captured by them. They will take you here for sure. However, I can't guarantee your safety.
-from the Places of Interest 285/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS29-009.name: The FallenKnight Mammon
BS29-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
For each opposing Spirit/Ultimate with cards under them, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] 1 (When Battles)
Put one card from the opposing decktop under any opposing Spirits/Ultimates facedown. When those Spirits/Ultimates would leave the Field, the cards under them are discarded.
BS29-009.flavor: Hey, hold on? You're all going in? Or rather, falling in!? This is a hole. It's a bottomless hole!

BS70-077.name: The Endless Road
BS70-077.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Spirits would leave the Field due to the opponent, if you control any "Contractor Huracan", you can refresh one of your "Roaring Azure" family Spirits.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While you control any exhausted "Roaring Azure" family Spirits, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

BS28-017.name: The FallenKnight Orcus
BS28-017.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks]
Summon this Spirit card. Then, activate three of your Spirits' [Poison Blade].

[LV2][LV3] 1 (When Battles)
Put one card from the opposing decktop under any opposing Spirits/Ultimates facedown. When those Spirits/Ultimates would leave the Field, the cards under them are discarded.
BS28-017.flavor: "Watch out! Get out of the way before you get poisoned!" Why give me 73 points for suddenly shouting that, Fric?

26RBS02-X03.name: The Enforcer Khonsular
26RBS02-X03.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2]When Summoned
Target an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit. Destroy it. When summoned using Legacy, effects of the destroyed target can't activate.

[LV2] True ReleaseDuring Attack
This Spirit gains +3000 BP.
26RBS02-X03.flavor: Those eyes see right through the sins of those they face. Nothing can escape them.

BS27-011.name: The FallenKnight Ramiel
BS27-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] 1 (When Battles)
Put one card from the opposing decktop under any opposing Spirits/Ultimates facedown. When those Spirits/Ultimates would leave the Field, the cards under them are discarded.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
If there are cards under any opposing Spirits/Ultimates, draw a card.
BS27-011.flavor: The properties of the venom users' poison and the poison of us snakes have different properties. Theirs is slow-acting. That's why it doesn't feel good going down the throat.

BS41-006.name: The EngineBeast Vulcan-Tiger
BS41-006.kanji: 機関獣バルカン・ティーガ
BS41-006.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Emperor Beast] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. For each "Emperor Beast" family Spirit card among them, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Return the revealed card to the deckbottom in any order.
BS41-006.flavor: New reinforcements!? Great, the more allies the better! We'll fight together with the pirates. The Vanity Deities are too powerful!!

BS29-010.name: The FallenKnight Sin
BS29-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2] 2 (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Put two cards from the opposing decktop under any opposing Spirits/Ultimates facedown. When those Spirits/Ultimates would leave the Field, the cards under them are discarded.
BS29-010.flavor: There's a shrine on the mountaintop. Darkness Hole is kept inside this shrine protected by the Knights.

26RSD05-X01.name: The EruptingThunder Palecoeurl
26RSD05-X01.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2]During Attack
This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2]Start of Your Attack Step
During this turn, give every opposing Spirit -2000 BP. Then, if they have 0 BP, destroy them.
26RSD05-X01.flavor: What if thunder and heavy armor charged at you at the same time? You can't stop them, and you can't run away. All you can do is close your eyes.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9762.name: The Exploding Submarine Volcano
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9762.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing End Step) When you have five or more cards in your Hand, discard cards from your Hand until you have four cards in your Hand. When the opponent has five or more cards in their Hand, the opponent discard cards from their hand until there are four cards in their Hand.

[LV2] (Opposing Turn) Treat all the opposing Magic cards in Hand as having no reduction symbols.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9762.flavor:
Once a year, a marvelous submarine volcano erupts at regular intervals. After erupting, a new island forms somewhere within a 10 kilometer radius of it. Are they related by some strange principle?
-from the Places of Interest 290/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS44-008.name: The EruptionDinosaur Stego-Erupt
BS44-008.kanji: 噴火恐龍ステゴ・イラプト
BS44-008.effect:
Flash- [Accel: Cost 5 ([Red Core][Red Core][Core])]
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up on your Removed Zone. If you control any "Terra Dragon" family Spirit with Advent, instead of sending it to the Removed Zone, you can add this card as a pre-advent to it.

[LV1][LV2] While you control any Spirit with Advent, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.
BS44-008.flavor: To fight against the Egytian Dark Snakes, even the Noble Order and the dinosaurs work together.

BS34-CP01.name: The ExplosionCatalyzer Izana
BS34-CP01.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Catl: Red] (When Summoned)
If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) was used to pay the summon cost, immediately activate one of your Red Soul Bursts. After that Burst activates, draw a card.

[LV2] (When Battles)
You can set a card with Burst effects from your Hand.
BS34-CP01.flavor:
The guardian that watches over the Flame War Province from the caldera of the country.
"Dance, O Flame! The Ring of Flames Formation passed down from every generation of War Dragons shall not perish!"

BS28-012.name: The FallenKnight Tums
BS28-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[LV1][LV2] 1 (When Battles)
Put one card from the opposing decktop under any opposing Spirits/Ultimates facedown. When those Spirits/Ultimates would leave the Field, the cards under them are discarded.
BS28-012.flavor: I thought there was data saying that poison was unique to Snakes, but it looks like I was wrong. According to Fric, there are several hundred varieties of venomous Spirits.

BS60-013.name: The EruptionDragon Volcanodosaurus
BS60-013.kanji: 噴火竜ボルカノドサウルス
BS60-013.effect:
(Once per turn: Same Name) When your counter increases and you have six or more counters, if you control any “The PartnerDragon Glow”, including being pre-advent, you can summon this card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can destroy an opposing one-symbol Spirit/Nexus, and the effects of the destroyed Spirit/Nexus can't activate.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, by -1 your counters, it remains on the field, exhausted.
BS60-013.flavor:
Wow~! Soooo big! We gonna get crushed~!
―The PartnerDragon Glow―

BS31-016.name: The FallenMusha Bone
BS31-016.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve. If there is [Soul Core] (Soul Core) on this Spirit, also, return a Purple Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.
BS31-016.flavor: The DarkArtsMagician's soldiers were tired by the innumerable and interminable battles. At the end of an endless battle of attrition, only things on the blurred border between life and death remained on the battlefield.

BS55-048.name: The EternalHero Mibrock-Gamushin
BS55-048.kanji: 永遠の覇王ミブロック・ガムシン
BS55-048.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Return all opposing Cost 6 or less Spirits/Ultimates to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3]
Give every "Supreme Hero"/"Great General" family Spirit you control: "[Heavy Armor: Purple/White] This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects."
BS55-048.flavor:
The enemy boss has completed its transformation and unleashed the power of time which shrouded Alex, trying to complete her brainwashing.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 4:26―

BS28-015.name: The FallenPrincess Elsha
BS28-015.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
You can summon a Spirit card with [Poison Blade] from your Hand. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
All opposing Spirits/Ultimates with two or more cards under them can't activate their effects.
BS28-015.flavor: There are venom-users among the astral spirits too! This is valuable data!

BS23-067.name: The Eternal Deity Capital
BS23-067.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
Return all Cost 8 or more Red Spirit cards from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Give all your Cost 8 or more Spirits: "[Clash] (When Attacks) The opponent must block if possible."
BS23-067.flavor: The Deity Capital has not changed in appearance at all from the past to the present. And in the future, it will continue to last eternally without decay.

SJ18-08.name: The ExplosionHeroGodKing Execeed-Bazzel
SJ18-08.kanji: 爆炎の覇神皇エグゼシード・バゼル
SJ18-08.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Emperor Beast & Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Or, stack it via [Advent].

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When you've done so, at the end of a blocked battle, you can send two opposing Lives to their Reserve. Also, you can immediately activate one of your Bursts.
SJ18-08.flavor: That's an evolved form obtained from getting The ExplosionHero Lord-Dragon-Bazzel's power!

BS29-X04.name: The FallenRideDeity Saturn
BS29-X04.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or higher Spirits]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] 2 (When Battles)
Put two cards from the opposing decktop under any opposing Spirits/Ultimates facedown. When those Spirits/Ultimates would leave the Field, the cards under them are discarded.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, for each three cards in total under opposing Spirits/Ultimates, the opponent discards a card from their Hand.
[utb]
BS29-X04.flavor: There's even an Ultimate in the shrine of Darkness Hole!

BS16-X01.name: The ExplosionHero Lord-Dragon-Bazzel
BS16-X01.kanji: 爆炎の覇王ロード・ドラゴン・バゼル
BS16-X01.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

When you are summoning a Cost 6 or less Spirit card with [Immortality] from the Trash, by exhausting this Nexus, summon that Spirit card without paying the cost. However, (When Summoned) effects of the Spirit don't activate.
BS15-064.flavor:
According to experts, the reason for the appearance of the Vanity Deities was in Dark Shield.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of the Hero Kei, Year 643—

P17-EXG06.name: The ExtremeGiant Exdremon
P17-EXG06.kanji: 極限巨人エクスドレモン
P17-EXG06.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest cost.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - [Extreme Drive] (Opposing Attack Step)
If you banish cards until [Three cards left in your Deck counting from deckbottom & 0 cards in your Trash], discard ten cards from the opposing decktop. When any Magic card is discarded by this effect, end this turn. [Extreme Drive] can only be used once per game.
P17-EXG06.flavor: The party begins! I won't allow anyone to interfere!!

CB01-051.name: The Evil Gathering on the Tower
CB01-051.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
You can discard a "KingDemonBeast"-named Spirit card from your Hand. Activate one of the (When Attacks) effects of the discarded card.

[LV2] (Your Draw Step)
Increase the amount of cards you draw by +1.
CB01-051.flavor:
The juvenile form preserved by Maga-Orochi descended into the Earth's crust, and absorbed Earth itself as its nutrition source. At the tower that stood where eight veins of earth converges, Magata no Orochi appeared.
―Ultraman Orb―

BS65-048.name: The ExtremeHarvestCow Yakushin
BS65-048.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control no Spirits & have 0 Spirit cards in your Trash]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void each to this Ultimate and an "Extreme Contract" family Ultimate you control.

[LV4][LV5] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Holies"/"Incarnate" family Ultimate is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.
BS65-048.flavor:
It has been tens of thousands of years since our home was taken away by the Evil God army. This small paradise is our final stronghold. However, we saw hope. We must make this plan succeed.
—Revelations of the Beginning—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9821.name: The Faraway Ground
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9821.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step) When an opposing Burst activates, unless the opponent send two cores from their Reserve to the Trash, the effect can't activate.

[LV2] When your "Machine Beast" family Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, return one of the destroyed Spirits to your Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9821.flavor:
Near the center of the nation, the Ice Shield generals shared Kei's vision. On the other hand, by the borderlands, the trend of objecting to Kei's power logic strengthened.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of the Hero Kei, Year 645—

BSC31-CP01.name: The ExtremeHeatFreshman Lyrica-Rem
BSC31-CP01.kanji: 極炎の新入生リリカ・レム
BSC31-CP01.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
Return every opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit to the deckbottom, and draw a card. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Only up to two cards can be discarded from either player's deck per turn.

[During Brave] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +10000 BP. When not blocked, this Spirit gains an extra Yellow symbol.
BSC31-CP01.flavor: "I've never really thought about it but... I guess I'm blessed. How about you?"

BS13-068.name: The Faraway Satellite Cannon
BS13-068.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Either player can only attack once with a Spirit that has two symbols.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit attacks, by exhausting this Nexus, return that Spirit to the Hand.
BS13-068.flavor:
The architects of the Lunar Brigade's ultimate weapon could not possibly be these two: a strange penguin astronomer, and a handicraft little fairy with a golden hammer, right?
—from the Telescopium chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS67-X08.name: The ExtremeHolyDragon Chocodraurum
BS67-X08.kanji: 極聖龍ショコドラウルム
BS67-X08.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Holies/Incarnate Spirit/Ultimate, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

When your Cost 6 or more Ultimates [Contract Advents], you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, draw two cards from the deckbottom.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned/Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, during this turn, give every opposing Spirit/Ultimate -15000 BP. Destroy every Spirit/Ultimate that has its BP brought to 0 by this effect.
[utb]
BS67-X08.flavor: The second restored Ultimate Dragon being rolled out after Albedrian.

BS36-020.name: The FarmerBird Hisui
BS36-020.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can brave this Spirit to a Brave on your Field. Or, this Spirit can exchange with a braved Spirit.
BS36-020.flavor: The opening stretch of the Monaca GP course is a city with rows of fairy tale-like buildings. Be careful of the narrow lanes, frequent curves, and devious traps.

BS66-X08.name: The ExtremeHolyMachineBeast Albedrian
BS66-X08.kanji: 極聖機獣アルベドライアン
BS66-X08.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 5 or higher Extreme Contract Ultimates]

(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your Ultimate Trigger is guarded, you can pay two costs to summon this card from the Hand.

[Double Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned/Attacks)]
For each Ultimate Trigger hits, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom. [Double Hit] When it hits twice, refresh an Ultimate you control. [Critical Hit] If the hit card is Cost 5 or more, during this battle, your Ultimates are unaffected by opposing effects.
[wutb]
BS66-X08.flavor: Crafted using the biological data of one of the legendary Ultimate Dragons, the new weapon of the Holies army.

BS68-056.name: The FateAngelia Fortunel
BS68-056.kanji: 運命の天使フォーチュエル
BS68-056.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Heaven Contract & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

(Once per Turn: Same Name) When drawing this face-up card from the deck, instead of adding it to the Hand, you can [Contract Advent] it, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can return an opposing LV2/LV4 Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Your counter +1. Then, draw a card.

P17-EXG05.name: The ExtremeHolySpirit Arkleo
P17-EXG05.kanji: 極限聖霊アークレオー
P17-EXG05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit/Ultimate -12000 BP. Destroy any Spirit/Ultimate whose BP is brought to 0 by this effect.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - [Extreme Drive] (Opposing Attack Step)
If you banish cards until [Six cards left in your Deck counting from deckbottom & 0 cards in your Trash], during this turn, the symbols of every opposing Spirit/Ultimate become 0. Then, put cores from the Void to your Life until you have five Lives. [Extreme Drive] can only be used once per game.
P17-EXG05.flavor: It heard our wish. How humble.

CB16-078.name: The Fate Beyond Love and Hatred
CB16-078.kanji: 愛と憎しみを超えた宿命
CB16-078.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the opponent]
You can summon a Spirit card with [Top Gun]/[Bushido] from your Trash, without paying the cost. When you've done so, destroy an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit. Then, by paying the cost, activate the Flash effect of this card.

[Flash]
You can summon a “Graham”-named Spirit card/Brave card from your Trash. Then, you can flip a pre-Rebirth Brave summoned by this effect. This effect can't be used during your Main Step.

PX26-12.name: The FaultLizard Fault-Geozard
PX26-12.kanji: 断層蜥蜴フォールト・ジオザード
PX26-12.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Gaia" & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

(Once per Turn: Same Name) By destroying one of your Nexuses, [Mani] this card from the Hand, treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[LV1-2-3] (When Manifests/Attacks)
You can deploy a "Primordial" family Nexus card from your Hand/Trash. You can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a number of symbols equal or inferior to the target deployed via this effect.
PX26-12.flavor:
Fault Lizard set out on a great march bearing the weight of the land upon its back.
―Theogonic Record Volume 2―

BS66-057.name: The ExtremeKickingBird Shamopler
BS66-057.kanji: 極蹴鳥シャモップラー
BS66-057.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more “The Extreme Partner, Zetter”, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Ultimate must also be from the Reserve.

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned)
Heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits. Also, during this turn, when your Ultimates would leave the Field due to the opponent, return two opposing exhausted Spirits to the deckbottom.
BS66-057.flavor: "After deploying the new weapon, the tide of battle has turned to our side."

BS14-090.name: The Fearless City on the Ship
BS14-090.effect:
[LV1]
Treat the "BP+ When Braved" of all Brave Spirits as 0.
BS14-090.flavor:
A giant ship that can fit 300 -- of giant size. Currently it has over 1000 people aboard, and it functions as a city.
-from the Places of Interest 529/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS19-092.name: The Feast of the Pastry Forest
BS19-092.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Cards can't be discarded from either deck.

[LV2] (Your Core Step)
When your Life is at two or less, instead of putting a core from the Void to your Reserve, you can put a core from the Void to your Life.
BS19-092.flavor: There are a great many temptations to forget my responsibilities here. Lead into the forest by the smell, delicious-looking sweets were lined up inside.

SD17-005.name: The FeatherDragon Pedopennar
SD17-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Terra Dragon" family Spirits gain +2000 BP.
SD17-005.flavor: A report came from the guardian of the skies stating that the Dark Green Army was spotted. The dinosaurs' morale increased as war approached.

BS63-022.name: The FeatheredSerpent Tlacopan
BS63-022.effect:
When your [Soul Core] is sent to the Counter Area, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
The opponent can't increase cores from the Void via effects.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
All your “Dark Snake” family Spirits/Nexuses/Grandwalker Nexuses can't be heavily exhausted by opposing effects.
BS63-022.flavor: Oh, so a fated match between Bat-kun and Oboro-kun! Oh wow, is that the power of Oracle, Bat-kun? White shield with Black sword! Niceee~ It looks sooo cool! And Oboro-kun is going to fight wearing that skeleton armor? Oh hey, do you want me to help?

BS62-017.name: The FeatheredSerpent Xaltocan
BS62-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
While [Soul Core] is in your Counter Area, when you're summoning/deploying/setting a "Dark Snake" family Spirit card/Nexus card/Mirage card, fulfill one of its [Purple Core] reduction symbols.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
You can send the [Soul Core] from your Reserve/Trash to the Counter Area. When you've done so, you can put two cores from the Void to your Trash.
BS62-017.flavor: Ah ha♪ Is that all you've got, Dan-kun? It can't satisfy me if it's only up to that extent. You should at least be able to beat my friends, Raon-kun and Terad-kun, at ease. If not, how can we proceed?"

BS07-052.name: The Fencer Falconia
BS07-052.kanji: 隼の剣士ファルコニア
BS07-052.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Assault: 1] (When Attacks)
his Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.
BS07-052.flavor:
Compared to all the worlds I've been to before, many opposition forces are being organized here, so I believe it's much easier here to resist the Empty Sky Army. It is exactly that, however, makes betrayal such a fatal miscalculation.
-from the 9th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS77-013.name: The FestivalDragon Shivaratri Dragon
BS77-013.kanji: 祭竜シヴァラートリドラゴン
BS77-013.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Shiva", (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1-2-3] (When Manifests/Destroyed)
You can +1 core to one of your "Shiva" Grandwalker Nexuses.

[LV2-3] (When Attacks)
By putting a card from your Hand facedown onto the Removed Zone, draw two cards.
BS77-013.flavor:
It was inevitable that Shiva, who had set out to make the Uncharted Realm his own, would clash with Qilin Pavallion, which sought to unify it.
―Uncharted Realm Log 02―

BS21-070.name: The Fiana Aircraft Carrier City
BS21-070.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
All your White Spirits gain +3000 BP.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your "Armed Machine" family Spirits, send a core from the opposing Life to their Reserve. This effect doesn't stack.
BS21-070.flavor: A giant aircraft carrier city that stopped functioning due to the effects of the global abnormalities. It now takes off under Kugel-Horn's command.

BS08-009.name: The FieldMarshalEmperor Dragron
BS08-009.effect:
[Tribute: Cost 3 or more → Trash]
After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from one of your Cost 3 or more Spirits to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy all Spirits with [High Speed]. When the [Tribute] was a "Dragon" family Spirit, also, look at the entire opposing Hand, and discard a Spirit card among them.

[LV2] [Clash] (When Attacks)
The opponent must block if possible.
BS08-009.flavor: A matchless warrior? Most likely. If the Oblivion Dragons face him head-on, they won't be leaving without some broken bones.

SD17-006.name: The FierceDragon Lambeos
SD17-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Clash] (When Attacks)
The opponent must block if possible.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.
SD17-006.flavor: Unable to contain their excitement, the dinosaurs self-servingly scrambled toward the enemy lines.

BSC45-004.name: The FierceHeadBeast Horngrizzly LT
BSC45-004.kanji: 猛角獣ホーングリズリーLT
BSC45-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Ultra Clash] (When Attacks)
Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.
BSC45-004.flavor: He remained indifferent to the battle between dragons and dinosaurs,but he seems to be unable to do so this time. It's Brave of him to provoke such an formidable enemy.

BS70-006.name: The FierceStarDragon Stellarwurm
BS70-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Ultra Clash] (When Attacks)
Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3 (When Attacks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.

[LV2][LV3 (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When your "Gekiha" family Spirit attacks, you can draw a card.
BS70-006.flavor: A new Wurm type of dragon that appeared like a meteor. It is said to have a space-travel speed faster than that Meteorwurm.

BS54-TX03.name: The FierceTigerKing's Mega-Grandstone
BS54-TX03.effect:
[GSTrule]

[Release:: (Cores are gained from the Void via your "Primal" family Spirit)]
◆When the Release condition is fulfilled, you can put one core from the Void to this Nexus.

[LV1] [Rebirth5]
When the number of cores on this Nexus becomes three or more, this Nexus can be flipped (all but one cores on it are sent to the Void).

[Grand Mystery] [LV1] (Either Attack Step)
When your Green-only/White-only "Primal" family Spirit attacks/blocks, send two cores from an opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void.

BS10-X05.name: The FallenDragonDeity Venu-Lucifer
BS10-X05.kanji: 堕天神龍ヴィーナ・ルシファー
BS10-X05.effect:
This Spirit card in your Hand can use the symbols on your Field as well as in your Trash for summoning cost reduction.

[When Braved] Flash - [LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
By discarding a Spirit card from your Hand, discard cards from your decktop until a Magic card is discarded, and immediately activate that Magic card's Flash effect without paying the cost.
BS10-X05.flavor:
This grotesque soul was once the lovely DragonDeity of Venus.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS54-TX03-A9847.name: The FierceTigerKing Jade-Gowl
BS54-TX03-A9847.kanji: 凶虎王ジェイ・ガゥル
BS54-TX03-A9847.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2] (When Reborn)
Put any number of cores from your Field to this Spirit/any of your Nexuses. Then, draw two cards.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom. Then, once per turn, refresh a Spirit you control.
BS54-TX03-A9847.flavor: The king of fierce beasts sealed within the Grandstone. Here it shows its rule-breaking violence.

BS52-CP07.name: The FallenHolyStaff Elua
BS52-CP07.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks)
During this turn, give an opposing Cost 1/4/6/8/9/10/12 Spirit/Ultimate -10000 BP, and return it to the deckbottom if its BP was brought to 0.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Galaxian" family Spirits would leave the Field due to the opponent, by sending two cores from this Nexus to the Void, one of those Spirits returns to your Hand.

SJ15-14.name: The FierceWarDragon Tenjou
SJ15-14.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy every opposing Nexus. For each Nexus destroyed by this effect, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending this Spirit's [Soul Core](Soul Core) to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts.
SJ15-14.flavor: "I swear by the very essence of my soul. I shall throw myself into this battle with every fibre of my being!!"

BS27-010.name: The FallenKnight Ariel
BS27-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2] 1 (When Battles)
Put one card from the opposing decktop under any opposing Spirits/Ultimates facedown. When those Spirits/Ultimates would leave the Field, the cards under them are discarded.
BS27-010.flavor: There's a proverb among us Snakes that goes "one may as well saturate themselves with poison if one consumes it." It's a saying that means that just because poison is tasty, you shouldn't have too much of it.

SD29-011.name: The Fierce Dragon Castle
SD29-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your Red Spirits gain +2000 BP. While this Nexus has [Soul Core] (Soul Core) on it, also, all your Red Spirits gain +2000 BP.

[LV2]
Give all your Red "War Dragon" family Spirits: "[True-Clash] (When Attacks) The opponent must block with their Spirits/Ultimates if possible."
SD29-011.flavor: The FlameDragon's howl reaches all the way to the War Dragons' stronghold, with tower- and door-like long castle walls. Its majestic appearance truly resembles that of a dragon's.

BS27-013.name: The FallenKnight Arioch
BS27-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can't be destroyed or returned to the Hand by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
Opposing Spirits/Ultimates with cards under them can't attack/block unless the opponent sends a core from those Spirits/Ultimates to their Trash.
BS27-013.flavor: There are many Snakes who stay single their entire lives. They're free from poisonous attachments. I wonder how it is for the venom users?

BSC48-050.name: The Fierce and Solitary Tiger
BSC48-050.effect:
[Flash]
Deploy up to one "Homura Toshiie" from your Hand/Trash/Soul State, without paying the cost. After this effect resolves, (Once per Turn: Same Name) if you control any "Contractor Homura Toshiie", you can pay two costs to summon a Cost 6 or more "Tiger"/"LeonLancer" from your Hand/Trash.

BS27-015.name: The FallenKnight Azazel
BS27-015.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] 2 (When Battles)
Put two cards from the opposing decktop under any opposing Spirits/Ultimates facedown. When those Spirits/Ultimates would leave the Field, the cards under them are discarded.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with four or more cards under it.
BS27-015.flavor: The motto of the venom users is "let's start with poison."

BS37-017.name: The Fifth's FourDragonHorsemen Black Rider
BS37-017.kanji: 戊の四騎龍ブラックライダー
BS37-017.effect:
Flash- [Accel: Cost 5 ([Purple Core][Purple Core][Purple Core])]
Summon a "Death Dragon" family Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve.
BS37-017.flavor:
The loss of Ourovorius has caused a need to change the plans. But the delay won't be a problem.
―■■■ Report―

BS30-013.name: The FallenKnight Beliard
BS30-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When opposing Spirits/Ultimates with cards under them are depleted/destroyed, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] 3 (When Battles)
Put three cards from the opposing decktop under any opposing Spirits/Ultimates facedown. When those Spirits/Ultimates would leave the Field, the cards under them are discarded.
BS30-013.flavor: Hurry up, we've got to meet up with Antarc and the others! She might have been poisoned, don't you know!?

BS38-012.name: The Fifth's FourDragonHorsemen Blue Rider
BS38-012.kanji: 戊の四騎龍ブルーライダー
BS38-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When your Purple "God-King/"Ten Crown" family Spirit effects would target opposing Spirits, opposing Ultimates can be targeted as well.

[LV2][LV3] (Your End Step)
If you control four differently-named "FourDragonHorsemen"-named Spirits, by sending all cores from an opposing Spirit to their Trash, send a core from the opposing Life to their Reserve.
BS38-012.flavor: To protect their main racer from the attacks of the Evil God Army, "Team Turon" mobilized the FourDragonHorsemen to run parallel as escorts.

P14-24.name: The FallenKnight Harut
P14-24.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
All other "Evil Shadow" family Spirits you control gain +2000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return a "FallenKnight"-named Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.
P14-24.flavor: It looks like the one inside the suit sprouting wings is a venom user. He'll wear away your stamina, so be careful!

BS36-013.name: The Fifth's FourDragonHorsemen Red Rider
BS36-013.kanji: 戊の四騎龍レッドライダー
BS36-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
For each "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirit you control, send a core from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve.
BS36-013.flavor: Racer Amethyst-Dragon has just now reached the goal in sixth place! ... Oh, excuse me. Seventh place. The thing rolling across the goal is apparently a racer.

BS40-073.name: The Fallen Battleship Ruins
BS40-073.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your End Step)
If you [advented] during this turn, you can send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to your Reserve. When you've done so, during the next Opposing Turn, give all your Spirits +5000 BP.

[LV2]
When the opposing Hand increases via an opposing Spirit/Magic effect, for each card increased, you can draw a card.
BS40-073.flavor:
In the past, a world called the "Reverse Continent" appeared in the skies above. This is the battleship that supposedly brought Ultimates from there.
-from the Places of Interest 766/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9861.name: The Fifth's FourDragonHorsemen White Rider
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9861.kanji: 戊の四騎龍ホワイトライダー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9861.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Send two cores from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning a "Death Dragon" family Spirit card/Brave card, you can also use the cores on the opposing Reserve, except [Soul Core], to pay the cost.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9861.flavor: The racers injured by the attack and brought into their pits seem to have had their choice of light equipment for the course backfire on them.

CB15-070.name: The Fallen Futo Tower
CB15-070.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can discard three cards from your decktop. Then, return an "Eternal"/"Dopant"-named card from your Trash to Hand.

[LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
By destroying this Nexus, during this battle, for every five cores in total in the opposing Reserve/Trash, add an extra Purple symbol to an exactly-named “Kamen Rider Eternal” you control.
CB15-070.flavor: Thanks to Kamen Rider Eternal who has collected all 26 Gaia Memories, Futo Tower is destroyed and collapsed together with the falling Kamen Rider W.....

BS39-009.name: The Fifth's ThreeSacredHorses Godolphin
BS39-009.kanji: 戊の三馬神ゴドルフィン
BS39-009.effect:
[Burst: After Spirits/Braves are summoned by an opposing effect]

When summoned from the Removed Zone, you can summon an "Imagine" family Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

BS19-061.name: The Fighter of Light Randall

BS32-008.name: The FightingWarDragon Chougen
BS32-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Catalyze: All Color (When Attacks) By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your trash, immediately activate your set Soul Burst.

[LV2] (When Attacks) Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.
BS32-008.flavor: " I, Chougen, will crush the Six Shogunate underfoot in the skirmish against them!"

BS10-096.name: The Final Championship Flag

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
Put a core from the Void to this Nexus.

[LV2] (Start of Your Main Step)

Together with great glory, the Master Unicorn awards this flag to the champion as proof of victory. It has traversed through every tournament in the Sapphire Realm, given only to the finest competitors. ...Or at least, that's how it would have been before the tournaments got cancelled and suspended until further notice. I would love to get my hands on such a legendary trophy, but its great size may pose a problem for me...
-from the Places of Interest 259/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

CB13-077.name: The Final Light

The rulers of the sky were the first to fight the dragons of the Empty Sky.
-from the 8th paragraph in chapter Red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

Combat Era, August 561. The safeties were off on what would be the fourth and essentially decisive battle.
―from the Kaminakajima Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

Centuries have passed since the footsteps of "Lolo" the Savior of Legend ceased. The Solar Militia and the Lunar Brigade have engaged each other in fierce combat for power for the past decade. —from the foreword of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

Centuries have passed since the footsteps of "Lolo" the Savior of Legend ceased. The Solar Militia and the Lunar Brigade have engaged each other in fierce combat for power for the past decade. I stretched out out my hands as far as I could but they wouldn't reach. And Alex threw the talisman to my hands, while herself got taken away.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 2:27―

Dan-kun, long time no see! Those primordial deities are messing up with our world as well. Which is why, let's fight together!
―Grandwalker Kukulkan―

The lake with silver sand reflects the clear sky. It is said that you won't be able to discern which part the lake surface is up to, and starting from which part it is the sky. It is exactly so even in my mechanical eyes.
―The PartnerMachine Stark―

If we can make Alex's memories return and let her fully use her powers, certainly we can return the world to normal.
――"Record of Wordly Matters" Volume 1:32―

I don't know what god that could have been, but I'm now one of that god's believers... Though it's probably, most likely a goddess.

A splendid Triumphal Arch... Where have I... Is it my imagination? But I feel like I've seen this somewhere before.
—Blue Seas Site No. 075 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

While being the Headquarters of the distinguished team, "Scuderia Maclarn", it is also famous for being a fort city surrounded by gigantic walls.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by summoning a "Shellman" family Spirit card from your Hand without paying the cost, refresh this Spirit.
BS28-X01.flavor: The king in the shadows that manipulates the FourShellSkys!

BS09-023.name: The FortressWorm Ralba
BS09-023.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void each to two White Spirits you control.

[LV2]
This Spirit is also treated as a White Spirit.
BS09-023.flavor: This way, over here! If we move forward together with this guy, we should be just fine, even if we run into the Rowdy Vandals! He may be a giant, but he's gentle, so there's nothing to be afraid of.

CB21-020.name: The First Adams' Vessel
CB21-020.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, by sending a core from this Spirit to the Trash, it remains on the Field, exhausted.
CB21-020.flavor: The form Mark. 9 took in the fight with Wunder. The original lord of Wunder.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9911.name: The Fortress Above the Clouds of Eirein
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9911.kanji: エイレインの雲上要塞
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9911.effect:
[LV1][LV2] When your "Divine Spirit" family Spirit is returned to your Hand/deck due to opposing Spirit/Magic effects, for each Spirit returned, put a core from the Void to your Life.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step) When the opposing battling Spirit's BP is brought to 0 for the first time that turn, draw a card from your deck.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9911.flavor: To tell the truth, the Angelias knew that the Ultimates were coming even before the Dragons. They even secretly built a fortress; impressive, isn't it?

BSC48-031.name: The FlameDragonKatana Onimaru LT
BSC48-031.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, by drawing two cards, during this turn, give every Spirit you control +10000 BP.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) At the end of battle, you can send your [Soul Core] to a Red-only Spirit. When you've done so, refresh a "Concluser"/"Lord"/"War Dragon" family Spirit you control.
BSC48-031.flavor: Widely known as a master swordsman, Muramasa only fought with this sword Onimaru for his entire life.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9913.name: The First Ultraman
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9913.effect:
When summoning this Spirit card, put three cores from the Void next to your deck. The cores next to your deck can only be used by this Spirit's effect.

[LV1][LV2] (Either End Step)
Send one of the cores besides your deck to the Void or a Nexus you control. When the number of those cores become 0, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate, and return this Spirit to your Hand.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9913.flavor:
The Giant of Justice that came from the Land of Light.
―Ultraman―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9914.name: The Fortress Cube
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9914.kanji: フォートレスキューブ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9914.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step) When your White Spirits refresh, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) When your Life is reduced by the attacks of opposing Spirits, return one of those opposing Spirits to the Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9914.flavor: A mysterious six-sided object believed to be a fortress. Wherever you view it from, it doesn't appear to have an entrance though.

BS15-048.name: The FishermanMaster Zigorou
BS15-048.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Start Step)
By sending a core from this Spirit to your Trash, during this turn, the number of cards discarded by your Spirits' [Crush]/[Great Crush] gets +1.
BS15-048.flavor: This is the third time I've been to this country. I wonder if the old man who helped me out of danger twice on my previous two meetings with him is doing well?

BS15-068.name: The Fortress Metropolis Naumann City
BS15-068.kanji: 要塞都市ナウマンシティー
BS15-068.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can summon a White Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of that Spirit can't activate.

[LV2] (Opposing Turn)
While there are two or more colors of Spirits/Nexuses on the opposing Field, for each of such color, increase the cost of all Magic cards in the opposing Hand by +1.
BS15-068.flavor:
This city first came into focus in the year 643, when the Vanity Deities appeared. Kei captured it, but took half a year to do so.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of the Hero Kei, Year 645—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9917.name: The FlameEmperorTigerDeity Blaze-Tiger
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9917.kanji: 焔皇虎神ブレイズ・タイガー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9917.effect:
When this card is revealed from the Deck, or sent to the Trash by your Red effect, you can add it to the Hand.

Flash- [Accel: Cost 4 ([Red Core][Core])]
Destroy an opposing Brave. Or, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with two symbols or more. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[During Brave] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit, and draw a card.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9917.flavor: The king that lost an ancient battle lost his great light. The age of gods was frozen under eternal night. Fire is once more inherited on the land, and a new flame is born.

BSC44-007.name: The FishingArmorBeast Opochtli
BSC44-007.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this card is put onto the Removed Zone via switching in places/revealing by your "Armored Beast" family effect, your counter +1.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can put an "Armored Beast" family card from your Hand onto the Removed Zone. When you've done so, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] [Ultimate Heavy Armor: White/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing White/Blue effects.
BSC44-007.flavor:
Tezcatlipoca, who had sneaked inside the central ground of the Primordial Deities, spotted Uranus successfully. However, he was shocked at the sight of the Grandwalker standing next to Uranus.
―"Theogonic Record" Fragment―

BS09-008.name: The FlameEmperor Agniffon
BS09-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send two cores from your Trash to one of your Spirits.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
The symbols of every "Emperor Beast" family Spirit you control becomes two symbols of the same color as the symbol that Spirit already has.
BS09-008.flavor: Unexpectedly, the Four Emperors have assembled! To lose here will be no laughing matter.

BS24-091.name: The Fortress Metropolis of Eternal Snow
BS24-091.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step) When your Ultimate is summoned, return an opposing Spirit with BP equal or inferior to the summoned Ultimate to the Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step) When your Ultimate reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
BS24-091.flavor:
Fitting for large Ultimates, the fortress we believe to be their base is firmly built and splendid to behold.
—White Lands Site No. 769 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9921.name: The FlameEmperor Kujaraku
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9921.flavor: We've waited long enough. I hope he ends this meaningless battle quickly.

BS70-020.name: The FortuneTellerDoll †Bahia†
BS70-020.effect:
When this card would be banished, you can summon it instead of banishing it.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
You can draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Turn)
When your other "Devotee"/"Concluser" & "Ogre Wizard" family Spirit is summoned, during this turn, the [Grand Field] of every opposing originally Cost 2 or less Green/White/Blue Grandwalker Nexus can't activate.
BS70-020.flavor:
"Hades won't nod his head and allow him back if we can't show any achievements worthy of that..."
I know...This is so irritating, but I guess I'll have to do him a flavor here, sadly. ―Grandwalker Hera―

BS52-038.name: The FloatingFortress Sulphur-Bottom
BS52-038.kanji: 浮遊要塞サルファ・ボトム
BS52-038.effect:
When your counters increase to one or more, you can activate this card, ignoring the Burst condition.

[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via opposing effects]
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. Also, if you have two counters or more, return two opposing Spirits to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.
BS52-038.flavor:
There, I witness an astounding scene: Alex begins to shine and, from an empty space, starts to create a new area.
――"Record of Wordly Matters" Volume 1:27―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9924.name: The FortuneTeller Deasha
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9924.kanji: 魔札の占い師ディーシャ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9924.effect: [LV2] (When Destroyed) The opponent choose a card from their Hand and return it to the decktop.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9924.flavor: A sorceress with the power to wind back time, a power bestowed upon her by the Dark Snakes. Compensation for such power is rumored to be enormous. That skill has finally been unleashed at the heavy price of her own self…

BS24-003.name: The FistBeast Kingroo
BS24-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Neither player can activate Bursts with the condition: [Burst: con] (After your Spirit is destroyed by the opponent) via the destroy of a 5000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Green.
BS24-003.flavor: The fact that Kingroo developed a new technique to employ against Ultimates should come in use for the six of us during our investigation report.

BS06-054.name: The FortuneTeller Pentan
BS06-054.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
By putting a Magic card from your Hand face-up onto the Removed Zone, draw a card.
BS06-054.flavor: The fortune-teller says, "The key is stuck on the inside of the crown." Why didn't that dull king feel anything on his head? On top of that, he's gone somewhere. We must find him.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9927.name: The FlowerMonarch Chikaya
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9927.effect:
[Burst: s] (After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks)
Summon this Spirit card without paying the cost. Then, send a core, besides [Soul Core] from your Trash to your Life, and you can set a card with Burst effects from your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] [catl: All Color] (When Attacks/Blocks)
By sending [Soul Core] from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts. After the Burst activates, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9927.flavor: "Even if you call me The Four Great Generals... I just want everyone to get along."

BS14-066.name: The FistMaster Tiga
BS14-066.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Assault: 2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, twice per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit's [Assault] also activates at (When Blocks).
BS14-066.flavor: He is glaring at me with a belligerent, aggressive gaze. Is Dragon Country really that disliked here?

P16-15.name: The FlowerMonarch Tanpopo
P16-15.effect:
[Burst: s] (After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks)
During this turn, the BP of all opposing Spirits become 0. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3]
While you have a set Burst, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, and your Burst can't be discarded.
P16-15.flavor:
"Everyone get along! Fighting is no good!"
―The 77th Sucessor to the Throne, Tanpopo―

26RBS02-059.name: The Five-InchStake Bisqular
26RBS02-059.effect:
When summoning this card, if you've made two or more attacks this turn, you can also use symbols in your Trash for reductions.

[LV1-2]When Summoned
If you control any "Wailwraith"/"Hexcraft" family Spirit, besides this Spirit, target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, give it -4000 BP. Then, if it has 0 BP, destroy it.
26RBS02-059.flavor: Resentment rarely leads to the right direction.

BSC45-062.name: The FortuneTeller Pentan LT
BSC45-062.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
By exhausting this Spirit, put a card from your Hand onto your Removed Zone. When you've done so, draw a card.
BSC45-062.flavor: The fortune-teller says, "The key is stuck on the inside of the crown." Why didn't that dull king feel anything on his head? On top of that, he's gone somewhere. We must find him.

BS09-049.name: The FlameLizard Cthughma
BS09-049.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can block opposing Spirits with "can't be blocked" effects.

[LV3] (When Blocks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with "can't be blocked" effects.
BS09-049.flavor: What's this?! He wrapped his own body in flames! Such genius! He must have gained this new strategy in Battle Ball.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9933.name: The FiveGoodDragonEmperors Aurelius
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9933.kanji: 五賢龍帝アウレリウス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9933.effect:
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned at Cost 5.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
When summoned by paying the original cost, destroy all opposing Spirits/Ultimates. Then, summon any number of "The FiveGoodDragonEmperors"-named Spirit cards from your Trash, without paying the cost and treated as summoned by paying their original costs.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or more Spirit/Ultimate.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9933.flavor: "For the sake of my empire's prosperity, I shall take the hidden treasure into these hands."

PX14-032.name: The FlowerMoonEmperor Ultimate-Wisteria
PX14-032.kanji: 咲月帝アルティメット・ウィステリア
PX14-032.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 3 or higher Spirits]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, during this turn, all opposing Spirit's level cost gets +2. [Critical Hit] If the hit card is a Spirit card, also, during this turn, all opposing Nexus' level cost gets +1.
[utb]

[LV5]
This Ultimate can't be destroyed.
PX14-032.flavor: It means "never let go" in the language of flowers.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9935.name: The FortySecond's Priest Apsu
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9935.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Both players simultaneously discards a card from the Hand. If the card discarded by the opponent has a lower cost than yours, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with two cores or less on it.

[During Seal] [LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
Send a core from your Reserve to your Life.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9935.flavor:
The clinical study of Imagine-linked specimen "Amethyst" has concluded. I'll entrust later management to Apsu.
―■■nio Report―

BS36-007.name: The FiveGoodDragonEmperors Hadrianus
BS36-007.kanji: 五賢龍帝ハドリアヌス
BS36-007.effect:
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned at Cost 5.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
When summoned by paying the original cost, deploy up to three Nexus cards from your Hand/Trash without paying the cost.

[LV2]
Treat all your "The FiveGoodDragonEmperors"-named Spirits as being on their highest levels.
BS36-007.flavor: The race is in turmoil because of the external attack! Racers Exeseed and Dos-Daimos have fallen behind and are ready to strike back!

BS73-010.name: The FlameMusha Pumaeda-Hidetsugu
BS73-010.kanji: 焔武者ピューマエダ・ヒデツグ
BS73-010.effect:
While you control any "Homura Toshiie", this set card is unaffected by opposing effects.

[Burst: s] (After an opposing Spirit/Nexus' (When Summoned/Deployed) effect resolves)
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total of 15000 BP. For each "Homura Toshiie" you control, increase the limit of this "BP Destruction effect" by +5000.

[LV2][LV3]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Vassal"/"Lord" & "Emperor Beast" family Spirit's "BP Destruction effect" activates, if the opponent controls no Spirits, you can draw two cards.

PX13-03.name: The FlowerQueen Cattleya
PX13-03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
All Spirits can't activate their (When Attacks) effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would be returned to the Hand/Deck by an opposing effect, it remains the the Field, refreshed.

[LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -3000 BP.
PX13-03.flavor: "Nothing comes from war. Everyone, please enshrine the swords."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9939.name: The FortySeventhGeneral Doberdog
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9939.kanji: 庚戌将ドーベルドッグ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9939.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Treat the cost of all opposing braved Braves as zero, and destroy all opposing Cost 6 or less Spirits/Ultimates. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[During Seal] [LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't use Magic cards from their Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9939.flavor: The only one with clean racing in "Wirian", which runs roughly a lot, is Racer Doberdog. It's this sort of individual you want becoming a Twelve God-King.

BSC20-002.name: The FlameSacredBeast Homurawolf
BSC20-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) is used to pay the summon cost, also, you can summon a Red Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When any opposing Spirit is destroyed by your Spirit/Ultimate effects, draw two cards.
BSC20-002.flavor: The story goes that since the braved Sengoku-Tiger was so splendid and heroic, he was permitted the name of Sengoku-Ashliger.

BSC44-001.name: The FlowerWingedSerpent Xochipilli
BSC44-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw a card. Then, if you control any "Contractor Kukulkan", your counter +1.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
You can send the [Soul Core] from your Reserve/Trash to the Counter Area. When you've done so, you can put two cores from the Void to your Trash.
BSC44-001.flavor:
Uru was a small faction located at the middle of the Divine World. And now, a messenger of Hades arrived at Grand-Lolo, the main world of Uru.
―"Theogonic Record" Fragment―

BSC48-007.name: The FlameSacredBeast Homurawolf LT
BSC48-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit, and you can draw a card. Then, if [Soul Core] was used to pay the summon cost, you can summon a Red Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, when any opposing Spirit is destroyed by your Spirit/Ultimate effects, you can draw two cards.
BSC48-007.flavor: The story goes that since the braved Sengoku-Tiger was so splendid and heroic, he was permitted the name of Sengoku-Ashliger.

BS56-043.name: The FlowerWitchGirl Preze
BS56-043.kanji: 花の魔女っ娘プレーゼ
BS56-043.effect:
During your Main Step, while you control any Yellow-only Grandstone Nexus, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
Every Yellow-only Grandstone Nexus you control gains an extra Yellow symbol.
BS56-043.flavor:
The SpacePirates were already attacking the temple when we arrived. While the Dark Artes had the advantage of numbers, they were disadvantaged facing the never-before-seen technology used by the SpacePirates. And that's "Mirage"! Mandi and the rest of the Spacetime Police joined the battle. This is a battle of future.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5:14―

PX13-01.name: The FlameSaintBeast Ignis-Tiger
PX13-01.kanji: 焔聖獣イグニス・ティーガー
PX13-01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Main Step)
Neither player can add cores from the Void.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would be returned to the Hand/Deck due to opposing effects, it remains on the Field, refreshed.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy two opposing 3000 BP or less Spirits.
PX13-01.flavor: This holy beast's flames are said to be the best for forging swords. I'll have to obtain them one way or another.

BS10-092.name: The Flower Garden with the Daystar
BS10-092.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
In addition to the symbols on your Field, you can also use the symbols of cards in your Trash for summon cost reduction of Yellow Spirit cards in your Hand.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
When your "Astral Deity"/"Galaxian"/"Astral Soul" family Spirit is summoned, send a core from your Reserve to your Life.
BS10-092.flavor:
This flower garden actually changes, showing a different face between day and night. Personally, I prefer the night version.
-from the Places of Interest 507/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS36-009.name: The FiveGoodDragonEmperors Nerva
BS36-009.effect:
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned at Cost 5.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
When summoned by paying the original cost, exhaust all opposing Spirits.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing braved Brave. Or, destroy an opposing Nexus.
BS36-009.flavor: Proceeding at top form, Racers Exeseed and Dos-Daimos have left the group and take the lead! The race is just getting started; is there anyone who can stop them!?

SD40-003.name: The FlameSannin Izayoi of the GreatShuriken
SD40-003.kanji: 焔三忍 大手裏剣のイザヨイ
SD40-003.effect:
Flash- [Accel: Cost 4 ([Red Core][Red Core])]
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with two symbols or more. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
You can summon a "Ninja Gale" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
SD40-003.flavor: The consecutive cooperate attack from Hokage and the three ninjas (Sannins) ! Wait, they already attacked right? It is too fast that it can't even be seen.

BS36-008.name: The FiveGoodDragonEmperors Pius
BS36-008.effect:
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned at Cost 5.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
When summoned by paying the original cost, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 15000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit attacks, by returning one of your "The FiveGoodDragonEmperors"-named Spirits to the Hand, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a BP total equal to the returned Spirit's BP.
BS36-008.flavor: We haven't caught up with the evacuation of the spectators in the city yet... Tonio-san, please report from the scene!

BS39-022.name: The FortySeventhSoldier Pursuer-Borzoi
BS39-022.kanji: 庚戌兵パーシュアー・ボルゾイ
BS39-022.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Opposing Bursts can't activate.
[Rush: Blue]
(While you have a Blue symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Blue Core]: The opponent can't use Magic cards from their Hand.
BS39-022.flavor: Oh, racer Doberdog seems to be disagreeing with racer Greedog on something. Whoa, racer Borzoi gave me a death glare. Scary, scary.

BSC49-080.name: The Flower Garden with the Daystar LT
BSC49-080.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When you're summoning any Yellow-only card, you can also use symbols of the cards in your Trash to reduce the cost.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
Once per turn, when your "Astral Soul"/ "Astral Deity"/ "Galaxian" family Spirit is summoned, you can send a core, besides [Soul Core], from your Reserve to your Life. When you've done so, if your Hand is five or less, you can draw a card.
BSC49-080.flavor:
This flower garden actually changes, showing a different face between day and night. Personally, I prefer the night version.
-from the Places of Interest 507/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

SD40-002.name: The FlameSannin Kayaku of the Explosion
SD40-002.kanji: 焔三忍 発破のカヤク
SD40-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Ignoring the "BP +" of Braves, by destroying an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit, draw a card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Green.
SD40-002.flavor: It is the three ninjas (Sannin) that directly under the head who discovered the intruders? Elites as expected.

BS36-026.name: The FourthKnightCaptain Inuwasher
BS36-026.kanji: 丁騎士長イヌワッシャー
BS36-026.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the opponent]
Exhaust an opposing Spirit, and you can summon a "God-King" family Spirit card that was depleted/destroyed when this Burst activates from your Trash, without paying the cost. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
At the end of battle, by setting this Spirit as a Burst, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
BS36-026.flavor: Though Racer Gale-Phoenix damaged his wings in battle, with the support of Racer Wedgetail, he managed to slide into 10th place.

CB22-054.name: The Four-Dimensional Kaiju Bullton［First Generation Ultra Kaiju］
CB22-054.kanji: 四次元怪獣ブルトン［初代ウルトラ怪獣］
CB22-054.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your effect exhausts any opposing Spirits, put a core from the Void to any "First Generation Ultra Kaiju"-named Spirit/Grandwalker Nexus you control.

[LV2]
