BS39-058-A10048.flavor: Racer Avalanche-Bison has gone through the battle with the Four Demon Lords with light wounds. It was thought he'd also stick to protecting, but he returns to the race.

BS28-066.name: The Flaming Divine Sword
BS28-066.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When you set Burst, draw a card. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2]
When your Ultimate card is being summoned via a Burst effect, ignore the summon condition.
BS28-066.flavor:
Something almost the same exists in our world as well. As I thought, are the Skylands a copy of our own continent?
—Red Plains Site No. 912 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10050.name: The Fourth's HoppingBeast Rocket-Rex
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10050.kanji: 丁の跳獣ロケット・レッキス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10050.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
The opponent exhausts two of their Spirits.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When it's the first attack of your turn, this Spirit refreshes.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10050.flavor: The race circling through islands is finally at its end. At the long bridge connecting to the main island, the long-awaited Racer Tiamadou enters the battle for the top! Throwing down her weapons, she seems ready for a fair and square match! However, Racer Gale-Phoenix mysteriously loses speed... A disturbing development!

26RBS02-X14.name: The FlashFuryPrincess Soljuret
26RBS02-X14.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2] Your Attack Step
When you make the second or subsequent attack of the turn, if the Spirit that attacks has the "Wailwraith"/"Hexcraft" family, target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, give it -4000 BP. Then, if it has 0 BP, return it to the deckbottom.

[LV2] True ReleaseDuring Attack [Invoke: Flash] Once Per Turn
Return one of your Cost 6 or less Spirits to the Hand ▶ During this turn, this Spirit gains an extra Yellow symbol.
26RBS02-X14.flavor: "The credit is all ours! We aren't giving it to any dolls or lizards."

BS38-016.name: The Fourth's RuinSnake Ruin Eel
BS38-016.kanji: 丁の遺跡蛇ルインイール
BS38-016.effect: When your "Death Dragon"/"Dark Snake" family Spirit effect depletes any opposing Spirits/Ultimates, you can summon this Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BS38-016.flavor: Racer Tiamadou mows down the Evil God Army in her way, clearing a path for the race and taking the lead! Further, racer Ruin Eel, following after racer Tiamadou, finishes off the Evil God Army and swallows them whole! It's frightening, but reassuring!!

BS70-039.name: The FrostyGreatFairy Breg
BS70-039.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - [Silver Wheel]
You can exhaust this Spirit. When you've done so, you can put a core from the Void each to this Spirit and another "Frostling" family Spirit you control.

[LV2][LV3]
When your "Frostling" family Spirits would leave the Field due to opposing effects, by sending a core, besides [Soul Core], from your Spirits to the Void, one of those Spirits remains on the Field, in the same condition.
BS70-039.flavor:
I am Brigit, a Celtica Grandwalker. At the request of my friend Toa, I take the liberty of assisting you!
―Grandwalker Brigit―

BS23-X08.name: The FlashSoulBlade Lightning-Shion
BS23-X08.kanji: 紫電の霊剣ライトニング・シオン
BS23-X08.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve, and draw a card.

[When Braved] [Charge]
Your non-Ultimate "core removal effects" send +1 core to the Reserve.

[When Braved] (When Attacks)
Treat this Spirit's color as colorless.
BS23-X08.flavor: The blade arrayed in lightning becomes invisible, and with one swing, burns the enemy to a crisp with its veiling flash.

BS35-025.name: The FourthKnight Chevalier
BS35-025.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Exhaust an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) was used to pay the summon cost, instead, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BS35-025.flavor: A fierce wind is raging right above the competitors in the opening mountain area, and the racers of Fordelia Wings are having a tough time!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10056.name: The FlashSoulBlade Lightning-Shion X
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10056.kanji: 紫電の霊剣 ライトニング・シオンX
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10056.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Send three cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve, and draw a card.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Treat this Spirit's color as colorless. Also, send two cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve.

[During Brave] [Rebirth5]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can separate and flip this Brave.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10056.flavor: The FlashSoulBlade that once supported the world. However, its wielder is already gone.

BS37-032.name: The FourthKnight Heavyquick
BS37-032.kanji: 丁騎士ヘビークイック
BS37-032.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Spirit is destroyed by the Opponent)
You can summon a Brave card and a "Winged Beast" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[When Braved] [LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Put two cores from the Void to any of your Spirits.
BS37-032.flavor: "Fordelia Wings"' Racer Air Eraser rides on the wind and gains position in a moment! Will it be able to aim for the rankings?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10058.name: The FlashSoulBlade Lightning-Shion X -Rebirth Incarnate-
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10058.kanji: 紫電の霊剣 ライトニング・シオンX -転醒化身-
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10058.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
During this turn, this Spirit's color is treated as colorless. Also, send three cores from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Reserve, and for each Spirit/Ultimate depleted, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit's color is treated as colorless. Also, send three cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10058.flavor: Now that its wielder is lost, it incarnates into a new form and exerts its power; all the while wandering in the gap between White and Black...

BS70-043.name: The FrostyGunFairy Wesba
BS70-043.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Brigit" & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Manifests)
Your counter +1, and return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus to the deckbottom. Then, if you have five counters or more, and it's the opposing Attack Step, immediately end the battle.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Discard an opposing Burst.
BS70-043.flavor:
Spinning of wheels is the law of this world!
―Grandwalker Brigit―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10060.name: The FlashSwordMaster Dorsalis
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10060.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) You can summon a Green "Exalted Sword" family Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks) Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[LV3] [When Braved] (Your Attack Step) You can change the target of this Spirit's "Exhausting opposing card effects" from Spirits to Ultimates.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10060.flavor: He's for protecting! He's for protecting the supporting sword! He's a friend, a friend!! He's probably our ally!!

BS54-016-A10061.name: The FlashingDragonKnightChief Jean-Valjean
BS54-016-A10061.kanji: 飛電の竜騎士長ジャンヴァルジャン
BS54-016-A10061.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
You can summon up to two non-Cost 5 "DragonKnight"-named Spirit cards from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirits can't activate. Then, if it is your Attack Step, for each Spirit summoned by this effect, send a core from the opposing Field to the Trash.
BS54-016-A10061.flavor: "No worries. Leave the matter of Grandstone to us. For the matter of the world, we would count on you!"

BS76-036.name: The FrostyHarpFairy Harpian
BS76-036.kanji: 霜の琴妖精ハーピアン
BS76-036.effect:
[LV1-2-3] Flash - [Silver Wheel]
You can exhaust this Spirit. When you've done so, (Once per Turn: Same Name) you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add every "Contractor Brigit" to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2-3] White/Yellow
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing White/Yellow Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.
BS76-036.flavor:
Brigit, Morrigan! We're in a good spot now, so please cooperate for a second!
―Contractor Toa―

26RBS02-075.name: The Floating Crag Citadel
26RBS02-075.effect:
[LV1-2] When Deployed
Target one of your Spirits. During this turn, give it: "[Clash] During Attack Opposing Spirits must block if possible."

[LV2] Your Attack Step
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your Spirit, target one of your Spirits. During this turn, give it +5000 BP.
26RBS02-075.flavor: "Drive the Floating Crag Citadel forward! Support the charge!"

26RSD09-010.name: The Floating Crag Link
26RSD09-010.effect:
[LV1-2] Your Main Step
If your Life is at two or less, this Nexus gains an extra Red symbol.

[LV2] Your Attack Step [Invoke: Flash]
Send your [Soul Core] to the Trash ▶ Target one of your Spirits. During this turn, give it +3000 BP.
26RSD09-010.flavor:
"One day, we'll link together even more crags to make a huge nest!"
"By then, there might not be any crags left to link together, though"
— from the Casual Chat of Spirits

26RBS01-092.name: The Floating Grove
26RBS01-092.effect:
[LV1-2] When Deployed
Target an opposing 2000 BP or less Spirit. Destroy it.

[LV2] Your Attack Step
When your Red Spirits make the first attack of the turn, target one of those Spirits that attacked. During this battle, it gains +2000 BP.
26RBS01-092.flavor:
A gentle, soothing breeze was blowing. I couldn’t help but recall the wind from where I used to be.
―from the Foreigner's Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

BS22-070.name: The Floating Island on the Mercury Sea
BS22-070.kanji: 水銀海に浮かぶ工場島
BS22-070.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn)
When the opposing Hand is increased via an opposing effect, for each card increased, the opponent discards a card from their Hand.

[LV2]
Give every Purple/White Spirit you control: "[Heavy Armor: Purple/White] This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects."
BS22-070.flavor: In the past, weapons were manufactured on this factory island. Now that it has been abandoned, it has become the home of the mechanical beasts.

BS70-037.name: The FrostyHeavenFairy Disel
BS70-037.kanji: 霜の空妖精ディッセル
BS70-037.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The number of cores on your "Frostling" family Spirits can't be brought to less than three due to opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2] Flash - [Silver Wheel]
You can exhaust this Spirit. When you've done so, if you control any "Contractor Brigit", return an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.
BS70-037.flavor:
While war rages throughout Olym, Dan and his range team took on the wanted Star Destroying Beast. But soon, Dan and his team got into a hard struggle against the power which destroyed even the stars. And at that moment, Toa and Brigit intervened.
―Theogonic Records Volume 3―

BS70-044.name: The FrostyHeavenFairy Faezel
BS70-044.kanji: 霜の空妖精フェーゼル
BS70-044.effect:
When this card is discarded by an opposing "deck discarding effect", you can return up to five cards from your Trash to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can put two cores from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - [Silver Wheel]
You can exhaust this Spirit. When you've done so, the opponent discards cards from their Hand until their Hand is four.
BS70-044.flavor:
Brigit, help us please! Let's beat that biggg guy together! ―Contractor Toa―
No problem. Let's show our power in front of everyone from Olym!―Grandwalker Brigit―

BS42-085.name: The Floating Jade Black Castle
BS42-085.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Shellman" family Spirit refreshes, exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Shellman" family Spirit attacks, you can reveal a card from your decktop. If that card is a Brave card, summon it without paying the cost. Discard any remaining cards.
BS42-085.flavor:
A castle of residence prepared by the Empress who found the great empire in the past, in order to live with her beloved husband. However, she died before the castle was completed and didn't get to live inside.
-from the Places of Interest 654/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BS64-076.name: The Floating Mass of Cloud
BS64-076.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Red Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By discarding a card from your Hand, activate one of your [Dragon Awaken], ignoring the "once per turn".

[LV1] (Either Attack Step)
Your "Scarlet Flame" family Spirits can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.
BS64-076.flavor:
A large mass of cloud appeared in the sky of Lecoulis ever since the Judgment Day. It's said that one of the 20 Legend Spirits fell from the sky is lying dormant in its central region.
―Travelogue of the Collapsing World 015―

26RSD01-011.name: The Floating Stone Realm
26RSD01-011.effect:
[LV1-2] When Deployed
If you control any exhausted Red Spirit, target a Cost 4 or less "Windfang" family Spirit card in your Trash. Return it to the Hand.

[LV2] Your Attack Step
All your Spirits with Legacy gain +2000 BP.
26RSD01-011.flavor: This is the realm of the red sky. It is a paradise for those who flap their wings, soar and fly.

BS70-045.name: The FrostyHeavenFairy Lemusir
BS70-045.kanji: 霜の空妖精レムシール
BS70-045.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks]
Refresh all your Spirits/Nexuses with [Silver Wheel], and during this turn, all the targets that refreshed are unaffected by opposing effects. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - [Silver Wheel]
You can exhaust this Spirit. When you've done so, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BS70-045.flavor:
Under the cooperation between Apollon's astral dragon team led by Dan and the Celtica Expeditionary Force led by Toa and Brigit, Chimestellar was successfully defeated.
―Theogonic Record Volume 3―

BS70-036.name: The FrostyLittleFairy Tink
BS70-036.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Flash - [Silver Wheel]
You can exhaust this Spirit. When you've done so, if you control any "Contractor Brigit", put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] Red/Purple
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.
BS70-036.flavor:
Toa and her Contract Spirits arrived at the Divine World via a special method. They appeared in the northern region of the Divine World. Toa was lucky enough to be saved by Grandwalker Brigit, and brought to the Celtica Union for refuge. She despaired, however, after learning that she would need to travel far away to the central region of the Divine World to tell Dan the information she gathered about the Contract Mediation Agency.
―"Theogonic Record" Fragment―

BS70-042.name: The FrostySwordFairy Meltica
BS70-042.kanji: 霜の剣妖精メルティッカ
BS70-042.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] Purple/Yellow
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Yellow Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.

[During Brave] [LV3]
While braved to "The SilverRingSword Silverwheel", this Spirit gains Red/Green/White.
BS70-042.flavor:
Dan, I've come to the Divine World too! And umm, this is new but, the Contract Mediation Agency is related to the Primordial Deities! Let's question Uranus!
―Contractor Toa―

BS62-067.name: The Frozen City Rhysgrad
BS62-067.kanji: 氷結都市リースグラード
BS62-067.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
This Nexus' symbol is fixed as three White symbols. Also, (Once per Turn: Same Name), including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any White Contract Spirit, when your Spirit is summoned, your counter +1.

[LV2]
Give every "Silver Contract" family Spirit you control: "[Heavy Armor: Purple] This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects."
BS62-067.flavor:
It's an emergency!! The High Priestess!!
―The PartnerMachine Stark―

BS40-072.name: The Frozen Ocean
BS40-072.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Your Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV2]
Give all your [During Advent] Spirits: "Purple/Yellow This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Yellow Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects."
BS40-072.flavor:
The Great Collapse caused motion around the entire White World to become sluggish as if time had stopped for it. This wave is a representative example; though it looks like it is stopped, it actually moves a few millimeters per day.
-from the Places of Interest 163/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BS43-084.name: The Frozen Volcano
BS43-084.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn)
When the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect, for each card increased, the opponent discards a card from their Hand.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit attacks, refresh a "Machine Beast" family Spirit you control.
BS43-084.flavor:
Since the mythical age, when even the air was frozen and stale, the mountain range has been covered with never-melting ice. Even when there is Volcano, and there is magma erupting, the ice will never melt.
-The Places of Interest 702/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BS76-073.name: The Fruit of Argent Wise Tree
BS76-073.effect:
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, while you control any "The ArgentIronKnight Yggdrasil", this card in Hand becomes Cost 4.

[LV1-2] (Opposing Turn)
When either your Life is reduced, or this Nexus is exhausted by your "Argent" effect, you can put a core from the Void to this Nexus.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
Refresh up to nine of your "Argent".
BS76-073.flavor:
The sapling of the Wise Tree was brought into the White World at a certain point of time. And now, having overcome the cold, it has grown into a fine tree.<
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 081―

BS25-066.name: The Fruit of Emerald Agrimony
BS25-066.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
All your battling Spirits/Ultimates gain +2000 BP.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When the Ultimate Trigger of your Green Ultimates hits, return one Spirit card/Ultimate card with [High Speed] from your Trash to the Hand.
BS25-066.flavor:
We have found a mysterious plant which is a staple of some of the Ultimates who boast of their overwhelming speed. There are no brave souls among us who have tried to pick and eat its fruit.
—Green Forests Site No. 447 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

BS52-062.name: The Fruit of Life -Original Seed-
BS52-062.effect:
[LV1] [Rebirth3]
When either an opposing Spirit exhausts, or this Nexus would leave the Field due to opposing effects, it can be flipped. When it is, put a core from the Void to this now-Reborn Spirit.

[LV1] (Opposing Attack Step)
Your Life can't be reduced by opposing effects, and when your Life is reduced by the opponent, draw a card.
BS52-062.flavor:
"Fruit of Life" is just a name I made up by myself, it refers to a tree which grows fruits that produce an extract that reinvigorates Spirits.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 1:12―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10081.name: The Fruit of Life Rookery
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10081.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step) After you summon an Ultimate, move 1 core from the Void to your Reserve. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) When your Life is decreased, for each Life decreased, draw 1 card from your deck.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10081.flavor: That's strange... I heard they were under siege by Ultimates, but I can't see a trace of upheaval... Can it be that they too have intelligence and pick where they destroy? No, I can't believe it.

BS17-066.name: The Fruit of Saint Tree
BS17-066.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by opposing Spirits, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2] (Opposing Main Step)
When the opponent uses Magic cards for two times or more, after the effect resolves, end the opposing Main step.
BS17-066.flavor:
There is a treasured tree fruit in Wind Shield that is said to be able to restart a heart once stopped. In 100 years, only 5 such precious fruits would mature. Manaka was entrusted with two of them, all so he could vanquish the Vanity Deities.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 643—

BS36-044.name: The Fruitsel La-Fran
BS36-044.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Meal: Cost 5 or less] (When Summoned)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon one Cost 5 or less "Drifting Spirit" family Spirit card, without paying the cost. Discard any unsummoned or remaining cards.
BS36-044.flavor: Racer Fromage is the prince of the GourmetFairies. In her motherland of Monaca, we can expect a race where she makes full use her home advantage.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10087.name: The Fruitsel Lemonade
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10087.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Meal: Cost 1/5] (When Summoned)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon one Cost 1/5 "Drifting Spirit" family Spirit card, without paying the cost. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] (When Destroyed)
During this turn, an opposing Spirit's/Ultimate's BP becomes 1000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10087.flavor:
Trickster didn't know the method to revive Lolo the Savior. However, she remembered Lolo's words. That the Snakekind of Purple know of many things... Alex's new destination had been decided.
-from the 2nd section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Yellow-

BS36-039.name: The Fruitsel Momopeach
BS36-039.effect:
When this Spirit card is discarded by an opposing "deck discarding effect", you can return all cards from your Trash to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV1][LV2]
Neither player's deck can be discarded from.
BS36-039.flavor: The stage of the fourth match in the BSGP is a city with sweet smells and colorful buildings. It's the land of treats and fairies, Monaca.

BS38-035.name: The Fruitsel Nanaba
BS38-035.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Meal: Cost 2/4/6] (When Summoned)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon one Cost 2/4/6 "Drifting Spirit" family Spirit card, without paying the cost. Discard any unsummoned or remaining cards.
BS38-035.flavor: I'm heating things up intensely with my live coverage of both the race and battle! I'll break for the moment. Bananas are effective nutritional supplements.

BS35-050.name: The Fruitsel Orangeo
BS35-050.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Meal: Cost 6 or less] (When Summoned)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon one Cost 6 or less "Drifting Spirit" family Spirit card, without paying the cost. Discard any unsummoned or remaining cards.
BS35-050.flavor: "Fruits Kingdom"'s pit has a niiice aroma. They're an unknown team due to being first participants, but as far as supplies go, they're perfect!

BS37-058.name: The Fruitsel Papaiyan
BS37-058.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Drifting Spirit" family Spirits are comparing BP, reveal a card from the opposing decktop. When that card is a Spirit card, without comparing BP, treat your attacking Spirit as if it weren't blocked. Return the revealed card to the deckbottom.
BS37-058.flavor: Among the "Fruits Kingdom" racers, there are also ones who specialize in temperate regions.

BS35-047.name: The Fruitsel Ringostar
BS35-047.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Meal: Cost 4 or less] (When Summoned)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon one Cost 4 or less "Drifting Spirit" family Spirit card, without paying the cost. Discard any unsummoned or remaining cards.
BS35-047.flavor: Whoa, Racer Ringostarr, as if running away from Racer Patissiere behind him, fiercely dashes! No, this could actually be running away, maybe. It'd be good if he continued in this fashion until reaching the goal.

BS40-050.name: The Fruitsel Star-Ruit
BS40-050.kanji: 果物人スター・ルーツ
BS40-050.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Meal: Cost 6 or less] (When Summoned)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon one Cost 6 or less "Drifting Spirit" family Spirit card, without paying the cost. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3]
While you control five or more "Drifting Spirit" family Spirits, this Spirit gains +15000 BP and an extra Yellow symbol.
BS40-050.flavor:
The Emperor now accompanying them claimed to know a legendary companion. Having discovered their greatest clue yet, they decided to next venture to the Yellow World.
-from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter White-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10099.name: The Fruitsel Straw-Berry
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10099.kanji: 果物人ストロ・ベリィ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10099.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Meal: Cost 2 or less] (When Summoned)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon one Cost 2 or less "Drifting Spirit" family Spirit card, without paying the cost. Discard any unsummoned or remaining cards.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10099.flavor: "Fruits Kingdom" is a team centered around Fruitsels. Previously they participated as the participating racers' alimentation, but now they're participating as racers. I'm already looking forward to what sort of racing they will do.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10100.name: The Fruitsel Suikadon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10100.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
For each "Drifting Spirit" family Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +2000 BP.

The race is over, and Queen Mangosteena presents the victory with a bouquet. Ah, Racer Mouchuu?
"There's no time for that! Scurry up and make Seburn a GodKing!"

BS70-014.name: The GardenerDoll †Bamboo†

Receiving the news of an incoming large-scale invasion of the Primordial Deities, Hades called upon all the Grandwalkers. And under Hades' command, Poseidon, Demeter, Artemis, and Dionysus, each given an army of a million, were deployed at various regions.
―Theogonic Record Volume 3―

When discovered, this fruit was mistaken for the fruit of the World Tree. It tastes extremely sour.

—from the Circinus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

Four of the Six Gem Realms are experiencing the same widespread assault. Feeling concerned, I went to the castle to warn the authorities on the recent events; of course, I was denied entry. It didn't matter that this could be the fifth such incident. Now that I look at this place, this realm has a high cultural level of civilization. I could run the risk of getting arrested for 'spouting nonsense'... Perhaps I should give up on my warnings.
-from the 2nd paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

The Master was concerned, and thus sent the Pirate Deity as the trump card to control the ocean war. Even they had to accept with the god as a mediator. What a good idea!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10250.name: The GiantCat Blynx
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10250.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks) Each player draws 1 card.

[LV2] (When Destroyed) Your opponent randomly discards 1 card.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10250.flavor: Having other athletes' Information before the competition is indispensable nowadays. It seems like each country has sent some scouts to other countries.

BSC42-067.name: The GiantCat Blynx LT
BSC42-067.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
when this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, discard a random card from the opposing Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Both players draw a card.
BSC42-067.flavor: Having other athletes' Information before the competition is indispensable nowadays. It seems like each country has sent some scouts to other countries.

BS27-048.name: The Giant Cepheus
BS27-048.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Assault: 1 - (When Attacks) This spirit can, once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step) When your Nexuses are exhausted by the "Assault" effect of your Spirits/Ultimates, destroy an opposing Nexus.
BS27-048.flavor: Little Antarc... Antarc is researching some forbidden writings. I'm good at analyzing books too. Let me read them sometime.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10254.name: The GiantCentaurusSoldier Danston
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10254.flavor:
That was more than I was expecting. Those battles were completely different than the ones between dinosaurs and dragons. The warriors were fighting in a ring that was set up in a high place. The crash of giants made my heart race.
-from the 4th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS30-070.name: The Giant Ocean Sword Detector
BS30-070.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The (When Summoned) effects of Spirits/Braves and (When Deployed) effects of Nexuses can't activate.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By exhausting this Nexus, reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Blue "Exalted Sword" family Brave card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.
BS30-070.flavor: So you're the representative of the Fighting Spirits. Take this. You'll be able to find the enemy's location with this. Work with the Angelias to take down the enemies with the Twelve Zodiac Braves please!

EX13-06.name: The GiantCentaurus Troydes
EX13-06.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Crush] (When Attacks)
Discard a number of cards from the opposing decktop equal to this Spirit's level.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each level this Spirit has, destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.
EX13-06.flavor:
The armor in which it was clad also controlled and camouflaged its power. Now that it has taken off its restraints, the warrior's suicide attack cannot be stopped by anybody.
—from the Centaurus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

SD16-001.name: The Giant Platoon
SD16-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your "Fighting Spirit" family Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, discard two cards from the opposing decktop.
SD16-001.flavor: "An unidentified group has attacked! Currently returning fire! Asking for urgent backup!" The booming voice you hear is a report from a running soldier.

BSCO-024.name: The GiantDeityKing Ediara-Khan
BSCO-024.kanji: 巨神王エディアラ・カーン
BSCO-024.effect:
(Can't Stack) When your Life is reduced by the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, you can put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Then, you can return this Spirit to the Hand.

BS41-074.name: The Giant Snake's Cast-Off Skin
BS41-074.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your "Dark Snake" family Spirits would leave the Field due to the opponent, draw a card.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
By discarding a "Baaral"-named Spirit card from your Hand, send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.
BS41-074.flavor:
The Snake's King molted skin. Though it was believed there was a Snake colony nearby, they seem to have a habit of shedding away from their nests. It on the other hand makes me more at ease when studying them.
-from the Places of Interest 224/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BS58-068-A10262.name: The Giant Tower of Hercules
BS58-068-A10262.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks, you can discard two cards from the opposing decktop. This effect doesn't stack.

[LV2] [Rebirth3]
When your "Artificial Soldier" family Spirits are destroyed, or this Nexus would leave the Field by opposing effects, it can be flipped. When it is, you can put a core from your Field/Reserve to this now-Reborn Spirit.
BS58-068-A10262.flavor: There echoes a voice that tries to speak to us as we are heading towards End-Of-Journey. No one is there, however. What exists is just a blue tower. And all of a sudden, the tower moved.

BS25-051.name: The GiantDeity Junius
BS25-051.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit. If this Spirit is summoned via [Summon Bolt], instead, destroy an opposing Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
All your "Fighting Spirit" family Spirits gain +5000 BP.
BS25-051.flavor: Amazing! A brilliant harmony with the respected Guardian General and company! While the Guardian General protects you, you make the attacks!

BS55-009.name: The GiantDragonSoldier Dragno
BS55-009.effect:
When your "Dragon" family Spirit effect destroys any opposing Nexus, you can activate this set card, ignoring the Burst condition.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit attacks]
Destroy an opposing 8000 BP or less Spirit and an opposing Nexus, and the effects of the destroyed Spirit/Nexus can't activate. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit.
BS55-009.flavor:
It seems that what Chronos aims to do, is to cut this world off from the influence of Izanagi and Izanami.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 4:02―

BS07-X28.name: The GiantEmperor Alexander
BS07-X28.kanji: 巨人大帝アレクサンダー
BS07-X28.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Assault: 2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to twice per turn, be refreshed by exhausting a Nexus you control.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit, and discard a number of cards from the opposing decktop equal to the cost of the destroyed opposing Spirit.
BS07-X28.flavor: The mighty sovereign's second-in-command has entered the battle! At last, the World Leader is about to show his true mettle!!

SD16-X01.name: The GiantEmperor Alexander-XIII
SD16-X01.kanji: 巨人帝王アレクサンダー13世
SD16-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard five cards from the opposing decktop.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by exhausting a "Fighting Spirit" family Spirit you control, this Spirit refreshes.
SD16-X01.flavor: Facing off against the abruptly invading enemy army, the king of the giants pierces and crushes his opponents and shows his overwhelming strength.

BSC45-XV06.name: The GiantEmperor Alexander XV
BSC45-XV06.kanji: 巨人大帝アレクサンダーXV
BSC45-XV06.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit exhausts, you can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest cost. For each cost of the target destroyed by this effect, discard a card from the opposing decktop.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [G Assault: 2] (When Attacks)
Up to twice per turn, you can exhaust a Nexus/Grandwalker Nexus you control. When you've done so, this Spirit refreshes twice, and during this battle, the cost of every card in the opposing Hand/Removed Zone increases by +2.
BSC45-XV06.flavor:
So that guy is finally showing his true mettle?
―Grandwalker Poseidon―

BS70-066.name: The GiantEmpress Alexander CXV
BS70-066.kanji: 巨人女帝アレクサンダー115世
BS70-066.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
During this turn, every opposing Cost 4 or more Spirit/Ultimate can't attack. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Brave. After this effect resolves, destroy an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit/Ultimate. If you have five counters or more, the limit of this "Cost Destruction effect" increases by +3.
BS70-066.flavor: An empress of Alexander's lineage. She is greatly popular at home and abroad because of her appearance, which is reminiscent of the first Alexander.

BS74-037.name: The GiantFungalBeast SaSai
BS74-037.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
Once per turn, when your Life would be reduced by the opponent, by destroying one of your "Fungal Bed", your Life won't be reduced.

[LV2][LV3] (Start of Either Attack Step)
You can heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can put three cores from the Void to one of your Spirits.
BS74-037.flavor:
Seeing that Kai wear an expression of resolve unlike any he had ever seen before, Yum-Kaax said nothing and simply followed Kai.
―Divine World Log 03―

BS52-057-A10270.name: The GiantHero Gaia-Titus
BS52-057-A10270.kanji: 英雄巨人ガイア・タイタス
BS52-057-A10270.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2] (When Reborn)
If the opposing Life is two or less, discard cards from the opposing deck until only five cards are left.
BS52-057-A10270.flavor: The Gaiacepter responds to young Arva's pure wish. The GiantHero is born, a new legend starts now.

BS21-054.name: The GiantHero Heraclas
BS21-054.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] When the opposing Hand increases due to their effects, for each card increased, discard a card from the opposing decktop.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step) When the attack of your "Astral Soul" family Spirit reduces the opposing Life, discard cards from the opposing decktop equal to that Spirit's cost.
BS21-054.flavor: The youth who inherited the power of the stars underwent 12 trials and joined the ranks of heroes.

BS43-060.name: The GiantHero Hydraman
BS43-060.kanji: ジャイアントヒーロー ハイドラマン
BS43-060.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
Your Life can only be reduced by one by the attack of the opposing Spirit with the highest cost per attack.
BS43-060.flavor:
Under the oppression of the real Siegfried, the Vanity Deity Emperor wasn't able to attack the adventing Lolo. With a swing of the cane, the six-colored beam was fired, penetrating and crushing the Dark Pyroxenes.
-from final section of "New Record of the Strange World" chapter Pyroxene Four-

BS41-069.name: The GiantHero Marvelous
BS41-069.kanji: ジャイアントヒーロー マーベラス
BS41-069.effect:
When the opponent summons any Spirit without paying the cost, besides via a Burst effect, you can immediately summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost. When you've done so, look at the entire opposing Hand, and discard every Brave card among them.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Besides via Burst effects, neither player can summon Spirit cards/Brave cards without paying the cost.
BS41-069.flavor: The fighter that guards the September Saint also joined the fight against the Vanity Deities.

BS43-067.name: The GiantHero Metalknuckle
BS43-067.kanji: ジャイアントヒーロー メタルナックル
BS43-067.effect:
Main - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Blue Core][Blue Core])]
During this turn, when the attack of your "Fighting Spirit" family Spirit reduces the opposing Life, discard ten cards from the opposing decktop. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.
BS43-067.flavor:
With Lolo Adventing onto Alex, all the Dark Pyroxene were eliminated, and at the same time the Vanity Deity Emperor was penetrated by Siegfried's flame.
-from the final section of "New Record of the Strange World" chapter Pyroxene Four-

BS03-X12.name: The GiantHero Titus
BS03-X12.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Discard ten cards from the opposing decktop.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by BP comparison, discard ten cards from the opposing decktop.
BS03-X12.flavor: He is the best of the best competitors ever!! He has won all seven events he competed in!

BS66-XV05.name: The GiantHero Titus XV
BS66-XV05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [XV Crush] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can discard ten cards from the opposing decktop. Then, if there is any opposing cards being banished, destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total cost of 15.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirits with "Crush"-named effects aren't blocked, they can refresh once per turn per Spirit.
BS66-XV05.flavor: The best of the best competitors ever!! He is the legend who has won all seven events he competed in!

BS55-044.name: The GiantIceAxePrincess Pulkheriya
BS55-044.kanji: 大氷斧の姫君 プリヘーリア
BS55-044.effect:
[Brave Symbol +1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn/Attacks)
Once per turn, discard an opposing Burst, and when you can't discard, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3]
Give every "Ice Princess" family Spirit you control: "[Heavy Armor: Red/Purple] This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects."
BS55-044.flavor: "One of the Ice Nobles, Pulkhería of the GiantIceAxe, show me what you've got!"

BS10-060.name: The GiantJaeger Orion
BS10-060.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Discard 12 cards from the opposing decktop.
BS10-060.flavor:
He is a grizzled war veteran. When he enters the battlefield, "destruction" is far too simple a word to describe the outcome.
—from the Orion chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS40-063.name: The GiantKing Aion
BS40-063.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
If there are five or more cards in the opposing Hand, you can discard their entire Hand. When you've done so, the opponent draws two cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't use Magic cards/[Accel] from their Hand.
BS40-063.flavor: So that's the ringleader!! He's just as pompous and tough-looking as I expected!!

BSC42-071.name: The GiantKing Randolph LT
BSC42-071.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Crush] (When Attacks)
Discard a number of cards equal to this Spirit's level from opposing decktop.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
For each card discarded via your [Crush], send a core from a single opposing Spirit to the Reserve.
BSC42-071.flavor: This year's competition is hosted by the king of the Central country where the competition meeting took place.

BS05-051.name: The GiantKnight Aldous
BS05-051.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
All your Nexuses can't be destroyed by opposing Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
For each Nexus you control, discard two cards from the opposing decktop. (Max. 6)
BS05-051.flavor:
One swing was enough to blow the dogs away from his arm. Is he going to overwhelm the opponent who has an advantage in numbers?
-from the 3rd paragraph in chapter blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo-"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10282.name: The GiantMobile Ymir
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10282.flavor:
I wondered how many times I had passed through this gate. As always, the strange landscape filled me with fear and curiosity. What was special on that day was that the gate did not close behind me but opened wide again to let in a huge machine.
-from the 1st paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BSC26-027.name: The GiantMoth Mothra
BSC26-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When your "Mothra"/"Battra"-named Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, you can summon a Green Spirit card with a cost higher than the destroyed Spirit's from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BSC26-027.flavor:
The guardian kaiju of the Cosmos. Transitioning from larva to cocoon to imago, she fought with Battra against Godzilla.
―Godzilla vs Mothra (1992)―

BS25-049.name: The GiantMusketeer Clifford
BS25-049.kanji: 巨人銃士クリフォード
BS25-049.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Cost 7/8 (When Battles)
At the end of the battle, by destroying this Spirit, summon a Cost 7/8 Spirit card in the same family type as this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By destroying an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BS25-049.flavor: Do you really think we can use Summon Bolt as a booster? It's an ability they were born with, right? It could be risky if we forcibly try to use it.

BS24-051.name: The GiantNavigator Tobby
BS24-051.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When your Cost 4 or less "Artificial Soldier" family Spirit is summoned, put a core from the Void to this Spirit. This effect can only be used once per turn.
BS24-051.flavor: We all went to investigate the dangerous areas and populous cities together, splitting up into two-person teams near the borders to cover. I thought it was a good plan, but I should have put more consideration into picking someone who wouldn't get seasick to go to the region covered in ocean like my homeland. Are you all right, Laten? You'll sing yo, man, I'll be sick, man, is it? You're certainly optimistic about this.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10287.name: The GiantPrince Alexander IV
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10287.kanji: 巨人皇子アレクサンダー4世
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10287.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Assault: 1] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10287.flavor: The son of that GiantEmperor has at last shown himself! His power is truly exemplary of a throughbred! He would surely become the star of hope for the Blue World!
sets: Ds Game: Battle Spirits Digital Starter Campaign Card

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10289.name: The GiantPrince Bharata
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10289.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
For each Spirit card with [Accel] in your Removed Zone, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10289.flavor: The opening course starts at a low hill, from where you can see a townscape of beautiful stone structures all in a row. Watch out for the steep slope on the way down.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10290.name: The GiantPrince Lakshmana
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10290.kanji: 巨人王子ラクシュマナ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10290.effect:
The symbol of this card on your Removed Zone is also treated as a symbol on the Field.

Main- [Accel: Cost 3 ([Blue Core][Blue Core])]
Draw two cards, then discard two cards from your Hand. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up on the Removed Zone.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10290.flavor: Judging by the site's condition, after contacting each other, they clashed on a stone wall. Fresh vestiges have been left on the stone wall it is thought they clashed on. This was Tonio, on site.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10301.name: The GiantPrince Rama
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10301.effect:
Flash- [Accel: Cost 6 ([Blue Core][Blue Core][Blue Core]]
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest cost. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Fighting Spirit" family Spirits are attacking, opposing Cost 4 or less Spirits/Ultimates can't block.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10301.flavor: The Gandala royals lift up their cups and grieve the deaths of the racers...

BS37-061.name: The GiantPrince Shatrugna
BS37-061.kanji: 巨人王子シャトルグナ
BS37-061.effect:
The symbol of this card on your Removed Zone is also treated as a symbol on the field.

Flash- [Accel: Cost 3 ([Blue Core][Blue Core])]
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up on the Removed Zone.
BS37-061.flavor: Gandala's royalty members have taken the visitor seats. I'm asking you to earnestly not make any blunders, okay, Polish?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10303.name: The GiantPrincess Sita
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10303.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
For each two Spirit cards with [Accel] in your Removed Zone, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
All your "Fighting Spirit" family Spirits can block opposing Spirits with "Can't be blocked" effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10303.flavor: Is Gandala's central racer, as expected, Racer Vishten? I approve of him as a hottie racer!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10304.name: The GiantSeaCreature Stellar
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10304.effect: [LV1][LV2] Assault: 3 - (When Attacks) This spirit can, three times per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10304.flavor: There's some idiot getting in the way of the pirate ship that's supposed to transport us in this era. What's he thinking?

BS27-041.name: The GiantShipDoctor Gordon
BS27-041.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Cost 3/4 (When Battles)
At the end of the battle, by destroying this Spirit, summon a Cost 3/4 Spirit card in the same family as this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BS27-041.flavor: I hate being watched by the guards, but I approve of the talks with the Ultimates. But what do we tell the people in charge? A lie like this is bound to be found out. If it's found out, we'll be hung and dried like fish. I don't want to dry. At least let me be raw fish.

SD24-001.name: The GiantSoldier Mucius
SD24-001.effect: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent) You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a Nexus card from among them to your Hand. Return the remaining cards to the decktop in any order.
SD24-001.flavor: Ozzania and I went to the Blue Seas Site No. 001 "The Capital Alexandra" for the implementation of the dual-world council.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10308.name: The GiantSpaceKaiju Bemstar
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10308.kanji: 宇宙大怪獣ベムスター
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10308.flavor:
He absorbed the MAT Space Center with the pentagonal opening on his abdomen. When fighting with Ultraman Jack, he was also able to absorb the Specium Ray.
―Return of Ultraman―

BS25-047.name: The GiantSwordsman Archbold
BS25-047.kanji: 巨人剣士アーチボルド
BS25-047.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can draw two cards. When you draw via this effect, discard two cards from your Hand.

[LV2]
When your Spirits with [Summon Bolt] are destroyed, by destroying this Spirit, that Spirit remains on the Field, exhausted.
BS25-047.flavor: You're the key person that'll Summon Bolt and switch out with Leader. It's like you're our seventh member.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10310.name: The GiantTeacher Aristotle
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10310.kanji: 巨人教師アリストテレス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10310.effect: [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step) When your "Fighting Spirit" family Ultimate is summoned, put a core from Void to this Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10310.flavor: After our audience with the king, I gained the chance to study this world's history at Alexandra's grand library. The knowledge I gained there substantiated the investigations we've been making, but something still tugs at my mind. If I had more time, I feel like I'd be able to find something...

BS54-029.name: The GiantTreeBeast Karma-Karama
BS54-029.kanji: 大樹獣カルマ・カラマ
BS54-029.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put two cores from the Void to any Green-only Spirits you control.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to any Green-only Spirit you control.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, for each three "Plant Spirit" family Spirits you control, send two opposing Lives to the Trash.
BS54-029.flavor:
"Creating worlds...isn't that just like what Alex did?" The words that someone said caught my attention. Deities...? No way, it can't be....
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 3:28―

BSC30-024.name: The GiantWeapon Titus-Bazooka
BSC30-024.kanji: 巨人兵器タイタスバズーカ
BSC30-024.effect:
[LV1] [Reload]
You can [Advent] onto this Spirit-condition Brave. When you [Advent] onto this Brave, you can brave this pre-Advent card to that Spirit.

[When Braved] (Your Attack Step)
When you're stacking a "Fighting Spirit" family card onto this Spirit via [Advent], you can add any number of "Fighting Spirit" family Spirits you control to underneath this Spirit as pre-advent cards.
BSC30-024.flavor: A Gun Brave made specifically for Titus-El-Grande.

CB18-055.name: The Giants' Statues
CB18-055.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Blue Core][Blue Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Tiga"/"Dyna"/"Gaia"-named Spirit attacks, put a core from the Void to that Spirit.

[LV1] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Tiga"/"Dyna"/"Gaia"-named Spirit attacks, destroy an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to that Spirit's.
CB18-055.flavor: The statues of three giants that exist within the Land of Tiga's Pyramid of Light. Due to Golza and Melba's attacks, the statues of Tiga's companions were destroyed.

CB23-048.name: The Giants of Light
CB23-048.effect:
When this card is revealed from deck by your Blue effect, you can add it to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Angel" family Spirit attacks, during that battle, by fixing its symbol as zero, discard two cards, but up to as many as possible, from the opposing decktop.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
(Once per turn: Same Name) When you are summoning an "Angel" family card, for each symbol-less Blue Nexus you control, you can reduce that card's cost by -1.
CB23-048.flavor: The giants that appeared in Antarctica during the Second Impact.

P15-25.name: The GigaEmperor Gerbelord
P15-25.effect:
[When Braved] (When Attacks)

Exhaust three opposing Spirits/Ultimates. Spirits/Ultimates exhausted by this effect can't refresh for the rest of the game.

[During Seal] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. The Spirit/Ultimate exhausted by this effect can't refresh for the rest of the game.

[During Seal] [LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects.
BS35-XX01.flavor: The beginning of everything lay in the six colors. Green gave the world nature.

BS40-026.name: The GreenSearcher Pookses
BS40-026.kanji: 緑の探索者プークスス
BS40-026.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add every card with [Advent] to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When you would [Advent], this Spirit can become Cost 5.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When you would [Advent], this Spirit can become Cost 6.
BS40-026.flavor: One of my escorts is an acrobat. Yet why is he so composed!? He's the lighest of all of us, but brings up the rear. Is it because he's actually the oldest?

BS09-058.name: The Grimoire Bookshelf
BS09-058.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When the opponent uses a Magic effect, send a core from any opposing Spirit to their Reserve.

[LV2] (Opposing End Step)
You can return a card from your Hand to the decktop. If the opposing deck has 0 cards, this effect don't activate.
BS09-058.flavor:
A forbidden tome that holds the many records of the Dark Snakes dating back to ancient times. Its contents are shrouded in mystery, but perhaps an even greater enigma is how the Dark Snakes managed to write any records at all, what with having no arms....
-from the Places of Interest 204/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS34-CP03.name: The GreenShadowCatalyzer Aogiri
BS34-CP03.kanji: 緑影の起導士アオギリ
BS34-CP03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Catl: Green] (When Summoned)
If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) was used to pay the summon cost, immediately activate one of your Green Soul Bursts. After that Burst activates, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
You can set a card with Burst effect from your Hand.
BS34-CP03.flavor:
The guardian that watches over the Verdant Leaf Province from the forest of the country.
"Knowing nothing about ninja arts, but stepping into the forest of the village. That's some good guts."

THE-GREAT-A10545.name: The Great Tree of Life
THE-GREAT-A10545.effect:
[LV1][LV2] When your Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) When an opposing Spirit's attack reduces your life, put a core from the Void to your Reserve, and refresh a Spirit you control.
THE-GREAT-A10545.flavor:
In the past, the Elders of the forest rested under this great tree. There are other trees like this, but truly its highlight is its immense size.
-from the Places of Interest 888/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS70-035.name: The GreenWindLionheart Hermaphros
BS70-035.kanji: 緑風の勇士ヘルマプロース
BS70-035.effect:
When summoning this card, if there are three or more cards in the opposing Removed Zone, this card can become Cost 5.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates.
BS70-035.flavor:
The war situation in various parts of Olym was conveyed to Hermes. And wherever it was, the situation was bad, despite the fact that they had already been sending armies of a size that almost doubled the number of the opposing troops.
―Theogonic Record Volume 3―

BSC21-X04.name: The GroundDeityBlade Ootenta
BSC21-X04.effect:
[Burst: s] (After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks)
Return an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand. After this effect resolves, summon this Brave card without paying the cost.

[When Braved] Flash - (When Attacks)
Once per turn, send the [Soul Core](Soul Core) from your Trash to this Spirit. When you've done so, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.
BSC21-X04.flavor: One swing of the Five Dominance Swords holds within it the true shine of the one it has accepted as its master.

SJ19-08.name: The GreenZodiacKnight Zodiac-Apollodragon
SJ19-08.kanji: 緑の光導騎士ゾディアック・アポロドラゴン
SJ19-08.effect:
This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Red/Purple/White/Yellow/Blue.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can summon a Green Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes. Also, while braved to a Brave, return two opposing exhausted Spirits/Ultimates to the deckbottom, in any order.
SJ19-08.flavor: The ZodiacKnight protects the stars of the zodiac with a wild heart. The Shifting Sacred Sword responds to that by releasing the Green power.

SD22-012.name: The Great Tree of the Lush Grounds
SD22-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by an opposing Spirit/Ultimate, draw a card.

[LV2]
When your Ultimate is summoned, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
SD22-012.flavor:
More land is on top of the trees that sprung from the land. Above that, our land is reversed in the sky. The Ultimates' forest is full of wonders.
—Green Forests Site No. 394 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

BSC48-035.name: The GroundDeityBlade Ootenta LT
BSC48-035.effect:
While you control any White-only Grandwalker Nexus, this set card is unaffected by opposing effects.

[Burst: s] (After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[During Brave] Flash - (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, you can send your [Soul Core] to this Spirit or your Reserve. When you've done so, you can return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.
BSC48-035.flavor: One swing of the Five Dominance Swords holds within it the true shine of the one it has accepted as its master.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10551.name: The Green Big Tree
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10551.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step) When your Spirit with Windstorm is summoned, exhaust an opposing Spirit with the same cost as that Spirit.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step) You target which Spirit(s) the opponent exhaust due to Windstorm.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10551.flavor:
As the oldest tree in the forest, at first many believed this to be the legendary World Tree. A miraculous marvel, this tree cannot break, be cut down, or catch flame.
-from the Places of Interest 280/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS11-067.name: The Great Wall of the White Shield
BS11-067.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Start Step)
Target an opposing Spirit. That Spirit must attack during that turn if possible.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By sending three cores from this Nexus to the Trash, immediately end the battle.
BS11-067.flavor:
The great fortress, pride of the Lunar Brigade, is protected by a white shield that fends off all attacks. Attacks by fire have also been taken into consideration, as it has been constructed from never-melting ice.
—from the Scutum chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10553.name: The GroundSupporter Francis
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10553.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Blocks) You may discard a nexus card from your hand. In that case, this spirit gets +5000BP until end of turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10553.flavor:
He taught us the way to the Central country yawning. It seemed like he had no interests in the competition meeting.
-from the 1st paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

CB16-074.name: The Guided Ones
CB16-074.effect:
When your "Unicorn Gundam"-named Spirit is summoned, you can return this card from the Trash to your Hand. This effect doesn't stack.

[Flash]
Return a Red "Pilot"/"Crew" family card from the Trash to your Hand. Then, you can summon/deploy a Red "Pilot"/"Crew" family card from your Hand. Then, banish this card.

BS42-083.name: The Green Holy Relic
BS42-083.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
For both players, the number of cores on Spirits can't be brought to 0.

[LV2] (Opposing Turn)
When an opposing Spirit attacks, the opponent exhausts a Spirit they control.
BS42-083.flavor:
One of the relics of the legendary Spirits, "the Companions". It was enshrined in the "Shinobi Village", an alternative world separated from the normal Green World.
-from the Places of Interest 003/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BS29-066.name: The Ground Drilling Stone Sword
BS29-066.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
For each symbol-less Brave you control, this Nexus gains an extra Red symbol.

[LV2]
When the Ultimate Trigger of your Brave Ultimates that are braved to "Exalted Sword" family Braves hits, draw two cards. This effect can only be used once per turn.
BS29-066.flavor:
A giant sword pierces through the earth. Is that "Truth-Eden"? This place feels similar to the Skylands.
—Paradise Site No. 333 from "Skylands Report" Extra by Nord—

BS53-TX03.name: The Green Nature Deity
BS53-TX03.effect:
[Brave Symbol +1]

[LV1] (When Reborn/Attacks)
Return an opposing exhausted Cost 6 or less Spirit to the deckbottom.

[LV1] [rtp]

[LV1]
When your Green "Primal" effect would increase cores, instead of increasing cores, you can draw a card.
BS53-TX03.flavor: A god of tree birthed by the Green World.

PX22-02.name: The Green Princess
PX22-02.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Green & Cost 3 or more) (This Nexus can hold up to 5 cores)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can put a core from the Void each to this Nexus and a Green-only Spirit you control. If you have 5 counters or more, this effect puts +1 core to the Spirit.

[Grand Skill: 3] [LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
(Send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) Put a core from the Void to your Counter Area, and exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates.

BSC49-079.name: The Great Wall of the White Shield LT
BSC49-079.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Start of Opposing Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) You can target an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When you've done so, put a core from the Void to this Nexus, and that target must attack at the beginning of the step if possible.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By sending three cores from this Nexus to the Trash, immediately end the battle.
BSC49-079.flavor:
The great fortress, pride of the Lunar Brigade, is protected by a white shield that fends off all attacks. Attacks by fire have also been taken into consideration, as it has been constructed from never-melting ice.
—from the Scutum chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS53-TX03-A10560.name: The Green World
BS53-TX03-A10560.effect:
[LV1] [Rebirth5]
When opposing Spirits/your Cost 6 or more Green Spirits exhaust, or when this Nexus would leave the Field by opposing effects, you can flip this Nexus, putting your [Soul Core] onto it.

[LV1] (When Deployed)
You can put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV1]
When your Green "Primal" effect, besides this Nexus's effect, would increase cores, instead of increasing cores, you can draw a card.
BS53-TX03-A10560.flavor: The Green World is a world of animals and insects that is rich in nature.

26RBS02-037.name: The GreyWave Grayken
26RBS02-037.effect:
[LV1-2] Your Attack Step
When your Spirit is blocked, you can target an opposing Spirit. Exhaust it.

[LV2] Your Attack Step
When your Spirit or the opposing Spirit is exhausted by your effect, target one of your Spirits. During this battle, it gains +2000 BP.
26RBS02-037.flavor:
It appears amidst the waves, destroys everything in its path, and then vanishes. It is a presence that brings to mind the great destruction of the past.
―from the Foreigner's Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

BS36-015.name: The GrimReaperNinthDragon Jet-The-Ripper
BS36-015.kanji: 死神壬龍ジェット・ザ・リッパー
BS36-015.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By destroying an opposing Spirit with two cores or less on it, draw a card.

[During Seal] [LV2][LV3]
When your "Death Dragon" family Spirit effect depletes/destroys opposing Spirits, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BS36-015.flavor: The God-Kings used their powers to protect the spectators and other racers from the attack, and ended up being unable to use their full potential in the race.

BS23-016.name: The GrimReaperSwordMaster Darkness-Mare
BS23-016.kanji: 死神剣聖ダークネス・メア
BS23-016.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Unsheathe] (When Summoned)
You can summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card that can brave with this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can summon a Cost 0/3 Purple Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy a Brave on an opposing Brave Spirit.
BS23-016.flavor: Having made a contract with the Twin Dragon of Darkness, the malevolent SwordMaster who leads the Six Darkness SwordsMasters. Wrapped in dark fog, he harvests lives with the DemonSword Deathscythe.

BS21-014.name: The GrimSnake Boomsnake
BS21-014.kanji: 告死蛇ブームスネーク
BS21-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Send a core each from every opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit to their Reserve. For each Spirit who has the number of cores on it brought to 0 by this effect, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
At the beginning of the Step, by exhausting this Spirit, during this turn, treat a Spirit you control as being colorless.
BS21-014.flavor: The rage that the snake expresses is an inescapable death sentence.

BS64-008.name: The GuidingDragon Drago Elder
BS64-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step)
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any “The Eagle Partner, Gut”, besides [Soul Core], you can put up to five cores from your Trash to any of your Spirits/Nexuses. Then, (Once per Turn: Same Name) If your Hand is five or less, and you control any 10000 BP or more Spirit, you can draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When your 6000 BP or more Spirit attacks, you can destroy an opposing Nexus.
BS64-008.flavor: "Miss Toa, please help me take care of Gut. I believe that he will be able to help you."

BS60-077.name: The Great Waterfall of Gurnabert
BS60-077.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
While the opponent has four or less counters, this Nexus is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
Your counter +1. Also, if you control any "The PartnerWolf Lampo", including being in Soul State/pre-advent, put a core from the Void to this Nexus.

[LV2]
While you have six counters or more, the effects of every opposing heavily exhausted Spirit/Nexus can't activate, and those Spirits/Nexuses can't refresh.
BS60-077.flavor:
無数の滝が流れ込む巨大な大河の源流。
―名所絶景録―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10567.name: The Great Workshop of the Meisters
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10567.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) When your "Creator" family Spirit becomes exhausted, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2] (Your End Step) By using the cores on your Field, you can deploy a Green/Blue Nexus card from your Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10567.flavor:
A factory complex managed and operated with the full strength of the Northern Country. As the nation's second designated capital, this is the project city where the finest artisans of machinery in all the Sapphire Realm gather.
-from the Places of Interest 109/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10568.name: The GunAstralArmored Baldo-Lizard
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10568.kanji: 砲星鎧バルド・リザード
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10568.effect:
Trigger Counter
When opponent's Ultimate-Trigger hits, this Brave card can be summoned from your hand before the "When hits" effect activates. Activate the following effect after summoned.

█ Destroy 1 opposing Ultimate in battle with 10000 BP or below.

[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks) This Spirit gains +5000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10568.flavor: They're not the Braves that we know. Are they really alive!?

BS31-047.name: The GunBeastMachine Liomael
BS31-047.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Return every opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) was used to pay for the summon cost, instead, return every opposing 15000 BP or less Ultimates to the Hand.
BS31-047.flavor:
The civil war in Clever Machine Province had been fanned by the Six Shogunate's power struggle. However, it may have also been the perfect chance for nameless military commanders to make a name for themselves.
―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―

BS62-029.name: The Grün∴Baum ApprenticeWizard Baht
BS62-029.kanji: G∴B 見習い魔法使いバーツ
BS62-029.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent, if you control any "The PartnerBug Gataru", exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS62-029.flavor: After losing to Lampo in the fight, Gataru got so depressed. That was impossible. Lacking any sort of motivation, he went through days after days doing nothing. Eventually, he vanished. And when he showed himself once again, he is already a different Gataru.

BS66-X05.name: The GunDeityBurai Mavrick-Menace
BS66-X05.kanji: 銃神無頼マーヴリック・メナス
BS66-X05.effect:
Flash - [Reverse Contract Advent: "The PartnerBurai Vrick" & C7 or more, (Your Turn)]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By sending your [Soul Core] or the opposing [Soul Core] to the Trash, or by -1 opposing counter, stacking this card from your Hand onto its target, including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2][LV3] [Steel Load] (When Advents)
You can put cards from your decktop facedown under one of your "The PartnerBurai Vrick", including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition, until there are five cards under it.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2][LV3] [Fast Draw: X] (When Attacks)
Discard any number of facedown cards under your "The PartnerBurai Vrick", including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition, and for every three cards discarded, during this turn, all your "Silver Zero" family Spirits gain an extra White symbol.

BS61-031.name: The Grün∴Baum DemonKing Zanardite
BS61-031.kanji: G∴B 魔王ザナーダイト
BS61-031.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Mystery Contract" family Spirits, or your Spirits with "High Speed"/"Swift"-named effects would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost. When you've done so, return up to three Green-only Spirits that would leave the Field, besides any exactly-named "The Grün∴Baum DemonKing Zanardite", to your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
At the end of battle, put two cores from the Void to this Spirit or your Reserve.
BS61-031.flavor:
So you are the Demon King, one of Grün∴Baum's Kings, right? Let's see...What an awful thing you've done! I think we can get along very well.
-The PartnerBug Gataru-

BS34-004.name: The GunDog Zash
BS34-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [SSoul: Red]
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains [Red Core] (an extra Red symbol).
BS34-004.flavor:
Combat Era, October 600. What would become the last and greatest war of the Great Sengoku Era, the Battle of Senkigahara, had begun.
―from the Senkigahara Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BS65-026.name: The Grün∴Baum FakeKing King Arbol
BS65-026.kanji: G∴B 偽王キングアルボル
BS65-026.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can reveal a card from your decktop. If that's a “Gataru”/“Grün∴Baum" Spirit card, you can summon it without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.
BS65-026.flavor:
I'm rebuilding the organization. And first...Let's start by choosing the executives...Wise King, Sorcerer King, Great King, Queen, Shine King, Ice King, and...Fake King? Um, so this is him...Ugh, I didn't see no one.
―The PartnerBug Gataru―

BS61-029.name: The Grün∴Baum GreatKing Elec-Ram
BS61-029.effect:
At the start of opposing Attack Step, if the opponent controls three or more Spirits, you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
3 Heavy exhaust three opposing Spirits/Ultimates. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3]
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, while you control any Green Contract Spirit, the number of cores on each opposing Spirit/Ultimate can't become less than one due to the opponent.
BS61-029.flavor: "This newly born world...What a shame if it is to be destroyed."

BSC48-003.name: The GunDog Zash LT
BSC48-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Homura Toshiie", and a "Vassal"/"Lord" & "Emperor Beast" family card, besides any "The GunDog Zash", to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV1][LV2] [SSoul: Red Red]
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains two extra Red symbols.
BSC48-003.flavor:
Combat Era, October 600. What would become the last and greatest war of the Great Sengoku Era, the Battle of Senkigahara, had begun.
―from the Senkigahara Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BS10-062.name: The GunDragon Phoenix-Cannon
BS10-062.kanji: 砲凰竜フェニック・キャノン
BS10-062.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy two opposing 4000 BP or less Spirits. Or, destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit and an opposing Nexus.

[When Braved] [Clash] (When Attacks)

BS10-062.flavor:
A streak of hellfire that cuts through the darkness and silence of the starry skies —- a true Brave of flames.
—from the Phoenix chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS63-038.name: The Grün∴Baum Greed-Gataru-the-Traceless
BS63-038.kanji: G∴B 無影のクリード・ガタル
BS63-038.effect:

By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

Once per turn, the opponent discards a card from their Hand, and if can't discard, put three cores from the Void to your Reserve.

Once per turn, you can summon a "Jade Thunder" family Spirit card from your Hand. When you've done so, return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom.

A streak of hellfire that cuts through the darkness and silence of the starry skies —- a true Brave of flames.
—from the Phoenix chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS63-X06.kanji: 銃皇機神ガンズ・マーヴリック

By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.
