―"Genesis Records" Volume 3:36―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10624.name: The GuardianGiantBeast Galaparzo
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10624.effect:
[LV1][LV2] When a Spirit with only 3000BP or less attacks, neither player loses Life Cores.

[LV2] Ice Wall: Green - (Opponent's Turn) When the opponent uses the effect of a Green Magic, by exhausting this Spirit, negate that effect.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10624.flavor: The watchman of the ridge is like an unshakeable steel wall against both the Invaders' protectors and their enemies. Passing through without permission is unforgivable.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10625.name: The HeadlessKnight Durahan
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10625.kanji: 首無し騎士デュラハン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10625.flavor: He once challenged the ruler and became a shadow of his former self. Though he lost his life and body, his battle never ends.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10626.name: The Healing Fountain
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10626.effect:
[LV1][LV2] All your Spirits with Holy Life gain +1000 BP

[LV2] (Your Attack Step) All your Spirits with Holy Life can't be blocked by opposing Cost 3 or less Spirits.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10626.flavor:
Beyond the Kingdom of Rainbows lies a sacred fountain where the Angels gather. If you take a deep breath of the purifying air, your entire body will be filled to the brim with radiant vitality.
-from the Places of Interest 270/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS10-053.name: The Guardian Bertram
BS10-053.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Your Blue Nexuses can't be destroyed by opposing Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
BS10-053.flavor:
We had total dominance of the battlefield before me. Therefore, I'd let my guard down. The worst possible news came to me by sunset: a deity from another world completely demolished the Eastern Kingdom....
-from the 13th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS04-087.name: The Heart-Buster Huge Slope
BS04-087.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Start Step)
Discard a card from the opposing decktop.

[LV2]
Every Spirit with no printed effects you control is treated as at its highest level during the turn it's summoned.
BS04-087.flavor:
In the East country, every entrant for the competition climbs this huge slope.
This tradition is not really for training but for good luck.
-from the Places of Interest 991/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS09-030.name: The Guardian Hlin
BS09-030.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Armor: Purple/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Blue Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2]
Give all your "Ice Princess" family Spirits: [Armor: Purple/Blue].
BS09-030.flavor:
Suddenly, I heard the sound of despair. A terrible sound like the shattering of glass erupted from the Singing Diva's throat as she crumpled into the Guardian's arms...
-from the 12th paragraph of chapter White in "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10630.name: The Heated Sports Festival
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10630.effect:
When this Nexus card is revealed by your [Friend], you can deploy it without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Turn)
All your "School Style" family Spirits gain +2000 BP.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
Refresh all your "School Style" family Spirits.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10630.flavor: Diva Academy's sports festival is split into six teams of red, purple, green, white, yellow, and blue. There are a variety of contests to compete in, like ball-tossing, relays, and cavalry battles.

BS54-027.name: The GuardingTree Botanikaiser
BS54-027.kanji: 守護樹ボタニカイザー
BS54-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can put two cores from the Void to any Spirits you control. Then, you can put a core from the Void to any Green Grandstone Nexus you control.

[LV1][LV2] 1 (When Attacks)
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
[heb]

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.
BS54-027.flavor: The guardian of forest bred from the Second Divine Tree. While BotanyKaiser looks small, it is no doubt strong. "I protected your home! Be thankful to me, Vina!"

SD02-012.name: The Heaven's Door
SD02-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life would be reduced by the attack of an opposing LV1 Spirit without [Tribute], discard a card from your decktop. If that card is a Spirit card, your Life won't be reduced. Also, if it has [Tribute], add it to the Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
The attack of your Spirit with [Tribute] can't be blocked by opposing Spirits with a level equal or inferior to that Spirit's.
SD02-012.flavor:
"The great gates of legend that can only be opened with seven keys. What would happen should those gates open...?"
-from the Places of Interest 107/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS12-070.name: The Heaven's Stairway
BS12-070.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your "Divine Spirit" family Spirit is summoned, return a Cost 4 or less "Divine Spirit" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2]
While you control five or more "Divine Spirit" family Spirits, your Life can't become zero.
BS12-070.flavor:
The staircase leading to the Heaven's Door. Rather than being able to contemplate happiness on the way to paradise like what one would think, the stairs are so large, climbing them takes considerable effort. Going to Heaven is quite troublesome.
-from the Places of Interest 712/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo-

26RSD09-008.name: The Heaven-Piercing Spinard
26RSD09-008.effect:
[LV1-2] When Summoned
Target an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit. Destroy it. If you control any "Purgatory Wings" family Spirit, target two Spirits instead.
26RSD09-008.flavor: Although the act of turning one's back is often viewed in a negative light, when it comes to this Spirit, one might take a different view.

BS67-060.name: The HeavenArmorBeast Vangurine
BS67-060.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more “The Extreme Partner, Zetter”, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned/Blocks)
Put one core from the Void to this Ultimate.

[LV3][LV4] (Your Main Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By exhausting this Ultimate, activate the following Ultimate Trigger.
[Ultimate Trigger] When Ultimate Trigger hits, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.
[utb]
BS67-060.flavor:
The technology level of the Holies army is so advanced that they can create even the vessel for gods.
―Revelations of the Apocalypse―

BS27-070.name: The Heaven Piercing Ballista
BS27-070.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your Red/Green Spirits get +2000 BP.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When only the opposing Ultimate is destroyed by comparing BP with your Brave Spirit, send an opposing Life to their Reserve. This effect doesn't stack.
BS27-070.flavor:
The Ultimates quickly established a fort to fight against the astral spirits.
—Red Plains Site No. 758 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

BS30-069.name: The Heaven Wings Sword Detector
BS30-069.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Turn)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Exalted Sword" family Brave is summoned, draw a card.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By exhausting this Nexus, reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Yellow "Exalted Sword" family Brave card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.
BS30-069.flavor: The honorable ArcAngelia, right? Take this. You'll be able to find the enemy's location with this. Work with the Fighting Spirits to take down the enemies with the Twelve Zodiac Braves please!

BSC48-X09.name: The HeavenlyDemonKing God-Sechs X -Type Destroy-
BSC48-X09.kanji: 天魔王ゴッド・ゼクスX -破ノ型-
BSC48-X09.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) At the end of the attack of your "God-Sechs", you can pay one cost to use the following [Change] of this card from the Hand/Trash.

Flash - [Change: Cost 6 ([Red Core][Purple Core][White Core])]
Return an opposing Spirit/Nexus/Burst to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, either discard this card, or replace one of your Cost 9 or less "Heavenly Demon King" family Spirits with this card in refreshed state.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can draw two cards.
[Six Heaven Rush: 4] (Activate while you have four or more symbol colors)
If there is [Soul Core] on this Spirit, you can destroy opposing Spirits/Grandwalker Nexuses, one of each.
BSC48-X09.flavor: "All ye common soldiers, be sacrificed to my Six Heaven's Rush!!"

THE-GUARDMAN.name: The Guardman Pug
THE-GUARDMAN.effect: [LV2][LV3] When your Nexuses are destroyed, by sending a core from this Spirit to your Trash, one of the Nexuses destroyed remains on your field in the same state.
THE-GUARDMAN.flavor: Anyway, we need to deal with the traitors first. I have to talk to those stupid soldiers from Ocean Shield.

BSC48-XX01.name: The HeavenlyDemonKing God-Sechs X -Type The End-
BSC48-XX01.kanji: 天魔王ゴッド・ゼクスX -終ノ型-
BSC48-XX01.effect:
Flash - [Advent2: Tenma Advent, Heavenly Demon King & Originally Cost 8/9/10, (Either Attack Step)]
By either sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, or putting a core from your "Heavenly Demon King" family Grandwalker Nexus to a Spirit you control, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can return opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus, one of each, to the deckbottom.

[During Advent] [LV3] (Your Turn)
Every Spirit you control is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.
[Six Heaven Rush: 6] <sub>(Activate if you have six symbol colors)</sub>
The symbols of your attacking Spirit are fixed as [Red Core][Purple Core][Green Core][White Core][Yellow Core][Blue Core] (Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue, one of each).

BS27-067.name: The HeavenAstralArmored Blanc-Pegase
BS27-067.kanji: 天星鎧ブラン・ペガス
BS27-067.effect:
[When Braved] (When Brave Attack)
During this battle, give an opposing Spirit/Ultimate -5000 BP.
BS27-067.flavor: There are plenty of snakes that grow wings, but I think a horse growing wings is weird.

BS04-007.name: The Guardsman Dragno
BS04-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
The (When Attacks) effects of all "Dragon" family Spirits activate as (When Blocks) effects.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +2000 BP.
BS04-007.flavor: How triumphant he looks! He might be in the lead now, but that doesn't undo his previous defeat.

PB17-X02.name: The HeavenlyDemonKing Pentan -Type God-Sechs-
PB17-X02.kanji: 天魔王ペンタン-ゴッド・ゼクスノ型-
PB17-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Magic effects.
[Six Pen Rush: 6]
While you control six or more "Pentan"-named Spirits, change this Spirit's symbols to [Yellow Core][Yellow Core][Yellow Core][Yellow Core][Yellow Core][Yellow Core] (six Yellow symbols).

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Pentan"-named Spirit attacks, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -6000 BP. Destroy the Spirits whose BP are brought to 0 by this effect.
PB17-X02.flavor: "Like roast beef, the enemies of Six Penguin must all be eaten!!"

BS30-062.name: The HeavenAstralBlade Schedar
BS30-062.effect:
[LV1] [SSoul: Yellow]
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains [Yellow Core] (an extra Yellow Symbol).

[When Braved] (When this Spirit/Ultimate Brave Attacks)
Give an opposing battling Spirit/Ultimate -4000 BP.
BS30-062.flavor: Almost all the reinforcements that came by the forbidden spell are Braved!

SD57-005.name: The HeavenlyDemonKing Weapons
SD57-005.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[During Brave]
While braved to a "God-Sechs"-named Spirit, this Spirit's symbols are also treated as Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.
SD57-005.flavor:
When dear brother was asked whether he wanted to leave the Realm of the Dead, he laughed out loud, "I have grown to like this world. Maybe it is not too bad to start conquering and uniting this world first!"
-Thirteen-

BS52-X08.name: The GuideGirl Vina
BS52-X08.effect:
[Core Charge: (Primal & Cost 3 or more) (Rebirth Nexus)]
◆When you summon/advent/deploy a target Spirit/Nexus, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2]
Add one of the Rebirth cards sent to Trash by this Nexus' [Core Charge] to the Hand.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) Refresh a "Primal" family Spirit you control.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
(Can't Stack) When you're summoning/deploying/using a "Primal" family card, fill one of its reduction symbols.

BS57-070-A10647.name: The HeavenBattleship Lord of Will
BS57-070-A10647.kanji: 天戦艦ロードオブウィル
BS57-070-A10647.effect:
[LV1]
When you use a Yellow-only Magic card with Mirage effects, after that effect resolves, by exhausting this Nexus, instead of sending that card to the Trash, set it without paying the cost.

[LV1] [Rebirth3]
When you set a Magic card Mirage during your Attack Step, or this Nexus would leave the Field by opposing effects, you can flip this Nexus. When you do, you can put a core from your Field/Reserve to this now-Reborn Spirit.
BS57-070-A10647.flavor: The Thrones-Class Heaven Battleship No.2, is a battleship that can even travel across time.

BS65-051.name: The HeavenBladeFalcon Eperlato
BS65-051.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control no Spirits & have 0 Spirit cards in your Trash]

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to any of your White Ultimates. Then, return an opposing Nexus to the Hand.

[LV4] (When Blocks)
This Ultimate gains +5000 BP.
BS65-051.flavor: "Stall until Lord Galykos, the Heaven Wolf Duke, one of the Tri-Extreme Dukes, comes! We will fight on until we scare the hell out of the Four Demon Lords!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10649.name: The HeavenlyHazeDragon Mikagura-Hydra
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10649.kanji: 天霞龍ミカグラハイドラ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10649.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can put two cores from the Void to any "Terra Dragon" family Spirits you control.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Besides this Spirit, while your "Terra Dragon"/"Ocean Emperor" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't send [Soul Core] to their Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10649.flavor:
When I came to myself again, I realized I had been sleeping between my younger brother, Susanoo's arms. My other younger brother, Tsukuyomi, was also standing by besides us.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 4:34―

BS63-X07.name: The HeavenCountSorceress Fermat-Searam
BS63-X07.kanji: 天数魔導フェルマ・シーラム
BS63-X07.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Number Contract & C6 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
If you've summoned for four times or more this turn, during this turn, this Spirit gains four Yellow symbols. Also, if you have 10 counters or more, during this turn, the opponent can't use cards with an even number cost from the Hand/Removed Zone.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
While the opponent hasn't used any Magic card this turn, this Spirit can't be blocked.

BS75-CX03.name: The HeavenlyThunderContractor Indra
BS75-CX03.kanji: 天雷の契約神インドラ
BS75-CX03.effect:
[Neo-Core Charge:: (Thunderive/Devotee/Concluser & Cost 3 or more)]
◆When your target Spirit is summoned, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this Nexus is deployed, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Revive] Main - (Once per Turn: Same Name) You can deploy this card from Soul State.

[Contract Field] [LV1][LV2]
Give all your "Thunderive" family cards an extra [Yellow Core] reduction symbol. Also, (Can't Stack) when your "Thunderive" family Spirit is summoned, you can +2 counters. (Max. Up to 10 counters)

3 [LV2] Flash -
(Once per turn, send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) During this game, an opposing Spirit/Ultimate can't attack/block.

BS65-053.name: The HeavenDeityDragon Avan-Shivre
BS65-053.kanji: 天神竜アヴァン・シヴル
BS65-053.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Extreme Contract & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Ultimate.

[SuAdcon: You control one or more “The Extreme Partner, Zetter”, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned/Advents)
Your counter +1. Then, you can return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

[During OC] [Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4] (When Blocks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, immediately end the Attack Step.
[utb]

BS13-055.name: The HeavyArmoredBrave Shield-Dragon Mk-II
BS13-055.kanji: 重装合体シールド・ドラゴンMk-II
BS13-055.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Nexus to the decktop.

[When Braved] [Heavy Armor: Green/White/Yellow]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Green/White/Yellow Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
BS13-055.flavor:
Throughout the war, the Brave dramatically evolved. The speed of that evolution prompted the end of the war.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

SD01-017.name: The HeavyArmoredBug Caterbarga
SD01-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Exhaust every Cost 1 or less Spirit.
SD01-017.flavor: You get lost easily in the woods. That's why they've left their minions here and there to mark their path.

BS70-X08.name: The HeavenEarthCreationStaff Diastima
BS70-X08.kanji: 天地創杖ディアスティマ
BS70-X08.effect:
[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]
Put a core from the Void to your Spirit/Reserve. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit/Ultimate -10000 BP, and return it to the deckbottom when it is brought to 0 BP.

[During Nexus Brave] [Contract Field] Flash -
Once per turn, you can immediately activate one of this Nexus' [Contract Skill], treating cores as being sent to the Void.

BSC45-041.name: The HeavyArmoredBug Caterbarga LT
BSC45-041.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Heavy exhaust every Cost 3 or less Spirit/Ultimate. For each target heavily exhausted by this effect, you can summon one Cost 7 or less "Shellman"/"Parasite" family Spirit card from your Hand/Removed Zone, paying one cost for each.
BSC45-041.flavor: You get lost easily in the woods. That's why they've left their minions here and there to mark their path.

BSC05-016.name: The HeavenHornBeast Bicorn
BSC05-016.effect:
[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
When this battle resolves, if the opposing blocking Spirit is 6000 BP or less, by not comparing BP, treat this Spirit as not being blocked.
BSC05-016.flavor:
Seeing this creature gracefully racing through the heavens as it performs Brave Fusion takes my breath away.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS08-026.name: The HeavyArmoredBug Goliearth
BS08-026.kanji: 超重甲蟲ゴライアース
BS08-026.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Battles)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, refresh this Spirit.

[LV2] (When Battles)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
BS08-026.flavor:
With single-minded fury, he rushes ahead at full tilt. While he's wailing on an enemy, I easily sneak by his flank unnoticed as I chase after an eagle gliding through the treetops.
-from the 11th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BSC50-028.name: The HeavenHornBeast Bicorn LT
BSC50-028.effect:
[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can draw two cards from the deckbottom. Also, when comparing BP with an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate, by not comparing BP, treat as not being blocked.
BSC50-028.flavor:
Seeing this creature gracefully racing through the heavens as it performs Brave Fusion takes my breath away.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10660.name: The HeavenKnight Harmonia
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10660.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put one core from the Void to any "Shellman" family Spirit you control. Then, you can reveal four cards from your decktop. Add a Grandwalker Nexus card which has "Shellman" family as a Core Charge condition to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10660.flavor:
The first one to arrive in Hindida territory was Grandwalker Ares. His speed was such that he left the group and seized a bridgehead pretty much by himself.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 2:38―

P14-22.name: The HeavyArmoredCorporal Parmenion
P14-22.kanji: 重装兵長パルメニオン
P14-22.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Assault: 1] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit. When this effect destroys any opposing Spirit, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.
P14-22.flavor: The Blue Seas region is where the Giants live. I can't help but feel nostalgic for some reason. Is this the memory of the Giant's blood flowing inside of me?

BS15-052.name: The HeavenMarshal Chohakkai
BS15-052.kanji: 天蒼元帥チョウハッカイ
BS15-052.effect:
This Spirit card in the Trash is treated as [The PigMan Chohakkai].

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Neither player can add/discard cards from Hand via Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Your End Step)
Deploy a Nexus card from your Trash without paying the cost.
BS15-052.flavor: It can't be, are the reinforcements just going to stay confined to the castle?

26RSD04-004.name: The HeavyClaw Forclawer
26RSD04-004.effect:
[LV1-2]Start of Opposing Attack StepCan't Stack
You can target an opposing Spirit. It must attack at the start of the step if possible.

[LV2]
When you're summoning any Cost 6 or more "Mineroid" family Spirit card, this Spirit gains an extra White symbol.
26RSD04-004.flavor: It was far too coarse and enormous to be called a claw.

BS69-031.name: The HeavyCrossbowLionheart Leonteus
BS69-031.kanji: 重弩の勇士レオンテウス
BS69-031.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Hermes" & C4 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can send one opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Removed Zone. By paying seven costs, change the "one" written in this effect to "ten".

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can return a card from the opposing Removed Zone to the deckbottom. When this effect returns a Cost 7 or more card, put two cores from the Void to your Spirits.
BS69-031.flavor:
Hey, Huracan! Don't you dare go before me!
―Grandwalker Hermes―

BS54-TX04-A10665.name: The HeavenRouseSpear Rhongo-Mynias
BS54-TX04-A10665.kanji: 天醒槍ロンゴ・ミニアス
BS54-TX04-A10665.effect:
[Brave Symbol +1]

[LV1] (When Reborn)
During this turn, your Life can only be reduced by one by attacks of opposing Spirits/Ultimates.

[During Brave]
This Spirit is treated as one level higher. Also, while you have three counters or more, this Spirit gains an extra God symbol.
BS54-TX04-A10665.flavor: Glory to the right hand! And victory to the left hand!

BS28-034.name: The HeavyCruiserMachine Peacocruiser
BS28-034.kanji: 重巡機ピーコックルーザー
BS28-034.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by the opponent]
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. You can summon every "Machine Beast" family Spirit card/Ultimate card among them, without paying the cost. Discard any unsummoned or remaining cards. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Machine Beast" family Ultimate is blocked by an opposing Ultimate, refresh that Ultimate you control.
BS28-034.flavor: Now's the time for all Spirits to work together and find the Space-Time Bonding Point where time travel is feasible, but why is it that Blizza-Liger and the rest of you are getting in our way!!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10667.name: The HeavenStarDragon Apollodragon-Spica
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10667.kanji: 天星龍アポロドラゴン・スピカ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10667.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing refreshed Spirit.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with one core on it.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10667.flavor:
The celestial halberd birthed from the flash of dawn is eternally destined to be passed into the hands of the brave.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS54-020.name: The HeavyDragonKnight Adams
BS54-020.effect:
For each Purple-only Rebirth Nexus you control, this card in Hand gets -1 cost (Max. -3).

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can draw two cards. Then, you can send three cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3]
For each "DragonKnight"-named Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +5000 BP.
BS54-020.flavor:
Seems that the Dragon Knights would continue to watch over the "Grandstone", while also protecting it for us. They are so reliable.

BSC45-025.flavor: The former ruler was transformed by the wisdom of the snake and the strength of the demons. He needed both to fight against the Empty Sky.

BS35-XX02.name: The HeavenlyDemonKing God-Sechs -Type The End-
BS35-XX02.kanji: 天魔王ゴッド・ゼクス -終ノ型-
BS35-XX02.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
You can swap this card from Hand with a "God-Sechs" Spirit you control in the same condition.

[LV3] (Your Turn)
All your Spirits are unaffected by opposing Spirit/Magic effects.
[Six Heaven Rush: 6] (Activate if you have six symbol colors)
The symbols of your attacking Spirit are fixed as [Red Core][Purple Core][Green Core][White Core][Yellow Core][Blue Core] (Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue, one of each).
BS35-XX02.flavor: "Six Heaven's Rush is finally accomplished… Bow down before the country-cleaving blade of the supreme ruler!!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10714.name: The HeavenlyDemonKing God-Sechs -Type Zero-
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10714.kanji: 天魔王ゴッド・ゼクス -零ノ型-
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10714.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.
[Six Heaven Rush: 2]
If you have two or more symbol colors, destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10714.flavor: The Master took Greedy-Death-Gal-Vados, one of the pillars of the Six Absolute Deities believed to live in Violet Spectre Province's underworld, very seriously.

BS24-087.name: The Hell City Caina
BS24-087.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Spirits with [Curse]/ [Spell Blight] are exhausted, draw a card.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
You can summon an "Ogre Wizard" family Spirit card from your Trash.
BS24-087.flavor: The Ogre Wizards have begun to gather in their sacred land to combat the Ultimates. And then, quite spontaneously, their city was formed.

BSC48-009.name: The HeavenlyDemonKing God-Sechs LT -Type Flame-
BSC48-009.kanji: 天魔王ゴッド・ゼクスLT -焔ノ型-
BSC48-009.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the opponent)
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can destroy an opposing Spirit/Nexus with one symbol or less.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can draw two cards.
[Six Heaven Rush: 3] (Activate if you have three or more symbol colors)
You can return a "Heavenly Demon King"/"Vassal" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.
BSC48-009.flavor: Among God-Sechs, there are also some undisclosed models. And which is this, Type-Flame.

BSC48-011.name: The HeavenlyDemonKing God-Sechs LT -Type Zero-
BSC48-011.kanji: 天魔王ゴッド・ゼクスLT -零ノ型-
BSC48-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can discard a card from your Hand. (Once per Turn: Same Name) When this effect discards any "Heavenly Demon King"/"Vassal" family card, you can draw two cards.
[Six Heaven Rush: 3] (Activate if you have three or more symbol colors)
For each of your symbol colors, you can send a core from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void.
BSC48-011.flavor: The Master took Greedy-Death-Gal-Vados, one of the pillars of the Six Absolute Deities believed to live in Violet Spectre Province's underworld, very seriously.

BSC48-X08.name: The HeavenlyDemonKing God-Sechs X
BSC48-X08.kanji: 天魔王ゴッド・ゼクスX
BSC48-X08.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Dairokuten Maou" & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.
[Six Heaven Rush: 3] (Activate if you have three or more symbol colors)
Every opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Grandwalker Nexus can't refresh.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can send two cores from the opposing Field to the Trash.
BSC48-X08.flavor: "In the name of the Six Heaven, all shall be leveled to me!"

BS40-075.name: The Heavenly City Lumina-Aeterna
BS40-075.kanji: 天空都市ルミナ・エテルナ
BS40-075.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your End Step)
If you [advented] during this turn, you can send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to your Reserve. When you've done so, return every opposing 3000 BP or less Spirits to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2]
While you control any [During Advent] Spirit, the number of cores on your "Divine Spirit" family Spirits can't become less than two due to opposing effects.
BS40-075.flavor:
When the Solar Militia and Lunar Brigade clashed, the Twelve Zodiac Spirits made peace in the shrine supposedly in this city.
-from the Places of Interest 812/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BS41-081.name: The Heavenly Spring
BS41-081.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The symbols of either player's Imagine Braves become 0, and neither player can summon "Imagine" family Brave cards.

[LV2] (Your Draw Step)
Instead of drawing, return a "Divine Spirit" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.
BS41-081.flavor:
The ground is lost due to the Great Collapse. As a result, however, a magnificent and beautiful floating Spring in the heavens is formed. Though, just beware that the "water" flowing from it is purely stimulus.
-from the Places of Interest 246/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

SD01-011.name: The HellFighter Balam
SD01-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Curse] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked at the end of battle.
SD01-011.flavor: Some warriors have sold their souls to the demons in order to fight against the soldiers of the Empty Sky. Many more are expected to follow them.

BSC45-021.name: The HellFighter Balam LT
BSC45-021.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Purple Core][Purple Core][Core])]
Destroy a Spirit with one core or less on it. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [True-Curse] (Your Turn)
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
BSC45-021.flavor: Some warriors have sold their souls to the demons in order to fight against the soldiers of the Empty Sky. Many more are expected to follow them.

BSC45-020.name: The HellGeneral Amaimon LT
BSC45-020.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
You can discard six cards from your decktop. Then, return a "Vanity Deity"/"Deified General" family card from the Trash to the Hand.

[LV2]
All your "Vanity Deity"/"Deified General" family Spirits are treated as being on their highest level.
BSC45-020.flavor: A new mission was given to those who work for the demons.

BS13-015.name: The HellGovernor Hagen
BS13-015.effect:
During (Your End Step), return this Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return a Spirit card with [Curse]/ [Immortality] from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your attacking Spirits with [Curse]/ [Immortality] are treated as colorless.
BS13-015.flavor:
With 9/10ths of the world swallowed up in darkness, it was a miracle that this place remained. The escape door that the cowardly Demonkin made to save themselves let me survive.
-from the 14th paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS20-014.name: The HellGuru Flaurou
BS20-014.effect:
[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return a Spirit card with [Rush] from your Trash to the Hand.
BS20-014.flavor: The masked one takes one glance at the strife occurring there and leaves as is.

BS15-014.name: The HellHollowBeast Ibos
BS15-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
While you have a Burst set, each Spirit can only reduce either player's Life by one each turn.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
By discarding a card from your Hand, destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.
BS15-014.flavor: We shake off the pursuing brood of the Vanity Deity! Never tired, I can always depend on Ikazuchi's speed.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10728.name: The HellKanabou Gokusotsu
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10728.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +3000 BP. Also, draw a card.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field] (Your Main Step)
When your Cost 3 or more Spirit is summoned, destroy an opposing Nexus. This effect can only be used once per turn.

BS06-024.name: The HellKnight Andra
BS06-024.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with two cores or less on it.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When Spirit with [Curse] you control attacks, send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.

[LV3] (When Destroyed)
For each Spirit with [Curse] you control, send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.
BS06-024.flavor: Having gained the support of the former rulers, the demons are going to advance towards the Dragon Emperor.

BS18-014.name: The HellLibrarian Dantalian
BS18-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2[LV3]
When your Purple Spirits would be exhausted by opposing Spirit/Brave effects, for each Spirit that would be exhausted, by sending a card from your decktop to your Trash, that Spirit won't become exhausted.
BS18-014.flavor: The head clerk immediately looked this way and scowled. Does he really object to Kei being the first emperor that much?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10731.name: The HellLionKnight Marbalion
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10731.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) Send cores from two opposing Spirits to the Reserve until only one core remains on each of them.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step) Your first attacking Spirit can target and attack an opposing exhausted Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10731.flavor: The heroes of the Demon Realm have slain many generals as they fought relentlessly. They will continue to do so until the Deities of Oblivion swallow them whole.

BS18-018.name: The HellMask Zorro
BS18-018.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
By returning a Cost 5 or more Red/Purple Spirit you control to the deckbottom, summon this Spirit card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
When summoned via a Burst effect, besides this Spirit, send one core each from every Spirit to its owner's Reserve. For each Spirit that has the cores on it becomes 0 due to this effect, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BS18-018.flavor: He arrives with the scent of roses.

BS10-017.name: The HellMousquetaire Gaim
BS10-017.flavor: The siege of the Infernal Lords buried the Generals of Oblivion, but their moment of victory was quickly erased due to the emergence of more Oblivion troops bearing striking resemblances to the fallen generals...

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10734.name: The HellMusician Mur
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10734.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Curse (During Your Battle Phase) Each time this spirit is blocked , destroy the spirit that blocked this spirit at the End of Battle Step.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed) Move all but 1 core from target spirit your opponent controls to the owners reserve
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10734.flavor: Those who control fear are free. Even if they are destroyed by a soldier of the Empty Sky, they will take the opponent with them.

HA-KUSAI.name: The HellNinjaChief Ha-Kusai
HA-KUSAI.kanji: 冥忍者棟梁ハ・クサイ
HA-KUSAI.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the opponent]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Treat this Spirit's color as colorless, and heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits. For each Spirit this effect heavy exhausts, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your Green Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.

BS21-017.name: The HellPatroller Valfared
BS21-017.kanji: 冥巡士ヴァルファレード
BS21-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Spirits with [Curse] are destroyed by the opponent, draw a card.
BS21-017.flavor: The global abnormalities and the rebellion that sprung from them. There were some who chose to simply observe until the two uproars ended.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10737.name: The HellRouseKing Luciferd
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10737.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon/deploy up to three Purple Rebirth Spirit cards/Rebirth Nexus cards from your Trash, paying one cost each. If you have three counters or more, you can use cores from the opposing Reserve/Nexuses, except [Soul Core], to pay the costs. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, increase the Level Cost of all opposing Spirits/Nexuses by +1.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10737.flavor: Nowadays there are tons of new Kings born into this world. A strong one from the Purple World would be him. It is cheating that he can use even the power of the opponent right?

BS08-016.name: The HellSerpentineMan Botis
BS08-016.effect:
[Tribute: Cost 1 or more → Trash]
After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from one of your Cost 1 or more Spirits to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw a card. When an "Infernal Lord" family Spirit was used for [Tribute], instead, draw three cards.
BS08-016.flavor: The Monarchs wish for complete conquest; Oblivion's goal is annihilation. The Dark Snakes who approve the Monarchs also evade Oblivion's existence.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10739.name: The HellShooter Gushion
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10739.flavor: As the investigation continued, the many mysterious things became nothing new. With the gloomy atmosphere, I am feeling really uncomfortable.

BS17-017.name: The HellSoarBeast Fur-Fool
BS17-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
When you set a Burst, send a core from any opposing Spirit to their Trash.
BS17-017.flavor: Even if one fall, it takes its opponent with it. All for its comrades... A warrior is the same in any nation.

BS22-011.name: The HellWarlock Shax
BS22-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Cost 12 or less Brave Spirit.
BS22-011.flavor: The DarkArtsWarrior sees the future. He sees beyond the continent being engulfed and destroyed by the invasion.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10742.name: The HellWheel Buer
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10742.effect:
[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
Draw a card, and send a core from any opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit to their Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10742.flavor:
It pursues as it spins over and over. Saying it's scary is an understatement.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS08-011.name: The HellWolf Armon
BS08-011.flavor: The Monarchs called forth and sent out many subordinates. So many in fact that one could assume they achieved world conquest in their spare time.

BS64-058.name: The HellflameBaron Garoborg
BS64-058.effect:
[Summon Condition: You have one counter or more]

[LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
Your counters +2. Then, you can target and attack an opposing Spirit. This "target attack" can't be prevented by opposing effects.

[LV4] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Nexus. Then, by sending a core from this Ultimate to the Trash, put a core from the Void to any Ultimate you control.
BS64-058.flavor: " Grrr! Lord Zahfag, I will take the pride of drawing the first blood in this war!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10745.name: The HellflameCount Deffert
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10745.effect:
This Spirit card in Trash is unaffected by any effect.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
If your Soul Core is banished, activate one of the [Soul Drive] of your [The Hellflame FourDemonLord Bram-Zand].

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When this Spirit, or your Ultimates attacks, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or more Ultimate.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10745.flavor: "The chagrin of my lord shall be dispelled with the revival of the Evil God-King."

SD65-001.name: The HellflameCount Zan-Zival
SD65-001.kanji: 獄炎伯ザン・ジヴァル
SD65-001.effect:
[Summon Condition: You have one or more counters]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit, or an opposing Nexus.

[LV4][LV5] (Start of Your Attack Step)
Send up to five cores from your Trash to your “Evil God”/"Next Generation" family Ultimates/Nexuses. Then, you can send two cores from your other "Evil God" family Ultimates/Nexuses to the Trash. When you've done so, destroy an opposing originally Cost 3 or less Grandwalker Nexus.
SD65-001.flavor: "Lord Zahfag is the descendant of the prestigious Bram family. He is said to be Lord Bram-Zand-the-Second."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10747.name: The HellsoilGreatKnight Orda-Granatos
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10747.kanji: 獄土の大騎士オルダ・グラナトス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10747.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by the Opponent)
Send a core each from every opposing Spirit to the Reserve. If you control any Ultimate, instead, send three cores each from every opposing Spirit to the Reserve. After this effect activates, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
The color of your attacking Ultimate is treated as colorless.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10747.flavor: The remarkably large knight blew away the entire War Dragon Army's fort in a single blow! Ultimate-Muramasa-Dragon, please keep at it! Protect the race!

P16-21.name: The Hellflame Duke Bram-Zand-Noir
P16-21.kanji: 獄炎公爵ブラム・ザンド・ノワール
P16-21.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at three or less]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
[Soul Drive] If you banish the [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Ultimate from the game, send two cores each from every opposing Spirit/Nexus to their Trash. On the next (Opposing Refresh Step), the opponent can't return any cores from their Trash to their Reserve.

[LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
Send cores from an opposing Spirit to the Trash until only one core remains on it.
P16-21.flavor: The FourDemonLord that governs hellfire revives, clad in flames of despair.

BS38-013.name: The HellsoilKnight Corps
BS38-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve. If you control any Ultimate, instead, send three cores from an opposing Spirit to their Reserve.
BS38-013.flavor: Ultimate-Muramasa-Dragon followed the War Dragon Army and met The Hellsoil FourDemonLord Magnamizer on the battlefield! In response, Magnamizer sent in his follower HellsoilKnight Corps! The fight is getting even more heated than the race!!

SD65-X01.name: The Hellflame FourDemonLord Bram-Zahfag
SD65-X01.kanji: 獄炎の四魔卿ブラム・ザッファーグ
SD65-X01.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more "The PartnerDemonLord Javad", including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned)
Destroy every opposing Spirit. Then, (Once per Game: Same Name) by sending one of your Lives to the Void, until your next Start Step, the opponent can't summon Spirit cards. This "can't summon" effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

[LV4][LV5] (Your Attack Step)
While your “Evil God” family Ultimate is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.
SD65-X01.flavor: "As long as my soul continues to burn, the flames of Limbo shall never fade!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10751.name: The HellsoilKnight Leftis
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10751.kanji: 獄土の騎士レフティス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10751.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[LV1][LV2] [SSoul: Purple]
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains [Purple Core] (an extra Purple Symbol).
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10751.flavor:
The investigation in Japang has found that the distortion in space that occurred 60 years ago remains, and is still open.
―■■■ Report―

BRAM-ZAND.name: The Hellflame FourDemonLord Bram-Zand
BRAM-ZAND.kanji: 獄炎の四魔卿ブラム・ザンド
BRAM-ZAND.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at three or less]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
[Soul Drive] If you banish the [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Ultimate from the game, destroy every opposing Spirit. Until the next (Your Start Step), the opponent can't summon Spirit cards.

[LV5] (Your Attack Step)
After the effect of this Ultimate's [Soul Drive] resolves, activate the [Soul Drive] of one of your Ultimates. This effect can only be used once per game.
BRAM-ZAND.flavor: The FourDemonLord who governs flame. The terrain burnt down by its inferno turns into scorched wasteland.

BS38-051.name: The HellsoilSorcerer Denial
BS38-051.kanji: 獄土の魔導師ディナイアル
BS38-051.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at three or less]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned)
[Soul Drive] If you banish the [Soul Core](Soul Core) on your Reserve from the game, send all cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve. For each core sent by this effect, you can summon one Purple Spirit card from your Trash without paying the cost.

[LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.
BS38-051.flavor: According to the stone monument left in the shrine, the FourDemonLords ruled the flames, wind, soil, and sea of the old world.

SQUIDMAN-ADMIRAL.name: The HellseaAdmiral Squidman-Admiral
SQUIDMAN-ADMIRAL.kanji: 獄海提督スキッドメン・アドミラル
SQUIDMAN-ADMIRAL.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at two or more]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4] (When Summoned/Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost.
[utb]

[LV4]
When your "Hellsea"-named Spirits/Ultimates are destroyed by opposing effects, they can remain on the Field, exhausted.
SQUIDMAN-ADMIRAL.flavor: Whoa, by Squidman-Admiral's command, the squidmen are coming in a rush!

BS64-061.name: The HellwindBaron Grachar
BS64-061.kanji: 獄風男爵グラシャール
BS64-061.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at two or more]

Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Ultimate must also be from the Reserve.

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Ultimate. Also, if it's your Attack Step, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS64-061.flavor: "If we are taking about speed then I'm pretty confident in it. I've heard that the Evil God army had once joined something called BSGP in Lord Vandiel's generation. I wonder how is that race going on now."

BS64-062.name: The HellseaBaron Glaugall
BS64-062.kanji: 獄海男爵グラウゴール
BS64-062.effect:
During your Main Step, by discarding this card from the Hand, summon one of your “The PartnerDemonLord Javad” in Soul State, without paying the cost.

[Summon Condition: You have one counter or more]

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, by sending a core from this Ultimate to the Trash, immediately activate one of your set “Evil God” family Bursts.
BS64-062.flavor: "Me may not look like it, but actually pretty smart. Ila said it wrong... Lord Ill doesn't have anything against the other Demon Lords. Lord Javad, please punish Ila."

SD65-005.name: The HellseaCount Ila-Riva
SD65-005.kanji: 獄海伯イラ・リーヴァ
SD65-005.effect:
[Summon Condition: You have one counter or more]

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Draw two cards, then discard a card from your Hand. Then, if this Burst was activated via your "Evil God" family effect, look at the entire opposing Hand, and discard a Magic card among them. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost. Then, by sending a core from your Field/Reserve to the Trash, set a Burst card from your Hand.
SD65-005.flavor: "Lord Ill-Dezal has said, 'Be it flame, soil, or wind, it is useless against the sea!' Denizens of the deep sea! This battle is a good chance for us to outclass the other three Demon Lords!"

SD65-004.name: The HellwindCount Nouvelle-Vague
SD65-004.kanji: 獄風伯ヌーヴェル・ヴァーグ
SD65-004.effect:
[Summon Condition: You have one or more counters]

Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any “The PartnerDemonLord Javad”, by sending two cores from your Reserve to the Trash, summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to this Ultimate, and exhaust an opposing Spirit. Then, if you have six counters or more, you can return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom.
SD65-004.flavor: "So the Four Demon Lords are gathered once again. And I am committing myself to Lord Van-Tous' winds."

BS38-047.name: The HellseaGeneral Squidman-General
BS38-047.kanji: 獄海将軍スキッドメン・ジェネラル
BS38-047.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Discard a number of cards from the opposing decktop equal to the cost of the attacking Spirit/Ultimate. When this effect discards any Ultimate cards, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Hellsea"-named Spirits/Ultimates gain an extra Blue symbol.
BS38-047.flavor: It is the Squidmen who destroyed the Evil God's shrine and roused the Evil God Army. They are said to be the clan of survivors from the Evil God Army that fell in ancient times.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10760.name: The HellwindMagician Centaur
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10760.kanji: 獄風の魔術師セントール
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10760.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
[Rush: Ultimate]
(While you have Ultimate symbols, the following effects activate next)
[Core]: Return an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.
[Core][Core]: Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10760.flavor: The Evil God Army's aim is to call forth something even greater from the warp in space that was generated in the past war. They've got to be stopped!!

BS38-044.name: The HellseaLionheart Squidman
BS38-044.kanji: 獄海勇士スキッドメン
BS38-044.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
If you have a Burst set, this Spirit can remain on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2] (After your Burst activates)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a cost equal or inferior to the activated Burst's.
BS38-044.flavor: Traces of the war from 60 years ago still remain on the old battlegrounds of Japang. Using this distortion in space, both the Evil God and Imagine can be called out easily. The Hellsea FourDemonLord's assassins, the Squidmen, are attacking with that in mind. The War Dragon Army keeps a vigilant watch day and night, fighting back.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10762.name: The HellwindUltimateSky Curvidens
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10762.kanji: 獄風極天クルビデンス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10762.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or more Spirit]

[uhand: Red/Green [LV3][LV4]]

[LV4] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Evil God" family Ultimates gain an extra Green symbol.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10762.flavor: Aah! The trap placed by the Evil God Army is catching the racers flying through the sky!

SD65-X04.name: The Hellsea FourDemonLord Ill-Dezal
SD65-X04.kanji: 獄海の四魔卿イル・デザール
SD65-X04.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more "The PartnerDemonLord Javad", including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

This set card can't be discarded by the opponent.

[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the highest cost. Then, destroy two opposing Spirits with a cost equal or inferior to the number of your counters. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV4][LV5] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
While your "DemonLord" is attacking, by sending a core from that Ultimate to the Trash, immediately activate one of your Bursts.

SD65-X03.name: The Hellwind FourDemonLord Van-Tous
SD65-X03.kanji: 獄風の四魔卿ヴァン＝トゥース
SD65-X03.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more "The PartnerDemonLord Javad", including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
By returning a card from your Hand to the decktop, put two cores from the Void to any of your Ultimates, and during this turn, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.

[LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Besides [Soul Core], by sending a core from your Trash to the Void, reveal a number of cards from your decktop up to the number of counters you have. Among them, you can summon up to three “DemonLord” without paying the cost, or [Contract Advent] them. Banish any remaining cards.
SD65-X03.flavor: "Each and every one of the Four Demon Lords are gathered. Lord Javad, let's march forward with ultimate divine winds!"

IL-IMARJO.name: The Hellsea FourDemonLord Ill-Immersio
IL-IMARJO.kanji: 獄海の四魔卿イル・イマージョ
IL-IMARJO.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or higher Spirits/Ultimates]

[uhand all: [LV3][LV4][LV5]]

[LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
[Soul Drive] If you banish the [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Ultimate from the game, you can activate any number of cards with Burst effects from your Hand, ignoring their conditions.
IL-IMARJO.flavor: The FourDemonLord who governs the sea. The dark, muddy streams of the ocean's depths wash away all on the surface.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10766.name: The Hellwind FourDemonLord Vandiel
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10766.kanji: 獄風の四魔卿ヴァンディール
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10766.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at three or Less]

[LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
[Soul Drive] If you banish the [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Ultimate from the game, reveal cards from your decktop until three Ultimate cards appear. Summon all those Ultimates cards without paying the cost, and ignoring their Summon Conditions. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV4] (Your Attack Step)
When the attacks of your Ultimates reduce the opposing Life, send an opposing Life to the Void.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10766.flavor: The FourDemonLord who governs the winds. The hellish winds tear the sky and summon new troops from another dimension.

BS38-021.name: The Hellwind Guard Tsunohasa-Shielder
BS38-021.kanji: 獄風の衛兵ツノハサ・シールダー
BS38-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void each to this Spirit and one of your Ultimates.

[LV2]
The number of cores on this Spirit and all your Ultimates can't become two or less due the opponent.
BS38-021.flavor: Sky and land are both in chaos after The Hellwind Guard Tsunohasa-Shielder's attack! He's leading the racers by the nose with his swift ninja-like movements! The StrayNinja racers signaled for Ninja Gale Village to send reinforcements. Village ninjas, please answer!

BS64-060.name: The HellsoilBaron Judas
BS64-060.effect:
[Summon Condition: You have one counter or more]

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned)
Treat this Ultimate's color as colorless, and destroy two opposing Spirits with three cores or more on them.

[LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
Unless the opponent sends a core from any of their Spirits to the Trash, they can't block.
BS64-060.flavor: "To say it in a way that you guys can understand, here is what called the 'Reverse Continent' in the past."

BS38-018.name: The Hellwind Platoon Antman
BS38-018.kanji: 獄風の小隊アントマン
BS38-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] [SSoul: Green]
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains [Green Core] (an extra Green Symbol).
BS38-018.flavor: The reinforcement Ninja Gales and Burberry Hopper make a pincer attack!! As fellow ninjas, their coordination is perfect. Their numbers are an equal match, but their formation has the advantage!! With this, can't they defeat the HellWind FourDemonLord's underlings!?

SD65-002.name: The HellsoilCount Grey-Tude
SD65-002.kanji: 獄土伯グレイ・チュード
SD65-002.effect:
[Summon Condition: You have one or more counters]

[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Your Turn)
By discarding this Mirage, your counter +1. When you do, send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve.

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1, and draw a card.
SD65-002.flavor:
The star of Limbo, Javad, is born. As if in response to that, the four demon lords of Flame, Soil, Wind, and Sea all showed up and introduced themselves. The four demon lords who fought amongst each other until then bowed their heads to Javad, and Javad thus became the actual ruler of the four demon lords.
―Evil God Comedy: Prologue―

BS38-CP05.name: The Hellwind Searcher Kagerou-Seeker
BS38-CP05.kanji: 獄風の探索者カゲロウ・シーカー
BS38-CP05.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at two or more]

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned)
If [Soul Core] was used to pay the summon cost, reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add an Ultimate card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV4]
Your Ultimate symbols are also treated as Red/Green symbols.
BS38-CP05.flavor: It was the Evil God Army's Kagerou-Seeker who found the distortion in space. "Bugs" was the one who noticed the Evil God Army's attack. Did some kind of resonance happen... a forbugging sense?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10772.name: The Hellsoil FourDemonLord Magnamiser
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10772.kanji: 獄土の四魔卿マグナマイザー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10772.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 3 or higher Spirit/Ultimate]

[Triple Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)]
For each Ultimate-Trigger hit, send two cores from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Trash.

[Double Hit] When it hits twice or more, send an opposing Life to the Trash.

[Triple Hit] When it hits thrice, discard two random cards from the opposing Hand.
[tutb]
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10772.flavor: The Four Demon Lord who governs the soil. The beings which crawl through the earth are reduced to ashes with one sword stroke and return to the soil.

SD65-X02.name: The Hellsoil FourDemonLord Magnazappah
SD65-X02.kanji: 獄土の四魔卿マグナザッパー
SD65-X02.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more "The PartnerDemonLord Javad", including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Evil God" family Ultimates would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[Count Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned/Attacks)]
When Count Ultimate Trigger hits, once per turn, send two cores from the opposing Field to the Trash.
[cutb]
SD65-X02.flavor: "I'm the Hellsoil Four Demon Lord of this generation. One day, I'll become legend too..."

BS25-017.name: The Hellwitch Aini
BS25-017.effect:
During (Your Draw Step), by discarding this Spirit card from your Hand, increase the number of cards you draw by +1.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Besides [The Hellwitch Aini], you can activate the (When Destroyed) effects of all Spirits you control, without destroying them.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Void.
BS25-017.flavor: Are those cat ears? Yeah, they're cat ears... but isn't something missing? Like, she doesn't feel alive? ...but seems like the sort of thing my brother might like.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10775.name: The Helmsman Isaac
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10775.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Summon Bolt: Cost 4/5 - (When Battles) At the end of the battle, by destroying this Spirit, summon 1 cost 4/5 Spirit card in the same family as this Spirit from your hand without paying its cost.

[LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent) Activate this Spirit's "Summon Bolt".
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10775.flavor: I know I'm a bit late, but is he a Summon Bolt user? I didn't think he'd be able to use it that well. If we use him, we can send forces straight to the enemy's most vulnerable spot! ...Oh, so we need the something-or-other Booster for that. Man, what a pain.

CB22-016.name: The HerculeanFighter Darrgon
CB22-016.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Enemy" family Spirit is attacking, that Spirit gains +3000 BP, and the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
By banishing five cards from your decktop, during this battle, this Spirit gains an extra Purple symbol.
CB22-016.flavor: The Herculean Fighter who works with Carmeara. He looks for an equal fight with similar power level, and the stronger the resistance the opponent offers, the greater power he can bring out.

BS58-010.name: The Hermit-Dog Skipper
BS58-010.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Purple Core])]
[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
Neither player can move cores from the Trash to the Field/Reserve.

[LV1][LV2]
Once per turn, when an opposing effect would increase cores from the Void, you can send those cores to this Spirit instead.
BS58-010.flavor:
Following the capture of "Tower", its kins stopped fighting. If things had gone smooth, then "Tower" might have been destroyed in the fight just then. That's probably what Chronos was aiming for, but we managed to avoid that. And now, we finally have both "Chariot" and "Tower" gathered.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 7:30―

BS58-013.name: The Hermit-Ritter Cuadrado
BS58-013.kanji: 隠者騎士クアドラッド
BS58-013.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Purple Core][White Core])]
[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
When your Purple/White "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" family Spirit attacks/blocks, send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return an "Evil Shadow"/"Armed Machine" family card from your Trash to the Hand. This effect can only be used once per turn.
BS58-013.flavor:
What's left was just travelling to the future. But it was at that time, all the Hermit-Ritters suddenly stood their guards and were poised for something to come. It was probably their nature which allowed them to detect the overflowing darkness power.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 7:31―

BS58-012-A10779.name: The Hermit-Ritter Eberardo
BS58-012-A10779.kanji: 隠者騎士 エベラルド
BS58-012-A10779.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Discard a card from your decktop, and draw a card.

[LV2] [Rebirth3]
When this Spirit attacks, if you have a Purple/White Mirage set, you can flip this Spirit.
BS58-012-A10779.flavor:
Only the Hermit-Ritters and a part of the spirits who reacted quick enough were free. All the others were swallowed by the wave of darkness and had their strength taken away from them.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 7:32―

BS60-016.name: The Hermit-Ritter Hermenegildo
BS60-016.kanji: 隠者騎士エルメネヒルド
BS60-016.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
By discarding a Purple/White card from your Hand, draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit attacks, if you control any "Oracle" Spirit, by destroying this Spirit, destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Grandwalker Nexus.
BS60-016.flavor:
Chrono's army appeared at different places around the world at the same time. The Chariot City was no exception.
"Now that the main force is not here, it is time for us the Hermit-Ritters to take care of it."

BS59-013.name: The Hermit-Ritter Jilvest
BS59-013.kanji: 隠者騎士 ジルベスト
BS59-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each "Oracle"/"Hermit"-named Spirit you control, send a core from a single opposing Spirit to the Reserve.
[Rush: White]
(While you have White symbols, the following effect activates next)
[White Core]: Refresh an "Oracle"/"PanzerBuild"-named Spirit you control.
[White Core][White Core]: Put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control.
BS59-013.flavor:
Before "The-Hermit" was caught, he had left a prophecy for the Hermit-Ritters. And that was to lend their power to us in this Armageddon that would happen here today.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 8:25―

BS59-011.name: The Hermit-Ritter Olegat
BS59-011.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 5 ([Purple Core][Purple Core][White Core])]
Send two core from an opposing Spirit/Ultiamte to the Reserve, and when depletes, draw a card. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto your Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing exhausted Spirit. When blocked, you can set a Purple/White Mirage card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BS59-011.flavor:
Was that a coincidence? Or was that the guidance of fate? The imprisoned Oracle was the Oracle Spirit of "Hermit".
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 8:23―

BS59-012-A10783.name: The Hermit-Ritter Villarreal
BS59-012-A10783.kanji: 隠者騎士ヴィジャーレアル
BS59-012-A10783.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
By discarding a card from your Hand, draw two cards.

[LV2] [Rebirth3]
At the end of this Spirit's attack, or when this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can flip this Spirit. When you do, this Reborn Brave can either refresh and brave to a Spirit you control, or remain in Spirit condition by putting a core from your Reserve/Spirit onto it.
BS59-012-A10783.flavor:
There is a strong bonding between the Hermit Oracle and the knights. It was by taking reference from both the talisman and their feelings that we ultimately reached the Oracle's location.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 8:24―

SD69-004.name: The HermitDragon Ma-Diga -Humanoid Form-
SD69-004.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Nexus' (When Summoned/Deployed) effect resolves]
Destroy an opposing Nexus, and effects of the destroyed target can't activate. Then, including being in Soul State, if you control any "Contractor Brahma", you can send out one of your "Rig Avatar Dragon" Tokens. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By destroying one of your Tokens, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest BP.
SD69-004.flavor: Once upon a time, there was a Hermit Dragon who flew out of Hindida. The pride of the Ma clan has long since been forgotten. But be of good health, my brothers who have lost your four arms.

BS76-009.name: The HermitDragon Ma-Kranti
BS76-009.effect:
When your "Creation" family Spirits would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand, treating all reduction symbols as fulfilled.

[LV1-2-3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with two symbols or less.

[LV2-3] (When Attacks)
You can send all cores from an opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void.
BS76-009.flavor:
Being around Indra just throws me off balance. He's always been like that. Basically never giving a thought to how others feel.
―Grandwalker Brahma―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10786.name: The HermitDragon Shloka
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10786.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Brahma" Nexus card, a "Generator", and a Saga Brave card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, by discarding a card from your Hand, it remains on the Field, in the same condition.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10786.flavor: Brahma is one of the three deities of Hindida's Trimurti. He administers creation.

BSC42-076.name: The Hermit Wise Tree LT
BSC42-076.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
For each exhausted Spirit you control, one of your attacking/blocking Spirits gains +1000 BP.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
You can refresh all your Spirits.
BSC42-076.flavor:
The Hermit Wise Tree which has been there since the initial stage of the woods. It told us a secret of the World Tree. I wonder if it survived the mass destruction by the Duke.
-from the Places of Interest 8/1000 or "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

P25-08.name: The HeroArcAngelia Mikatitus
P25-08.kanji: 英雄大天使ミカタイタス
P25-08.effect:
Flash - [Mani: Contract Grandwalker Nexus & C4 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Manifests/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can reveal a card from your decktop for each Spirit/Ultimate you control. Add a card among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
When only the opposing Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed via BP comparison, you can discard ten cards from the opposing decktop.
P25-08.flavor: That figure is truly a hero...and an ArcAngelia.

BS49-033.name: The HeroBeastBrothers Dioscuri
BS49-033.kanji: 英雄獣兄弟ディオスクーロイ
BS49-033.effect:
This card in Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
While you control any Green Grandwalker Nexus, cards in the Removed Zone can't be used by the opponent.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can send an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the Removed Zone. When you've done so, take two cores from the Void, and in anyway you like, either put them to this Spirit or + cores to one Green-only Grandwalker Nexus you control.
BS49-033.flavor:
Amidst their celebrations, a letter is delivered to Susanoo. A letter which later would be called "Hermes' Secret Letter."
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 2:52―

BS44-032.name: The HeroBeast ArcheryGeneral Pandaro-Cross
BS44-032.kanji: 英雄獣 弓将パンダロ・クロス
BS44-032.effect:
When this card in Hand is discarded by an opposing effect, you can draw up to three cards.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can banish a card from the opposing Trash. When you've done so, return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the Hand.
BS44-032.flavor: Achilleser's beloved friend and an expert archer, skill approved even by Artemis herself. His only fault is being bad at picking bamboo.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10791.name: The HeroBeast Bear-Cadmus
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10791.kanji: 英雄獣ベア・カドモス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10791.effect:
This card in Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates. Also, during this battle, the opposing Burst can't activate.

[During Brave] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By sending three cores from any of your Green-only Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void, during this battle, Flash effects can't be used by the opponent.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10791.flavor: There are many Heroes across the wild, even if they're concealed by the shadow cast by the Seven Great Hero Beasts. Bear-Cadmus is also one of these. The lethal blow dealt by his tough body doesn't give the opponent a chance to react.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10792.name: The HeroBeast Captain-Jason
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10792.kanji: 英雄獣キャプテン・イアソーン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10792.effect:
This card in Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Put a random card from the opposing Hand onto their Removed Zone. Also, return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Nexus/Purple Spirit effects.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
The opposing Burst can't activate.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10792.flavor: Not counted as one of the Seven Great Hero Beasts, but also a Hero Beast that can rival them. Commanding the Argo, he travels through the vast sea with Medea.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10793.name: The HeroBeast OldGeneral Tiger-Nestor
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10793.kanji: 英雄獣 老将タイガー・ネストール
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10793.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can put two cores from the Void to this Spirit. Also, banish all cards in the opposing Trash, and for each three cards banished, heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by paying one cost, this Spirit refreshes.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10793.flavor: Even now, despite becoming old, that Hero is still in good health. Or rather, if you consider the old tiger's crafty strategies, you can only accept that he is currently on his golden years.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10794.name: The HeroBeast Peirithus
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10794.kanji: 英雄獣ペイリトゥース
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10794.effect:
This card in Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a random card from the opposing Hand onto their Removed Zone, and when any Spirit card/Ultimate card is put, put two cores from the Void to this Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10794.flavor: A HeroBeast that participated on the Grand-Lolo defense line together with Theseus. A seven-day long battle was nothing short of intense, but thanks to Hermes' information handling, they somehow managed it.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10795.name: The HeroBird Lord-Kiji-Toria
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10795.kanji: 英雄鳥ロード・キジ・トリア
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10795.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn)
While you have a Burst set, all your "Supreme Hero"/"Great General" family Spirits get +3000 BP.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
If you don't have a Burst set, you can set a card with Burst effect from your Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10795.flavor: The thunder released by Ikazuchi cut through the sky! ...But the target has somehow directed back to this side instead! As expected from Kiji!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10796.name: The HeroDog Lord-One-Kengo
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10796.kanji: 英雄犬ロード・ワン・ケンゴー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10796.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Give all your "Supreme Hero"/"Great General" family Spirits: "[Clash] (When Attacks) The opponent must block if possible."

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10796.flavor: No way! Once it remembers your scent, it'll chase after you anywhere!

BS65-X01.name: The HeroDragonKing Dragroy-XVII
BS65-X01.kanji: 英雄竜王ドラグロイ17世
BS65-X01.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this card is discarded from the Hand via your "Scarlet Flame" family effect, if you have four counters or more, you can summon it by paying two costs.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with one symbol. If you have six counters or more, instead, you can destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to two symbols.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, when opposing Spirits/Ultimates are destroyed via your Spirit effects, draw two cards.
BS65-X01.flavor: "Sacrificing oneself to save the world? It shouldn't be the case!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10798.name: The HeroDragon Lord-Dragon X
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10798.kanji: 英雄龍ロード・ドラゴンX
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10798.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Rebirth5]
When this Spirit attacks, if you have a set Burst, you can flip this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can set down a card with Burst effect from your Hand. When you've done so, draw two cards.

BS65-013.name: The HousekeepingFairy Silkie

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)

They were really having a death wish. Camu...Our mischievous students have done a great job and prevented things from turning into a big mess. But one of the secret treasures were stolen...Well, as long as it doesn't dirty my place I'm fine."

BS05-X18.name: The HugeBeastLord Behedoth

BS67-XV05.flavor: The ground is breaking apart! A different king has actually showed up!!

Belial gave birth to it by making the countless Kaiju ghosts sleeping on the Kaiju Graveyard become one, a Supreme Fusion Kaiju with the appearance of a devil.
―Great Kaiju Battle Ultra Ginga Densetsu THE MOVIE―

Avrielle feels the motion of the Braves, and descends into the Divine World.

So there are those that can stand up against us on the Dark Continent, you say.
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, 699 days remaining—

BS36-043.flavor: Racer Amethyst-Dragon blows something away right before the goal!

BSC05-018.name: The Immovable Headquarters
BSC05-018.effect:

[LV2] (Your End Step)
Refresh all your Brave Spirits.

The Tiger General's stronghold lies before an imposing mountain. Take one single step inside, and the high tension that flows through the area will stop you in your tracks.
-from the Places of Interest 188/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

PB02-G07.name: The InfantIslandGuardian Mothra (1966)
PB02-G07.kanji: インファント島の守護神モスラ (1966)
PB02-G07.effect:

Put one core from the Void each to this Spirit and any "Godzilla"-named Spirit/Grandwalker Nexus you control.

When this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, by putting a core from the Void to this Spirit, it remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
The opposing Burst can't activate.
PB02-G07.flavor:
Ran into Godzilla on the Letchi Island, but did not proceed to start a fight.
―Ebirah, Horror of the Deep (1966)―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10973.name: The ImperialGuard Corpse Soldier
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10973.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
Draw a card.

[LV1][LV2]
While [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, every exactly-named "Grandwalker Dionysus" you control is unaffected by opposing Nexus effects.

[LV2]
While [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, this Spirit can't attack and is unaffected by opposing effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10973.flavor:
"This isn't what we agreed upon...!" The one besides the man who attacked me was Tsukuyomi. He was blown away by same shockwave I was.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 4:25―

SD01-004.name: The Infantry Dragron
SD01-004.flavor: The game may be up for the terra dragons; I'm surprised they were defeated so quickly by small fry. The shortness of the battle might also allow them to recover quickly, though.

P22-08.name: The ImperialLionGuard Arrosoir
P22-08.kanji: 近衛獅団アロゾワール
P22-08.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return a Blue Spirit card with [Contract Advent] from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [AFO]
Give this Spirit and every "The PartnerLion Raon" you control, including those that are in pre-advent condition, the effect: "[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] (When Attacks/Blocks) Destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost."
P22-08.flavor:
If you become my subordinate, you would not fear death, nor hesitate to become the best of the best! And only by then would I allow you to climb to the top with me!
―The PartnerLion Raon―

BS69-015.name: The InfernalCrowSorcerer Raum
BS69-015.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your Hand is discarded via your "Hades"/"Sorcerer" effects, you can return this card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When any Purple "Sorcerer" is summoned from your Trash, if you control any "Contractor Hades", you can draw a card.
BS69-015.flavor: "You want to go to Hermes' world, Hercadia? True that if I use my dimension-controlling power, it's nothing. But does Lord Hades know about this? About this matter, Lord Hermes has rejected our intervention. So should I take this as Dan, you moving at your own discretion?"

BS64-052.name: The ImperialLionGuard Band-Golem
BS64-052.kanji: 近衛獅団バンド・ゴレム
BS64-052.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [AFO]
Give this Spirit and every "The PartnerLion Raon" you control, including those that are in pre-advent condition, the effect: "[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] This Spirit can't be heavily exhausted, or returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects."

[LV2][LV3]
When your Hand is increased via your “King Contract” family Spirit effect, the opponent can't activate any "when draw/when increase Hand" effects.
BS64-052.flavor:
Ever since the day when The-Judgment disappeared, Judgment Beasts have been swaggering around Lecoulis. And the Imperial Lion Guards have then undertaken the mission of monitoring and controlling the beasts.
―The PartnerLion Raon―

BS65-019.name: The InfernalDragon Sabbathfall
BS65-019.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Infernal Contract & C5 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can set a "Blood Crystal" family Mirage card from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost.

BS72-053.name: The ImperialLionGuard Boarstian
BS72-053.kanji: 近衛獅団ボアスチアン
BS72-053.effect:
[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]

Kai, who was searching for the Grandwalker of Contract primarily in the southern realm of the Divine World, encountered Ra-Harakhti, who shared the same objective. A clash between the overbearing Ra-Harakhti and the rebellious Huracan was inevitable, but Raon stepped in to mediate, leading to a truce.
―Divine World Log 01―

BS35-021.name: The InfernalDragon Zon-Tharg
BS35-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)

The opponent sends all cores from one of their Spirits/Ultimates to their Reserve.
BS35-021.flavor:
Evidently, this explosion was caused by a gigantic dragon.
That's all; this is Tonio, reporting on site.

BS64-057.name: The ImperialLionGuard Captain Gangurias

The opponent can't use Magic cards/[Accel].
