BS67-048.flavor: "Alright, eat as much as you want! Eat well, and serve King Raon well!"

BS65-015.name: The InfernalPrincess Paimonia

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)

BSC24-021.name: The InfernalWarrior Kyrieloid
BSC24-021.kanji: 炎魔戦士キリエロイド

[LV1][LV2][LV3](When Summoned)

To oppose Ultraman Tiga, the Kyrielian altered his body size and changed into this battle form. He can shoot powerful flames from his hand.

I've come to settle our fight, Glow! You didn't lose to anyone before me right? Don't go down that easily! Alright so, let's fight!

Kai was under attack by someone while exploring the southern region of the Divine World. The attacker was most likely a local Spirit controlled by Nyx. However, few people had eyes which could detect it. I can only hope it wouldn't become a cause of dispute.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)

BS62-057.name: The ImperialLionGuard Gribeauval-Golem

[LV1][LV2] [AFO]
Give this Spirit and every "The PartnerLion Raon" you control, including those that are in pre-advent condition, the effect: "[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] (When Attacks) Destroy an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's, and when destroys, put a core from the Void to this Spirit."

It would only turn into an attrition warfare if we go on with the fight against Glow. Terad, I am withdrawing! Make sure you don't get the timing of withdrawing wrong too, alright?
―The PartnerLion Raon―

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]

"Rarrrrr! I'll taken over from here! Fight for the king!!"

The dreaded weapon and base of the invaders. This ship later became the home of the singers who, after leaving their tower, boarded it to fill the world with their singing voices.

[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]

The guardian deity of the Seatopia undersea empire. It tormented Godzilla with the geothermal napalm it spits from its mouth and the anti-beast laser fired from its horn.
―Godzilla vs Megalon (1973)―

BS63-071.name: The ImperialLionGuard Hydrain
BS63-071.kanji: 近衛獅団ハイドライン
BS63-071.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw two cards, then discard two cards from your Hand. The opponent can't activate Nexus effects via this draw.

If you have seven counters or more, instead, destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost."

The battle risking The-Hanged Man broke out at the Seal City.
―Record of Sealing Sea 2―

BS67-054.name: The ImperialLionGuard Leader Sanglier

[LV1][LV2] [AFO]

BS62-051.name: The ImperialLionGuard Ortho-Tiger

Treat this Brave as Cost 2.

[When Braved]
Give all your non-braved Ultimates +2 Cost and +5000 BP, and they can activate their [When Braved] effects.
BS30-X08.flavor: All of the Ultimates are gaining strength! This is the power of a DeitySword!

BS10-029.name: The JupiterDragonDeity Nobunagard-Zeuses
BS10-029.kanji: 木星神龍ノブナガード・ゼウシス
BS10-029.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon any number of Brave cards from your Hand without paying the costs. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Braves can't activate.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
For each Brave Spirit you control, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS10-029.flavor:
A dangerous charm! An absolute charisma! Even his minor efforts have a great influence on the tide of battle.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BSC49-027.name: The JupiterDragonDeity Nobunagard-Zeuses LT
BSC49-027.kanji: 木星神龍ノブナガード・ゼウシスLT
BSC49-027.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Green & Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Advents)
You can summon any number of Brave cards from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost. Then, you can put a core from the Void each to every Brave Spirit you control.

[During Brave] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each Brave you control, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BSC49-027.flavor:
A dangerous charm! An absolute charisma! Even his minor efforts have a great influence on the tide of battle.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

X13-07.name: The JusticeHolySword Justicesword
X13-07.kanji: 正義の聖剣ジャスティスソード
X13-07.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 5000 BP, and draw a card for each Spirit destroyed.

[LV1] (Your Attack Step)
All your Spirits with [Charge] gain +1000 BP.

[When Braved] (Your Attack Step)
All your Spirits with [Charge] gain +1000 BP.
X13-07.flavor: The heart of justice burning with passion created a sacred sword.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11057.name: The KabukiDragon Keiji-Dragon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11057.kanji: 火武輝龍ケイジ・ドラゴン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11057.effect:
Flash - [Advent: War Dragon/Clever Machine & Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Destroy two opposing Nexuses. Also, when this Spirit is [advented], you can pay one cost to summon one of its pre-Advent cards.

[LV2]
For each card in the opposing Hand, this Spirit gains +5000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11057.flavor:
"Alex, and Grandwalkers of Hindida, can you hear me? Take me to the enemy's king." I am well aware of how absurd of a demand that is, but if we can't do it, we can't win.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 4:16―

CB22-031.name: The KaijuChief Geronimon［First Generation Ultra Kaiju］
CB22-031.kanji: 怪獣酋長ジェロニモン［初代ウルトラ怪獣］
CB22-031.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Green Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, summon an "Ultra Kaiju"-named card from your Trash by using [Soul Core] as part of its summon cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can summon a Cost 6 or less "Ultra Kaiju"-named Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
The opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.
CB22-031.flavor: It has the power to revive kaijus. It aims to revive various kaijus and launch an all-out attack.

BSC26-X02.name: The KaijuKing Burning Godzilla
BSC26-X02.kanji: 怪獣王バーニングゴジラ
BSC26-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Neither player can remove cores from this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your End Step)
Put two cores from the Void to this Spirit. Then, if there are eight or more cores on this Spirit, destroy this Spirit, and destroy every opposing 20000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit.
BSC26-X02.flavor:
Godzilla, on the verge of a nuclear implosion after the destruction of Birth Island and the nuclear energy in his inner reactor core going out of control.
―Godzilla vs Destoroyah (1995)―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11060.name: The KaijuKing Emerges
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11060.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When the opponent draws, refresh a "Godzilla"-named Spirit you control.

[LV2]
All your "Godzilla"-named Spirit can't be returned to Hand/Deck by opposing effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11060.flavor:
The red Godzilla, who carried the risk of causing a nuclear explosion that would wipe out the Earth, appeared in Shikoku and attacked the power station as he spewed red heat rays.
―Godzilla vs Destoroyah (1995)―

THE-ISLAND.name: The Island of Ocean Master
THE-ISLAND.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed) You can deploy a Nexus card from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step) Treat all your "Ocean Emperor" family Spirits as being 1 Lv higher.
THE-ISLAND.flavor:
The dwelling of an oceanic dragon tribe, where for a moment I thought I had lost my way back into the Ruby Realm. If you would like to go here, you need to bring along a being larger than yourself. Everything comes with a sacrifice.
-from the Places of Interest 90/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

CB28-014.name: The KaijuKing Godzilla (1989)
CB28-014.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Godzilla" & C4 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate, and if there are any Red cards among this Spirit's pre-advent cards, draw two cards.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2]
Increase the limit of this Spirit's "BP Destruction effect" by +10000, and change its target to all.

P23-14.name: The KaijuKing Godzilla (2004)
P23-14.effect:
(Once per Game: Same Name) When your "Godzilla" would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can immediately the following Burst of this card from the Trash.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Either destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with one symbol or less, or exhaust it. When this effect destroys or exhausts, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your Cost 6 or more "Godzilla" gain an extra Red symbol.
P23-14.flavor: Despite being sealed in the ice by Gotengo after fighting it in Antarctica, it is released from the seal by New Gotengo in order to counter the invading monsters controlled by the Xiliens.

BSC26-010.name: The KaijuKing Godzilla［2000］
BSC26-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit is destroyed by opposing effects, it remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit, and draw a card.
BSC26-010.flavor:
The second specimen of Godzilla, following the original who first surfaced in 1954. His body's cells include a material with marvelous regenerative abilities, Organizer G1.
―Godzilla 2000: Millennium―

CB32-CP02.name: The KaijuQueen Gigantron
CB32-CP02.kanji: 怪獣の女王ジャイガントロン
CB32-CP02.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Kaiju" would leave the Field due to opposing effects, or your Cost 7 or more "Ultraman" attacks, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's. Or, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with three cores or more on it.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While you have eight counters or more, this Spirit's "Destruction effects" can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Heavy Armor].
CB32-CP02.flavor: The arch-enemy of the Ultramans. Thought she seems to be fighting to protect something...

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11066.name: The Islands dotting the Emerald Sea
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11066.kanji: エメラルドの海に散らばる島々
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11066.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn) When opposing Spirit is refreshed, refresh a Spirit you control.

[LV2] Besides the (Opposing Draw Step), when the number of cards in the opposing Hand increases, the opponent must discard 1 card from their Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11066.flavor:
A beautiful chain of islands lined up as if all by calculation. At times, nature's aesthetic can surpass the people's imaginations... I wonder if creating them around here was a good idea...
-from the Places of Interest 820/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BSC24-043.name: The Kaiju Graveyard
BSC24-043.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, draw a card.

[LV2] (Start of Opposing Attack Step)
You can summon a Cost 5 or less "Kaiju"/"Seijin"-named Spirit card from your Trash by using [Soul Core](Soul Core) as part of its summon cost.
BSC24-043.flavor:
The space where Kaiju defeated by Ultra Warriors sleep. Ultraman Belial used the Giga Battle Nizer to revive kaiju one after the other.
―Mega Monster Battle: Ultra Galaxy Legends The Movie―

BS53-048.name: The JadeBirdWitch Rirura
BS53-048.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn/Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control, and exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your Reborn Spirit, or "Dark Artes" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.
BS53-048.flavor: "Alex...and Vina...I...I finally become a witch! Um...yea...this way, I can finally maintain proper eye contacts with you while talking...!"

BS55-028.name: The KamiumiBeast Iwatsuchibiko
BS55-028.kanji: 神産ノ獣イワツチビコ
BS55-028.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can't attack, and is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Turn)
The number of cores on each opposing Spirit can't be brought to less than one due to the opponent.

[LV2][LV3]
"Yomi"/"Kamiumi" in your Hand are unaffected by opposing effects.
BS55-028.flavor:
Alex, who has overwhelmed us, must have been going straight to Izanagi's place. Feeling all worthless I am and losing myself, tears started to well up in my eyes again.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 4:15―

BS55-018.name: The JadeDuke Grunwald
BS55-018.kanji: 碧の公爵グリュンワルド
BS55-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can banish up to six Purple-only "Primal" family cards from your Hand, and for each two cards banished, discard a random card from the opposing Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Nightling" family Spirit attacks, the opponent can't block unless they banish one card from their Hand. If you have three counters or more, this effect banishes +1 card. This effect doesn't stack.
BS55-018.flavor: "Vernhard, and El-Folio. Which one should I side with? It's the moment of watershed I guess."

BSC47-002.name: The KamiumiBeast Jumoku-no-Shika
BSC47-002.kanji: 神産ノ獣ジュモクノシカ
BSC47-002.effect:
While you have less counter than the opponent, this card in your Hand/Removed Zone gains an extra [Purple Core] reduction symbol.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can put one core from the Void to any of your Spirit. Then, if you control any "Izanagi & Izanami", by banishing a card from the opposing Trash, your counter +1. If you have two counters or more, this "Banish effect" can't be prevented by opposing effects.
BSC47-002.flavor:
I got to tell you this at the beginning. This is a story that will not be recorded. It happened suddenly and without warning. Chronos broke out from the prison of time. Being one who manipulates time, I should say that's no surprise. An extraordinary irregularity. It should not be in the history I record. So I decided to prune it.
―Divine World Log XXX―

BS35-CP01.name: The JadeEmperorDragon Daiteiou
BS35-CP01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal 12 cards from your decktop. Summon any number of "God-King" family Spirit cards among them, without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
For each "God-King" family Spirit you control, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
BS35-CP01.flavor: "The 216th Twelve God-Kings Battle Survival Grand Prix begins! To the 167 racers! To the limit of your strength, run, run, and run to the end!!"

BS55-027-A11073.name: The KamiumiBeast JumokuMashira
BS55-027-A11073.kanji: 神産ノ獣 ジュモクマシラ
BS55-027-A11073.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, for each opposing six-colored Cost 3 or less Nexus, the opponent discards two cards from their Hand.

[LV1][LV2] [Rebirth3]
When an opposing Spirit/Ultimate exhausts, or this Spirit would leave the Field due to an opposing effect, you can flip this Spirit.
BS55-027-A11073.flavor: Izanagi and Izanami are a pair of Grandwalkers. Izanagi, the male deity, is the king who rules the earth. He gave birth to eight Divine Trees, and from that Six Worlds were born. The duo, however, was then bound in the Chains of Time and imprisoned by Chronos. The world is hence distorted, and becomes a world where spacetime is twisted, and the past, present, and future are mixed.

BS23-060.name: The JadeKodachi Nichirinmaru
BS23-060.kanji: 翡翠の小太刀 日輪丸
BS23-060.effect:
[When Braved] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't activate Bursts.

[When Braved] (When Attacks)
Activate this Spirit's [Bunshin].
BS23-060.flavor: When this emerald blade is drawn... a blinding light illuminates the area.

BS55-036.name: The KamiumiBeast JumokuRyoken
BS55-036.kanji: 神産ノ獣ジュモクノリョウケン
BS55-036.effect:
When your Cost 5 or more "Spiritual Beast"/"Plant Spirit" family Spirits are summoned, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
BS55-036.flavor:
The kins of Izanagi were fighting desperately to protect their god, and their opponent is undoubtedly the world destroyers.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 4:19―

BS56-023.name: The KamiumiBeast JumokuUsagi
BS56-023.kanji: 神産ノ獣ジュモクウサギ
BS56-023.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Once per turn, when your Cost 4 or more "Yomi"-named Spirit is summoned, draw a card.

[LV1][LV2]
Once per turn, when your Cost 4 or more "Kamiumi"-named Spirit is summoned, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BS56-023.flavor:
Apparently, they were chasing after criminals who tried to alter and interpolate history, and thought Alex was the suspect. However, realizing that she is a Grandwalker, they apologized for thier misunderstanding. Even if a Grandwalker intervened and changed the history, it is considered a Creation but not a crime.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5:08―

BS29-068.name: The Jade Old Tree
BS29-068.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When the opponent would draw cards via an effect, they can only draw one card.

[LV2]
All your "Shellman" family Spirits/Spirit cards are treated as "FourShellSky"-named.
BS29-068.flavor:
What we first saw upon passing out of Empty Sky was an old tree that gave off vibes of antiquity and the moss reflecting light; truly a forest scene that glimmered like a jewel.
—Paradise Site No. 001 from "Skylands Report" Extra by Nord—

BS57-026.name: The KamiumiBeast Kakuba
BS57-026.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2]
During the turn this Spirit was summoned from the Hand, its (When Summoned) effect is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, send an opposing Life to the Trash.
BS57-026.flavor:
"To change the future, please lend me a hand," Polluc reached out for Alex's hand. While still very much in doubt, Alex took his hand.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 6:05―

BS09-059.name: The Jade Shrine
BS09-059.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Every "Blade Beast" family Spirit you control gains +2000 BP.

[LV2] (Opposing Main Step)
The number of cores on your Spirits can't become less than their LV1 cost.
BS09-059.flavor:
A shrine erected to worship the spirits who created these forests. Actually, one can find many shrines like this spread out in one single forest, resulting in diverse architectural styles.
-from the Places of Interest 28/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BSC47-003.name: The KamiumiBeast Ooyabiko
BSC47-003.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractors Izanagi & Izanami", (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can put a core from the Void to any of your "Yomi"/"Kamiumi". Then, when summoned via an effect, you can heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates/Grandwalker Nexuses. If this Spirit has three or more cores on it, this "Exhaustion Effect" can't be prevented by opposing effects.
BSC47-003.flavor:
We govern the beginning and the end. Which means that the nature is similar to that of the self-recurring time.
―Grandwalker Izanagi―

SD28-012.name: The Jade Sword Detector
SD28-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced, draw a card.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By exhausting this Nexus, reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Green "Exalted Sword" family Brave card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.
SD28-012.flavor: Ah yeah, before coming here, Euro gave Leader some sort of searching device... If only it could search us out...

BS56-X03.name: The KamiumiBushin Onogoro
BS56-X03.kanji: 神産ノ武神オノゴロウ
BS56-X03.effect:
(Can't Stack) When your Life is reduced to three or less by the opponent, you can pay one cost to summon this card from your Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates. Then, you can put two cores from the Void to other "Yomi"/"Kamiumi" Spirits you control.

BS09-015.name: The JailBeast Gashabers
BS09-015.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Draw Step)
If you control any 8000 BP or more Spirit, you draw +1 card.

[LV3] (When Destroyed)
Return a Yellow Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.
BS09-015.flavor:
The three fantastic figures appeared before me, exactly like what happened last time.
-from the 5th paragraph of the final chapter of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS55-033.name: The KamiumiGrassDeity Kayanohime
BS55-033.kanji: 神産ノ草神カヤノヒメ
BS55-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When you've done so, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Start of Either Attack Step)
You can exhaust this Spirit. When you've done so, you can destroy opposing Grandwalker Nexuses until only one remains, and when destroys, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BS55-033.flavor: Being called the "Four Deities of Izanagi", there are four spirits that Grandwalker Izanagi first gave birth to. They are in charge of Wind, Grass, Tree and Mountain respectively, and helped Izanagi and Izanami on the creation of the rest of the world.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11085.name: The KamiumiGreatRouseBeast Ooyashima
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11085.kanji: 神産ノ大醒獣オオヤシマ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11085.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can put two cores from the Void to any of your Spirits.

[LV1][LV2] [Rebirth5]
When this Spirit summons a Spirit via an effect, or would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can flip this Spirit.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can summon a "Spiritual Beast"/"Plant Spirit" family Spirit card from your Hand. If the Spirit summoned via this effect is Cost 5 or more, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11085.flavor: "My Avatar, Ooyashima. It creates land and gives birth to gods -- It is the origin of everything."

BS56-016.name: The JailBeast Gashabers X
BS56-016.effect:
While you control any exactly-named "The Phantom Star Creation Place", this card in Hand is Cost 3.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit is destroyed by opposing effects, if you have fewer Lives than the opponent, you can return it to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Draw Step)
If you control any Red-only Rebirth Spirit, you draw +1 card. This effect doesn't stack.
BS56-016.flavor:
We tried to let the spirits with a good nose to follow the smell of the SpacePirates but ended with no luck. Those pirates might seem playful and all, but they did their work right and properly.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5:04―

BS56-030.name: The KamiumiGuardian Inokami
BS56-030.kanji: 神産ノ守護者イノカミ
BS56-030.effect:
When opposing Spirits/Ultimates are depleted, you can activate this set card, ignoring the Burst condition.

[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the opponent]
You can summon a “Yomi"/"Kamiumi" Spirit card from the Hand. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, refresh this Spirit.
BS56-030.flavor: "Hmmm I can feel the same smell as that of the world you created. Doesn't seem like a bad guy. So, I wonder what's wrong?"

BS10-063.name: The JavelinBeast Balli-Star
BS10-063.effect:
[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, destroy every opposing Spirit with the same family as that destroyed Spirit.
BS10-063.flavor:
As I visited the castle, the spear was aimed straight at me.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS55-039.name: The KamiumiMountainDeity Ooyamatsumi
BS55-039.kanji: 神産ノ山神オオヤマツミ
BS55-039.effect:
When you're activating a "summon cards from Hand/Trash" effect, this card can become Cost 5.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Turn)
Your "Spiritual Beast"/"Plant Spirit" family Spirits are unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
By paying two costs, refresh a "Spiritual Beast"/"Plant Spirit" family Spirit you control.
BS55-039.flavor:
Where the kins of Izanagi bear their fangs at, stood....Alex!! This time, I will definitely bring you back!
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 4:21―

BS55-037.name: The KamiumiTreeDeity Kukunochi
BS55-037.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can put two cores from the Void to any "Spiritual Beast"/"Plant Spirit" family Spirits you control. Then, you can summon a Cost 3/5/7/8 "Spiritual Beast"/"Plant Spirit" family Spirit card from your Hand.

[LV2][LV3]
For each pair of one Purple Spirit and one Green Spirit you control, this Spirit gains an extra Green symbol.
BS55-037.flavor:
Kukunochi is the leader of the "Four Deities of Izanagi", and also the attendant to Izanagi.
"Lord Izanagi...no alcohol...you must not drink alcohol... If not you would be scolded by Milady Izanami...!"

BS72-009.name: The JavelinThrowerMartialArtist Carbuncly
BS72-009.kanji: 投槍の武芸者カーバンクリー
BS72-009.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Lugh" & C2 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, you can draw a card. If you destroyed any opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus this turn, this effect draws +1 card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy any number of opposing Nexuses up to the number of Braves on one of your "Contractor Lugh".
BS72-009.flavor:
Lugh and his fellow martial artists were wandering in the Eastern region of the Divine World, and were busy hunting the local giant Spirits.
―Divine World Log 01―

BS55-035.name: The KamiumiWindDeity Shinatsuhiko
BS55-035.kanji: 神産ノ風神シナツヒコ
BS55-035.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can put two cores from the Void to any "Spiritual Beast"/"Plant Spirit" family Spirits you control. Then, you can summon a Cost 4/6 "Spiritual Beast"/"Plant Spirit" family Spirit card from your Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Spiritual Beast"/"Plant Spirit" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.
BS55-035.flavor:
Izanagi is apparently bound in chains as well. When compared to that of Izanami's, however, the seal is rather incomplete. When we arrived at the scene, it was right in the middle of a fierce battle.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 4:18―

CB01-053.name: The Jewel-turned City
CB01-053.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Nexus' color and symbol are also treated as White.

[LV2]
When your "Kaiju"/"Seijin"-named Spirits are destroyed by opposing effects, by discarding six cards from your decktop, they remain on the Field, exhausted.
CB01-053.flavor:
Cities are turned into jewels one by one under the influence of the rays emitted by Diabolic, a kaiju who was summoned by Murnau's Dark Ring.
―Ultraman Orb The Movie: Let Me Borrow the Power of Bonds!―

BS61-013.name: The KanabouOgreMusha Tekkai
BS61-013.kanji: 金棒ノ鬼武者テッカイ
BS61-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
Your counters +2. Then, (Once per Turn: Same Name), you can return a "Blood Crystal" family Spirit card from the Trash to your Hand.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counters +2. Then, you can destroy a Spirit/Ultimate you or the opponent controls with two cores or less on it.
BS61-013.flavor: "There are four heads who are called the Ogre Generals. Bagrago the CurseGrudge feeds on resentment and grudges that he keeps coming back from hell. Inga the Spellbind binds the souls of his enemies and strips their freedom away. Young Oboro has in him the making of BloodSlash general. What about the last one you say? He is the only one that no one dare to talk about. Not even rumors."

SJ16-06.name: The Kappa Kawatarou
SJ16-06.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, you can send the [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from a Spirit you control to another Spirit you control. When you've done so, refresh the Spirit you control with [Soul Core] (Soul Core) being sent to it.
SJ16-06.flavor: Got it!! The butt ball!! Thanks for buying "Butt Ball!"!!

BS04-039.name: The JewelBug Scaraveil
BS04-039.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your Spirits with [High Speed] gain +1000 BP.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirits with [High Speed] is destroyed by opposing Spirits via BP comparison, by sending a core from your Field/Reserve to your Trash, return that Spirit to the Hand.
BS04-039.flavor: They create life by enriching the soil with patience. Fighting is not the only way of resisting the invaders.

BS10-067.name: The KarakuriDog Shiba
BS10-067.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[When Braved] (When Battles)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, refresh this Spirit.
BS10-067.flavor:
It fuses at raging speeds, enough to raise dust clouds!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BSC42-042.name: The JewelBug Scaraveil LT
BSC42-042.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
All your Green/White Spirits gain +2000 BP.

[LV2] (Your Turn)
When your Spirits with the "Silver Zero" family or "High Speed"/"Swift"-named effects are destroyed by the opponent, return them to the Hand by paying one cost.
BSC42-042.flavor: They create life by enriching the soil with patience. Fighting is not the only way of resisting the invaders.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11099.name: The KarakuriGeneral Gennai
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11099.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Showdown - (Opposing Start Step) Your opponent selects a Spirit they control and compares BP with this Spirit. Spirits with equal or lower BP are destroyed, and when only the opposing Spirit is destroyed, activate the following effect:

▪During this turn, the opponent can't summon cost 4 or less Spirit/Ultimate/Brave cards. Also, if you control a White symbol, during this turn, the opponent can't summon Spirit cards from the Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11099.flavor: An unconventional samurai even among Souldragon's subordinate Generals, he makes use of karakuri, mechanical contraptions.

BS73-049.name: The JewelSwordsman Bluezirco
BS73-049.effect:
This card is also treated as a Magic card.

[Flash] (You can't use this effect while it's on Field)
During this turn, give up to three opposing Spirits/Ultimates -7000 BP. Then, return every 0 BP target to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, (Once per Turn: Same Name) you can summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit/Ultimate -10000 BP. When it is brought to 0 BP via this effect, destroy it, and draw two cards.
BS73-049.flavor: "This is Lady Morrigan's order. We will dominate the battlefield."

BSC20-020.name: The KatanaGeneralArmor Ash-Lion
BSC20-020.kanji: 刀将鎧アシュ・ライオン
BSC20-020.effect:
[When Braved] (When Attacks)
The opponent destroys one of their 7000 BP or less Spirits/Ultimates without Soul Core on it.
BSC20-020.flavor: Having acted heroically in the Battles of Kaminakajima, Sengoku-Tiger was awarded a historical Brave passed down in Flame War Province.

BS68-028.name: The JudgmentBeast Dead-Foxy
BS68-028.kanji: 審判獣デッド・フォックシー
BS68-028.effect:
Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
If you control any "Judgment" family Nexus, you can summon this card from your Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can banish a card from the opposing Trash. When you've done so, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS68-028.flavor:
Dan, Kai, Toa, and all eighteen partner Spirits. The brave warriors that are going to challenge the final judgment were gathered. And finally, The-Judgment showed itself. However, its form greatly deviated from what it appeared to be last time. It appeared very human, and held a large scythe in its hand. The final battle that would decide Lecoulis' fate was about to begin.
―Lecoulis Judgment Record―

BSC48-X10.name: The KatanaGeneralArmor Ash-Lion X
BSC48-X10.kanji: 刀将鎧アシュ・ライオンX
BSC48-X10.effect:
[During Brave] (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, while braved to "Tiger"/"LeonLancer", when this Spirit/Ultimate's "Destruction Effect" activates, if the opponent controls no Spirits, this Spirit/Ultimate can refresh.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can +2 cores to any of your "Homura Toshiie" Grandwalker Nexuses. Then, you can destroy an opposing Nexus, and an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with [Soul Core] on it.
BSC48-X10.flavor: "Sengoku-Tiger! I am entrusting my power to you!!"

BS68-064.name: The JudgmentBeast Dead-Regalecus
BS68-064.kanji: 審判獣デッド・レガレクス
BS68-064.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
While you control any Cost 7 or more "Judgment" family Spirit, give all your "Judgment" family Spirits: "[Assault: 1] (When Attacks) This Spirit can, once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses."

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest cost, and when destroys, look at the entire opposing Hand, and discard a Magic card among them.
BS68-064.flavor:
What happened during the Judgment in Lecoulis would be recorded here.
―Lecoulis Judgment Record―

BS15-X01.name: The KatanaHero Musashied-Ashliger
BS15-X01.kanji: 刀の覇王ムサシード・アシュライガー
BS15-X01.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit attacks]
If the Spirit that attacks when this Burst activates is 5000 BP or more, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost. Then, during this turn, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, destroy a Brave on an opposing Brave Spirit, or an opposing Nexus.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BS15-X01.flavor: Waving his katana, he split both wings off the Vanity Deity at the same time!

BS68-006.name: The JudgmentBeast Dead-Stallion
BS68-006.kanji: 審判獣デッド・スタリオン
BS68-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can discard a "Judgment" family card from your Hand. When you've done so, your counter +1, and destroy an opposing Nexus.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When this Spirit, or your Cost 7 or more "Judgment" family Spirit attacks, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.
BS68-006.flavor:
The different layers of worlds fused successfully with each other via the power of the Legend Spirits, and Dan is hence no longer the singularity that twists the world. Being released from the Judgment prison, Dan finally returns to Lecoulis. Here, the three contractors are finally gathered together.
―Lecoulis Judgment Record―

BS30-064.name: The KeelStick Canopus
BS30-064.effect:
[LV1] [SSoul: Blue]
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains [Blue Core] (an extra Blue Symbol).

[When Braved] (When this Spirit/Ultimate Attacks)
Treat this Spirit/Ultimate as being at its highest level.
BS30-064.flavor: It's a race against time! Everyone, attack with your full power!!

BS62-016.name: The KeenListener Shobu
BS62-016.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Purple Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, you can discard a card from your decktop. If that's a "Blood Crystal" family card, send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can discard a card from your decktop. Then, if you have four counters or more, you can send three cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void.
BS62-016.flavor: "It seems that Hyde has been checking on Tezcatlipoca. Good that he is safe...And anyway, congratulations for being listed as one of the ThirteenMarquess."

BS67-021.name: The JudgmentBeast DeadBirds
BS67-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
(Once Per Turn: Same Name) Your counter +2. Then, you can put a core from the Void each to every "Judgment" family Spirit you control. Also, if you have eight or more counters, you can put two cores from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Judgment" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.
BS67-021.flavor: Hmm? The sky got so dark all of a sudden...And that's huge! So this the rumored Judgment Beast of the Sky huh. It's said that their existence alone activated the other Judgment Beasts.

BS67-005.name: The JudgmentBeast DeadEnder
BS67-005.kanji: 審判獣デッドエンダー
BS67-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Judgment" family Spirit attacks, your counter +1. Then, you can draw a card.
BS67-005.flavor:
Lecoulis is in a world layer different to Grand-Lolo's, one that locates right above it, and floats like a tentative dream...Give up on this world. That's the only chance to fix The-Judgment's bug. If everything goes well, Lecoulis can be returned to Grand-Lolo properly.
―Contractor X―

BS67-055.name: The JudgmentBeast Jawson
BS67-055.effect:
When summoning this card from the Hand, if you control any "Judgment" family Spirit/Nexus/Mirage, this card becomes Cost 4.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw three cards, then discard two cards from your Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Judgment" family Spirit attacks, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest cost.
BS67-055.flavor:
World destruction...I've been waiting for this! It's time to turn the table! Siegfriden, Deathtaurus, use your power to merge the different layers of worlds! Lecoulis would be reborn in Grand-Lolo properly!
―Contractor X―

BS64-047.name: The JudgmentBeast Judgephinx
BS64-047.kanji: 審判獣ジャッジフィンクス
BS64-047.effect:
This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Red/Purple/Green/White/Blue.

Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) While an opposing Cost 6 or more Spirit is attacking, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any “Terad”/ “Oboro”/ “Gataru”/ “Vrick”/ “Fermat”/ “Raon”, you can summon this card from the Hand, treating all reduction symbols as fulfilled. When you've done so, put a core from the Void to your Life.

[LV2][LV3] (When Blocks)
Draw a card from the deckbottom.
BS64-047.flavor:
My mission is to have a grasp on the present situation of Lecoulis, and conduct field research.
―The PartnerCat Fermat―

BS63-011.name: The JudgmentDragon Exodusk
BS63-011.effect:
This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

[Mirage: Cost 2]
[During Set]
All your “Judgment” family Spirits gain an extra Red symbol that is also treated as Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, return a Spirit card with [Contract Advent], or a “Judgment” family card, besides “The JudgmentDragon Exodusk”, from your Trash to the Hand.
BS63-011.flavor:
There are more than one Judgement cards. You'll never have too many trump cards.
―Contractor X―

BS67-065.name: The JudgmentFangGun Tribal Claw
BS67-065.kanji: 審判牙銃トライバルクロウ
BS67-065.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate, and put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
BS67-065.flavor: A forbidden brave made using various parts of the Judgment Beasts.

BS67-069.name: The JudgmentGun Judgment Day
BS67-069.kanji: 審判銃ジャッジメントデイ
BS67-069.effect:
[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest cost. Then, put a core from the Void to your Reserve. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[During Brave] (Your Attack Step)
All your attacking "Judgment" family Spirits are treated as at their highest levels.
BS67-069.flavor: The-Judgment's flute that gives the Judgment Beasts power and its purge targets despair.

BS64-054.name: The JudgmentSeaDragon Bazdazilla
BS64-054.kanji: 審判海竜バズダジーラ
BS64-054.effect:
This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. You can deploy a Nexus card among them, without paying the cost. Discard any remaining cards. When any “Judgment” family Nexus card is deployed via this effect, destroy an opposing Spirit with the highest cost.

[LV2] [Assault: 2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to twice per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.
BS64-054.flavor:
Judgment Beast identified! A hydra type! Catch it!
―The PartnerLion Raon―

BS64-018.name: The JudgmentSnake Tsui-no-Mushibami
BS64-018.kanji: 審判蛇ツイノムシバミ
BS64-018.effect:
When your Cost 6 or more Spirit [Contract Advent], you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, send two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve. For each two counters you have, this effect sends +1 core to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3]
Once per turn, when opposing Spirits/Ultimates are depleted/destroyed, you can draw two cards.
BS64-018.flavor: After The-Judgement had disappeared, numerous Judgment Beasts were left in Lecoulis.

BS63-081.name: The Judgment Day
BS63-081.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Nexus' symbol is also treated as Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

[LV2]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your “Judgment” family Spirit is summoned/[Advent], your counter +1, draw a card, and put a core from the Void to this Nexus.
BS63-081.flavor: The judgement induced by one of the Oracles, The-Judgement, is the root of Lecoulis' collapse. Kai, who has contracted with The-Judgement via the World Destruction Contract, has been acting behind the scenes to enable The-Judgement to manifest. And now, the judgement by The-Judgement on Lecoulis has just begun.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11119.name: The JumpKnight Cruhopper
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11119.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this card from your Removed Zone. When you've done so, send three cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 3 ([Green Core][Green Core])]
Target two opposing Grandwalker Nexuses. Return every non-targeted Grandwalker Nexus to the deckbottom in any order. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11119.flavor:
A Grandwalker that isn't connected to their world loses most of their power, unless they can use Grandphosis. Ares was soon cornered.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 2:49―

BS10-074.name: The Kigurumi Kumattar
BS10-074.effect:
[When Braved] (When Battles)
Exhaust every opposing Nexus. Effects of all exhausted Nexuses can't activate.
BS10-074.flavor:
Gah~... It's just too cute...
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BSC49-069.name: The Kigurumi Kumattar LT

When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.
BSC49-069.flavor:
Gah~... It's just too cute...
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11122.name: The KillingGame Gegeru
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11122.effect:
Except via its own effect, including when it is deployed, cores can't be placed on this Nexus, and this Nexus is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2]
When your "Zu-"/"Me-"/"Go-"/"N-"-named "Nightling" family Spirits/Ultimates deplete/destroy opposing Spirits/Ultimates, for each Spirit/Ultimate depleted/destroyed, put a core from the Void to this Nexus.

[LV2] (Opposing Start Step)
By paying seven costs from this Nexus, send up to five opposing Lives to the Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11122.flavor:
Ge-Ro-Bo-Ze-Ga-Su "Linto" Zo-Ba-Su-Ga-Du-Ji-N-Ge-Ge-Ru
(A killing game where you hunt "Linto")
Bi-Re-Sa-Se-Da-Su-Su-N-Ro-Do
(Under pre-established rules)

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11123.name: The KingBeastTribe Bamboo Kodkod
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11123.kanji: 王獣一族タケノコドコド
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11123.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] (Opposing Turn)
When the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect, for each increased card, you can put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11123.flavor:
The Blue World was full of refugees from the Green World. This world's true enemy was targeting the Green World first. All the power was absorbed by the Dark Pyroxene, and literally disappeared.
-from the 3rd section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Purple-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11124.name: The KingBeastTribe Blade Youth
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11124.kanji: 王獣一族ブレードユース
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11124.effect:
[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]
Summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Or, put three cores from the Void to any of your Spirits with [Whirlwind].

[LV2][LV3]
While your "Blade Beast" family Spirits are battling, the opponent can't activate their Bursts.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11124.flavor: Please, protect the AugustSovereign!! His power is suppressing the Vanity Deity's revival!

BS43-021.name: The KingBeastTribe Catcus
BS43-021.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 3 ([Green Core][Green Core])]
Banish up to three cards from the opposing Trash. For each card banished by this effect, exhaust an opposing Spirit. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.
BS43-021.flavor: The King Beast Tribe, who lost their homeland, joined the Noble Order main army to fight this war.

BS41-027.name: The KingBeastTribe Tategamine
BS41-027.kanji: 王獣一族タテガーミン
BS41-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, if there is any opposing exhausted Spirit, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2]
Spirit cards in opposing Trash are unaffected by opposing effect, and can't activate their effects.
BS41-027.flavor: With the power of the AugustSovereign you brought along, we have the Vanity Deities in check. Thank you, now's the time to do our very best!!

THIS-GUY.name: The KidnappingPhantom Kemur Man
THIS-GUY.flavor:
A race of alien from Kemur which has a long history of 2020 years. Its physical capabilities surpassed humans on Earth and it can dash with a speed on par with a car. It can release goo with teleporting abilities from its head, and uses it to kidnap humans.
―Ultra Q―

CB01-009.name: The KingDemonBeast of Earth Maga-Grand-King
CB01-009.kanji: 土ノ魔王獣マガグランドキング
CB01-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, all your "KingDemonBeast"-named Spirits gain +5000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy two opposing Nexuses.
CB01-009.flavor:
The King Demon Beast of Earth who lay dormant underground. It sank various buildings to the ground by causing land subsidence. It can release energy beams from its body, and cuts a circle on its target's body.
―Ultraman Orb―

CB01-006.name: The KingDemonBeast of Fire Magapandon
CB01-006.kanji: 火ノ魔王獣マガパンドン
CB01-006.effect:
[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.
CB01-006.flavor:
The Fire King Demon Beast, whose body is always enveloped in high temperature fireballs. Using the heatwaves its body emanates, it raises the temperature of the city it appears in.
―Ultraman Orb―

CB01-013.name: The KingDemonBeast of Light Maga-Zetton
CB01-013.kanji: 光ノ魔王獣マガゼットン
CB01-013.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy two opposing 8000 BP or less Spirits. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 15000 BP or more Spirit. When this effect couldn't destroy any Spirits, draw a card.
CB01-013.flavor:
The King Demon Beast of Light who was sealed by the Ultraman card, and lay dormant in the forest region of Northern Europe. It woke up around 100 years ago, and fought against Ultraman Orb.
―Ultraman Orb―

CB01-048.name: The KingDemonBeast of Water Magajappa
CB01-048.kanji: 水ノ魔王獣マガジャッパ
CB01-048.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't block unless they discard a card from their Hand.
CB01-048.flavor:
The King Demon Beast which was asleep beneath a lake. Because of its foul stench, it started an incident in which the entire town's water smelled.
―Ultraman Orb―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11132.name: The KingDemonBeast of Wind Maga-Basser
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11132.kanji: 風ノ魔王獣マガバッサー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11132.flavor:
The King Demon Beast of Wind, which was asleep on the Ionosphere. Possessing giant wings, it attacked using the shockwaves and whirlwinds made from the wind pressure of its flapping.
―Ultraman Orb―

26RBS03-X15.name: The KingEater Alterhibius
26RBS03-X15.kanji: 王喰アルターヒビウス
26RBS03-X15.effect:
Legacy

[LV1-2]Either Attack Step
When your Nexuses, or your Spirits that are originally Nexuses are destroyed, refresh this Spirit.

[LV2]True ReleaseEither Attack Step [Invoke: Flash] Once Per Turn
Target one of your "Cyantree" family Nexuses with one or more core on it. During this step, it doesn't activate its Nexus effects, and is treated as a Spirit with "<1>LV1 5000 BP, <3>LV2 7000 BP."
26RBS03-X15.flavor: A massive jaw, like a calamity that swallowed everything whole.

BS31-024.name: The KingOgre Naraku
BS31-024.effect:
This Spirit card in Trash is treated as Cost 4.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
For each "Nightling" family Spirit you control, send two cores from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to their Reserve.
BS31-024.flavor: The DarkArtsMagician sealed Naraku, but on the condition that Flame War Province would agree to arbitration.

SD43-006.name: The KingSnake Pend-Viper
SD43-006.kanji: 王蛇ペンド・ヴァイパー
SD43-006.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to their Reserve. When this effect depletes a Spirit, draw a card.
SD43-006.flavor:
It was a Grandwalker called Lolo that raised Uru.
－Holy Book Fragment－

BS04-022.name: The KingSnake Quetzalcoatl
BS04-022.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By discarding any number of cards from your Hand, send one core each from a number of opposing Spirits equal to the number of cards you discarded to their Trash.
BS04-022.flavor: The creature is the embodiment of wisdom. We are so lucky to see it with our own eyes.

BSC42-024.name: The KingSnake Quetzalcoatl LT
BSC42-024.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 6 ([Purple Core][Purple Core][Core])]
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can draw three cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard any number of cards from your Hand, and for each card discarded, send a core from one opposing Spirit to the Trash.
BSC42-024.flavor: The creature is the embodiment of wisdom. We are so lucky to see it with our own eyes.

BS54-X01.name: The King Dragno
BS54-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Great Pursuit]
This exhausted Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, and can heavy exhaust to attack.
[heb]

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP for each "Dragno"-named Spirit you control. Also, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.
BS54-X01.flavor: One who commands all dragons, to construct a world by the Dragnos, and for the Dragnos!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11139.name: The King Snake Nest
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11139.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Draw Step) If you control three or more "Dark Snake"/"Zombie" family Spirits, increase the number of cards you draw by +1.

[LV2] (Your Start Step) For each "Dark Snake" family Spirit you control, send a core from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve. (This effect can't bring the number of cores on the opposing Spirit down to 0.)
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11139.flavor:
The ultimate destination of those who seek knowledge. Unless you can answer the gatekeeper's questions correctly, you will be plunged into the giant snake's stomach instead of being allowed into its nest.
-from the Places of Interest 404/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS21-X05.name: The LandBeastDeity Behemoth
BS21-X05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Treat all opposing Spirits as being at LV1.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Spirits with one core on them.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: Exhaust every opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit.
BS21-X05.flavor: All land as far out as the horizon is ruled by the incarnation of the earth.

PB33-004.name: The Land of Rabbits
PB33-004.effect:
When this card is revealed from deck, or sent to the Trash from deck by your Yellow-only effect, you can deploy it.

[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Draw two cards. Then, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -12000 BP. Then, return every opposing 0 BP Spirit to the deckbottom.

[LV2]
Every opposing Spirit gets -1000 BP. For each “The Land of Rabbits” in your Trash, this “BP- effect” reduces 3000 further.
PB33-004.flavor: "I've heard that this place is somewhere over the clouds!" "And I've heard that there lives a princess who is forever 12 years old!"

P13-16.name: The Land of Sacred Swords
P13-16.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Brave Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, the Brave of that Brave Spirit remains and you can return only the Spirit to your Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Brave Spirit attacks, destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit. This effect doesn't stack.
P13-16.flavor:
All you who seek the Sacred Swords, show your strength in the Sacred Sword War!
-From the Preface of Sacred Sword War Accounts-

BS31-085.name: The Land of Sharp Valleys
BS31-085.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you use [Soul Core](Soul Core) to pay the summon cost of your Spirit, destroy an opposing Nexus.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Red Spirit destroys any opposing Spirit/Ultimate, draw a card.
BS31-085.flavor: The SengokuDragon accepted the request of the SupremeRealmWisdomKing, and an alliance was formed between Flame War and Gandala.

CB18-017.name: The LastJudgementer Gillvalis［Ultra Kaiju 2020］
CB18-017.kanji: ラストジャッジメンター ギルバリス［ウルトラ怪獣2020］
CB18-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Each "Ultra Kaiju 2020"-named Spirit you control gains "[Heavy Armor: Purple/Blue] This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects."

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's, and once per turn, refresh this Spirit.
CB18-017.flavor: While it has been defeated by Geed long ago, it was revived under the power of Devil Splinter. It had the power of controlling the machines in its surroundings and gave sevenger a hard time.

BS52-CP14.name: The Last Card
BS52-CP14.effect:
This card has "Superstar"/"Galaxian" families.

[Main]
Reveal four cards from your decktop. Add every "Sagitto"-named card among them to your Hand. Return the remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[Flash]
During this turn, when only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your exactly-named "The SuperCentaurusDeity Grand-Sagitto-Nova", send two opposing Lives to the Reserve.

THE-KINGDOM.name: The Kingdom between Two Rivers
THE-KINGDOM.kanji: 二つの川に挟まれた王国
THE-KINGDOM.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed) When deployed from your Hand, you can target a Nexus you control. Destroy an opposing Spirit with the same cost as that Nexus.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step) All Spirits can't be refreshed by Nexus/Magic effects.
THE-KINGDOM.flavor:
It allied itself with the side of the Vanity Deities and betrayed the world, and it was destroyed in the end. It's a typical example of just deserts.
-from the Places of Interest 159/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

SD28-009.name: The Last Emperor
SD28-009.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 3 or higher Spirits]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned)
Put two cores from the Void to this Ultimate.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, exhaust two opposing Spirits. After Ultimate Trigger, if your Life is at three or less, proceed to Cross Ultimate Trigger.
[Cross Ultimate Trigger] When Cross Ultimate Trigger hits, send an opposing Life to their Trash.
[xutb]
SD28-009.flavor:
He is the original Ultimate and the Ultimate of demise.
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, Past Records: Day 12—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11148.name: The Kingdom of Cards
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11148.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (During Your Battle Phrase) All "Magician" spirits you control cannot be exhausted by the effects of a card your opponent controls.

[LV2] (During Your Battle Phrase) Each time a Yellow spirit you control is destroyed or depleted, refresh target exhausted "Magician" spirit you control.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11148.flavor:
The palace of the land of trump is just adorable, of course, I will keep it to myself.
-from the Places of Interest 170/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS65-070.name: The Last Paradise, La-Gita
BS65-070.kanji: 最後の楽園ラ・ジータ
BS65-070.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Core])]
[During Set]
Once per Step, when your Ultimate Trigger hits, you can put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV1][LV2]
The number of cores on your "Holies"/"Incarnate" family Ultimates can't be brought to less than three due to opposing effects.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
This Nexus gains an extra Green symbol.
BS65-070.flavor:
The final destination of the ones who are displaced from their home.
―Travelogue of the Collapsing World: Extra―

BS67-077.name: The Kingdom of Insects, Insectia
BS67-077.kanji: 蟲の王国インセクティア
BS67-077.effect:
When drawing this face-up card from your deck, instead of adding it to the Hand, you can deploy it without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2]
When face-up cards are sent from your deck to the Trash via an opposing effect, you can summon/deploy one of those cards without paying the cost.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When your "Golden Cloud" family Spirit attacks, if you have any face-up cards in your deck, either +1 to your counter, or draw a card from the deckbottom.
BS67-077.flavor:
A kingdom where the fairies of insects live. It's famous for housing three beautiful princesses.
―Travelogue of the Collapsing World 064―

BS40-068.name: The Last Rose Crystal
BS40-068.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by the attack of opposing Spirits/Ultimates, send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Trash.

[LV2]
The LV2 costs of all your Purple Spirits get -1. However, the level costs can't become zero.
BS40-068.flavor:
The worlds changed mostly for the worse because of the Great Collapse, but conversely, some places became magnificent. This flower is an uncommon example of such. Though it looks like glass, it has a sweet fragrance.
-from the Places of Interest 188/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BS35-081.name: The Kitchenhenge Ruins
BS35-081.kanji: キッチンヘンジの遺跡
BS35-081.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
All your "Fairy" family Spirits gain +2000 BP.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you set a Burst, you can send a core from your Reserve to your life. This effect can only be used once per turn.
BS35-081.flavor:
Known for being the ruins of the original kitchen where food was cooked. Currently, it is under the supervision of the Gourmet Fairies, and it is said it is used for a certain ritual.
―From Visit Global Ruins by Monthly BSGP―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11153.name: The LaurelDragon Daphne Dragon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11153.kanji: 月桂竜ダフネドラゴン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11153.effect:
[Unleash: 1, Minor] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by sending one core from your exactly-named "Grandwalker Apollon" to the Trash, immediately activate its [LV1][LV2] [Grand Skill], treating the cores as having been sent to the Void.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit, and draw a card.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11153.flavor:
To prevent the uncertain factor that is Osiris from becoming a disturbance, Apollon was deployed. This is Athena's third scheme.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 4:29―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11154.name: The KnightDeathDragon Glaizus
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11154.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can activate one of your Spirits' (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent) effects without it being depleted or destroyed.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Brave Spirits attack, discard a random card from the opposing Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11154.flavor: Racer Glaizus is running while pulling Racers Ourovorius and Amethyst-Dragon behind him. It seems Turon's cooperation is going well.

BS74-009.name: The LavaAstralFishDragon Mosasauro
BS74-009.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Ometeotl" & C2 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Manifests/Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest BP, and when destroys, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by sending your [Soul Core] to any "Contractor Ometeotl" Grandwalker Nexus, this Spirit refreshes.
BS74-009.flavor:
Let me test your strength once again!
―Grandwalker Ometeotlー

BS17-X02.name: The KnightHero Swordius-Arthur
BS17-X02.kanji: 騎士の覇王ソーディアス・アーサー
BS17-X02.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
When your Life is at three or less, summon this Spirit card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can summon a Spirit card with [Immortality] from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[When Braved] [LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Void.
BS17-X02.flavor: The Dark Shield's strongest hero blocked the way of the Flame Shield's dark knight.

BS74-012.name: The LavaAstralFishDragon Notosaurus
BS74-012.kanji: 溶星魚竜ノットザウルス
BS74-012.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) If you have five counters or more, by sending your [Soul Core] to any "Contractor Ometeotl" Grandwalker Nexus, summon this card from the Hand, treating all summon costs as being paid.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy up to three opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit. For each counter you have, increase the limit of this "BP Destruction effect" by +1000.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw two cards. Then, once per turn, if you have seven counters or more, this Spirit can refresh.
BS74-012.flavor:
The flowing magma is the pulse of the star...You could feel that too?
―Grandwalker Ometeotlー

BS10-066.name: The KnightSnake Pendragon
BS10-066.kanji: 騎士王蛇ペンドラゴン
BS10-066.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit to their Reserve. When the number of cores on that Spirit is brought to 0 by this effect, draw a card.

[When Braved] (When Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing non-braved Spirit to their Reserve.
BS10-066.flavor:
To him, life is but stardust in the night sky.
—from the Draco chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS74-008.name: The LavaAstralFish Ichziyon
BS74-008.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Red Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Lava Fish" family Spirit/Ultimate attacks, you can send two cores, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to that target.

[During Set] Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
By sending your [Soul Core] to any "Contractor Ometeotl" Grandwalker Nexus, summon this Mirage without paying the cost.
BS74-008.flavor:
In the past, Kai couldn't contract with Ometotl. Simply because his power was too great. But now, he must fight to get him over.
―Divine World Log 03―

BSC49-060.name: The KnightSnake Pendragon LT
BSC49-060.kanji: 騎士王蛇ペンドラゴンLT
BSC49-060.effect:
(Once per Game: Same Name) During your Main Step, by banishing a card from your Hand, summon this card from the Trash.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can send three cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve. When this effect depletes, you can draw two cards.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can send two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve. When this effect depletes, during this battle, this Spirit gains an extra Purple symbol.
BSC49-060.flavor:
To him, life is but stardust in the night sky.
—from the Draco chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS75-010.name: The LavaAstralFish Magmatodon
BS75-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. You can deploy a "Contractor Ometeotl" among them. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, you can send your [Soul Core] to any "Contractor Ometeotl" Grandwalker Nexus. When you've done so, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3]
You can add a "Lava Fish" family card revealed from the deck by this Spirit's effect to the Hand.
BS75-010.flavor:
Chaos? It isn't just about the collapse of a single world or two.
―Contractor Kai―

BS75-009.name: The LavaAstralShell Magmazosia
BS75-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit. Then, you can send your [Soul Core] to any "Contractor Ometeotl" Grandwalker Nexus. When you've done so, your counter +1.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When [Soul Core] is sent to your "Contractor Ometeotl", you can draw a card.
BS75-009.flavor:
So a contract that surpasses even the ones with Apollon or Hades. ―Contractor Kai―
Chaos brought forth the participation of the Grandwalker hailed as the mightiest of Hindida, and a contract with Dan. This surpassed the script Kai had envisioned. ―Divine World Log 04―

BS24-046.name: The Knight Pentan
BS24-046.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your Yellow Spirits are depleted/destroyed by the opponent, you can summon a "Song Bird" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3]
For each "Song Bird" family Spirit/Ultimate you control, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
BS24-046.flavor:
Among the many visitors from the Dark Continent, there were also those who lacked the desire to fight.
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, 709 Days Remaining—

BS74-010.name: The LavaAstralTurtle Archelon
BS74-010.effect:
When [Soul Core] is sent to your "Contractor Ometeotl", you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned/Advents) effect resolves]
Destroy every opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate, and when destroys, draw two cards. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Turn)
While you control any "Contractor Ometeotl", the opponent can't end the Turn/Attack Step via effects.
BS74-010.flavor:
Kai made a contract with Ometeotl in exchange for his partners.
―Divine World Log 03―

BS19-062.name: The Knight of Light Hope
BS19-062.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Crush] (When Attacks)
Discard a number of cards from the opposing decktop equal to this Spirit's LV.

[LV2][LV3] [Assault: 1] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.
BS19-062.flavor: After receiving news of those who have appear together with the black orbs since the abnormalities, this country did not shirk in preparing all combatants to execute countermeasures.

BS36-006.name: The LavaBeast Volrus
BS36-006.flavor: On the scene, it seems that the city has regained its calm. The band has already resumed its cheering prep. Polish-san, how are the racers who were brought to the pits?

BS18-X02.name: The KnightsEmperor Avalo-Paladion
BS18-X02.kanji: 騎神皇アヴァロ・パラディオン
BS18-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can summon any number of "Supreme Hero" family Spirit cards from your Trash, without paying the cost. However, those Spirits can't activate any (When Summoned) effects.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your Purple "Supreme Hero" family Spirits, send all cores from that destroyed Spirit to the Trash.
BS18-X02.flavor: The blown horn calls all of the Heroes!

BS75-012.name: The LavaBladeFish Cladoselache
BS75-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit, and when destroys, you can draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While there is [Soul Core] on your "Contractor Ometetol", when your "Lava Fish" family Spirit attacks, you can activate this Spirit's (When Summoned) effect.
BS75-012.flavor:
Ometeotl was the hero who saved Vulrica from an unprecedented crisis. Yet, because of this, he transcended the bounds of an ordinary Grandwalker.
―Divine World Log 04―

SD24-009.name: The KnowledgeGeneral Ptolemios
SD24-009.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or higher Spirits]

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from the opposing decktop. Discard a card from among them. Return the remaining cards to their decktop in any order.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, discard an opposing Burst. If it is a Magic card, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
[utb]
SD24-009.flavor: It's a relief you understand so quickly. I sense the same aura as my own on you.

BS69-028.name: The KnowledgeableLionheart Eudoros
BS69-028.kanji: 知見の勇士エウドロス
BS69-028.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
If you control any "Contractor Hermes", you can put two cores from the Void to any of your Spirits. Then, you can banish every card in the opposing Trash. When this effect banishes four or more cards, the opponent puts a card from their Hand to their Removed Zone.

[LV2]
Once per turn, when cards are put onto the opposing Removed Zone, you can heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
BS69-028.flavor:
Huracan visited Hermes' world bringing his devotees with him. His provocative appearance made him stand out in the entire Olym.
―Theogonic Record Volume 2―

BS75-013.name: The LavaDinosaur Sphinott-Hauser
BS75-013.kanji: 溶岩恐龍スピノット・ハウザー
BS75-013.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Ometeotl" & C5 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Manifests)
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total of 20000 BP. By sending your [Soul Core] to any "Contractor Ometeotl" Grandwalker Nexus, banish one of the targets destroyed by this effect.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When [Soul Core] is sent to your "Contractor Ometeotl", refresh a "Lava Fish" family Spirit/Ultimate you control.
BS75-013.flavor:
This time... this time, I shall save it completely...
―Grandwalker Ometeotlー

BS73-050.name: The KunziteJewelChainswordsman Koon-Zite
BS73-050.kanji: 黝輝石の宝鎖剣士クーン・ツァイト
BS73-050.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Morrigan" & C4 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Manifests/Attacks)
You can immediately activate one of the Flash effects of a "Prismwing" family Magic card in your Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your other Spirit isn't blocked, this Spirit can refresh.
BS73-050.flavor:
Morrigan rampages freely across the battlefield. Having fought against Yum-Kaax and Nyx, and winning both battle. The storm she has unleashed shows no signs of abating.
―Divine World Log 02―

BS62-011.name: The LavaEmperorFish Scapanolancer
BS62-011.kanji: 溶皇魚スカパノランサー
BS62-011.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Flame Contract/Lava Fish & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit. By discarding a "Lava Fish" family pre-advent card underneath this Spirit, instead, destroy three opposing 15000 BP or less Spirits.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, you can return a "Lava Fish" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

BS13-X05.name: The KylinStarBeast Rean
BS13-X05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can brave ignoring brave conditions.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
By exhausting a Spirit you control in the same family as this Spirit, it remains on the Field, refreshed.

[When Braved] [LV3]
This Spirit gains the families of all Spirits you control.
BS13-X05.flavor:
By the wish of the stars, the ancient PhantomLord was reborn.
—from the Camelopardalis chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS74-005.name: The LavaMeteorite Petalodash
BS74-005.kanji: 溶隕石ペタロダッシュ
BS74-005.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Ometeotl" & C2 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can return a total of one "Contractor Ometeotl" and "Lava Fish" family card from your Trash to the Hand. If you have six counters or more, this effect returns +1 card to Hand.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
By sending your [Soul Core] to any "Contractor Ometeotl" Grandwalker Nexus, +1 core to one of your Grandwalker Nexuses.
BS74-005.flavor:
Because of his strength, he dwells in a place beyond anyone's comprehension.
―Divine World Log 03ー

BS70-022.name: The LabyrinthGuard Deatherios
BS70-022.kanji: 迷宮の番人デステリオス
BS70-022.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can summon a Cost 8 or less "Ogre Wizard" family Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with three cores or less on it.
BS70-022.flavor:
Hera's Ogre Wizards fought on with no fear of death. Their high morale was a major reason why they had been winning battles after battles against the Primordial Deities.
―Theogonic Record Volume 3―

BS75-004.name: The LavaSnake Pachyrhachis
BS75-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can +1 core to one of your "Contractor Ometeotl" Grandwalker Nexuses. Then, you can send your [Soul Core] to any "Contractor Ometeotl" Grandwalker Nexus.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can draw a card.
BS75-004.flavor:
The appearance of Indra, the Grandwalker who rules over thunder...Ometeotl stared wide-eyed at the sight, while Morrigan wore a savage smile. Despite Toa's futile attempts to stop her, Morrigan lunged at Indra. Indra brushed her aside with a single kick. Without pause, Ometeotl drove a blow into the fray. In an instant, Indra was surrounded. As the situation reached breaking point, Mitra stepped between them.
―Divine World Log 04―

BS17-064.name: The Lake of the Dead
BS17-064.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (After Your Burst Activates)
Destroy a Brave on an opposing Brave Spirit.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Cost 3 Spirits are exhausted, draw a card.
BS17-064.flavor:
A blessed lake where many spirits are born from. It's a place that calms the hearts of the Amethyst Realm denizens. The ways different beings feel about the same thing are indeed multifarious.
-from the Places of Interest 442/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS74-006.name: The LavaWingedShark Aquilo-Lamda
BS74-006.kanji: 溶翼鮫アクイロ・ラムダ
BS74-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1. Then, either destroy an opposing Nexus, or send three cores from an opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void. By sending your [Soul Core] to any "Contractor Ometeotl" Grandwalker Nexus, this "Destruction Effect"/"Core Removal Effect" can't be prevented by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Also, if there is [Soul Core] on your "Contractor Ometeotl", draw two cards.
BS74-006.flavor:
The encounter with "Chaos" resolved Kai's determination. It was the summoning of the supreme deity Ometotl, who was forbade from leaving Vulrica.
―Divine World Log 03―

BS10-091.name: The Lakeside with Soap bubbles
BS10-091.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Spirits with no printed effects are destroyed, draw a card.

[LV2] (Opposing Turn)
Your Cost 2 Spirits are unaffected by opposing Spirit effects.
BS10-091.flavor:
My hometown was known for having ugly, smelly bubbles made by crabs float into the city from the surface of the nearby lake. To think that such a cute scene as this place would make me think back to where I was born... Maybe it's because I've realized I can't go back home.
-from the Places of Interest 27/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

SD48-006.name: The LavashotDragon Jatis-Waram
SD48-006.kanji: 溶弾龍ジャティス・ワラム
SD48-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

The Country of Brass... Due to the beasts causing strife, we are still unable to enter...

Zeus-Lolo's forces took him by surprise, but even so, Ra held his ground, trying to even the score once more.
