BS40-CP08.name: The MagicianAngelia Molchel
BS40-CP08.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this card from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Draw a card, and during this turn, this Spirit gains +10000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
By discarding one of this Spirit's pre-Advent cards, this Spirit remains on the Field, refreshed.
BS40-CP08.flavor: Do it at your own pace! There is no one that can follow your dance!!

BS42-022.name: The MakaiOfficer Drosmuba
BS42-022.kanji: 魔界参謀ドロスムーバ
BS42-022.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Purple & Cost 3 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents)
Discard any number of pre-advent cards under this Spirit. For each card discarded by this effect, you can summon a "SevenShogun"-named Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.
BS42-022.flavor: You turned to the Vanity Army? Stop saying selfish words while selling the whole world!

BS54-047.name: The MagicianDragon Jaculus
BS54-047.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can return two "Magibullet" family Magic cards from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Besides [Soul Core], you can send a core from this Spirit to your Life. Or, you can pay three costs to immediately use the Flash effect of a "Magibullet" family Magic card, or a Cost 12 Magic card from your Hand.
BS54-047.flavor: I must also thank the denizens who taught us the way to use the talisman. Another important piece of information is that it would respond to special powers, like those that are on par with what comes from a deity.

SD41-004.name: The MakaiSoldier Curse Swordsman
SD41-004.kanji: 魔界兵カースソーズマン
SD41-004.effect:
[LV2] (When Attacks)
By sending a core from any opposing Spirit that the opponent chooses to their Reserve, draw a card.
SD41-004.flavor:
The Vanity Army was led by a general who held the power of the pyroxene stone, and could freely prompt multiple advents. However, with one strike from the Purple Siegfried, the pyroxene was destroyed. They didn't even have a chance to escape, and got eradicated.
-from section 3 of "New Record of the Strange World" chapter Shinobi-

BS54-TX02.name: The MagicianEmperor's Mega-Grandstone
BS54-TX02.effect:
[GSTrule]

[Release:: (Drawing via your "Primal" family Spirit)]
◆When the Release condition is fulfilled, you can put one core from the Void to this Nexus.

[LV1] [Rebirth5]
When the number of cores on this Nexus becomes three or more, this Nexus can be flipped (all but one cores on it are sent to the Void).

[Grand Mystery] [LV1]
Effects of Six-colored Spirits/Ultimates/Nexuses/Grandwalker Nexuses that are originally Cost 6 or less can't activate.

BS70-NX01.name: The MakaiSwordDeityDoll †Enchante†
BS70-NX01.kanji: 魔界剣神ドール†アンシャンテ†
BS70-NX01.effect:
(Once per Game: Same Name) When your Life is reduced to three or less, and you have four counters or more, you can immediately activate the following Burst of this card from your Trash.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned/Advents) effect resolves]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, during this turn, increase the LV cost of two opposing Spirits/Ultimates by +2.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can send up to two cores from one opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve. When this effect depletes, draw two cards.
BS70-NX01.flavor: Despite being Hera's loyal sword, no one could have understood her true intentions, so there is no choice but to put her on the wanted list.

BS54-TX02-A11355.name: The MagicianEmperor A-Zra
BS54-TX02-A11355.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
Put three cores, except [Soul Core], from your Trash to this Spirit/any Nexuses you control. Then, destroy two opposing Spirits/Ultimates.

[LV3]
The opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects. Also, when the opponent uses any Magic card, after that effect resolves, put a core from the Void to your Life.
BS54-TX02-A11355.flavor: The emperor of magic sealed within the Grandstone. It would once again dye the world in chaos.

BS41-018.name: The MakaiSwordsman Salzerk
BS41-018.kanji: 魔界剣士ザルツェルク
BS41-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
By returning a Spirit card with [Advent] from your Trash to the Hand, this Spirit remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.
BS41-018.flavor: If the Ogre Wizards find and catch us, everything is over... better sneak away.

BSC05-002.name: The Magician Dragonaga
BSC05-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to their Reserve.
BSC05-002.flavor: They were very strong reinforcements, but the Dark Snakes are too heavy in the waist; they're already beginning to collapse.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11358.name: The MakaiTactician Inogelatu
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11358.kanji: 魔界軍師イノゲラトゥ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11358.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal cards from your decktop until an exactly-named "The MakaiDeity Desfermion" is revealed (Max. 13 cards). When you've done so, you can pay one cost to summon it. Banish the remaining cards.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Summon any number of exactly-named "The MakaiDeity Desfermion" from your Hand, paying one cost for each.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11358.flavor:
"My Deity Desfermion is immortal! Come, show yourself!"
The Desfermionism fanatics appear on the front stage of history.

BS22-014.name: The Magician Hakuja
BS22-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Cards can't be discarded from either player's deck.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When either player add cores from the Void via Green Spirit effects, send all those added cores back to the Void. Also, send all the cores from the Spirit who activated that effect to the Void.

[LV3] [Charge]
Your "core removal effects" send +1 core to the Reserve.
BS22-014.flavor: Though it's quite rash, there are snakes that enjoy the chaotic situation. They're able to use forbidden techniques for the time being, after all.

BS73-042.name: The MalachiteJewelFairyGirl Makala
BS73-042.kanji: 孔雀石の宝妖精女マカラ
BS73-042.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2([Yellow Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Prismwing" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When this Spirit would be returned to the Hand via the [Contract Skill] of your "Contractor Morrigan", this Spirit's cost gets +1 for each counter you have.
BS73-042.flavor:
Morrigan is a Celtica Grandwalker. She proclaims her dominance over Celtica, and comes straight to Amahara, ignoring Lugh's warnings, longing to contract with Toa.
―Divine World Log 02―

SD10-012.name: The Magma Spouting Star City
SD10-012.kanji: 噴き上がるマグマの星都
SD10-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Astral Dragon" family Spirits gain +2000 BP.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When opposing Spirits are destroyed by your Spirit effects, draw a card.
SD10-012.flavor: A metropolis where magma spurts all year round. A special ore is formed due to the continuous flow of magma over the land, and it is one of the materials needed for the core of a sword.

BS14-X06.name: The MalevolentDeity Nyarla-Trap
BS14-X06.kanji: 千貌の魔神ニャルラ・トラップ
BS14-X06.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal five cards from the opposing decktop. Among them, return a card to the opposing deckbottom. Return any remaining cards to the opposing decktop in any order.

[LV1][LV2]
All (When Destroyed) effects of opposing Spirits can't activate.

[LV2] (When Destroyed)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's.
BS14-X06.flavor: Zeyon's scheme was for the country's sake. His plot is only for his own enjoyment.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11363.name: The MaliciousAlien Mefilas Seijin［First Generation Ultra Kaiju］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11363.kanji: 悪質宇宙人メフィラス星人［初代ウルトラ怪獣］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11363.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, summon any number of "First Generation Ultra Kaiju"-named cards, except any exactly-named "The MaliciousAlien Mefilas Seijin［First Generation Ultra Kaiju］", without paying the cost. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your "First Generation Ultra Kaiju"-named Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't move cores, except [Soul Core], from their Spirits/Nexuses/Grandwalker Nexuses.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11363.flavor: A cunning alien with high intelligence who aims to conquer the Earth without using force.

BSC24-020.name: The MaliciousAlien Mephilas Seijin
BSC24-020.kanji: 悪質宇宙人メフィラス星人
BSC24-020.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Kaiju"/"Seijin"-named Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Trash.
BSC24-020.flavor:
An alien that does not like violence. He tried to tempt an Earthling child and take the world into his control. He fought on equal standing with Ultraman, but left Earth saying "there is no point to aliens fighting each other."
―Ultraman―

CB18-031.name: The MaliciousDemonicMonster Grimdo
CB18-031.effect:
Flash - [Advent: "Kaiju"/"Seijin"/"Tregear" & Cost 7 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Send two cores each from every opposing Spirit to the Reserve. Then, destroy every opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
Once per turn, you can refresh this Spirit. Also, if this Spirit has any "Tregear"-named pre-Advent card, during this turn, this Spirit is fixed as having three Purple symbols.
CB18-031.flavor: The Kaiju sealed inside Tregear which became his source of power.

CB26-054.name: The ManInBlack Mr. BLACK
CB26-054.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Sengoku Subaru"/"Mr. BLACK", (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Discard an opposing Burst. Then, once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison with your Spirits, send an opposing Life to the Reserve. This effect can't bring the opposing Life to zero.
CB26-054.flavor: "I would crush you with my barrier!"

BS35-058.name: The MarineCorps Kojirac
BS35-058.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 2 or less Spirit. By discarding a card from your Hand, instead, destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit.
BS35-058.flavor: Falling behind, Racer Calamity-Boar starts roaring! No, he starts going wild! A good half of the following group is caught up and blown away from the course!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11368.name: The MarineCorps Sharga
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11368.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit. If your Hand is three or less, instead, destroy an opposing Spirit with a cost equal to or inferior to this Spirit's.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
While your Hand is two or less, the opponent can't use Magic cards from their Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11368.flavor: "Wirians" has support teams for land, sea and sky. The Marine Corps is the sea support team.

BS35-056.name: The MarineCorps Suna-Meri
BS35-056.kanji: 海傭師団スナ・メリー
BS35-056.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
Destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.
BS35-056.flavor: "Wirians" is a team famous for being comprised of Beast Heads alone, who will run dangerously and do anything for the sake of winning. However, there are many fans attracted by that dirty appeal. The observers' seats are always overflowing with poorly-behaved hooligans. Sensible BSGP fans, since it's dangerous, should not approach them!

BS29-X07.name: The MarsDeitySword MarsBringer
BS29-X07.kanji: 火星神剣マーズブリンガー
BS29-X07.effect:
[When Braved]
Treat this Brave as Cost 0.

[When Braved] (When Braved Attacks)
If the cards hit by this Ultimate's Ultimate-Trigger are all Cost 4 or less, you can, instead of activating the hit effect, at the end of your turn, refresh three Ultimates you control, and repeat Attack and End Steps in order once more. This effect can only be used once per turn.
BS29-X07.flavor: This is the what the broken Sacred Swords have been reborn as with the power of the stars now residing in them: The MarsDeitySword!!

BS72-CX01.name: The MartialArtsContractor Lugh
BS72-CX01.effect:
[Neo-Core Charge:: (Martial/Devotee/Concluser & Cost 3 or more) (Saga Brave)]
◆When your target Spirit/Brave is summoned, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this Nexus is deployed, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Revive] Main - (Once per Turn: Same Name) You can deploy this card from Soul State.

2 [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
(Once per turn, send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) Your counters +2. Then, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, you can pay one cost to summon a "Devotee"/"Martial" family Saga Brave card. Return any remaining cards to either the decktop or deckbottom only. [Core Charge] doesn't activate via this effect.

[Contract Field] [LV2]
This Nexus can brave with up to two Braves. Also, all your "Martial" family Spirits are treated as [During Brave], and gain all the [During Spirit Brave] of all "Devotee"/"Martial" family Braves that are braved to this Nexus.

BS61-058.name: The MartialArtsMaster Ashikanosuke
BS61-058.kanji: 武芸百般アシカノスケ
BS61-058.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit. When you've done so, you can summon one of your pre-advent condition "The PartnerShark Shack", without paying the cost.

[LV2]
While the opponent has a Burst set, this Spirit gains an extra Blue symbol.
BS61-058.flavor:
"Shack, my lord, I think I should have taught you that defeating your opponent without even starting a fight is what makes a person truly strong."
Ah yes, master. Of course I remember that! If the opponent can't do a thing, then it is my victory! What you taught me has been extremely useful! Hahaha!
―The PartnerShark Shack―

BSC26-035.name: The Maser Tank 92
BSC26-035.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's to the Hand.
BSC26-035.flavor:
The Ground Self-Defense Force's anti-G superweapon. Its official number is DAG-MBT-MB92. With a self-propelled battery, the turret is built with a parabola-shaped barrel that emits Maser beams.
―Godzilla vs Biollante (1989)―

CB22-027.name: The MagneticKaiju Antlar［First Generation Ultra Kaiju］
CB22-027.kanji: 磁力怪獣アントラー［初代ウルトラ怪獣］
CB22-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put two cores from the Void to any of your Spirits/your Trash.

[LV1][LV2]
The cores on this Spirit can't be moved by opposing Spirit/Magic effects.

[LV2]
This Spirit can't be destroyed by opposing Spirit/Magic effects.
CB22-027.flavor: A kaiju that has lived in the desert around Baradhi since the ancient times. It has a strong jaw and a firm shell that can deflect even Spacium Rays.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11376.name: The Memorable Field Trip
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11376.effect:
When this Nexus card is revealed by your [Friend], you can deploy it without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Add all the cards that would be discarded by your [Friend] to the Hand.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When a Spirit card is revealed by your [Friend], by sending [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from this Nexus to the Trash, give that card +1 or -1 cost.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11376.flavor: The students of Diva Academy decide the destination and plot the course of their field trips by themselves. The field trips are very loose, as Diva Academy respects the students' independence.

BS60-084.name: The Mahlathamizu Grandsea City
BS60-084.kanji: マーラサーミズ神海都市
BS60-084.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
While the opponent has four or less counters, this Nexus is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2]
While you have five or less cards in Hand, your Hand is unaffected by opposing effects. If you have five or less cards in Hand during your End Step, your counter +1.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Treat all your "Azure Wave" family Spirits as being on their highest levels.
BS60-084.flavor:
神海の至宝と謳われる神海帝国ムウの7大都市のひとつ。
―名所絶景録―

26RBS02-086.name: The Memory Palace
26RBS02-086.effect:
[LV1-2] When Deployed
Target one of your "Cyantree" family Spirits. Put a core from the Void to it.

[LV2] True ReleaseOpposing Attack Step [Invoke: Flash]
Pay one cost ▶ During this step, this Nexus doesn't activate its Nexus effects, and is treated as a Spirit with "<1>LV1 5000 BP, <3>LV2 7000 BP."
26RBS02-086.flavor: You'd never guess it from his appearance, but it is said that there's a palace inside his head, complete with a vast library.

BS48-018.name: The MaidDoll †Sonora†
BS48-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, besides any exactly-named "The MaidDoll †Sonora†", add a "Doll" Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Turn)
When your other "Ogre Wizard" family Spirit is summoned, you can discard a Green/White/Blue card from the opposing Removed Zone.
BS48-018.flavor:
The love she, who strongly inherited Hera's jealousy, years for is devotion.
"Making light of Milady Hera's love... I won't go easy on you just because you're the supreme deity..."

26RBS03-071.name: The Menacing Myrmecotyla
26RBS03-071.kanji: 威嚇するミルメコティラ
26RBS03-071.flavor: At first glance, this pose may appear defenceless, but in reality, it is indeed a defenceless pose.

CB16-075.name: The Maiden of Revolution
CB16-075.effect:
When your "Tekkadan" family Nexus is deployed, you can return this card from the Trash to your Hand. This effect doesn't stack.

[Flash]
During this turn, unless the opponent sends a core from the Spirit they control that would attack/block to the Trash, they can't attack/block. Then, return this card to the deckbottom.

26RSD04-011.name: The Menhir Circle
26RSD04-011.effect:
[LV1-2] When Deployed
Show up to two White "Mineroid" family cards from your Hand to the opponent. Return them to the deckbottom in any order. For each card returned, draw a card.

[LV2] Opposing Attack Step[Invoke: Flash]
Exhaust this Nexus ▶ Target an opposing attacking 3000 BP or less Spirit. Return it to the Hand.
26RSD04-011.flavor:
It is said that these stones survived even that great cataclysm and washed ashore in this world.
―from the Foreigner's Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

BSC30-006.name: The MakaiFistOgre Namu
BSC30-006.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 2 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve. After this effect resolves, you can stack a Purple card from your Hand onto this Spirit via [Advent], treating Soul Core as being sent to the Trash.
BSC30-006.flavor: The denizens of the Purple World were well-aware of the threats brought by the Empty Skies, since they knew that one of the Dark Pyroxene gangs targeted at them after destroying the Green World.

BS29-065.name: The MercuryDeitySword MercuryBlade
BS29-065.kanji: 水星神剣マーキュリーブレイド
BS29-065.effect:
[During Brave]
This Brave becomes Cost 0.

[During Brave] [Assault: 1] (When Attacks)
This Ultimate can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting a Nexus you control.
BS29-065.flavor: The Twelve Sacred Swords have been reborn to bring forth new DeitySwords!

BS70-023.name: The MakaiGuardGeneral Deathdriath
BS70-023.kanji: 魔界衛将デスドライアス
BS70-023.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Hera" & C5 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this card would be banished, instead of banishing it, you can [Mani] it, treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Send two cores from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Reserve. By banishing an "Ogre Wizard" family card from your Trash, this effect sends +2 cores to the Reserve.
BS70-023.flavor:
Alright, I will go. Hades, you owe me one now.
―Grandwalker Hera―

BS10-058.name: The MercuryDragonDeity Mercurius-Serpent
BS10-058.kanji: 水星神龍メルクリウス・サーペント
BS10-058.effect:
(Your Main Step)
By returning a Blue Nexus you control to the deckbottom, you can summon this Spirit card from your Hand without paying the cost.

[When Braved] [LV2] (When Brave Attacks)
Choose a random card from the opposing Hand. Then, look at its content; if it is a Magic card, discard it. Otherwise, return it to their Hand.
BS10-058.flavor:
That thing's a monster! It gobbled up that robotic knight whole in a matter of seconds!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS07-047.name: The Merman Apkareel
BS07-047.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When the opponent uses a Magic effect, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BS07-047.flavor: This has become a dangerous situation! Reports bear the unprecedented horrible news that the Western Lands have turned their back on the world and allied with the Armies of Oblivion! We'll soon learn the true extent of their intentions...

BS64-079.name: The Merolaura Flower Field
BS64-079.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced, you can draw a card. Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "The Flower Partner, Frau", instead of drawing one card, you can draw a card for each Life reduced.

[LV2]
While your “Jade Thunder” family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.
BS64-079.flavor:
A secret garden spreading wide between the valleys of the Merolaura Village where numerous tree spirits and flower spirits live. Let me leave a comment of how beautiful flowers could end up becoming sharp blades.
―Travelogue of the Collapsing World 082―

BS33-021.name: The Messenger Genet
BS33-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Spirit Soul: Green - When you are summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains an extra [Green Core] (Green Symbol).

[LV2] After your Soul Drive effect resolves, put three cores from the void to your Reserve.
BS33-021.flavor: After the case of the fugitive ninjas, the Ninja Gale were pressed to reorganize their village and as such could not participate in the battles. However, there were suspicious movements in Onmyou Territory, or so was the message Genet delivered. Upon receiving the message, Tensei entrusted Genet with a secret message asking for assistance from Yaibanokami and sent him off towards Verdant Leaf Province.

BS70-072.name: The Messenger Post on the Cape
BS70-072.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn)
Once per turn, when the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect, if you control any "Contractor Hermes", the opponent puts a card from their Hand to the Removed Zone.

[LV2]
Once per turn, when cards are put onto the opposing Removed Zone, you can exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
BS70-072.flavor:
A building used by Hermes to gather information and deliver messages in this war against the primordial deities. It seems to be a simple and plain temple on first look, but is actually an ultra important facility centering all information across Olym.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 766―

BS74-001.name: The MeteorLavaScorpion Eurymeteos
BS74-001.kanji: 流星の溶蠍ユーリメテオス
BS74-001.effect:
Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can summon this card from your Hand. When you've done so, you can deploy one of your "Contractor Ometeotl" from Soul State/Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. Then, by sending your [Soul Core] to any "Contractor Ometeotl" Grandwalker Nexus, +1 core to one of your Grandwalker Nexuses.
BS74-001.flavor:
Kai and his team were conducting investigations in the Eastern Region of the Divine World. There, he encountered “Chaos”. Kai swiftly recognised its danger and departed the scene.
―Divine World Log 03―

408993-965.name: The MasterBlacksmith Kamemitsu
408993-965.effect: [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step) When you are summoning "The LotusMonarch Senju", by exhausting any number of Nexuses you control, for each nexus exhausted, treat as 1 cost being paid.
408993-965.flavor: The Six Heaven Army and Gandala established a secret pact. This was a major miscalculation on the part of the Supreme Beast Army.

BS19-009.name: The MeteorSwordsman Damasques
BS19-009.kanji: 流星の剣使いダマスクス
BS19-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Charge]
Increase the limit of your"BP Destruction effects" by +1000.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
When blocked by an opposing Spirit with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's, destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit.
BS19-009.flavor: Going by him, knights who can wield the Sacred Swords do exist.

SD03-008.name: The MasterCarpenter Mccoy
SD03-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a number of cores equal to this Spirit's LV from the Void to a Nexus you control.
SD03-008.flavor:
Worker refugees from the besieged North have been welcomed into the Central country. This could open the path towards defeating the seemingly unstoppable.
-from the 10th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS07-055.name: The Meteor Stream Nightsky
BS07-055.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Give all your "Soldier" family Spirits: "[Awaken] During Flash Timing, you can send any number of cores from Spirits you control to this Spirit."

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Astral Dragon" family Spirits gain +2000 BP.
BS07-055.flavor:
On the night of the hottest day of the year, you can see the epic battle of the Astral Dragons. As the name implies, they become like shooting stars so beautiful, one cannot help but sigh in marvel and awe.
-from the Places of Interest 303/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS08-X29.name: The MasterDragonRider Dark-Crimson
BS08-X29.kanji: 魔帝龍騎ダーク・クリムゾン
BS08-X29.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Reveal seven cards from your decktop. You can summon all "Dragon Emperor"/"Dragon Knight" family Spirit cards among them, without paying the cost and without using [Tribute]. However, any (When Summoned) effects of these Spirits can't activate. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each "Dragon Emperor" family Spirit you control, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.
BS08-X29.flavor: Behold... The commander of all Evil Dragons has emerged.

CB22-001.name: The MetronSeijin Marluru
CB22-001.kanji: メトロン星人マルゥル
CB22-001.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Trigger"-named effect, you can add it to the Hand.

[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Red Core][Blue Core])]
[During Set] (Start of Your Attack Step)
You can send two cores each, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to one "Trigger"-named Spirit you control and one "Tiga"-named Spirit you control.
CB22-001.flavor: The wandering Metron Seijin who works as the operator of the expert team, GUTS-SELECT. It has a rich knowledge about Kaijus.

BS31-071.name: The MasterFencerBeastman Gaou
BS31-071.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit/Ultimate without Soul Core on it.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
While there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Spirit, the opponent can only block with a Spirit with Soul Core on it.
BS31-071.flavor:
Combat Era, November 564. The Battles of Kaminakajima were brought to an end thanks to Usugane's arbitration.
―from the Kaminakajima Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11399.name: The Middle of Hard Battle
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11399.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opponent's Battle Phase) At start of Phase, destroy target spirit your opponent controls with 1000 BP or less.

[LV2] (During Your Battle Phase) Each time a spirit you control with Evolution defeats a spirit, destroy target spirit your opponent controls with the same BP as the defeated spirits BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11399.flavor:
The most fierce battlefield of the second great war. This place seems to be very important in terms of strategy and there has been a war on this battlefield for the control of it.
-from the Places of Interest 553/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS60-030.name: The MasterOfJadeWoods Jira-Jerl
BS60-030.kanji: 碧樹海の主ジラ・ジャール
BS60-030.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can discard your entire Hand. When this effect discards any "Jade Thunder" family cards, draw a card for each Spirit/Nexus the opponent controls. The opponent can't activate Nexus effects via this draw.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
(Once per turn: Same Name) You can refresh a "Jade Thunder" family Spirit you control. If you have eight counters or more, instead, you can refresh all your "Jade Thunder" family Spirits.
BS60-030.flavor:
Apparently even the Master of the JadeWoods has part of its power sealed within the stone tablets.
―The PartnerWolf Lampo―

LM13-03.name: The MidnightSunLightSword Midnight-Solar
LM13-03.kanji: 白夜の光剣ミッドナイト・ソーラー
LM13-03.effect:
[LV1] [Charge]
Increase the number of bodies refreshed by your “Spirit-refreshing effects” by +1.

[When Braved]
This Spirit's [Rush] activates ignoring the conditions.

[When Braved] (When Battles)
Refresh a non-Braved Spirit you control.
LM13-03.flavor: By combining heavenly light and white darkness, a light sword that shines through the night was created!

SD11-X02.name: The MidnightSunTreasuredSword Midnight-Sun
SD11-X02.kanji: 白夜の宝剣ミッドナイト・サン
SD11-X02.effect:
[When Braved] [Heavy Armor: Green/White/Yellow/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Green/White/Yellow/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[When Braved]
This Spirit's [Rush] effects activate, ignoring the conditions.
SD11-X02.flavor: In the darkness, this treasured sword beautifully emits an aura of unusual color.

BS33-X01.name: The MasterSwordsmanDragon Samurai-Dragon-Amatsu
BS33-X01.kanji: 剣豪龍サムライ・ドラゴン・天
BS33-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Infinite Blade] (Your Attack Step)
While there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Spirit, this Spirit can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When you do, this Spirit doesn't exhaust.

[LV2][LV3]
Give all your "Lord"/"Vassal" family Spirits: "[Flash] [Awaken] You can move any number of cores from Spirits you control to this Spirit."
BS33-X01.flavor: "The Twin Heaven United secret sword unleashed through 'Flame Bolt' and 'Shooting Star'! Infinite Blade!!"

MIDNIGHT-SUN.name: The MidnightSunTreasuredSword Midnight-Sun X
MIDNIGHT-SUN.kanji: 白夜の宝剣ミッドナイト・サンX
MIDNIGHT-SUN.effect:
[During Brave] [Heavy Armor: Red/Purple/White/Yellow]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/White/Yellow Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[During Brave] [Rebirth5]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can separate and flip this Brave.
MIDNIGHT-SUN.flavor: The MidnightSun Treasured Sword that once supported the world. However, its wielder is already gone.

BS73-X01.name: The MasterSwordsmanDragon Samurai-Dragon-Amatsu X
BS73-X01.kanji: 剣豪龍サムライ・ドラゴン・天X
BS73-X01.effect:
(Can't Stack) When your [Soul Core] is sent to the Trash via your "Rekka" family effect, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can send three cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void. Then, if your Hand is five or less, you can draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] [In Unleash: 2] (Your Attack Step)
This Spirit can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When you do, this Spirit doesn't exhaust. By sending two cores from any of your "Rekka Yukimura" Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit, instead, this Spirit attacks without exhausting.
BS73-X01.flavor: "Unstoppable attacks, and endless strikes, that's my Infinite Blade!"

NINETAIL-DARK.name: The MidnightSunTreasuredSword Midnight-Sun X -Rebirth Incarnate-
NINETAIL-DARK.kanji: 白夜の宝剣ミッドナイト・サンX -転醒化身-
NINETAIL-DARK.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2] (When Reborn)
Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2] Red/Purple/White/Yellow
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/White/Yellow Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.
NINETAIL-DARK.flavor: Now that its wielder is lost, it incarnates into a new form, and wanders around to search for a new king.

SJ18-05.name: The Master Kouryuu Licht
SJ18-05.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 2 or less] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
During this turn, every Cost 2 or less Spirit you control gains an extra Red Symbol.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Cost 3 or less Spirit attacks, you can discard a card from your decktop. When a Cost 0 card is discarded by this effect, that Spirit refreshes.

BSC25-018.name: The MatchlessMusha Sakuma-Guardian
BSC25-018.kanji: 双璧武者サクマ・ガーディアン
BSC25-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.
[Rush: White]
(While you have a White symbol, the following effect activates next)
[White Core]: Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each color of your symbols, send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.
BSC25-018.flavor: Racer Amethyst-Dragon now summons Holy Demon-God. It'll be tricky for the racers running behind to get past this!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11409.name: The Midnight Sun King Yaiba
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11409.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Machine Beast/Fencer/Worldswalker & Cost 3 or more) (Exalted Sword & Brave)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit/Brave, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Send 4 cores from this Nexus to Void) Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
Besides via Burst effects, when the opponent summons any Spirit/Brave without paying the cost, put four cores from Void to this Nexus.

BSC25-017.name: The MatchlessMusha Shibata-Guardian
BSC25-017.kanji: 双璧武者シバタ・ガーディアン
BSC25-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as White.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit attacks, send a core from any opposing Spirit to their Reserve, and put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3]
While you control any [The MatchlessMusha Sakuma-Guardian], this Spirit can't be destroyed by opposing effects.
BSC25-017.flavor: The competitors in the teams not contracted with an Imajin are having a hard time despite getting out of the raging tornado, and are dropping out of the fight for the top spot.

26RSD04-008.name: The MightyArm Anatoma
26RSD04-008.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2]When Summoned
Target an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit. Return it to the Hand.
26RSD04-008.flavor: "If you resist, I won't go easy on you!"

BS64-046.name: The MathematicWitch Mari-Mersenne
BS64-046.kanji: 数魔女マリー・メルセンヌ
BS64-046.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Yellow Core])]
[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
Neither player's Life can be reduced by the attacks of LV1 Spirits and LV3 Ultimates.
BS64-046.flavor:
Please work together and try to collect various information about the world. ―The PartnerCat Fermat―
Mari "Ok, understood~" Arsh "Noted~ Leave it to me, senpai~"

BS62-X08.name: The MightyKing King-Raon
BS62-X08.kanji: 覇道王キング・ラオン
BS62-X08.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: King Contract & C7 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When this Spirit, or your Spirits with [AFO] would leave the Field due to the opponent, they can remain on the Field in the same state.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, for every two Spirits with [AFO] you control, you can send an opposing Life to the Reserve. Then, once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.

BS64-044.name: The Mathematician Pentan
BS64-044.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Yellow Core])]
[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
Neither player's Life can be reduced by the attacks of LV1 Spirits and LV3 Ultimates.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "The PartnerCat Fermat", and you've summoned for two times or more in this turn, until your next Start Step, the effects of every opposing Nexus/Grandwalker Nexus can't activate.
BS64-044.flavor:
Although you don't belong to the Red tribe, that's some excellent performance.
―The PartnerCat Fermat―

BS22-068.name: The Mausoleum of Ten Thousand Spirits
BS22-068.effect:
[LV1] (When Deployed)
Separate the non-"Exalted Sword" family Braves from all Brave Spirits. However, the owner moves the core during the separation.

[LV1]
All Cost 4/6/7 Spirits can't brave.
BS22-068.flavor: The countless cursed souls steal the freedom of bodies. They do not limit themselves to only living things, but inhibit weapons as well.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11416.name: The Mausoleum that Enshrines God-Kings
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11416.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Main Step)
When opposing Spirits/Ultimates brave, exhaust those Brave Spirits/Ultimates.

[LV2]
The reduction symbols of "God-King" family Spirit cards in your Hand are also treated as Purple.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11416.flavor: A God-King temple which dates back to the first BSGP tournament. Every God-King is appointed to their roles on this altar, and here they are enshrined.

BS60-036.name: The MechanicalHuman Mechanirace
BS60-036.kanji: 機械人類メカニレイス
BS60-036.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([White Core])]
[During Set] (Either End Step)
When the number of cards in your Hand is equal or inferior to the opponent's, if you have one counter or more and have a number of counters equal or greater than that of the opponent's, you can draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
You can return this Spirit to the Hand.
BS60-036.flavor:
"Welcome to the Argento City. If you need any help, please tell me."
This is the city of machines, the place where I was created.
―The PartnerMachine Stark―

BS45-008.name: The MedicineDeityDragon Aeskulapius Dragon
BS45-008.kanji: 医神龍アイスクラーピウスドラゴン
BS45-008.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, besides any exactly-named "The MedicineDeityDragon Aeskulapius Dragon", you can pay one cost to summon a Red/Purple "Worldswalker"/"Avatar" family Spirit card from your Hand/Trash.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When any Spirit is summoned via this Spirit's effect, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.
BS45-008.flavor: The one who supported the disadvantaged Apollon was the MedicineDeityDragon who has reached the extremes of medicine.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11419.name: The MedicineSeller Cursor
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11419.flavor: She naturally sells ointments, as well as stomach pain relievers and even poisons. In any case, what we need now are nausea pills for boat trips.

BS33-052.name: The MedicineSeller Terinosuke
BS33-052.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [SSoul: Blue]
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains [Blue Core] (an extra Blue Symbol).

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When your "Beast Head" family Spirit/Ultimate is summoned and [Soul Core](Soul Core) was used to pay the summon cost, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BS33-052.flavor: Receiving intel that the Six Heaven Army's reinforcements were heading toward the besieged Nagashino Castle, the Azure Fang Squad sent a messenger to the Heaven Squad.

26RBS01-X14.name: The MegaThunder Zelotl
26RBS01-X14.effect:
[LV1-2]When Summoned
Target up to two opposing Spirits. During this turn, give them -2000 BP. Then, if they have 0 BP, destroy them.

[LV2]During AttackOnce Per Turn
When you use a "Thunder Dragon" family Magic card, after its effect resolves, you can return that card to the Hand.
26RBS01-X14.flavor: You don't need to tense up or plan for it to release the voltage. You just need to hold back.

BS27-075.name: The Military Port City Ostia
BS27-075.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The (When Summoned) effects of Spirits/Braves, and (When Deployed) effects of Nexuses can't activate.

[LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
By sending a core from this Nexus to your Trash, once per turn, refresh this Nexus.
BS27-075.flavor:
Apparently there is a port completely occupied by the astral spirits. The blue Vanity Deity's lightning assault is being carried out there.
—Blue Seas Site No. 609 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

SD25-X01.name: The MilkDipper Blazing-Dragon
SD25-X01.kanji: 南斗六星ブレイジング・ドラゴン
SD25-X01.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
If your life is three or less, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
Draw a card.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Astral Dragon" family Spirit attacks, refresh this Spirit.
SD25-X01.flavor: Look out, it's an enemy!! One of those guys from Darkness-somewhere-or-other! We'll be crushed before we can meet the king of the Ultimate Giants!!

BS24-029.name: The MilleniumBeast Behemoth-Cedar
BS24-029.kanji: 千年獣ベヒモス・シダー
BS24-029.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
For each Yellow Spirit you control, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Behemoth"-named Spirit attacks, if the opponent blocks with Spirits, they can only block if they block with two of their Spirits. When that Spirit you control is blocked, choose one opposing blocking Spirit to battle against.
BS24-029.flavor: It's huge... don't tell me this is Asia's new bodyguard...

BS40-071.name: The Millennial Forest
BS40-071.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your End Step)
If you [advented] during this turn, you can send the [Soul Core](Soul Core) from your Trash to your Reserve. When you've done so, refresh one of your Spirits.

[LV2]
The cores on all your Green [During Advent] Spirits can't be removed due to opposing effects.
BS40-071.flavor:
The propagation of plants has accelerated considerably thanks to the Great Collapse. As such, this strange area looks like it has a long history, but is relatively new, making such a rare view. Be sure to bring Green tea with you for a visit.
-from the Places of Interest 245/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

P15-17.name: The Minis' Great Athletics Meeting
P15-17.effect:
You can put any number of [The Minis' Great Athletics Meeting] in your deck.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
For each [The Minis' Great Athletics Meeting] you control, all your Spirits gain +1000 BP.
P15-17.flavor: "Let's strive for victory at the athletic meet! Hip, hip, hooray!"

BS45-003.name: The MinstrelDragon Orphestar Dragon
BS45-003.kanji: 吟遊詩竜オルフェスタードラゴン
BS45-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy two opposing 7000 BP or less Spirits, and return a "Worldswalker"/"Avatar" family card from your Trash to your Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When your "Worldswalker"/"Avatar" family Spirit [advents] on this Spirit, you can summon this pre-Advent card by paying one cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Your Grandwalker Nexus'/"Worldswalker"/"Avatar" family Spirit's "BP Destruction effects" can't be prevented by "Armor"-named effects.
BS45-003.flavor: The tune of the harpist taught by Apollon echoes on the battlefield.

BS13-044.name: The Minstrel Orphe
BS13-044.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
By discarding a card from your Hand, look at the entire opposing Hand, and discard a Magic card among them.

[LV2]
The opponent can't return cards from the Trash to their Hand.
BS13-044.flavor:
"The Master Unicorn is the vital point of this world." It was as the song of the poet that I listened to at the competition had told. Without their master, the Giants were wiped out one after another.
-from the 14th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BSC49-045.name: The Minstrel Orphe LT
BSC49-045.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can discard a card from your Hand. When you've done so, look at the entire opposing Hand, and discard a Magic card/card with [Accel] among them.

[LV2]
All the cards in either player's Trash are unaffected by effects except this one, and their effects can't be used.
BSC49-045.flavor:
"The Master Unicorn is the vital point of this world." It was as the song of the poet that I listened to at the competition had told. Without their master, the Giants were wiped out one after another.
-from the 14th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11430.name: The Miraculous Hill
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11430.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (During Your Battle Phase) "Divine Spirit" spirits you control get +1000BP.

[LV2] (During Your Battle Phase) Each time a "Divine Spirit" spirit you control is defeated, it is moved to your hand instead of their Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11430.flavor:
A hill in the land of rainbows. Rainbows are said to originate from here. Shining angels frequent this place and make it look like a starry sky even during the day.
-from the Places of Interest 017/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

26RBS02-033.name: The MireCaller Daisy
26RBS02-033.effect:
[LV1-2] When Summoned
Target an opposing Spirit. If it is refreshed, exhaust it; if it's exhausted, heavy exhaust it.

[LV2] True ReleaseYour End Step
If the opponent controls one or less refreshed Spirit, the opponent targets one of their exhausted Spirits that aren't heavily exhausted. Heavy exhaust it.
26RBS02-033.flavor: "This area's ours from today. Got a problem with that?"

BS77-CP05.name: The MelodyContractor Saraswati
BS77-CP05.kanji: 旋律の契約神サラスヴァティー
BS77-CP05.effect:
[Neo-Core Charge:: (Imp/Devotee/Concluser & Cost 3 or more) ("Saraswati" & Nexus)]
◆When your target Spirit/Nexus is summoned/deployed, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this Nexus is deployed, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Revive] Main - (Once per Turn: Same Name) You can deploy this card from Soul State.

[Contract Field] [LV1]
For this Nexus, its symbols are unaffected by opposing effects, and its number of cores can't be brought to less than three by opposing effects. Also, (Can't Stack) when your "Saraswati", or your "Imp" family Spirit refreshes, if it's your Attack Step, by sending three cores from this Nexus to the Void, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

3 [LV1] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
(Send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) During this turn, this Nexus is also treated as a Spirit with [LV1] 3000 BP, and can only be destroyed by Grandwalker Nexuses.

26RBS03-X11.name: The MirrorPlaneKnight Cavaliare
26RBS03-X11.kanji: 鏡面騎士カヴァリアーレ
26RBS03-X11.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2] Your Attack StepCSOPT
At the end of the battle of your refreshed White Spirit, target an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit. Return it to the deckbottom.

[LV2] True ReleaseWhen Attacks
If you control three or more "Wollaguard" family Spirits/Nexuses, this Spirit can refresh. If this Spirit refreshes, during this turn, it can't attack.
26RBS03-X11.flavor: Extravagant and resplendent. Magnificent and splendid. A new word was needed to describe the knight who had come from the other side of mirror.

BS20-070.name: The Mirror Surface World Entrance
BS20-070.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Your Hand is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When opposing Spirits attack, refresh a Spirit you control with a cost equal or inferior to the attacking Spirit's.
BS20-070.flavor: The line of ice pillar after ice pillar after ice pillar is never ending. According to rumor, one of the pillars among these becomes a door to another world. There have been no verified instances of this happening, so the truth is unknown.

BS68-030.name: The MischievousBug Colick
BS68-030.kanji: いたずら虫のコルリック
BS68-030.effect:
When you [Ultra Contract Advent], you can immediately summon this card from the Hand by paying one cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Besides [Soul Core], you can send a core from your Field/Reserve to the Trash. When you've done so, if the opposing Hand is six or more, and you control any "Frau", the opponent discards cards from their Hand until their Hand is three.
BS68-030.flavor:
Lecoulis seems to have overcome the final reckoning of The-Judgment. But what actually happened, is a reconstruction of the entire Lecoulis into a different world that may as well be called "Grand-Lolo-Lecoulis" which happened when the vague memories of Grand-Lolo actualizes via the destruction and creation before and after the final reckoning.
―Lecoulis Judgment Record―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11436.name: The MischievousFairy Imp
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11436.effect: [LV2][LV3] (Your Draw Step) If you control three or more "Fairy"/"Imaginary Beast" family Spirits, increase the number of cards you draw by +1.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11436.flavor: The former ruler is now active behind the scenes. Apparently he's sent a spy into the royal palace.

BS70-029.name: The MischievousLionheart Pan
BS70-029.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Green Core][Green Core])]
[During Set] (Start of Your Attack Step)

Morrigan reluctantly sheathed her spear at Toa's stern rebuke.

A kaiju born from the mind of an Earthling who believed in the moon rabbit pounding mochi. He came to Earth from the moon to eat mochi.
―Ultraman Taro―

Kilmanjack Mountain is part of a floating mountain range and is said to resemble the mountain that is a symbol of the eastern island country, Japang. It's apparently a sight that makes Japangese runners homesick.
―from the Famous Courses Report by Monthly BSGP―

The opponent can't use Magic cards.

BS10-084.name: The Mouth of False
BS10-084.effect:

[LV2] (Your End Step)

This place is the source of the Dark Snakes' knowledge. Apparently they can hear voices whispering to them in this area... It was only then did I realize that the Dark Snakes are not omniscient.
-from the Places of Interest 514/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS60-046.name: The MovingTempleCity Elas-Palace
BS60-046.kanji: 移動神殿都市エラスパレス

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.

That's the Temple City pilgrimage of the Empire. Let's circumvent it.
―The PartnerMachine Stark―

BS73-019.kanji: 泥騎士男爵マディアス

Kai is a contractor who was once an enemy of Dan. Currently, due to Nyx's scheming, Kai has distanced himself from Dan and Toa and is searching for the Grandwalker of Contracts on his own. ―Divine World Log 02―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11560.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Cost 6 or less "Zombie" family Spirits would leave the Field due to opposing effect, you can pay one cost to summon a Cost 7/8/9 "Zombie" family Spirit card from your Hand. When you've done so, draw a card.

[LV1][LV2]
Your Spirits with 0 cores on them gain +5000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11560.flavor:
What pierced through me was a purple energy wave. It was the doing of the man hidden on the far end of the battlefield, who was pulling all the strings from the shadows.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 4:24―

BS23-024.name: The NoctisButterflySwordMaster Morphonight
BS23-024.kanji: 夜蝶剣聖モルフォナイト
BS23-024.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your effects exhaust any opposing Spirits, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] [Unsheathe] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, you can summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card that can brave with this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[When Braved] [LV2] (When Brave Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS23-024.flavor: The knight of the empress fought to the end with the last swords. That is what makes a real knight.

BSC23-048.name: The Nocturne Twilight Gothic Stage
BSC23-048.kanji: 夜想のトワイライトゴシックステージ
BSC23-048.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Draw Step)
Instead of drawing, you can return a [Song] Magic card from your Field/Trash to the Hand.

[LV2]
For each [Song] Magic card on your Field, every [Twilight Gothic] Spirit you control gains +2000 BP.
BSC23-048.flavor: The eastern stage where the Twilight Gothics excite the audience with their cool and gothic performance.

BS74-016.name: The NetherThespian Jadis
BS74-016.kanji: 冥府劇役者ジャディス
BS74-016.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Dionysus" & C2 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
You can discard three cards from your decktop, and when any "Nether" is discarded, your counter +1. Then, once per turn, besides any "NetherThespian Jadis", you can summon/deploy/set a Cost 5 or less "Dionysus"/"Nether" from your Trash. (Once per Turn: Same Name) If this Spirit is at LV3, you can summon/deploy/set that card by paying one cost instead.
BS74-016.flavor:
Ultimate Imaginate? It's best not to use it, but...
―Grandwalker Dionysus―

BS19-X02.name: The NetherThreeGiants Baroque-Bordeaux
BS19-X02.kanji: 冥府三巨頭バロック・ボルドー
BS19-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put up to three cards from your Hand underneath this Spirit, face-down. (The cards underneath are discarded when this Spirit would leave the Field.)

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would be destroyed/returned to the Hand/Deck by the opponent, by discarding a card underneath, this Spirit remains on the Field, refreshed.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By discarding a card underneath, destroy an opposing Spirit, and send a core from that Spirit to the Void.
BS19-X02.flavor: Taking advantage of the world's abnormalities, one of the three major forces began to make his move at last.

BS26-069.name: The Norandy Absolute Defense Line
BS26-069.kanji: ノーランディ絶対防衛線
BS26-069.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When the Ultimate Trigger of your 10000 BP or more Ultimate is guarded, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When two or more of your Life is reduced at once, when that battle ends, end the Attack Step.
BS26-069.flavor:
A giant defense line is being constructed because of the Ultimates. It is warding off the Ultimates better than we first thought.
—White Lands Site No. 348 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11566.name: The NorthWindBeast Qebui
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11566.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can summon a Cost 4 or less "Imaginary Beast" family Spirit card or a Yellow-only Saga Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost. When you've done so, draw a card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
The number of cores on this Spirit can't be brought to 0 by either player.

[During Brave] [LV2][LV3]
Every "WindBeast"-named Spirit you control becomes Cost 8.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11566.flavor:
Horus stands in high spirits. However, he takes a blow from the side and endures great damage.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 3:06―

BS24-X02.name: The NetherThreeGiants Queen-Merduk
BS24-X02.kanji: 冥府三巨頭クイン・メドゥーク
BS24-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Spell Blight] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
By sending an opposing Life core to the Trash, this Spirit remains on the Field, refreshed.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Turn)
Give all your Spirits with [Curse]: [Spell Blight].

[LV2][LV3]
When your Spirit with [Spell Blight] reduces the opposing Life, the core from the opposing Life is sent to the Void instead of Reserve/Trash.
BS24-X02.flavor: So this is the hero who came home alive after facing a corps of 12 Ultimates! It's an honor to meet you!

BS22-X02.name: The NetherThreeGiants Zainde-Milion
BS22-X02.kanji: 冥府三巨頭ザンデ・ミリオン
BS22-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Zombie" family Spirit attacks, unless the opponent destroys a Spirit they control, they can't block.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Zombie" family Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, you can summon a Spirit card from your Trash with a cost inferior to the destroyed Spirit's, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirit can't activate.
BS22-X02.flavor: The supreme force of the netherworld rules over an immortal army. The invincible troops head toward the light and begin their advance...

BS11-036.name: The NetherWitch Helen
BS11-036.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
By putting up to three Magic cards from your Hand face-up onto the Remove Zone, for each card you put, draw a card. An opened Magic card can be used as if it were in your hand until the end of the game.
BS11-036.flavor:
She circles around the Oort Dragon's Nest on her strange broom taking a leisurely stroll. She has zero sense of danger.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BSC49-038.name: The NetherWitch Helen LT
BSC49-038.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By putting up to three Magic cards/cards with [Accel] from your Hand onto the Removed Zone, for each card put to the Removed Zone, draw a card.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, you can immediately use one of the Flash effects of a "Devotee"/ "Astral Soul"/ "Galaxian" family Magic card/card with [Accel] from your Removed Zone, without paying the cost.
BSC49-038.flavor:
She circles around the Oort Dragon's Nest on her strange broom taking a leisurely stroll. She has zero sense of danger.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11571.name: The NetherworldDeity Obsidion
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11571.kanji: 冥府魔神オブシディオン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11571.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Clash] (When Attacks)
The opponent must block if possible.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When your Spirits would be returned to the Hand due to the opponent, for each Spirit to be returned, the opponent discards a card from their Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When blocked by opposing Spirits, send a number of cores equal to the cost of the blocking Spirit from any opposing non-blocking Spirits to their Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11571.flavor: The obsidian devil mounts the corpse dragon and wanders the netherworld. He is unable to fulfill his oath to the SevenShogun...

BS19-094.name: The Never Ending Aqueduct
BS19-094.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The (When Summoned) effects of Spirits/Braves can't activate.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Fighting Spirit" family Spirit is blocked by opposing Spirits, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.
BS19-094.flavor: One might be curious as to where the gushing water flows to and gaze at it for quite a while. Truly, as the water flows, so does time.

BSC39-CP02.name: The NewGenerationCutestGeneral Magoichi ObsidianSoldier
BSC39-CP02.kanji: 新世代最可愛将孫市 黒曜の徒
BSC39-CP02.effect:
When this card is either revealed from deck, or sent to the Trash from deck by your Yellow effect, you can add it to the Hand.

[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core])]
[During Set] (When Set)
You can +1 counter. Then, you can draw a card.

[During Set]
When you're summoning/deploying a "Diva" family card, fulfill one of its reduction symbols.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11574.name: The NewWorld's Alex
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11574.effect:
This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Yellow.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
During this turn, an opposing Spirit/Nexus can't activate its effects, and return that Spirit/Nexus to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Yellow.

[LV2][LV3] [Rebirth5]
When the opposing Life is reduced, or this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can flip it (Cores on it are sent to the Reserve).
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11574.flavor: "I am...Alex. Umm, should be so. Can you...tell me about this world?"

CB29-074.name: The New Freedom
CB29-074.effect:
When this card is sent to the Trash via the [Core Charge] of your Grandwalker Nexus, you can +1 core to one of your White-only Grandwalker Nexuses, and you can add this card to the Hand.

[Flash]
Refresh a "Gundam" you control. Then, if you control any "Pilot" family Brave, you can send a core, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to your Life.

BS10-087.name: The New Life on the Battlefield
BS10-087.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Core Step)
By not putting a core from the Void to your Reserve, draw a card.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, put a core from the Void each to every Brave Spirit you control.
BS10-087.flavor:
On the wargrounds where countless brave souls have fallen, can something new be born from the hefty price of life? If you push away a little of the earth on the wargrounds, permeating with the lives and dreams of the fallen, a future filled with hope, down to the smallest leaf vein, surely is growing at rapid speed. At least, this is what I believe. And I have no doubts that the wishes of those who died in battle are the same as mine. Put your ear to the earth... Can't you hear it? The beating pulse of a new future?
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BSC49-077.name: The New Life on the Battlefield LT
BSC49-077.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Core Step)
You can exhaust this Nexus. When you've done so, by sending a core, besides [Soul Core], from your Reserve/Trash to the Void, draw a card.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, you can put one core from the Void, each to every Spirit you control.
BSC49-077.flavor:
On the wargrounds where countless brave souls have fallen, can something new be born from the hefty price of life? If you push away a little of the earth on the wargrounds, permeating with the lives and dreams of the fallen, a future filled with hope, down to the smallest leaf vein, surely is growing at rapid speed. At least, this is what I believe. And I have no doubts that the wishes of those who died in battle are the same as mine. Put your ear to the earth... Can't you hear it? The beating pulse of a new future?
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

CB23-045.name: The New Tokyo-3 City
CB23-045.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit attacks, you can return up to three "Evangelion" from your Trash to the deckbottom. Also, once per turn, if that opposing Spirit has the "Angel" family, you can return an "Evangelion" from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2]
When you're summoning an "Evangelion", fulfill one of its reduction symbols.
CB23-045.flavor: A fortress city built to intercept the Apostles (Angels). NERV's Headquarters is located underground.

CB32-X05.name: The New Ultra Brothers, Ultraman Mebius
CB32-X05.kanji: 新たなウルトラ兄弟 ウルトラマンメビウス
CB32-X05.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this card is either revealed from deck or sent to the Trash from deck by your effect, you can use the [Accel] of this card, without paying the cost.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 6 ([White Core][White Core][White Core])]
Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, put this card onto your Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put two cores from the Void to any of your Spirits.

[LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, you can refresh a Spirit you control.
CB32-X05.flavor: A rookie in the Inter Galactic Defense Force who was ordered by Father of Ultra to defend the Earth.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11580.name: The New World
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11580.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Rebirth3]
When either the opposing Life is reduced, or when this Nexus would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can flip this Nexus, putting your [Soul Core] onto it.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning a "Primal" family Spirit card, this Nexus's symbol is also treated as Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

[LV2]
While your originally Cost 4/5/6 "Primal" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11580.flavor: A stone arch unknown to her casts its shadow over grasslands and a blue sky which spread as far as the eye can see.

26RBS03-056.name: The NewlyFledged Kolulu
26RBS03-056.effect:
[LV1-2]When Summoned
You can reveal a card from your decktop. If that's Cost 2/4/6/8, target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, give it -2000 BP. Then, if it has 0 BP, destroy it. If it's Cost 1/3/5/7, destroy this Spirit. Return the revealed card to the deckbottom.
26RBS03-056.flavor: Dragon hatchlings fledge early. It is the nest that cannot hold them.

26RBS02-X09.name: The OceanGod Leviaclan
26RBS02-X09.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2] When AttacksOnce Per Turn
You can target an opposing Spirit. Exhaust it. Then, you can target one of your Spirits. Refresh it.

[LV2]Your TurnOnce Per Turn
When Spirits you or the opponent controls are exhausted by your effect, you can target an opposing exhausted Spirit. Heavy exhaust it.
26RBS02-X09.flavor: The Lord of the Trench has awoken—

BS29-054.name: The NextGenerationGiant Brybar
BS29-054.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or higher Spirits]

When your Spirit's [Summon Bolt] activates, this Ultimate card in your Hand is also treated as a Spirit card.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, return a Spirit card with [Summon Bolt] from your Trash to the Hand.
[utb]

[LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit.
BS29-054.flavor: Antarc, you can't communicate with them either? As I thought, Ultimates aren't all the same.

26RSD03-006.name: The OceanPhantom Coela-Canth
26RSD03-006.effect:
[LV1-2]When Summoned
Besides this Spirit, you can target an "Armored Fish" family Spirit you control. Put a core from the Void to it. Then, if you control any exhausted "Armored Fish" family Spirit, you can target one of your Spirits. Refresh it.
26RSD03-006.flavor: If you see a light in the darkness of the deep sea, you'd be wise not to approach it. If there are three lights, you should run for your life.

BS28-X06.name: The NextGenerationMachineBeast Blizza-Liger
BS28-X06.kanji: 次代機獣ブリザ・ライガ
BS28-X06.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 3 or higher Spirits/Ultimates]

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks]
If your Life is at three or less, return an opposing Spirit to the decktop. After this effect resolves, summon this Ultimate card without paying the cost.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, this Ultimate can't be blocked by opposing Spirits. Once per turn, when this Ultimate reduces the opposing Life, it refreshes.
[utb]
BS28-X06.flavor: Stop it!! The Tri-Dragon Deities no longer have enough power to withstand your attacks!!

BS20-047.name: The OceanShieldGuardian Giles
BS20-047.kanji: 海楯の守護者ジャイルズ
BS20-047.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Cost 3 or less Spirits are destroyed by opposing effects, they can remain on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2] (When Battles)
Discard two cards from the opposing decktop.
BS20-047.flavor: The inheritor of the axe passed down for generations in the country lying at the bottom of the sea. He suppressed the erupting land and slowed the rate of destruction.

BSCO-011.name: The NightEmperor Voltissimo
BSCO-011.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By returning an opposing Cost 8 or less Spirit to the Hand, pay two costs to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Send two cores from one opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve. The Spirit/Ultimate depleted by this effect is banished, not sent to the Trash.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11588.name: The OceanStardragon Delphinios
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11588.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Red & Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
By destroying an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit, refresh this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When opposing Spirits are destroyed by your effects, draw a card.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11588.flavor:
Poseidon and Apollon didn't seem to agree with Zeus-Lolo's ideology, but they didn't openly state their opinions.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 1:02―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11589.name: The OceanclawDragon Tsubasa-no-Jou
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11589.kanji: 海爪竜ツバサノジョウ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11589.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control.
[Rush: Red]
(While you have a Red symbol, the following effect activate next)
[Red Core]: Destroy an opposing Brave.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
All your "Terra Dragon"/"Ocean Emperor" family Spirits gain +3000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11589.flavor:
The spacetime distortion that is supposed to happen when a world is connected did not occur when Susanoo linked his world, perhaps due to his ancient Grandwalker powers.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 2:47―

BS26-R021.name: The NorthWindWolf BoreasWolf
BS26-R021.kanji: 北風の狼ボレアースウルフ
BS26-R021.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step) At the beginning of the step, you can look at the first card on top of your opponent's deck.

[LV1][LV2] All "Blade Beast" family Spirits you control cannot be returned to the hand or deck from your Field by opposing effects.

26RBS03-029.name: The OceanicFan Greaseticola
26RBS03-029.effect:
[LV1-2]During AttackOnce Per Turn
At the end of battle, you can return a card from your Hand to the deckbottom. If returned, you can send out one of your "Swordish" Tokens.

[LV2]True ReleaseYour End Step
If you control any "Swordish", refresh this Spirit.
26RBS03-029.flavor: The pattern spreads out across the sea. It serves as a guide for the Oceanic Green Spirits, and as a bewitching barrier for their enemies.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11592.name: The NovaCannonEmperor Evol-Tiger
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11592.kanji: 新星砲皇エヴォル・ティーガ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11592.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 13000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2][LV3] [Twinkle Bombardment] (When Attacks)
If you control any [During Advent] Spirit, you can reveal two cards from your decktop. For each "Emperor Beast" family Spirit card among them, send an opposing Life to their Reserve. Add the revealed cards to the Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11592.flavor: Behind the scenes, an invasion was underway. It was not an immediate threat thanks to the thirty-six heroes who secretly fought against them.

BS13-065.name: The Octant Small Shrine
BS13-065.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Main Step)
When either player is summoning a Cost 3 or less non-"Imp"/"Astral Soul" family Spirit card, it is summoned in exhausted state.

[LV2] (Opposing Main Step)
Cores can't be removed from opposing Spirits unless via an opposing effect.
BS13-065.flavor:
I secretly created this to determine the positions of spirits that hold the power of constellations; the intricate patterns of the stars reveal their locations.
—from the Octans chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS51-046.name: The OctaveSoundBeast Noteselephant
BS51-046.kanji: 八分音獣ノーツエレファント
BS51-046.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent]
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit. Or, put two cores from the Void to any of your Red/Green Grandwalker Nexuses.
[heb]
After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.
BS51-046.flavor: "Oh, Alex transformed. Hmm, she also looks nice with her hair short."

BS73-015.name: The OdachiMartialArtist Behedarus
BS73-015.kanji: 大太刀の武芸者ベヒダロス
BS73-015.effect:
When opposing 10000 BP or more Spirits/Ultimates are destroyed by your effects, you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After your Spirit is Destroyed by the Opponent]
Summon from your Hand up to one "Martial" family Spirit card with a cost equal or inferior to your number of counters, without paying the cost. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[During Brave] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 12000 BP.
BS73-015.flavor:
If Morrigan successfully contracts with Toa, it is gonna be disastrous.
―Grandwalker Lugh―

BSC24-018.name: The OddBeast Gan Q
BSC24-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with two cores on it.
BSC24-018.flavor:
It can suck in missiles with its giant eyes and make them ineffective. It was an illogical being that did not show any signs of being alive, but it formed a body out of the material it absorbed and became a kaiju.
―Ultraman Gaia―

CB01-028.name: The OddMachineAlien Gapiya Seijin Sades
CB01-028.kanji: 奇機械宇宙人ガピヤ星人サデス
CB01-028.effect:
During (Either Attack Step), when opposing Spirits/Ultimates are summoned/[Advent], you can summon this Spirit card from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By exhausting one of your exactly-named "The OddMachineKaiju Diabolic", send all cores from one opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Trash.
CB01-028.flavor:
A battle-loving alien which was once defeated by Orb. Having a preference for hot fights, he once undid Orb's transformation with a single hit of his Sure-Kill Punch, "Galactica Sadisfaction."
―Ultraman Orb The Movie I'm Borrowing The Power of Bonds!―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11598.name: The OddMachineCustomDragon Galactron
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11598.kanji: 奇機械改竜ギャラクトロン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11598.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
By destroying an opposing exhausted Cost 6 or less Spirit, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as White.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11598.flavor:
Galactron's other mechanical body, which, due to Murnau customizations, became able to shoot a ray that turns matter into jewels. It fought with Orb and Zero in Hawaii.
―Ultraman Orb Movie I'm Borrowing the Power of Bonds！―

CB01-029.name: The OddMachineKaiju Diabolic
CB01-029.kanji: 奇機械怪獣デアボリック
CB01-029.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit attacks, refresh this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can return an opposing Spirit to the decktop. When you've done so, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Discard a random card from the opposing Hand.
CB01-029.flavor:
A kaiju controlled by Murnau. The Jewelic Blaze fired from the Jem Arm on its right arm can turn matter into jewels.
―Ultraman Orb Movie I'm Borrowing the Power of Bonds！―

BS40-066.name: The Odd Dragontail Rock
BS40-066.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Your "Terra Dragon"/Winged Dragon"/"Ancient Dragon" family Spirits can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Your "Terra Dragon"/Winged Dragon"/"Ancient Dragon" family Spirits gain +3000 BP.
BS40-066.flavor:
An odd rock that warped into a strange shape by way of the Great Collapse. If you go south at this landmark, you'll end up at the Terra Dragons' stronghold.
-from the Places of Interest 110/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BS34-014.name: The OgreArtsPriest Araya
BS34-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[LV2] [catl: Purple] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Purple Soul Bursts.
BS34-014.flavor:
Darkness-Griffon planned to return the Master from the underworld. And so he awaited for the moment when the largest war began.
―from the Soldier's Biography of "Sengoku Obscurities" by Kuroe―

BS47-X02.name: The OgreBladeEmperor Death-Sire

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11603.name: The OgreBladeSwordsman Dil-Sireger
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11603.kanji: 鬼刃剣士ディル・ザイガー

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11604.effect:

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11604.flavor: Those who challenged and lost to the OgreBladeEmperor are countless. Those who have their strenght acknowledged become blades and act as the Emperor's forerunners.

BS63-028.kanji: 鬼骸武者ガシャ・オボロ

[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Blood Crystal" family Spirit is attacking, unless the opponent destroys a Spirit with three cores or more they control, they can't block.

BS46-X02.name: The OgreDeityQueen Jealousick Doll
BS46-X02.kanji: 鬼神女王ジェラシックドール
BS46-X02.effect:
When this card in your Hand is discarded by an effect, you can summon it.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can discard a card from your decktop. When the discarded card is a "Ogre Wizard" family card, or a Nexus/Magic card, for each cost of the discarded card, send one core from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Trash.

[Unleash: 2] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Destroyed)
The opponent destroys one of their Spirits/Ultimates. Also, by sending two cores from any of your Purple Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit, return one Purple card from your Trash to the Hand.
BS46-X02.flavor: "I won't allow any cheating... Jealousick Doll, it's time for punishment."

BSC20-X02.name: The OgreDeity Basara
BSC20-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
For each core on this Spirit, send a core from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve. When a Spirit/Ultimate with Soul Core on it was depleted by this effect, send all the cores from the opposing Reserve to their Trash.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your Purple Spirits become exhausted, send a core from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve.
BSC20-X02.flavor: Soul magic sometimes awakens those who must not touch it...

BS33-015.name: The OgreHorseMusha Kugai
BS33-015.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to their Reserve. If you control any Purple Ultimate, also, draw a card.
BS33-015.flavor:
The Heaven Squad fled to the Youkai Folk's hidden village, closing the curtains of the Battle of Nagashino with a historic victory for the Six Heaven Army and Onmyou Territory.
―from the Battle of Nagashino Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BS63-021.name: The OgreMusha Headiless
BS63-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
By discarding a card from your Hand, draw a card.

[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Your counters +2. Then, you can return a "The PartnerMusha Oboro" from your Trash to the Hand.
BS63-021.flavor:
Shall you be craving to becoming an Ogre General, defeat the current Ogre General~ That's exactly how I became a General~ But there is Zekuu. Zekku, one who has never ever surrendered his title to anyone~
―The PartnerMusha Oboro―

BSC24-033.name: The OilKaiju Takkong
BSC24-033.kanji: オイル怪獣タッコング
BSC24-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
Destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.
BSC24-033.flavor:
A kaiju whose favorite food is oil. He has suckers like an octopus, and two sharp tusks.
―The Return of Ultraman―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11611.name: The OldKingDragon Ma-Dura -Humanoid Form-
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11611.kanji: 古王龍マ・ドゥーラ -人態-
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11611.effect:
When this card is discarded via an opposing "Deck Discarding effect", you can summon it without paying the cost. Also, during this game, cards can't be discarded from your deck via opposing "Deck Discarding effects".

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return either a Red Spirit card, or a "Brahma" Nexus card from your Trash to the Hand. If that card has "Creation" family, instead of returning it to the Hand, you can summon it.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11611.flavor:
However, Lolo is their God. God's word couldn't possibly be mistaken. And because of that, their unrest was massive.
―"Genesis Records" Grand-Lolo Tale 03

BSC05-017.name: The Old Devil's Castle
