[LV1][LV2]
When the opponent uses a Spirit/Magic effect that targets your Spirits, you can choose one of your Spirits affected by that effect, and change the target of that effect to that Spirit only.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Brave Spirit becomes exhausted, draw a card.
BSC05-017.flavor:
The Demon King who reigned over the Underworld once used this castle as his residence. Now that it's open to the general public, it appears to have become quite the cheerful attraction.
-from the Places of Interest 4/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS73-052.name: The OlivineJewelArcherFairy Perid
BS73-052.kanji: 橄欖石の宝射妖精ペリド

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Return every Yellow "Prismwing" family Magic card, or every Yellow Grandstone Nexus card, from your Trash to the Hand.
BS73-052.flavor: "Nyx, you've become Lady Morrigan's target. Poor thing."

SD03-014.name: The Olymspia Stadium
SD03-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Main Step)
Spirits can't be summoned via Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When opposing non-braved Spirit would attack, unless the opponent sends a core from their Reserve to the Trash, it can't attack.
SD03-014.flavor:
There is a landbased contest where grueling battles do not occur, the only tournament of its kind; these are the grounds where such a unique competition is held. Even though none of the participants engage each other in combat, this stadium is famous for having fights break out among the audience.
-from the Places of Interest 219/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS39-034.name: The NovaSixthMachineBeast Aero-Sheep
BS39-034.kanji: 新星己獣エアロ・シープ

BS39-034.flavor: Aero-Sheep is the new machine based on data obtained from Glorious-Sheep! It has been leaving an excellent record since its debut in the seventh battle. The best candidate for the next Sheep God-King!

BS55-043.name: The OminousStarSoldier Gradiston
BS55-043.kanji: 妖星機兵グラジストン

This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Ultimate effects.
BS55-043.flavor:
The binding chains on Izanagi are tightening up. All because of Alex's power. It's over...we won't make it at this rate.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 4:24―

[During Advent] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

BS74-007.flavor: "Yin overcomes yang... You've forced me to use forbidden magic, haven't you?"

BS18-068.name: The O.K. Corral

The warriors of Ice Shield that worked with Kei during the Hero War were granted a special zone. While It was a favorable treatment, it was also said to be a mean to separate the fellow from the masses.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Imperial Year One—

The door that became the exit was in the bottom of a well that had in the past imprisoned a goddess of ice.
-from the 14th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Lord"/"Vassal" family Spirit attacks, send a core from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to their Reserve.

2 [LV1][LV2] Flash

[LV2][LV3] [Catl: Purple/Yellow/Blue] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Purple/Yellow/Blue Soul Bursts. After that Burst activates, return a Purple Magic card from the Trash to your Hand.
BS35-022.flavor: The Mad Scientist welcomed by the "Diabolics". What sort of ripples will the secret technique from the eastern island country make on BSGP?!

BS62-044.name: The ObsidianBladeArmoredBeast Itztli

When the opposing counter increases to six or more, you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Return two opposing Cost 6 or less Spirits to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, you can swap a card from Hand with an “Armored Beast” family card on your Removed Zone. When you've done so, this Spirit refreshes.
BS62-044.flavor:
The power of you Grandwalkers. Let me borrow it for a while.
―Contractor Ｘ―

BS11-062.name: The Oort Dragon's Nest

Give every "Astral Dragon" family Spirit card in your Hand reduction symbol: .

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)

A giant funnel cloud where the Astral Dragons live. Its size is enough to swallow an entire city. Quite a spectacle to behold, even looking from a distance. It certainly has appeal for its war potential.
-from the Places of Interest 153/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11629.name: The OceanEmperorBlade Triwave
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11629.kanji: 海皇剣トライウェーブ

When you summon a Spirit via [Summon Bolt], refresh this Spirit.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
You can summon a Spirit card with [Summon Bolt] from your Hand without paying the cost.
BS25-X02.flavor: Please, go well! You're the key to the TS Plan! It all depends on you going to the Reverse Continent first!!

BS23-054.name: The OceanEmperorGiantSoldier Atlaia-Golem
BS23-054.kanji: 海皇巨兵アトライア・ゴレム
BS23-054.effect:

For each "Fencer"/"Artificial Soldier" family Spirit you control, destroy an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
All opposing Cost 1/2 Spirits can't attack/block.
BS23-054.flavor: The jewel of the Atlaia Sea Empire's weapons craft. If this had been completed earlier, we might have been able to avoid all the tragedies after the massive abnormalities...

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11632.name: The OriginGodKingDragon Daiorigin
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11632.kanji: 起源神皇龍ダイオリジン

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11632.flavor: The wishes of sixty Ten Crowns causes the advent of a great power.

BS52-065-A11633.name: The OceanGateSoldier Oceangate-Golem
BS52-065-A11633.kanji: 海門機兵オーシャンゲート・ゴレム
BS52-065-A11633.effect:
[Brave Symbol +1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total Cost of 6.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)

BS66-006.kanji: 異空龍パブラ＝アシュカ

Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1. Then, by destroying this Spirit, draw cards until your Hand is five.
BS66-006.flavor: Clues about Dan finally! And ugh...you look...a bit cuter than before but...you're Glow, right?

[LV3]
Every "Terra Dragon"/"Ocean Emperor" family Spirit your control gains an extra Blue Symbol.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11635.flavor: The watchdog of Susanoo's army. They say Susanoo is deeply indebted to him.

BS35-064.name: The OceanGeneral Kanimedes
BS35-064.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy all opposing Cost 5 or less spirits. For each Spirit destroyed by this effect, discard a card from the opposing decktop.

[When Braved] [LV2] [Assault: 2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to twice per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.
BS35-064.flavor: Wasn't the fight put up by the rookie, Racer Dos-Deimos, against two veteran God-Kings, a really, really, really great one?!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11637.name: The Outlaw Wasteland
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11637.effect:

The place where nameless strong beings sleep. This place has been dinosaurs' territory. This place might have been the battlefield once.
-from the Places of Interest 23/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

AVALANCHE-BISON.name: The OxTwelveGodKing Avalanche-Bison

[LV2][LV3]

The Hindida Gods who have the power of Grandphosis can detach themselves from their world and act individually.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 1:19―

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)

BS13-064.flavor:
In the crumbling world, the one thing remaining is the palace of the snakes that gathered all knowledge. It is a difficult journey, but those who want to know something should try visiting it.
-from the Places of Interest 14/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

When this Spirit card is sent to your Trash due to opposing Ultimate Trigger or "Deck Discarding effects", during this turn, cards can't be discarded from your deck, and you can summon this Spirit card, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your "ORIGAMI CYCLONE"/"ROCK BISON" is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects, and if that Spirit is [During Advent], the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

BS63-072.name: The Physicist Manadae
BS63-072.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Blue Core]]}
[During Set]
When you draw via your "Azure Wave" family effect, the opponent can't activate "when draw/when increase Hand" effects.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "The PartnerShark Shack", draw three cards, then discard three cards from your Hand. When this effect discards any "Azure Wave" family Nexus card, you can deploy one of those cards without paying the cost.
BS63-072.flavor: "Nnnaa...Today's another day of Wobble wobble wakame~"

SD17-009.name: The PiercingDragon Styragorn
SD17-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Clash] (When Attacks)
The opponent must block if possible.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.
SD17-009.flavor: With acceleration and weight added in, its piercing horns become a blade that can kill with one hit.

BS08-047.name: The PigMan Chohakkai
BS08-047.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Neither player can draw outside Draw Step.
BS08-047.flavor: It's a pig! It's the world's strongest pig who loves all things beautiful! Even today, the scent of cologne floats lightly in the breeze...!

BS03-072.name: The Pikeman Jeffrey
BS03-072.flavor:
So many people are now flooding to this town for the competition meeting. Even though the gatekeepers are supposed to secure the town, they seem to be neglecting their jobs. They didn't even stop me when I tried to go in. I wonder if this is how they are here.
-from the 1st paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS11-071.name: The PillarRocks' Aquapolis
BS11-071.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When your Spirit with [Crush] is summoned, discard two cards from the opposing decktop.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit attacks, discard a card from the opposing decktop. If that card is Cost 3 or less, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS11-071.flavor:
Traces of life remain within the cluster of rocky structures located in the Northern Seas. Perhaps these cities of the surface and the ocean floor were left behind by the citizens of a past world?
-from the Places of Interest 599/1000 of "Record of the Strange World by Wanderer Lolo"-

SD66-004.name: The PinnacleDinosaur Jurassickle-Zenith
SD66-004.kanji: 頂天恐龍ジュラシックル・ゼニス
SD66-004.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Assault Contract & C1 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2]
When your other Spirits are depleted via an effect, your counter +1. Then, you can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can summon a Cost 6 or less "Scarlet Flame" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

BS66-010.name: The PinnacleDragon Ba-Gaw-Zenith
BS66-010.kanji: 頂天竜魔人バ・ゴゥ・ゼニス
BS66-010.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Assault Contract & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Your counter +1. Then, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. For each counter you have, increase the limit of this "BP Destruction effect" by +2000.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, by destroying an opposing Nexus, draw two cards.

SD66-005.name: The PinnacleDragon Ma-Gwo-Zenith
SD66-005.kanji: 頂天竜魔人マ・グー・ゼニス
SD66-005.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Assault Contract & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
You can destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. If you have six counters or more, increase the limit of this "BP Destruction effect" by +10000.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When you activate an "Awaken"-named effect, you can activate one of this Spirit's (When Summoned) effects. When you've done so, during this turn, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.

BSC42-040.name: The Piper Heimdall LT
BSC42-040.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Only up to three cards can be discarded from your deck per turn by opposing effects.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) During this battle, the opponent can't use cards from their Hand during Flash Timing.
BSC42-040.flavor: Clear tones, the words of non-words deliver so many messages: pain, sorrow, distress and happiness.

BS42-077.name: The Pirate'sSpeargun Zeroy-Shooter
BS42-077.kanji: 海賊銛銃ゼーロイ・シューター
BS42-077.effect:
[LV1] [Reload]
You can [Advent] onto this Spirit-condition Brave. When you [Advent] onto this Brave, you can brave this pre-Advent card to that Spirit.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Unless the opponent sends a core from their Reserve to the Trash, they can't use Magic cards/[Accel]. If this Spirit is [During Advent], this effect sends three cores to Trash instead.
BS42-077.flavor: A gift from the Noble Order to the DragonEmperor's Pirate Crews. It possess even the power to split the sea.

CB22-014.name: The PirateAlien Barossa Seijin (The Fourth)
CB22-014.kanji: 海賊宇宙人バロッサ星人（四代目）
CB22-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can banish three cards from your decktop. When you've done so, destroy an opposing Spirit with two cores or less on it.

[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Discard a card from the opposing decktop, and if a non-Brave card is discarded, this Spirit remains on Field, exhausted.
CB22-014.flavor: The Pirate Alien with the properties of taking over various weapons and turning them into its own weapon.

CB18-027.name: The PirateAlien Barossa Seijin (The Second)［Ultra Kaiju 2020］
CB18-027.kanji: 海賊宇宙人バロッサ星人(二代目)［ウルトラ怪獣2020］
CB18-027.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
While there is any opposing Brave, this card in Hand can be summoned.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Brave. Also, when summoned by an effect, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit is treated as [During Brave], and you can activate a "[During Brave] (When Attacks)" effect of a Brave card in the opposing Trash as this Spirit's effect.
CB18-027.flavor: Coming for the Beliarok, the second Pirate Alien. It was the younger brother of the first one who went after King Joe, and attacked Zett to revenge for his brother.

BS52-CP02.name: The PiscesEvilCannon Pisceculverin
BS52-CP02.kanji: 双魚魔砲ピスケカルバリン
BS52-CP02.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks)
Send one core each from every opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field] (Your Attack Step)
(At least four cores on this Nexus) When your Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, discard a random card from the opposing Hand.

BS28-048.name: The PirateCaptain Edgar
BS28-048.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon a Cost 3 or less Spirit card with [Summon Bolt] from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Fighting Spirit" family Spirits/Ultimates gain +2000 BP.
BS28-048.flavor: In the end, Summon Bolt has been a useful ability throughout the plan. We need to gather more information on it.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11742.name: The PistolDoll †Bourbonella†
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11742.kanji: 拳銃ドール†バーボネラ†
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11742.effect:
When this card was discarded/sent to the Trash by the effect of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Hera", you can add it to the Hand. When you've done so, send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
For each "Doll"-named Spirit you control, send one core from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to their Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11742.flavor:
"AHAHAHAHAHA! Eat my bullets! If you can endure all of them, I'll do whatever you want me to."
The bullets which are endlessly one-directional drill through the meat and pierce the skies.

BSC30-016.name: The PirateChief Murakami-Kiri
BSC30-016.kanji: 海賊衆頭領ムラカミキリ
BSC30-016.effect:
[Burst: s] (After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect)
Summon this Spirit card without paying the cost. Then, if the opponent has five or more cards in Hand, by discarding the entire opposing Hand, the opponent draws three cards.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, by exhausting one of your Nexuses, refresh this Spirit.
BSC30-016.flavor:
In this world, there were figures who called themselves the four great generals. The four forces that made them the lords had absolute powers.
-from section four of "New Record of the Strange World" chapter Sengoku-

BS25-064.name: The Planet Celtic Cross
BS25-064.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
One [Red Core] reduction symbol on all Red Spirit cards in your Hand is also treated as [Core] reduction symbol.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Astral Dragon" family Spirit is blocked by an opposing Spirit, your attacking Spirit gain +5000 BP.
BS25-064.flavor: The day before the TS Plan went into action, we verified an unexpected natural phenomenon: specifically, a planetary phenomenon that is a sign of bad luck. Will we safely reach the floating continent? The plan being what it is, I'm worried.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11745.name: The PirateDeity Piscegalleon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11745.kanji: 双魚賊神ピスケガレオン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11745.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Besides this Spirit, send a core each from every Spirit to its owner's Reserve. Draw a card for each Spirit depleted by this effect.

[LV2] (When Destroyed)
For each "Galaxian"/"Astral Soul" family Spirit you control, both players discard a card from their Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11745.flavor:
What beautifully radiates from inside him are stolen lives.
—from the Pisces chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BSC42-074.name: The Plateau of Duel LT
BSC42-074.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Start Step)
You can refresh a “Scarlet Flame” family Spirit you control and a Spirit with "Awaken"-named effects you control.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When your Spirit with "Awaken"-named effects, or your Red Spirit with 4000 BP or more attacks, you can draw a card.
BSC42-074.flavor:
The great land of the awakening. They say a legendary hero had been defeated here and turned himself into a dragon.
-from the Places of Interest 3/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11747.name: The PirateDeity Piscegalleon X
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11747.kanji: 双魚賊神ピスケガレオンX
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11747.effect:
This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Send two cores each from every opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve, and for each target depleted, send three cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void.

[Unleash: 2, Astral] [LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
By putting two cores from any of your six-colored Grandwalker Nexuses to any of Spirits, discard two random cards from the opposing Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11747.flavor: Pisces is the last outlet before the Starpower gathered by the Twelve Zodiacs pours onto the land.

BS12-015.name: The PlutoDragonDeity Krono-Hades
BS12-015.kanji: 冥王神龍クロノ・ハデス
BS12-015.effect:
[Tribute: Astral Soul → Void]
After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from an "Astral Soul" family Spirit you control to the Void.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
By sending three cores from your Field to the Void, send four cores from the opposing Field to the Void.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
Each player targets one of their Spirits. Destroy all Spirits that aren't targeted.
BS12-015.flavor:
Before the incredible power that controls time, the PlutoSacredBeast was lured and absorbed by the SaturnDragonDeity without being able to resist!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BSC49-XV04.name: The PirateDeity Piscegalleon XV
BSC49-XV04.kanji: 双魚賊神ピスケガレオンXV
BSC49-XV04.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When opposing Spirits/Ultimates would leave the Field due to your effects, you can summon this card from the Trash.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Treat this Spirit's color as colorless. Then, send one core each from every opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Trash. When this effect couldn't deplete, draw up to two cards.

[LV2]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your Spirits would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can discard two random cards from the opposing Hand.
BSC49-XV04.flavor:
The Twelfth Radiance is a pirate ship that wanders, bearing countless souls.
―"Secret Tales of the Eighty-Eight Constellations"―

BS11-015.name: The PlutoSacredBeast Inferd-Hades
BS11-015.kanji: 冥王神獣インフェルド・ハデス
BS11-015.effect:
[Immortality: Cost 4/5] (Either Attack Step)
This Spirit card in your Trash can be summoned when your Cost 4/5 Spirit is destroyed.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Separate an opposing Brave Spirit. However, the opponent moves the cores for the separation.
BS11-015.flavor:
It is said that wherever this beast visits becomes a living hell. If what witnesses say is true, then hell on our world has only just begun.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11751.name: The PirateFleet Captain-Wallace
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11751.kanji: 海賊艦隊キャプテン・ウォルラス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11751.effect:
When your Blue Spirits are depleted/destroyed by the opponent, you can summon this card from the Removed Zone without paying the cost.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 6 ([Blue Core][Blue Core][Blue Core])]
Destroy every opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit/Ultimate and an opposing Cost 5 or more Spirit/Ultimate. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Look at the contents of an opposing Burst, and if it is a Spirit card/Magic card, discard it.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11751.flavor: “All that is left to wipe them out! Captain, get rid of those of the Empty Skies!”

BSC49-017.name: The PlutoSacredBeast Inferd-Hades LT
BSC49-017.kanji: 冥王神獣インフェルド・ハデスLT
BSC49-017.effect:
[Immortality: Devotee/Concluser/Astral Soul/Galaxian] (Either Attack Step)
This Spirit card in your Trash can be summoned when your "Devotee"/ "Concluser"/ "Astral Soul"/ "Galaxian" family Spirit is destroyed.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Brave, and when you couldn't destroy, send up to two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your Spirits with "Immortality"-named effects gain an extra Purple symbol.
BSC49-017.flavor:
It is said that wherever this beast visits becomes a living hell. If what witnesses say is true, then hell on our world has only just begun.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS26-045.name: The PirateGeneral Edward
BS26-045.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon a "Galaxian"/"Astral Soul" family Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost. If a "Galaxian" family Brave is summoned via this effect, draw three cards. Then, discard two cards from your Hand.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
Discard a card from the opposing decktop. The opponent can't use cards from their Hand that shares the same color as the discarded card.
BS26-045.flavor: Hey Nord! Hurry up and analyze him with that P-something device!

BS24-054.name: The PirateGiant Kidd
BS24-054.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Add all "Artificial Soldier"/"Fighting Spirit" family Ultimate cards among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
Destroy an opposing Cost 1 or less Spirit. If you control any Ultimate, also, destroy an opposing Cost 3 Spirit.
BS24-054.flavor: Let's leave the maritime investigation to the locals. Please comb the whole area, search every corner!

BS18-040.name: The Poet Pentan
BS18-040.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When cores are increased from the Void due to an opposing Spirit/Nexus effect, you can draw a card for each core increased.

[LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
Opposing Cost 4 or less Spirits battling with this Spirit are treated as LV1.
BS18-040.flavor: Please bear witness to my wedding with Kei. For free, if you could...

BS42-071.name: The PirateGodKing Greedog-Pirate
BS42-071.kanji: 海賊の神皇グリードッグ・パイレート
BS42-071.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Fusion Beast/Blade Beast & Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Look at the entire opposing Hand, and discard a Magic card or a Spirit card with [Accel] among them. You can immediately activate the Main/Flash effect of that Magic card or [Accel], without paying the cost.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Activate this Spirit's (When Advents) effect.
BS42-071.flavor: That power that takes away everything! That is necessary for collecting the Holy Relics!

BS29-056.name: The PoisonSnakeScythe Alphard
BS29-056.effect:
[LV1] [SSoul: Purple]
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains [Purple Core] (an extra Purple symbol).

[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
When only this Ultimate is destroyed by comparing BP, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate that was in battle with this Ultimate.
BS29-056.flavor: Antarc, have you ever braved? What? You can talk to your braved Brave!? These weapons can talk!

BS29-038.name: The PirateGunner Harvey
BS29-038.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
Opposing Cost 3 or less Spirits/Ultimates can't attack.

[LV2][LV3] Cost 6/8 (When Battles)
At the end of the battle, by destroying this Spirit, summon a Cost 3/4 Spirit card in the same family as this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BS29-038.flavor: Huh? You're sending me to Darkness Hole? You're not coming with? You're sending me off with a bang? None of this bodes well.

BS13-071.name: The Port of Giants
BS13-071.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When you control three or less Spirits, you can't attack. When the opponent controls three or less Spirits, they can't attack.

[LV2] (Opposing Main Step)
When the opponent uses Magic effects twice or more, after that effect resolves, end the opposing Main Step.
BS13-071.flavor:
A giant harbor located in the South Kingdom. After constantly fleeing from a rapidly spreading wave of devastation, I cast off from this place on my journey to the final island. As a secret between you and me, the scale of this site is so huge that it doesn't even feel like an actual port.
-from the Places of Interest 199/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo-

BS12-X06.name: The PirateKing Leviadan
BS12-X06.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy all opposing Spirits with the same costs as your "Beast Head" family Spirits.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, by destroying one of your Spirits with no printed effects, refresh this Spirit.

[LV3]
Treat all your Spirits as Spirits with no printed effects.
BS12-X06.flavor:
The legendary Pirate King, he who sailed across and ruled the world's oceans for thousands of years, now rises again from the depths!!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

P14-13.name: The PirateKnight Brendan
P14-13.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Cost 5 (When Battles)
At the end of the battle, by destroying this Spirit, summon a Cost 5 Spirit card in the same family as this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost.
P14-13.flavor: "Summon Bolt", hmm~? An instantaneous but life-threatening method of transfer... You can do this because of your bonds as pirates, I suppose.

BS04-052.name: The Postman Pentan
BS04-052.effect:
[LV3] (Your Draw Step)
If you control a total of three or more "Pentan"/"Empereur"-named Spirits, you draw +1 card.
BS04-052.flavor: As you know, the key found in the land of penguin turned out to be a fake. Why is he walking so slowly as if nothing had happened?

BS28-049.name: The PirateOfficer Cephas
BS28-049.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by the Opponent]
By returning a "Fighting Spirit" family Spirit/Ultimate card from your Trash to the Hand, summon this Spirit card.

[LV2][LV3] Cost 4/8 (When Battles)
At the end of the battle, by destroying this Spirit, summon a Cost 4/8 Spirit card in the same family as this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BS28-049.flavor:
"I'll do anything to get my hands on treasure," said the carrier with a smile.
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, 295 days remaining—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11764.name: The Pouring Clear Stream
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11764.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step) When your Green Spirit attacks, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits with Charge.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) When your life is reduced by the attacks of opposing Spirits, draw a card.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11764.flavor: I must store some of this famously refreshing water for the journey to come. But how should I gather this water here?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11765.name: The PirateShipEater Hydra-Kraken
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11765.kanji: 海賊船喰いのハイドラ・クラーケン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11765.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Blue] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

You can also stack this Spirit card onto your Blue Nexus with at least one core on it via [Advent].

[LV1][LV2]
The (When Summoned) effects of opposing Spirits/Braves can't activate.

[During Advent] [LV2]
This Spirit can't attack, and is unaffected by opposing Spirit effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11765.flavor: Its many long legs get in the way, and the movements of the enemy's underlings are stopped!

26RBS03-064.name: The PowerWings Megaropsis
26RBS03-064.effect:
[LV1-2]When Destroyed
Target an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit. Destroy it. If you control any Blue Spirit with no printed effects, the targeting cost becomes 5 or less instead.
26RBS03-064.flavor: To Spirits that have survived the primeval forests, battlefields are nothing more than playgrounds.

BS43-070.name: The PirateShipGodKing Calamity-Boar-Ship
BS43-070.kanji: 海賊船の神皇カラミティ・ボア・シップ
BS43-070.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Roaring Azure/Fusion Beast & Cost 4 or more] ((Your Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost. When any Spirit is destroyed by this effect, you can summon a "Pirate"-named Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When any opposing Spirit is depleted/destroyed, refresh this Spirit.
BS43-070.flavor: Always face the front, and move at full throttle!

BS41-054.name: The PranksterGodKing Moujoker
BS41-054.kanji: 悪戯の神皇マウジョーカー
BS41-054.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Drifting Spirit] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending [Soul Core] to your Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Advents)
You can send a core from an opposing Spirit to another opposing Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
You can summon a Spirit card among this Spirit's pre-Advent cards, without paying the cost. When you've done so, return this Spirit to your Hand.
BS41-054.flavor: Since you advented on the Sovereign, are you now a Sovereign Mouse?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11769.name: The PirateUnionGeneral Forge-Low
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11769.kanji: 海賊連合総長フォージ・ロウ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11769.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, during this turn, when your "Pirate"-named Spirits attack, you can stack a Blue card from your Hand onto that Spirit via [Advent], treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
By summoning/deploying a Brave card/Nexus card from your Hand without paying the cost, during this turn, unless the opponent discards a Magic card from their Hand, they can't block.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11769.flavor: I have come to an understanding with the commander! From today on, you guys are our allies, the Pirate Union!!

BS70-X09.name: The Precipice of Phantom Star
BS70-X09.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed/Destroyed)
Once per turn, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, you can deploy one "Primordial" family Nexus card without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom. If you have eight counters or more, the "one" text of this effect is changed to "up to three".

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, when your Nexuses are destroyed, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate, and send a core, besides [Soul Core], from the destroyed target to the Void.
BS70-X09.flavor:
A fossil of something floating in the wreckage of a star.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 333―

BS67-062.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Extreme Contract & C3 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Ultimate.

[SuAdcon: You control one or more “The Extreme Partner, Zetter”, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

[During Advent] [Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4] (When Advents/Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost.
[utb]

[During OC] [LV3][LV4] (Your Attack Step)
When your Ultimate Trigger hits, during this turn, increase the cost of every card in the opposing Hand by +1.

26RBS02-073.name: The RampagingTree Ordolily
26RBS02-073.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2] When Attacks
Target any number of Nexuses you control. Exhaust them. For each Nexus exhausted via this effect, target an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit. Destroy them.

[LV2]True ReleaseStart of Either Attack Step
You can target one of your "Cyantree" family Nexuses. Send one or more cores from your Field/Reserve to it, and during this step, it doesn't activate its Nexus effects, and is treated as a Spirit with "<1>LV1 5000 BP, <3>LV2 7000 BP."
26RBS02-073.flavor: Despite being an advance party sent into the Oceanic Green territory prior to the main offensive, the scale of the chaos they caused went far beyond what one would expect from an advance party.

BS65-060.name: The PrimeRaptorDuke Varlant
BS65-060.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more “The Extreme Partner, Zetter”, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

This set card can't be discarded by the opponent.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest cost. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4] (When Summoned/Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, you can draw two cards. When you've done so, discard cards from your Hand so that five or less cards left.
[utb]
BS65-060.flavor: "Zetter, rampage as you want! We, the Tri-Extreme Dukes, approve!"

BS03-114.name: The Rampart of Sapphire
BS03-114.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
For your Spirits with no printed effects, if there is one core on them, treat them as LV1; If there are two cores, treat them as LV2; If there are three cores or more, treat them as being on their highest level.

[LV2]
While you control three or more Spirits with no printed effects, all your Nexuses can't be destroyed by opposing Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.
BS03-114.flavor:
A castle wall of the Central country which is the site of the competition meeting. It tells people how tremendously rich they are.
-from the Places of Interest 91/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS65-058.name: The PrimeSapper Artifact-Golem
BS65-058.kanji: 至工兵アーティファクト・ゴレム
BS65-058.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control no Spirits & have 0 Spirit cards in your Trash]

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1. Then, draw two cards, and discard two cards from your Hand. If you control any "The ExtremePartner, Zetter", including those that are in pre-advent condition, this effect discards -1 card.

[LV4] (Your Attack Step)
When the opponent would use cards from their Hand/Removed Zone, they can't use it unless they pay one extra cost.
BS65-058.flavor:
The Holies army is disadvantaged since the start of the war. And their final hope is Zetter. An ultimate star created by converging the power of triggers.
—Revelations of the Beginning—

BS65-059.name: The PrimeSeaDragon Supreme-Hydra
BS65-059.kanji: 至海竜スプリーム・ハイドラ
BS65-059.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Extreme Contract & C2 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Ultimate.

[SuAdcon: You control one or more “The Extreme Partner, Zetter”, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, destroy an opposing Spirit with the highest cost.
[utb]

[During OC & During Advent] [LV3][LV4] (Your Attack Step)
When your Ultimate attacks, you can activate one of this Ultimate's Ultimate Trigger.

BS31-068.name: The PurifyingKnowledge WisdomKing
BS31-068.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
While there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Spirit, every "WisdomKing"/"Douji"-named Spirit you control gains +4000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When any Magic card is discarded via your "Opposing Deck Discarding" effect, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.
BS31-068.flavor: "It seems the enemy forces have an excellent strategist as well."

SD17-012.name: The Primeval Forest
SD17-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your Spirit, draw a card.

[LV2]
When your Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, return a "Terra Dragon" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.
SD17-012.flavor: Multiple scratches serve to warn of danger. Ahead lies a place that you must not venture into, the forest where dinosaurs lurk.

26RBS03-X04.name: The PurpleAsterBladessom Rindorin
26RBS03-X04.kanji: 紫苑の刀華リンドリン
26RBS03-X04.effect:
[LV1-2] When Summoned
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Discard a Spirit card among them. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order. Then, if the discarded card has the "Dark Puce" family, target an opposing Spirit. Send a core from it to the Reserve. (The opponent chooses which cores to send)

[LV2]True Release [Invoke: Main] Once Per Turn
Target a Purple Spirit card in your Trash. During this step, one of its Purple symbols is treated as a Purple EX symbol.
26RBS03-X04.flavor: "Regretfully, it seems like I will be one standing at the end..."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11823.name: The PurpleFlameSage Denham
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11823.effect:
When your Purple Spirit is destroyed, you can summon this card from the Hand/Removed Zone.

When this card was revealed and sent to the Trash, or sent to the Trash from your Deck/Hand/Removed Zone by an effect, you can pay two costs to summon a Purple Cost 3 or less Spirit card, besides any exactly-named "The PurpleFlameSage Denham", from your Trash.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 5 ([Purple Core][Purple Core][Purple Core])]
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with three or less cores on it. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up on the Removed Zone.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11823.flavor: "Trying to suppress my wisdom with power...?! These fools!"

BS22-X01.name: The PrimitiveKing Gigano-Rex
BS22-X01.kanji: 原始の王者ギガノ・レックス
BS22-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Clash] (When Attacks)
The opponent must block if possible.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: Once per turn, refresh all "Terra Dragon" family Spirits you control.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
For each "Terra Dragon" family Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +5000 BP.
BS22-X01.flavor: The king's roar stirs his company and gives them the power to rise once more!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11825.name: The PurpleMoonDragon Strike-Siegwurm
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11825.kanji: 月紫龍ストライク・ジークヴルム
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11825.effect:
When your Purple-only Spirits are destroyed, you can pay two costs to summon this facedown card from your Removed Zone. When you've done so, you can put a card from your Hand facedown onto your Removed Zone.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by banishing a facedown card from your Removed Zone, this Spirit refreshes. Also, if you control any Purple Grandwalker Nexus, this Spirit can't be blocked.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11825.flavor: The Purple Moon vanishes into the shadows to wait and see.

BS69-063.name: The PrimordialGiantDeity Brontes
BS69-063.effect:
While you control any "Primordial" family Grandwalker Nexus, this set card can't be discarded by the opponent.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy four opposing Cost 7 or less Spirits/Ultimates. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, if you control any "Primordial" family Grandwalker Nexus, draw two cards, then discard a card from your Hand. When this effect discards any "Primordial" family Nexus card, you can deploy that card without paying the cost.
BS69-063.flavor:
Wow...You've got a nice weapon, haven't you? Let me have a look.
―Grandwalker Hephaestus―

BS69-018.name: The PrimordialPoisonDragon Poisonagua
BS69-018.kanji: 原初毒竜ポイゾナグァ
BS69-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
If you control any "Primordial" family Grandwalker Nexus, send two cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve, and when depletes, draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Primordial" family Spirit attacks, by paying one cost, during that battle, the target's color is treated as colorless.
BS69-018.flavor:
It was reported that primordial deities had been appearing in various parts of Olym, besides those led by Gaia. And Athena was in charge of handling all those.
―Theogonic Record Volume 2―

THE-RANGE.name: The Range of Royal Crypts
THE-RANGE.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Flash- (Your Attack Step) By discarding a Magic card from your Hand, during this turn, a Spirit you control gets +3000 BP.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step) When your Spirits with Brilliance/Evil Light are destroyed by the opponent, by exhausting this Nexus, one of the destroyed Spirits remain on your field, exhausted.
THE-RANGE.flavor:
The crypts of the kings of the Magic, Fairy, and Rainbow lands are lined up here. At the time, the rulers of the 3 kingdoms were friends of each other, and constructed them with the idea of "being together, even after death" in mind.
-from the Places of Interest 727/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11829.name: The PrimordialSnakeEmperor Amun-Kematera
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11829.kanji: 原初蛇皇アモン・ケマテラ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11829.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Dark Snake & Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Advents)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can summon any number of "Dark Snake" family Spirit cards from your Hand/Trash, up to a total of Cost 12, paying one cost for each.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Dark Snake" family Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11829.flavor: The primordial serpent sealed on the depths of the Egytian desert.

BS37-XX02.name: The PurpleOriginDragon Is-Baram
BS37-XX02.kanji: 紫の起源龍イシュ・バラム
BS37-XX02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step)
You can summon Purple Spirit cards/Brave cards up to a total cost of 6 from your Trash, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects can't activate.

[During Seal] [LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects.
BS37-XX02.flavor: Purple spread darkness on the world. The darkness enveloped the world, concealing everything.

BS72-004.name: The RapierMartialArtist Almiraj
BS72-004.kanji: 細剣の武芸者アルミラジ
BS72-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, if you control any "Contractor Lugh", you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Concluser" & "Martial" family Spirit card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Martial" family Spirit attacks, for each Brave on one "Contractor Lugh" you control, you can discard a card on the opposing Removed Zone.
BS72-004.flavor: Lugh is the Grandwalker who administered the sun in Celtica. He is a practitioner of a hundred martial arts, and a hunter who has hunted many giant Spirits.

P23-10.name: The RedBladeDragonEmperor Wywald-V
P23-10.kanji: 赤刃竜皇ワイバルト・V
P23-10.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Scarlet Flame & C1 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit, and an opposing 7000 BP or less Ultimate.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
For each counter you have, increase the limit of this Spirit's "BP Destruction effect" by +2000.

BS70-009.name: The RedBladeDragon Merzoudo
BS70-009.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Flame Contract/Heat Contract & C2 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Your counter +1. Then, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2]
Once per turn, when this Spirit destroys any opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus, return a Brave card from your Trash to the Hand.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11834.name: The RaptorDeity Galoud
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11834.effect:
[LV1][LV2] 5 (When Attacks)
When this Spirit is blocked, the opponent exhausts five Spirits they control.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, discard twelve cards from the opposing decktop.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When opposing Spirits are exhausted, for each of those Spirits, discard three cards from the opposing decktop.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11834.flavor: Will my voice reach!? I'm coming in live from the center of the storm the Raptor Deity has whipped up!!

BS31-012.name: The RedBladeDragon The-Heat
BS31-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy two opposing 8000 BP or less Spirits.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
If there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Spirit, destroy an opposing 20000 BP or less Ultimate.
BS31-012.flavor: While the War Dragons were spreading their might, the Ancient Dragons were supposedly spending all their time struggling for power with the Six Shogunate.

BS29-052.name: The RaptorSwordMaster Peregrine
BS29-052.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or higher Spirits]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, destroy an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit.
[utb]

[When Braved] [LV4][LV5] (When this Ultimate Brave Attacks)
Put two cores from the Void to one of your Nexuses.
BS29-052.flavor:
If the Sacred Swords are so special, then they must need special wielders as well.
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, Past Records: Day 11—

BS40-015.name: The PurpleSearcher Deal
BS40-015.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add every card with [Advent] to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When you would [Advent], this Spirit can become Cost 5.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When you would [Advent], this Spirit can become Cost 6.
BS40-015.flavor: One of my escorts is a conjurer. While I can only consider him to be a narcissist, he is very crude. At least aim before you attack with the offensive spells please.

BS70-010.name: The PrimordialWings Genocondor
BS70-010.kanji: 原初の翼ジェノコンドル
BS70-010.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Nexus's (When Summoned/Deployed) effect resolves]
Destroy up to two Nexuses you or the opponent controls, and for each target destroyed, send up to one core, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to your "Primordial" family Spirits. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Your "Primordial" family Spirits can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.
BS70-010.flavor:
Uranus' army advanced at a leisurely pace. Alongside Uranus, together in the main army, were Gaia and Aphrodite.
―Theogonic Record Volume 3―

BS25-071.name: The Rare Metal Mine
BS25-071.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Attacking Spirit/Ultimate with [Crush] you control gains +2000 BP.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When the opposing Life is reduced, discard three cards from the opposing decktop.
BS25-071.flavor:
The Golems were sent over there. We've found a location where we believe their raw materials were mined. If we can seize this, we can mass produce new military forces on that land.
—Blue Seas Site No. 013 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

BS60-007.name: The RedBladeDragon Wywald
BS60-007.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Flame Contract & C1 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, for each two counters you have, destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) At the end of the battle of your Red [During Advent] Spirits, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11841.name: The RatMan Zurich
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11841.effect: [LV1][LV2] (Permanent) While you control a "Fighting Beast" spirit, this spirit is treated as being LV2.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11841.flavor: Wow! The athlete from the East country is accompanied by his coach! You might wonder for a moment which one is the coach. Believe it or not, the coach is the smaller one.

BS38-031.name: The RedFlameWarPrincess Brynhildr
BS38-031.kanji: 紅炎の戦姫ブリュンヒルデ
BS38-031.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Return all opposing non-braved Spirits/Ultimates to the Hand. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.
BS38-031.flavor: If racer Avalanche-Bison is a brusque and steadfast fortress, this person is like an elegant knight who protects the fortress.

BS69-049.name: The PrimordialWolf Lovolgis
BS69-049.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit/Ultimate -5000 BP, and return it to the deckbottom when it is brought to 0 BP. If you have four counters or more, this effect can activate for an extra time.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, if you control any "Primordial" family Grandwalker Nexus, including being in Soul State, you can put a core from the Void to your Life.
BS69-049.flavor:
Apparently, there was someone who was hunting the titans that escaped from Athena's surveillance network. It was rumored that it was a kid controlling giant robots, but it was unclear whether that was true or not.
―Theogonic Record Volume 2―

26RBS01-009.name: The RedGuide Shaniel
26RBS01-009.effect:
[LV1-2] [Clash]During Attack
Opposing Spirits must block if possible.

[LV2]True Release Your Attack Step
All your Spirits with [Clash] gain +2000 BP.
26RBS01-009.flavor: It is said that there is no end to those who seek that whip, be they foe or friend.

BSC42-063.name: The RatMan Zurich LT
BSC42-063.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
While you control any Spirit with [Crush]/the "Fighting Beast" family, this Spirit is treated as being on its highest level.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Your Spirit/Magic's' "Opposing Deck Discarding" effects discard +1 card.
BSC42-063.flavor: Wow! The athlete from the East country is accompanied by his coach! You might wonder for a moment which one is the coach. Believe it or not, the coach is the smaller one.

BS05-040.name: The Princess-Snowwhite
BS05-040.kanji: プリンセス・スノーホワイト
BS05-040.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Turn)
When the opponent uses any Spirit/Magic effect that includes your White "Ice Princess" family Spirits as targets, you can change the target of that Spirit/Magic effect to affect this Spirit only.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
If you control any [Dwarf-Seven], return this Spirit to the Hand.
BS05-040.flavor: The princess and the servants of the country of the flowers have set out to find the Spring. Cute, good princess, huh?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11847.name: The RedHoodFairy Rouge
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11847.kanji: 赤ずきん妖精ルージュ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11847.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Holy Life (When Attacks) When the opponent's life is decreased by this Spirit's Attack, put one core from the Void to your Life.

[LV3] (When Attacks) When attacking after your Brave Spirit, this Spirit cannot be blocked.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11847.flavor: What are you standing around staring at? Don't tell me this girl is your type? I just don't get you.

BSC30-023.name: The PrincessGun -Miyabi-
BSC30-023.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent)
Summon a Cost 5 or less Yellow Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1] [Reload]
You can [Advent] onto this Spirit-condition Brave. When you [Advent] onto this Brave, you can brave this pre-Advent card to that Spirit.
BSC30-023.flavor: A very elegant gun Brave given to the War Princesses.

BS31-015.name: The RedOgre Bakuzou
BS31-015.flavor: After the Ounin War, the military commanders defeated by Flame War Province as they spread their power once more stood as commanders on the side of Onmyou Territory in each of the Kaminakajima battles.

BS33-069.name: The Princesses' Floating Garden
BS33-069.effect:
[Burst: s] (After an opposing Spirit's/Brave's (When Summoned) effect resolves)
During this turn, a Spirit you control can't be destroyed. After this effect resolves, deploy this Nexus card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
During this turn, all opposing Spirits become LV1.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
All battling opposing Spirits get -3000 BP.
BS33-069.flavor: The Great Sengoku Era had extraordinary generals known as the SengokuSixGenerals. What they had in common were their historically significant actions and their overwhelming might.

BS37-XX01.name: The RedOriginDragon Amaterasu
BS37-XX01.kanji: 赤の起源龍アマテラス
BS37-XX01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
When summoned by paying its original cost, destroy every Spirit/Ultimate other than this Spirit.

[During Seal] [LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects.
BS37-XX01.flavor: Red gave the world flames. Flames became the light which shines on the world sunk in darkness.

BS73-AX02.name: The PrismKnightEmperor Dragonic-Arthur
BS73-AX02.kanji: 彩騎士皇帝ドラゴニック・アーサー
BS73-AX02.effect:
This card is also treated as a Magic card.

While you have five counters or more, this card in Hand becomes Cost 5.

[Flash] (You can't use this effect while it's on Field)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -20000 BP, and return it to the deckbottom when it is brought to 0 BP. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects. After this effect resolves, (Once per Turn: Same Name) you can summon this card without paying the cost. Also, if you control any Yellow-only Contract Grandwalker Nexus, and it's the opposing Attack Step, immediately end the battle.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.
BS73-AX02.flavor: At the entrance to the Imaginate world, the Dragon Knight Emperor who wandered into the Jewel Paradise became an imaginate fairy.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11853.name: The RedRockKing Boanefel
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11853.effect:
If there are any Magic cards on the opposing Field, this card in your Hand/Trash becomes Cost 3.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Dark Snake" family Spirit attacks, by discarding a Magic card on the opposing Field, draw a card.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11853.flavor: One of the kings which swore loyalty to Osiris. The Red Rock King, as the name implies, crushed red rocks until undeveloped land became land the citizens could live in.

BS54-X06.name: The PromiseWitch Elneze
BS54-X06.kanji: 約束の魔女エルネーゼ
BS54-X06.effect:
Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
You can summon this card from your Hand. When summoning via this effect, by banishing up to four Yellow-only "Primal" family cards from your Trash, for each card banished, this card's cost gets -1. When summoned via this effect, during this turn, three opposing Spirits/Ultimates can't attack.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, discard two cards from your decktop, and put a core from the Void to your Life.
BS54-X06.flavor: "It has become quite a long journey. But now I'm back, back to this world."

BS40-004.name: The RedSearcher Edwick
BS40-004.kanji: 赤の探索者エドウィック
BS40-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add every card with [Advent] to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When you would [Advent], this Spirit can become Cost 5.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When you would [Advent], this Spirit can become Cost 6.
BS40-004.flavor: One of my escorts is a swordsmaster. He's as taciturn as he looks yet more sensitive than he seems. It's because he's a half-breed of two opposite species.

BS31-067.name: The RedSwords WisdomKing
BS31-067.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
The effect of every opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit/Ultimate can't activate.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard three cards from the opposing decktop. If a Magic card is discarded by this effect, destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit/Ultimate.
BS31-067.flavor: "If there are people who are suffering, lending them a hand would be the correct thing to do."

SD46-X02.name: The RedThunderGodKing Revol-Tiger-Z
SD46-X02.kanji: 紅き雷神皇リボル・ティーガ・Z
SD46-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Seal: Seal] (When Summoned/Attacks)
