BSC45-081.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy opposing Cost 0/2/4/6/8 Spirits, one of each.

[LV2][LV3] [Assault: 1] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.
BSC45-081.flavor: Nothing less than expected from one of the legendary champions! He wields enough power to rival that of an entire Oblivion Army fleet!

CB22-024.name: The RuffedDinosaur Jirahs［First Generation Ultra Kaiju］
CB22-024.kanji: エリ巻恐竜ジラース［初代ウルトラ怪獣］
CB22-024.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits/your Trash, and exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't activate Burst effects. Also, when it's the first attack of your turn, this Spirit refreshes.
CB22-024.flavor: The dinosaur survivor in the Ness Lake. While it fought with the Ultraman, it was defeated after its ruffle got torn apart from it.

26RBS01-X03.name: The RoaringWind Valdigeyer
26RBS01-X03.kanji: 轟風ヴァルディガイヤー
26RBS01-X03.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2] [Clash]During Attack
Opposing Spirits must block if possible.

[LV2]True ReleaseDuring Attack
When blocked by an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit, refresh this Spirit.
26RBS01-X03.flavor: He is not a mere ruler of the red skies. One day, he will rule the skies of the entire world.

BS69-026.name: The RuffianLionheart Priapus
BS69-026.kanji: 乱波の勇士プリアポス
BS69-026.effect:
When your "Blade Beast" family Spirit is summoned during either Attack Step, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand. When you've done so, your counter +1.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate, and put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.
BS69-026.flavor:
You have no role to play here! Pack your stuff and leave now! ―Grandwalker Hermes―
Look who it is! So it's Lord Hermes from Olym. I've heard that you're proud of your speed, but that's history already. Could you keep up with me? ―Grandwalker Huracan―
That's some cheap provocation. ―Grandwalker Hermes―

BS35-009.name: The Roaring Rapide
BS35-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit. At the end of a blocked battle, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.
BS35-009.flavor: Racer Exeseed's heat melts the snow in front of him and clears a path to the goal!

BS20-X01.name: The RuinDragonEmperor TheEnd-Dragonis
BS20-X01.kanji: 滅龍帝ジエンド・ドラゴニス
BS20-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4]
Cores on your destroyed Spirits are sent to this Spirit, instead of your Reserve.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] (Your Attack Step)
Besides any exactly-named "The RuinDragonEmperor TheEnd-Dragonis", when your Spirit is blocked by an opposing Spirit, refresh this Spirit.

[LV3][LV4] Flash - (When Attacks)
By destroying a Spirit you control, refresh this Spirit. This effect can only be used up to three times per turn.
BS20-X01.flavor: The symbol of destruction begins the countdown.

BS59-020.name: The RoboSheriff Herak-Beetroid
BS59-020.kanji: ロボ刑事ヘラク・ビートロイド
BS59-020.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] [Rebirth3]
At the end of this Spirit's attack, or when this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can flip this Spirit. When you do, this Reborn Brave can either refresh and brave to a Spirit you control, or stay in Spirit condition by putting a core from your Reserve/Field onto it.
BS59-020.flavor: "RUSHING TO THE SECNE...ARRIVED. THE RIGHT TO COMMAND IS NOW PASSED ON TO THE APPOINTED INVESTIGATING OFFICER."

PC01-001.name: The Ruins of the Hill Where Shooting Stars Fall
PC01-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The opponent can't use Magic cards which don't have the same colors as the symbols on their Field. Also, while you have five or more counters, the opponent can't use [Accel] which don't have the same colors as the symbols on their Field.

[LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) You can pay one cost to summon an "Incarnate" family pre-advent card under your Spirit.
PC01-001.flavor:
調査開始から30日。アルティメットの力をもってしても時空の亀裂を閉じることは叶わなかった。エウロー発案のコントラクトアーマーの投入が決定。契約の力を何倍にもするものだというが、果たして……。
―ノルドの手記―

CB32-028.name: The RobotKaiju Crazygon［First Generation Ultra Kaiju］
CB32-028.kanji: ロボット怪獣クレージーゴン［初代ウルトラ怪獣］
CB32-028.effect:
During your Main Step, you can pay the summon cost from your "First Generation Ultra Kaiju" Grandwalker Nexus to the Void to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Either exhaust three opposing Spirit, or return every opposing "Android"/"Machine Beast"/"Armed Machine" family Spirit to the deckbottom.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
By sending three cores, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to the Void, refresh this Spirit.
CB32-028.flavor: A robot Kaiju sent forth by Banda Seijin, who had used up their home planet's resources, in order to secure iron resources.

BS60-076.name: The Ruins of the Malgrue Chapel
BS60-076.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
While the opponent has four or less counters, this Nexus is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
(Once per turn: Same Name) You can discard a card from your decktop. If that's a "Blood Crystal" family card, you can draw two cards.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While you have four counters or more, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via Spirit effects.
BS60-076.flavor:
ここは、かつて隆盛を極めた聖魔教会の礼拝堂であった。
―名所絶景録―

CB32-003.name: The RobotKaiju Mecha Gomora
CB32-003.kanji: ロボット怪獣メカゴモラ
CB32-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Belial" to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. Then, when summoned from the Trash, send two cores from one opposing Spirit to the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Purple.
CB32-003.flavor: Summoned by Kei Fukuide to destroy Geed. Based on the data recorded by RE.M, it can see through Geed's action pattern.

BS08-066.name: The Ruins of the Seabed
BS08-066.kanji: 海底に眠りし古代都市
BS08-066.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When your "Fusion Beast" family Spirit is summoned, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2]
The symbols of all your "Fusion Beast" family Spirits become two symbols with the same color as the symbol they originally have.
BS08-066.flavor:
A vast set of ruins that lie in the deep seas further south of the Southern Kingdom. It is said that the ancient city is still actively functioning today, but few people believe this.
-from the Places of Interest 299/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS23-070.name: The Rocket City
BS23-070.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
All Spirits without [Charge] can't refresh.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When opposing Spirit attacks, refresh a White Spirit with [Charge] you control.
BS23-070.flavor: It seems that they have turned a heirloom rocket into a city. By the way, what's a rocket?

BS12-069.name: The Ruler Mountains
BS12-069.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When the number of cores on your Spirits become zero due to opposing Spirit/Brave/Magic effect, that Spirit is treated as being destroyed at its highest level.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
Your Lives can't be reduced by the attacks of opposing Spirits with two symbols.
BS12-069.flavor:
There are few travelers who are not hurt by the steep triangular crags or the sharp grass. Also, if your luck is bad you may meet a strange angel; it's a dangerous place in many ways.
—from the Norma chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12001.name: The RocktreeBeast Ariocarpus
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12001.effect:
[LV1] This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Ultimate effects.

[LV2] (When Attacks) Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Or, return an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the decktop.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12001.flavor:
Hermes's gut feeling tells him that this round-trip holds the key to the battle. The power he wanted to save for fighting was also invested into his moving. Thus, he and his world connect to Hera's world in an instant.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 3:30―

BS64-X06.name: The Ruler of FourDemonLords God-Javad
BS64-X06.kanji: 四魔卿を統べる者ゴッド・ジャバド
BS64-X06.effect:
Flash - [Final Contract Advent: Hell Contract & C10 or more, (Your Turn)]
By banishing the [Soul Core] from your Field/Reserve, stack this from the Hand onto your target Ultimate.

[SuAdcon: You control one or more “The PartnerDemonLord Javad”, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

[During Advent] [Quadruple Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)]
For each Ultimate Trigger hit, send two cores from the opposing Field to the Trash. [Triple Hit] When it hits thrice or more, look at the entire opposing Hand, and discard three Spirit cards among them. [Quadruple Hit] When it hits four times, during this turn, this Ultimate's symbol is fixed as four Ultimate symbols.
[qutb]

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12003.name: The SacredDragonFlute Bhagavad-Gita
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12003.kanji: 神龍甲笛バガヴァット・ギーター
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12003.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand. Or, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field]
The "Return opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand" effects that this Nexus and "Armored Dragon" family Spirits you control activate can only be prevented by "Remains on the Field" effects.

BS33-063.name: The Rocky Ogre Fortress
BS33-063.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Spirit is Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit. After this effect resolves, deploy this Nexus card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
Draw a card.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
Send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.
BS33-063.flavor: The stronghold of Onmyou Territory lay in the area of Violet Spectre Province that was inhabited by the Nightlings. Violet Spectre Province was an appropriate place for sorcery, as it bordered on the lands of the living and the dead.

SD65-003.name: The Ruler of FourDemonLords Lord-Javad
SD65-003.kanji: 四魔卿を統べる者ロード・ジャバド
SD65-003.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Hell Contract & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Ultimate.

[SuAdcon: You control one or more “The PartnerDemonLord Javad”, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned/Advents)
By discarding a card from your Hand, draw two cards. When this effect discards any "Evil God" family card, send two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve.

[During OC] [LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, at the end of battle, by sending the [Soul Core] from your Trash to this Ultimate, this Ultimate refreshes.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12006.name: The SacredEmperorWeapon Siegfrieden-Cannon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12006.kanji: 聖皇兵装ジークフリーデン・キャノン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12006.effect:
Flash- [Accel: Cost 4 ([Red Core][White Core])]
Destroy two opposing 7000 BP or less Spirits. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1] [Reload]
You can [Advent] onto this Spirit-condition Brave. When you [Advent] onto this Brave, you can brave this pre-Advent card to that Spirit.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of Cost 8.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12006.flavor: A very recent weapon developed after Siegfrieden's equipment.

BSC48-041.name: The Rocky Ogre Fortress LT
BSC48-041.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Spirit/Nexus is Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
Treat this card as colorless, and destroy three opposing exhausted Spirits. Then, when this Burst was activated via a "Catalyze"-named effect, draw two cards. After this effect resolves, deploy this card paying the cost.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
You can send two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve.
BSC48-041.flavor: The stronghold of Onmyou Territory lay in the area of Violet Spectre Province that was inhabited by the Nightlings. Violet Spectre Province was an appropriate place for sorcery, as it bordered on the lands of the living and the dead.

BS66-XV02.name: The SacredEmperor Siegfrieden XV
BS66-XV02.kanji: 聖皇ジークフリーデンXV
BS66-XV02.effect:
When your Cost 8 or more Spirit [Contract Advents], by sending a core, besides [Soul Core], from that target to the Void, immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent]
Draw two cards. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, ignoring the cost of Braves, you can destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates/Nexuses up to a total cost of 9.
BS66-XV02.flavor: They have united! Is that a reaction to that dragon-shaped Spirit?

BS67-X01.name: The Ruler of Judgment Beasts, Ju-Stra
BS67-X01.kanji: 審判獣を統べる者ジウ＝ストラ
BS67-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can draw one card for each "Judgment" family Spirit you control.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When the opponent would use cards from their Hand that share the same color as the symbols of your "Judgment" family Spirits/Nexuses, unless they send a core from their Life to the Void, they can't use it.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
If there are six colors of symbols of your "Judgment" family Spirits/Nexuses, send two opposing Life to the Reserve.
BS67-X01.flavor: "The final judgment is about to commence...I must prepare to welcome my master."

BS63-004.name: The SacredFlameBeast Almirabbit
BS63-004.kanji: 聖炎獣アルミラビット
BS63-004.effect:
(Can't Stack) When the opponent [Core Charge], you can return this card from the Trash to your Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. Then, including being in pre-advent condition, if you control any Red Contract Spirit, send four cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void.
BS63-004.flavor: Kai shows up in front of Dan's group, who have just gathered six Oracles. "Hi, Dan. Congratulations on gathering all six Oracles. However, time is up. Let me play the prelude to world destruction for you. Together with the six pairs of Contract Spirits."

BS66-X10.name: The RumblingContractBlade Thunder Edge
BS66-X10.kanji: 雷鳴の契約刃サンダーエッジ
BS66-X10.effect:
[B Engage: Contract Advent Spirit with "Petit Lampo" as pre-advent]
(Once per Game: Same Name) When braving with the target, you can activate the following effect:
█ After your Attack Step of this turn ends, an extra Core Step, Draw Step and Refresh Step occur, once and only once.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate, and when heavily exhausted, during this battle, effects of that Spirit/Ultimate can't activate. Also, while braved to a "Jade Contract" family Spirit, this Spirit gains an extra Green symbol.

BS51-X03.name: The SacredHeavenBeast Gayatri-Fox
BS51-X03.kanji: 神聖天獣ガーヤトリー・フォックス
BS51-X03.effect:
[Unleash: 1] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put two cores from the Void each to three "Hindida" family Grandwalker Nexuses you control. Then, by sending a core from any of your Green Grandwalker Nexus to this Spirit, during this turn, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Put one core from the Void each to an "Imp" family Spirit you control and a "Hindida" family Grandwalker Nexus you control.
BS51-X03.flavor: "And here's what was up my sleeve: My dear Gayatri-Fox! Save me!!"

XEN-FU2.name: The SaberTiger Xen-Fu
XEN-FU2.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Exhaust all unexhausted spirits with only 1 core on them except this spirit.

[LV2] (When Attacks) This spirit gets +1000BP for each spirit you control with High Speed until end of turn.
XEN-FU2.flavor: He came out of hibernation only after 30 years. He usually hibernates for 100 years, so he might've sensed the crisis in the woods.

BS58-011-A12014.name: The SacredHellKnight Charvi
BS58-011-A12014.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.
[Rush: White]
(While you have a White symbol, the following effect activates next)
[White Core]: If it is your Main step, you can set a Purple/White card with Mirage effects from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2] [Rebirth3]
When this Spirit attacks, if you have a Purple/White Mirage set, this Spirit can be flipped.
BS58-011-A12014.flavor: Keeping his own consciousness even while being possessed by shadow...did he happen to be a great knight originally?

26RBS03-027.name: The Saboteur Stofir
26RBS03-027.effect:
[LV2] Your Attack Step
When your "Primeval Floodragon" family Spirit is blocked, the opponent targets a refreshed Spirit they control. Exhaust it.
26RBS03-027.flavor: Don't be fooled by his appearance. When it comes to sabotage behind enemy lines, no one can match him.

BS45-X04.name: The SacredMachineBeast Lightning-Ceryneia
BS45-X04.kanji: 神聖機獣ライトニング・ケリュネイアー
BS45-X04.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Machine Beast & Cost 3 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, by paying two cost to summon one "Machine Beast" family Spirit card from your Hand, put a core from the Void to this Spirit, and this Spirit remains on the Field, in the same state.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.
BS45-X04.flavor: The swiftest and toughest of the Lunar Machine Beasts. It gallantly throttled towards Artemis when she was in danger.

SD29-009.name: The Rookie Hirinmaru
SD29-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Nexus. If this Spirit has [Soul Core](Soul Core) on it, also, destroy an opposing 8000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.
SD29-009.flavor: A young War Dragon who took advantage of the troubled times to supplant his lord. He first participated in the Ounin War on the side of the West Army, but in Combat Era year 471, he switched to the East Army.

BS10-078.name: The SacredArmoredBeast Ammead
BS10-078.effect:
[When Braved] (Your Attack Step)
Treat this Spirit as being on its highest Level.
BS10-078.flavor:
Try not to get eaten before Braving...
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS74-003.name: The Rookie Souldragon
BS74-003.kanji: 若武者ソウルドラゴン
BS74-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1. Then, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Rekka Yukimura", and a Cost 4 or more "Souldragon"/"Onimaru" to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can add a "Rekka" family card revealed from the deck by your "Rekka" family effect to the Hand.
BS74-003.flavor:
Combat Era year 6XX. The only child of SengokuDragon who ascended to the heavens was growing strong and healthy.
―from "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12020.name: The SacredSwordDragon Gou-Guren
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12020.kanji: 聖剣刃龍ゴウ・グレン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12020.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can separate a Brave from a Spirit/Grandwalker Nexus you control and brave it to this Spirit. Then, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's. This effect can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Armor].

[Unleash: 2] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By putting two cores from any of your Red Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit, for each Red-only Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +5000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12020.flavor: "The Avatar engraved with my name, Gou-Guren! Let us have a fair fight!"

BSCO-015.name: The SacredBeastDragon Gilzash Ritter Stance
BSCO-015.kanji: 神獣龍ギルザッシュ リッタースタンス
BSCO-015.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 6 ([Blue Core][Blue Core][Green Core][Green Core])]
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the highest cost. After this effect resolves, banish all cards on the opposing Trash. Also, either discard this card, or replace one of your Cost 7 or more Spirit with this card in refreshed condition.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can send every core from your Trash to this Spirit. When you've done so, exhaust every opposing Spirit.

BS30-045.name: The SacredTiger Bengaul
BS30-045.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 3 or higher Green Spirits]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, put two cores from the Void to this Ultimate, and refresh two non-braved Spirits you control. After Ultimate Trigger, if your Life is at three or less, also, proceed to Cross Ultimate Trigger.
[Cross Ultimate Trigger] When Cross Ultimate Trigger hits, exhaust every opposing Spirit and Ultimate.
[xutb]
BS30-045.flavor: Until the forbidden spell is complete, we've got to protect Antarc from the tiger Ultimate!

BS10-027.name: The Rookie Unpyoru
BS10-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, you can separate the Brave from one of your Brave Spirits, and brave it to a Spirit you control.
BS10-027.flavor:
The eyes of a young warrior-in-training views battles as grand festivals. To him, the battlefield is a playground, and the erasing of others' lives becomes the ultimate pastime.
—from the Lynx chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS60-019.name: The SagaciousWhiteSnake Adel-Braska
BS60-019.kanji: 叡智の白蛇アデル・ブラスカ
BS60-019.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can send two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve. Then, for each "The PartnerKnight Bat" you control, including those being in Soul State/pre-advent, you can destroy two opposing originally Cost 3 or less Grandwalker Nexuses.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can discard two cards from your decktop. After this effect resolves, you can pay one cost to summon a Cost 4 or less "Blood Crystal" family Spirit card from your Trash.
BS60-019.flavor: "The Soul Tablets have sealed within them the power of spirits. To release those power...Dan, it seems that only you can do it. Please take care of this world, Dan."

BSC31-CP03.name: The SagaciousWisdom Brain Yuki
BSC31-CP03.effect:
When your Cost 5 or less Green/Yellow Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, you can summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from the opposing decktop. For each Magic card among them, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand. Return the revealed cards to the opposing decktop in any order you like.

BS75-067.name: The Sage's Sanctuary
BS75-067.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. Among them, you can let up to a total of three "Contractor Mitra" and "Awakened Dragon" family cards enter Soul State. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By exhausting this Nexus, return five of your "Awakened Dragon" family cards in Soul State to the deckbottom. When you've done so, reveal five cards from your decktop. You can pay one cost to summon an "Awakened Dragon" family card from among them by paying one cost. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.
BS75-067.flavor:
The sage tree that grows in lands far beyond Uru.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 960―

BS19-054.name: The Sage Pentan
BS19-054.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When you're using a Magic card, by exhausting this Spirit, treat up to three costs as being paid from your Reserve.
BS19-054.flavor: I tried asking the sage about this country's sword, but after hearing what he said, I regret to have asked the wrong person... Speak clearly, I'm confused by your cryptic words.

BSCO-016.name: The SacredBeastDragon Gilzash Wild Stance
BSCO-016.kanji: 神獣龍ギルザッシュ ワイルドスタンス
BSCO-016.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Green/Blue & Cost 7 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents)
Exhaust ten opposing Spirits/Ultimates. Also, when [advents] onto a Spirit with at least the two colors, Green & Blue, during this turn, the opponent can't use Cost 4/6/8 cards from their Hand.

[LV2] (When Attacks)

Since Hermes would stay behind, the residents of what used to be Set's world also wouldn't take part.

What Alex herself wants to do is also unclear. Brahma decided to only set things onto motion once Alex recovers.

A short while after, two worlds connected to Grand Alexa. Set and Isis have arrived.

Set's world should have been put under Poseidon's command, but Poseidon didn't agree with it, so it ended with Hermes temporarily taking over it.

On the world of large deserts and violent oceans, the Beast Headed inhabitats created an oasis where they can take it easy.

The light emitted from the AbsoluteDragonDeity was regarded as a blessing, and thus everyone was looking forward to the summon of the AbsoluteDragonDeity.

―6th in Line to Inherit the Throne, Utai―

It battled with the Gotengo on the Normandy seafloor. It coiled around the New Gotengo with its long body and pressed it to the brink of falling apart, but was frozen by the cooling Maser beam and pulverized by the ramming drill.
―Godzilla FINAL WARS (2004)―

In the skies above
Destroying his enemy
In the purple smoke
Hazy yet still visible
Keep following his shadow

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
You can immediately activate one of your "Ryutia" set Burst.
BS63-043.flavor: "Lady Ryutia, have you found out what to do after meeting with those two persons?"

BS34-023.name: The Sentry Kinka
BS34-023.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Exhaust an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) was used to pay the summon cost, instead, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS34-023.flavor: All so Burning-Souldragon could end the fight with a one-hit finisher, the generals of all provinces that approved of destroying Six Heaven's Rush worked together.

BSC42-031.name: The SeaHorse Kelpie LT
BSC42-031.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When cards are discarded from the opposing deck via your effect, you can refresh all your Spirits with [Crush].
BSC42-031.flavor: Since they first invaded here, we started to see many strangers in the woods. It is said that they are the reinforcement from the neighboring woods.

26RBS02-057.name: The SedutiveDance Waltana
26RBS02-057.effect:
[LV1-2]When Attacks
Target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, give it -2000 BP. Then, if it has 0 BP, destroy it.

[LV2]During Attack
If this is the second or subsequent attack of the turn, this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Spirits without [Soul Core] on it.
26RBS02-057.flavor: It is said that the gods took a particular liking to the way she danced as if in battle. Though those gods themselves do not exist anymore...

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12208.name: The SephirothicSheepDeity Sephiro-Aries
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12208.kanji: 白羊樹神セフィロ・アリエス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12208.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Main Step)
When any player would summon a Spirit card/Brave card without "Imp" family, it is summoned in exhausted state.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, refresh a "Galaxian"/"Astral Soul" family Spirit you control.

[LV3]
Besides via [Tribute], cores can't be removed from Spirits.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12208.flavor:
The one who is enveloped in his aura will have eternal life.
—from the Aries chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

26RBS01-044.name: The SeaMonster Morgawler
26RBS01-044.effect:
Legacy

[LV1-2] When Attacks
If you control any Spirit with [Current], you can target an opposing Spirit. Heavy exhaust it.
26RBS01-044.flavor: Not a loop, but a spiral. A mysterious spiral.

26RBS01-071.name: The SedutiveFury Randarisa
26RBS01-071.effect:
[LV1-2]When Summoned
Target an "Echochant" family Magic card in your Trash. Return it to the Hand.
26RBS01-071.flavor: "Please calm down~ I am not going to eat you, you know?

BS22-049.name: The SeaPrince Eon
BS22-049.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
By showing a Spirit card/Brave card from your Hand to the opponent, destroy an opposing Spirit with the same cost as that card.

[LV2]
Besides [The SeaPrince Eon], the effects of all Cost 6/7 Spirits can't activate.
BS22-049.flavor: "If my elder brother says he will use that power, I will stop him."

BS66-014.name: The SerpentReaper Xolotl
BS66-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can discard a card from your Hand. When you've done so, return either a "Grandwalker Kukulkan", or a Cost 5 or more "Dark Snake" family card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
You can send the [Soul Core] from your Reserve/Trash to the Counter Area. When you've done so, you can put two cores from the Void to your Trash.
BS66-014.flavor: Ahhh! This is totally not interesting! Kai-kun has deceived us! It's true that we're still green as Grandwalkers, but bold of you to have tricked and looked down on us~!

26RBS01-107.name: The Seed-Showering Giant Tree
26RBS01-107.effect:
[LV1-2] Your Attack StepCSOPT
When cards with EX Symbols are discarded by your [Rumble], if your Hand is four or less, you can draw a card.

[LV2] Your End Step
You can target one of your Spirits with [Rumble]. Refresh it.
26RBS01-107.flavor: If anyone passes beneath this tree without wearing a helmet, they must be an outsider.

BS30-033.name: The SeaSacredBeast Leviard
BS30-033.effect:
When this Spirit card is sent to the Trash from your deck by an opposing "Deck Discarding effect", return an opposing Ultimate to the deckbottom. Also, during this turn, cards can't be discarded from your deck.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Cards can't be discarded from either deck.
BS30-033.flavor: A new world for Spirits and Ultimates. We've had our struggles, but let's pray for a beautiful daybreak.

BS66-063.name: The SerpentineCreatorDagger Ce-Acatl
BS66-063.kanji: 創蛇の短剣セーアカトル
BS66-063.effect:
[During Brave] (Your Attack Step)
This Spirit's color is treated as colorless.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Once per battle, when opposing Cost 6 or more Spirits/Ultimates are depleted by this Spirit's effect, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BS66-063.flavor: A dagger brave created by Grandwalker Kukulkan to be used in rituals. Just like the one who created it, it appears to be cute, but its nature is right the opposite. It is also called the dagger of lie.

BS31-055.name: The SengokuAngelia Mushael
BS31-055.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When your "War Princess" family Spirits are destroyed by opposing effects, they can remain on the Field, exhausted.

[LV3] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
By sending the [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from any of your "War Princess" family Spirit to the Trash, during this battle, give an opposing Spirit/Ultimate -5000 BP.
BS31-055.flavor: "Nayuta-sama, we have received more proposals of arranged marriage."

BSC23-CP01.name: The SevenBeautyDiva Momomin
BSC23-CP01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit to Hand. Then, return an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit to Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
If [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, once per turn, refresh this Spirit.
BSC23-CP01.flavor: Nanamin! Tomomo-chan! To think we'd be able to sing together, I'm so happy~!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12218.name: The SevenGreatHeroBeasts Agamemnon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12218.kanji: 七大英雄獣アガメムノン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12218.effect:
When this card in Hand is discarded by an opposing effect, you can pay one cost to summon it. When you've done so, draw three cards.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by comparing BP with your "Blade Beast" family Spirit, send an opposing Life to their Trash.

[LV2]
Besides [Soul Core], neither player can remove cores from their Spirits/Ultimates.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12218.flavor: One of the Seven Great Hero Beasts. Odyssaber develops a strategy and Agamemnon executes it.

SJ15-19.name: The SengokuBeastEmperor Souldragon-Flame
SJ15-19.kanji: 戦国獣皇ソウルドラゴン・焔
SJ15-19.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
If your Life is three or less, summon any number of "Souldragon"-named Spirit cards from your Hand without paying the cost. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, also, destroy up to two opposing 7000 BP or less Spirits.
SJ15-19.flavor: "Members of the proud dragon clan! Assemble by my side!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12220.name: The SevenGreatHeroBeasts Hector
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12220.effect:
While this card is in the Removed Zone, neither player can draw via Red/Purple/Yellow/Blue Spirit/Nexus effects.

Put a core from the Void to your Trash. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
The opposing Burst can't activate.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12220.flavor: The Trojon Seven Great Hero Beasts. Together with Achilleser and Odyssaber, they're loyal to Hermes, but before that they were mutual enemies.

BS74-X11.name: The SengokuDeityDragon Blazing-Souldragon
BS74-X11.kanji: 戦国神龍ブレイジング・ソウルドラゴン
BS74-X11.effect:
[Burst: s] (After an opposing Spirit/Nexus' (When Summoned/Deployed) effect resolves)
Draw two cards, and summon this card without paying the cost. Then, during this turn, when your "Rekka" family Spirits become the target of opposing effects, by discarding a card from your Hand, all those targets are unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
You can target up to two opposing Spirits and attack them at once.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Souldragon" destroys opposing Spirits/Ultimates, refresh that Spirit you control, and during this turn, that target gains an extra Red symbol.
BS74-X11.flavor:
Wrapped in divine flames, Sengoku Dragon ascends to the heavens, illuminating the land.
from "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji

IMAGE-8.name: The SevenGreatHeroBeasts LightSpeedDeityKing Odyssaber
IMAGE-8.kanji: 七大英雄獣 光速神王オデュッセイバー

This card in Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.

[Unleash: 1] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send two opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Removed Zone. Also, by sending a core from any of your Green Grandwalker Nexus to this Spirit, until your next Start Step, cards in the opposing Removed Zone can't be used by the opponent.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each two cards in the opposing Removed Zone, this Spirit gains an extra Green symbol.
IMAGE-8.flavor: "Nobody can stop me! Run wild, Avatar! Odyssaber!"

BS34-X01.name: The SengokuDragonEmperor Burning-Souldragon
BS34-X01.kanji: 戦国龍皇バーニング・ソウルドラゴン

By sending [Soul Core] from this Spirit to your Trash, target up to two opposing Spirits/Ultimates and battle them at once. When you've done so, for each battling opposing target that is depleted/destroyed during this battle, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12224.name: The SevenGreatHeroBeasts Lio-Ajax

Return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
The opposing Burst can't activate.

(Once per Turn: Same Name) Send every core from your Trash to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, send two opposing Lives to the Reserve.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12226.name: The SevenGreatHeroBeasts SupremeKingBeast Theseus

When only the opposing Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by BP comparison, this Spirit refreshes.

[Summon Condition: Your Life is at three or less]

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Send two cores each from every opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void.

BS31-X01.name: The SengokuDragon Souldragon
BS31-X01.kanji: 戦国龍ソウルドラゴン

Destroy all opposing 20000 BP or less Ultimates.

[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] [Consecutive Blade] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core] from this Spirit to your Trash, the opponent must block with two of their Spirits/Ultimates if possible, and simultaneously battle this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
For each opposing Spirit destroyed by comparing BP via [Consecutive Blade], send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

IMAGE-11.name: The SevenGreatHeroBeasts WhirlwindKing Achilleser

This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By heavy exhausting an opposing Spirit, this Spirit refreshes.
[heb]

P15-08.name: The SengokuDragon Souldragon-Ruin
P15-08.kanji: 戦国龍ソウルドラゴン・滅
P15-08.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Consecutive Blade] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, the opponent must block with two Spirits/Ultimates if possible, and they simultaneously battle this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Cores on opposing Spirits/Ultimates destroyed via BP comparison by [Consecutive Blade] are sent to the Void.

SJ17-03.name: The SengokuDragon Souldragon-Twinkle
SJ17-03.kanji: 戦国龍ソウルドラゴン・煌
SJ17-03.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Red & Cost 6 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to this Spirit. When [advented] onto a "War Dragon" family Spirit you control, also, destroy every opposing 20000 BP or less Ultimate.

You can target up to two opposing Spirits and simultaneously battle.

P15-13.name: The SengokuDragon Souldragon-Victory
P15-13.kanji: 戦国龍ソウルドラゴン・勝
P15-13.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] [Consecutive Blade] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, the opponent must block with two of their Spirits/Ultimates if possible, and simultaneously battle this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +3000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.

BS34-X06.name: The SevenSeasDaimyo Shironagasu

[Burst: s] (After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the opponent)
Destroy all Spirits without "Lord"/"Beast Head" family. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

If your Life is three or less, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's, and during this turn, for every symbol on the opposing Spirit/Ultimate destroyed by this effect, this Spirit gains an extra Blue symbol.
BS34-X06.flavor: "Compared to the raging waves of the sea during a storm, a thousand troops are easy to overcome."

BS08-X30.name: The SevenShogun Asmodios
BS08-X30.kanji: 魔界七将アスモディオス
BS08-X30.effect:

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Send two cores from any opposing Spirits to the Void.

BS09-X36.kanji: 魔界七将ベルドゴール
BS09-X36.effect:
[Immortality: Cost 4/5] (Either Attack Step)
This Spirit card in your Trash can be summoned when your Cost 4/5 Spirit is destroyed.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Cost 4 or less Spirit.

BS73-TX01.name: The SengokuDragon Souldragon X
BS73-TX01.kanji: 戦国龍ソウルドラゴンX
BS73-TX01.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Rekka Yukimura" & C5 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Manifests)
Return a Soul Burst card from your Trash to the Hand, or set it. Then, you can immediately activate one of your set Soul Bursts. After this effect resolves, you can compare the BP of this Spirit with up to two opposing Spirits. Destroy all targets with the same or lower BP.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] [Rebirth4m]
At the start of your Attack Step, or when opposing Spirits/Ultimates are destroyed by this Spirit, you can flip this Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12238.name: The SevenShogun Beliot
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12238.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon a "SevenShogun"-named Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
Send a core from the opposing Field to their Trash.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Activate one (When Destroyed) effect of a Spirit you control without destroying that Spirit.

PX15-01.name: The SengokuEmperor Alexander

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Assault: 4] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to four times per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Nexus with Soul Core on it is exhausted by your Spirit's [Assault], unless the opponent sends three cores from their Reserve to their Trash, they can't block.
PX15-01.flavor:
Swaying about up
On the waves of the blue sea
While gazing upon
The countries and thinking deep
The coming day is afloat

26RBS03-X06.name: The SevenShogun Desperado (26RBS03-X06)
26RBS03-X06.kanji: 魔界七将デスペラード

Legacy
[LV1-2]When Summoned

[LV2]True ReleaseWhen Attacks
Target an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit. Send cores from it to the Reserve until one core, besides [Soul Core], remains.

What the purple blade summoned was the primordial demon. An evil spirit, accompanied by a plague, had manifested in this world.
―from the Foreigners' Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

BSC20-X01.name: The SengokuGoldDragon Ragou
BSC20-X01.effect:

You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When another Spirit you control is depleted via [Awaken], you can summon a Spirit card with [Awaken] from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.
BSC20-X01.flavor: "Pride will cloud your sight, so focus your mind."

BS64-XV02.name: The SevenShogun Destlord XV
BS64-XV02.kanji: 魔界七将デストロードXV
BS64-XV02.effect:
Including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition, while you control any "The PartnerMusha Oboro", when summoning this card from the Hand, if you or the opponent controls any LV2 Spirits, fulfill all its reduction symbols.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
Your counter +1. Then, (Once per Turn: Same Name) you can destroy any number of LV2 Spirits you or the opponent controls, and for each Spirit destroyed, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

When your Spirits are destroyed via an effect, during this turn, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

BS32-X01.name: The SengokuHero Gyuumonji
BS32-X01.kanji: 戦国覇王ギュウモンジ
BS32-X01.effect:

Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 20000 BP. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

Destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit. Also, if [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, when any Spirit is destroyed by this effect, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

BS04-X14.name: The SevenShogun Pandemium
BS04-X14.kanji: 魔界七将パンデミウム
BS04-X14.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When any opposing Spirit is destroyed, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your Spirit is destroyed by opposing Spirits via BP comparison, exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[LV3] (When Destroyed)
Both players discard five cards from the Hand.

BSC23-045.name: The Sengoku Fest Main Stage
BSC23-045.kanji: 戦国フェス メインステージ

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
When your "Private Wear" family Spirit is summoned, return a "Stage Style" family Spirit card with the same team as the summoned Spirit from your Trash to the Hand.
BSC23-045.flavor: It was The SengokuPrincess Makina's idea to open the Sengoku Fest. A feast of divas crossing over space and time to gather unfolds here.

BS41-075.name: The SevenShogun Resting Mausoleum
BS41-075.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
Discard three cards from your decktop. Then, return a Spirit card with [Advent] from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When you [advents], send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve.
BS41-075.flavor:
A mausoleum where the first of the SevenShoguns to die was put to rest. However, persistent rumors claim that it is empty inside and he has already come back to life. It seems nobody has the courage to peek inside for themselves.
-from the Places of Interest 501/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BSC23-044.name: The Sengoku Trophy
BSC23-044.effect:
[During Brave] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP. Also, while braved to a "Diva" family Spirit, return an opposing Nexus to the deckbottom.
BSC23-044.flavor: The Flower Monarch gives the trophy of honor to the team that pumped the audience up the most at the Sengoku Fest.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12248.name: The SevenSisters Maia
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12248.kanji: セブンシスターズ マイア
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12248.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Give all your "Machine Beast"/"Blade Beast" family Spirits: "[Heavy Armor: Red/Purple] This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects."

[LV2][LV3] (When Blocks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP. Also, once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12248.flavor: The eldest Pleiades sister. They get rid of any who approach Artemis, but it seems Hermes is allowed.

BS16-069.name: The Seven Bridge
BS16-069.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Draw Step)
At the start of the step, by discarding a Yellow Spirit card from your Hand, increase the number of cards your draw by +1.

[LV2]
When your "Magician" family Spirits are destroyed, you can return one of those destroyed Spirits to your decktop.
BS16-069.flavor:
The architects of the Kingdom of Cards made this bridge inspired by the Kingdom of Rainbows. It might not compare to a real rainbow bridge, but it's superior in terms of being cute.
-from the Places of Interest 271/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12251.name: The Seventh's AccelDragon Turbulence
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12251.kanji: 庚の加速龍タービュランス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12251.effect:
Main - [Accel: Cost 4([Red Core][Red Core])]
Draw two cards. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can summon any number of Spirit cards with [Accel] from your Removed Zone , without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12251.flavor: As we approach the middle half, Revol-Tiger of "Speed Tiger" is going down in the rankings. That previous incident must have been a cause for worry.

BS19-096.name: The Sea Monster Infested Ocean
BS19-096.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit with [Rush] attacks, treat that Spirit as being one level higher.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
The opponent can't activate Red/Green/White Bursts.
BS19-096.flavor: Just like the changes that occurred in other countries, this sea too has been greatly affected. The raging areas of the ocean and their masters have become much stronger after the fluctuations.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12253.name: The Seventh's CrystalDragon Amethyst-Dragon-Sonic
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12253.kanji: 庚の水晶龍アメジスト・ドラゴン・ソニック
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12253.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw two cards. Then, you can summon a Brave card from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost. When an Imagine Brave was summoned by this effect, send all cores from an opposing Ultimate to the Reserve.

[During Brave] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirit you control, send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12253.flavor: "I WANT TO... RACE WITH ALL WE'VE GOT....SEBURN, IT'S A MATCH"

BS68-074.name: The Sea Serpent Eye's Odachi
BS68-074.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Turn)
While your Hand is three or less, you can discard -1 card via your "Petit Shack"'s effect, including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Petit Shack", you can discard a card from the opposing decktop. If a card with a cost higher than the attacking target's is discarded via this effect, during this battle, your Life can't be reduced.
BS68-074.flavor:
The eyes of the sea serpent can see through the opponent's weakness.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 827―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12255.name: The Sea of Trees in Dark Green
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12255.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (During Your Battle Phase) Each time a spirit you control with no printed effects defeats a spirit, gain 1 core on this nexus.

[LV2] (During Your Battle Phase) Each time a spirit you control with no printed effects is defeated, it is moved to your hand instead of your Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12255.flavor:
This place is located in the deepest part of the forest and The Elders gather here to hold meetings. While they are in a meeting, no one except animals are allowed to step in. This sacred place is covered with beautiful moss that looks like a huge green carpet.
-from the Places of Interest 58/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS38-037.name: The Seventh's GoldMonkey Kandamadan
BS38-037.kanji: 庚の金猿カンダマダン
BS38-037.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Blue.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When summoning [The MonkeyTwelveGodKing Hanumerlin] from your Hand, for each card in your Removed Zone, its cost gets -1.
BS38-037.flavor: Racer Hanumerlin, along with racer Gale-Phoenix, head to Lord Burning-Souldragon's rescue!

BS34-054.name: The SeadragonMusha Ikkaku
BS34-054.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Look at the contents of an opposing Burst, and if it is a Spirit card/Magic card, discard that Burst.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
You can activate the Burst effect of the Burst discarded via this Spirit's effect as your own effect. However, that card can't move from the Trash.
BS34-054.flavor: The one leading the Azure Fang Squad during this war was the Beast Head warrior, Shironagasu.

BS41-031.name: The SealKingBeast Leopawn
BS41-031.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Blade Beast/Fusion Beast] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending [Soul Core] to your Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] 1 (When Advents)
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
[heb]

[During Advent] [LV2][LV3]
Besides [Soul Core], cores can't be removed from Spirits.
BS41-031.flavor: When about to be done in, the situation is mediated through Advent!

P13-17.name: The Sealed Divine Sword
P13-17.effect:
[When Braved] (When Attacks)
Draw a card, and destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit.
P13-17.flavor: The Sealed Sword of Judgement is waiting for a new wielder to appear.

BS63-075.name: The Sealed Ela-Zaguir
BS63-075.kanji: 封じられしエラ・ザギール
BS63-075.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
For every three counters you have, you can summon one Cost 7/8/9 “Azure Wave” family Spirit card from your Hand without paying the cost, up to as many as you like. When you summoned via this effect, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When this Spirit and your originally Cost 7/8/9 Spirits are destroyed by opposing effects, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BS63-075.flavor:
An undersea prison huh...Such a fitting name! All the other sealed beings gathered here are unimaginably dangerous monsters. Come on, The-Hanged-Man, I would break your seal!
―The PartnerShark Shack―

BS70-076.name: The Sealed Lands: Flower Field
BS70-076.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When this Nexus would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can return it to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2]
When you're summoning/deploying a "Primordial" family Spirit card/Nexus card, fulfill one of its [Red Core]/[Yellow Core] reduction symbols.

[LV2] (Your Turn)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Primordial" family Spirit/Nexus is destroyed, if your Life is at three or less, you can send a core, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to your Life.
BS70-076.flavor:
The flower fields from the gods' age are still so beautiful.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 963―

BS69-072.name: The Sealed Lands: Forest
BS69-072.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed/Destroyed)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. If you have eight counters or more, this "exhaustion effect" exhausts +1 Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV1][LV2]
When you're summoning/deploying a "Primordial" family Spirit card/Nexus card, fulfill one of its [Red Core]/[Green Core]/[Yellow Core] reduction symbols.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your Cost 5 or more "Primordial" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.
BS69-072.flavor:
Forests in the gods' age are the fruits of life.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 963―

BS70-074.name: The Sealed Lands: Iceberg
BS70-074.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed/Destroyed)
Return an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand. If you have eight counters or more, return it to the deckbottom instead of Hand.

[LV1][LV2]
When you're summoning/deploying a "Primordial" family Spirit card/Nexus card, fulfill one of its [Red Core]/[White Core]/[Yellow Core] reduction symbols.

[LV2]
While you control any "Primordial" family Grandwalker Nexus, if your Hand is five or less, your Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.
BS70-074.flavor:
They have remained in the same form ever since the gods' age without melting.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 964―

BS69-078.name: The Sealed Lands: Ocean
BS69-078.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When you're summoning/deploying a "Primordial" family Spirit card/Nexus card, fulfill one of its [Red Core]/[Yellow Core]/[Blue Core] reduction symbols.

[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest cost.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit/Ultimate would attack, unless the opponent sends a core from their Reserve to their Trash, it can't attack.
BS69-078.flavor:
The oceans in the gods' age were the sources of life.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 696―

BS70-071.name: The Sealed Lands: Swamp
BS70-071.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed/Destroyed)
Once per turn, by discarding a "Primordial" family card from your Hand, draw two cards.

[LV1][LV2]
When you're summoning/deploying a "Primordial" family Spirit card/Nexus card, fulfill one of its [Red Core]/[Purple Core]/[Yellow Core] reduction symbols.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Primordial" family Spirit attacks, send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve.
BS70-071.flavor:
It is said that they are bottomless since the god's age.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 962―

BS69-068.name: The Sealed Lands: Volcano
BS69-068.effect:
[LV1] (When Deployed/Destroyed)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, besides "The Sealed Lands: Volcano", add a "Primordial" family card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom. If you have six counters or more, this effect can reveal +1 card.

[LV1]
When you're summoning/deploying a "Primordial" family Spirit card/Nexus card, fulfill one of its [Red Core]/[Yellow Core] reduction symbols.
BS69-068.flavor:
The lands of the gods' age which were sealed away together with the primordial deities had come back to life. Volcanoes are the bloodstreams that flow through the lands.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 961―

BS24-094.name: The Sealed Spellbook Library
BS24-094.kanji: 封印されし魔導書図書館
BS24-094.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Cards can't be discarded from either player's decks, and either player's Spirits can't be refreshed via effects.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your draw cards via your Magic effects, by exhausting this Nexus, double the number of cards you draw. This effect doesn't stack.
BS24-094.flavor: With all the info and data sorted out, there's something on my mind. Do the Ultimates have a connection to our past... or rather, our ancient history? Let's check the oldest history books.

BS63-077.name: The Sealed Zeira
BS63-077.effect:
Besides via an effect, this card in Hand can't be summoned.

When this card is discarded from the Hand by your “Azure Wave” family effect, you can summon it, treating all reduction symbols as fulfilled.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit can't brave/[Advent].

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your Cost 8 or more “Azure Wave” family Spirits are attacking, opposing Spirits with printed effects can't block.
BS63-077.flavor:
Raon admitted his defeat, and passed on the ownership of The-Hanged Man to Shack. Raon's attitude was so dignified that Shack acknowledged him.
―Record of Sealing Sea 4―

BS39-039.name: The Seventh's MonkeyKing Valin
BS39-039.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
Return a Spirit card from your Removed Zone to the Hand. When a Yellow Spirit card is returned by this effect, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up on your Removed Zone.

[During Seal] [LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
After your [Accel] effect resolves, during this turn, this Spirit gains an extra Yellow symbol.
BS39-039.flavor: Racer Hanumerlin is already guaranteed a TwelveGodKing spot points-wise. It seems "Lunar Racing" is heading to deal with the EvilGod forthwith.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12270.name: The Seventh's MonkeyPrince Angada
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12270.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When your "Monkey"-named Spirits are destroyed by opposing effects, they can remain on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
After your [Accel] effect resolves, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -5000 BP. Destroy the Spirit who was brought to 0 BP by this effect.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12270.flavor: Running as if to be close to his "Lunar Racing" team members, Racer Hanumerlin races at the back of the leading group at the beginning of the race.

BS35-007.name: The SeventhBeastDragon Draleon
BS35-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy two opposing 5000 BP or less Spirits. When this effect destroys any Spirit, you can summon a Brave card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Give all your Brave Spirits +5000 BP.
BS35-007.flavor: Racer Execeed lost to Racer Gale-Phoenix by one beak's length. Maan, was that a climactic God-King vs God-King battle!

P16-08.name: The SeventhBeastEmperor Victory Griffin
P16-08.kanji: 庚獣皇ビクトリーグリフィン
P16-08.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy every opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. For each Spirit destroyed by this effect, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[During Seal] [LV2]
This Spirit gains an extra Green symbol.
P16-08.flavor: Felarl Racing and Fordelia Wings... Unite the power of the two teams and seize victory!

BS37-010.name: The SeventhBeast Golden-Accel-Tiger
BS37-010.kanji: 庚獣ゴールデン・アクセル・タイガー
BS37-010.effect:
Flash- [Accel: Cost 4 ([Red Core][Red Core][White Core])]
You can destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. When you've done so, refresh a "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirit you control. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[When Braved] [LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
By destroying an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit, once per turn, refresh this Spirit.
BS37-010.flavor: Since "Ferarl Racing"'s home is Italicia, their numerous fans have flocked to this event.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12274.name: The SeventhBeast Highleon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12274.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +4000 BP. By sending the [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from your Life to any of your "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirits, also, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12274.flavor: Horse and Dragon, two gaping holes are opened among the Twelve God-King seats. And Racer Exeseburn isn't the only one aiming for the position.

BSC25-X01.name: The SeventhFlameEmperor Blazel
BSC25-X01.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon an "Imagine" family Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 8000 BP.
BSC25-X01.flavor: The blue flash of Scuderia Criniera, master of an Imajin!

BS36-CP01.name: The SeventhSkyBeast Radiant-Pegas
BS36-CP01.kanji: 庚天獣レディアント・ペガス
BS36-CP01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Brave card and a "God-King" family Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit. When blocked by an opposing Spirit with 10000 BP or less, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BS36-CP01.flavor: Not only did the current God-Kings protect everyone from the FiveGoodDragonEmperors' intrusion, five of them also ranked. Once again, they've proven just how strong they are.

BS10-082.name: The Sextant Observatory
BS10-082.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your End Step)
Return a Spirit card with no printed effects from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2]
When your "Evil Shadow" family Spirit is summoned, send cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve until one core remains on it.
BS10-082.flavor:
This apparatus measures everything with pinpoint accuracy. The distance to the stars, the hairs on a rat... Some even say it can determine the length of your lifespan.
—from the Sextans chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12278.name: The Sextant Ruri-Author
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12278.kanji: 六分儀剣のルリ・オーサ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12278.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core each from the Void to two Red Spirits you control.

[LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Red.

[LV2]
Your Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12278.flavor: The astral spirits suddenly appeared before us....Could it be that they don't live here, or anywhere else around here?

26RBS02-006.name: The Shackler Chainel
26RBS02-006.effect:
[LV1-2]When Destroyed
Target an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit. Destroy it. If this Spirit is being blocked, target two instead.

[LV2] [Clash] During Attack
Opposing Spirits must block if possible.
26RBS02-006.flavor: That chain of flame is not merely a restraint. It can also become a fearsome weapon.

BS52-015-A12280.name: The ShadowKnight Durazal
BS52-015-A12280.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] [Rebirth3]
When any opposing Spirit is depleted/destroyed, you can flip this Spirit.
BS52-015-A12280.flavor:
Her name is Alex, and it seems the nobles are searching for her because they want her blood.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 1:18―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12281.name: The ShadowSwordsman Blackpard
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12281.kanji: 影の剣使いブラックパルド
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12281.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Cards can't be discarded from either deck.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks) At the end of battle, return a Brave card from the Trash to your Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12281.flavor: Having challenged the SwordsSaints numerous times in the past yet losing as many times. Even so, he still aims at defeating the SwordsSaints.

BS67-064.name: The ShadowyBlade Shadow Dagger
BS67-064.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can discard a card from your decktop. If that's a card with "Curse"-named effects, during this turn, the level costs of every opposing Nexus increase by +2.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, you can target and attack an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate.
BS67-064.flavor: A dagger carried by the knights. It can pin the opponent's shadow on the ground, and seal their movements.

SHAMAN-RIO.name: The Shaman Rio
SHAMAN-RIO.flavor:
A one-man assault on the enemy base carried out teleportation. The revolutionary tactic named "Slay God" after its inventor, the "God-Slayer Hero", in the later ages, was first used here. As a sort of fun fact, since it was a bit too effective, it had been so frequently used that teleportation has today become a forbidden art.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 647—

BS06-007.name: The ShamshirDinosaur Parasaur
BS06-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Reveal a card from your decktop. If that card is a "Terra Dragon" family Spirit card, add it to the Hand. If not, return it to the decktop.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
For each "Terra Dragon" family Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
BS06-007.flavor:
I heard him roar for help. Five minutes later, I saw him engulfed by the Empty Sky
-from the 10th paragraph in chapter Red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS24-057.name: The SharkDrake Sharkhydra
BS24-057.kanji: 鮫首竜シャークハイドラ
BS24-057.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When any Cost 8 or more Spirit is destroyed, refresh this Spirit.
BS24-057.flavor:
Why do you fight by dragging in your allies while you battle!
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, 702 days remaining—

SD69-005.name: The Six-Sword Wheel Treasure
SD69-005.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Nexus, and draw a card.

[During Nexus Brave] [Contract Field]
This Nexus is unaffected by opposing Spirit effects. Also, while you have four counters or more, this Nexus is unaffected by opposing Magic effects.

BS32-XX02.name: The SixAbsoluteDeities Affection-El-Rafil
BS32-XX02.kanji: 六絶神 慈愛のエル・ラフィル
BS32-XX02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
While there are only Yellow symbols on your Field, you do not lose the game even if your Life becomes zero.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Start Step)
When your Life is zero, send six cards from your decktop to the Trash. This effect doesn't stack.

[LV3] (Either Attack Step)
If you control ten or more Yellow symbols, the BP of every opposing Spirit/Ultimate becomes 0.
BS32-XX02.flavor: Though hardship and suffering may come, the gleam of life shall not be lost.

BS61-XX01.name: The SixAbsoluteDeities Axanarl-of-Causation
BS61-XX01.kanji: 六絶神 因果のアザナール
BS61-XX01.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Blood Crystal & C4 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Send three cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve. Or, once per turn, draw two cards.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When opposing Spirits/Ultimates are depleted/destroyed, send an opposing Life to the Void.
BS61-XX01.flavor: A deity of the new world, Lecoulis —— Causation is encompassed in this world.

BS33-018.name: The Shikigami Kobushi
BS33-018.effect:
This Spirit card in Trash is treated as Cost 3.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) If you have Soul Core in your Trash, the opponent must a Spirit they control.
BS33-018.flavor: The Six Heaven Army hid their numbers and lured the opposition with the illusion of a fair fight. In reality, Mudou's forces hid in the shadow of Senryuukaku's army, almost too colossal to be called an ambush.

BS33-XX01.name: The SixAbsoluteDeities Burly-Drag-Magna
BS33-XX01.kanji: 六絶神 剛力のドラグ・マグナ
BS33-XX01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Red Spirit attacks, during this turn, give this Spirit +10000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, give one of your Red Spirits +10000 BP.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
The symbols of all your 30000 or more BP Spirits become [Red Core][Red Core][Red Core](3 Red symbols).
BS33-XX01.flavor: Power, that is to say, truth.

BS32-013.name: The Shikigami Shuukai
BS32-013.effect:
This Spirit card in the Trash is treated as Cost 2.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit with two cores or less on it. While there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Spirit, also, draw a card.
BS32-013.flavor: "The fort can be rebuilt. The troops can revive with soul magic. This is the Master's callous yet logical plan."

BS63-XX02.name: The SixAbsoluteDeities Celestia-of-Hope
BS63-XX02.kanji: 六絶神 希望のセレスティア
BS63-XX02.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Golden Cloud & C4 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Advents)

When your Life would be reduced, by banishing four cards from your decktop, your Life won't be brought to zero.

BS61-XX02.name: The SixAbsoluteDeities Garnable-of-Universe

BS61-XX02.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Jade Thunder & C4 or more, (Either Attack Step)]

BS13-X01.name: The ShineCentaurusDeity Sagitto-Apollodragon
BS13-X01.kanji: 光龍騎神サジット・アポロドラゴン

[LV1][LV2][LV3]

[During Brave] [LV3] (When Attacks)
For each Brave on this Spirit, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.

His power has increased thousands-fold; this lets him forget having ever feared those who stood against him.
—from the Sagittarius chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS31-XX01.name: The SixAbsoluteDeities Greedy-Death-Gal-Vados
BS31-XX01.kanji: 六絶神 欲望のデス・ガル・ヴァドス

The ninth brilliance is an archer of light and flame who races across the night sky.
―"Secret Tales of the Eighty-Eight Constellations"―

[LV3]

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12303.name: The ShineDragonPalace Breidhablic
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12303.kanji: 輝竜殿ブレイザブリク

BS13-050.name: The ShineDragon Shine-Blazer

The legendary celestial halberd that appeared in the Birthplace of the Sword was taken by a Brave radiating with light.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

The legendary celestial halberd that appeared in the Birthplace of the Sword was taken by a Brave radiating with light.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS62-XX01.name: The SixAbsoluteDeities Verndict-of-Valiance

SD10-X01.name: The ShineDragon Shining-Dragon

BS26-062.name: The ShipAstralArmored BraveArgo
BS26-062.kanji: 船星鎧ブレイヴアルゴー

They were sure Ares was made into Susanoo's prisoner. So why is he on this battlefield now, fighting Vishnu?
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 3:20―

A new world...! I am actually getting quite excited about this.
―Grandwalker Saraswati―

BS26-065.name: The Shine of Supernova

BS26-065.flavor:
We've witnessed a celestial event on the Reverse Continent. No, wait... that might have been the moment of the birth of an Ultimate. Will conduct an extended investigation!
—Red Plains Site No. 276 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

BS55-021-A12319.name: The ShatteringDragonKnightChief Volstin
BS55-021-A12319.kanji: 地雷の竜騎士長ヴォルスティン

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. Then, discard a card from your Hand. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, also, destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12322.name: The SheepTwelveGodKing Glorious-Sheep

The Shining Emperor, the Sun Dragon's trusted friend, has been appointed the new commander for the upcoming Great Wall of the Shield invasion. Once he arrives at his post, the destruction of the Great Wall is pretty much assured.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS29-014.effect:

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

A shrine that has worshiped the Horse Twelve God-King for generations. It's said it dates back all the way to the first BSGP, and the staff of "Ferarl Racing" visit it every year.
―from the Ferarl Racing feature by Monthly BSGP―

BSC45-070.kanji: 光輝の勇者皇リュートLT

Although the history has been changed, the supreme deity, Amaterasu, continued to exist. Chronos then proceeded to send the enemies of "Amahara" from the past to the future there.

Ratel's company, hired by the Six Heaven Army for assassination, was instead persuaded by Yaibanokami and became his subordinates.

Amid the battle against the new enemies, two unfamiliar spirits appeared in the thin air. Who would have thought that they would be fighting alongside the two spirits in the days to come?

BS54-008.name: The SiegeTrooper Dragno

The world revives?! As if nothing has ever happened, there are even Spirits existing on the restored area that has returned to its original state. Scattered gem, Imagine....the key is there.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 3:18―

Chronos' history alteration has reached even Amahara's place. The intertwining past and future, the visitors from the future that no one probably would remember now...Let's record it down here, the scenes in history that vanished in the thin air like a bubble.
