[LV1] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[When Braved] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.
BS10-064.flavor:
Just as I thought, the Braves play a major role in the flow of battle.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS56-006.name: The SnakeDragon King-Gorgo X
BS56-006.kanji: 蛇竜キング・ゴルゴーX
BS56-006.effect:
While you control any exactly-named "The Phantom Star Creation Place", this card in Hand is Cost 3.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit is destroyed by opposing effects, if you have fewer lives than the opponent, you can return this Spirit to the Hand.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
For each Rebirth Spirit you control, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.
BS56-006.flavor:
With the power of The-Star, the Mirage of the Mecha-Dragons was thoroughly activated. In a moment, they have regained their momentum.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5:38―

BSC48-029.name: The SoulMusha Ryuga LT
BSC48-029.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Draw a card. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Soul Burst card, and a "Catalyst" family card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

BSC49-056.name: The SkullTank Geparberd LT
BSC49-056.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can draw a card.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.
BSC49-056.flavor:
Just as I thought, the Braves play a major role in the flow of battle.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS35-006.name: The SoulRider Seiga
BS35-006.flavor: Racer Seiga came all the way from overseas. His dream is to return home triumphantly, or something. As Japang would also be holding a part of this tournament, I hope he can do his best.

SD48-001.name: The SmallAncientDragon Scharla-Chrot
SD48-001.kanji: 小古龍シャルラ・ハロート
SD48-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks) Draw a card.

[LV2] Your Spirits/Grandwalker Nexuses braved to Saga Braves gain +3000 BP.
SD48-001.flavor:
Egyt's invasion of Grand-Lolo was stopped by the Olym and Uru coalition army. The worlds damaged by the battles were slowly being restored through the power of the Grandwalkers. Egytian worlds which lost their masters also went Zeus' protection, and shall now enjoy post-war peace. That was when a new Grandwalker visited Alex.
―"The Genesis Records" New Volume One Prologue 01

BS29-X08.name: The SnakeEmperorAstralArmored BravePiooze
BS29-X08.kanji: 蛇帝星鎧ブレイヴピオーズ
BS29-X08.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Send any amount of your Life to your Trash. For each core sent to the Trash by this effect, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

[During Brave] (Your Attack Step)
When opposing Spirits are depleted/destroyed by your effects, for each Spirit depleted/destroyed, the opponent discard a card from their Hand.
BS29-X08.flavor: It was you. You're the root of all this!

CP14-X03.name: The SmallFireDragon Hinoko
CP14-X03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Add an Ultimate card among them to your Hand. Return the remaining cards to the bottom of your deck in any order you like.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Spirit Soul: Red - When you summon an Ultimate, this Spirit gets 1 extra Red Symbol.
CP14-X03.flavor: If you're helping out the Ultimates, I bet you're a curse-sealed guy too! I, the great Ozzania, won't forgive you!

BS54-X03.name: The SnakeEmperorDragon Garmeshard
BS54-X03.kanji: 蛇皇龍ガルメジャード
BS54-X03.effect:
By discarding this card from your Hand during your Start Step, during this turn, when you draw via a Purple-only "Primal" family Spirit effect, only for once, you can draw +2 cards.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked, and can't be exhausted by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] 4 (When Attacks)
By -4 counters (send four cores from your Counter Area to the Void), send up to eight cores from the opposing Field/Reserve/Trash to the Void. [Count Break] can only be used once per game.
BS54-X03.flavor: The gigantic snake dragon who is said to be wandering about the space outside the six separated worlds.

BS26-057.name: The SkyAstralArmored Eaglet
BS26-057.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. That Spirit can't be refreshed until the start of the next (Opposing Attack Step).

[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
You can change the target of this Spirit's "Opponent-targeting Exhaustion effects" from Spirits to Ultimates.
BS26-057.flavor: For real, Laten!? When did you get to brave!? How is it, can you beat an Ultimate with that?

BS35-002.name: The SoulSaber Rindou
BS35-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
While there's Soul Core on your "War Dragon" family Spirits, this Spirit gains +5000 BP.
BS35-002.flavor: The pole position on the opening battle is racer King Cheetah. Thanks to a combination of terrain and climate, he ran as well as the audience predicted.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12515.name: The SmallPrincess Ant-Princesse
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12515.kanji: 小姫アント・プランセス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12515.effect:
Flash - ⚞Advent⚟: Shellman (Either Attack Step)
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your hand onto your target spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents) Put two cores from the Void to this Spirit. Also, you can pay one cost to summon an "Ant"-named pre-advent card under this Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12515.flavor: The treasured princess of the Ant Clan. Destined to become the queen, she was buttered up ever since she was a child. Because of that, she grew into admiring butterflies, and exacerbates a desire to see the blue sky, her feelings lie with the aboveground.

BS47-089.name: The SkyBirdArmor Falcom
BS47-089.kanji: 天空鳥鎧ファルコーム
BS47-089.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to any "Egyt" family Grandwalker Nexus you control.

[During Brave]
Treat this Brave's cost as 0.

[During Brave] Flash - (When Attacks)
Once per turn, you can return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the Hand.
BS47-089.flavor: A Sky Brave Thoth made for Horus' sake.

BS27-037.name: The SmallSaint Romeda
BS27-037.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By discarding one Magic card from your Hand, draw two cards.

[LV3] (Either Attack Step)
Give all Magic cards without [Trigger Counter] in your Hand: "[Trigger Counter] When the opponent's Ultimate Trigger hits, if this card is in the Hand, you can use the following effect before the "When Hits" effect activates. █ If the hit card is a Yellow card, treat the hit as a Guard."
BS27-037.flavor: I can't believe there are cute girls like this among the astral spirits...

BS68-009.name: The SmallSwordMaster Gadged
BS68-009.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Blade Contract" family Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate, and when destroys, draw a card. For each counter you have, increase the limit of this "BP Destruction effect" by +1000.
BS68-009.flavor: "I'll show you why you can't judge one's sword skills by one's look!"

BS06-021.name: The SnakeEmpress Medousa
BS06-021.flavor: The Snakes have stopped being a mere spectator. We can see how serious the situation is.

BS34-049.name: The SmallWave Douji
BS34-049.flavor:
Azure Fang Squad has, obviously, allied with the campaign that's opposite to Gandala's. This is the my enemy's enemy is my ally thing, isn't it?
―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12521.name: The SkyBird Armingo
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12521.effect:
When this card is revealed by the [Grand Skill] of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Horus," you can pay one cost to summon it.

[LV1][LV2]
When your "Winged Beast" family Spirits/Ultimates are depleted/destroyed due to opposing effects, you can put one core from any of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Horus" to each of those Spirits/Ultimates. Spirits that had cores put on them by this effect remain on the Field in the same state.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12521.flavor:
Olym's frontlines are crumbling. One would think this battle would end just like the previous one.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 4:13―

BSC48-022.name: The SmallWave Douji LT
BSC48-022.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When the "Opposing Deck Discarding effect" of your "WisdomKing"/"Douji" activates, you can set this card from your Trash. When you do, return your originally set Mirage to the Hand.

[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Blue Core])]
[During Set]
Including being in Soul State, while you control any "Gunjou Souun", if your Hand is five or less, your Hand and your set Soul Bursts are unaffected by opposing effects.
BSC48-022.flavor:
Azure Fang Squad has, obviously, allied with the campaign that's opposite to Gandala's. This is the my enemy's enemy is my ally thing, isn't it?
―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―

BS13-X02.name: The SnakeMasterDeity Asklepiooze
BS13-X02.kanji: 蛇皇神帝アスクレピオーズ
BS13-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
By destroying an "Astral Soul" family Spirit you control, draw three cards.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Galaxian"/"Dark Snake" family Spirits are destroyed by comparing BP, they remain on the Field, refreshed.

[LV3] (When Blocks)
Besides [Soul Core], send every core from the opposing Spirit that this Spirit blocks to the Void.
BS13-X02.flavor:
The inquisitive mind strays from ethics and yields to the ways of the wicked deity.
—from the Ophiuchus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

P25-06.name: The SnakeMasterDeity Asklepiooze XV
P25-06.kanji: 蛇皇神帝アスクレピオーズXV
P25-06.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Astral Soul"/ "Galaxian"/ "Dark Snake" family Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, by paying one cost to summon this card from the Trash, all those targets remain on the Field, refreshed.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By destroying an "Astral Soul" family Spirit you or the opponent controls, draw three cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
When the battle resolves, besides [Soul Core], send every core on the opposing battling Spirit to the Void.
P25-06.flavor:
The hidden Thirteenth Radiance is a solitary, lofty evil deity of the darkest shadows.
―"Secret Tales of the Eighty-Eight Constellations"―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12525.name: The SkyBird Nilebird
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12525.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. Add every exactly-named "Grandwalker Horus" among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit is depleted/destroyed by opposing effects, by putting a core from the Void to this Spirit, it remains on the Field, exhausted.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12525.flavor: The Nilebird has a symbiotic relationship with Pestuchos. At times, it will go inside its mouth and clean its teeth.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12526.name: The SkyBravePrincess Nefals
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12526.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at two or more]

When this card is revealed from the deck, you can use its [Accel].

Flash - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Green Core][Green Core][Core])]
Return an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone. Or, instead of putting it onto the Removed Zone, summon it by paying one cost.

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned)
Put two cores from the Void to this Ultimate.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12526.flavor:
Antarc introduced Horus to Athena. Giving him to her, who is the most reasonable among them, was a good decision.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 4 Prologue 11―

SD34-003.name: The SnakeMonk Harim
SD34-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[LV1][LV2] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
SD34-003.flavor:
The world beyond "i Gate" does not follow the logic of our world. The prime beings there are called -- the "Imajin"s. The Imajins resemble Braves, each with their own traits, and they spoke to us. How should I have answered them?
―■■■ Report―

26RBS03-018.name: The SnakePossessed Sthenon
26RBS03-018.effect:
[LV1-2] [Shaman: Beastleptic & Cost 4 or less] When Destroyed
You can target a Cost 4 or less "Beastleptic" family Spirit card in your Trash. Summon it.

[LV2]During Attack/Block [Invoke: Flash] Once Per Turn
Destroy one of your "Beastleptic" family Spirits ▶ Target an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit. Send a core, besides [Soul Core], from it to the Reserve.

BSC25-011.name: The SnakePriest Rhinora
BSC25-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
By discarding a "Death Dragon" family Spirit card/Brave card from your Hand, draw a card.
BSC25-011.flavor: Having braved with the Imajin that Amethyst-Dragon summoned, racers Ourovorius and Gardea are spurting toward the endgame!

BS54-018.name: The SkyDragonKnight Scriver
BS54-018.kanji: 天空の竜騎士スクライヴァー
BS54-018.effect:
When this card in Hand/Trash is summoned by your Purple effect, and it is your Attack Step, send an opposing Life to the Reserve. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can draw a card. Then, you can destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Trash.
BS54-018.flavor: "While I'm also concerned about the moves of the ThreeOriginDukes, seems that we should first solve the mysteries about Grandstones for now!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12531.name: The SkyEmeraldPhoenix Phara-Nix
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12531.kanji: 天空翠凰ファラ=ニクス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12531.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Winged Beast Spirit/Ultimate]

When summoning this revealed card, ignore the Summon Condition.

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Ultimate. Also, if the opposing Life is four or less, you can discard a random card from the opposing Hand.

[LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
At the end of a blocked battle, refresh this Ultimate.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12531.flavor: When preparing for the battle with Zeus-Lolo, Horus had his eyes set on a certain phoenix.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12532.name: The SnakeQueen Neferlula
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12532.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) By discarding a "Dark Snake" family card from your Hand, draw two cards.

[LV2] (When Attacks) Send two cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12532.flavor:
Apollon took charge of Osiris' world. As he had already been charge of it from the very start of the Great War, it was the least chaotic case.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 1:07

BS65-X05.name: The SkyEmperorKillerWhale Mercur-Orca
BS65-X05.kanji: 天空皇鯱マーキュル・オルカ
BS65-X05.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By banishing a card with [Excite: 5] from your Trash, summon this card from the Hand by paying one cost. When you've done so, if it's the opposing Attack Step, immediately end the battle.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Every "Zero Contract" family Spirit you control gains an extra White symbol.
BS65-X05.flavor: Excite Release!　I'll finish you here!! ―The Zero Partner, Wiz―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12534.name: The SnakeTwelveGodKing Tiamadou
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12534.kanji: 巳の十二神皇ティアマドー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12534.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Seal: Seal] (When Attacks)
You can send the [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Life.

[Seal: During Seal] [LV1][LV2][LV3] [God Strike] (Your Attack Step)
While your "God-King" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't block unless they send a core from their Life to the Void.

[Seal: During Seal] [LV2][LV3] [God-Army] (When Attacks)
You can summon "God-King" family Spirit cards from your Hand and Trash, one from each, without paying the cost.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12534.flavor: The frontline commander which supervises the Twelve God-Kings. That is the true form of the Snake God-King!

BSC26-008.name: The SkyGiantKaiju Rodan
BSC26-008.flavor:
An ancient kaiju hatched from a pteranodon egg by the effects of nuclear testing. Using its giant wings, it can fly at speeds up to mach 1.5.
―Giant Kaiju of the Sky Rodan (1956)―

BS42-017.name: The SnakeWarrior Feraga
BS42-017.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 5 ([Purple Core][Purple Core][Purple Core])]
Send a core, other than Soul Core, from your Trash to your Life. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
Draw a card.
BS42-017.flavor: We really hope that you guys can help us along to search for the Holy Relics in the other worlds. Your wisdom and knowledge are essential in this.

SD47-X01.name: The SkyGodKing Budgie-Pesed
SD47-X01.kanji: 天空神皇バッジー・ペセド
SD47-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Seal: Seal] (When Summoned)
You can send [Soul Core] from your Reserve to your Life.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, put a core from the Void to any Green-only Grandwalker Nexus you control.

[Seal: During Seal] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Cost 5 or more "Winged Beast" family Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, send an opposing Life to their Reserve. This effect doesn't stack.
SD47-X01.flavor:
Horus borrowed the power of the God-Kings.
"I promise it. I shall not use this power for evil."

BSC26-017.name: The SmogKaiju Hedorah
BSC26-017.effect:
When your Red/Purple Spirit is summoned, you can summon this Spirit card from the Trash.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit which battled this Spirit during battle resolution at the end of the battle.
BSC26-017.flavor:
The enigmatic creature that flew to Earth on a meteorite absorbed sludge from the polluted ocean and became a kaiju. Sulfuric mist spreads wherever Hedorah goes, rusting metal and melting living beings to the bone.
―Godzilla vs Hedorah (1971)―

SD47-X03.name: The SkyGodKing Gale-Phoenix-Horus
SD47-X03.kanji: 天空神皇ゲイル・フェニックス・ホルス
SD47-X03.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Seal: Seal] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can send [Soul Core] from this Spirit to your Life.

[Seal: During Seal] [LV1][LV2][LV3] [Grand Soar] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, by either paying one cost, or putting a core from any Green Grandwalker Nexus you control to this Spirit, this Spirit refreshes.

[Seal: During Seal] [LV2][LV3] 2 (When Attacks)
Heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates.
[heb]
SD47-X03.flavor: "Gale-Phoenix, I think we might be compatible. Won't you conquer the skies with me?"

BS19-083.name: The Snake's Castle Gate
BS19-083.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Main Step)
Besides putting cores for summons, exhaust every opposing Spirit that has cores being put onto it.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Dark Snake" family Spirit attacks, send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.
BS19-083.flavor: Looking for the swallowing snake, we headed to the snake palace. We finally arrived, but even the door looks ominous...

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12541.name: The SnakeWingKing Mencobra
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12541.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Dark Snake & Cost 5 or more] ((Your Turn))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
You can send two cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void. When you've done so, put two cores from the Void to any of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Osiris."

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When the opposing Trash has six or less cores, by sending one core from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Trash, this Spirit refreshes.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12541.flavor: One of the Six kings loyal to Osiris. It is said his wings bring death.

BSC20-005.name: The SnakeArtsMagician Zuda
BSC20-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
When [Soul Core](Soul Core) is used to pay the summon cost, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3]
When any Cost 6 or more Spirit is summoned from your Trash, send cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve until only one core remains.
BSC20-005.flavor: Mumei was awakened by soul magic in the midst of battle.

BS46-X07.name: The SkyGodbird Haroeris
BS46-X07.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Green Spirits]

When summoning this revealed card, ignore the Summon Condition.

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. At the end of battle, once per turn, this Ultimate refreshes.
[heb]

[LV4]
Opposing heavily exhausted Spirits/Ultimates can't refresh nor activate their effects.
BS46-X07.flavor: The sky is Horus' holy land. Those who stain it shall not be forgiven.

BS26-055.name: The SnakeAstralArmored Snakers
BS26-055.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Send a core from an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve.
BS26-055.flavor: Hey, why don't the Ultimates fuse with Braves instead of just capturing them? Huh!? They can't? They can't brave!? I didn't know that...

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12545.name: The SkyHero Lord-Dragon-Bazzel
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12545.kanji: 天空の覇王ロード・ドラゴン・バゼル
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12545.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] 1 (When Summoned/Attacks)
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
[heb]

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can immediately activate one of your "Supreme Hero"/"Winged Beast" family Bursts. After that Burst activates, refresh this Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12545.flavor: A new powerful one appears from the skies.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12546.name: The Snakemancer Hem-Nesel
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12546.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Send one core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Trash.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can discard every Green/White card in the opposing Removed Zone. When you've done so, for each card discarded, send one core from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to their Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12546.flavor:
Olym's main forces, including Zeus-Lolo, distancing themselves from Egyt signaled an opportunity for Horus and his group.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 2:10―

BS21-X07.name: The SkyLightSword Crown-Solar
BS21-X07.kanji: 天空の光剣クラウン・ソーラー
BS21-X07.effect:
[LV1] [Charge]
Your non-Ultimate “Spirit-refreshing effects” refresh +1 body.

[During Brave] [Charge]
Your non-Ultimate “Spirit-refreshing effects” refresh +1 body.

[During Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Refresh a non-Braved Spirit you control.
BS21-X07.flavor: The light of the sword that looks to the sky once more gives power to those who have fallen and been hurt.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12548.name: The SnowKiddie Yeti
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12548.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) If this spirit is unexhausted, exhaust this spirit.

[LV2] (During Opponent's Battle Phase) Each time your opponent plays a spell, if this spirit is exhausted, refresh this spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12548.flavor: Even sleepyheads like them can no longer continue sleeping, because those dragons are threatening to make their country disappear.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12549.name: The SkyLightSword Crown-Solar X
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12549.kanji: 天空の光剣クラウン・ソーラーX
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12549.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" & "Armed Machine" family Spirit effect, you can add it to the Hand. When you've done so, discard a card from your Hand.

[During Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.

[During Brave] [Rebirth5]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, this Brave can separate and flip.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12549.flavor: The SkyLightSword that once supported the world. However, its wielder is already gone.

BS30-057.name: The SnakeAstralWhip Sabik
BS30-057.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Send a core from any opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve.

You can target and attack an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate.

Zeus-Lolo outclasses Alex. However, the support given by the gathered Hindida Grandwalkers allowed them to preserve the battleline.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 4:10―

To ensure there would never again be any battles between Grandwalkers, the Hindida gods proposed for our worlds to be permanently connected, something akin to a peaceful coalition. ―"Genesis Records" New Volume 5:04―

CB32-014.effect:
The card/Spirit is also treated as "Kaiju".

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Send any number of cores from your Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void, and for each core sent, send two cores from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Reserve. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest BP.
CB32-014.flavor: A bioweapon kaiju constructed by Shadow Seijin after years of research. Its finisher is Zegunt Beam, which sends the enemy it hits to another dimension.

BS04-032.name: The SpearBeetle Lucanidos
BS04-032.effect:
[LV2] (When Battles)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by BP comparison, refresh this Spirit.
BS04-032.flavor:
The monster appeared suddenly. A resident of the woods tried to protect the Elder, but the monster's well-aimed blow pierced and flung off the brave one.
-from the 5th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS59-053.name: The SpacetimeDragonArmyCaptain Tymra-Dymra
BS59-053.kanji: 時空竜軍団長タイムラー・ダイムラー
BS59-053.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn/Attacks)
Ignoring the costs of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit, and when destroys, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Chrownos" family Spirit is attacking, when the opponent would activate a Burst, unless they pay the cost of that card, they can't activate it.
BS59-053.flavor: "I am Tymra-Dymra, the captain of Chronos' Second Imperial Force! What I lead is the Spacetime-Dragon-Army. Giltachyon, let's defend the Gate of Spacetime at all cost!"

BS11-054.name: The SpearBird Spineed-Hayato
BS11-054.kanji: 武槍鳥スピニード・ハヤト
BS11-054.effect:
[When Braved] (Your Attack Step)
At the start of the step, choose a color. During this turn, when this Spirit is blocked by a Spirit with the selected color, refresh this Spirit.
BS11-054.flavor:
Receiving hard to believe news, he flies singlemindedly towards the Aquapolis!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS58-022.name: The SpacetimeInvestigatingOfficer Oliver
BS58-022.kanji: 時空捜査官オリヴァー
BS58-022.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit would leave the Field by opposing effects, by summoning one of your Spirit card Mirage without paying the cost, it remains on the Field in the same condition.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, this Spirit can refresh. When you've done so, put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control.
BS58-022.flavor:
Out of perhaps everyone's expectation, the Investigating Officers of the Spacetime Police turned out to be the main contributors towards the deciphering of the sacred books. Apparently they didn't just know how to fight around.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 7:12―

BSC50-022.name: The SpearBird Spineed-Hayato LT
BSC50-022.kanji: 武槍鳥スピニード・ハヤトLT
BSC50-022.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can put a core from the Void each to your Reserve and an "Astral Deity" family Spirit you control.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't activate Burst effects. Also, when blocked, this Spirit can refresh.
BSC50-022.flavor:
Receiving hard to believe news, he flies singlemindedly towards the Aquapolis!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS73-056.name: The SpacetimeKnightOrderCaptain Lowig
BS73-056.kanji: 時空騎士団長レーヴィヒ
BS73-056.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Chronos" & C1 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Once per turn, when this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, by -1 your counter or the opposing counter, it remains on the Field, refreshed.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When opposing Spirits/Ultimates attack/block, you can +1 core to one of your "Chronos" Grandwalker Nexuses.
BS73-056.flavor: "Impossible! Time is returning to normal!? But Lord ■■■■ is the ruler of spacetime! Our existence is disappearing. How can this be allowed?"

BS10-057.name: The Stagman Deard
BS10-057.flavor: According to the testimony of the last remaining survivors of the Eastern Lands, a deity from another realm summoned forth a massive earthquake that split the earth just as people were in hot debate over the recent battles. The latest reports confirm that the epicenter of the quake is moving southwest, with the Southern Country as its next possible target. To have an earthquake as your enemy... I wonder what the heroes gathered in the Middle Kingdom must be thinking as they prepare to engage this force of nature.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12638.name: The SpearKnight Grantbeet
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12638.kanji: 槍騎士グラントビート
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12638.effect: When summoning this card from the Hand, every "Shellman" family Spirit you control gains an extra Green symbol.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12638.flavor:
The remainders won. However, if looking at the entire picture of the conflict, it was only a partial victory. At the main battlefield, Vishnu found himself outnumbered.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 3:37

BS16-068.name: The Stairway Mountains
BS16-068.kanji: イ・ケダヤンの階段山脈
BS16-068.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
When deployed from the Hand, at the end of this turn, refresh all your Spirits.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning a Spirit card/Brave card, this Nexus' symbol becomes three White symbols.
BS16-068.flavor:
It is said that while some Ice Shield's people claimed that the invasion of Flame Shield had just cause, an economical reason of coveting warm, unfrozen ports may have had more to do with the actual cause of the war.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of the Hero Kei, Year 629—

BS59-067.name: The SpacetimeProtectorDragon Giltachyon
BS59-067.kanji: 時空守護龍ギルタキオン
BS59-067.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
Destroy an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit. If you have a Mirage set, instead, destroy three opposing Cost 6 or less Spirits.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By returning four "Chrownos" family cards from your Trash to the deckbottom, this Spirit refreshes.
BS59-067.flavor: The Gate of Spacetime that connects right to Chronos' place. And the guard of the gate appeared.

BS45-X05.name: The StarAngeliaGoddess Ishstar
BS45-X05.kanji: 星天使女神イシスター
BS45-X05.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at six or less]

[Unleash: 2] [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
You can either send two cores from any of your Yellow Grandwalker Nexuses, or one core from your Life to this Ultimate. When you've done so, return two opposing Spirits to the Hand, and send an opposing Life to their Trash.

[LV4][LV5] (Your Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced, this Ultimate refreshes.
BS45-X05.flavor: "Come, let's go to the afterlife... together with my Avatar, Ishstar..."

BS51-040.name: The SpearKnight Weinreich
BS51-040.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When your Hand would be discarded via the effect of your exactly-named "Bugs Reverse", or via your "Shellman" family Spirit effect, you can treat all the cards as having been discarded and put them onto the Removed Zone. This effect can only be used once per game.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return a Green "Celeste" family card from your Removed Zone to the Hand.
BS51-040.flavor:
When it comes to battles between gods, the more numerous side isn't guaranteed to be advantageous one. Alex and her allies were being pushed back.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 4:05

BS56-060.name: The SpacetimeSeaBeast ChronoOrca
BS56-060.kanji: 時空海獣クロノオルカ
BS56-060.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Destroy an opposing Cost 8 or less Spirit/Ultimate, and when destroys, you can return a Blue "Chrownos" family card from your Trash to the Hand. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Ignoring the costs of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 5/6/7 Spirit, and when destroys, put two cores from the Void to any "Chrownos" family Spirits you control.
BS56-060.flavor:
The interrogation ended with us getting no information about the Time-alterer.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 5:26―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12644.name: The SpacetimeTenBlade Extreme-Jitte
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12644.kanji: 時空十刃エクストリーム・ジッテー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12644.effect:
[+1]

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by BP comparison, send two opposing Lives to the Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12644.flavor: RoboSheriff revealed his secret function and transformed into blade mode.

X13-05.name: The StarAngelia Mikarean
X13-05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -3000 BP.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can brave ignoring brave conditions.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a Magic card among them to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the decktop in any order.
X13-05.flavor: In the country of Yellow Sky, there is a fairy tale of an ArcAngelia riding upon a legendary beast. Yes, I too thought it was only a fairy tale until now.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12646.name: The StarOracle Olen
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12646.kanji: 星の神託者オーレーン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12646.effect:
When you summon an "Astral Dragon" family Spirit, you can summon this card from the Hand as Cost 1.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When any Red card is sent to the Trash via the [Core Charge] of your Red-only Grandwalker Nexus, destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12646.flavor: The ritualist responsible for the oracling in Apollon's Stardragon Temple. Having received an oracle regarding Apollon's retreat at the hands of Set, he quickly moved the Stardragon Temple.

BS57-050.name: The SpacetimeTortoiseBeast Xuanwu
BS57-050.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
For each "Chrownos" family Spirit you control, destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Chrownos" family Spirit effect destroys any opposing Spirits, put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control. This effect doesn't stack.
BS57-050.flavor:
Oracles that can seal off that Ultimate...Although our cooperating organizations own "Empress" and "Star", they aren't suitable this time. First, we need "Strength". Then, we also want "Emperor" and "Justice".
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 6:16―

BS11-056.name: The StarSwordShuttle Polar-Caliber
BS11-056.kanji: 極星剣機ポーラ・キャリバー
BS11-056.effect:
[When Braved] (When Blocks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, return an opposing Spirit/Brave/Nexus to the Hand.
BS11-056.flavor:
Request for reinforcements confirmed! A powerful Brave has flown into the battlefield.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS22-045.name: The SpacetimeWitch Grandes
BS22-045.kanji: 時空の魔女グランディース
BS22-045.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Besides any [The SpaceTimeWitch Grandes], you can activate a (When Summoned) effect of a Spirit card in your Trash as this Spirit's effect.
BS22-045.flavor: The world trembles at her whim. What will she do today? It'd be good if she could stand the boredom.

BSC50-027.name: The StarSwordShuttle Polar-Caliber LT
BSC50-027.kanji: 極星剣機ポーラ・キャリバーLT
BSC50-027.effect:
(Can't Stack) During either Attack Step, when your "Apollo" is summoned, you can summon this card from the Hand by paying one cost. When you've done so, you can discard an opposing Burst.

[During Brave] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block all opposing "can't be blocked" Spirits. Also, when your Spirit destroys an opposing Spirit via comparing BP, you can return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.
BSC50-027.flavor:
Request for reinforcements confirmed! A powerful Brave has flown into the battlefield.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

SD14-001.name: The SpearSoldier Antman
SD14-001.effect:
[LV2] (When Attacks)
For each core in your Reserve, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
SD14-001.flavor: Some of the ones imprisoned by darkness have memories of their past, and have joined forces with members of their original tribe.

BS26-068.name: The Spacetime Bonding Point A-01
BS26-068.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Main Step)
All Cost 2 or less Spirits can't fulfill the summon conditions of Ultimates.

[LV2]
When a Brave card is discarded from your deck by an opposing "Deck Discarding effect", during this turn, cards can't be discarded from your deck.
BS26-068.flavor:
From our investigation, we have learned that this is a bonding point of space-time. We're hatching a plan to return to the past world, but will it work out?
—White Lands Site No. 779 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

BS30-017.name: The SpearUser Hornets
BS30-017.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.
[Rush: Blue]
(While you have a Blue symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Blue Core]: When summoned during (Either Attack Step), draw two cards. Then, discard a card from your Hand.
BS30-017.flavor: That spirit with the spear is facing the other spirits three-on-one! Amazing!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12654.name: The StarTravelerDragon Chronic Dragon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12654.kanji: 星渡竜コロニックドラゴン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12654.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return a Saga Brave card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
If you control any Saga Brave, by paying two costs, destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12654.flavor:
"Grandwalker Alex is a desertor and a rebel." This single piece of news shook all spirits of Grand Lolo.
―"Genesis Records" Grand Lolo Tale 01

CB23-035.name: The Spear of Gaius
CB23-035.effect:
One copy of this card/Brave can brave to a Spirit that is braved to "Ikari Shinji" you control, ignoring the number of Braves on it.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
If your Life is five or less, you can send a core, besides [Soul Core], from the Trash to your Life.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
While braved to "Unit-01", during this battle, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.
CB23-035.flavor: The spear crafted by the will of people who hope to return the world to what it should have been. Its other name is the Spear of WILLE.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12656.name: The StarArmoredDragon Sieg-Brave
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12656.kanji: 星鎧龍ジーク・ブレイヴ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12656.effect:
[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.

[When Braved]
Treat this Spirit as having "Siegwurm" in name.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12656.flavor:
Nova! Shineee!!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

BS51-X07.name: The Spear and Shield of Genesis
BS51-X07.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] [Unleash: 2] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by sending two cores from any of your Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit, this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Spirits/Ultimates with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field] (Opposing Turn)
(When this Nexus has at least two cores) Your Life can only be reduced by one per turn by opposing effects.

CB21-042.name: The Spear of Longinus
CB21-042.effect:
[During Brave] (When Attacks)
During this battle, an opposing exhausted Spirit can't activate its effects, and you can destroy that Spirit. Also, while being braved to two exactly-named "The Spear of Longinus", this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Spirits with four cores or less on them each.
CB21-042.flavor: The spear of despair. It was thought to be the Spear of Longinus and the Spear of Gaius that pierced through Lilith. However, it was actually two Spears of Longinus that did the work.

BS13-036.name: The StarBird Kuhja
BS13-036.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your Yellow Spirits are destroyed, by sending a core from your Life to your Reserve, one of your destroyed Yellow Spirits remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your Yellow Spirits are destroyed, draw a card.

[LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your Yellow Spirits are destroyed, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
BS13-036.flavor:
Beauty is an immortal thing.
—from the Pavo chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12660.name: The SpearbeakDragon Spearheadphodon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12660.kanji: 嘴槍竜スピアヘッドフォドン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12660.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This exhausted Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. By sending up to two cores from any of your Red-only Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void, for each core sent, destroy +1 Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12660.flavor:
Zeus-Lolo's power was tremendous. Little by little, the land becomes hydrated again.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 4:04―

BS49-008.name: The StarbowDragon Argyros Dragon
BS49-008.kanji: 星弓龍アリギュロスドラゴン
BS49-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Then, you can send a core from any opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void. When any core is sent, discard three cards from the opposing Removed Zone.

[LV2]
Your Life can only be reduced by one per turn per opposing Ultimate.
BS49-008.flavor:
Apollon didn't deploy with Zeus-Lolo's forces, so he would keep the rear guard composed of Egyt stable.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 2:07―

BS75-062.name: The Stardust Lava Sea
BS75-062.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Red Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, by sending the [Soul Core] from your "Contractor Ometeotl" Grandwalker Nexus to the Trash, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV1]
When the opponent would activate any "Deck-discarding" effect, by sending your [Soul Core] to any "Contractor Ometeotl" Grandwalker Nexus, during this turn, cards can't be discarded from either player's deck.
BS75-062.flavor:
A sea of lava dotted with islands of stars.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 176―

BSC49-037.name: The StarBird Kuhja LT
BSC49-037.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your Yellow Spirits are destroyed, by sending a core from your Life to the Reserve, one of those targets remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2][LV3]
When your "Devotee"/ "Astral Soul"/ "Galaxian" family Spirits are destroyed, you can draw a card.

[LV3]
When your Yellow Spirits are destroyed, you can put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
BSC49-037.flavor:
Beauty is an immortal thing.
—from the Pavo chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS12-020.name: The Spearhead Siberza
BS12-020.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Neither player's life can be reduced by the attacks of Brave Spirits with two symbols.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
If this is the first attack of your turn, this Spirit refreshes.
BS12-020.flavor:
Though still unrefined, his superior speed and presence already makes for the number one shine on the battlefield. His unclouded face reminds me of a Braver from the past.
—from the Canis Major chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

SD25-003.name: The StarBowDragon Kaus-Wyvern
SD25-003.kanji: 星弓竜カウス・ワイバーン
SD25-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
If you control any Ultimate, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.
SD25-003.flavor: Is it possible that the guys from Dark-somewhere-or-other will pop up on our continent too? I haven't thought about it, but it could happen...

BS19-079.name: The Stargazing Triple Tower
BS19-079.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Cost 2 or more Spirit with [Charge] attacks, draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Astral Dragon" family Spirits destroy any opposing Spirits, return a Brave card from your Trash to your Hand.
BS19-079.flavor: Tall and splendid, these giant towers were erected at a spot with an authoritative point of view. That's not all; they also have a practical function as watchtowers.

BSC49-021.name: The Spearhead Siberza LT
BSC49-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Your Life can't be reduced by the attacks of opposing Brave Spirits/Brave Ultimates with two symbols or more.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Blade Beast" family Spirit makes the first attack of your turn, the opponent put a card from their Hand onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When this is the first attack of your turn, this Spirit refreshes.
BSC49-021.flavor:
Though still unrefined, his superior speed and presence already makes for the number one shine on the battlefield. His unclouded face reminds me of a Braver from the past.
—from the Canis Major chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12668.name: The StarlightDragon Siegwurm-Deneb
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12668.kanji: 輝星龍ジークヴルム・デネブ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12668.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit.

[LV2] [Assault: 1] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12668.flavor:
The beautiful wings are the sign of the stars. Watching over those who come and go, they continue to shine. If you look up at the night sky, they might be there now.
-from the Star's Fragment of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS64-X03.name: The StarCountSage Fermat-Searam-Q.E.D.
BS64-X03.kanji: 星数賢者フェルマ・シーラム・Q.E.D.
BS64-X03.effect:
Flash - [Reverse Contract Advent: "The PartnerCat Fermat" & C7 or more, (Your Turn)]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By sending your [Soul Core] or the opposing [Soul Core] to the Trash, or by -1 opposing counter, stacking this card from your Hand onto its target, including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
You can return two Yellow-only cards from your Trash to the Hand. Also, if it's your Main Step, you can negate an opposing active effect, besides any on-field effects.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While you have summoned for four times or more in this turn, neither player can use cards with an odd number cost from the Hand/Removed Zone. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

BSC26-038.name: The SpecialFighter Griffon
BSC26-038.kanji: 特殊戦闘機グリフォン
BSC26-038.flavor:
The chief weapon of the anti-Godzilla combat team "G Grasper" organized under the special G countermeasures headquarters.
―Godzilla x Megaguirus (2000)―

BS65-X09.name: The StarCrushHammer Daedalossa
BS65-X09.effect:
[B Engage: Contract Advent Spirit with "The Artificial Partner, Reve" as pre-advent]
(Once per Game: Same Name) When braving with the target, you can activate the following effect:
█ Destroy any number of Nexuses you and the opponent controls, and for each Nexus destroyed, draw two cards. The effects of the Nexuses destroyed can't activate.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Discard three cards from the opposing decktop. Also, while braved to an "Artificial Contract" family Spirit, during this battle, the opponent can't activate Burst effects of cards/use Magic cards from Hand/Removed Zone that have the same name as cards in the opposing Trash.

BS64-082.name: The Starlight Study
BS64-082.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
Including those in Soul State/pre-advent condition, while you control any "The PartnerCat Fermat", the opponent can't use any Cost 3/6/9 Spirit cards from their Hand, nor can their Cost 3/6/9 Spirits activate any effects.

[LV2] (Your Turn)
Once per turn, when your counter increases via a "Golden Cloud" family effect, you can return an opposing LV1 Spirit to the deckbottom.
BS64-082.flavor:
One of the research labs that Fermat took over in order to observe Lecoulis. It was originally some sort of second residence to certain local nobles. Well, let's start tidying up!
―Travelogue of the Collapsing World 079―

BS67-CP06.name: The StarCrushingArtificialDeity Reve-Daedalus
BS67-CP06.kanji: 砕星造神レーヴ・ダイダロス
BS67-CP06.effect:
Flash - [Ultra Contract Advent: "The Artificial Partner, Reve" & C7 or more, (Your Turn)]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By stacking this card from your Hand onto its target, including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition, send your [Soul Core] to this Spirit.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest cost. Also, once per turn, if it's your Attack Step, unless the opponent discards 10 cards from their decktop, send two opposing Lives to the Trash. If there are 25 or more cards in the opposing Trash, instead, discard 10 cards from the opposing decktop, and send two opposing Lives to the Trash.

BS13-069.name: The Starry Sky Concert Hall
BS13-069.kanji: 星空のコンサートホール
BS13-069.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Main Step)

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Lv1/Lv3 Spirits/Ultimates.
P25-04.flavor: "The true power of Celtica should rest with Lady Morrigan. Just you wait, you lot of moderates."

BS70-067.name: The SteamNobleThief Westmoreland
BS70-067.kanji: 蒸貴賊ウェストモーランド
BS70-067.effect:
When this card is discarded from the Hand by your "SteamNobleThief" effects, if you have six counters or more, you can summon it, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Put a core from the Void each to every "Dalnia"/"SteamNobleThief" you control.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, when the "opposing deck discarding effect" of your "SteamNobleThief" activates, if no cards could be discarded, you can refresh a "Dalnia"/"SteamNobleThief" you control.
BS70-067.flavor: "There is no guarantee what would appear in the Divine World. Dalnia, I will leave Reve's adjustment to you!"

BSC49-006.name: The StarHornBeast Unigaunt LT
BSC49-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Brave card to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When your Spirits would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can summon a Brave card from the Hand, without paying the cost, in Spirit-condition.
BSC49-006.flavor:
Purification of a world disrupted by selfishness. Its proud pure white horn pointing to the heavens is the advent of noble will.
—from the Unicorn chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12720.name: The Spinner Harfelicite
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12720.kanji: 機織のハーフェレシテ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12720.effect:
[LV1][LV2] During Your Main Phase) At start of phase, you may discard a nexus card from your hand. In that case, gain 1 core on this spirit.

(When Destroyed) You may deploy target nexus card from your Trash without paying its cost.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12720.flavor: There are many artisans in the North country. I would say it is no exaggeration to say that the artificial soldiers competitive exhibition was started for them.

BS11-034.name: The StarHorse Colutte
BS11-034.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit is destroyed by opposing Spirit effects, separate every opposing Brave Spirit with two symbols or more. However, the opponent decides how the cores are moved during separation.
BS11-034.flavor:
Unconditional cuteness that makes one forgive everything. With dignity wavering in its warm heart and possessing a strong will within its body, while still a colt, I very much feel that it will have great talent.
—from the Equuleus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS64-X07.name: The SpinningReversalBlade Zweizar
BS64-X07.effect:
[B Engage: Contract Advent Spirit with "The EaglePartner, Gut" as pre-advent]
(Once per Game: Same Name) When braving with the target, you can activate the following effect:
█ Put cores from the Void to this Spirit so that it reaches highest level.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. Then, for every three counters you have, destroy an opposing Nexus.

[During Brave] (Your Turn)
While you have six counters or more, this Spirit's “Destruction Effects” can't be prevented by opposing effects.

BS11-X03.name: The StarKnight Hercules Ω
BS11-X03.effect:
While your Life is at three or less, the cost of this Spirit card in Hand becomes Cost 4.

Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3]
When your Spirit with [High Speed] is summoned, this Spirit refreshes.
BS11-X03.flavor:
He gallantly appears in times of disaster, valiantly exterminating his foes. Everyone calls him a great hero.
—from the Hercules chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

PB13-04.name: The StarMedium Kushina
PB13-04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By destroying this Spirit, summon a [The SupernovaDragon Siegwurm-Nova] from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is also treated as a Red Spirit.
PB13-04.flavor: "The future I have seen ends here. The rest is up to you to clear open."

BS68-067.name: The SteamNobleThief Winchelsea
BS68-067.kanji: 蒸貴賊ウィンチェルシー
BS68-067.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks]
During this turn, all your "Dalnia"/"SteamNobleThief" can't be destroyed by the opponent. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Turn)
When your "Dalnia"/"SteamNobleThief" attacks, discard two cards from the opposing decktop, and put a core from the Void to that target.
BS68-067.flavor: "That's so troublesome. I'll just leave it to Gerald! What? Dalnia-chan is coming too? You should've told me about that earlier!"

26RBS02-070.name: The SpinousPiercer Mandia
26RBS02-070.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2] [Rumble: 6] [During Attack]
At the end of battle, discard six cards from the opposing decktop. For each cost of the Spirit card that blocked in the opposing Trash, it discards -1 card.

[LV2]Your Attack StepCan't Stack
When the attack of your Spirit with [Rumble] reduces the opposing Life, discard six cards from the opposing decktop.
26RBS02-070.flavor: Though its savage nature makes even its own kind give it a wide berth in peacetime, it becomes a reliable ally during war.

BS64-068.name: The SpinyLeafSpear Alospear
BS64-068.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can discard your entire Hand. When this effect discards any "Jade Thunder" family card, draw a card for each card in the opposing Hand/Removed Zone.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
BS64-068.flavor: A spear made from processed leaves of a plant called Alokai that grows in forest cities.

SD03-009.name: The StarMonster Sea-Serpendar
SD03-009.kanji: 星海獣シー・サーペンダー
SD03-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] [Assault: 1] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
While you control any Brave Spirit, Cost 4 or less Spirits can't attack.
SD03-009.flavor:
A new head grows from its severed neck, a perfect demonstration of the paper-thin difference between the mysterious and the ghastly.
—from the Hydra chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BSC49-046.name: The StarMonster Sea-Serpendar LT
BSC49-046.kanji: 星海獣シー・サーペンダーLT
BSC49-046.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit, and when destroys, put a core from the Void each to this Spirit and a Nexus you control.

[LV1][LV2] [Assault: 1] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
While you control any Brave Spirit, every opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit can't attack.
BSC49-046.flavor:
A new head grows from its severed neck, a perfect demonstration of the paper-thin difference between the mysterious and the ghastly.
—from the Hydra chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

SJ13-04.name: The SpiralHatchet Gale-Axe
SJ13-04.kanji: 大旋斧ゲイル・アックス
SJ13-04.effect:
[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
Exhaust two opposing LV1 Spirits.
SJ13-04.flavor: The hatchet rouses the strongest whirlwind that blows away everything.

BS52-063-A12731.name: The SpireGiantTortoise Thousand Hawksbill
BS52-063-A12731.kanji: 尖塔大亀サウザンタイマイ
BS52-063-A12731.effect:
[Brave Symbol +1]

[LV1][LV2] (When Reborn)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. You can summon a White "Primal" family Spirit card among them, without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards to either only the decktop or the deckbottom.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the deckbottom.
BS52-063-A12731.flavor:
From within the crevice comes out a gigantic Spirit carrying an emblematic beautiful tower. The land wasn't the only thing she created.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 1:29―

BS67-011.name: The SpiritArmorPrincess Mercedes
BS67-011.kanji: 霊鎧姫メルツェーデス
BS67-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, your counter +1. Then, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a "Camus" among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV1][LV2]
Cards can't be discarded from your deck via opposing effects, and cards in your Removed Zone are unaffected by opposing effects.
BS67-011.flavor:
So that bug feels like he is doing me a flavor? I need to let him know it isn't that easy...But first, let's defeat that thing.
―The InfernalGunGoddess Camus-Sequence―

BS73-021.name: The SpiritSwordCount Fon Brunhes
BS73-021.kanji: 霊剣伯フォンブリューヌ
BS73-021.effect:
When summoning this card, by sending three cores from your "Contractor Nyx" Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void, this card becomes Cost 5.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)

[LV2][LV3] (Start of Opposing Main Step)
You can draw a card for every three cores in the opposing Reserve. (Max. 3)
BS73-021.flavor: "Yum-Kaax, Morrigan, Yamato Takeru...I can see it, the seed of conflict."

BS61-051.name: The StarOceanPirateAngel Maryel
BS61-051.kanji: 星海の海賊天使メアリエル
BS61-051.effect:
When your "Incarnate"/"Tri-Dragon Deity" family Spirit/Ultimate attacks, you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned/Reborn) effect resolves]
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -12000 BP, and destroy it when its BP is brought to 0. If you control any "Choco", including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, this effect activates once more. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.
BS61-051.flavor: "You want me to help those guys who are trying to close the rift? Well, I ain't cheap!"

BS65-041.name: The SteamSubmarine Steam Angler
BS65-041.kanji: 蒸気潜水艦スチームアングラー
BS65-041.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits. If there are 10 or more cards in the opposing Trash, this effect puts +1 core.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While there are 10 or more cards in the opposing Trash, the opponent can't activate Burst effects of Spirit cards. While there are 20 or more, instead, the opponent can't activate Burst effects of Spirit cards/Magic cards.
BS65-041.flavor:
So the castle-like Legend Spirit is the winning prize of the artificial soldier competition?! ―The Zero Partner, Wiz―
I HAVE -- ALREADY ENROLLED -- INTO THE ARTIFICAL SOLDIER COMPETITION. LET'S---FIGHT. ―The Artificial Partner, Reve―

BS26-043.name: The StarOceanPirate Perseus
BS26-043.kanji: 星海の海賊ペルセース
BS26-043.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Cost 6/8 (When Battles)
At the end of the battle, by destroying this Spirit, summon a Cost 6/8 Spirit card in the same family type as this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[When Braved] [LV2] (When Brave Attacks)
Once per turn, by returning a "Fighting Spirit" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand, put two cores from the Void to this Spirit.
BS26-043.flavor: What is this, there's someone who can use Summon Bolt here too! Huh? I don't think I've seen him before.

BS18-063.name: The Spirit Tower in the Sea
BS18-063.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Neither player can increase cores from the Void via Spirit/Brave effects.

[LV2]
While your Hand is five or less, when your Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, draw a card.
BS18-063.flavor:
This tower makes me think I should create a "100 Creepiest Locales" out of the Places of Interest. It's that creepy.
-from the Places of Interest 42/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS65-076.name: The Steam City Steamhive
BS65-076.kanji: 蒸気都市スチームハイヴ
BS65-076.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Cards in the opposing Trash are unaffected by opposing effects, and their effects can't be used. Also, while your Hand is five or less, your Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Once per Turn, when your "Artificial Contract" family Spirit attacks, you can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add either a Blue Brave card, or an "Artificial Contract" family Spirit card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to only the decktop or deckbottom.
BS65-076.flavor:
The oldest town in the Country of Steam. Stream Festival is held here every year.
―Travelogue of the Collapsing World 800―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12739.name: The Spring of Full Magical Powers
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12739.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (During Opponent's Main Phase) While you control 3 or more "Magician" spirits, spirit cards your opponent summons cost 1 more to summon.

[LV2] (During Opponent's Battle Phase) While you control 3 or more "Magician" spirits, each time a spirit your opponent controls attacks, they must move 1 core from a card they control or their Reserve to their Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12739.flavor:
This spring is located in the land of trump and was created by someone from the land of magic. It provides not only water, but also infinite magical powers. It is perhaps those powers that make the water so sweet and refreshing.
-from the Places of Interest 217/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS18-023.name: The SteedGeneral Boorchu
BS18-023.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Wheile your "Great General" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Bursts with the condition: [Burst: con] (After your Spirit is Destroyed by the Opponent).
BS18-023.flavor: There are spirits faster than them, spirits stronger than them. But having both qualities is a valuable asset on the battlefield.

BS11-061.name: The Star Altar
BS11-061.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When your "Astral Deity"/ "Galaxian"/ "Astral Soul" family Spirit is summoned, destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Astral Deity"/"Galaxian"/"Astral Soul" family Spirits gain +3000 BP.
BS11-061.flavor: This world is not one of the sun or of the the moon. Twelve constellations gather at the altar, and when my lips trace over those words, the new world we have awaited for will give its first cry.—from the Ara chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS09-056.name: The Star Creation Place
BS09-056.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Give all your 8000 BP or more Spirits the effect: "[Clash] (When Attacks) The opponent must block if possible."

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your "Astral Dragon" family Spirit, return a Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.
BS09-056.flavor:
The place where a certain Dragon gained immense power upon his reincarnation. From that moment on, this site has become sacred ground for all Dragons.
-from the Places of Interest 123/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS73-069.name: The Spring of Moonlight
BS73-069.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Cost 5 or less "Machine Beast" family Spirits would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can reveal a card from your decktop. If it is a "Concluser" & "Machine Beast" family card, you can add it to the Hand. If it is a Cost 5 or less "Machine Beast" family Spirit card, you can summon it by paying one cost. Return any remaining card to either the decktop or deckbottom.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Your Cost 5 or less White Spirits can't be blocked.
BS73-069.flavor:
A beautiful spring reflecting the moon which is located in the Divine Moon Forest.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 322―

BS41-072.name: The Star Desert
BS41-072.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The effect of opposing Spirits/Ultimates destroyed by your effects can't activate.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Astral Dragon" family Spirit attacks, draw a card.
BS41-072.flavor:
The Astral Dragons like deserts and make their nests there. Giant fossils have been found where they nest, quietly looking up at the sky.
-from the Places of Interest 420/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BS09-062.name: The Spring of Norn
BS09-062.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn) You can exhaust a Nexus you control instead for the Ice Wall of your Spirits.

[LV2] Your White/Yellow Nexuses cannot be destroyed by opposing Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.
BS09-062.flavor:
A mysterious spring said to help one fully recover one's power. The hints to everything were right in this spot.
-from the Places of Interest 506/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS18-024.name: The SteedGeneral Boroqul
BS18-024.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Great General" family Spirits gain +2000 BP.
BS18-024.flavor: Delivering the ceasefire orders was left to the four steeds. If it's them, the message would be able to reach faster than anyone else.

BSC35-035.name: The Star Festival Venue
BSC35-035.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Idol" family Spirit is attacking, the cost of opposing Magic cards increases by +1.

[LV2]
Your Spirits under the effect of [Solo Part]/[Duet Part] can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.
BSC35-035.flavor: It's Daiya Lune here. Behind me is the venue of Star Festival, the dream festival of idols. Live performances of various idols are going on on different stages. That's all for my report.

BS18-022.name: The SteedGeneral Chilaun
BS18-022.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Wheile your "Great General" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Bursts with the condition: [Burst: con] (After an opposing Spirit attacks).
BS18-022.flavor: Those who fought their best for the Five Nation Alliance is against Kei's ascension to the throne. Among the protesters, the four steeds of Wind Shield are the most noisome.

SD33-008.name: The Sprinting Dashrunner
SD33-008.kanji: 激走ダッシュランナー
SD33-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible. At the end of a blocked battle, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
SD33-008.flavor: It's Racer Dashrunner of the "Panther-Tusk-Racing Team". "Speed is our specialty here at PTR. Well, just watch."

BS18-021.name: The SteedGeneral Muqali
BS18-021.effect:
[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Great General" family Spirit attacks, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
BS18-021.flavor: The four Steeds are not averse to Kei, they simply would prefer me to be emperor... I appreciate the sentiment, but I'm not cut out for it. Besides, my role is not to rule an empire, but to defeat Zeyon.

26RBS01-024.name: The SpyButterfly Papilioni
26RBS01-024.effect:
[LV1-2] [Shaman: Dark Puce & Cost 3 or less] When Summoned
You can target a Cost 3 or less "Dark Puce" family Spirit card in your Trash. Summon it.

[LV2]When Attacks
Target an opposing Cost 3 or less exhausted Spirit. Destroy it.
26RBS01-024.flavor: "There're no tricks, and no gimmicks at all~"

BS23-071.name: The St. Mikafar Cathedral
BS23-071.kanji: 聖ミカファール大聖堂
BS23-071.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Cards can't be discarded from either player's deck, and Spirits can't be exhausted by effects.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Cost 5 or more "Divine Spirit" family Spirits are destroyed by the opponent and sent to the Trash, draw two cards.
BS23-071.flavor: A cathedral under the divine protection of an ArcAngelia. "I want to get just a little closer to that person I adore!" -- so think the average Angelias who come in droves to this place.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12753.name: The SteelAirKnight Lysander
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12753.kanji: 鋼鉄機空士ライサンダー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12753.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 2 ([White Core])]
Reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, you can pay one cost to summon one "Steel" Spirit card/Brave card. Return any remaining cards to either the decktop or deckbottom. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. When you've done so, once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12753.flavor:
The very tactical Athena, thinking that their advantage must be made as solid as possible, had further plottings prepared.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 3:06―

SD30-001.name: The SteelBladeDragon Calyvorous
SD30-001.effect:
[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Nexus. If this Spirit has [Soul Core] (Soul Core) on it, also, draw a card.

◆When your target Spirit is summoned, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this Nexus is deployed, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

2 [LV1][LV2] Flash
(Once per turn, send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) Your counters +2. Then, you can immediately activate one of the Main/Flash [Accel] effects of a "Steel" card in your Hand that has an Accel cost equal or inferior to your number of counters, without paying the cost.

[Contract Field] [LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, by returning a "Steel" card from your Removed Zone to the Hand, refresh 1~3 "Android" family Spirit you control.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12756.name: The Steel Forest
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12756.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Start Step) Move target "Armored Beast" spirit card from your Trash to your hand.

[LV2] (During Your Main Phase) Each time you summon an "Armored Beast" or "Giant Beast" spirit, move target spirit your opponent controls with BP less than or equal to the summoned spirit's BP to its owner's hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12756.flavor:
The effects from the invaders' activities have turned these trees into steel. When the wind blows, the overlapping steel leaves hit each other and produce beautiful sounds as if they were countless bells. It is really fantastic.
-from the Places of Interest 166/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS27-074.name: The Star View Observatory
BS27-074.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Whenever the Ultimate Trigger of your Red/Yellow Ultimates hits, draw a card.
BS27-074.flavor:
To prepare for the appearance of the astral spirits, the Ultimates established an agency to surveil the heavens.
—Yellow Sands Site No. 559 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

BS58-069-A12758.name: The Star and Beast's Grandstone
BS58-069-A12758.effect:
[GSTrule]

[Release:: (Summon/Rebirth of your Cost 3 or more "Astral Dragon"/"Blade Beast" family Spirit)]

[LV1] [Rebirth3]

[Grand Mystery] [LV1] (Your Turn)
When your draw via Red/Green effects, you can put a core from the Void to any "Astroblazer" & "Astral Dragon"/"Blade Beast" family Spirit you control. This effect doesn't stack.

BS77-023.name: The StaccatoSoundBeast Notestag
BS77-023.kanji: スタッカート音獣ノーツスタッグ
BS77-023.effect:
When the [Grandphosis] of your "Saraswati" activates, you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Return up to two opposing exhausted Spirits/Ultimates to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Imp"/"Grandwalker" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.
BS77-023.flavor:
Shiva, stop it! Don't destroy the forest!
―Grandwalker Saraswati―

BS24-093.name: The Stage Where Angels Descended
BS24-093.kanji: 天使の舞い降りた場所
BS24-093.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Start Step)
At the start of the step, by putting one Magic card from your Hand onto the Removed Zone, draw one card.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, all your "Diva" family Spirits gain an extra Yellow Symbol.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12761.name: The SteelDragon Niflheimr

[LV1][LV2] [Armor: Green]
