BS58-001.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 4 ([Red Core][Red Core][Green Core])]
[During Set] (When Set)
Destroy an opposing Nexus, and when destroys, draw a card.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Green.
BS58-001.flavor:
Who would have thought that Grand-Woden's attack would become the trigger to an ever greater tragedy. Saegebracht absorbed the lights, and proceeded to rebirth. Combining with the holy devil power, it evolved into an even more vicious being...
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 7:36―

BS53-044-A12805.name: The StoutArmWarMachine Lughaid Type-G
BS53-044-A12805.kanji: 剛腕戦機ルガイド Type-G
BS53-044-A12805.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
This Spirit refreshes, and ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 8 or less Spirit/Ultimate. This effect can't be prevented by opposing Ultimate effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard ten cards from the opposing decktop.
BS53-044-A12805.flavor: "Magic-Armor Mode Change! Type-G! Hahaha! Turning into this form I am also now slightly different from what I have been. My power is different. Power!"

BS59-007.name: The SunStarDragon Sun-Dragonix
BS59-007.kanji: 太陽星龍サン・ドラゴニクス
BS59-007.effect:
While this card is in your Removed Zone, when you are summoning an "Astroblazer" family card, fulfill one of its [Red Core] reduction symbols.

Main - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Red Core][Green Core])]
Draw two cards. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto your Removed Zone.

[LV2][LV3] [Ultra Clash] (When Attacks)
Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.
BS59-007.flavor:
I've heard from a certain Dragno once upon a time. Armaments aren't limited to weapons. There are ways to lodge and hold spirits in both arms to fight together.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 8:31―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12807.name: The SteelMaiden000 Orthia
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12807.effect:
Main - [Accel: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core]]
Put a core from the Void to your Trash. Also, put a core from the Void to any "Android" family Spirit you control. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Ultimates returned to the Hand by the [Grand Skill] of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Athena" are banished instead.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12807.flavor:
The first Steel Maiden, and also the Steel Maiden whose existence has been hidden.
"She is special. That must be why she doesn't awaken. However, she may be happier being asleep..."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12808.name: The SunWyvern Flaredragoon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12808.kanji: 太陽飛竜フレアドラグーン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12808.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the same BP as this Spirit's.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
For each "Sun"-named Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12808.flavor:
The Lunar Brigade is reinforcing their armor so they can compete with the Solar Militia's immense offensive.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—
sets: Sun and Moon Brave Campaign - Started 4

BS64-055.name: The StrangeBeast Chimai-Raon
BS64-055.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: King Contract & C4 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

(Once per turn: Same Name) If you have six counters or more, you can [Contract Advent] this card from your Hand, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Your Turn)
Once per turn, you can return an "Azure Wave" family card from your Trash to the Hand. Then, you can summon a Cost 8 or less "Azure Wave" family Spirit card from your Hand by paying one cost.

BSC50-004.name: The SunWyvern Flaredragoon LT
BSC50-004.kanji: 太陽飛竜フレアドラグーンLT
BSC50-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the same BP as this Spirit's.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
If you control any "Apollo", you can draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
During this battle, you can give this Spirit +1000 BP. You can activate this effect additionally for any number of times up to the number of counters you have.
BSC50-004.flavor:
The Lunar Brigade is reinforcing their armor so they can compete with the Solar Militia's immense offensive.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

SD31-011.name: The StrangeFangGreatShinobi Hyousouga
SD31-011.kanji: 異牙上忍ヒョウソウガ
SD31-011.flavor: Kurohagane sent an elite corps comprised of GreatShinobi and higher ranks to pursue them. This was the same response that would be reserved for nation-shaking emergencies and wars.

BS40-076.name: The Sunken City Ruins
BS40-076.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your End Step)
Refresh all your "Fighting Spirit" family Spirits.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Fighting Spirit" family Spirit attacks, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.
BS40-076.flavor:
Due to the Great Collapse, the Blue World's land and water levels reversed, making the many dry areas in the past sink underwater. This place was submerged as well, but became more mystical as a result. The sunset here, in particular, is a must-see.
-from the Places of Interest 339/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BS34-028.name: The StrangeFangNinjaCommander Leo-Kamui
BS34-028.kanji: 異牙中忍レオ・カムイ
BS34-028.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put two cores from the void to this Spirit. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) was used to pay the summon cost, also, the opponent exhaust two Spirits they control.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While there is [Soul Core] (Soul Core) on this Spirit, when the attacks of your "Vassal"/"Blade Beast" family Spirit/Ultimate reduces the opposing life, send an opposing life to their Reserve.
BS34-028.flavor: The one chosen for this battle by the Village is a StrangeFangShinobi who excels in armed combat.

PX26-03.name: The SteelMaiden001 Linnea
PX26-03.effect:
Flash -
You can summon this card from the Removed Zone.

(Can't Stack) When this card is sent to the Trash by your [Core Charge], you can activate the following [Accel] by paying one cost.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 3 ([White Core])]
If you control any "Athena", including those in Soul State, reveal up to two cards from your decktop. You can put any number of "Athena"/"Steel" among them to the Removed Zone until your Removed Zone has six cards. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom. Then, (Once per Turn: Same Name) your counters +2. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.
PX26-03.flavor: "I hold full authority in Lady Athena's absence. Everything is for Lady Athena's sake."

BS68-039.name: The SteelMaiden002 Eufemia
BS68-039.kanji: 鋼鉄乙女002エウフェミア
BS68-039.effect:
Main - [Accel: Cost 3 ([White Core][White Core])]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Return a White "Android" family card from your Removed Zone to the Hand, or summon it by paying one cost. After this effect resolves, put this card onto your Removed Zone.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When the opponent uses any White/Yellow Magic card, if you control any "Contractor Athena", before that effect activates, by exhausting a "Devotee"/"Concluser" family Spirit you control, immediately negate that effect.
BS68-039.flavor: "The primordial deities are the first generation Grandwalkers of Oylm that were exiled by Lord Zeus. They should be monitored by Lord Hades...I wonder what happened..."

BS12-022.name: The SunlightMusha Genji-Bolta
BS12-022.kanji: 太陽武者ゲンジ・ボルタ
BS12-022.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The cores on your "Sun"-named Spirits can't be removed by opposing Spirit/Brave/Magic effects.

[LV1][LV2]
All your "Parasite"/"Shell Insect"/"Shellman" family Spirits gain +1000 BP.
BS12-022.flavor:
While walking alone on the battlefield, a Musha warrior inquires something to all he passes. It appears that he is pursuing a quest to decide a match with his fated archenemy. For him, the war is for finding and finishing things with his rival.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

SJ12-03.name: The StrongestShogun Death-Violet
SJ12-03.kanji: 最強魔将デス・ヴァイオレット
SJ12-03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
For each "Strongest"-named Spirit you control, send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to their Reserve.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Treat this Spirit as colorless.
SJ12-03.flavor: The shogun that in the past boasted to be the strongest has revived once again!

BS19-087.name: The Stronghold of the Demonic Insect
BS19-087.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When the attacks of your Spirits with [Rush] reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When summoning a Spirit card/Brave card from your Hand via [High Speed], once per turn, you can summon it without paying the cost.
BS19-087.flavor: We had to ask the reigning insect lord to get permission to operate in this country. He answered thusly: You have my permission to act, but your life cannot be guaranteed.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12819.name: The SteelMaiden003 Cressa
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12819.kanji: 鋼鉄乙女003 クレッサ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12819.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add every exactly-named "Grandwalker Athena" to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
All your "Steel"-named Spirits gain +2000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12819.flavor:
The third Steel Maiden is the Shield Maiden which protects all... or is she?
"I will protect Lady Athena! ...And everyone else while at it!"

BS14-081.name: The Stumpcity of God Tree
BS14-081.effect:
[LV1] (Your End Step)
You can reveal a card from your decktop. If that card is a Green Spirit card, you can summon it. If you're not summoning it, or it's some other card, return it to the decktop.
BS14-081.flavor:
I came across a tree city in the neighboring forest. It seems there are similar cities of Light Tree, Heaven Tree, and Sage Tree. Each has its own special peculiarities, so I'd like to see them all.
-from the Places of Interest 828/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS75-061.name: The Sunstone Air Fortress
BS75-061.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Crimson"/"Wurm" effects, you can deploy it.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Crimson"/"Wurm" attacks, you can +1 counter. Then, once per turn, if your Life or the opposing Life is at three or less, you can draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
Once per turn, you can pay one cost to summon one of your "Siegwurm" Contract cards in the Hand/Soul State/pre-advent condition.
BS75-061.flavor:
The Sunstonr Shrine was remodeled into a fortress.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 233―

BS69-033.name: The SturdyLionheart Guneus
BS69-033.effect:
When cards are put onto the opposing Removed Zone, you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can return an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.
BS69-033.flavor: "Hohoho. It's been such a long time since I last saw Lord Hermes looking so full of life."

BS34-X03.name: The StrangeFangShinobiHead Toudou
BS34-X03.effect:
When the opposing [Soul Core] is sent to the opposing Trash, after that effect resolves, you can summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Attacks/Blocks)
For each "Blade Beast" family Spirit/Ultimate you control, exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. All those Spirits/Ultimates can't be refreshed on the next (Opposing Refresh Step).
BS34-X03.flavor: The most pro-war member of Ninja Gale Village, skilled with all kinds of armor.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12824.name: The SteelMaiden004 Zenaida
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12824.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add one exactly-named "Grandwalker Athena/"Shield of Aegis"/"The SteelGoddess Athenaea" to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2] (Opposing Turn)
Your Life can only be reduced by one per turn by opposing effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12824.flavor:
The fourth Steel Maiden is an engineer which comes along and works with Athena to develop the Steel Knights.
"The Shield of Aegis' maintenance is complete. Hecateus, deliver this to Milady Athena."

BS08-056.name: The Sunstone Shrine
BS08-056.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When a Spirit with [Clash] you control attacks as the first attack of your turn, and only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by BP comparison, you can destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total BP of the Spirit destroyed.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirits with [Clash] are destroyed, by sending a core from your Life to the Void, they return to the Field, refreshed.
BS08-056.flavor:
A great temple the Dragons built to worship the Astral Dragons. Its grandeur exceeds the imagination three times over.
-from the Places of Interest 233/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS37-029.name: The StylishNinja Burberry Hopper
BS37-029.kanji: ハイカラ忍者バーバリホッパー
BS37-029.effect:
Flash- [Accel: Cost 3 ([Green Core][Green Core])]
During this turn, give one of your Spirits: "(When Attacks) When only the opposing Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by BP Comparison, send an opposing Life to the Trash." After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can return this Spirit to the Hand. When you've done so, refresh one of your Spirits.
BS37-029.flavor: In the middle half, "Scuderia Maclarn" overtakes racer Mistral-Bit with a quick recovery!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12827.name: The SteelMaiden006 Clytie
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12827.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Heavy Armor: Purple/White]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV1][LV2]
When White cards in your Hand/Removed Zone would be discarded/banished by opposing effects, for each of those cards, put a core from the Void to either your exactly-named "Grandwalker Athena" or "Android" family Spirits you control.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12827.flavor:
Out of the SteelMaidens created by Athena, the sixth one is Clytie. She can communicate with owls, Athena's holy bird.
"Oh, you've seen the ends of the world? How nice, one day, I'd like to... Ah, I have to recharge now, could you wait for a few moments?"

BS36-025.name: The StrangeFangShinobi Cheetah
BS36-025.flavor: As to be expected of the "Bugs" team members! Both racers and fighters, they're not at all afraid of the dangers hindering the race!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12829.name: The SteelMaiden007 Madeleine
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12829.effect:
This card in Removed Zone is unaffected by opposing effects.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 3 ([White Core])]
Put a core from the Void to your Trash. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When the opponent uses a White/Yellow Magic card, before the effect activates, by exhausting another "Android" family Spirit you control, immediately negate that effect.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12829.flavor: "On the name of the Steel Will. That is our pride!"

BS68-043.name: The SteelMaiden008 Tryphaena
BS68-043.kanji: 鋼鉄乙女008トリュファイナ
BS68-043.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 3 ([White Core])]
Put a core from the Void to your Trash. After this effect resolves, put this card onto your Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Either +2 cores in total to any of your "Contractor Athena" Grandwalker Nexuses, or put a core from the Void each to three White "Devotee"/"Concluser" family Spirits you control.
BS68-043.flavor: "Lord Hades is so cool for real! How can he be so handsome??? Among the twelve Olympians, Lord Apollon is the wild type, Lord Hermes is the punk type, and Lord Dionysus is the type with a dark past...Finally, we got the intellectual type!"

BSC45-085.name: The Sunstone Shrine LT
BSC45-085.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Cost 3 or more Spirit makes the first attack of the turn, you can draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirits with "Clash"-named effects would leave the Field due to the opponent, by sending one of your Lives to the Void, one of those Spirits remains on the Field, refreshed.
BSC45-085.flavor:
A great temple the Dragons built to worship the Astral Dragons. Its grandeur exceeds the imagination three times over.
-from the Places of Interest 233/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12832.name: The SteelMaiden009 Aspasia
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12832.effect:
Main- [Accel: Cost 3([White Core])]
Reveal two cards from your decktop. You can put "Steel" among them to your Removed Zone until it has six cards. Return any remaining cards to the decktop. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can summon up to two "Steel" from your Removed Zone, paying one cost for each. This effect doesn't trigger [Core Charge].
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12832.flavor:
The Ninth Steel Maiden is a saint of steel which guides the knights.
"I have your backs! Let's give Lady Athena this victory!"

BS32-023.name: The StrangeFangShinobi Jagan
BS32-023.effect:
[Burst: s] (After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect)
If the opposing Hand is five or more, the opponent discards two cards from their Hand. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.
BS32-023.flavor: The Supreme Beast Army that succeeded in attacking the fort of the Six Heaven Army was warmly welcomed by the land's people and held a banquet.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12834.name: The Super-TwelveGodKing Execeed Formula
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12834.kanji: 超・十二神皇エグゼシードF
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12834.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] [Seal: Super Seal] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Life, during this turn, this Spirit is treated as being on its highest level.

[Seal: During Seal] [LV2][LV3][LV4] [Pyro Drive] (When Attacks)
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's up to the number of "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirits you control, and you can target attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When you've done so, at the end of a blocked battle, for each Spirit/Ultimate destroyed in this battle, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12834.flavor: The new God-King which gallops into the next generation along with blue flames!!

BS69-036.name: The SteelMaiden011 Medis
BS69-036.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 2 ([White Core])]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Put a "Steel" from your Hand onto the Removed Zone, and when put, put a core from the Void to your Trash. If this effect put a "Devotee"/"Concluser" family card, your counter +1. After this effect resolves, put this card onto your Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Look at the top three cards of your deck, and return them to the decktop or deckbottom one by one.
BS69-036.flavor: "Ok, please let me look at your injuries... So a scratch. Let's fix it quick. Stay still please."

CARD-G01.name: The Super-TwelveGodKing Gale-Phoenix Zephyr
CARD-G01.kanji: 超・十二神皇ゲイル・フェニックスZ
CARD-G01.effect:
[Seal: When Sealed] Flash [Thunder Swift] (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this Spirit card from the Hand as Cost 4.

[LV1][LV2] [Seal: Seal] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can send the [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Life.

[Seal: When Sealed] [LV2] Flash [Thundering Soar] (When Attacks)
By paying one cost, refresh a "God-King" family Spirit you control, and this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Spirits/Ultimates with a number of cores on them equal or inferior to this Spirit's.
CARD-G01.flavor:
The green phoenix which reached its peak form by repeatedly resurrecting.
"Wind of Hope! Together with the thunder that destroys evil, give me power!"

P16-06.name: The Summer Means Swimming With Everyone
P16-06.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Between June 1st and August 31st, when your Blue Spirits are destroyed, discard a card from the opposing decktop, and when any Spirit card is discarded, those Spirits remain on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2]
The LV2 cost of all Blue Spirits you control becomes 2.
P16-06.flavor: When it's summer, let's all go swim in the ocean! Competing and inflatable rings are both fun. Huh? ChickenKnight, you can't swim?

BS43-026.name: The StrangeFangShinobi Jaguara
BS43-026.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Green] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV2] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom.
BS43-026.flavor: The Dark Pyroxene has six colors. Guarding it are six generals that must be defeated. Thank you for the information.

BS65-064.name: The SummonBadge Unicorn Medaille
BS65-064.kanji: 召喚徽章ユニコーンメダイユ
BS65-064.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1. Then, either return a [Vision] Magic card from your Trash to the Hand, or put it onto your Field.

[LV1]
When your "Phantom Contract" family Spirit [Contract Advent], you can immediately brave this Spirit-condition Brave to that Spirit in the same state as that Spirit.
BS65-064.flavor: An old-fashioned badge engraved with a horned Spirit that no one knows where did it come from.

BSC24-034.name: The SuperAncientApexSoldierKaiju Zoiger
BSC24-034.kanji: 超古代尖兵怪獣ゾイガー
BSC24-034.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Treat your "God"-named Spirit with [Soul Core] on it as being at its highest level.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
When summoning [The EvilGod Gatanothor] from your Hand, it gets -1 cost.
BSC24-034.flavor:
"The Evil Wings Razing the Land" acting as the Evil God's footsoldiers came from the Super Ancient Ruins R'lyeh surfacing out of the deep.
―Ultraman Tiga―

BS32-025.name: The StrangeFangShinobi Kangaroo
BS32-025.flavor:
Lunihel disguised himself as a peasant telling tales of the "Master's" tyranny with seeming truth, and later dined at Gyuumonji's feast.
―from the Soldier's Biography of "Sengoku Obscurities" by Kuroe―

CB22-011.name: The SuperAncientDarkKaiju Golba
CB22-011.kanji: 超古代闇怪獣ゴルバー
CB22-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
By banishing four cards from you decktop, draw a card.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
If there are ten or less cards in your deck, send three cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve.
CB22-011.flavor: Having two faces and four eyes, a mysterious Super-Ancient Dark Kaiju. Spreading its wings from the protruding parts of its shoulders, it could fly up the sky and release flaming balls from its horn.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12843.name: The StrangeFangShinobi Katanazelle
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12843.flavor:
There are interrogation records left from when some of the runaway ninjas were caught. From them, we learn that most of the runaways were low-ranking ninjas. This power can be used even by regular ninjas. This forbidden technique is fearsome.
―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―

BS65-X08.name: The SummonStaff Summon-Peak
BS65-X08.kanji: 召喚杖サモン・ピーク
BS65-X08.effect:
[B Engage: Contract Advent Spirit with "The Phantom Partner, Palm" as pre-advent]
(Once per Game: Same Name) When braving with the target, you can activate the following effect:
█ Until your next Start Step, your Hand and all your "Phantom Contract" family Spirits are unaffected by opposing effects.

[During Brave] (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, when you use any Magic, return a Magic card with [Vision] from your Trash to the Hand, and draw a card from the deckbottom. Also, if you have six counters or more, during this turn, this Spirit gains an extra Yellow symbol.

CB01-032.name: The SuperAncientGhostWingedBeast Shibito Zoiger
CB01-032.kanji: 超古代怨霊翼獣シビトゾイガー
CB01-032.effect:
You can put any amount of copies of this card in deck.

This Spirit/Spirit card is also treated as being exactly-named "The SuperAncientApexSoldierKaiju Zoiger"

[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Add a "Gatanothor"/"Zoiger"-named Spirit card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.
CB01-032.flavor:
They're smaller Zoigers, but attack in great numbers. It has the power to change into the form of the humans it attacks and devours.
―Ultraman Tiga THE FINAL ODDYSEY―

BS65-073.name: The Summon Gate
BS65-073.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "The Phantom Partner, Palm", draw a card from the deckbottom. By discarding a Magic card with [Vision] from your Field, this effect draws +1 card.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Increase the cost of all your "The Phantom Partner, Palm" Spirits and Spirits with "The Phantom Partner, Palm" as pre-advent card by +1.

The gate which opens when Spirits are summoned from the other worlds. If it is set open permanently then it will be right like what Dan does.
―Travelogue of the Collapsing World 570―

―Ultraman Tiga―

BSC24-046.name: The SuperAncientRuins R'lyeh

―Ultraman Tiga―

What was the result of our final battle, you ask? If you want to know the answer, just look at the night sky. Because you'll see the radiance of the twelve zodiacs.
―"Reborn Star Negotiation Memos" Fin―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12926.name: The SuperstarApostle Spitzer Dragon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12926.kanji: 超星使徒スピッツァードラゴン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12926.effect:
This card in Trash can't be returned to the Hand/deck, and can't be switched in places.

When the opponent declares a Burst activation, you can pay one cost to immediately summon this card from the Hand. When you've done so, discard one of those Bursts, and either put two cores from the Void to this Spirit or + cores to any Grandwalker Nexuses you control, in any way you like.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate, and when it destroys, refresh this Spirit.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12926.flavor: The two Supernovas guide us. Towards the new planet of gods, Laniakea.

LM19-01.name: The SuperstarDragonBlade Siegwurm Sword
LM19-01.kanji: 超星龍剣ジークヴルムソード
LM19-01.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] [Twinkle Clash] (When Attacks)
Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible. When blocked, you can [Advent] a card from your Hand onto this Spirit, without sending [Soul Core] to the Trash.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
You can exhaust this Nexus. When you've done so, send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to any of your "Superstar" family Spirit and, during this turn, all your Spirits with [Soul Core] on it gain +5000 BP.

BS62-037.name: The SupportRobo Pick
BS62-037.kanji: サポートロボ ピック
BS62-037.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can pay one cost to summon a White Contract Spirit card that is in your Hand/Soul State condition. When you've done so, draw a card.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
From turn 3 onward, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any White Contract Spirit, for each two costs of one of such Spirits, your counter +1.
BS62-037.flavor: The High Priestess decided to lend her power to Stark, who was trying to protect the town from the incoming threat. Should we call that the intuition of a pope? Or an expression of expectation?

BS08-018.name: The SupremeDarkKnight Schwart
BS08-018.kanji: 暗黒騎士シュヴァルト
BS08-018.effect:
[Tribute: Cost 3 or more → Trash]
After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from one of your Cost 3 or more Spirits to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return an "Evil Shadow" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy all opposing exhausted Cost 4 or less Spirits.
BS08-018.flavor: Even yesterday's traitors can become today's saviors.

CB34-030.name: The SupremeDarkness N-Daguva-Zeba
CB34-030.kanji: 究極の闇ン・ダグバ・ゼバ
CB34-030.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing non-"Supreme" family Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Nightling"/"Enemy" family Spirit/Ultimate is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Ultimate effects.
CB34-030.flavor: "The one who brings Supreme Darkness", and one who is called the ruler of Gurongi. It is officially addressed by the police as "Unidentified Lifeform No.0".

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12931.name: The SupremeDestructionDeity Dragno
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12931.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy three opposing 13000 BP or less Spirits, and all opposing Nexuses/six-colored Grandwalker Nexuses, and effects of the destroyed Spirits/Nexuses can't activate.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Nexus effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, for each Nexus card in the opposing Trash, send an opposing Life to the Trash.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12931.flavor: “Take the world! Take it all with your four arms…!”

BS67-X07.name: The SupremeEmperor Kaiser-Raon
BS67-X07.kanji: 覇皇帝カイゼル・ラオン
BS67-X07.effect:
Flash - [Reverse Contract Advent: "The PartnerLion Raon" & C8 or more, (Your Turn)]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By sending your [Soul Core] or the opposing [Soul Core] to the Trash, or by -1 opposing counter, stacking this card from your Hand onto its target, including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
If there are four or more cards with [AFO] in your Trash, you can put two cores from the Void to this Spirit. Then, you can summon any number of differently-named cards with [AFO] from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
If you control four or more Spirits than the opponent does, send two opposing Life to the Reserve.

X13-16.name: The SupremeHero Manaka
X13-16.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed by the opponent]
When the total color of Spirits you control is two or more, summon this Spirit card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing "Supreme Hero" family Spirit.

[LV2][LV3][LV4]
While the opponent has a Burst set/controls any Spirit with a Burst effect, this Spirit gains +10000 BP.
X13-16.flavor: It's not my style... but I will defeat you!

BSC24-044.name: The Targeted Town
BSC24-044.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Seijin"-named Spirit attacks, you can target and attack an opposing exhausted Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Seijin"-named Spirit attacks, send a core from one opposing Spirit to their Reserve.
BSC24-044.flavor:
Metron Seijin, who had come to conquer Earth, hid out in and acted from a cheap apartment in the city of Kitagawa. He cheerfully received Moroboshi Dan when he sneaked in.
―Ultraseven―

BS31-X06.name: The SupremeRealmWisdomKing Nirvana
BS31-X06.kanji: 覇界明王ニルヴァーナ
BS31-X06.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest cost. For each of the Spirit/Ultimate's cost destroyed by this effect, discard a card from the opposing decktop.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] (Your Attack Step)
While [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, when the "Opposing Deck-Discarding effect" of your "WisdomKing"-named Spirit discards any Cost 3 card, refresh that Spirit.
BS31-X06.flavor: The Fist of Gandala saves the weak, while it supresses, pierces, and crushes the strong.

BS54-031.name: The TearWar Teardropper
BS54-031.kanji: 涙戦ティアドロッパー
BS54-031.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When you're deploying a "Mega-Grandstone"-named Nexus card, this Spirit gains an extra Green symbol.

[LV2]
All your White Grandstone Nexuses gain an extra White symbol.
BS54-031.flavor:
To seek new information, we've come to the "White World". While we were looking for any responses from the talisman, messengers who claimed to be looking for us appeared. They were saying that they would like to talk to the ones who were associated with Alex. Although it might be a trap, we have no choice but to follow them.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 3:30―

26RBS02-083.name: The Supreme Cactus Wall
26RBS02-083.effect:
[LV1-2] Your Attack Step
All opposing Cost 5 or less Spirits that are destroyed at 0 BP are returned to the deckbottom in any order instead of being sent to the Trash.

[LV2] Either Attack StepOnce Per Turn
When your non-attacking/non-blocking "Topaz" family Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, draw a card.
26RBS02-083.flavor: Whatever you do, don’t even think about trying to cut your way through.

P16-23.name: The Tearful Graduation Ceremony
P16-23.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
Between February 1st and March 31st, by returning an opposing Cost 7 or more Spirit to the Hand, draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Start Step)
You can summon a Cost 2 or less Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.
P16-23.flavor: A tearful graduation ceremony. It's sad to say goodbye to everyone, but new encounters lie ahead!

BS63-CP06.name: The TempestFangEmperor Sturm-Lampo
BS63-CP06.kanji: 激嵐牙皇シュトゥルム・ランポ
BS63-CP06.effect:
Flash - [Ultra Contract Advent: "The PartnerWolf Lampo" & C7 or more, (Your Turn)]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By stacking this card from your Hand onto its target, including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition, send your [Soul Core] to this Spirit.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit gains every effect of a "Grom-Lampo" pre-advent card beneath this Spirit, ignoring levels.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By heavy exhausting an opposing Spirit/Nexus, this Spirit refreshes. Then, you can return an opposing exhausted Spirit/Nexus to the deckbottom.

BS33-054.name: The SurgeMusha Seijuurou
BS33-054.kanji: 潮武者セイジュウロウ
BS33-054.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Beast Head" family Spirit/Ultimate effect destroys any opposing Spirit/Ultimate, draw two cards. Then, discard one card from your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit.
BS33-054.flavor: In preparation for their skirmish with the Six Heaven Army, the Heaven Squad requested to form an alliance with the Azure Fang Squad.

BS41-077.name: The Temple Engulfed In Green
BS41-077.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced, draw a card for each Life reduced.

[LV2]
All Spirit cards/Brave cards in the opposing Trash are unaffected by opposing effects, and their effects can't be used.
BS41-077.flavor:
A temple erected in memorial of the Ultimates from the Reverse Continent safely leaving both continents. It has been saturated with green because of the rainstorms.
-from the Places of Interest 655/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BS30-027.name: The SurvivorAngelia Kuroel
BS30-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Cards can't be discarded from either player's deck, and this Spirit can't be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV2] [Disp: 2] (When Battles)
When you use a Magic card that targets one opposing Spirit/Ultimate, change the number of targets to two.
BS30-027.flavor: The continent's descent has stopped completely. It looks like our mission has been accomplished.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12943.name: The TenJudges Henjou
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12943.effect:
[Immortality: 0/3/8] (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this card from your Trash when your Cost 0/3/8 Spirit is destroyed.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Your Cost 4 or less "Evil Shadow"/"Youkai" family Spirits are unaffected by opposing Burst effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Evil Shadow"/"Youkai" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12943.flavor: "I'm one of the Ten Judges, Henjou. Your destination is the Maharaurava!"

BS25-037.name: The SurvivorAngelia Mael
BS25-037.kanji: 生還者 天使メイル
BS25-037.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit can't be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
All your "Divine Spirit" family Spirits get +2000 BP. If you control any Ultimate, instead, all your "Divine Spirit" family Spirits/Ultimates get +4000 BP.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Isfiel"-named Ultimate attacks, draw two cards.
BS25-037.flavor: The leader of the Guardian Generals is my former classmate, Mael-chan!

BS51-065.name: The TenJudges Shinkou
BS51-065.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can reveal one card from your decktop. If the revealed card is Purple/Yellow, give an opposing Spirit -5000 BP. Destroy it when it is brought to 0 BP. Add the revealed card to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Evil Shadow"/"Youkai" family Spirit [advents] onto this Spirit, you can pay one cost to summon this pre-advent card.
BS51-065.flavor: “I am one of the Ten Judges, Shinkou. Let's start by having you receive my judgement."

P17-01.name: The Survivor Armored Panther
P17-01.kanji: 生還者アーマードパンサー
P17-01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as White.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can't be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When stacking a Red/White card onto this Spirit via [Advent], draw a card.
P17-01.flavor: Those who survived the Empty Sky are holding a secret.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12947.name: The TenJudges Shokou
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12947.effect:
While there is any "Evil Shadow"/"Youkai" family Spirit card in your Trash, this set card is unaffected by opposing effects.

[Burst: After your Spirit is Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent]
Summon a Cost 4 or less "Evil Shadow"/"Youkai" family card from your Trash, without paying the cost. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send one core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve. Then, return an opposing LV1 Spirit to the Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12947.flavor: "I am one of the Ten Judges, called Shokou. I am good at water tricks"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12948.name: The Survivor Beebird
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12948.effect: [LV1][LV2] Either player's deck cannot be discarded from, and this Spirit cannot be destroyed by opposing effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12948.flavor: You're staying? Why! It's true that you're much stronger than we are. Because you're an Ultimate. But even so, is there any need for a young girl like you to stay in this land alone!?

P17-03.name: The Survivor Buckler-Bit
P17-03.kanji: 生還者バックラー・ビット
P17-03.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Red.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit can't be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When stacking a Red/Green card is stacked onto this Spirit via [Advent], put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.
P17-03.flavor: Normally, once you're caught by the Empty Sky, you become unable to move, only being further enveloped by it. How did they survive.....?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12950.name: The TenShikiWarOgres Danzou
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12950.effect:
When this card is sent from the Deck to the Trash by the effect of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Tsukuyomi", you can summon it without paying the cost.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By sending one of your Life to this Spirit, during this step, this Spirit gains two extra Yellow symbols. Your Bursts can't activate via this effect.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12950.flavor: "I hereby command thee: Danzou, dance as a spiral."

BS25-046.name: The Survivor Buddy
BS25-046.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can't be destroy by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Cost 5/6 (When Battles)
At the end of the battle, by destroying this Spirit, summon a Cost 5/6 Spirit card in the same family as this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BS25-046.flavor: A respected Guardian General who protects us all from the Ultimates. It doesn't really matter, but... "Guardian General" by itself it sounds pretty cool, but adding "respected" onto it makes it awesome.

BS51-022.name: The TenShikiWarOgres Kage Kojirou
BS51-022.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks) For each "Evil Shadow"/"Youkai" family Spirit you control, the cost of Magic cards in the opposing Hand/Removed Zone increases by +1.

[LV2][LV3] For each two Purple/Yellow card in your Trash, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
BS51-022.flavor:
My other younger brother is nowhere to be seen. But he never stands in the frontlines of a battle anyway, unless something incredible happens.
ー"Genesis Records" New Volume 4:07ー

BSC45-063.name: The SwordBraver Ryute LT
BSC45-063.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
All your "Braver" Spirits are unaffected by opposing Blue Nexus effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your LV2/LV3 "Braver" Spirit attacks, you can draw a card.
BSC45-063.flavor:
I am powerless. Therefore, I entrusted my vengeance to him.
-from the 11th paragraph in chapter Yellow of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12954.name: The TenShikiWarOgres Reverse Musashi
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12954.effect:
When an opposing Spirit with two symbols or more attacks, you can pay two costs to summon this card from the Trash.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) Destroy an opposing exhausted 7000 BP or less Spirit. Also, when summoned by this Spirit's effect, destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] For each two Purple/Yellow cards in your Trash, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12954.flavor: "I hereby command ye, most peerless fencers of all time, cut down the enemies in my path."

BS30-049.name: The SwordDancePriestess Maiel
BS30-049.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or higher Spirits]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (Start of Your Attack Step)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, you can summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
[utb]

[LV4][LV5]
For each "Divine Spirit" family Spirit/Ultimate you control, this Ultimate's cost increases by 1.
BS30-049.flavor: We're saying farewell to the SwordsSaints of this land too. I'm glad that we could help.

BS25-020.name: The Survivor Fugue
BS25-020.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit can't be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2] [Bunshin: 1] (When Depleted by the Opponent)
By placing one cards from your decktop onto the Field facedown and putting at least one core from the Reserve onto it, until the end of the game, it is treated as "Cost 0/"Bunshin" family/LV1: 1 core, 3000 BP/[Green Core]" Green Bunshin Spirits. (Bunshin Spirits can't be braved, and are discarded when sent to the Hand/Deck.)
BS25-020.flavor: This is just between us, but my brother was chosen as a Guardian General candidate. He was bitter about it, but I'm glad he wasn't picked. It would have worried me.

SD03-002.name: The SwordDinoman Stegorus
SD03-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
While you control two or fewer Spirits, treat this Spirit as being at LV3.
SD03-002.flavor: No longer is this about the Dragon/Dinosaur War. Thinking that the future will come no matter who loses is a bit ironic.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12958.name: The TenShikiWarOgres Shiki Wakamaru
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12958.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can send one of your Lives to this Spirit. When you've done so, you can summon from your Trash a Cost 3 or less "Evil Shadow"/"Youkai" family card, besides any exactly-named "The TenShikiWarOgres Shiki Wakamaru", without paying the cost. Your Bursts can't activate via this effect.
[Rush: Yellow]
(While you have a Yellow symbol, the following effect activate next)
[Yellow Core]: If your Life is five or less, you can send a core, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to your Life.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12958.flavor: "I hereby command thee: Shiki Wakamaru, leap across the eight ships."

P17-08.name: The Survivor KiteCobra
P17-08.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as White.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can't be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When [adventing] a Purple/White card onto this Spirit, send a core from any opposing Spirit that is not During Advent to their Trash.
P17-08.flavor: There seems to be someone who saw a glow in the empty space that should not have anything. And six colors shine... What is it?

BS07-009.name: The SwordDragonEmperor Ex-Calibus
BS07-009.kanji: 剣龍皇エクス・キャリバス
BS07-009.effect:
[Tribute: Cost 3 or more → Trash]
After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from one of your Spirits with a designated cost to the designated area.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 6000 BP.

[LV2] [Clash] (When Attacks)
The opponent must block if possible.
BS07-009.flavor: “When taking down enemies, casualties are unavoidable,” you say? I'd certainly like to hear the opinions of the wounded allies needlessly involved in the onslaught…

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12961.name: The TenShikiWarOgres Yami Benkei
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12961.effect:
Flash - Advent: Evil Shadow/Youkai (Either Attack Step)
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Advents) You can discard a card from your Hand. When you've done so, draw two cards.

[LV2] (Your Turn) Your Cost 5 or more "Evil Shadow"/"Youkai" family Spirits are unaffected by opposing Burst effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12961.flavor:
"You'll betray us too?!"
Tsukuyomi answers Alex's screaming with nothing but a sarcastic smile.
ー"Genesis Records" New Volume 3:44ー

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12962.name: The SwordDragon Stegodita
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12962.effect: [LV1][LV2][LV3] Clash (When Attacks) The opponent must block if possible.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12962.flavor: Like a projectile weapon, it throws itself at its enemy. It's an attack method that makes the most use of its body.

BS21-052.name: The TenSwordMasters Bourde-Sainos
BS21-052.kanji: 十剣聖ブールド・サイノス
BS21-052.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When the opposing Burst activates, by destroying a "Fusion Beast" family Spirit you control, negate the activation of that Burst and discard it.

[LV2][LV3] [When Braved] (When Battles)
This Spirit gains +2000 BP for each "Fusion Beast" family Spirit you control.
BS21-052.flavor: His combined full-body charge and sword attack gives no time to evade, let alone counterattack.

BS30-018.name: The Survivor Kouroko
BS30-018.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2]
Cards can't be discarded from either player's deck, and this Spirit can't be destroyed by opposing effects.
BS30-018.flavor: There's a reaction from P-Major! This six-colored aura can't be anyone but Lolo! Let's go to him immediately!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12965.name: The SwordEmperorDoll †Enchante†
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12965.kanji: 剣帝ドール†アンシャンテ†
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12965.effect:
When this card is discarded from your Hand by the [Grand Skill] of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Hera," you can pay three cost to summon it.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
If it's your Attack Step, you can discard a card from your decktop. If it's a "Doll"-named card, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit gets +10000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12965.flavor:
Hera's second sword. A blade that strikes whenever there's conflict. This is also a shape of love.
"I can't stand you, OgreBladeEmperor... I am Lady Hera's sword...."

BS25-003.name: The Survivor Neo-Arc
BS25-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can't be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
The number of cores on this Spirit can't be brought to zero by any player's effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
If you control any Ultimate, this Spirit gains +5000 BP, and you draw a card.
BS25-003.flavor: Representing all the different species of the world, the bravest warriors recognized for their defensive skills were appointed as "Guardian Generals" and placed in charge of the world's defense forces.

BS66-009.name: The SwordEmperorDragon Duclid
BS66-009.kanji: 剣帝龍デュークリッド
BS66-009.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Heat Contract & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents)
You can send up to three cores from your Trash to this Spirit. Then, you can destroy two opposing 15000 BP or less Spirits/Ultimates.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2]
Your "Heat Contract" family "Destruction effects" can only be prevented by "Armor"-named effects.

BS30-001.name: The Survivor Ryuuman-Falco
BS30-001.kanji: 生還者リューマン・ファルコ
BS30-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Cards from every player's deck cannot be discarded, and this Spirit cannot be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV2] Spirit Soul: Red - When you summon an Ultimate card, this Spirit gets [Red Core](1 extra Red Symbol).
BS30-001.flavor: Now that all our forces are gathered, we must use that force to the fullest. Let's target the enemy boss and take him down!

BS38-007.name: The SwordEmperorWarDragon Zettou-Dragon
BS38-007.kanji: 剣皇武龍ゼットウ・ドラゴン
BS38-007.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit. If this effect can't destroy any opposing Spirits, send an opposing Life to their Reserve. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
BS38-007.flavor: He is the strongest warrior in this era and the inheritor of Onimaru-Shin'uchi.

BS20-017.name: The TenSwordMasters Cobraja
BS20-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return a Brave card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

BS19-064.name: The TenSwordMasters Egbert
BS19-064.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard two cards from the opposing decktop.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirits with [Charge] attack, the opponent can't activate Red Bursts.

[When Braved] [LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's.
BS19-064.flavor: I had him take the giant sword that I could not carry.

SD24-008.name: The SwordGeneral Sution
SD24-008.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or higher Spirits]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (Opposing Attack Step)

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, draw two cards. Then, discard a card from your Hand.
[utb]
SD24-008.flavor: If it weren't for his advice, the meeting we had would have ended in failure.

BS21-027.name: The TenSwordMasters Gohonkaku
BS21-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
Exhaust two opposing Spirits.
BS21-027.flavor: The intimidating five-horned one boasts of his unbeatable skill with the sword.

BS17-X01.name: The SwordHero Sieg-Susano-Fried
BS17-X01.kanji: 天剣の覇王ジーク・スサノ・フリード
BS17-X01.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
If your Life is at three or less, for each Red Spirit you control, destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +10000 BP.

[LV3][LV4]
While you have a Burst set, this Spirit gains an extra Red Symbol.
BS17-X01.flavor: His blade of black flame scorches the very air it touches!

BS19-053.name: The TenSwordMasters Luciel
BS19-053.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -2000 BP.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
During the Flash Timing, you can use a Yellow Magic card without paying the cost.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
When you use a Cost 3 Magic card, after that effect resolves, refresh this Spirit.
BS19-053.flavor: She has magnificent skill with the sword she swings. Is she too aiming at the Sacred Swords?

BS13-029.name: The SwordHorse Granim
BS13-029.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
All your Red Spirits can block opposing 6000 BP or less Spirits while exhausted.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
All your Red Spirits can block opposing Brave Spirits while exhausted.

[LV3]
This Spirit is also treated as a Red spirit.
BS13-029.flavor:
The white world that I know has already been invaded. Still, it would be better than now.
-from the 2nd paragraph of the final chapter in "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS19-033.name: The TenSwordMasters Murasame
BS19-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[When Braved] [LV1][LV2]
Give all your "Winged Beast" family Spirits: "(When Battles) The opponent can't activate their Burst."

[LV2] (When Attacks)
If this is the first attack of your Turn, refresh this Spirit.
BS19-033.flavor: His sword can split an enemy in two with just one flap of a wing.

BSC49-033.name: The SwordHorse Granim LT

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Red. Also, all your Red Spirits can block while exhausted.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When your Red Spirit attacks/blocks, you can put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BSC49-033.flavor:
The white world that I know has already been invaded. Still, it would be better than now.
-from the 2nd paragraph of the final chapter in "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS21-042.name: The TenSwordMasters Narasimha
BS21-042.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing LV1 Spirits.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
Return a Cost 2 Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: Exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS21-042.flavor: Despite his appearance, he can easily slip through enemy lines and scatter them.

BS29-049.name: The SwordMasterAngelia Momoel
BS29-049.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or higher Spirits]

[When Braved] [Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Brave Attacks)]

[utb]

[LV4][LV5] (Either Attack Step)
Either player's Life can't be reduced by attacks of Spirits with [Rush].
BS29-049.flavor:
What is the connection between the two continents and the SwordsSaints?
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, Past Records: Day 11—

BS19-X01.name: The TenSwordMasters Starblade-Dragon
BS19-X01.kanji: 十剣聖スターブレード・ドラゴン
BS19-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the highest BP.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)

BS19-X01.flavor: The SwordsSaint bearing the title of strongest appears carrying a sword.

BS29-019.name: The SwordMasterBeetle Tenagakogane
BS29-019.kanji: 剣聖甲蟲テナガコガネ
BS29-019.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can brave with any of your "Exalted Sword" family Brave, ignoring its Brave Condition.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
You can brave one of your "Exalted Sword" family Braves to a non-braved Ultimate you control.
BS29-019.flavor:
Once we crossed over Empty Sky, a new world awaited.
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, Past Records: Day 8—

BS21-036.name: The TenSwordMasters Zanba-Kong
BS21-036.kanji: 十剣聖ザンバー・コング
BS21-036.effect:
[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Nexus to the Hand.
[Rush: Green/Blue]
(While you have Green/Blue symbols, the following effect activate next)
[Green Core]: Exhaust an opposing Spirit.
[Blue Core]: This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting a Nexus you control.

[When Braved] [LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your Brave Spiritd, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
BS21-036.flavor: He released a series of dimension-splitting slashes that could sink a fortress!

BS29-012.name: The SwordMasterDemonKing Gaap
BS29-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw a card. If you control any "Exalted Sword" family Brave, also, draw a card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
Return a "Fencer" family Spirit card/Ultimate card from your Trash to the Hand.
BS29-012.flavor:
At last we have reached Darkness Hole.
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, Past Records: Day 12—

BS23-052.name: The SwordMasterGeneral Firanda
BS23-052.kanji: 剣聖将軍フィランダー
BS23-052.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Unsheathe] (When Summoned)

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw two cards. Then, discard two cards from your Hand.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's. After this effect resolves, destroy a Brave on this Spirit.
BS23-052.flavor: "Emperor Eon, I believe that you will be the one to use that power properly."

BS35-026.name: The Tenth's Apostle Yurikamo
BS35-026.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When the opponent would summon any non-Green Spirit card via effects, it is summoned in exhausted condition.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BS35-026.flavor: The endgame course of the Norse-Trio GP is a complete 180 from the poor visibility of the forest course, and is instead a prairie bare as the eye can see. The snow's piled on thick, so it's sure to trip up the contestants.

BSC21-X02.name: The SwordMasterGeneral Kaidou Tsunoshige
BSC21-X02.kanji: 剣聖武将カイドウ ツノシゲ
BSC21-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit can brave with up to two Braves.

[When Braved] [LV2] (When Battles)
At the end of battle, once per turn, if this Spirit is braved with two Braves, refresh this Spirit.
BSC21-X02.flavor: "The Five Dominance Swords... splitting them between five countries means leaving one out."

BS39-032.name: The Tenth's BeastBattleship King Ox the 5th
BS39-032.kanji: 癸の獣戦艦キングオックス5世
BS39-032.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Your Spirits with two or more symbols can't be blocked by opposing Ultimates.
[During Seal] Also, your Spirits with two or more symbols can't be blocked by opposing Spirits.
BS39-032.flavor: The perfectly coordinated march of the steel armada from Avalanche-Bison's team "Gigantea" is truly marvelous to behold. If only they could go a little faster, there'd be nothing to fault them for.

BS36-052.name: The Tenth's ExplosiveBeast Babyracer
BS36-052.kanji: 癸の爆獣バビレーサー
BS36-052.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Roaring Azure" family Spirits attack/block, discard two cards from the opposing decktop.

[During Seal] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "God-King" / "Ten Crown" family Spirit is attacking, when the opponent would activate a Burst, unless they pay for the cost of the card, it can't be activated.
BS36-052.flavor: Racer Calamity-Boar has just reached the goal, straining for the sake of the forcibly retired Racer Dos-Deimos! Now half of the winning spots are filled!

BS23-026.name: The SwordMasterMagusShinobi Jiraiya
BS23-026.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Unsheathe] (When Summoned)
You can summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card that can brave with this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
For each Bunshin Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.
BS23-026.flavor: The toad he calls upon is multifarious. Working together with the toad, he can make an infinite number of sword techniques.

BS36-056.name: The Tenth's ExplosiveBeast Grizzcrash
BS36-056.kanji: 癸の爆獣グリズクラッシュ
BS36-056.effect:
When this card would be discarded from the Hand via your effect, instead of sending it to the Trash, you can summon it without paying the cost.

[During Seal] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard seven cards from the opposing decktop, and when any Magic card is discarded, destroy an opposing Spirit with the highest cost.
BS36-056.flavor: I've been told that the race will continue, and that the racers have started up all at once again. That's all from Tonio, on scene. Back to Harold-san's coverage.

BS29-032.name: The SwordMasterMusician Oliviel
BS29-032.kanji: 剣聖楽師オリヴィエル
BS29-032.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can brave with any of your "Exalted Sword" family Brave, ignoring its Brave Condition.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When This Spirit Brave Attacks)
Targeted an opposing Ultimate. During this turn, the targeted Ultimate can't block.
BS29-032.flavor:
The Saviour is said to have witnessed the destruction of the Realms.
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, Past Records: Day 4—

P16-12.name: The Tenth's HoppingBeast Belgian
P16-12.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve. If you control another "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirit, also, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the Hand.
P16-12.flavor: One of the runners from Animalodge, which is led by the Rabbit Twelve God-King Mistral-Bit. A team made up of nothing but fast Imps will certainly guide Mistral-Bit to the goal.

BSC25-010.name: The Third's WhiteImperialSteed Lipitzzaner
BSC25-010.kanji: 丙の白皇馬リピッツナー
BSC25-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit. If you control another “Emperor Beast” family Spirit, also, return a Red Magic card from your Trash to the Hand.

When any opposing Spirit is destroyed by your Magic effects, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
BSC25-010.flavor: Racers Andaluzia and Lipitzzaner lead the way, breaking the wind for Felarl Racing and pushing on through the fierce gusts!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12995.name: The Tenth's SpearBeast Yariarashi
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12995.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as White.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your End Step)
This Spirit refreshes.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12995.flavor: The ones which are slightly late to the lead and run through the island flourishing with a tropical rainforest are the rivals Racer Lio-Bit and Racer Bros-Tiger.

BSC21-X03.name: The SwordMasterPrincess Tsuru
BSC21-X03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal up to five cards from your decktop. Add all cards with Burst effects among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core] from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts. After that Burst activates, this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Spirits with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's.
BSC21-X03.flavor: "We're going forth! Himetsuruichimonji, lend me your strength..."

BS38-CP07.name: The Third's WoodMonkey Nala
BS38-CP07.effect:
Flash- [Accel: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core][Blue Core])]
By putting a Spirit card with [Accel] from your Hand face-up onto the Removed Zone, draw a card. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return any number of Green/Yellow/Blue Spirit cards with [Accel] from your Removed Zone to your Hand.
BS38-CP07.flavor: When there are rivers and valleys that ground racers can't cross, if the boss monkey racer Nara can cross it, there'll be an impromptu bridge up in no time at all. That's one fast-working monkey.

BSC48-X05.name: The SwordMasterPrincess Tsuru X
BSC48-X05.effect:
This card/Spirit gains the "Devotee"/"Concluser"/"Vassal"/"Lord" families.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal up to five cards from your decktop. Among them, add every Brave card/Burst card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] [True Catalyze] (When Attacks)
If [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, you can immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts. After that Burst activates, during this turn, this Spirit can't be blocked.
BSC48-X05.flavor: "I am also lending you my strength, as long as this can end the war..."

SD33-009.name: The ThirdBeastKing Blazoma
SD33-009.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
If your Life is three or less, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy every opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can summon a Red "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
SD33-009.flavor: The representative runner of "Scuderia Criniera" and one of the top choices to win! Seeing him roar with his burning mane is truly regal.

BS37-038.name: The TenthArtifactBeast Grosso-Teriuman
BS37-038.kanji: 癸械獣グロッソ・テリウマン
BS37-038.effect:

All your "Ten Crown" family can block while exhausted.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)

BS37-038.flavor: This is Polish, before the start line! With Racer Glorious-Sheep at the lead position, the team is getting in formation. Could this blue Machine Beast at the center be a new weapon?

BS29-039.name: The SwordMasterSeaBeast SwordHydra
BS29-039.kanji: 剣聖海獣ソードハイドラ
BS29-039.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)

[LV1][LV2][LV3]

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by braving an "Exalted Sword" family Brave you control to this non-braved Spirit, destroy an opposing Spirit with [Rush].
BS29-039.flavor:
Upon reaching the city, we obtained a variety of information concerning the Twelve Sacred Swords.
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, Past Records: Day 10—

BS37-008.name: The ThirdBeast Blast Tiger
BS37-008.kanji: 丙獣ブラストタイガー
BS37-008.flavor: It seems the state of the accident has just now reached Revol-Tiger, who runs ahead. Racer Exeseed is the racer who made him aim for BSGP. As expected, he cannot hide his trembling, and his running is being influenced...

SLED-BLITZEN.name: The TenthArtifactBeast Sled-Blitzen
SLED-BLITZEN.kanji: 癸械獣スレッド・ブリッツェン
SLED-BLITZEN.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Blocks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
Refresh all your "Machine Beast" family Spirits.
SLED-BLITZEN.flavor: Live from the scene! The Evil God-King and Twelve God-Kings are continuing their standoff. The BSGP has lasted through countless crises before, but will continuing the race be impossible this time!?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13004.name: The ThirdBeast Ringtail
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13004.effect:
When this Spirit card is revealed by your [The TigerTwelveGodKing Revol-Tiger]'s effect, you can summon it without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit. When this Spirit is summoned from the Deck, instead, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13004.flavor: Once Racer Revol-Tiger heard the information about the Evil God Army's raid, he withdrew from the course. He seems to have headed to intercept, leaving the words: "I'm leaving the race to Bros-Tiger."

BS30-008.name: The Survivor Shieldenritter
BS30-008.kanji: 生還者シールデンリッター
BS30-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Cards from every player's deck cannot be discarded, and this Spirit cannot be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step) When your Purple Spirit/Ultimate cards are put into the trash by opposing Ultimate-Trigger, after the trigger resolves, you can summon all of the triggered Spirit/Ultimate cards without paying the cost.
BS30-008.flavor: Something is fighting against the Spirits. What does this mean?

BSC21-X01.name: The SwordMasterWarDragon Mitsurugi-Dragon
BSC21-X01.kanji: 剣聖武龍ミツルギ・ドラゴン
BSC21-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your End Step)
You can set a card with Burst effect from your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts. For each opposing Spirit depleted/destroyed by that Burst effect, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
BSC21-X01.flavor: "Even if my lord dies, this fine blade shall be passed on and await the next war."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13007.name: The Thorny Colosseum
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (During Your Battle Phase) Cores cannot be moved from any battling spirits.

[LV2] (During Your Battle Phase) Battling spirits are unaffected by the effects of spirits or spells either player controls.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13007.flavor:
The final defense line the Elders established against Shellmen. This structure was abandoned when the gigantic Kaiseratlas appeared, as it was not strong enough to stop him.
-from the Places of Interest 85/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo-"

P17-09.name: The Survivor Silviel
P17-09.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as White.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can't be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When stacking a Yellow/White card onto this Spirit via [Advent], target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, that Spirit can't attack/block.
P17-09.flavor: In spite of having lost her power in the empty sky, she has gained the physique that can withstand even the power of the empty sky...That being said, she probably didn't intend to be absorbed into the empty sky.

BSC21-003.name: The SwordMasterWisdomKing Shura
BSC21-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts.
BSC21-003.flavor: Onimaru, Doujikiri, Mikazuki, Juzumaru, and Ootenta. The power of the Five Dominance Swords were needed to banish the DemonSword.

BS65-067.name: The Thouarwell Control Tower
BS65-067.kanji: トゥアーウェル管制塔
BS65-067.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Red Core][Red Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, when your "Sky Contract" family Spirit attacks, by paying one cost, draw a card.

[LV1] (Start of Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) Besides [Soul Core], by sending a core from your Trash to any of your "Sky Contract" family Spirits, during this turn, the "target attack" of your Spirits can also target Ultimates.
BS65-067.flavor:
A new air navigation facility built to monitor the sky after the Judgment Day. While it is meant to prepare for the invasion of enemies from the outside world, is it really necessary for a would that is about to end?
―Travelogue of the Collapsing World 374―

BSC21-001.name: The SwordMasterWraith Eaglen
BSC21-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned
You can summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts.
BSC21-001.flavor: "Let me test if this DemonBlade brought forth from hell is as powerful as legend."

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13012.name: The ThousandBeastsKing Dos-Deimos
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13012.kanji: 千獣の王者ドス・ダイモス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13012.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the highest cost. If your Hand is two or less, also, this Spirit gains an extra Blue symbol.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13012.flavor: "Terra Stampede"'s new strength! His rampage is earth-shaking!!

BS31-096.name: The Thousand Bay Kannon Temple
BS31-096.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
All your "Fighting Spirit" family Spirits gain +2000 BP.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When cards are discarded from the opposing deck due to the (When Attacks) effect of your Spirit with [Soul Core] on it, discard five cards from the opposing decktop.
BS31-096.flavor: A temple rising high above the mountains that separate the domains of Gandala and Onmyou Territory. It was here that the arbitrations of the Battles of Kaminakajima were held.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13014.name: The TenthArtifactSacred Shine-Griff
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13014.kanji: 癸械神機シャイングリフ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13014.effect:
After your White Burst activates, you can summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Blocks)
