BS42-062.kanji: 三つ首海賊団ロッド・ワイラー
BS42-062.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The cores on this Spirit can't be removed by the opponent.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
This Spirit gains an extra Green Symbol.
BS42-062.flavor: Another Pirate Gang that worships the Pyroxene Twelve Gems...While both are a member of the Pyroxene Twelve Gems, should I say he is tolerant, or perverse...? There are all sorts of different persons in the world...I guess. Ahahaha...

BS43-062.name: The ThreeHeadedPirateGang Ruki
BS43-062.effect:
The symbol of this Spirit card in your Removed Zone can also be treated as Green, and is also treated as a symbol on the Field.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 3 ([Blue Core][Green Core])]
Exhaust an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.
BS43-062.flavor:
The Vanity Deity Emperor had fallen, and the Dark Pyroxenes had been eliminated. Light had returned to the world.
-from the final section of "New Record of the Strange World" chapter Pyroxene Four-

BS43-065.name: The ThreeHeadedPirateGang Schnauzar
BS43-065.kanji: 三つ首海賊団シュナウザー
BS43-065.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Fusion Beast"/"Blade Beast" family Spirit attacks, destroy an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to that Spirit's.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Green.
BS43-065.flavor: "You are worrying about Alex? No worries. After all the things are settled, she would return to you. For now, following her will, let's try to save this world first."

BS54-XX01.name: The ThreeHeavenDeity Daybreaker
BS54-XX01.kanji: 三天神デイブレイカー
BS54-XX01.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Single color & Reborn] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Destroy two opposing 30000 BP or less Spirits/Ultimates. If you have three counters or more, cores on the opposing Spirits/Ultimates destroyed by this effect are sent to the Trash instead of Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each counter you have, draw a card.
BS54-XX01.flavor: To save the world from crisis, the first Heaven Deity appears in the dawn sky.

BS54-XX02.name: The ThreeHeavenDeity Noontide
BS54-XX02.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Single color & Reborn] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents)
For each counter you have, you can reveal a card from your decktop. Among them, summon any number of "Primal" family Spirit cards, without paying the cost. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 12 or less Spirit/Ultimate.
BS54-XX02.flavor: To expel the Disaster Beasts, the second Heaven Deity roars in the sky of midday.

BS54-XX03.name: The ThreeHeavenDeity Sun-Down
BS54-XX03.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Single color & Reborn] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
For each counter you have, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the decktop, and for each Spirit/Ultimate returned, put a core from the Void to your Life.

[LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.
BS54-XX03.flavor: Having stopped the collapse of the world, the third Heaven Deity vanished from the twilight sky.

BS40-023-A13063.name: The SyntheticBeast Chimeberus
BS40-023-A13063.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Fusion Beast/Blade Beast] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents)
Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit/Ultimate. If you control any Green Spirit, also, refresh this Spirit.
BS40-023-A13063.flavor: The Giant also advented!! Once again, a battle between two Advent Spirits!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13064.name: The ThreeTreasureDragonSwords Absolutecalibur
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13064.kanji: 三龍宝剣 アブソリュートキャリバー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13064.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] [Heavy Armor: Red/Purple/White/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/White/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Skill: 4] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
(Send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) During this turn, either this White-only Nexus, or an "Armored Dragon" family Spirit you control can't be blocked.

BS10-079.name: The Table Mountain Range
BS10-079.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Turn)
All your Spirits gain +1000 BP.

[LV2]
All your Brave Spirits can't be returned to the Hand from Field by opposing Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
BS10-079.flavor:
This place is imbued with godlike power. Mysteriously, battles never occur here.
—from the Mensa chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS50-X07.name: The ThreeTreasureDragonSwords Ancientcalibur
BS50-X07.kanji: 三龍宝剣エンシェントキャリバー
BS50-X07.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks)
When blocked, send an opposing Life to the Reserve. While braved to an "Avatar"/"Creation" family Spirit, this effect sends +1 core to the Reserve.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field] (Your Attack Step)
(At least three cores on this Nexus) Decrease the amount of cores designated on this Nexus' [Grand Skill] by -1 (It can't become 0).

BS15-026.name: The TacticianBird Shokatsuryo
BS15-026.kanji: 軍師鳥ショカツリョー
BS15-026.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
If there are a total of three or more exhausted Spirits on your Field and the opposing Field, summon this Spirit card.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit with [Windstorm] attacks, by sending a number of cores from your Reserve to your Trash equal to the number designated by that Spirit's [Windstorm], exhaust that number of opposing Spirits.
BS15-026.flavor: There's a famously wise general in Wind Shield. Once getting lost in the labyrinth he laid, the Vanity Deity could not escape from the "Flowered Woods".

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13068.name: The ThreeTreasureDragonSwords Necrocalibur
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13068.kanji: 三龍宝剣 ネクロキャリバー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13068.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks)
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit to their Reserve, and draw a card.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field] (Your Attack Step)
(At least two cores on this Nexus) When you activate [Grandphosis], once per turn, send two cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void, and put a card from your decktop facedown on your Removed Zone.

BS33-003.name: The Tactician Crowderdragon
BS33-003.kanji: 軍師クローダードラゴン
BS33-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit with [Awaken]/ [True-Clash]/ [Showdown]/ [Consecutive Blade]/ [Infinite Blade] attacks, draw a card.
BS33-003.flavor:
Prompted by the Azure Fang squad's offensive, the Heaven Squad also began their onslaught.
―from the Battle of Nagashino Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13070.name: The Tactician Shoujouji
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13070.effect: [LV1][LV2] (Either Main Step) Neither player can use Flash effects of Magic cards.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13070.flavor:
The tactics used in Battle Bowl seem to work in actual battles. A group of beasts is overpowering the dragon of the Empty Sky. Now that I come to think of it, all the sporting events here are directly related to warfare.
-from the 9th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

26RSD09-007.name: The ThreeTreasures Cornix
26RSD09-007.effect:
[LV1-2]When Summoned
You can target a Cost 4 or less "Red Cloud" family Spirit card in your Trash. Return it to your Hand.

[LV2]When Attacks
Target an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit. Destroy it. If the [Soul Core] is in your Trash, the targeting BP becomes 4000 or less instead.
26RSD09-007.flavor: He has studied divination from another world and has mastered the art of averting misfortune and inviting good fortune.

SJ15-06.name: The ThreeVassalsDragon Fuse Cland
SJ15-06.kanji: 三臣竜 火縄のクランド
SJ15-06.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 5000 BP. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) was used to pay the summon cost, increase the limit of this "BP Destruction Effect" by +5000.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing braved Brave. Or, destroy an opposing Nexus.
SJ15-06.flavor: "Lord, your outrider will finish this, so give the signal for the general offensive."

SJ15-05.name: The ThreeVassalsDragon Ingenious Hyoubu
SJ15-05.kanji: 三臣竜 知略のヒョウブ
SJ15-05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return all "Ultimate Trooper" family Spirit cards from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
While you control [The ThreeVassalsDragon Lancefighting Shougen], [The ThreeVassalsDragon Ingenious Hyoubu] and [The ThreeVassalsDragon Fuse Cland], at least one of each, all [The WarParamountWarDragon BuraiDragon] in your Hand becomes Cost 4.
SJ15-05.flavor: "This plan that abandons our defenses is exactly possible because we are confident in our victory."

SJ15-04.name: The ThreeVassalsDragon Lancefighting Shougen
SJ15-04.kanji: 三臣竜 槍撃のショウゲン
SJ15-04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, also, draw two cards.
SJ15-04.flavor: "We of the Backblaze Corps will never withdraw and are ready to fight to the death!!"

BS25-070.name: The Three Headed Dragon Pirate Flag
BS25-070.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your Spirits with [Summon Bolt] are destroyed by comparing BP, you can activate their [Summon Bolt] effects.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirits with [Summon Bolt] are blocked, you can draw a card. When you draw via this effect, discard a card from your Hand.
BS25-070.flavor: It was Asia who proposed the TS Plan. This bold scheme which would utilize the special skill of those with the three-headed dragon tattoo, "Calling Thunder", gained the support of the council members. It's outrageous...

BS59-044.name: The ThroneAngelia Faniel
BS59-044.effect:
When you use a Yellow-only Magic card with Mirage effects, after that effect resolves, by discarding this card from your Removed Zone, instead of sending that card to the Trash, set it without paying the cost.

Main- [Accel: Cost 5 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
Draw two cards from your deckbottom. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto your Removed Zone.

[LV2][LV3]
Give every opposing Spirit/Ultimate -2000 BP.
BS59-044.flavor:
The Space Pirates had attacked the Fortress immediately at their first encounter, but were easily repelled.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 8:07―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13077.name: The ThroneAngelia Safiel
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13077.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. Among them, add every Cost 6 or more "Divine Spirit" family Spirit card, besides any exactly-named "The ThroneAngelia Safiel", to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
For each [During Advent] Spirit you control, all your non-braved "Divine Spirit" family Spirits gain an extra Yellow symbol.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13077.flavor: "Providing logistical support for Aerin~ is my mission. Please leave all the work to me!"

THE-THRONE.name: The Throne Inheritance Lottery
THE-THRONE.effect: [LV1] (Your Draw Step) Instead of drawing, you can discard the top card of your deck. If the discarded card is a "War Princess" family Spirit card, draw two cards from your deck. If the discarded card is a Magic card, put two cores from the void to any "War Princess" family Spirit(s) you control. If the discarded card is anything else, add it to your Hand.
THE-THRONE.flavor:
In Combat Era Year 603, representatives from all six provinces gathered in Flowering Yellow Province for a conference. Peace in the Six Provinces was declared by the new successor of the SengokuPrincesses.
―from the Serenity Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

BS64-077.name: The Throne of the Ruler of Four Demon Lords
BS64-077.kanji: 四魔卿を統べる者の玉座
BS64-077.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Core])]
[During Set] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by an opposing attack, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "The PartnerDemonLord Javad", you can send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Trash.

[LV1]
This Nexus's symbol can also be treated as Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.
BS64-077.flavor:
The supreme throne of the star of Limbo who rules over the four demon lords. It is located at the center of Limbo, and blocks the entrance to the lower levels of Limbo. It's said that the vast world of Ultimates lies right under it.
―Travelogue of the Collapsing World: Extra―

BS44-001.name: The ThrustDinosaur Pachycetto
BS44-001.kanji: 突恐龍パッキーケット
BS44-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] This exhausted Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Brave effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks) When blocked by an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit, destroy the blocking opposing Spirit.
BS44-001.flavor:
Their fight with the EmptySky Invaders ended. But that was naught but the end of the prologue.
―"Genesis Records" Prologue 01―

26RBS01-103.name: The Thunder-Erupting Mountain
26RBS01-103.effect:
[LV1-2] Opposing Attack StepCSOPT
When you use a Magic card, you can target a "Topaz" family Spirit you control. Refresh it.

[LV2] True ReleaseOpposing Attack Step[Invoke: Flash]
If your Spirit with [Magirrate] is blocking, exhaust this Nexus ▶ Target an opposing attacking Spirit. During this battle, treat it as LV1.
26RBS01-103.flavor: The mountains in this area store thunder within them.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13083.name: The ThunderBeastEmperor Thunder-Z-Liger
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13083.kanji: 雷獣皇サンダー・Z・ライガー
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13083.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy an opposing 7000 BP or more Spirit/Ultimate. The effects of the Spirit/Ultimate destroyed by this effect do not activate. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost, and you can set a card with Burst effect from your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13083.flavor:
Zeus and Lolo, now one, send their command. The decisive battle which everything rides on now begins.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 4:01―

26RBS03-060.name: The ThunderBeast Ermineia
26RBS03-060.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2] When AttacksOnce Per Turn
If all your Spirits are Cost 2/4/6/8 with the "Topaz" family, target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, give it -5000 BP. Then, if it has 0 BP, destroy it.

[LV2] Your Attack Step
If all your Spirits are Cost 2/4/6/8 with the "Topaz" family, all your Spirits can't be blocked by opposing 3000 BP or less Spirits.
26RBS03-060.flavor: Only this Spirit could pull off such a feat as riding a thunderbolt.

BSC05-012.name: The ThunderBeast Raijoule
BSC05-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Holy Life (When Attacks) When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step) Your Cost 10 Spirits can't be blocked by opposing Spirits with printed effects.
BSC05-012.flavor:
Is it a lantern of memories? I feel like I saw her on the beast's back.
-from the 13th paragraph in chapter Yellow of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

26RBS02-054.name: The ThunderClaw Zinoris
26RBS02-054.effect:
[LV1-2]During Attack
Neither player's Spirits would be destroyed by BP comparison.

[LV2]True ReleaseYour End StepCan't Stack
If this Spirit is in exhausted state, you can target one of your "Topaz" family Spirits. Refresh it.
26RBS02-054.flavor: Truly a performance worthy of a spearhead. After all, he swept through the entire area alone.

BSCO-017.name: The ThunderDragonKing Brightening
BSCO-017.kanji: 雷竜王ブライトニング
BSCO-017.effect:
Flash - [Mani: Contract Grandwalker Nexus & C3 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By discarding your entire Hand (at least one card), draw three cards.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, if you control five or more Spirits/Nexuses, this Spirit can refresh.

BSCO-018.name: The ThunderDragonKing Brightening-Zero
BSCO-018.kanji: 雷竜王ブライトニング・ゼロ
BSCO-018.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this card is revealed from the deck by your effect, you can summon it by paying one cost.

[LV1][LV2]
While you control two or more Spirits/Nexuses, this Spirit gains +10000 BP. Also, (Once per Turn: Same Name) when your Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, if you have seven counters or more, you can send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

BS76-048.name: The ThunderDragonLady Vajreine
BS76-048.kanji: 雷竜嬢ヴァジュレーヌ
BS76-048.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed by the opponent]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1-2-3] (When Summoned)
You can return an opposing LV1 Spirit to the deckbottom. Then, if there is any opposing Spirit under "can't attack/block" effects, you can return an opposing LV2 Spirit to the deckbottom.
BS76-048.flavor: "Ahaha! Dan's having the upper hand! Come on, hurry up and reload! We can't lose as well!"

BS08-006.name: The ThunderDragonRider Rayblitz
BS08-006.kanji: 雷帝竜騎レイブリッツ
BS08-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
Once per turn, you can summon a Spirit card with [Tribute] from your Hand without using [Tribute]. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirit can't activate.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Treat all your "Dragon Emperor"/ "Dragon Knight" family Spirits as being on their highest Levels.
BS08-006.flavor: Hey... I can't see all that well, but... That guy riding the Dragon... Doesn't he look different than before?

BS75-045.name: The ThunderDragon Raivajdra
BS75-045.kanji: 雷竜ライヴァジュドラ
BS75-045.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Indra", (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Manifests/Attacks)
You can draw a card from the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Thunderive" family Spirit attacks, you can send three cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void.
BS75-045.flavor:
Dan had finally found someone who allowed him to unleash his full power. To save the Divine World and vanquish Khaos, the Divine World Salvation Contract was forged.
―Divine World Log 04―

BS75-046.name: The ThunderDragon Shimavajdra
BS75-046.kanji: 雷竜シマヴァジュドラ
BS75-046.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When the opponent summons any Spirit from the Trash, if you control any "Contractor Indra", you can immediately activate the following effect.
■ During this turn, the effects of an opposing Spirit can't activate.

[LV2][LV3]
Give all your Cost 5 or more "Thunderive" family cards an extra [Yellow Core] reduction symbol. Also, when you're summoning/deploying/using any Cost 5 or more "Thunderive" family card, this Spirit's symbol is fixed as two Yellow symbols.
BS75-046.flavor:
I'm taking Nyx. That sounds more fun.
―Grandwalker Morrigan―

BS76-047.name: The ThunderDragon Togevajdra
BS76-047.kanji: 雷竜トゲヴァジュドラ
BS76-047.effect:
When summoning this card, if this card has four or more reduction symbols, you can summon it, treating all reduction symbols as fulfilled. When you've done so, you can return an opposing non-Yellow Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

[LV2-3] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, you can return this Spirit to the Hand.
BS76-047.flavor:
Khaos was blasted away by Dan and the SuperThunderousDeity. However, Khaos was not erased. He was just imprisoned in Tartarus once again.
―Divine World Log 04―

BS75-049.name: The ThunderElephantDragon Airavajdra
BS75-049.kanji: 雷象竜アイラヴァジュドラ
BS75-049.effect:
(Can't Stack) When your "Thunderive" family Spirits would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can summon this card from the Hand. When summoning this card, you can also use symbols from your Trash to reduce the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
If you control any "Contractor Indra", you can return an opposing LV1/LV2 Spirit to the deckbottom. Then, (Once per Turn: Same Name) you can discard your entire Hand (at least one card). When you've done so, draw four cards from the deckbottom.
BS75-049.flavor:
So you do understand how to handle the Thunder God Dragon Emperor, don't you, Dan?
―Grandwalker Indra―

BS68-X04.name: The ThunderEmperorBird Keravno-Adler
BS68-X04.kanji: 雷皇鳥ケラヴノ・アードラー
BS68-X04.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Jade Contract & C6 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon/deploy any number of "Jade Thunder" family cards, paying one cost each. Discard any remaining cards.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2]
Opposing heavily exhausted Spirits/Ultimates can't activate any effects, and can't refresh.

RP26-01.name: The ThunderEmperorDragon Siegwurm (RP26-01)
RP26-01.effect:
[LV1-2] [Clash]During Attack
Opposing Spirits must block if possible.

[LV2]Your Attack Step
Give all your "Red Cloud" family Spirits [Clash].
RP26-01.flavor: He paralyzes his opponents with lightning. No one can avoid his attacks.

BSC45-012.name: The ThunderEmperorDragon Siegwurm LT
BSC45-012.effect:
When summoning this card, its cost becomes the same as your Life.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 5 ([Red Core][Red Core][Core])]
Ignoring "BP+" and "Give + BP" effects, destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate, and effects of the destroyed target can't activate. When this effect destroys, draw a card. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Ultra Clash] (When Attacks)
Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.
BSC45-012.flavor: He paralyzes his opponents with lightning. No one can avoid his attacks.

BS66-X04.name: The ThunderFangKing Blitz-Lampo
BS66-X04.kanji: 雷牙王ブリッツ・ランポ
BS66-X04.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Jade Contract & C6 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't activate Burst effects. Also, heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates/Nexuses.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can return any number of opposing exhausted Spirits/Ultimates/Nexuses to the deckbottom. At the end of battle, while braved to a "Jade Thunder" family Brave, by paying one cost, this Spirit refreshes.

BS54-002.name: The ThunderFourHeavenlyKings Dragon-The-Tsuna
BS54-002.kanji: 雷の四天王ドラゴン・ザ・ツナ
BS54-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit. Also, if you have one counter or more, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
If [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, draw cards until you have four cards in Hand.
BS54-002.flavor:
At the destination where they planned to annihilate monsters, Raikou-Dragon and his fellow four heavenly kings were washed over by a wave of bright red light. And when they regained consciousness, they found themselves now in a mysterious world with a strong feeling of déjà vu.
"What on earth has happened? Lord Raikou, let me scout around a bit to see what's going on here."

BS54-009.name: The ThunderFourHeavenlyKings Sakatano-Bear
BS54-009.kanji: 雷の四天王サカタノ・ベア
BS54-009.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Nexus's (When Summoned/Deployed) effect resolves]
Destroy two opposing Nexuses. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to any Red Grandstone Nexus you control. Then, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit. Effects of the Spirit destroyed by this effect can't activate.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.
BS54-009.flavor: "Gahahahahaha! Wherever it is, we Four Heavenly Kings are unmatched!"

BS55-006.name: The ThunderFourHeavenlyKings Urabe-Dragon
BS55-006.kanji: 雷の四天王 ウラベ・ドラゴン
BS55-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

PB41-X03.name: The VeteranWarrior Ultraman Zero
PB41-X03.kanji: 歴戦の勇者 ウルトラマンゼロ
PB41-X03.effect:

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) Refresh a White “Ultraman”/"Special Aircraft" Spirit/Ultimate you control. Or, during this battle, one of your White "Ultraman"/"Special Aircraft" can't be blocked.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
All your White "Zett"/"Special Aircraft" Spirits can block while exhausted.

BSC49-083.name: The Unfinished Ancient Battleship:Stern LT
BSC49-083.kanji: 未完成の古代戦艦：船尾LT
BSC49-083.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Neither player can increase cores from the Void to their Life. Also, give all your "Ancient Battleship": "[Assault: 4] (When Attack) This Spirit can, up to four times per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses."

[LV2] (Opposing Main Step)
The (When Summoned) effects of Spirits/Ultimates can't activate.
BSC49-083.flavor:
The stern of the battleship in construction has a figurehead of a goddess of victory affixed to it. Unexpectedly elegant for a battleship, its figure makes the day when it can be beheld seem not so far off.
—from the Puppis chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS10-026.name: The Veteran Nogan
BS10-026.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] 1 (When Attacks)
When this Spirit is blocked, the opponent exhausts a Spirit they control.
BS10-026.flavor: Let's follow this elder to higher ground. We already handed over the sword; now we'll just be in the way of the battle if we stay any longer.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13390.name: The UnicornDragon Volsung
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13390.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed) Your spirits with 2 or more gems get +5000BP until end of turn.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks) This spirit gets +3000BP until end of turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13390.flavor: Stupid dragons. How many of them did they revive? It seems like they keep coming out endlessly.

BS26-041.name: The ViceCaptain Chester
BS26-041.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Cost 5/6 (When Battles)
At the end of the battle, by destroying this Spirit, summon a Cost 5/6 Spirit card in the same family type as this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Battles)
This Spirit's [Summon Bolt] can summon Cost 5 and Cost 6 Spirits, one of each.
BS26-041.flavor: Give my regards to your boss. We're going to spill the beans about the secret of the Ultimates!

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13392.name: The Unicorn Einhorn
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13392.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Blocks) This spirit gets +1000BP for each nexus you control until end of turn.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13392.flavor: A brave warrior who destroyed the gate of distortion. He never stops fighting despite the high risk of it.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13393.name: The VictoryWarPrincess Sigrdrifa
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13393.kanji: 勝利の戦姫シグルドリーヴァ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13393.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal seven cards from your decktop. Among them, put every [The SixthArtifactKing Blion] and "Imagine" family Brave cards face-up onto the Removed Zone. Discard any reemaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks, refresh an "Android" family Spirit you control.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13393.flavor: "Avalanche-Bison was convinced by Tiamadou. He was told that 'Nobody else can be the Ox Twelve God-King.' And I thought Blion-kun's rivals would decrease. It's too bad."

BS04-088.name: The Victory Stand of the Glory
BS04-088.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you are paying the cost for deploying Nexus, you can discard a card from your decktop for each cost to be paid instead.

[LV2]
When your Nexus is deployed, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
BS04-088.flavor:
As a final event, one athlete will be chosen from the entire competition to receive the MVP award from "Master Unicorn" on this victory stand. Every entrant dreams of standing here.
-from the Places of Interest 209/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

SD66-007.name: The View at the Peak
SD66-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, while you control any Red Contract Spirit, increase the limit of your "BP Destruction effects" by +3000.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your Spirit with "Top Buddy, Aibou" as pre-advent card is attacking, that Spirit gains +10000 BP.
SD66-007.flavor:
The statue of the Dragon Emperor who guided us to victory. However, one must climb a tall mountain to look at this. OF course, things are different if you have wings.
-from the Places of Interest Extra 001 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS67-004.name: The VigilanteMember Crown
BS67-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When your Hand is discarded via your Red effect, after that effect resolves, you can summon one of the discarded "Scarlet Flame" family cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can return a "Scarlet Flame" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.
BS67-004.flavor:
So Kai's partners actually set this all up for us...Hope they don't mind we steal their show☆
―The AquilaFlameSwordDeity Gut-Zwei―

SD19-011.name: The Village of Hunters
SD19-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your Red Spirits/Ultimates gain +2000 BP.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit. If you control any Ultimate, instead, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.
SD19-011.flavor:
Are the Ultimates less culturally advanced than we are? We've found a very primitive village.
—Red Plains Site No. 023 from "Skylands Report" by Nord—

CB01-018.name: The VillainousAlien Temperor Seijin Batista
CB01-018.kanji: 極悪宇宙人テンペラー星人バチスタ
CB01-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
The cost of every exactly-named "The OddMachineKaiju Diabolic" in your Hand gets -1.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
By exhausting one of your exactly-named "The HellAlien Hipporito Seijin Callisto", send three cores from an opposing Spirit to their Reserve.
CB01-018.flavor:
An alien that is very strong in combat. It can launch Ultra High Heat Beams from his two arms, attacked together with the HellAlien Hipporito Seijin Callisto using a special combo move.
―Ultraman Orb The Movie: Let Me Borrow the Power of Bonds!―

BS41-020.name: The VioknightDragon Viorose
BS41-020.kanji: 騎紫竜ヴァイオローゼス
BS41-020.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Purple/White] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.

[During Advent] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each of this Spirit's pre-Advent cards, return an opposing Spirit with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's to the Hand.
BS41-020.flavor: I can't believe a dragon is descending into a machine's body!! But it's the truth! This is a joint battle against the Vanity Deities!!

BS69-NX03.name: The ViolentAzureLimitedExpress Uxmal
BS69-NX03.effect:
When this card in Hand would be discarded by an effect, if you control any Blue-only Grandwalker Nexus, instead of sending it to the Trash, you can pay one cost to summon it. When you've done so, (Once per Game: Same Name) if your have five or more counters, Core Step and Draw Step don't occur for the opponent next turn.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest cost.
BS69-NX03.flavor: A Spirit wanted for speeding and destroying cultural property of beasts in Hermes' world.

BS43-018.name: The VioletCorpseBrigade Armagaze
BS43-018.kanji: 紫骸旅団アルマゲイズ
BS43-018.effect:
This Spirit card's [Accel] can't be used unless one cost or more is paid.

Flash- [Accel: Cost 6 ([Purple Core][Purple Core])]
Send a core from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Void. After the effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with three cores or more on it.
BS43-018.flavor: Fight till annihilation ?! Retreat! For now!

THE-URTEXT.name: The Urtext of Creativity
THE-URTEXT.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed) When deployed from your Hand, return a Yellow Magic card from your Trash to your Hand.

[LV2] When your Burst activates, if that Burst is a Magic card, you can activate its Main/Flash effect without paying the cost.
THE-URTEXT.flavor:
While injured, Manaka was sheltered in a place that stood out quite a bit at first glance.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 644—

SJ17-10.name: The VioletCorpseBrigade Black Cypher Dragon
SJ17-10.kanji: 紫骸旅団 黒竜サイファードラゴン
SJ17-10.effect:
Flash - [Advent: key] (Accel, (Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Put one of this Spirit's pre-advent cards face-up onto the Removed Zone. You can activate the [Accel] of the card put onto the Removed Zone via this effect, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, by discarding a card from your Removed Zone, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
SJ17-10.flavor: The Violet Corpse Brigade... They're an army of dead dragons led by the Purple Dark Stone.

BS42-015.name: The VioletCorpseBrigade Bonehead-Drago
BS42-015.kanji: 紫骸旅団ボーンヘッド・ドラコ

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Your "VioletCorpse"-named Spirits can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.

[LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Draw two cards.
BS42-015.flavor: The Pyroxene Heroes are fighting among themselves? Wait, no. That Death Dragon isn't from the Vanity Army...What is happening?

BS42-019.name: The VioletCorpseBrigade Deathrib Dragon
BS42-019.kanji: 紫骸旅団デスリブドラゴン
BS42-019.effect:
While this card is in your Removed Zone, opposing effects can only gain up to one core from the Void per turn.

By discarding a "Death Dragon"/"Zombie" family Spirit card from your Hand, draw two cards. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.
BS42-019.flavor: Already on the run? We haven't even battled them from the front!!

BS42-023.name: The VioletCorpseBrigade Tanzanite-Bone-Dragon
BS42-023.kanji: 紫骸旅団タンザナイト・ボーン・ドラゴン

Summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit, and draw a card.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
After your Purple [Accel] effect resolves, by paying one cost, you can summon that Spirit card from the Removed Zone, without paying the cost.
BS42-023.flavor: Don't chase after them if they escape! It is enough that we repelled them.

BS42-026.name: The VioletCorpseBrigade White Enigma Dragon
BS42-026.kanji: 紫骸旅団 白竜エニグマドラゴン
BS42-026.effect:

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
The color of all Purple [Accel] you use are treated as colorless.
BS42-026.flavor:
The Vanity Army retreated with haste. When they saw Alex's gang joining the battle, they immediately fled.
-from 3rd section of "New Record of the Strange World" chapter Purple-

BS42-016.name: The VioletCorpseBrigade Zombie Dragon
BS42-016.kanji: 紫骸旅団ゾンビドラゴン
BS42-016.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 6 ([Purple Core][Purple Core][Purple Core])]
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.
BS42-016.flavor:
The Vanity Army also had beings with the power of the pyroxenes, who were the "Dark Pyroxene Six Generals", also called the "Dark Stones". The Green world was destroyed because of that. They used the great battle in the Red world as a cover to aim for the Purple world in secret.
-from the 3rd section of "New Record of the Strange World" chapter Purple-

EXO-URO.name: The VioletCorpseGodKing Exo-Ourovorius
EXO-URO.kanji: 紫骸の神皇エグゾ・ウロヴォリアス
EXO-URO.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Death Dragon & Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending [Soul Core] to your Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

After your [Accel] effect resolves, you can stack this Spirit card from the Hand onto your Spirits via [Advent].

[LV2][LV3] [Twinkle Spellbind] (Opposing Turn)
At the start of each opposing step, you can send a core from opposing Spirits/the opposing Reserve to their Trash. While this Spirit is [During Advent], when any Spirit is depleted by this effect, send an opposing Life to their Trash.
EXO-URO.flavor: It's reviving over and over again!? Ourovorius!

26RBS01-023.name: The VioletScreech Dracuroar
26RBS01-023.effect:
[LV2]When Attacks
Target an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit. Send cores from it to the Reserve until one core remains. (The opponent chooses which cores to send)

26RSD02-010.name: The Violet Witherlands

[LV1-2] When Deployed
Target an opposing Spirit. Send a core, besides [Soul Core], from it to the Reserve.

[LV2] [Invoke: Main]
Destroy this Nexus ▶ Target an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit. Send cores from it to the Reserve until one core remains. (The opponent chooses which cores to send.)
26RSD02-010.flavor: It is said that the handprints carved into that gravestone are the remnants of beings who existed before this world began.

BS60-083.name: The Vircaic Beach
BS60-083.kanji: ヴィルカイックビーチ
BS60-083.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
Your counters +2. Then, (Once per turn: Same Name) if you have seven counters or more, send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to this Nexus.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When opposing Spirits that are destroyed by your originally Cost 8 or more Spirit effects have remained on Field by "remain on Field" effects, you can refresh an "Azure Wave" family Spirit you control.
BS60-083.flavor:
The beautiful sandy beach formed by a sophisticated combination of tide and sand. Its form continues to vary with time, and you will never see the same beach again.
―The PartnerShark Shack―

BS26-061.name: The VirgoAstralArmored VirgoBrave
BS26-061.kanji: 乙女星鎧ヴァルゴブレイヴ
BS26-061.effect:
[During Brave] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
By sending a core from any of your Spirits to your Trash, during this battle, give an opposing Spirit/Ultimate -3000 BP.

[During Brave] (Opposing Attack Step)
Opposing Cost 2/3/5/7 Ultimates can't attack.
BS26-061.flavor: The 12 Reverse Zodiacs? What do you mean, Reverse!?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13414.name: The VirupaksaGeneral Bilbaksha
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13414.kanji: 広目天将ビルバクシャ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13414.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Reveal three cards from your decktop. Put every Spirit card with [Accel] among them face-up onto the Removed Zone. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to the number of Spirit cards with [Accel] in your Removed Zone.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13414.flavor: "Team Gandala" renewed their ties with Japang's Gandala. Apparently the pre-race celebration party they held yesterday evening lasted all night!

BS09-022.name: The Viscount Minoba
BS09-022.effect:
[LV1][LV2] 1 (When Attacks)
When this Spirit is blocked, the opponent exhausts a Spirit they control.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your Spirits with [Windstorm] gain +2000 BP.
BS09-022.flavor:
A sudden tempest developed with winds clashing at blinding speeds. Somehow, my guide and I managed to hold on to each other. No matter what happens, I must not let go of this blade!
-from the 10th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS66-040.name: The VisionCallingAngelia Visuel
BS66-040.kanji: 幻魂呼びの天使ヴィジュエル
BS66-040.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Yellow Core])]
[During Set]
When you're summoning/deploying a "Golden Cloud" family card, for each Magic card with [Vision] in your Trash, fulfill one of its [Yellow Core] reduction symbols.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can put a Magic card with [Vision] from your Hand onto the Field. When you've done so, draw two cards from the deckbottom.
BS66-040.flavor: "So you wish to restart the village? Or restore your memory?"

BS53-021-A13417.name: The VisionaryFlameWatchdog Cerberussa
BS53-021-A13417.kanji: 詩炎の番犬 ケルベロッサ
BS53-021-A13417.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
If your Life is at five or less, put a core from the Void to your Life.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
Once per turn, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -10000 BP, or an opposing Ultimate -20000 BP. Return it to the deckbottom when its BP is brought to 0 by this effect.
BS53-021-A13417.flavor: See? Doing this yourself is a piece of cake. But if you want treats, you can't follow us and leave, since someone would be troubled if you are gone.

26RBS01-108.name: The Vitality Woods
26RBS01-108.effect:
[LV1-2] When Destroyed
Target one of your "Ferobeast" family Spirits. During this turn, give it +3000 BP.

[LV2] Your Attack Step
When this Nexus exhausts, if your Hand is four or less, draw a card.
26RBS01-108.flavor:
The bluish forest is soothing to the soul. It seems I shall be able to rest here and forget the hardships of the journey.
―from the Foreigner's Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

CB18-028.name: The VoidKaiju Greeza［Ultra Kaiju 2020］
CB18-028.kanji: 虚空怪獣グリーザ［ウルトラ怪獣2020］
CB18-028.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects besides opposing Brave Spirit effects, and its symbol is also treated as Red.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.
CB18-028.flavor: Its mass, energy and all stats can't be measured, a being that can be said as the embodiment of nothingness. It can't be defeated unless a needle that could sew the hole of space is used.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13420.name: The Volcanic Canyon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13420.kanji: ボルカニックキャニオン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13420.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step) For each "Terra Dragon" family Spirit you control, all your Spirits gain +1000 BP.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step) When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your Red Spirit, refresh that Spirit you control.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13420.flavor: A grand plateau was formed and continues to be built upon by a cycle of eruption and solidification of magma.

BS53-004.name: The VolcanoAzureDragon Vurgannon
BS53-004.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2] (When Reborn/Attacks)
Once per turn, destroy an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit/Ultimate, and put a core from the Void each to this Spirit and a Nexus you control.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can return a Red-only/Blue-only Nexus card from your Trash to the Hand.
BS53-004.flavor: Wa...wait, its number of heads increased all of a sudden?! Then it is not a Terra Dragon, but an Ocean Emperor right? Why am I so surprised? What are you talking about! Change of family is an unprecedented event!

BS53-004-A13422.name: The VolcanoDinosaur Vurgannon
BS53-004-A13422.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can return a Red "Rouse Emperor" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV1][LV2] [Rebirth3]
When your Red Cost 5 or more Spirit attacks, this Spirit can be flipped.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. If you have four counters or more, this effect draws +1 card.
BS53-004-A13422.flavor: Don't be afraid. Thinking that it would be a Volcano, but it turned out to be a Terra Dragon. This is nothing unusual in the Red World!

BS53-054-A13423.name: The VolcanoDragonKing Juran
BS53-054-A13423.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing one-symbol Spirit/Ultimate. This effect can't be prevented by opposing Ultimate effects.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
By destroying an opposing Nexus, refresh this Spirit.
BS53-054-A13423.flavor: "Disaster Beasts that go around the world and destroy? I would defeat such beings. Leave it to me! You are in good hands. Feel assured and just wait and see! "

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13424.name: The VolcanoheadDragon Volcaphallusaurus
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13424.kanji: 火山頭竜ボルケファロサウルス
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13424.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit. By sending up to three cores from any Red-Only Grandwalker Nexus(es) you control to the Void, for each core sent, increase the limit of this "BP Destruction effect" by +5000 BP.

[LV2] This exhausted Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13424.flavor:
Ra's power is immense, but as if to erase it, a roar resounds across the battlefield. "Advent onto me!"
―"Genesis Records" Volume 4:34―

BS53-X07.name: The WBS Ace FortuneGoddess Lokamata
BS53-X07.kanji: WBSエース 吉祥女神ローカマーター
BS53-X07.effect:
When this card in Hand would be discarded by your "WBS"-named Spirit effect/exactly-named "Grandwalker Lakshmi"'s effect, instead of sending it to Trash, you can summon it as Cost 6.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Cost 8 or less Spirit. Also, when summoned via an effect, during this turn, this Spirit can't be blocked.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
For each counter you have, this Spirit gains an extra Blue symbol.
BS53-X07.flavor: “Wealth, fame and luck are all in the palm of my hand. Let's go, Lokamata!”

BS54-054.name: The WBS BlueCharisma Anik
BS54-054.kanji: WBS青のカリスマ アニク
BS54-054.effect:
When this card in Hand would be discarded by your "WBS"-named Spirit effect/exactly-named "Grandwalker Lakshmi"'s effect, instead of sending it to Trash, you can put it onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Draw a card, then discard a card from your Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your "WBS"-named Spirits are treated as one level higher, and can't be destroyed by BP comparison.
BS54-054.flavor:
"Hey, Zeophilus-bro! Hand me your belt next!"
"Ha! Come and try! This belt isn't as light as you may think!"

BS54-X07.name: The WBS FirstGenerationChampion The-Beast
BS54-X07.kanji: WBS初代王者ザ・ビースト
BS54-X07.effect:
When this card in Hand would be discarded by your "WBS"-named Spirit effect/exactly-named "Grandwalker Lakshmi"'s effect, instead of sending it to Trash, you can put it onto the Removed Zone. When you've done so, you can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest cost.

When summoning from the Removed Zone, this card becomes Cost 4.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When the opponent would use a card from the Hand/Removed Zone during Flash Timing, unless they send three cores from their Reserve to the Trash, they can't use it.
BS54-X07.flavor: His power is yet to wane. The legendary WBS first generation champion who has shaken the Blue world!

BS04-043.name: The Valkyrie-Hildr
BS04-043.kanji: ワルキューレ・ヒルド
BS04-043.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Magic effects.

[LV2]
When your Life is reduced, refresh this Spirit.
BS04-043.flavor: Her songs discourage invaders. The one who lacked the ability to appreciate their beauty destroyed the gates to the tower.

BSC42-046.name: The Valkyrie-Hildr LT
BSC42-046.kanji: ワルキューレ・ヒルドLT
BSC42-046.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 2 ([White Core])]
Target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, your Life can't be reduced by the attack of that Spirit. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2]

―"Genesis Records" New Volume 6:06―

When the Ruby Realm collapsed, there was one place that remained. I tried to erect a stone monument there; this place alone is connected to the past.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)

Draw a card from the deckbottom. Also, if braved to any exactly-named "Grandwalker Parvati", this Spirit gains the "Hunter Beast" family.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field] (Start of Either Attack Step)
By sending a core from this Nexus to the Void, during this turn, an opposing Nexus can't activate its effects.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13564.name: The WildWaveSpiritBlade Aranami
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13564.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
While braved to a "Terra Dragon"/"Ocean Emperor" family Spirit, once per turn, by exhausting a Grandwalker Nexus you control, refresh this Spirit.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit/Ultimate would attack, unless the opponent sends a core from their Reserve to the Trash, it can't attack. This effect doesn't stack.

BSC47-007.name: The WaterLilyGoddess Ganga
BSC47-007.effect:
When this card is sent to the Trash by your Yellow Mirage effects, you can add it to the Hand

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add either a "Parvati" Grandwalker Nexus card, or a "Concluser" family card to the Hand. Return any remaining card to the deckbottom.

[LV2]
You can add a "Hunter Beast" family Mirage card revealed from deck by this Spirit's effect to the Hand.
BSC47-007.flavor: "Sister Parv, a bunch of weirdos are swarming out~"

SD31-009.name: The WindDemonGreatShinobi Highwind
SD31-009.kanji: 風魔上忍ハイウインド
SD31-009.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Refresh a "Ninja Gale" family Spirit you control. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, you can return this Spirit to the Hand. If this Spirit was returned to the Hand by this effect, you can set a card with Burst effect from your Hand.
SD31-009.flavor: For there to be traitors who would take the forbidden technique and run meant that there had to be somebody giving them orders.

BS59-041.name: The WaterLilyGoddess Neelkanth
BS59-041.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 5 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
When this battle resolves, end the battle without comparing BP. Then, refresh a "Hunter Beast" family Spirit you control. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When cards are sent to the Trash by your Yellow Mirage effects, reduce the cost of each of those cards by -1.
BS59-041.flavor:
A new piece of information was obtained from the Space Pirates. Looting from every corner and every dimension, they had once discovered a fortress moving across the gaps of time.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 8:05―

BS33-030.name: The WindDemonGreatShinobi Quetzal
BS33-030.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] [Bunshin: 4] (When Summoned)
By placing up to four cards from your decktop onto the Field facedown and putting at least one core from the Reserve onto them, until the end of the game, they are treated as "Cost 0/"Bunshin" family/LV1: 1 core, 3000 BP/[Green Core]" Green Bunshin Spirits. (Bunshin Spirits can't be braved, and are discarded when sent to the Hand/Deck.)
BS33-030.flavor: The letter from the reinforcements only read "endure for three days."

BS32-027.name: The WindDemonGreatShinobi Tokizane
BS32-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts. After that Burst activates, your can set one of your Spirits with Burst effects as a Burst.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, refresh a Spirit you control.
BS32-027.flavor: "You there, where did you come to know of this technique?"

BS32-X03.name: The WindDemonHead Shinobiou
BS32-X03.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates. When this Burst is activated via [Catalyze], then, return two opposing exhausted Spirits to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By sending two cores or the [Soul Core] on this Spirit to your Reserve, exhaust an opposing Spirit.

BSC20-007.name: The WindDemon Amatsuba
BSC20-007.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Refresh a Cost 5 or less Spirit you control. When [Soul Core](Soul Core) is used to pay the summon cost, instead, refresh a Spirit you control.
BSC20-007.flavor: According to scrolls left in the Ninja Gale Village, the SengokuGoldDragon boldly and imposingly lay in wait for the reinforcement corps.

SD31-007.name: The WindDemon Benimatoi
SD31-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve. Also , if [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
SD31-007.flavor: With the forbidden technique now leaked to the world, the need for Ninja Gale Village to create a new technique was imminent. After all, if they showed weakness to other provinces during the Great Sengoku Era... they would be quickly consumed.

BS34-027.name: The WindDemon Hototogisu
BS34-027.flavor:
Otonosama had lost the power struggle for Verdant Leaf Province and decided to side with the Six Heaven Army faction, which employed the services of Ninja Gale Village. Senkigahara was the spot where power struggles for many provinces took place.
―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―

SD40-006.name: The WindDemon Ikaruga
SD40-006.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits. Also, if this Spirit was summoned via an effect, refresh a "Ninja Gale" family Spirit you control.
SD40-006.flavor: Is that...the Green Holy Relic ?! Brought to us coming all the way long? Since lord Yatagarai is worried that it would be lost in battles? Such a considerate leader! Thank you so much!

SD40-005.name: The WindDemon Kakitsuburi
SD40-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit with [Accel] effects, or your "Ninja Gale" family Spirit with [Soul Core] on it attacks, return an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.
SD40-005.flavor:
The Shinobi Village was originally a world from a different space. However, it became connected to the six worlds as a hidden gate appeared.
-from the 3rd section of "New Record of the Strange World" chapter Shinobi-

BS43-022.name: The WindDemon Kamahashi
BS43-022.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Cards can't be discarded from either player's deck.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
This Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.
BS43-022.flavor: The most powerful enemies are the Vanity Deities, but the most numerous are the armies of the Dark Pyroxenes.

BS74-032.name: The WindDemon Kujagara
BS74-032.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Houryokuin Kanetsugu" & C4 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
You can summon a "Ninja Gale" family Spirit card from your Hand by paying one cost.

[LV2] [W Catl: Green] (When Attacks)
By sending your [Soul Core], or a core from your Grandwalker Nexus to the Trash, immediately activate one of your Green Soul Bursts.
BS74-032.flavor: Onmyou Territory's activities had intensified. According to intelligence from Ninkouchou, the "Master" was pulling the strings behind the scenes.

BS31-029.name: The WindDemon Ninkouchou
BS31-029.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. Also, if [Soul Core] was used to pay for the summon cost, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BS31-029.flavor: In the second battle, the movements of Flame War Province were leaked to Onmyou Territory. No living being under the sun can escape the eyes of a WindDemon.

BS74-028.name: The WindDemon Ninkouchou X
BS74-028.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1. Then, you can put a core from the Void to any of your "Ninja Gale" family Spirits. When core is put onto another Spirit via this effect, exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Then, if it's your Attack Step, +1 core to one of your Grandwalker Nexuses.
BS74-028.flavor: "Kueh! We Ninja Gale come to aid the Flame War Province!"

BS32-021.name: The WindDemon Sasakunai
BS32-021.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve. Also, if [Soul Core] is used to pay the summon cost, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit gains +3000 BP.
BS32-021.flavor: The Supreme Beast Army intended to expand their territory and thus set their sights on the Six Shogunate. The only ones in their way were the Six Heaven Army stationed in a fort in Oukehazama.

BS31-027.name: The WindDemon Shinobilica
BS31-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Ninja Gale" family Spirit with Soul Core on it attacks, return an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.
BS31-027.flavor:
There are no ninjas more skilled at scouting than the WindDemon shinobi. That's because no matter how small an alley you travel down, they can get a complete view by looking from the sky.
―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―

BS35-024.name: The WindDemon Tashigi
BS35-024.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Separate a Brave from an opposing Brave Spirit and leave it in Spirit condition. However, the moving of core upon separation is decided by the opponent.
BS35-024.flavor: The BSGP is a celebration that happens once every twelve years. So, contestants from all over the world come to make a name for themselves there. Racer Tashigi is one of them, a ninja from a small eastern island country!

BSC30-008.name: The WindDemon Tsubakura-Crow
BSC30-008.kanji: 風魔ツバクラ・クロー
BSC30-008.effect:
When this Spirit card is discarded by opposing "deck discarding effects", send an opposing Life to their Trash. If this effect is activated during (Opposing Main Step), this effect sends +1 core to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
BSC30-008.flavor: Birds scattered all over the places have gathered in the Purple World. Everyone, War Dragons, Astral Dragons, the Birds, and the Noble Order, together with the native denizens...such a great number of people. It almost seems like a festival. If this isn't to prepare for war, it would have been so nice...

BS34-020.name: The WindDemon Yabusame
BS34-020.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
At the end of battle, by sending the [Soul Core] from this Spirit to your Trash, return this Spirit to your Hand.
BS34-020.flavor: The stage for the war was Senkigahara, a lordless and desolate wasteland.

THE-WHIRTING.name: The Whirling Big Channel
THE-WHIRTING.effect:
[LV1][LV2] All exhausted Spirits can only be refreshed during the Refresh Step.

[LV2] While you have a Burst set, (When Destroyed) effects of Spirits can't activate.
THE-WHIRTING.flavor:
The appearance of the Vanity Deities affected every place. What had been a calm channel morphed and obstructed Manaka's path, delaying him on his path to defeat the Vanity Deities.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 643—

BS41-X03.name: The WhirlwindKingBeast Blast-Saber
BS41-X03.kanji: 旋風王獣ブラスト・サーベル
BS41-X03.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Green & Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV1][LV2] 2 (When Advents/Attacks)
Heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates.
[heb]

[LV2] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, for each opposing heavily exhausted Spirit/Ultimate, send an opposing Life to their Trash.
BS41-X03.flavor: It has combined the powers of all the beasts! The whirlwind of the Vanity Deities was taken down!

SD31-X01.name: The WhirlwindNinja Kirikage
SD31-X01.effect:
Flash - [Soul Swift] (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this Spirit card from your Hand by using [Soul Core](Soul Core) from the Reserve to pay the entire summon cost and cores from the Reserve to put onto it.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Catl: Green] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to the Trash, immediately activate one of your Green Soul Bursts.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.
SD31-X01.flavor: "Whirlwind! Tornado! Take the essence of Ninja Gale!!"

BSC48-X03.name: The WhirlwindNinja Kirikage X
BSC48-X03.effect:
This card/Spirit gains the "Devotee"/"Concluser"/"Vassal"/"Lord" families.

Flash - [Soul Swift - Love] (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this card from the Hand/Removed Zone by using one [Soul Core] to pay for the entire summon cost, and putting cores from your Reserve onto it.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can exhaust two opposing Spirits/Nexuses/Grandwalker Nexuses.

[LV2][LV3] [True Catalyze] (When Attacks)
If [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, you can immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts. After that Burst activates, you can heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits/Nexuses/Grandwalker Nexuses.
BSC48-X03.flavor: "May the presiders over warriors be my vanguard!"

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13589.name: The Whirlwind Ravine
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13589.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (During the Main Phase) While a player controls 4 or more spirits, that player cannot summon spirits

[LV2] (During Your Battle Phase) Change the text of High Speed on spirit cards in your hand to the following (the Levels do not change):

"High Speed (Flash Step) This spirit card may be summoned from your hand."
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13589.flavor:
The wind that reaches the woods of the World Tree comes from here. This place might have something to do with the gas spouted from the World Tree. You definitely need a safety rope to visit here.
-from the Places of Interest 185/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS69-071.name: The Whirlwind Spiral Way
BS69-071.effect:
When this card is sent from the deck to the Trash via the effect of your "Hermes" Grandwalker Nexus, you can add it to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By exhausting this Nexus, send an opposing exhausted Cost 3 or less Spirit/Ultimate to the Removed Zone.

[LV2]
Once per turn, when cards are put onto the opposing Removed Zone, you can reveal a card from your decktop. If the revealed card is a Green "Devotee"/"Concluser"/"Grandwalker family card, add it to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.
BS69-071.flavor:
A spiral pathway that appeared from the battle against Gaia.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 223―

BS27-064.name: The WhiteAstralArmored Cygnus-Wing
BS27-064.kanji: 白星鎧キグナス・ウィング
BS27-064.effect:
[Trigger Counter]
When the opposing Ultimate Trigger hits, you can summon this Brave card from your Hand before the "When hits" effect activates. Activate the following effect after being summoned.

█ Refresh all your Spirits. Also, if the hit card is a Spirit card, treat it as a Guard.

[When Braved] (When Brave Attack)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS27-064.flavor: I don't think so. Swans shouldn't have talons.

BS60-059.name: The WhiteCloudWhale Physeter
BS60-059.kanji: 白雲鯨ピュセーテール
BS60-059.effect:
When your "Golden Cloud" family Spirits have returned to the Hand/Deck due to effects, you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed by the opponent]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, you can summon two Cost 6 or less "Golden Cloud" family Spirit cards from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
By +1 opposing counter, set this Spirit as a Burst.
BS60-059.flavor:
If we could ride on his back, we would reach the capital in a moment!
―The PartnerBird Feaniel―

26RBS03-X10.name: The WhiteCopperBladessom Lumerian
26RBS03-X10.kanji: 白銅の刀華ルメリアン
26RBS03-X10.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2] Your End Step
You can target one of your Cost 6 or less White Spirits. Refresh it.

[LV2]True ReleaseWhen Attacks/BlocksOnce Per Turn
You can show a "Leucomyst"/ "Wollaguard" family card from your Hand to the opponent and return it to the deckbottom. If returned, draw a card. When you draw, if your Hand is two or less, draw two cards instead.
26RBS03-X10.flavor: "...If you get any closer, I'll cut you down."

P13-11.name: The WhiteCrestedIbis Yatagross
P13-11.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
The opponent exhausts a Spirit they control.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's effect exhausts any opposing Spirit, for each Spirit exhausted, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
P13-11.flavor: Ah, that bird is! Oh good, it's still white. Let's leave here quickly. If it turns black, it'll be a disaster.

BS68-005.name: The WhiteCrowDragon Korax
BS68-005.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) During your End Step, by sending a core from any of your "Apollon" Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void, return this card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can draw a card. Then, including being in Soul State, if you control any "Apollon" Grandwalker Nexus, discard a Cost 4 or less Magic card from the opposing Field.
BS68-005.flavor:
Having stopped the first wave of attack of the Olym Primordial Deities alone, Apollon suffered serious injury, and was forced to drop out of the frontline.
―Theonogic Record Volume 1―

26RBS02-045.name: The WhiteForge Breaston
26RBS02-045.effect:
Legacy
[LV1-2] When Summoned
Target an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. Return it to the Hand. If summoned using Legacy, the targeting BP becomes 5000 or less or 8000 or more instead.

[LV2] [Camou: 1]
When the opponent would target this Spirit with a Spirit effect, unless they pay one cost, they can't target it.
26RBS02-045.flavor: With this Spirit, you can even take on a hurricane. And you might even win against it.

BS54-007-A13597.name: The WindDragon Febranica
BS54-007-A13597.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can put a core from the Void to any Red Grandstone Nexus you control.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy three opposing 7000 BP or less Spirits, and you can draw a card for each Spirit destroyed.

[LV2][LV3] [Rebirth3]
When this Spirit attacks, if your Hand is five or more, you can flip this Spirit.
BS54-007-A13597.flavor: If it is to go to the Dragon's Village, the shortest way would be to take the aerial route called "the Crossroads of the Wind", where a lot of flying dragons are gathered.

EX13-08.name: The WindDragon Shining-Dragon-Hurricane
EX13-08.kanji: 風龍シャイニング・ドラゴン・ハリケーン
EX13-08.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. When this effect exhausts any Spirit, you can summon a Cost 3 or less Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV3] [Charge]
Increase the number of bodies to be exhausted by your “opponent-targeting exhaustion effects“ by +1.
EX13-08.flavor: The dragon imbued with the power of wind blows away the ominous clouds.

BSC44-006.name: The WindFangHeadKnight Ookibateus
BSC44-006.kanji: 風牙の騎師団長オオキバティウス
BSC44-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
If you control no Spirits/Ultimates other than this one, you can pay one cost to summon a "Shellman" family Spirit card with a cost equal or inferior to your number of counters from your Hand/Removed Zone/Trash.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
During this battle, the Spirit you control that is attacking simultaneously with this Spirit gains an extra Green symbol. Then, once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.
BSC44-006.flavor:
A new Grandwalker from the primordial deities side showed itself before Ares who advanced.
―"Theogonic Record" Fragment―

BS27-047.name: The WindGeneral Erigyius
BS27-047.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw two cards. Then, discard two cards from your Hand.

[LV1][LV2] Cost 2/6 (When Battles)
At the end of the battle, by destroying this Spirit, summon a Cost 2/6 Spirit card in the same family type as this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BS27-047.flavor: The forbidden writings are a type of prophecy. They hint at the continent's destruction and also contain records regarding the astral spirits. According to the analysis of them, the astral spirits are behind this continent collision incident.

BS42-073.name: The WindGodGun Behexhaust
BS42-073.kanji: 風王銃ベヒーエグゾースト
BS42-073.effect:
[LV1] [Reload]
You can [Advent] onto this Spirit-condition Brave. When you [Advent] onto this Brave, you can brave this pre-Advent card to that Spirit.

[When Braved] (When Attacks)
For each two opposing exhausted Spirits, this Spirit gains an extra Green Symbol.
BS42-073.flavor: The famous Gun Brave that can control winds, given to the King Beast Tribe as a present from the Noble Order.

BS35-065.name: The WindGod WisdomKing
BS35-065.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 2/4/6 Spirit. If you control [The WindGod WisdomKing] and [The ThunderGod WisdomKing], both braved, also, discard 15 cards from the opposing decktop.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While you control [The WindGod WisdomKing] and [The ThunderGod WisdomKing], both braved, the opponent can't use non-Blue Magic cards from their Hand.
BS35-065.flavor: Coming from the east to enter the competition, "Gandala". They're known for having a profound relationship with lord JadeEmperorDragon, who held the BSGP. Will they show the miracles of God this time around too?

BS14-X03.name: The WindHero Dorcus-Ushiwaka
BS14-X03.kanji: 風の覇王ドルクス・ウシワカ
BS14-X03.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed by the Opponent]
Exhaust two opposing Spirits. Then, if you have at least 8 cores total in your Field/Reserve/Trash, summon this Spirit card.

Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
At the end of the battle, by returning this Spirit to your Hand, during this turn, a Spirit you control gains +3000 BP.
BS14-X03.flavor: He split into eight!? No! His movements are just too fast!

BS63-033.name: The WindHornedBeast Windeer
BS63-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can put a core from the Void to any of your Spirit. Or, if you have three cards or less in Hand, you can reveal four cards from your decktop. Add a "Lampo" among them to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
If you have five counters or more, heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BS63-033.flavor: It was Gataru that stood in Lampo's way. However, he wasn't smiling at all. Manipulating the gigantic Annihilation Shell Deity, Gataru came right at Lampo.

PX21-05.name: The White Bearer of Core Light Gallet Revolt
PX21-05.kanji: 白の光主ガレット・レヴォ
PX21-05.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Purple/White & Proximate/Astroblazer & Cost 3 or more, "Bladra")]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2]
This Nexus's symbol is also treated as Purple.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
+1 core to this Nexus, and put one core from the Void each to two White Spirits you control.

[Grand Skill: 7] [LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send 7 cores from this Nexus to the Void) During this turn, every "Evil Shadow"/"Armed Machine" family Spirit you control gains an extra White symbol.

BS41-078.name: The White Holy Relic
BS41-078.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Draw Step)
Instead of drawing, reveal two cards from your decktop. Add one of the cards among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2] (Opposing End Step)
Put a core from the Void to any of your [During Advent] Spirit.
BS41-078.flavor:
One of the relics of the legendary Spirits who are called the "companions". It is placed right next to the two White pyroxene stones, and is the first relic discovered by Alex.
-from the Places of Interest 004/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

PX22-01.name: The White King
PX22-01.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (White & Cost 3 or more) (This Nexus can hold up to 5 cores)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)

Eminent figures were buried in these catacombs in the past. You should look around this site during the day, as it can be dangerous at night.

Draw a card from the deckbottom.

Morrigan! Keep your hands off the other factions' Grandwalkers, I say!
―Contractor Toa―

This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2]

BS69-032.name: The YellowTurbanPreacher Proacher-Choukaku
BS69-032.kanji: 黄巾の伝道師プローチャー・チョーカク

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Primordial"/"Gaudy Trooper" family Spirit attacks, heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV1][LV2] This Spirit cannot attack.

Lord is requesting an alliance with the moderates that oppose them. The belligerent faction headed by Kei vehemently disagrees and advocates resistance to the end. For once, I am in agreement with Kei. I feel sorry for Lord though...

BS05-079.effect:
[Flash]

The Holy Relic taken away by the traitor, Alice. A treasure that has a higher value than any precious gems.
-from the Places of Interest 005/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BS05-024.name: The Yojinbo Antman

It was so quick. From the moment the ant type intruder was attacked by a beast, another ant who came from nowhere sliced the beast in half.
-from the 4th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wander Lolo"-

BS32-044.name: The YoukaiBeast Nue

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)

BS32-044.flavor: Having shown his energy in the Battles of Kaminakajima, Kashaneko sought the next place where he could play a role.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13714.name: The YoukaiEmperor En'ou

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13714.flavor: "An Avatar of mine, one of the ten judges of purgatory, En'ou. Your destination has been decided"

BS32-X05.name: The YoukaiGeneral Kashaneko-Ikusa
BS32-X05.kanji: 妖戒大将カシャネコ・イクサ

BS35-049.name: The YoukaiPrince Kidracula
BS35-049.kanji: 妖戒王子キッドラキュラ
BS35-049.effect:

BS35-049.flavor: I've spotted Racer Kidracula of "Ghost Riders"! Would you let this lady listen to your story? Ah, he disappeared.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

BS54-032-A13724.name: The ZeroFlowerPrincess Miloslava

One of the "Ice Nobles" who lives on the "Giant Tower of Silver", and also the pilot of "Queen-Flawless".

BS53-X04.kanji: 零騎女王クイン・フローレス

BS64-081.flavor:
This is the first research city established at the dawn of Lecoulis when the savage lands were about to be developed. It is now, however, only a decayed place that is long forgotten.
―Travelogue of the Collapsing World 006―

Zodiac, the gift from the Genesis Dragons!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

Right in the middle of war, the commander of the opposing army raided the stronghold of the other camp alone and a failed assassination happened with betrayal towards the leader of the stronghold —- Even after experiencing such nonsensical turns of events, Manaka still kept an unwavering resolve.
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 647—

THURST-SHEPHERD.name: Thrust-Shepherd
THURST-SHEPHERD.kanji: スラスト・シェパード
THURST-SHEPHERD.flavor: Have we really arrived in the past? Those Tri-Dragon Deities are no joke. So we've got to search for the legendary Saviour here? Wait, so that story about creating entire continents is real and not just a fairy tale?

BS24-013.name: ThirdEyes-Snake
BS24-013.kanji: サードアイズ・スネーク

[LV1][LV2]

BS24-013.flavor: The surrounding energy is converging in that Spirit? Oh no, get Laten away from it! That snake is Laten's natural enemy!

BS68-034.name: Thunder-Yakko
BS68-034.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Blocks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, if you have five counter or less, your counter +1.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks, this Spirit refreshes.
BS68-034.flavor:
Stark, who was separated from Dan due to the attack from the Olym Primordial Deities, washed up in Artemis' world. It was a world of Machine Beasts. While walking on a wasteland shone bright in moonlight, a female appeared before Stark. And she was Artemis, the goddess of Moon, and the sister of Apollon.
-"Thenogonic Record" Fragment-

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13736.name: Thunder-Z-Bison
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13736.kanji: サンダー・Z・バイソン
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13736.effect:

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13736.flavor:
And thus... On the battlefield where fierce battles took place, an Emperor Beast that could sweep off ultimates appeared.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 2:49―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13737.name: This Is The Last One!
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13737.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed by the opponent]
Summon a Cost 6 or less "Unit-02"-named Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's flash effect.

BS71-011.name: Thunder-Z-Black Leopard
BS71-011.kanji: サンダー・Z・ブラックレオパルド
BS71-011.effect:

BS71-011.flavor:
Zeus, you say? I am just a passing-by old man with a bit of confidence in my strength. Hmmph, it looks like you are one man short.
―Grandwalker Zeus―

SD46-003.name: Thunder-Z-Grizzly
SD46-003.kanji: サンダー・Z・グリズリー
SD46-003.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Red Core][White Core][Core])]
Destroy an opposing Brave, and draw a card. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
