SD46-003.flavor:
Zeus' power as a Grandwalker would be shared with Lolo. By becoming Zeus-Lolo, he could directly offer his power to the Spirits of Grand-Lolo.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 4 Prologue 2―

BS71-002.name: Thunder-Z-Hedgehog
BS71-002.kanji: サンダー・Z・ヘッジホッグ
BS71-002.effect:
[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Z" to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards.
BS71-002.flavor:
The main force of the Primordial Deities, led by Uranus, had finally moved. Hades gathered all Grandwalkers of Olym to counter that. Then, Celtica Union, a remote faction, joined the battle. Dan, who was entrusted with Apollon's army, confronted the Star Destroyer Beast, and had a difficult time. There, however, came Toa, together with the Celtica Grandwalker, Brigit. The two thus managed to defeat the Beast. Meanwhile, Hera bit on Uranus' provocation and was driven into a corner. Dan and Toa came to Hera's rescue, and confronted Uranus.
―"Theogonic Record" Volume 4―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13741.name: Thunder-Z-Hippogriff
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13741.kanji: サンダー・Z・ヒポグリフ
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13741.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 5 ([Red Core][Red Core][White Core])]
Destroy any amount of opposing Spirits/Ultimates, up to a total of 8000 BP. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit, and draw a card. Effects of the Spirit destroyed by this effect can't activate.

P14-15.name: Ultimate-Jewelgα

We have already wasted 499 days. We cannot waste a single day more.
—Antarc, Revelations of the Apocalypse, 500 Days Remaining—

BS24-X05.name: Ultimate-Kaiseratlas

[Summon Condition: You control one or more Green Spirits]

When only the opposing Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by comparing BP, send an opposing Life to the Void.

SD22-X01.name: Ultimate-Kingtaurus
SD22-X01.kanji: アルティメット・キングタウロス

[Summon Condition: You control one or more Green Spirits]

When Ultimate Trigger hits, the opponent exhausts two Spirits they control. [Critical Hit] If the hit card is Cost 3 or less, also, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

For each core on this Ultimate, this Ultimate gets +1000 BP.
SD22-X01.flavor: This is bad, REALLY bad! The Ultimate's supremely hoppin' MAD! Crash! Boom!!

SD23-008.name: Ultimate-Kleio
SD23-008.kanji: アルティメット・クレイオ
SD23-008.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Yellow Spirits]

BS24-071.kanji: アルティメット・コリスタル
BS24-071.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Yellow Spirits]

BS24-071.flavor: Many of the Ultimates attacking this region can't have their strength measured just by looks.

[Summon Condition: You control one or more Purple Spirits]

When Ultimate Trigger hits, during this turn, all opposing Spirits with cards under them can't attack.
[utb]

BS30-X07.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control two or more Green/Blue Spirits]

[xutb]

[LV5] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't use Magic cards.

BS26-C077.kanji: アルティメットウィンド

King of the lions, now once show that gallantry before us!

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By paying two costs, refresh this Spirit.
PB08-CP03.flavor: The form which Leito Igaguri and Ultraman Zero, two of them combined into one, transform into after Neo Fusion Rise.

P21-08.name: Ultraman Zett
P21-08.effect:
The symbol and reduction symbols of this card/Spirit are also treated as Red/Blue.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
If you control another "Ultraman"/"Special Aircraft"-named Spirit/Grandwalker Nexus, draw a card and put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit. This effect can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor] / [Ultra Armor].
P21-08.flavor: A hot-blooded hero who embraces peace and justice second to none.

CB22-013.name: Ultraman Zett (Red Damage)
CB22-013.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット（レッドダメージ）
CB22-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve. Then, by banishing five cards from your decktop, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with two cores or less on it. If you have ten or less cards in deck, instead, destroy an opposing Spirit with four cores or less on it.
CB22-013.flavor: The form of Ultraman Zett being injured in battle and has its eyes reddened.

CB18-032.name: Ultraman Zett Alpha Edge
CB18-032.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット アルファエッジ
CB18-032.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Cost 4 or more "Ultraman"/"Special Aircraft"/"Juggler"/"STORAGE"-named card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] (Opposing Main Step)
When the opposing Hand increases due to an opposing effect, for each card increased, the opponent discards a card from their Hand.
CB18-032.flavor: A young Ultraman that the new member of STORAGE, Haruki Natsukawa, transforms into. He fights with Space Martial Arts inherited from his master.

CB18-033.name: Ultraman Zett Alpha Edge (CB18-033 (A))
CB18-033.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット アルファエッジ
CB18-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Besides Burst/Mirage effects, neither player can summon Spirit cards/Brave cards via originally Cost 3 or less effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Rebirth3]
When this Spirit blocks, or would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can flip it.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard an opposing Burst.
CB18-033.flavor: The inherited powers between a master and his disciple: transforms using the Ultra Medals of Zero, Seven, and Leo. Excels at speedy combat focusing on karate techniques.

CB22-036.name: Ultraman Zett Alpha Edge ［2］
CB22-036.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット アルファエッジ [2]
CB22-036.effect:
[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases due to opposing effects]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can put a core from the Void to your Trash.

[LV2]
When you're [adventing] a "Delta Rise Claw"-named card, this Spirit can become Cost 6.
CB22-036.flavor: Ultraman Zett's form obtaining the power from his masters, Zero, Seven and Leo. Using Zestium, its hissatsu technique, it fought with numerous Kaijus and Seijins.

CB32-020.name: Ultraman Zett Alpha Edge ［3］
CB32-020.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット アルファエッジ ［3］
CB32-020.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit attacks]
Send one core each from three opposing Spirits to the Reserve. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit with three cores or less on it. When you've done so, once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.
CB32-020.flavor: A young Ultra Hero that has become a member of the Inter Galactic Defense Force. He fought on Earth together with Ultraman Geed and defeated Gillvalis.

CB32-041.name: Ultraman Zett Alpha Edge ［4］
CB32-041.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット アルファエッジ ［4］
CB32-041.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Zero" with [Contract Advent] to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. Then, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Zero" Contract Spirit, your counter +1.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
For each counter you have, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
CB32-041.flavor: The disciple of Zero, a newbie Ultraman who is active on Earth.

PB41-002.name: Ultraman Zett Alpha Edge ［5］
PB41-002.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット アルファエッジ ［5］
PB41-002.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Ultraman Zett", (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Your counter +1. After this effect resolves, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a White "Ultraman"/"Special Aircraft" to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2]
Either set, or add to the Hand a "STORAGE"/"Zestium" revealed from the deck by this Spirit's effect.

CB18-034.name: Ultraman Zett Beta Smash
CB18-034.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット ベータスマッシュ
CB18-034.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core])]
Target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, your Life can't be reduced by that Spirit. After this effect resolves, either discard this card, or replace a White Cost 6 or less "Zett"/"Special Aircraft"-named Spirits you control with this card, in refreshed state.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit gets +2 costs. Also, when only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by BP comparison, refresh this Spirit.
CB18-034.flavor: Transforming using the Ultra Medals of Ultraman, Ace, and Taro, the brothers who built the legend. A type that is strong at heavy fights with power.

PB41-003.name: Ultraman Zett Beta Smash ［2］
PB41-003.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット ベータスマッシュ ［2］
PB41-003.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Ultraman Zett" & C2 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, once per turn, you can put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits. When core is put onto this Spirit via this effect, during this battle, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, you can send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

PB41-X02.name: Ultraman Zett Deathcium Rise Claw
PB41-X02.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット デスシウムライズクロー
PB41-X02.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Ultraman Zett" & C7 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Return any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of Cost 15 to the deckbottom, and for every 5 costs of the targets returned, discard a random card from the opposing Hand.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, this Spirit can refresh. When you've done so, you can send a core, besides [Soul Core], from the opposing Trash to the Void.

CB18-X05.name: Ultraman Zett Delta Rise Claw
CB18-X05.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット デルタライズクロー
CB18-X05.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 6 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom. If this Spirit has any White "Ultraman"-named pre-Advent card, this effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked. Also, while braved to any exactly-named "The PhantomWorldSword Beliarok", at the end of battle, send two opposing Lives to the Trash.
CB18-X05.flavor: The form achieved by Ultraman Zett through an Ultra Fusion using the Ultra Medals of Zero Beyond, Geed, and Belial Atrocious.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14163.name: Ultraman Zett Delta Rise Claw ［2］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14163.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット デルタライズクロー [2]
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14163.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 6 ([White Core][White Core][White Core][Purple Core])]
Discard three cards from your decktop, and for each White "Zett"/"Special Aircraft"-named card discarded, destroy an opposing Spirit with three cores or less on it. Then, draw a card. After this effect resolves, either discard this card, or replace a White "Zett"-named Spirit you control with this card, in refreshed state.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom. Also, if you control any "Special Aircraft"-named Spirit, this Spirit refreshes.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14163.flavor: The form born from the combination of medals that are strong while having complicated relationships with each other. It boasts the strongest power among all types of Ultraman Zett.

PC04-X02.name: Ultraman Zett Delta Rise Claw ［3］
PC04-X02.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット デルタライズクロー［3］
PC04-X02.effect:
Flash - [Advent: "Ultraman" & Cost 6 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
Once per turn, draw three cards, then discard two cards from your Hand. For each two costs of the total cost of cards discarded by this effect, send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, treat this Spirit's color as colorless, and return an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's to the deckbottom.
PC04-X02.flavor: Using Zestium Ray, he successfully stopped the dimension collapse caused by D4 Ray.

PB41-007.name: Ultraman Zett Delta Rise Claw ［4］
PB41-007.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット デルタライズクロー ［4］
PB41-007.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Ultraman Zett" & C5 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Return an opposing Brave to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, you can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with four cores or less on it.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
This Spirit's effect is treated as colorless.

CB18-037.name: Ultraman Zett Gamma Future
CB18-037.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット ガンマフューチャー
CB18-037.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 5 ([White Core][White Core][White Core])]
Return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, either discard this card, or replace a White Cost 6 or less "Zett"/"Special Aircraft"-named Spirit you control with this card in refreshed state.

[LV2][LV3] (When Blocks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, when only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
CB18-037.flavor: Good at long range battles, the power-up form of Ultraman Zett. While it is disadvantaged in close combats, it could use mysterious power to fight without approaching its opponent.

CB18-033-A14167.name: Ultraman Zett Gamma Future (CB18-033 (B))
CB18-033-A14167.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット ガンマフューチャー
CB18-033-A14167.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
You can summon a "Special Aircraft"-named card from your Hand/Trash without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
At the end of battle, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
CB18-033-A14167.flavor: New lights who forge hope: transforms using the Ultra Medals of Tiga, Dyna, and Gaia. A telekinetic battler who freely harnesses mysterious powers in addition to a variety of beam techniques.

PB41-005.name: Ultraman Zett Gamma Future ［2］
PB41-005.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット ガンマフューチャー ［2］
PB41-005.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Ultraman Zett"& C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

(Once per Turn: Same Name) If you have four counters or more, you can [Contract Advent] this card from the Hand, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents)
You can return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2]
When your "Special Aircraft" is summoned, send up to four cores from an opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void.

CB18-043.name: Ultraman Zett Original
CB18-043.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット オリジナル
CB18-043.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add an "Ultraman"-named card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as White.
CB18-043.flavor: A young Ultra warrior who admires Zero and became his disciple. Became a member of the Inter Galactic Defense Force after repeated hard work.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14170.name: Ultraman Zett Original［2］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14170.kanji: ウルトラマンゼット オリジナル ［2］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14170.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit. This effect can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Armor].
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14170.flavor: Originally chasing after the Barossa Seijin who took the King Joe STORAGE Custom, the Ultraman who came from another dimension.

PC03-X02.name: Ultraman ［Shin Ultraman］
PC03-X02.kanji: ウルトラマン［シン・ウルトラマン］
PC03-X02.effect:
(Can't Stack) When your Life is reduced by the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit, and when you can't destroy, you can return a "Spacium Ray" from the Trash to your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, you can put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Then, you can return this Spirit to the Hand.
PC03-X02.flavor: A silver giant that suddenly visits the Earth. It fought with Kaiju No.7 and defeated it.

CB32-CP03.name: Ultraman ［Ultraman: Rising］
CB32-CP03.effect:
This set card is unaffected by opposing effects.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Nexus' (When Summoned/Deployed) effect resolves]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw three cards, then discard two cards from your Hand. Including being in Soul State, if you control another "Ultraman"/"Emi", this effect discards -1 card.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit/Ultimate.
CB32-CP03.flavor: A different form of Ken Sato, the star baseball player.

CB01-042.name: Ultraseven
CB01-042.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as being exactly-named "Ultraman".

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost. During this turn, the opponent can't use Magic cards with a cost equal or inferior to that of the Spirit destroyed by this effect.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can deploy a Nexus card from your Trash, without paying the cost.
CB01-042.flavor:
Moroboshi Dan transforms by wearing the Ultra Eye. He protected the Earth from countless invaders.
―Ultraseven―

BS55-001.name: Umihiko-Dragon
BS55-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
If you have a set Burst, draw a card. This effect doesn't stack.

[LV2]
Your “Supreme Hero” family Burst can also activate at [Burst: con] (After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned) effect resolves).
BS55-001.flavor:
From what the "Three Heaven Deities" told us, this world was created by the two Grandwalkers, "Izanagi" and "Izanami". Never heard of those names.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 4:01―

BS69-006.name: Undersea Geozard
BS69-006.kanji: アンダーシー・ジオザード
BS69-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't stack) When your "Primordial" family Spirit attacks, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a BP equal or inferior to that Spirit's.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw two cards.
BS69-006.flavor:
Grandwalker Hermes' world, Hercadia, was located at the outermost part of Olym. And now, Gaia's force was approaching there.
―Theogonic Record Volume 2―

BSC26-028.name: Underwater Mode Mothra
BSC26-028.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
For each "Mothra"-named Spirit you control, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
BSC26-028.flavor:
In order to fight Dagahra, who specialized in underwater combat, Rainbow Mothra changed into this form by using the sun's energy to rearrange his own molecules.
―Mothra 2: The Great Undersea Battle―

CB15-073.name: Underworld
CB15-073.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When you use a "Kamen" & "Dark Artes" family Magic card/[Change], you can draw a card. This effect doesn't stack.

[LV2]
All "Kamen" & "Dark Artes" family cards in your Removed Zone/Trash are unaffected by opposing effects.
CB15-073.flavor: The "inner world" of humans that everyone possesses. Images that represent the hope of its owner would be projected, and there are no living things inside.

BSC25-031.name: Unicorn Demon-God
BSC25-031.effect:
This Brave doesn't exhaust, and while in Spirit condition, can't attack or block.

[When Braved on the Right] (When Attacks)
During the Flash Timing, you can use a Red Magic card from your Hand without paying the cost.

[When Braved on the Left] (When Attacks)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a Magic card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

CB29-005.name: Unicorn Gundam 02 Banshee Norn ［Awakened］
CB29-005.kanji: ユニコーンガンダム2号機 バンシィ・ノルン［覚醒］
CB29-005.effect:
This card is also treated as "Destroy Mode".

When your Life would be reduced by the opponent, if your Life is at two or less, by immediately activating this set card, your Life isn't reduced.

[Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can return a Red Spirit card/Brave card, besides "Banshee", from your Trash to the Hand.
CB29-005.flavor: Banshee who awakened in response to Riddhe's call.

CB16-010.name: Unicorn Gundam 02 Banshee Norn ［Destroy Mode Psyco-Field］
CB16-010.kanji: ユニコーンガンダム2号機 バンシィ・ノルン [デストロイモード サイコ・フィールド]
CB16-010.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks]
Destroy two opposing Spirits with one core or less on them. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with three cores or more on it.

[During Brave] [LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While braved to a "Riddhe" Brave, cores on opposing destroyed Spirits/Nexuses are sent to the Trash instead of the Reserve.
CB16-010.flavor: The power to defeat the Newtypes who are adapted to the Universe.

CB13-019.name: Unicorn Gundam 02 Banshee Norn ［Destroy Mode］
CB13-019.kanji: ユニコーンガンダム2号機 バンシィ・ノルン［デストロイモード］
CB13-019.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Treat this Spirit's color as colorless.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Brave. After this effect resolves, destroy an opposing Spirit with three or less cores on it.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send three cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve, and when depleted, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
CB13-019.flavor: As a man of the Marcenas family, and as an officer of the Earth Federation, he fought against Full Armor Unicorn and Kshatriya Repaired to protect Laplace's Box.

CB13-015.name: Unicorn Gundam 02 Banshee Norn ［Unicorn Mode］
CB13-015.kanji: ユニコーンガンダム2号機 バンシィ・ノルン［ユニコーンモード］
CB13-015.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Flash - [NT-D]
When any player controls a Spirit with at least two symbols, this Spirit can change places with a "Destroy Mode" Spirit card from your Hand in refreshed state. When you do, send all the cores from an opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, during this battle, an opposing Spirit's symbol become two Red symbols.
CB13-015.flavor: The form of Banshee equipped with Psycho-Frame to aid the activation of NT-D. Its pilot is Riddhe Marcenas. It assaulted Banagher who was on the way to the final coordinate.

SD54-X02.name: Unicorn Gundam 02 Banshee［Destroy Mode］
SD54-X02.kanji: ユニコーンガンダム2号機バンシィ［デストロイモード］
SD54-X02.effect:
When this set card is discarded by the opponent, you can activate it, ignoring the Burst condition.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy three opposing Spirits with two cores or less on them.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with five cores or less on it.
SD54-X02.flavor: Marita Cruz, reconditioned into being Ple Twelve, piloted it, but she's freed from that curse by Banagher and Zinnerman's influences.

CB27-001.name: Unicorn Gundam 03 Phenex ［Destroy Mode］
CB27-001.kanji: ユニコーンガンダム3号機 フェネクス [デストロイモード]
CB27-001.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 4 ([Red Core][Red Core])]
[During Set]
The symbols of all your "Gundam" with [NT-D] are fixed as two Red symbols.

[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
When your Red-only "Gundam" would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can summon this Mirage without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
When comparing BP, you can end the battle without comparing BP.
CB27-001.flavor: The golden unit 03 built upon the construction data of unit 01 and unit 02.

CB16-009.name: Unicorn Gundam ［Awakened Shield Funnel Equipment］
CB16-009.kanji: ユニコーンガンダム［覚醒 シールド・ファンネル装備］
CB16-009.effect:
When your Life would be reduced by the opponent, by returning three “Unicorn" from your Trash to the deckbottom, summon this card from your Hand, without paying the cost. When you've done so, during this turn, your Life can only be reduced by one.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing one-symbol Spirit/Nexus.
CB16-009.flavor: Unicorn 's shield is equipped with Psycho-Frame and I-field, while Beam Gatling Gun can be mounted on the inner side. Upon awakened, Unicorn can use this shield as funnels despite it lacking any thrusters.

CB29-X08.name: Unicorn Gundam ［Crystal Body］
CB29-X08.kanji: ユニコーンガンダム［結晶体］
CB29-X08.effect:
This card is also treated as "Destroy Mode".

Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
If there is any Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus with two symbols or more, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
During this turn, three opposing non-braved Spirits/Ultimates can't attack/block.

[LV2][LV3]
At the opposing End Step, or when this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, draw three cards, and banish this Spirit.
CB29-X08.flavor: The beast of possibility that becomes Singularity One.

CB13-013.name: Unicorn Gundam ［Destroy Mode Beam Gatling Gun Equipped］
CB13-013.kanji: ユニコーンガンダム［デストロイモード ビーム・ガトリングガン装備］
CB13-013.effect:
While the opponent doesn't control any "Sleeves" family Spirits, this card in your Hand is Cost 3.

[LV1][LV2]
Your "Unicorn" Spirits can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 6000 BP.
CB13-013.flavor: The equipment Banagher used when escaping from Palau. It was manufactered by Neo Zeon, but due to the Universal Standard, Unicorn can use it too.

CB13-010.name: Unicorn Gundam ［Destroy Mode］ (CB13-010 (B))
CB13-010.kanji: ユニコーンガンダム［デストロイモード］
CB13-010.effect:
[+0]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.
CB13-010.flavor: The Unicorn's transformed form when NT-D activates and it exposes the Psychoframes across its body. It's called the Parted Horn. It can only maintain this form for five minutes, and its performance also reaches extraordinary levels.

SD54-007.name: Unicorn Gundam ［Unicorn Mode］
SD54-007.kanji: ユニコーンガンダム［ユニコーンモード］
SD54-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. Among them, add every "Destroy Mode" to the Hand. Return the remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash- [NT-D]
When any player controls a Spirit with at least two symbols, this Spirit can change places with a "Destroy Mode" Spirit card from your Hand in refreshed state. When you do, destroy an opposing Spirit.
SD54-007.flavor: The beast of possibility, entrusted to Banagher Links by Cardeas Vist.

CB13-010-A14191.name: Unicorn Gundam ［Unicorn Mode］ (CB13-010 (A))
CB13-010-A14191.kanji: ユニコーンガンダム［ユニコーンモード］

You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Add a Red "Pilot" family Brave card among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] [Zero Rebirth]
During the Flash Timing of either Attack Step, if there is any Spirit with two symbols or more, you can flip this Spirit.
CB13-010-A14191.flavor: A White MS birthed by the UC Project, called the One-horned MS. The La+ Program built in it is said to guide True Newtypes to Laplace's Box.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14192.name: Unicorn Gundam［Awakened］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14192.kanji: ユニコーンガンダム［覚醒］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14192.effect:
When your "Pilot" family Braves are destroyed by the opponent, by returning all those Braves to the Hand, summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
The opponent can't summon Spirit cards/Brave cards via opposing effects/Burst effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, by paying one cost to summon a "Pilot" family card from your Hand, this Spirit refreshes.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14192.flavor: As if responding to Banagher Links's feelings, the phosphorescence turned rainbow in color.

SD54-X01.name: Unicorn Gundam［Destroy Mode］
SD54-X01.kanji: ユニコーンガンダム［デストロイモード］
SD54-X01.effect:

Destroy every opposing Spirit with two symbols or more.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit with the highest BP. When this effect destroys, this Spirit refreshes. At the end of battle, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
SD54-X01.flavor: Unicorn Gundam's true form, achieved after transforming upon the activation of NT-D. Its La+ guides Banagher Links to Laplace's Box.

CB02-040.name: Unimon
CB02-040.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Warp Digivolve: Yellow] (When Attacks)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Yellow "Ultimate" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -5000 BP. Destroy any Spirit whose BP is brought 0 by this effect.
CB02-040.flavor:
[Champion. Holy Beast. Vaccine]
A composite Digimon that has both the horn of the Unicorn, the legendary holy beast, and the wings of the Pegasus.

CB16-038.name: Union Flag
CB16-038.effect:
Flash - [TopG: Cost 1 ([Blue Core])]
If you control no Spirits other than Braves, you can summon this card from the Hand as Cost 1 ([Blue Core]).

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
At the end of battle, draw two cards, then discard a card from your Hand.
CB16-038.flavor: A transformable MS with flight capabilities. It was in this unit that Graham Aker first met Gundam Exia. While being suppressed in specs, his heart was taken.

CB23-009.name: Unit-13's Arm Unit
CB23-009.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) If you control any Purple "NERV" family Spirit, you can summon this card from the Trash.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
When this Spirit blocks, or is blocked, send a core from the opposing battling Spirit to the Reserve.
CB23-009.flavor: Units that are not unlike the arms of EVAs equipped with progressive knife. Multiple units of these surprised and attacked New Unit-02 and Revised Unit-08 at the NERV headquarters, toying the two EVAs with their speed, and destroyed Revised Unit-08's two arms via suicidal attacks.

P19-13.name: Unite Counter
P19-13.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck, you can add it to the Hand.

Besides via Burst effects, when the opponent summons a Spirit without paying at least one cost, you can immediately use the following effect of this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
█ Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 5000 BP. Effects of Spirits destroyed by this effect can't activate. After this effect resolves, by paying one cost, return this card to the Hand.

[Flash]
Return an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit to the deckbottom.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14198.name: United Power
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14198.effect: (Flash Step)(Your Main Phase) Exhaust an unexhausted spirit you control. In that case, target spirit you control gets + X BP until end of turn where X is equal to the exhausted spirits BP.

26RBS02-088.name: Unmask
26RBS02-088.effect:
[Soul Magic: p]
You can't use this card during Main Step.

[Flash]
Target a Purple Spirit you control. During this turn, give it +5000 BP. When this battle ends, destroy it.
26RBS02-088.flavor: Once the mask of pretence is removed, one's raw animal nature is laid bare.

SD54-015.name: Universal Century Charter
SD54-015.effect:
[Type: Field]
While on the field, all the following effects are active:
█ Neither player can put more than one core on each Grandwalker Nexus per turn.
█ When your [NT-D] activates, you can return this card to your Hand.

[Main]
Draw two cards. Then put this card on your Field.

P15-15.name: Unmasked Antarc
P15-15.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at three or less]

[LV3][LV4][LV5][LV6]
All "Investigator" family Spirits you control gain +5000 BP.

[LV4][LV5][LV6] (When Attacks)
[Soul Drive] If you banish the [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Ultimate from the game, you can reveal 20 cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon any number of "Investigator" family Spirit cards, without paying the cost. Discard any unsummoned or remaining cards.
P15-15.flavor: I wonder how all the Investigators are doing right about now? Maybe I should call them. If it's only for a little while… should be fine!

LM18-G07.name: Unmanned Train Bomb
LM18-G07.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total of 12000 BP. Or, heavy exhaust an opposing "Shin-Godzilla"-named Spirit. This heavy exhausting effect can't be prevented by any effect.
[heb]
LM18-G07.flavor:
To fight Godzilla whose movements had slowed down after being injected with Blood coagulant, bomb of such materials carried by unmanned train was used to attack it again and successfully brought it down.
―Shin Godzilla (2016) ―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14203.name: Upu-Aut
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14203.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks) You can summon a Cost 4 or less "Imaginary Beast" family Spirit card or a Yellow-only Saga Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost. When you've done so, draw a card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Neither player can make cores on this Spirit become 0.

[During Brave][LV3] (When Attacks) Return an opposing LV1/LV2 Spirit to the Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14203.flavor:
Horus imagined that center of the resistance to their uprising would come from Hermes. However, he was not the only enemy.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 3:05―

BS70-075.name: Uranus' Astral Night Temple
BS70-075.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Yellow Core])]
[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
When your Burst is set, if you control any "Contractor Uranus", during this battle, the effects of an opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus can't activate.

BS70-075.flavor:
Uranus' castle that floats in the night sky. Its surface is like a polished mirror, reflecting the lights of the stars, and inspiring awe in all who see it.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 978―

CB04-061.name: Urataros
CB04-061.effect:

[When Braved]

[When Braved] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.
CB04-061.flavor: Possessing Ryotaro, it can transform into Kamen Rider Den-O Rod Form.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14206.name: Urataros［2］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14206.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Den-O"-named card to your Hand, and put every "Ogre Wizard" & "Clown" family card, other than exactly-named "Urataros", onto your Removed Zone. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14206.flavor: One of the Imagine which has boarded into the DenLiner. Loves the ladies and is a charmer, he worked gathering intel and fooling enemies.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14207.name: Uriborg
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14207.flavor:
Peace has such a wonderful ring to it. I was delighted, and everyone rejoiced. However, it was all too brief... Due to the first invasion, the realm was frozen, and both the Singing Diva and the Braver were gone. Looking at the people's eyes, you could see that what they had lost was great. All that was left at the end of the victory was a world that had lost all hope.
-from the 14th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS36-048.name: Urimadillo
BS36-048.flavor: Racer Calamity-Boar has caused a lot of crashes with stampeding in this BSGP and has a generally poor record, but this time he has a decent start. Will his race be as flashy as usual now?

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14209.name: Usir Cobra
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14209.effect: [LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Reveal two cards from your decktop. Add either a Saga Brave card or a "Dark Snake" family Spirit card among them to your Hand. Discard the remaining cards. If this effect added "The DarkSnakeGrandstaff Ogdoad" to your Hand, send two cores from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14209.flavor:
Those close to Zeus were obviously aware of it, but none of them worried. After the military expeditions started, Zeus-Lolo realized indoctrinations en masse. He permeated even more just how powerful he was, and heightened his dominance. As such, he infiltrated his way into the hearts and minds of spirits, making it seem any possible rebellious intent had been dispersed.
―"Genesis Records" Grand Lolo Tale 10―

SD28-003.name: Usubaageha
SD28-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2] While your "Shellman" family Ultimates are battling, the opponent can't activate Bursts.
SD28-003.flavor: Lucky! I was able to jump on a flying butterfly's back! Antarc, come over here!

26RSD02-009.name: Utmost Depth: The Bloodrouse Mountain Range

26RSD02-009.flavor:
The inhabitants here believe that as long as that purple moon exists, they are immortal.
―from the Foreigner's Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

It is said that green water flowed out of this fissure and formed a vast sea.
―from the Foreigner's Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

26RSD06-010.flavor:
Some say that this tree draws energy from the forest, whilst others say that it distributes energy throughout the forest.
―from the Foreigner's Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

26RSD04-010.name: Utmost Depth: The White Heaven Plain
26RSD04-010.effect:

26RSD04-010.flavor: The white sun shone mercilessly upon the earth. Though its light gave strength to the soil and rocks, it was far too intense.

CB05-046.name: Veemon
CB05-046.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add one "Champion"/"Ultimate"/"Armor" family Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. Then, you can pay two cost to summon one Green "Champion" family Spirit card from your Hand.

CB05-046.flavor:
[Rookie. Small Dragon Type. Free Attribute]
Partner Digimon of Motomiya Daisuke.

26RSD01-010.name: Utmost Depth: The Windfang Crag

CB30-067.name: Vehicle Chemy Golddash

CB30-067.effect:

CB04-027.name: Utopia Dopant
CB04-027.kanji: ユートピア・ドーパント

Draw two cards.

CB30-061.name: Vehicle Chemy Steamliner

CB30-061.effect:
[LV1]

CB34-056.name: Vehicle Chemy Tenliner
CB34-056.kanji: ビークルケミー テンライナー

CB34-056.flavor: The Vehicle Chemy that transformed into level number 10 after refining Steamliner using ancient alchemy.

BS31-026.name: Uzulucky

P13-27.name: V-Long
P13-27.effect:

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.

26RBS03-021.name: Veilfall
26RBS03-021.flavor: In the hand that had been holding the spade, an axe was now clenched instead. His hands, which had been caked in mud and dried out, were now red and damp.

BSC29-016.name: V-V-Victory!!
BSC29-016.effect:

[Flash]
Destroy two opposing 4000 BP or less Spirits.

BS12-001.name: Veloci-Harpe
BS12-001.effect:
[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

The Solar Militia is gathering its forces for the next planned invasion at the Corpse Skyscraper. Standing at the head of this regiment is… the Sun Dragon Deity!!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

A cutting-edge apparatus that remains precise no matter how many hundreds of times it appears. No matter the age, its developer would gain much fame and fortune.
—from the Antlia chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BSC50-002.name: Veloci-Harpe LT

The Solar Militia is gathering its forces for the next planned invasion at the Corpse Skyscraper. Standing at the head of this regiment is… the Sun Dragon Deity!!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

[LV2]When Attacks

A cutting-edge apparatus that remains precise no matter how many hundreds of times it appears. No matter the age, its developer would gain much fame and fortune.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14239.name: Velotical Wind

CB02-031.name: Vademon
CB02-031.effect:

[Ultimate. Space Alien. Virus]
An Alien Digimon shaped like something that came from the far reaches of the cosmos. However, it is rumored that it was born from the seed of a plant. While hard to imagine from its overdeveloped head and octopus-like lower body, it carries terrifying offensive power.

BS24-002.name: Vajiriaxe
BS24-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +2000 BP. While you control any Ultimate, also, this Spirit gains +2000 BP.
BS24-002.flavor: Just when was the shadow in the sky first noticed? It was only recently that we found out it was an upside-down continent. We learned that the beings dubbed "Ultimates" came from that continent due to the testimony of a small lizard.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14242.name: Virgo Zodiarts
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14242.kanji: ヴァルゴ・ゾディアーツ

Treat every opposing braved Brave as Cost 0, and destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit.

By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] [Fast Draw: 1] (When Summoned/Advents)
Your counter +1. Then, by discarding one facedown card under your "The PartnerBurai Vrick", including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition, return an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the deckbottom.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.

Since we put if off until later, the Yellow Region had suffered the most damage, and we reasoned that it would take time to investigate. What really surprised us was that everyone was a lot more chipper than we would have imagined.

CB26-002.name: WILD TIGER

[Flash]

I know that there are no "ifs" in history. However, everyone has probably wondered this at least once: if there were no armistice in the Hero War, who would have won?
—Authentic History: Chronicles of Manaka, Year 647—

The Egytian forces kept their silence regarding the military expedition. There were two large reasons for that, one of them being the friendly relationship between the residents of the world which Osiris used to rule with Apollon. Thanks to it, they didn't wish for Egyt to return to what it was.
―"Genesis Records" New Volume 2:11―

-The Murmurs of Lapis, Future Days-

Your counter +1. Then, draw a card.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP. Also, if you control any Red Brave, destroy an opposing Nexus, and effects of the destroyed Nexus can't activate.
BS66-002.flavor: On Judgment Day, Dan used all powers of the Oracles, and sent his seven Contract Spirits to various places around Lecoulis to help. They have hence, however, suffered great damages, and couldn't move an inch until this point.

CB17-045-A14454.name: White Wizard (CB17-045 (A))
CB17-045-A14454.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can activate the Flash effect of a "Dark Artes" family Magic card from your Trash, without paying the cost. When you've done so, return that card to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] [Rebirth3]
When this Spirit attacks, by destroying another "Dark Artes" family Spirit, flip this Spirit.
CB17-045-A14454.flavor: Appeared before Haruto Soma, who was forced to join the Sabbath in the past, a magician shrouded in mystery that gave Haruto the Wizardriver, Wizard Rings and entrusted him with Koyomi.

BS31-066.name: Yarisquid
BS31-066.flavor:
The arbitration request must have been a godsend for Onmyou Territory. In these troubled times, if you immerse yourself in one conflict, you'll be hit from behind with a bang.
―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14456.name: Whiterock Hydra
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14456.effect:
When this card is sent to the Trash from deck by the effect of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Susanoo", you can summon it without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Cost 6 or more "Terra Dragon" / "Ocean Emperor" family Spirit attacks, during this turn, every exactly-named "Grandwalker Susanoo" you control is treated as being on LV2.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14456.flavor:
They had no idea if Tsukuyomi had been convinced or not. That will lead to a tragedy in the future, but there was nothing they could do at the moment. The battle between Zeus-Lolo, who just arrived on the battlefield, and Susanoo had started.
ー"Genesis Records" New Volume 3:14ー

BS36-040.name: Wolfboy
BS36-040.effect: When your symbolless Brave is summoned, you can summon this Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
BS36-040.flavor: At the very start of the race, melted chocolate flows onto the roadway, halting the grounded racers, and the flying racers are having a tough time getting caught in cotton candy clouds. On the other hand, "Delicious Cook"'s familiarity with the course gives them an excellent start.

BS17-055.name: Yasakani-Wing
BS17-055.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 4000 BP. If you control any [The SwordHero Sieg-Susano-Fried], instead, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 7000 BP.
BS17-055.flavor: When braved, the Sword Hero appeared several times larger.

CB32-058.name: Wide Zero Shot
CB32-058.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Including being in Soul State, if you control any "Ultraman Zero", during this turn, every opposing Cost 4 or more Spirit can't attack. Then by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a cost equal or inferior to your number of counters.

BS10-006.name: Yashium
BS10-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return a Spirit card/Brave card from your Trash to the Hand.
BS10-006.flavor:
Deep in the heart of the jungle, a stone circle suddenly emerges. There, a brilliantly colored crimson warrior tirelessly guards the premises; his oath sworn by faith does not forgive intrusion by anyone.
—from the Tucana chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14461.name: Wolvy
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14461.flavor:
Without greenery, they cannot live. They shared the fate of the forest.
-from the 15th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

BS11-082.name: Wig Bind
BS11-082.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, all opposing Spirits with printed effects can't attack nor block, and non-Yellow cards in Hand can't be used by the opponent.
BS11-082.flavor:
From ancient times, supernatural power has supposedly dwelt in long and beautiful hair. This power is at times pure, and at times repulsive. When power leans toward the latter, it takes on a dark will, and it's said that still-beating life will be dragged to the underworld...
—from the Comae Berenices chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BSC49-005.name: Yashium LT
BSC49-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can return a Spirit card/Brave card, or a "Galaxian" family card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Astral Soul"/ "Galaxian"/ "Emperor Beast" family Spirit attacks, you can destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to the target's.
BSC49-005.flavor:
Deep in the heart of the jungle, a stone circle suddenly emerges. There, a brilliantly colored crimson warrior tirelessly guards the premises; his oath sworn by faith does not forgive intrusion by anyone.
—from the Tucana chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

CB17-063.name: Wonder World
CB17-063.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you are summoning a "Fencer"/"Exalted Sword" family card, this Nexus gains an extra Red symbol.

[LV2] (Your Draw Step)
Increase the number of cards you draw by +1. After you draw, discard a card from your Hand.
CB17-063.flavor: An alternate world that looks as if it is from pages of a book. Amid the beautiful scenery, monsters are flying across the sky, right like the fantasy world from a book, expanding before one's eyes.

BS14-032.name: Yatsunokanzo
BS14-032.effect:
[LV1][LV2] 2 (When Attacks)
When this Spirit is blocked, the opponent exhausts two Spirits they control.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Give all your Spirits with [Windstorm]: "(When Attacks) When this Spirit is destroyed, return to the Hand every opposing Spirit exhausted by this Spirit's [Windstorm]."
BS14-032.flavor: On a plain gusting with violent wind, one giant bird was surrounded by troops. There was internal strife, but Lord's teaching was to ally oneself with the minority. I jumped onto Ikazuchi's back.

BS42-087.name: Wonderland
BS42-087.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Magician" family Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, instead of sending them to the Trash, you can put them onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
Your Life can only be reduced by one per turn per opposing Spirit/Ultimate with two or more symbols.
BS42-087.flavor:
The headquarters of Wonderland. While things are in a fuss and pretty messed up forever, the orders from the Queen are still lenient enough. I can feel the sadness of the underlings.
-from the Places of Interest 260/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-

BSC49-099.name: Wig Bind LT
BSC49-099.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, all opposing Spirits with printed effects can't attack/block. Also, by banishing five "Devotee" & "Galaxian"/ "Astral Soul" family cards from your Trash, during this turn, the opponent can't use non-Yellow cards from their Hand/Removed Zone.
BSC49-099.flavor:
From ancient times, supernatural power has supposedly dwelt in long and beautiful hair. This power is at times pure, and at times repulsive. When power leans toward the latter, it takes on a dark will, and it's said that still-beating life will be dragged to the underworld...
—from the Comae Berenices chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS69-002.name: Wood Geozard
BS69-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a “Primordial” family Nexus card, or a “Primordial” & “Concluser” family Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While you control a “Primordial” family Nexus, each of your “Primordial”/“Reptile Beast” family Spirits can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
BS69-002.flavor:
The vanguard of the primordial deities was Grandwalker Gaia. She was the Grandwalker who created the land of Olym, and was No. 2 among the primordial deities, just after Uranus.
―Theogonic Record Volume 2―

BS36-077.name: Wild Crash
BS36-077.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy an opposing braved Brave.
[During Seal] Also, during this turn, when your "Roaring Azure" family Spirits are blocked, discard three cards from the opposing decktop.

SD23-012.name: Yellow Alert
SD23-012.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -2000 BP. If this Magic card was used on the Opposing Turn, also, refresh a Yellow Spirit you control.

BS60-035.name: Wood Gorilla
BS60-035.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
If you have four counters or more, and you control any "The PartnerWolf Lampo", including being in Soul State/pre-advent, you can summon this card from the Hand as Cost 5.

Your counter +1. Then, for every two counters you have, heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Nexus.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP. Also, while you have six counters or more, this Spirit gains an extra Green symbol.
BS60-035.flavor:
Gorilla-san, can you lend us a hand? Ehehe, that's a great help!
―The PartnerWolf Lampo―

BS39-057.effect:

During this turn, an opposing Spirit can't attack/block.

Return a Yellow Magic card from your Trash to the Hand.

BS66-029.name: Wood Mandrill
BS66-029.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)

Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, while you control any "Petit Lampo", the number of cores on your "Jade Thunder" family Spirits can't become less than two due to opposing effects.
BS66-029.flavor: "You all are lookin' for that thing right?...What's da name again...? Thunde..Gadge? That's the thing that stabbed right into that rowdy fellow's head!"

BS52-073.name: Yellow Field
BS52-073.effect:
This card has "Primal" family.

[Type: Field] <sub>(While on the field, the following effects are active)</sub>
█ Every Grandwalker Nexus on the Field has zero symbols.

Reveal two cards from your decktop. Add a card among them to your Hand. Discard the remaining card. Then, put this card on your Field.

BS61-023.name: Wood Pony
BS61-023.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Your counters +1. Then, you can put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Your counters +2. Then, exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
BS61-023.flavor:
I've been playing with this magic user called "Gataru" the other day. Dan used a new Contract Advent power on me that time~
―The PartnerWolf Lampo―

BSC29-027.name: Yellow Hold
BSC29-027.effect:
If you control any "GreatAngelia"-named Spirit, the cost of this Magic card in Hand/Removed Zone becomes Cost 3.

Target an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. During this turn, that Spirit/Ultimate can't attack/block.

CB02-022.name: Woodmon
CB02-022.effect:

CB02-022.flavor:
[Champion. Plant. Virus]
A Plant Digimon with the appearance of a large, withered tree.

BS31-109.name: Yellow Recover
BS31-109.effect:
[Flash]
Refresh a Yellow Spirit you control. This effect can only be used once per turn.

BS06-032.name: Woodykong
BS06-032.flavor: Do you hear the Siren? We are in Danger!

26RSD08-011.name: Yellow Rise: The Swordian Performance
26RSD08-011.kanji: イエローライズ：ソーディアン公演
26RSD08-011.effect:
[team: Yellow Rise]

[LV1-2] Your Attack Step
All your attacking "Sword Eye" family Spirits gain +1000 BP.

[LV2]True Release Either Attack Step [Invoke: Flash]
If you used any "Sword Eye" family Magic card this turn, exhaust this Nexus ▶ Target an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit. Return it to the Hand.

BSH-002.name: World Collapse
BSH-002.effect: (Main) Destroy all opposing set bursts and all opposing Ultimates.

26RSD08-010.name: Yellow Rise Stage
26RSD08-010.kanji: イエローライズステージ
26RSD08-010.effect:
[team: Yellow Rise]

[LV1-2] Your Main Step
If you used any [Yellow Rise] Magic card this turn, this Nexus gains an extra Yellow symbol.

[LV2] Your End Step
If you used any [Yellow Rise] Magic card this turn, you can target a "Diva" family Spirit you control. Refresh it.
26RSD08-010.flavor: The stages, divided into six colours, will feature special effects for each new team! This is the stage for Yellow Rise, the new team that shines like a dazzling light illuminating the Divas' future. And the Divas are shining bright with the lighting effects.

BSH-005.name: World Release
BSH-005.effect: (Main) Move 3 cores from the void to the BSH player's reserve, and the BSH player draws 3 cards from their deck.

BS35-099.name: Yellow Sun

[Flash]

CB05-020.name: Wormmon

[LV2][LV3] [Digivolve: Green] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Green "Champion" family Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
CB05-020.flavor:
[Rookie. Larva. Free]
Ichijouji Ken's Partner Digimon.

CB32-055.name: Wrecking Burst
CB32-055.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When opposing Spirits/Ultimates are depleted by your "Fighting Spirit" family "Geed" effects, you can return this card from your Trash to the Hand.

[Flash]
Send two cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve. If you control any "Ultraman", this effect is also treated as an "Ultraman" effect.

[Core Charge: (Winged Beast/Ten Crown/God-King/Worldswalker/Avatar & Cost 3 or more) (Imagine Brave)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit/Brave, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

When this card is revealed from deck by your Green Spirit/Grandwalker Nexus effect, you can add it to the Hand.

[Grand Skill: 3] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)

[During Seal] [Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Winged Beast" family Spirit/Ultimate attacks, return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom.

CB24-023.name: Yoroi Gani
CB24-023.effect:
While this card is in your Removed Zone, all your "Armed Hibiki" are unaffected by opposing Spirit effects.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 5 ([Purple Core][Purple Core][Purple Core])]
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.
CB24-023.flavor: The powered-up form of being an Armed Disc Animal that Kihada Gani, one of the Disc Animals, obtained via the sound waves released by the Ongekizofukuken Armed Saber.

BS75-074.name: Wurm Draw
BS75-074.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When using this card, if you control any "Wurm", including those in Soul State/pre-advent condition, this card can become Cost 3.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a "Wurm" you control +5000 BP.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14490.name: Yoroibatta
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14490.effect:
Flash - High Speed - This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.
[Rush: White/Blue]
(While you have White/Blue symbols, the following effect activate next)
[White Core]: Return an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit to the Hand.
[Blue Core]: During this turn, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14490.flavor:
They don't have a commander... there's been trouble... deciding the successor... Wouldn't that small caterpillar be all right?... Or not?...
-The Murmurs of Rutile, Future Days-

BS20-016.name: Wybone
BS20-016.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to their Reserve.
[Rush: Red]
(While you have a Red symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Red Core]: You can target and attack an opposing Spirit.
BS20-016.flavor: Though its has no flesh, only bones on its body, it still retains its claim on its aerial domain.

BS24-022.name: Yoroifukurou
BS24-022.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2]
When cores would be removed from this Spirit by the opponent, by showing an Ultimate card in your Hand to the opponent, the number of cores on this Spirit can't become less than its LV1 cost.
BS24-022.flavor: Hard, armored, quick... um... amazing, annoying. ...It's useless, I can't rap. Maybe I just can't understand Laten after all.

26RBS02-019.name: Wyll-Gale
26RBS02-019.effect:
[LV1-2]During Attack/Block [Invoke: Flash]
Destroy this Spirit ▶ Target an opposing attacking/blocking Spirit. Send two cores, besides [Soul Core], from it to the Reserve.
26RBS02-019.flavor: "Please call me Wyll, Lady Babianaros. I'll prove myself more useful than that man."

BS24-021.name: Yoroikarasu
BS24-021.flavor: I don't know how I got appointed the leader of the six of us. But what I don't understand even more is Laten from the Green Region. I don't know anything about his history as a ninja descended from insects. I don't get what he says, and I have no idea what he thinks. What I really want to say the most is that I wish he would call me "Nord", not "maaan".

BS31-009.name: Yoroistego
BS31-009.flavor:
Combat Era, April 553. The SupremeRealmWisdomKing invaded the area where the Onmyou Territory ruled. Thus began an eleven-year struggle called the Battles of Kaminakajima.
―from the Kaminakajima Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―

SD27-002.name: Wyvern-Vela
SD27-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
By putting any number of "Galaxian" family Spirit cards/"Astral Deity" family Ultimate cards from your Hand to your Removed Zone, for each card put, draw one card.
SD27-002.flavor:
This isn't good! Asklepiooze was supposed to be sealed away, but it's gone.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

CB32-029.name: YouPi the Robot (YouPi)

BS24-039.name: Wyvernberyl
BS24-039.effect:
While you control any Ultimate, this Spirit card in Hand is treated as Cost 5.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Ultimate attacks, refresh this Spirit.

CB29-073.effect:

CB25-028.effect:

By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
You can exhaust two opposing Spirits. Then, you can return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
The effects of every opposing exhausted Spirit can't activate. Also, when your "Flash" family Spirit attacks, you can exhaust an opposing Spirit.

BSC44-003.name: Xochiquetzal
BSC44-003.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
+3 cores to one of your "Kukulkan" Grandwalker Nexuses. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
During this turn, your Life can't be reduced by the attack of opposing Spirit/Ultimate with two or less cores on them. Also, (Once per Game: Same Name) you can send a core, besides [Soul Core], from your Reserve to your Life.
BSC44-003.flavor:
So I will leave Dan-kun to you~ Since we've got something else to do. I wonder, who is the one that revived the primordial deities~? ―Grandwalker Kukulkan―
No problem, leave it to me! I will protect Dan! ―Grandwalker Kinich Ahau―

BS32-040.name: Yuki Girl
BS32-040.effect:
This Spirit card is also treated as a Magic card.

[Flash] (This effect can't be used while on the Field.)
When this battle ends, if your Life is at two or less, end the Attack Step.
BS32-040.flavor: According to the archives, when the Supreme Beast Army set up camp in Oukehazama, Gyuumonji had already been replaced by a Youkai.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14512.name: Yukisemi
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14512.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Put one core from the Void to your Reserve. Also, if your Life is at four or more, you can return this Spirit to the Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14512.flavor:
The power level of a Grandwalker is measured by how much history has been created since their world was created. The time that has passed, and the records passed onwards become the world's girth, and that in turn becomes the power of the Grandwalker which administers it.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 2:46―

CB07-020.name: Xuanwumon
CB07-020.effect:

While you control four or more "Mega"/"Plant Spirit" family Spirits, the opponent can't remove cores from their Spirits.
CB07-020.flavor:
[Mega. Holy Beast. Vaccine]
One of the Four Holy Beasts, guardian of the North, user of shapeshifting water skills.

BS37-011.name: Yabusame-Dragon
BS37-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

BS37-011.flavor: Racer Revol-Tiger has recovered from despair and is gaining at high speed as he scatters the forerunners with bombardment. He's lost all hesitation! He's running at full speed toward the goal!

[LV1][LV2]
This Nexus' symbol is also treated as Purple.

[Grand Skill: 3] [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When any opposing Spirit is depleted/destroyed, you can refresh a Red/Purple "Mega" family Spirit you control.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14516.name: Yagoisobana
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14516.effect:
Flash - High Speed - This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

(While you have a White symbol, the following effect activates next)
[White Core]: Return an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand.
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14516.flavor:
The insects are rampaging... they cannot be stopped... we must contact the other countries...
-The Murmurs of Rutile, Third Day of the Ninth Month-

BS14-061.name: Yagyurd-Jubei
BS14-061.kanji: ヤギュード・ジューベイ

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Supreme Hero" family Spirits are treated as being on their highest levels.
BS14-061.flavor: By a hair's breadth, he managed to return the opponent's unblockable attack! Oh no, he saw me!!

BS31-002.name: Yaibird

Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate, and draw a card.
BSC48-002.flavor: The influentials rose up in rebellion and the power of the Six Shogunate was reduced.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14520.name: Yak-Vehicle
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14520.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit can't be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV2]
Once per turn, when cores are increased from the Void via your [Core Charge] or an effect, during this turn, this Spirit gains an extra White symbol.

Artemis, who was rescued by Athena, is currently staying on the Fortress Temple.
"As usual, wherever I turn to, it's full of robots."
"You're the last person I want to hear that from, but yes, that's right."
"Oooh, that one over there, if you put five beam cannons on it, it'll be really cool."
"Rejected."

BS73-067.name: Yum-Kaax's Slime Mold Temple
BS73-067.kanji: ユム・カアシュの粘菌神殿
BS73-067.effect:
[LV1] [Rebirth2m]
When your "Fungal Bed" is destroyed, or this Nexus would leave the Field due to opposing effects, including being in Soul State, if you control any "Contractor Yum-Kaax", you can flip this Nexus. When you do, put a core from the Void to this Reborn Spirit.

(Can't Stack) Including being in Soul State, if you control any "Contractor Yum-Kaax", and you control four or less "Fungal Bed", you can send out one of your "Fungal Bed" Tokens.
BS73-067.flavor:
Yum-Kaaxi's temple that was built in Amahara before one knew it. Mushrooms grew around it and soon covered the entire surroundings. While it was hidden in the shadow of the great battle against Nyx, it is actually quite a big diplomatic issue.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 886―

CB10-013.name: Yurusen
CB10-013.effect:

This Spirit can't attack, block nor brave and is unaffected by opposing effects. Also, this Spirit's LV1 Cost is 0.
